Uncover the secrets of Spitalfields’ entertainment past, from a historic music hall to the inspiring efforts of Annie Besant, who stood alongside the striking ‘match girls’ in a fight for fair pay and working conditions—an act that influenced the modern trade union movement.

tours.name: Private Great Fire of London Tour
tours.description:
Step back in time to one of the most dramatic moments in London’s history: the Great Fire of 1666. On this captivating guided walk, you will follow in the footsteps of Samuel Pepys and others who witnessed the destruction of three-quarters of the city, forever altering its landscape.

Led by a London tour guide, this tour takes you through the narrow streets and historic landmarks that bore witness to the inferno. Learn how the fire began in a humble bakery on Pudding Lane before quickly engulfing churches, homes, and businesses. Discover the panic, heroism, and devastation that unfolded over four days as the City burned, and find out who was blamed for the disaster.

This tour also explores the lasting impact of the fire, from the introduction of new building regulations to the reconstruction of St Paul’s Cathedral under Sir Christopher Wren. Hear fascinating tales of survival, loss, and resilience, and uncover how some Londoners took advantage of the chaos for their own gain.

tours.name: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde: a Private Tour
tours.description:
Step into the shadows of Gothic London

Step into the gas-lit streets of Victorian London and uncover the eerie tale of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde. Set in the West End, particularly Soho, Robert Louis Stevenson’s gothic novella explores the duality of human nature—respectable society on one side, shadowy backstreets on the other.

This walking tour takes you through locations that mirror the novel’s descriptions, bringing London’s darker past to life. Led by a London tour guide Hazel, you'll gain insight into Stevenson’s inspirations, the contrasts of 19th-century London, and the anxieties that shaped his chilling story.

London in 1886 was a city of extremes—rapidly industrialising, filled with gas-lit alleyways, and home to both extreme wealth and desperate poverty. These stark contrasts added to the eerie atmosphere of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, making London itself feel like a character in the novel.

This walk is perfect for literature lovers, GCSE students, and those intrigued by the mysteries of London’s past**. Step into Stevenson’s world and experience one of literature’s most haunting tales.

Housed in a grand Romanesque building, the museum itself is a masterpiece, its cathedral-like architecture reflecting the grandeur of nature. tours.description:
Explore the vibrant streets of Soho, London’s historic entertainment district, on this private walking tour. Known for its theatres, music venues, and countercultural movements, Soho has been the epicenter of fashion, rebellion, and creativity for centuries. From Piccadilly Circus’s bright lights to the historic alleyways where rock legends, literary greats, and radical thinkers left their mark, uncover the stories that shaped this legendary neighborhood.

Stroll through Carnaby Street, the heart of Swinging Sixties fashion, where designers like Mary Quant and Vivienne Westwood transformed British style. Pause at the Broad Street Pump, where Dr. John Snow’s groundbreaking discovery changed public health forever. Walk along Old Compton Street, home to London’s LGBTQ+ community, and hear the story of the Admiral Duncan pub, a landmark of resilience. Discuss the district's nobility at Soho Square, before reaching Chinatown, where authentic restaurants and cu
highlights:
Golden Square
Step into Golden Square, a hidden gem with a rich aristocratic past, now home to some of London’s most influential media and creative businesses.

London Palladium
Pass by the legendary London Palladium, one of Britain’s most famous theatres, where Charlie Chaplin, The Beatles, and modern-day stars have graced the stage.

Carnaby Street
Wander through Carnaby Street, the beating heart of Swinging Sixties fashion, where designers like Mary Quant and Vivienne Westwood revolutionized British style.

The Broad Street Pump
Visit the Broad Street Pump, where Dr. John Snow’s discovery of contaminated water changed the course of public health history.

Berwick Street Market
Explore Berwick Street Market, a vibrant street market dating back over 200 years, known for its independent traders, record shops, and food stalls.

Meard Street
Stroll down Meard Street, a charming Georgian-era street that has long been a haven for artists, activists, and writers.

Dean Street
Walk along Dean Street, once frequented by Karl Marx, Oscar Wilde, and The Rolling Stones, and hear the stories of Soho’s rebellious past.

Soho Square
Take in the tranquil greenery of Soho Square, surrounded by historic buildings and the creative studios that keep Soho’s bohemian spirit alive.

tours.name: Natural History Museum of London Guided Tour - Private (ENGLISH)
tours.description:
Step into the Natural History Museum, one of London’s most awe-inspiring institutions, where the wonders of the natural world come to life. From towering dinosaur skeletons to rare gemstones, this private tour explores the museum’s most remarkable treasures.

Housed in a grand Romanesque building, the museum itself is a masterpiece, its cathedral-like architecture reflecting the grandeur of nature. In the vast Hintze Hall, gaze up at Hope, the 25-meter-long blue whale skeleton suspended from the ceiling. Then, in the Earth Hall, come face to face with Sophie the Stegosaurus, one of the most complete Stegosaurus skeletons ever discovered. Discover Cheddar Man, Britain’s oldest known human, before beholding one of the most significant books in scientific history—a first edition of Darwin’s On the Origin of Species, which revolutionized our understanding of evolution.

tours.name: Private Greenwich Walking Tour
tours.description:
Come and see some of the finest and most important buildings in England.

Greenwich was for centuries the ceremonial entrance to the capital from the river. It was the site of one the most important Tudor palaces, and later of the Royal Naval Hospital where a collection of the greatest names in English architecture worked, including Wren and Hawksmoor.

In the middle of the hospital is the Queen’s House, which introduced Italian renaissance architecture to England, and in the park is the Royal Observatory, where Charles II’s Astronomer Royal John Flamsteed mapped the night sky.

The presence of the palace, and then the sailors ensured a rich and various history for the town. Explore Greenwich’s magisterial and its seedy sides, and hear about its literary connections on this fascinating walking tour.

tours.name: 剑桥校友伴你行 - 剑桥大学步行导览 & 康河撑篙游船之旅（私人小团）
tours.description:
通过这项结合 步行导览与康河撑篙体验 的行程，从多个角度探索剑桥，全面了解这座城市的历史、学院与传统。

行程首先由剑桥大学学子或具有学术背景的专业导游带领进行步行导览。沿着剑桥历史悠久的街道前行时，您的导游将介绍剑桥大学独特的学院制度，并分享学生生活、著名校友、学院竞争以及延续 800 多年的校园传统。

在导览途中，您将经过剑桥最著名的学院，包括 国王学院、三一学院和圣约翰学院，了解这所大学如何发展成为世界最具影响力的学术中心之一。

希望进一步丰富体验的客人可以选择 升级进入国王学院礼拜堂（视当天开放情况而定）。在导游的历史与建筑背景介绍之后，您将有机会走进这座世界最著名的哥特式礼拜堂之一。

步行导览结束后，行程将在 康河 上继续展开。客人将前往 Mill Lane 靠近 Mill Pond 的撑篙码头 Punting Station，参加由 Scudamore’s 运营的拼船撑篙体验。Scudamore’s 是剑桥历史最悠久的撑篙公司，也是 Alumni Tours 的长期合作伙伴。

经验丰富的船夫将带领您沿着著名的 The Backs 学院后园河段 前行，并现场讲解河岸两侧的学院建筑、桥梁、花园以及大学传统。

在宁静的河面上缓缓滑行，穿过历史悠久的桥梁，从全新的角度欣赏优雅的学院建筑，这是剑桥最具代表性的体验之一。

这项 步行导览与撑篙组合行程 将历史故事讲解与轻松的康河游览完美结合，非常适合希望在一次体验中全面了解剑桥的游客。

A focused introduction to British government, monarchy, power and protest, ideal for History, Politics, Citizenship and International Relations groups.​

Step into the shadows of Gothic London

Step into the gas-lit streets of Victorian London and explore the unsettling world of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde. Set in the West End, particularly Soho, Robert Louis Stevenson’s Gothic novella examines the dual nature of humanity—respectable public life contrasted with darker, more unsettling streets.

This curriculum-linked walking tour explores locations that reflect the atmosphere and themes of the novel, helping students connect the text to its real-world setting. Led by an experienced London guide, Hazel, the walk provides valuable context on Stevenson’s inspirations, Victorian society, and the social anxieties that shaped this enduring work of literature.

London in 1886 was a city of sharp contrasts: rapid industrial growth, gas-lit alleyways, great wealth alongside extreme poverty. These conditions helped create the tense and unsettling backdrop of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, with the city itself feeling almost like a character in the story.

tours.name: School group: Private Financial London Tour
tours.description:
Financial London Tour

Bring business and economics to life with an on-foot exploration of the City of London, where global finance has been shaped over hundreds of years. This curriculum-linked walking tour is designed for teachers bringing GCSE, A level, IB or college students studying business, economics or finance.

Explore London’s Financial Legacy

Step into the heart of the City of London, where fortunes have been made—and lost—for centuries. This guided walk takes your students through the narrow alleys and grand institutions that helped shape London into one of the world's leading financial centres, making clear links to topics such as financial markets, sources of finance, risk and globalisation.
Discover the origins of the stock market, insurance and banking, and see how these industries continue to drive the UK and global economy today, reinforcing classroom learning with real-world examples.

What Teachers and Students Can Expect

Walk through historic alleyways where 17th- and 18th-century deals laid the fou
highlights: Walk through historic alleyways where 17th- and 18th-century deals laid the foundations of modern finance, ideal for discussing enterprise, risk and the growth of financial institutions.
Learn how equities, bonds, commodities and insurance first emerged, how they are traded today, and why these markets matter for businesses, governments and consumers.
Hear the stories of financial pioneers who built empires—and those who lost everything—prompting discussion around speculation, bubbles, regulation and ethical decision-making.
Gain expert insights from a Qualified City of London Guide who is experienced in adapting explanations for different academic levels and linking content explicitly to curriculum themes.
Meeting Point – Arrive at Cannon Street Station (exact details provided upon booking).

tours.name: Changing of the Guard Guided Walking Tour – Semi-Private (ENGLISH)
tours.description:
Experience one of Britain’s most iconic traditions on this small-group walking tour through historic Westminster. With an expert guide, uncover the history behind the Changing of the Guard Ceremony as you witness this spectacular display of pageantry and precision.

Begin in the monumental Trafalgar Square, then follow the Royal Guard as they march in full ceremonial dress, accompanied by the rhythmic beat of military drums. Admire their perfectly groomed horses and distinctiv uniforms—scarlet tunics and towering bearskin hats—as you pass through Admiralty Arch, past St. James’s Palace, the most senior royal residence in Britain, and onto the historic parade grounds. Your guide will share stories of Britain’s most revered monarchs as the New Guard replaces the Old Guard in this centuries-old tradition. Conclude your tour with views of Buckingham Palace, where the guards arrive at their final post.

You will also experience the traditional English moorland villages of Hutton-le-Hole and Goathland (Heartbeat and Harry Potter filming location) and travel back to York through the Howardian Hills, passing by Castle Howard. tours.name: Quirky Westminster Private Tour
tours.description:
Westminster is known for its grandeur—Big Ben, Parliament, and Buckingham Palace—but beyond the famous landmarks lies a world of peculiar history, oddities, and architectural curiosities. This 90-minute walking tour takes you on an unconventional journey through the quirky side of Westminster, revealing the strange, the unexpected, and the downright bizarre.

Starting in Covent Garden, we’ll explore secret sculptures, peculiar street art, and stories of eccentric Londoners who have shaped the city in their own unique ways. You’ll step into a secret alleyway barely wide enough to walk through, hear tales of historical pranks and mysterious monuments, and discover how seemingly ordinary locations hide remarkable secrets.

As we weave through the streets towards Trafalgar Square and Admiralty Arch, you’ll see how history has left behind its quirks—whether it’s a missing statue, an architectural mistake, or an unusual wartime relic. From an ear embedded in a wall to a hidden nose on a historic arch, this tour proves that London is full of surprises—if you know where to look.

Ending near St James’s Palace, this tour offers a fresh perspectiv

Engaging Storytelling – Your expert guide will bring history to life with fascinating anecdotes, humorous tales, and little-known facts.
Plenty of Walking – This is a 90-minute walking tour, covering approximately 1.5 miles (2.4 km) with stops along the way. Expect to be on your feet for most of the experience.

tours.name: LGBT+ Westminster Private Tour
tours.description:
Step into the heart of London’s LGBT+ history on this fascinating 90-minute walking tour through Westminster. From clandestine meeting spots to grand royal palaces, uncover the untold stories of love, defiance, and resilience that have shaped the LGBT+ experience in Britain’s capital.

As we stroll from Embankment to Parliament Square, you’ll discover:

The secret lives of monarchs, including King James I/VI and his beloved companions, reveal how attitudes towards sexuality have evolved over the centuries.

The tragic yet inspiring story of Oscar Wilde, a literary genius whose persecution highlights the struggles and triumphs of queer identity.

The extraordinary tale of the Chevalier d’Éon, a trans fencer and diplomat who challenged 18th-century gender norms.
The role of ‘molly houses’ and hidden spaces like St James’s Park, which provided sanctuary to those who dared to love in a time of criminalisation.

The sacrifices and contributions of LGBT+ individuals in wartime Britain, including Alan Turing, the war hero condemned by an intolerant society—his story leading to ‘Turing’s Law’ and the eventual recognition of past injustices.

tours.name: Private Smartphone Photo Tour: Tower Hill
tours.description:
Tips on great spots for photographing some of London's most iconic landmarks!

If you love London's architecture around the area of Tower Hill and want to improve your photography skills on your smartphone, then sign up to Alastair's smartphone photo walk.

Alastair, a professional photographer will be your expert guide. He will lead you around the area getting the best views and explore the key aspects of it's architectural history and design.

During your Tower Hill smartphone photo walkshop, Alastair will set photography challenges, nurture your photographic eye and help you develop a better understanding of what makes a great photo. You will receive insider tips on great spots for photographing some of London's most iconic landmarks.

At the end of the 2 hour tour you will have gained a collection of photos you will feel proud of and having gained insight as to how to improve your smartphone photography.

tours.name: Churchill and World War II : a Private Tour
tours.description:
An informative and at times moving walk looking at the history of World War II looking especially at Winston Churchill but also others who contributed to the war effort and in some cases paid the ultimate sacrifice.
Duration

90 minutes

About

Embark on a private tour into the heart of London, a city forever intertwined with the life and legacy of Winston Churchill. Guided by your qualified London guide, Maggie / Philip, traverse the corridors of history to understand this towering figure's connection to the city, particularly the district of Westminster, where he lived, worked, and is now remembered.

Journey back in time to the places that played a significant role in Churchill's life, from the Palace of Westminster, the stage for his most riveting speeches, to the quaint St Margaret's Church, where he exchanged wedding vows. This exclusive walk will offer insights into Churchill's political career, his two terms as Prime Minister, and the rare honour of a Lying In State and State Funeral - events that were deeply etched in the annals of London.

In Parliament Square, stand in front of Churchill's statue, a monument with a story as compelling as the man himself. Radcliffe Camera 拉德克利夫图书馆

Sheldonian Theatre 谢尔登剧院

tours.name: School group: Private Great Fire of London Tour
tours.description:
Step back in time to one of the most dramatic moments in London’s history: the Great Fire of 1666. On this captivating guided walk, you will follow in the footsteps of Samuel Pepys and others who witnessed the destruction of three-quarters of the city, forever altering its landscape.

Led by a London tour guide, this tour takes you through the narrow streets and historic landmarks that bore witness to the inferno. Learn how the fire began in a humble bakery on Pudding Lane before quickly engulfing churches, homes, and businesses. Discover the panic, heroism, and devastation that unfolded over four days as the City burned, and find out who was blamed for the disaster.

This tour also explores the lasting impact of the fire, from the introduction of new building regulations to the reconstruction of St Paul’s Cathedral under Sir Christopher Wren. Hear fascinating tales of survival, loss, and resilience, and uncover how some Londoners took advantage of the chaos for their own gain.

Perfect for history lovers and curious explorers alike, this immersive experience will bring the Gre
highlights: A focused introduction to one of London’s most famous disasters, ideal for History, Geography and Citizenship groups.
Site‑specific stories about Samuel Pepys, Londoners, and key figures of the 1666 fire, helping students visualise life in the city and how events unfolded.
Discussion prompts on urban planning, fire prevention, and the social, economic and architectural impact of the fire on London’s rebuilding.
Meeting Point – Arrive at Monument Station (exact details provided upon booking).

Accessibility – Route includes cobbled streets and uneven surfaces; please contact us in advance to discuss specific access needs or adaptations.
Walk through the streets of the City of London where the Great Fire of 1666 began and spread, exploring key sites including Pudding Lane and the path of destruction.

tours.description:
Discover the complete story of England on this fully guided 2-hour walking tour designed to give visitors a clear, engaging, and chronological understanding of English history. Led by an expert local guide, this immersive experience traces England’s journey from Roman Britain through Saxon and Norman rule, medieval monarchy, religious change, empire, and the formation of the modern English state.
This immersive experience begins with a 2-hour guided walking tour offering an accessible and engaging introduction to the history of England. Starting outside St Paul’s Cathedral, guests are introduced to Roman Britain, early Christianity, and the long relationship between religion and power in English history.

tours.name: Liverpool Beatles Walking Tour
tours.description:
Discover how The Beatles became The Beatles - in the city where it all began.

This small-group walking tour starts at Liverpool’s iconic waterfront and follows a carefully designed route through the streets that shaped the band’s rise. Rather than simply visiting famous locations, your expert guide brings together the people, places and moments that turned a local group into a global phenomenon.

From the influence of the docks and the Mersey Ferry to Brian Epstein’s record store and the Cavern Club, this is a connected story of Liverpool’s music scene — and the role it played in changing music history.

With a maximum of 12 guests, the experience remains personal, engaging and rich in detail throughout.

What's included

Story-led experience – understand how the Beatles happened, not just where they went

Small groups (max 12 guests) – more interaction, better guiding

tours.name: Bleeding Hearts and Body Parts Walk
tours.description:
London’s history is steeped in blood, betrayal, and mystery. Join us on a journey through Farringdon and Smithfield, where the echoes of public executions, rebellions, and gruesome crimes still haunt the streets.

Beneath the historic streets of Farringdon and Smithfield lies a past stained with blood. This was a place of disease, rebellion, and religious turmoil—where martyrs were burned, criminals met their end, and the unfortunate simply disappeared. The cries of the condemned once rang out from execution sites, while plague pits swallowed thousands of nameless dead.

On this chilling journey, we peel back the layers of history to reveal London’s dark heart, where cold-blooded murder, public executions, and the dismembered remains of the past tell the

Accessibility – The walk includes some very narrow walkways, steps and cobblestoneNo Step-free route available.If you have any concerns, please get in touch before booking.
Introduction & Welcome - A warm welcome and an overview of what to expect on the tour. Brief historical context of Farringdon and Smithfield.
Public Executions at Smithfield - Stand where London’s condemned met their fate. Learn about gruesome executions, from heretics burned at the stake to traitors hanged and quartered.
William Wallace & the Peasants' Revolt - Discover how a revolt against the monarchy ended in bloodshed.
Bleeding Heart Yard & the Lady in Red - Hear the chilling legend of Lady Elizabeth Hatton. Uncover why her still-beating heart was allegedly found on these streets.

About

The Tour is based on the History of the City, and its architecture it also covers several aspects of English Language, and the origins of phrases we take for granted.

The duration is around 2 hours, and it's a gentle walking pace around the city. Canterbury's history stretched back over the millennia, from pre-roman settlement to the present day city bustling with visitors, students, and locals alike. The footsteps of Pilgrims and parsons are etched into its fabric and the tour takes you in their footsteps. The tour is fully accessible for anyone in a wheelchair or with mobility issues, which given my work with the elderly I feel it's important to be inclusive.

As it's a walking tour, on city streets, just be sure to wear comfortable walking shoes and be sure to dress for the English Climate, i.e. on a sunny day bring an umbrella, just in case.

I am very pleased to announce that the book to accompany the tour is now available to download in 'Kindle Fire' Format or in 'Paperback' format from Amazon worldwide. A link will be provided in your confirmation email.
I look forward to showing you around my beautiful city.
It makes a perfect souvenir too.

Kind Regards
John

tours.name: Private Secrets of Belgravia
tours.description:
Belgravia is one of the most expensive places to live in London. Hear how an area of swampland became ripe for development, which eventually became the must have address for the members of the ruling class.

Actors and TV celebrities have long made a beeline for Belgravia when searching for a London home.

Joan Collins, Sir Michael Caine, Sir Lawrence Olivier, Christopher Lee and Vivien Leigh have all lived in Belgravia plus many more notables.

More recently, Belgravia has attracted Noam Gottesman, founder of Mayfair hedge fund GLG, investment guru George Soros, advertising and art dealing millionaire Charles Saatchi and his wife Nigella Lawson plus CarpetRight founder Lord Harris of Peckham.

Hidden backstreet pubs, quaint cobbled streets and garden squares add to the character of this exclusive area.

Impressive mansions and townhouses take pride of place, but also there was also a large domestic servant population that worked tirelessly to keep the owners households running.

tours.description:
Get your bearings and discover Liverpool on an exclusive private tour, with your own local, expert guide.

Over 1.5 hours, you’ll not only uncover Liverpool’s past but also get an authentic glimpse into what it means to be a Liverpudlian today. Along the way, explore hidden gems and iconic landmarks, from the legendary docks and the city’s Titanic connections to the famous mythical Liver Birds and, of course, The Beatles! tours.name: Composers of the West End
tours.description:
A music-themed private tour, touching on the lighter side, about composers connected with the Strand and some of the places where their music was performed.

Not only does this private walking tour cover a variety of classical composers but also theatre and opera productions plus some performance venues in London's  West End.

Hear how European influences, including  George Frederic Handel and other notable composers helped secure the future of London's increasingly sophisticated classical music scene and how that created popular offshoots in operetta and musicals.

Enjoy walking through Regency London with its wide straight streets and square. Marvel at the neoclassical theatre designed by architect John Nash before embarking on the Victorian centre for entertainment before finishing in iconic Covent Garden.

tours.name: Oxford On Screen Walking Tour
tours.description:
Join us for an Oxford On Screen Walking Tour

Oxford naturally lends itself as a backdrop for the movie and TV screen and reflects why VisitBritain latest promotion campaign is called “Starring Great Britain”.

The city has been the host of over 40 movies and 7 TV series, and is synonymous with 102 episodes of Inspector Morse, Lewis and Endeavour. The city and its historical university naturally lend itself as the inspiration and backdrop for many stories on screen.

Our expert and passionate guides will show you around the most famous landmarks that have been immortalised on screen, from the Radcliffe Camera in Emerald Fennel’s Saltburn, to the Bodleian Library in Harry Potter, and share the titbits and anecdotes that filming in Oxford can bring.

Tread in Inspector Morse’s footsteps around the pubs of Oxford, follow Lyra (His Dark Materials) around the colleges, and eat with the vampires (A Discovery of Witches) in the historic Covered Market.

Suitable for all ages, whether you are a “set-jetting” cinephile

Conclude your tour with views of Buckingham Palace, where the guards arrive at their final post.

Southwark has long been a gateway to London, a place where medieval pilgrims gathered, Shakespearean theatre thrived, and some of the city’s most intriguing figures left their mark.

This 90-minute guided walk uncovers hidden histories, literary connections, and remnants of the past, revealing the area's significance beyond its modern-day vibrancy. Discover how Southwark became the entertainment hub of Tudor London, with its playhouses, taverns, and bear-baiting pits drawing crowds from both sides of the river. Explore a surviving 17th-century galleried inn mentioned by Dickens, and find out why pilgrims, playwrights, and prisoners all had their place in Southwark’s past.

tours.name: Private Intimate Churchill's London & War Rooms Museum Tour
tours.description:
Winston Churchill plotted our victory from the streets of London
On this deeply personal tour, we will visit the lesser-known streets, shops and buildings which played a huge role in Churchill's life and self-image. You'll check out the shop where he purchased his iconic cigars, stand in the military parade ground with its own hidden WW2 communications centre, visit the wine merchant with cellars running beneath the street, and take in the social clubs of which he was a member.

Hear about his relationships to his wife Clementine and President Roosevelt, his life as a young soldier, and the stories of valour and predestiny which shaped his journey to become the man of the hour.

And then for the mind blowing trip into the Churchill War Rooms. Here your guide will accompany you through London's most atmospheric and haunting museum, literally entering a time capsule from London in the War.

Samuel Pepys was more than just a diarist—he was a keen observer of 17th-century London, a naval administrator, and a man who lived through some of the city's most dramatic events. His vivid accounts provide an unparalleled glimpse into the Restoration era, covering everything from royal scandals and public executions to the Great Plague and the Great Fire.

Step into Pepys’ London – Explore the city through the eyes of one of its most famous chroniclers.

Surprising Tales – Discover lesser-known aspects of Pepys’ life, from imprisonment and attempted mugging to encounters with exotic animals.

tours.name: The Anglo-Saxon World at Bamburgh and Lindisfarne
tours.description:
The capital of Northumbria and the cradle of Christianity!
About

Since pre-history Bamburgh and Lindisfarne have had human settlements. As a fortress of the Kingdom of Northumbria Bamburgh was the centre of the largest Kingdom in England during the 7th and 8th centuries. In the middle ages, the Castle developed as an important fortress against Scottish attack - eventually developing into the impressive fortification you see today. Lindisfarne is famous for both the Lindisfarne Gospels and being one of the first locations in the United Kingdom to be attacked by the Vikings. It is called the cradle of English Christianity due to the importance of the monastery in the dark ages. Due to the tides, the tour may go to Lindisfarne at different times to enable safe crossing and return to the mainland. 当夜幕降临、游客散去，剑桥呈现出完全不同的氛围。

About

In the depths of the jungle, two tribes have been at war for a very long time, the Watchati tribe and the Watchatchu tribe.

To settle their differences they have decided to marry off the prince and the princess from either tribe. They need the help of a sacred white bat, the ‘shikaka’, which is an important part of the ceremony. Unfortunately, someone has kidnapped the bat!

tours.description: Uncover the dark secrets of Victorian Whitechapel on a gripping 2-hour tour. Walk historic sites, see original photos, hear chilling stories, and explore the mystery behind Jack the Ripper and his victims.

tours.name: Giant's Causeway Private Full Day Tour
tours.description: Explore Northern Ireland’s stunning coast, walk the Carrick-a-rede Rope Bridge, visit the ancient Giant’s Causeway, and enjoy charming villages and castles—all in a private, customizable 8-hour tour with top guides.

tours.name: First Class Return Travel with Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Savor a scenic Yorkshire Dales train ride in First Class, complete with freshly made sandwiches, mini quiche, scones with clotted cream, and Yorkshire tea. A perfect, indulgent afternoon escape.

tours.name: GEORGIA - NEW OPEN WHITE MOTOR BOAT
tours.description: Enjoy a peaceful river trip with a spacious, easy-to-handle electric boat. Bring a picnic, spot wildlife, and relax upstream past The Trout Inn and St John’s Lock—perfect for families, couples, and dogs.

tours.name: Half Day Gorge Adventure
tours.description: Trek through stunning gorges carved by rivers over thousands of years, navigating rocks and water in an exhilarating adventure. Perfect for thrill-seekers, with gear and safety tips provided—no swimming required.

tours.name: Belfast – Skip-the Line Titanic Museum & Distillery Discovery Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating double headliner tour of Northern Ireland, exploring the iconic Titanic Museum and the remarkable Titanic Distillery. Guided by an expert, delve into the Titanic's history and enjoy an interactive whiskey tasting experience at the original shipyard. Discover the SS Nomadic, the last surviving White Star Ship.

tours.name: Roman Ruins to Blitz Bombings: London's Fiery History
tours.description: Step into 2,000 years of London's history, from Roman ruins to royal ghosts, the Tower’s dark past, and secret tunnels into the Bank of England—all in a lively 2-hour walk through the city’s ancient heart.

tours.name: Booze, Brothels & The Bard: London's Bawdy Borough
tours.description: Step into London's past with a lively two-hour walk through Borough and Bankside. Encounter Shakespeare, medieval figures, ghostly tales, and historic sites like prisons, markets, and the Globe Theatre. Limited to fifteen guests, this tour offers an immersive journey through centuries of intrigue, drama, and legendary stories.

tours.name: Historic London Pub Tour
tours.description: Uncover London's hidden pub treasures, from medieval sites to royal secrets. Sip craft beers, sit by historic fires, and explore stories not in guidebooks on a lively 2.5-hour tour of four iconic pubs.

tours.name: Dino in the Jurassic (Escape Dungeon)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling one-hour adventure to recover Dino's hidden treasures before he returns to wreak havoc! Test your skills in this exciting escape challenge set in a Jurassic backdrop. Gather your team and race against time at the Jubilee Hotel, where unforgettable memories await.

tours.name: Teen's Clay Play @ Nottingham City Centre
tours.description: Create a decorative clay hanging plaque using shaping tools, stamps, and embossing. Enjoy expert tips, air-dry clay, and design sheets in a fun, creative session with treats and optional afternoon tea.

tours.name: Tower of London Crown Jewels and English Royal History Tour
tours.description: Experience the rich history of the Tower of London with a guided tour led by a knowledgeable Blue Badge guide. Explore iconic sites like the Crown Jewels and the White Tower, meet the famous Beefeaters, and encounter the legendary ravens, all while uncovering the stories behind this historic landmark.

tours.name: Easy Access Tower of London Crown Jewels Royal Secrets Scandals Tour
tours.description: Explore the Tower of London with timed tickets, gaining access to the Crown Jewels and royal secrets. Uncover tales of intrigue, scandal, and history as you navigate regal bedchambers and encounter the iconic Beefeaters and Ravens. This immersive experience reveals the dramatic stories that shaped the monarchy.

tours.name: 1 Hour Junior Indoor Sports Dome Party
tours.description: Celebrate in our giant inflatable Sports Dome with lively entertainers, fun activities, and outdoor seating—perfect for a weatherproof, high-energy birthday bash kids will never forget.

tours.name: Private The Last Kingdom: Bamburgh, Holy Island & The Northumberland Coast
tours.description: Cross the causeway to Holy Island, a historic Christian site, then soak up coastal views, explore Bamburgh Castle, and spot seabirds on the Farne Islands—an adventure full of history, scenery, and legend.

tours.name: Kayak Hire (1 Hour)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of tandem kayaking in the serene waters of Studland Bay. Paddle at your own pace, soaking in breathtaking coastal views, and enjoy the flexibility to swap paddlers. This self-guided adventure promises unforgettable moments in a stunning natural setting, perfect for couples or friends seeking outdoor fun.

tours.name: Bodyboard Hire (3 Hour)
tours.description: Experience the exhilaration of the ocean with our 3-hour bodyboard hire! Perfect for all skill levels, glide along the breathtaking Jurassic Coast at your own pace. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned pro, this adventure promises unforgettable moments and endless fun in the surf.

tours.name: Daphne du Maurier coastal guided walk
tours.description: Explore a scenic 3.5-mile coastal walk along the South West Coast Path, passing rocky coves, sandy beaches, and Daphne du Maurier’s inspiration sites, with stunning views, wildlife, and a visit to a 16th-century castle.

tours.name: Fowey Town & Coastal guided walk
tours.description: Explore Fowey’s stunning coast and uncover Daphne du Maurier’s inspiration on a scenic 2.5-mile walk. Enjoy breathtaking views, wildlife, and literary connections, ending with a visit to a historic 16th-century castle.

tours.name: Famous Belfast Murals Private Tour
tours.description: Explore Belfast’s powerful murals and peace walls on a 1-hour tour led by local guides. Hear firsthand stories, see iconic sites like Divis Tower and Bobby Sands mural, and gain a deep understanding of The Troubles’ history and hope for peace.

tours.name: Auld City and the Dead House
tours.description: Uncover Liverpool’s haunted history on a 90-minute tour through its original streets, ending in the eerie, historic morgue once visited by Herman Melville. Dive into tales of plague, slavery, and hidden city secrets.

tours.name: Farm & Highland Cow Experience
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the authentic life of a Wensleydale farmer on this unique working farm experience. Feed Highland cows, sheep, and rare breed pigs, while enjoying breathtaking views from a Land Rover. Participate in seasonal farm activities and learn about sustainable farming practices, all while sipping coffee or tea.

tours.name: Croyde Coasteering Adventure | Baggy Point | Fun For All | Less Challenging
tours.description: Experience the thrill of coasteering at stunning Baggy Point, perfect for families and less confident adventurers. Enjoy short gulley swims, fun jumps, and bouldering while surrounded by breathtaking North Devon scenery. With professional guides ensuring safety, this action-packed 2.5-hour adventure promises unforgettable memories for all ages.

tours.name: Yorkshire Dales National Park
tours.description: Journey through Yorkshire Dales' breathtaking scenery, visit historic castles, charming villages, and the famous Wensleydale Cheese Factory. Capture stunning photos and immerse yourself in rural Yorkshire life all in one day.

tours.name: Small Group Coasteering | Our most popular tour!
tours.description: Dive into Cornwall’s wild coast with coasteering—swim, scramble, explore caves, and jump into deep Atlantic waters. Perfect for all levels, guided by experts, and packed with adrenaline and unforgettable views.

tours.name: Tank, Army Truck and Snatch Landrover Driving Experience - RUGBY
tours.description: Drive three powerful vehicles in 90 minutes: a speedy sports tank, a versatile military truck, and a rugged Land Rover. Feel the thrill of off-road challenges and unleash your inner driver in this action-packed experience.

tours.name: Coastal Seafari - 1.5hr Trip
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 90-minute boat trip from New Quay to explore the stunning Cardigan Bay. Encounter bottlenose dolphins, seals, and porpoises while learning from an on-board researcher. With only 12 passengers allowed, enjoy ample space for photography and listen to the dolphins through our underwater microphone.

tours.name: Official World Famous Belfast Taxi Tour™
tours.description: Embark on a private tour through Belfast's complex history, exploring the contrasting narratives of the Falls Road and Shankill Road. Discover poignant murals, including the iconic Bobby Sands, and engage with the city's legacy by signing the Peace Walls. Experience this unique journey in a classic Belfast black taxi.

tours.name: The Roman Frontier: Hadrian’s Wall and Housesteads Roman Fort
tours.description: Explore Hadrian’s Wall with immersive visits to Segedunum and Housesteads, uncover Roman life through artifacts, reconstructions, and expert guides. Walk the ancient wall and dive into Britain’s Roman history in just 4 hours.

tours.name: Mission Impossible Tour of London • Private
tours.description: Follow Ethan Hunt’s footsteps on a 2.5-hour London tour visiting iconic film locations from the Mission Impossible series, including famous landmarks, secret sites, and a historic pub. Perfect for film fans and adventure seekers.

tours.name: Paddleboard - 1.5 hours
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding, the UK's fastest-growing water sport! Whether you seek tranquility as you glide across serene waters or laughter-filled races with friends, this activity offers something for everyone. Enjoy a full-body workout, practice yoga, or simply float away your worries in a safe, supportive environment.

tours.name: All Creatures Great and Small Tour • Private
tours.description: Embark on a captivating All Creatures Great and Small Tour, exploring over 15 iconic filming locations from both the classic 1970s BBC series and the latest adaptation. Enjoy the stunning Yorkshire Dales, visit the award-winning World of James Herriot, and savor lunch at the historic Drovers Arms pub. A must for fans!

tours.name: Changing of the Guard with Royal Food & Drink Tour
tours.description: Watch the Changing of the Guard up close, walk alongside the Old Guard, and sample royal-approved foods from trusted suppliers. An insider tour blending history, luxury, and exclusive tastings in London.

tours.name: Mini Garden Crafternoon
tours.description: Create a charming mini garden in a terracotta pot using preserved moss and dried flowers, then add a gilded touch. Perfect for a relaxing afternoon of crafting, tea, and tasty treats in a cozy, inspiring setting.

tours.name: Raft Building
tours.description: Create a raft from limited materials, then race and navigate on water in a lively team challenge. Enjoy laughs, teamwork, and a splash of chaos as you build, test, and conquer your floating masterpiece.

tours.name: Children's Plate Illustration Crafternoon
tours.description: Unleash your creativity by hand-painting a ceramic plate with vibrant pens, guided by expert tips. Perfect for young artists, this fun craft session sparks imagination and leaves you with a unique keepsake.

tours.name: 剑桥校友伴你行 - 剑桥大学怪谈之旅（与他人共享导游）
tours.description: Uncover Cambridge’s haunted past on a 60-minute outdoor walking tour. Hear chilling stories of ghostly sightings, ancient legends, and dark history at historic colleges, ending near a centuries-old cemetery.

tours.name: Shared Spanish • Oxford Combined Walking & Punting Tour & Optional New College
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s rich history and stunning architecture, from the Narnia lamp-post to Alice’s meadows. Walk past iconic colleges, learn secret stories, and enjoy a scenic punt along the river’s historic sights.

tours.name: Private Spanish • Harry Potter Film Locations Walking Tour & New College
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s film magic in 1.5 hours with guides connected to the university. See key Harry Potter locations, learn about famous actors, Marvel films, and the university’s literary and cinematic ties. Perfect for fans!

tours.name: Shared Spanish • Harry Potter Film Locations Walking Tour & New College
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s film magic with former students guiding you through iconic Harry Potter locations, Marvel spots, and famous authors’ ties to the university—plus insider stories and photo stops.

tours.name: Private Spanish • Cambridge University Walking Tour & Optional King's College
tours.description: Explore Cambridge’s rich history and stunning architecture on a guided walking tour led by students or alumni. Visit iconic colleges, learn insider stories, and see highlights like the Corpus Clock and King’s College from the Backs.

tours.name: Shared Spanish • Oxford Walking Tour  & Optional New College
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s rich history and stunning architecture on a lively walking tour. See the lamp-post that inspired Narnia, learn secret student stories, and marvel at Gothic masterpieces—all in 90 or 150 minutes.

tours.name: Wheels & Water: Coast & Castle E-Bike Explorer
tours.description: Cycle scenic coastal paths on a fat-tyre e-bike, cruise through marshes to Hurst Castle, and explore charming towns like Lymington and Milford on Sea. A fun-filled day of adventure, history, and seaside charm awaits.

tours.name: Kitesurfing Lessons Group up to 4
tours.description: Experience personalized kitesurfing instruction tailored to your unique needs. With one-on-one lessons, progress at your own pace and focus on specific skills. Ideal for both beginners and advanced riders, this approach can significantly enhance your learning, making it possible to overcome challenges in just an hour.

tours.name: The Original Liverpool Pub Tour
tours.description: Sip through Liverpool’s historic pubs, where stories of music, football, and local life come alive. Visit four lively venues and uncover the city’s vibrant culture in a relaxed, storytelling tour.

tours.name: Private Posh Parks and the Toon Cycling Tour
tours.description: Cycle through Newcastle’s hidden green spaces like Jesmond Dene and Town Moor, then explore vibrant neighborhoods, historic sites, and scenic riverside views—an unforgettable adventure off the beaten path.

tours.name: Children's Mini Plant Pot Illustration Crafternoon
tours.description: Unleash your creativity by decorating a mini terracotta pot, perfect for young artists. Enjoy sweet treats and drinks, with options for all ages. A fun, colorful activity to spark imagination and craftiness.

tours.name: Seasonal Felt Decoration Crafternoon
tours.description: Create charming seasonal felt decorations by hand-stitching colorful shapes and details, adding a cozy touch to your home or thoughtful gifts. Unleash your creativity and celebrate the seasons!

tours.name: May • Craft of the Month: Mini Spring Garden
tours.description: Create your own spring-inspired floral arrangement with dried moss and flowers in a terracotta pot, then enjoy tea, scones, or grazing platters. A perfect blend of creativity and delicious treats in a cozy setting.

tours.name: July • Craft of the Month: Mini Wreath Making
tours.description: Create a charming miniature wreath using dried and preserved flowers and greenery, guided by experts. Personalize your design with colors and flora for a unique, seasonal keepsake.

tours.name: The Shakespeare Express – Morning Service
tours.description: Ride a vintage steam train from Birmingham to Stratford-upon-Avon, exploring Shakespeare’s birthplace. Savor full English breakfast, afternoon tea, and enjoy 4.5 hours of sightseeing in this charming historic town.

tours.name: Small Group London Bucket List Tour
tours.description: Join a lively 1.5-hour tour to see the Changing Guard from a prime spot, marching alongside bands and guards, avoiding crowds, and capturing unforgettable moments of London's royal pageantry and history.

tours.name: River Rafting Safari (Full Day)
tours.description: Paddle through stunning scenery on a 2.5-hour river rafting adventure in the Peak District, tackling gentle grade 2 rapids with expert guides. Perfect for all ages, it’s a fun, safe team experience on the water.

tours.name: Calm Sauna & Swim at TCR the Hub
tours.description: Unwind in a rustic Finnish lakeside sauna, where crackling fire and steamy heat meet invigorating cold dips in pristine lake water, creating a revitalizing hot-and-cold sensory escape.

tours.name: Farm Tour
tours.description: Get up close to farm life in just an hour—feed sheep, pigs, goats, and more while learning how we care for each animal. A lively, hands-on tour full of rural charm and farmyard surprises.

tours.name: Half Day Abseil
tours.description: Experience the thrill of abseiling in a half-day session at Split Rock, where you'll learn to control your descent down 25-meter cliffs. With expert instructors guiding you every step of the way, this adrenaline-pumping adventure promises unforgettable moments as you conquer your fears and enjoy the breathtaking views.

tours.name: Half Day Rock Climbing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of rock climbing at Burrington Combe, where you can tackle six unique climbs tailored to all skill levels. With expert instructors and breathtaking views, this adventure fosters teamwork and communication. Join the fastest-growing sport in Britain for an unforgettable outdoor challenge that promises excitement and personal growth.

tours.name: Full Day Caving
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable full-day caving adventure in the Mendip Hills! Perfect for all skill levels, explore the enchanting Goatchurch Cavern and the thrilling Swildon's Hole, featuring stunning rock formations and cascading waterfalls. With expert instructors ensuring safety and excitement, this unique experience promises to be both memorable and exhilarating!

tours.name: Full Day Caving and Abseiling
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling full-day adventure of caving and abseiling in the stunning Mendip Hills! Perfect for beginners, this exclusive experience offers two cave options and breathtaking abseiling venues, all in one location. Enjoy personalized instruction from expert guides, ensuring a safe and memorable day for all ages.

tours.name: Full Day Climbing and Abseiling
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating day of climbing and abseiling in the stunning Mendip hills. Tackle diverse climbs at Burrington Combe and conquer a thrilling 25-meter vertical wall at Split Rock. With expert instructors ensuring safety and personalized adventures, this unique outdoor challenge promises unforgettable memories for all ages.

tours.name: Full Day Caving & Climbing
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating full-day adventure of caving and climbing in the stunning Mendip Hills. Perfect for all skill levels, explore the enchanting Goatchurch Cavern and tackle diverse climbs at Burrington Combe. Led by experienced instructors, this unforgettable experience promises safety, excitement, and breathtaking scenery for ages 8 and up.

tours.name: Half Day Dry Caving
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling half-day caving adventure, perfect for beginners! Explore the captivating Goatchurch cave with diverse routes tailored to your comfort level. Experience stunning stalactite formations and the chance to see sleeping bats, all under the guidance of expert instructors. A unique opportunity for families and youth groups alike!

tours.name: Offshore Islands & Dolphin Voyage
tours.description: Embark on a unique 2.5-hour Offshore Island and Dolphin Voyage, where you'll sail to Grassholm Island, home to a vast gannet colony. Explore the remote Smalls lighthouse and venture into the Celtic Deep, searching for dolphins, porpoises, and even whales. Experience the thrill of marine wildlife like never before!

tours.name: Coasteering
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating coasteering adventure along the stunning Pembrokeshire Coast! Experience wild swimming, cliff jumping, and cave exploration, all while being guided by experts. Perfect for families and groups, this half-day activity promises unforgettable memories as you navigate hidden coves and the breathtaking Blue Lagoon.

tours.name: Hampton Loade to Arley
tours.description: Embark on a memorable 2-hour paddling adventure through the stunning Severn Valley, featuring picturesque countryside and charming bridges. Enjoy a picnic stop in the delightful village of Arley, where you can relax at a pub or explore local shops before returning via a scenic riverside walk or train ride.

tours.name: Bridgnorth to Hampton loade
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 2-hour canoe adventure along the River Severn, starting in Bridgnorth. Paddle through picturesque countryside and enjoy the tranquil sounds of nature, with the chance to spot passing trains. Conclude your journey at Hampton Loade, where your gear will be collected, creating a memorable outdoor experience.

tours.name: Bridgnorth to Arley
tours.description: Paddle 10.5 miles through scenic Severn Valley, passing bridges and countryside. Enjoy a picnic or pub lunch, then return by heritage steam train or other transport. Dogs welcome for a relaxing, picturesque river adventure.

tours.name: One Hour Private Charter
tours.description: Embark on a private boat trip from New Quay to explore the stunning Cardigan Bay, home to playful bottlenose dolphins, seals, and diverse marine life. With expert guidance, enjoy a personalized experience aboard a spacious vessel, complete with an underwater microphone to hear dolphins up close. Create unforgettable memories in this breathtaking coastal paradise.

tours.name: Newcastle: A History of the Toon
tours.description: Uncover Newcastle’s rich history from Roman fort to industrial powerhouse. Walk inside historic sites like the castle and cathedral, and see how this city shaped the world in just three hours.

tours.name: Roman and Anglo-Saxon Tyneside Tour
tours.description: Uncover ancient stories at Arbeia Roman Fort and Jarrow Hall, where reconstructed buildings and vivid exhibits reveal the lives of soldiers, traders, and scholars from the Roman and Anglo-Saxon eras in North East England.

tours.name: The Super Tanker Party SUP!!
tours.description: Experience the thrill of group adventure with the giant 10-person stand-up paddle board! Perfect for families or parties, this unique activity offers a fun-filled hour or two on the water. Enjoy expert tips and instructions to ensure an unforgettable day at the beach, making memories with friends and loved ones.

tours.name: Derry Girls Taxi Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating Derry Girls tour in Belfast, where you'll explore iconic filming locations from the beloved comedy. Discover the vibrant city that served as a backdrop for Erin and her friends, while enjoying insights from an expert local guide. A must-do for fans seeking a unique connection to the show!

tours.name: Gavin and Stacey Tour [OFFICIAL]
tours.description: Step into Barry Island’s TV world with a 3.5-hour Gavin and Stacey tour. Visit iconic locations, see clips, sing along, and uncover behind-the-scenes stories in this fan-favorite adventure.

tours.name: Electric Apollo
tours.description: Set sail on the Apollo, a comfy electric boat with heating, a toilet, and a kettle. Glide through the broads with friends or pets, enjoying full instructions and free parking—perfect for a relaxing day on the water.

tours.name: London City of Lights Tour
tours.description: Capture London's stunning nightscape from dusk to darkness, photographing iconic landmarks like St. Paul’s and Tate Modern. Learn camera tricks, long exposures, and create unforgettable city images in a private, tailored 3-hour tour.

tours.name: London River City Tour
tours.description: Capture London's iconic sights with a private photographer guide. Learn camera tricks, master lighting, and take stunning photos of landmarks like Buckingham Palace and St. Paul’s Cathedral in a personalized 5-hour tour.

tours.name: East London Day Tour
tours.description: Capture London's vibrant East End with a private photographer, mastering camera settings, street art, and iconic sights in 5 unforgettable hours. Bring friends, learn tips, and leave with stunning images.

tours.name: London Hidden Gems Tour
tours.description: Capture London's hidden charm in a private 3-hour tour, exploring vibrant streets, historic alleys, and colorful street art. Improve your photography skills while wandering off the beaten path.

tours.name: London Famous City Landmarks Tour
tours.description: Capture London's iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace and the London Eye with a private 3-hour photography tour. Improve your skills, get personalized tips, and leave with stunning, memorable images of the city.

tours.name: Archery
tours.description: Aim, focus, and hit the bullseye in a fun, two-hour archery session. Perfect for all ages, with expert guidance and gear tailored to you—then test your skills in a lively competition.

tours.name: Edinburgh Top Outlander Highlights Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore the enchanting village of Culross, where the captivating world of Outlander comes to life. This 2.5-hour guided tour reveals iconic filming locations and rich history, all within a small group setting. Experience the charm of Scotland’s past while immersing yourself in the drama that inspired the beloved series.

tours.name: Edinburgh - Magical Harry Potter Highlights & Wizards Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour guided tour of Old Town Edinburgh, where you'll explore the iconic Royal Mile and the National Museum of Scotland. Discover the enchanting world of Harry Potter and delve into the city's rich history and culture with an expert guide, all in an intimate small group setting.

tours.name: L: VIP Kensington Palace Tour & Royal Tea Crown Experience
tours.description: Walk through royal gardens and explore Kensington Palace’s stunning rooms before savoring a luxurious afternoon tea in a regal setting—an elegant, unforgettable taste of London royalty.

tours.name: Electric Comet
tours.description: Experience the serene beauty of the Norfolk Broads aboard Comet, a comfortable and easy-to-handle boat. With amenities like a toilet, electric kettle, and sliding roof, you can enjoy a relaxing day on the water. Pets are welcome, and free parking is available, making it a perfect getaway for everyone.

tours.name: Chiltern Street, Marylebone Half-Day Experience
tours.description: Discover the charm of central London’s Chiltern and Dorset streets, home to unique menswear shops like Grey Flannel and Dashing Tweeds. Enjoy personalized service while exploring exquisite boutiques, handmade shoes, and artisanal jewelry. With a blend of shopping and delightful refreshments, this experience is perfect for fashion enthusiasts seeking hidden gems.

tours.name: Chiltern Street, Marylebone Full-Day Experience
tours.description: Discover the charm of central London's Chiltern and Dorset streets, home to unique menswear shops like Grey Flannel and Dashing Tweeds. Enjoy personalized service while exploring stylish boutiques, handmade goods, and exquisite perfumes. With 6-8 hours to shop and unwind, this experience is perfect for fashion enthusiasts seeking hidden gems.

tours.name: Latest in Design Full-Day Experience
tours.description: Immerse yourself in London's vibrant fashion scene with a unique 6-8 hour exploration of fine designer stores and boutiques. Discover cutting-edge and daring designs, engage in insightful discussions about trends and sustainability, and enjoy a delightful lunch or afternoon tea. Experience fashion like never before, where creativity meets accessibility.

tours.name: A Day Out in Style
tours.description: Embark on a personalized shopping tour through London's chicest neighborhoods, including Mayfair and Soho. Tailor your experience to explore boutiques, Savile Row tailoring, or indulge in exquisite dining. With expert guidance, enjoy a full day of luxury, fashion history, and delightful refreshments, making it a memorable celebration for any occasion.

tours.name: Chiltern Street, Marylebone
tours.description: Explore the charming streets of Chiltern and Dorset in central London, where you'll discover a curated selection of unique menswear and womenswear boutiques. Experience exceptional personal service while browsing timeless pieces, handmade shoes, and exquisite jewelry. This personalized shopping tour promises hidden gems and memorable finds in a vibrant atmosphere.

tours.name: Heathrow Airport to/from Cotswolds
tours.description: Experience seamless airport transfers with London Minicab Service. Enjoy a personalized journey from Heathrow to the picturesque Cotswolds, traveling through charming villages. With a reliable Meet & Greet service, monitored flights, and a fleet of comfortable vehicles, your trip promises to be stress-free and memorable.

tours.name: London to Cotswolds Day Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable day tour of the enchanting Cotswolds, exploring picturesque villages and historical towns in a private vehicle. Tailor your itinerary to your interests, enjoy leisurely exploration, and learn from a knowledgeable Blue Badge guide. Experience the beauty of England's countryside like never before!

tours.name: London to / from The Cotswolds Transfers
tours.description: Experience seamless travel with London Minicab Service, your premier choice for national transfers. Enjoy private, direct pickups from your accommodation, flexible departure times, and a range of comfortable vehicles. With guaranteed reliability and award-winning service, your journey through the picturesque countryside will be stress-free and memorable.

tours.name: London to Paultons Park Home of Peppa Pig World Transfers
tours.description: Experience seamless travel with London Minicab Service, your premier choice for transfers to Paultons Park, home of Peppa Pig World. Enjoy a private, air-conditioned ride with child seats available, ensuring comfort for the whole family. With a commitment to reliability and award-winning service, your journey will be stress-free and memorable.

tours.name: London Gatwick Airport to/from Central London
tours.description: Experience seamless airport transfers with London Minicab Service. Enjoy a personalized Meet & Greet at Gatwick, where friendly drivers assist with your luggage. With monitored flights, reliable service, and a fleet of comfortable vehicles, your journey will be stress-free and tailored to your needs. Trust the award-winning choice for your travel.

tours.name: Round Island (up to 3 hours)
tours.description: Explore the island at your own pace with a bike rental—full-day access to scenic spots, fresh air, and adventure. Perfect for all ages, just remember to return before 5 pm and wear suitable clothing.

tours.name: All Day Hire
tours.description: Experience the beauty of the island like never before with an all-day bike hire! Explore at your own pace, discovering hidden gems and scenic spots. Perfect for families, this adventure allows you to immerse yourself in the stunning surroundings while enjoying the freedom of cycling. Don’t miss out on this unforgettable journey!

tours.name: General Admissions
tours.description: Experience the enchanting Dundonald Castle, where history meets stunning views. Enjoy complimentary tours led by passionate volunteers, explore ancient woodlands, and relax at the visitor centre with a delightful coffee shop. With free entry for under 5's and Historic Scotland members, this adventure promises memorable moments for all ages.

tours.name: 4 Day  Canoe Adventure
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic River Severn on a 4-day self-guided trip, passing historic towns, lush countryside, and the iconic Ironbridge. Enjoy wild camping or cozy B&Bs, with all gear and safety support included.

tours.name: Hampton Loade to Bewdley
tours.description: Paddle through scenic countryside on a 10-mile, self-guided canoe trip from Hampton Loade to Bewdley. Enjoy gentle rapids, charming bridges, and stops in Arley’s cozy pubs—perfect for a relaxing, adventure-filled day.

tours.name: Private transfers between London & Bath
tours.description: Experience the enchanting city of Bath, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its stunning Georgian architecture and rich history. Enjoy a private transfer from London, allowing you to explore the city's vibrant food scene, iconic Roman baths, and festive atmosphere, especially during the magical Bath Christmas Market.

tours.name: Brick Lane and Spitalfields Half-Day Experience
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 5-6 hour journey through Brick Lane and Spitalfields, where vibrant markets and rich history intertwine. Discover unique vintage finds while exploring the dramatic stories of immigrant craftsmanship. Experience the essence of London's East End, enhanced by delightful food options and engaging local characters along the way.

tours.name: Brick Lane and Spitalfields Full-Day Experience

tours.description: Experience seamless travel with London Minicab Service, offering professional drivers for stress-free transfers from Heathrow or Southampton Cruise Terminal. Enjoy a full meet and greet service, tailored to your needs. Extend your journey with captivating excursions to Salisbury, Stonehenge, and Windsor, all in the comfort of your private vehicle.
