tours.description: Experience seamless travel with London Minicab Service, offering professional drivers for stress-free transfers from Heathrow or Southampton Cruise Terminal. Enjoy a full meet and greet service, tailored to your needs. Extend your journey with captivating excursions to Salisbury, Stonehenge, and Windsor, all in the comfort of your private vehicle.

tours.name: London Holiday Walking Food Tour with Tea and Doughnuts
tours.description: Indulge in a festive London donut tour with seasonal treats, historic sights, and cozy tea stops. Savor fresh, artisanal donuts near Borough Market and enjoy stunning views of Tower Bridge to end your sweet journey.

tours.name: Prison Break (Escape Dungeon)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a Prison Break Escape Room set in a real WWII bunker beneath Weymouth’s seafront. With just 60 minutes to escape execution, immerse yourself in a gritty challenge alongside your crew. Dress up, strategize, and test your teamwork in this unforgettable adventure before enjoying delicious food and games nearby.

tours.name: Prison Break 2.0 (Escape Dungeon)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a high-stakes escape in "Prison Break 2.0." With only one hour to evade execution after a wild crime spree, gather your team and strategize your escape. Set in the atmospheric Jubilee Hotel, this adult-oriented adventure promises heart-pounding excitement and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Defuse the Bomb (Escape Dungeon)
tours.description: Step into the thrilling world of espionage with "Defuse the Bomb," your ultimate spy challenge! In just one hour, test your skills and teamwork as you race against time to defuse a bomb. Perfect for adult groups, this immersive experience promises excitement and unforgettable memories at the Jubilee Hotel.

tours.name: Shore Excursion: Giants Causeway Tour (Small Group)
tours.description: Explore the stunning Irish coast with a small-group tour: visit the Giants Causeway, Dunluce Castle, Rathlin Island, and Ballycastle. Enjoy scenic drives, insider guides, and plenty of time to soak in breathtaking views before returning to Belfast.

tours.name: City of Layers: Monopoly to Metropolis with John W
tours.description: Explore the vibrant history of Cardiff on a captivating 1.5-hour walking tour. Discover the stories behind iconic landmarks like the Medieval town wall, Cardiff Castle, and the Civic Centre, all while tracing the city’s evolution over 150 years. Experience why Cardiff is celebrated as the “Chicago of Wales.”

tours.name: Falls Road Mural Tour
tours.description: Experience Belfast's rich history on a captivating 3-hour Falls Road Mural Tour, led by former activists and political ex-prisoners. Discover powerful stories and visit iconic sites, including the International Wall and Bobby Sands’ mural, culminating at Milltown Cemetery. This immersive journey offers a unique perspective on Ireland's complex past and peace process.

tours.name: Wildlife, Bushcraft & Sea Cave Kayak Safari
tours.description: Paddle through stunning sea caves and coves, spot seals, and end with a wild swim on a secluded beach. Enjoy a bonfire, marshmallows, and learn about ancient coral reefs in a breathtaking natural setting.

tours.name: Llangollen Kayaking Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 2.5-hour kayaking adventure through the stunning Dee Valley! Navigate thrilling whitewater rapids and explore the historic Llangollen canal, all under expert guidance. Perfect for beginners, this unique experience offers the chance to paddle your own kayak while enjoying breathtaking natural scenery and learning essential skills.

tours.name: Private Group White Water Kayaking
tours.description: Conquer thrilling rapids in a safe, guided whitewater adventure. Paddle stable kayaks or SUPs, learn river skills, and enjoy scenic views—perfect for beginners and non-swimmers alike. All gear included, just bring your spirit of adventure.

tours.name: 剑桥大学历史文化徒步游普通话导游 (Mandarin University Walk: Private Walking Tour)
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5 to 2-hour guided walking tour of Cambridge University, exploring its rich history and stunning architecture. Discover the influence of Christianity on the university's legacy while strolling through iconic sites like the Round Church and the Senate House, all narrated by a knowledgeable local guide.

tours.name: Foot Golf
tours.description: Kick off a fun-filled game of FootGolf on a scenic 18-hole course with slopes and tricky shots, perfect for all ages and occasions. Play casually any day or challenge friends in a lively, relaxed setting.

tours.name: Private Pub Crawl
tours.description: Immerse yourself in Belfast's vibrant culture on a Traditional Irish Pub Crawl. Over 3.5 hours, explore historic and modern pubs, enjoy live music and Irish dancers, and soak in stunning city views. With a local guide and two complimentary drinks, this experience promises unforgettable stories and a lively atmosphere.

tours.name: Snorkel Skomer Island
tours.description: Get up close to Pembrokeshire’s lively bird colonies and try 'snAUKling'—using decoys to attract puffins, guillemots, and razorbills. An exciting, weather-dependent adventure at Skomer and Skokholm awaits!

tours.name: Errington Farm Tour and Cheese Tasting
tours.description: Meet friendly farm animals, see cheesemaking in action through observation windows, and savor award-winning Scottish cheeses on a scenic farm tour that connects you to the land and its delicious traditions.

tours.name: Revive and Shine - Re imagine Your Unloved Silver and Gold
tours.description: Transform your unloved family silver or gold into a bespoke piece of jewelry in this creative workshop led by expert jeweller James. Experience hands-on techniques, from melting down metals to crafting unique designs, all while enjoying a glass of Wagtail Retreat's wine. Celebrate your artistry in a memorable morning session!

tours.name: Belfast Bike Tour
tours.description: Pedal through Belfast’s vibrant streets, from historic pubs to the Titanic Quarter. Feel the city’s stories at the Peace Wall and explore iconic murals, all on a guided bike adventure that brings Belfast’s history to life.

tours.name: Original Harry Potter Walking Tour : York: French
tours.description: Step into Harry Potter’s world in York with quizzes, spell challenges, and re-enactments. Visit iconic film sites, explore city walls, and end at the famous Harry Potter shop—an interactive adventure for true fans.

tours.name: Wonders of Whitehall Walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute guided walk through Whitehall, where history comes alive. Discover iconic landmarks like the Houses of Parliament and Westminster Abbey, delve into royal scandals, and explore film locations from popular movies. With engaging storytelling and hidden gems, this tour offers a unique glimpse into Britain's rich past.

tours.name: Intermediate Full Day
tours.description: Push your limits with a full day of advanced trials riding on challenging terrain, honing balance, throttle control, and line choice. Perfect for experienced riders ready to master technical sections and improve skills.

tours.name: Army Truck Driving Experience - RUGBY
tours.description: Command a 6-tonne military troop carrier across tough terrain, mastering tricky maneuvers with expert guidance. Feel the raw power and adrenaline of off-road driving in this action-packed, military-style adventure.

tours.name: Kayak Hire
tours.description: Paddle through the calm waters of Carbis Bay in a single or tandem kayak. Enjoy a safety briefing, then glide along the shoreline, feeling the sea breeze—perfect for beginners seeking fun and adventure on the water.

tours.name: Arcade VR Gaming Session
tours.description: Dive into an unforgettable Virtual Reality experience at our Portsmouth branch, where you can choose from a vast selection of games, including family-friendly options and thrilling zombie adventures. Enjoy immersive sessions in a Room Scale "Pod" setup, perfect for solo players or groups of up to six. Your adventure awaits!

tours.name: Junior Military Driving Experience (12+) - RUGBY
tours.description: Kids and teens can conquer rugged hills in Land Rover Defenders or race through terrain in a fast SAS-style buggy, learning to handle powerful vehicles on challenging off-road courses.

tours.name: Surf Lesson
tours.description: Ride the waves with our fun-filled surf course, perfect for beginners and intermediates. All gear included, with lessons at 10:30 or 1:30 pm—grab your towel and dive into the ocean today!

tours.name: James Bond Film Locations Walking Tour in London
tours.description: Step into the world of James Bond with a 2.5-hour tour of iconic film locations, secret offices, and historic sites in London. Capture photos, learn spy secrets, and feel like a 007 agent for a day.

tours.name: 2 Hour Guided Tour (under the Bridge)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-hour guided kayaking tour from Ballintoy Harbour, perfect for beginners. Paddle beneath the iconic Rope Bridge while soaking in stunning coastal views and local history. With all equipment provided, enjoy the chance to spot playful dolphins, making this adventure both exciting and memorable.

tours.name: Private Breakfast Cruise With Skipper
tours.description: Experience a private breakfast cruise along the scenic Leeds/Liverpool canal, complete with a full English breakfast and Bucks Fizz. Enjoy the tranquility of the countryside, spot historic windmills, and engage with waterfowl, including the rare Kingfisher, while your knowledgeable skipper shares fascinating insights about the canal's history.

tours.name: Absolute Beginners Full Day
tours.description: Start from zero with a full day of gentle, personalized trials coaching on electric bikes. Build confidence, learn control, and enjoy a relaxed environment with lunch included—perfect for absolute beginners.

tours.name: Tipsy Truffle Thursday (formerly Choctails)
tours.description: Indulge in a luxurious evening of chocolate and cocktails. Mix a boozy ‘Lady Marmalade’ drink, craft rich ganache truffles with toppings, and take home your edible masterpieces in just 1.5 hours of sweet fun.

tours.name: Choc-tails Friday (formerly Cocktail & Chocolate Making)
tours.description: Create irresistible chocolate truffles and craft boozy or non-alcoholic chocolate cocktails in a lively workshop. Decorate, dip, and take home your sweet creations—perfect for a fun, indulgent weekend treat.

tours.name: Scorpion Firing Experience - RUGBY
tours.description: Experience the thrill of driving and firing a tank with a partner! Navigate a challenging course while one of you takes the wheel and the other aims the powerful 76mm gun. Switch roles for an unforgettable adventure, perfect for families, couples, or friends. Get ready for an exhilarating 30-minute experience!

tours.name: Ted Lasso Tour
tours.description: Step into the world of Ted Lasso with a guided walk through Richmond-Upon-Thames. Visit filming spots, learn behind-the-scenes secrets, snap photos, and end at Ted’s favorite pub for a true fan experience.

tours.name: 1.5 Hour Public Cruise
tours.description: Glide along the Leeds/Liverpool Canal on a cozy narrowboat, soaking in scenic towns and villages. Relax with unlimited tea and coffee as friendly skippers share stories of Lancashire’s waterways.

tours.name: The Highland Way
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a self-guided walking safari to see Highland Cows up close! Enjoy the safety of a dedicated walkway while exploring the farm, where you can also meet goats, chickens, sheep, and pigs. In spring, don’t miss the chance to bottle feed adorable lambs! Picnics are welcome.

tours.name: Whitewater Rafting - Private
tours.description: Paddle down the thrilling rapids of the River Dee with your own private raft. Enjoy stunning scenery, adrenaline-pumping rapids like Serpents Tail, and quality time with your chosen crew in North Wales.

tours.name: Chester Whitewater Session
tours.description: Conquer your first rapids on a 2.5-hour beginner-friendly kayak tour through Chester. Paddle past historic sights, enjoy grade 2 whitewater, and learn new skills in stable, open-top kayaks—no experience needed.

tours.name: VR Escape Rooms
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling virtual reality adventure with over 9 unique titles to choose from, including Survival, Alice in Wonderland, and Cyberpunk. Perfect for families, these immersive experiences allow players to connect and assist each other in a captivating world. Choose your adventure and make unforgettable memories together!

tours.name: Your Choice
tours.description: Immerse yourself in an exhilarating virtual reality experience with a diverse selection of top VR titles. Enjoy single or multiplayer games, creative activities, and musical sessions, all customizable to your preferences. With flexible time slots, you can explore various adventures at your own pace, ensuring a unique and memorable experience.

tours.name: London Movie Locations Walking Tour with Film Clips
tours.description: Explore Greenwich’s haunted past on a spooky 2-hour walk, hearing ghost stories, shipwreck tales, and Viking legends while strolling along the Thames past iconic sights like the Cutty Sark and Trafalgar pub.

tours.name: Family Friendly British Museum Guided Tour - Private (ENGLISH)
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour private tour of the British Museum, tailored for families. Discover ancient treasures like mummies, the Rosetta Stone, and the Parthenon Marbles through engaging stories from expert guides. This interactive experience promises to ignite curiosity and create unforgettable memories for both kids and adults alike.

tours.name: Historic Pub Landlord & Cotswold Village Experience
tours.description: Step into a 16th-century inn once visited by Queen Elizabeth I, learn about real ale brewing, pour your own pint, explore charming thatched cottages and an ancient church, then enjoy a hearty traditional pub meal.

tours.name: Southend Day Trip (Departing Rochester)
tours.description: Set sail from Rochester to Southend for a classic seaside day: enjoy fish and chips, explore Adventure Island, or ride the pier train. Relax for 4-5 hours before returning on a scenic river trip.

tours.name: from Ravenglass ➔ Return Journey
tours.description: Ride through stunning Cumbria landscapes on a 40-minute steam train, with wildlife sightings, scenic stops, and optional upgrades like First Class or Afternoon Tea. Perfect for families, couples, and explorers.

tours.name: Beginners Sea Kayaking (Half Day)
tours.description: Embark on a half-day sea kayaking adventure designed for beginners, where you'll master essential paddling skills and safety techniques. Explore the stunning coastal beauty of Old Harry Rocks, discovering hidden caves and secret beaches, while keeping an eye out for seals, dolphins, and vibrant birdlife along the way.

tours.name: VIP Karaoke Booth 2
tours.description: Take the stage in a private karaoke booth with endless song choices, disco lights, and friends. Sing solo or together, strike a pose, and turn up the fun—perfect for parties, birthdays, or just a night of letting loose.

tours.name: 'Peter's Railway' Little Engineers' Day Easter special with Chris Vine
tours.description: Young engineers dive into a railway adventure with storytelling, hands-on engine workshops, signal box fun, and Easter-themed toy railway activities—creating unforgettable memories behind the scenes.

tours.name: Sail & Stay Experience | Bounty x Stones & Stars
tours.description: Sail aboard the Bounty replica for a 4-hour adventure through Plymouth Sound, passing Drake’s Island, Cawsand Bay, historic forts, and stunning coastlines. Enjoy breathtaking views, stories, and a touch of maritime thrill.

tours.name: Whaly 435 Rental
tours.description: Experience a day of fun on the water with our stable and safe boats, powered by an 8HP engine. Featuring a user-friendly steering console and ample space, these boats are perfect for family outings, ensuring a memorable adventure for everyone. Enjoy the thrill of exploration and relaxation together!

tours.name: Snatch Landrover Driving Experience Rugby
tours.description: Take control of a powerful military truck on rugged terrain, mastering tricky maneuvers and feeling the raw power of a V8 engine. An adrenaline-filled off-road adventure perfect for thrill-seekers and military fans.

tours.description: Uncover York’s haunted secrets on a spooky 1.75-mile tour through shadowy alleys, historic sites, and ghostly landmarks like Clifford’s Tower and The Shambles. Perfect for thrill-seekers and history lovers alike.

tours.name: Swan Splash Tour
tours.description: Embark on the Swan Splash Road and River Duck Tour for a thrilling blend of land and water exploration in Windsor. Experience iconic sights like Windsor Castle and the Long Walk, followed by an exhilarating splashdown into the River Thames, all while enjoying expert commentary and breathtaking views.

tours.name: Whitewater Rafting
tours.description: Conquer thrilling rapids like Serpents Tail and Town Falls on Wales' top whitewater river. Feel the rush, enjoy stunning scenery, and share the adventure with friends from our cozy riverside café.

tours.name: White Water River Bugs
tours.description: Jump into a 2.5-hour adventure with bugging and whitewater fun. No experience needed—just a swim! All gear provided. Feel the thrill, get wet, and leave spinning with excitement.

tours.name: Gorge Walking Adventure
tours.description: Splash through crystal waters, conquer rocky slides, jumps, and deep pools amid stunning cliffs and lush greenery. Feel the thrill, get soaked, and create unforgettable outdoor adventures in North Wales.

tours.name: Open Canoe Aqueduct Tour
tours.description: Paddle along the tranquil Llangollen Canal, then glide over the highest aqueduct in the world. Enjoy 2.5 hours of scenic beauty, peaceful waters, and immersive storytelling in a memorable, unhurried journey.

tours.name: Ramsey Island Voyage
tours.description: Embark on the Ramsey Island Voyage, a thrilling 1-hour boat trip perfect for all ages! Discover stunning sea caves and rock gorges while spotting Atlantic Grey Seals, Harbour Porpoises, and diverse seabirds. Enjoy a guided tour that uncovers the island's rich history and geology, making it a memorable family adventure!

tours.name: Skomer Island Voyage
tours.description: Embark on the Skomer Island Voyage, a thrilling 2-hour boat trip that offers unparalleled puffin sightings at one of the UK's largest colonies. Experience the vibrant wildlife, including thousands of seabirds and the chance to spot seals and dolphins, all while navigating the stunning St Brides Bay and Jack Sound.

tours.name: Gavin Family Friendly Tour
tours.description: Join tour guide Gavin on a one-hour adventure through York, where his personal journey enriches the experience. Discover the city's hidden gems through cat-spotting, puzzles, and games, while exploring its fascinating chocolate history. This unique tour combines fun and insight, showcasing the potential in everyone.

tours.name: Secrets of the Lanes Tour
tours.description: Stroll Brighton’s historic Lanes, filled with narrow streets, hidden passageways, and tales of smugglers, Regency glamour, and early film. A lively 90-minute tour revealing centuries of local secrets and legends.

tours.name: Beach and Cave Kayak Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 2-hour beach and cave tour, where you'll paddle through stunning bays, explore hidden beaches, and encounter local wildlife like dolphins and seals. With expert guidance and all equipment provided, this adventure promises a perfect blend of excitement and relaxation in a breathtaking coastal setting.

tours.name: The Explorer Family SUP
tours.description: Experience the thrill of exploring the coastline with the Explorer SUP, a spacious stand-up paddle board designed for up to four adults. Perfect for family adventures, you can choose from 1 to 3-hour rentals to enjoy leisurely paddling or exciting tandem tours. Don’t forget your wetsuit for added fun!

tours.name: Single person kayak hire
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Combe Martin bay by kayaking through its stunning creeks and coves. Perfect for all skill levels, this adventure offers a chance to spot diverse wildlife while enjoying the scenic coastline. With expert instructors and top-quality kayaks, your safety and comfort are guaranteed for an unforgettable outing.

tours.name: Broadsands Beach Kayak Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 2-hour adventure at Broadsands beach, where you'll kayak to hidden coves and spot local wildlife like dolphins and seals. With expert guidance and all equipment provided, enjoy paddling instruction, explore pristine beaches, and take a refreshing dip in the ocean. Experience nature like never before!

tours.name: Mary Poppins Small Group Tour of London
tours.description: Step into London’s magic with a 2-hour Mary Poppins tour. Visit film locations, dance on iconic steps, enjoy stunning rooftop views, and uncover secrets behind the beloved nanny and her adventures.

tours.name: Sherlock Holmes Walking Tour of London
tours.description: Step into Sherlock Holmes’ London: walk historic streets, see filming locations, and explore sites from the books and TV series. Perfect for fans eager to relive the detective’s legendary adventures.

tours.description: Gather your friends for an unforgettable 2-hour adventure on the Super Stand Up Paddle Board! With experienced coaches guiding you, this unique experience promises fun and skill-building in a stunning bay setting.

tours.description: Sail beyond Plymouth Sound into peaceful Tamar River waters, exploring naval landmarks, swimming, paddling, and relaxing in nature’s quiet. Perfect for reconnecting and escaping the busy world on a full-day adventure.

tours.name: Bristol Darkest Secrets Tour
tours.description: Uncover Bristol’s haunted secrets on a spooky evening walk filled with ghost stories, eerie landmarks, and mysterious tales. Join a live guide, test your wits in a fun quiz, and feel the thrill of the city’s ghostly past.

tours.description: Sample Edinburgh’s finest cheeses on a lively 2-hour crawl, meet local cheesemakers, enjoy fun facts, cheesy puns, and a glass of prosecco—delivering a flavorful, interactive adventure for cheese lovers.

tours.description: Explore London's rich pub history in a 2.5-hour tour, visiting 4 historic pubs, from Dickens' prison to the birthplace of John Harvard, sampling traditional cask and modern craft beers along the way.

tours.name: The Hidden Mews Pubs of Belgravia
tours.description: Uncover London's secret pub stories, from haunted card rooms to Beatles hangouts. Sip craft beers in historic venues filled with memorabilia, and walk through centuries of local legends on this immersive 2.5-hour tour.

tours.name: Literary and Musical Soho Pub Tour
tours.description: Explore London's historic pubs, from secret literary haunts to legendary battle sites. Walk through vibrant streets, hear wild stories, and sip craft beers in places linked to Dylan Thomas, Bowie, Hendrix, and more.

tours.name: Brighton & The Lanes Holiday Doughnut Tour
tours.description: Savor festive donuts and warm drinks as you stroll Brighton’s historic streets, explore holiday traditions, and end with seaside views at the iconic pier. A sweet, cozy holiday adventure by the sea.

tours.name: National  Portrait Gallery tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5-hour guided tour at the National Portrait Gallery, exploring 500 years of Muslim history through art. Discover hidden narratives, including the overlooked contributions of a Black Muslim in 1700s England, and unravel the complexities of British-Muslim relations during pivotal moments like the Crimean War.

tours.name: Jack the Ripper Walking Tour: Murder, Mystery, & the Women of Whitechapel
tours.description: Step into Whitechapel’s dark past as we unravel Jack the Ripper’s mystery, visiting original sites and exploring the lives of his victims in a gripping 2-hour journey through history’s most infamous unsolved case.

tours.name: Royal Cooking Class and Dining Experience
tours.description: Cook classic English dishes with a royal connection, then share a dinner inspired by British royalty. Enjoy a cozy, family-like atmosphere and insider stories that bring London’s food culture to life.

tours.name: Dalegarth to Ravenglass • Outbound Journey
tours.description: Ride a scenic steam train through Cumbria’s stunning landscapes and World Heritage Sites. Enjoy wildlife, waterfalls, and historic sites, with options to upgrade for luxury, afternoon tea, or explore charming villages along the way.

tours.name: from Dalegarth ➔ Return Journey
tours.description: Enjoy a scenic 40-minute ride through Cumbria’s stunning landscapes and World Heritage Sites, with options for upgrades, afternoon tea, and exploring the railway museum—perfect for families, couples, and groups.

tours.description: Ride a scenic steam train through Cumbria’s stunning landscapes and World Heritage Sites. Enjoy waterfalls, wildlife, and charming stations, with options to upgrade, walk, shop, and relax—perfect for all ages and interests.

tours.description: Experience the tranquility of the river with family and friends in a kayak! Choose between half or full-day hires, and enjoy a leisurely paddle upstream. Spot Kingfishers, savor a picnic, and unwind at The Riverside Inn after your adventure. It's a perfect blend of nature, relaxation, and fun!

tours.description: Glide across the river on a stable, top-quality paddleboard—perfect for beginners or relaxing sitting. Enjoy a safety briefing, scenic views, and finish with a refreshing drink at nearby cafes.

tours.name: Diesel • Day • Boat
tours.description: Glide along the River Thames on a diesel boat, passing historic colleges, green meadows, and quaint villages—an unforgettable journey through Oxford’s scenic charm.

tours.name: Self Guided Kayak Snorkel Trail
tours.description: Embark on a memorable tandem kayaking adventure in Studland Bay, where you’ll paddle through calm waters, snorkel at scenic spots, and savor ice cream on South Beach. This self-guided experience allows you to explore the stunning coastline while swapping paddlers, making it perfect for couples seeking a unique outdoor escape.

tours.name: The Ultimate Lake District Descent
tours.description: Dive into Stoneycroft Canyon for a 4-hour thrill ride of scrambling, sliding, jumping, and plunging through waterfalls and rapids. Perfect for adrenaline junkies, groups, or families seeking Lake District adventure.

tours.name: Soho Rock & Roll Pub Tour
tours.description: Explore Soho’s legendary music scene on a 3-hour pub tour, visiting iconic spots linked to The Beatles, Hendrix, Bowie, and more. Hear captivating stories, see historic venues, and feel London’s vibrant musical heartbeat.

tours.name: (GRPN) VR Escape Rooms and Adventures

tours.description: Ride a vintage steam train through Warwickshire’s scenic countryside, departing Stratford-upon-Avon. Watch the locomotive in Birmingham, snap photos, and enjoy a nostalgic journey on historic rails.

tours.description: Hop into a high-speed armored tank for a 20-minute thrill ride. Feel the power of a 200+ HP engine, stand in the turret, and enjoy an adrenaline-pumping adventure in Britain’s fastest tracked vehicle.

tours.name: The Shakespeare Express, with Flying Scotsman – Brunch
tours.description: Travel through Warwickshire on the iconic Flying Scotsman, savoring a delicious brunch and scenic views. Relax in vintage carriages, enjoy included tea and coffee, and relive the golden age of steam train travel.

tours.name: Greenwich: Time, Tides And The Making Of The Modern World
tours.description: Step into Greenwich’s rich past, where explorers, monarchs, and hidden stories shaped the world. Wander grand architecture and uncover lesser-known tales that reveal how this remarkable place changed history.

tours.name: The Shakespeare Express, with Flying Scotsman – Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Travel behind the legendary Flying Scotsman through Warwickshire’s scenic countryside, savoring afternoon tea in First Class. Relax, enjoy the golden age of steam, and make February truly unforgettable.

tours.name: The Shakespeare Express, with Flying Scotsman – 3-Course Dinner
tours.description: Travel back to the golden age of steam aboard the legendary Flying Scotsman. Relax in style with a 3-course dinner, enjoy scenic views, and feel the romance of classic train travel on this unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Derby Shakespeare Express
tours.description: Travel in style from Derby to Stratford-upon-Avon on a heritage steam train, exploring Shakespeare’s birthplace. Enjoy scenic views, leisure time, and optional gourmet meals for a memorable family adventure.

tours.name: Worcester Shakespeare Express
tours.description: Travel through scenic Worcestershire to Stratford-upon-Avon on a vintage steam train, enjoy 4.5 hours exploring Shakespeare’s birthplace, and indulge in delicious meals on a luxurious Pullman journey.

tours.name: Tour Gratis del Museo Británico en Londres
tours.description: Explore the British Museum’s treasures, from the Rosetta Stone to Egyptian mummies and Greek sculptures, on a guided Spanish tour that reveals the stories behind humanity’s greatest civilizations.

tours.name: Tour Gratis de la City de Londres
tours.description: Un recorrido en español por la histórica City de Londres, desde sus raíces romanas hasta su papel como centro financiero global, explorando monumentos, historia y reconstrucción en un paseo fascinante y cercano.

tours.name: Kayaking/Stand-up Paddleboarding - Wimbleball Lake
tours.description: Paddle along Exmoor’s stunning coast or Wimbleball Lake, spotting wildlife like porpoises and eagles. Enjoy fun games, learn new skills, and take in breathtaking scenery on a safe, guided kayaking adventure suitable for all levels.

tours.name: Beach Sauna
tours.description: Relax in a beachside sauna on Croyde beach, soaking in stunning ocean views while melting away stress. Feel the warmth and sea breeze combine for a truly refreshing escape.

tours.name: Private Boat Charter • HENLEY Regatta
tours.description: Sail along the scenic Thames in a private boat, perfect for small groups. Enjoy views of countryside, riverside homes, and historic landmarks—ideal for celebrations, family time, or watching Henley Royal Regatta in style.

tours.name: The Jack the Ripper Pub Tour
tours.company: The Jack the Ripper Tour With Ripper Vision
tours.description: Walk London's dark alleys and historic pubs linked to Jack the Ripper. Visit crime scenes, legendary taverns, and hear chilling stories from experts, all while soaking in Victorian atmosphere and local legends.

tours.name: Royal London Tour
tours.description: Step into Royal London’s rich history with visits to Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, and the Horse Guard’s Parade. Witness regal traditions and iconic sights on this unforgettable royal tour.

tours.name: Love Actually Walking Tour • Private
tours.description: Step into London’s film magic with a 2.5-hour Bridget Jones tour, visiting iconic locations from the movies, hearing behind-the-scenes stories, and snapping photos at landmarks like Tower Bridge and Bridget’s apartment.

tours.name: Private London Bucket List Tour
tours.description: Join a lively 1.5-hour walk to see the Changing the Guard from a prime spot, marching alongside bands and guards, avoiding crowds, and capturing unforgettable photos of this iconic ceremony and royal sights.

tours.name: London: Kensington Palace Gardens Tour & Royal Afternoon Tea Experience Spanish
tours.description: Stroll through Kensington Gardens, visit the Princess Diana statue, and explore the whimsical Cradle Walkway. Hear stories of Queen Elizabeth II’s reign and enjoy a regal afternoon tea in a stunning setting.

tours.name: London: Kensington Palace Gardens Tour & Royal Afternoon Tea Experience German
tours.description: Walk through Kensington Gardens’ royal grounds, see the Princess Diana statue, hear stories of Queen Elizabeth II, and enjoy a regal afternoon tea in a stunning setting.

tours.name: London: Kensington Palace Gardens Tour & Royal Afternoon Tea Experience French
tours.description: Walk through Kensington Gardens, visit the Princess Diana statue, and hear stories of Queen Elizabeth II’s reign. Finish with a regal afternoon tea in a stunning setting.

tours.name: Cycle Hire
tours.description: Discover the enchanting New Forest on a leisurely cycling adventure! With high-performance bikes, expert guidance, and scenic routes, you’ll explore hidden gems and meet the famous ponies. Perfect for couples and friends, this experience combines relaxation and nature, ensuring a memorable day filled with exploration and enjoyment.

tours.name: Troubles Tour: Walls & Bridges
tours.description: Embark on a profound 2.5-hour walking tour through Belfast, exploring its tumultuous history of conflict and resilience. Led by local experts, you'll visit iconic sites like the Peace Walls and political murals, gaining deep insights into the city's past and future, all while experiencing its vibrant culture and art.

tours.name: Canoe Rental - ALL SEASONS
tours.description: Paddle your own Canadian canoe on open water, exploring scenic spots at your own pace. Flexible bookings, perfect for families or small groups, with a 10% discount at nearby cafes.

tours.name: Exmoor Enduro
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Exmoor's best enduro trails on a guided ride designed for advanced mountain bikers. Navigate steep, technical paths through stunning moorlands and woodlands, led by expert British Cycling guides. Enjoy a full day of adventure, covering 30-40km with breathtaking views and a cozy lunch stop along the way.

tours.name: Jenny Wren - Canal Boat Cruises
tours.description: Embark on a 90-minute cruise aboard the charming Jenny Wren, navigating the iconic Hampstead Road Lock at Camden. Experience the beauty of Regent’s Park and London Zoo while enjoying engaging commentary from the crew. This unique journey from vibrant Camden to serene Little Venice promises unforgettable sights and delightful moments.

tours.name: 18 Hole Crazy Golf
tours.description: Experience a thrilling round of crazy golf on our unique 18-hole course, featuring exciting challenges and classic favorites. Perfect for any occasion, from family fun to competitive outings with friends, this memorable adventure promises excitement and enjoyment for everyone. Join us and see where you rank on our leaderboard!

tours.name: Table Tennis
tours.description: Experience the thrill of table tennis with friends and family at our venue featuring five full-size tables. Whether you're playing casually or competitively, enjoy food and drinks delivered right to your table. Book an hour slot for an unforgettable time filled with laughter and friendly rivalry!

tours.name: Canyoning - Keswick
tours.description: Conquer stunning Lake District canyons with climbing, abseiling, and zip wires. Feel adrenaline rush past waterfalls and deep pools, all guided by expert instructors in a safe, exhilarating outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Outdoor First Aid
tours.description: Master outdoor first aid in two days with hands-on training designed for remote UK settings. Gain skills to handle injuries and emergencies in the wild, backed by nationally recognized certification.

tours.name: Exmoor E-Bike Enduro
tours.description: Tackle Exmoor’s toughest enduro trails on your e-bike, conquering steep, technical terrain with expert guides. Ride scenic moorlands and lush valleys for a thrilling, 7-hour adventure designed for seasoned riders.

tours.name: Lantern Ghost Storywalk
tours.description: Follow Shanty Baba’s lantern into haunted St Ives, where ghostly tales, graveyards, and dark secrets come alive after sunset. An authentic, atmospheric storytelling experience you won’t forget.

tours.name: Windsor and Stonehenge Private Tour
tours.description: Uncover royal secrets at Windsor Castle, marvel at the ancient mystery of Stonehenge, and relax in Bath’s historic Roman Baths. A full-day private tour blending history, architecture, and legend in England’s finest sights.

tours.name: Shuffleboard
tours.description: Engage in an exhilarating game of shuffleboard, where strategy meets skill! Compete against friends to score points by knocking pucks off or sliding into high-scoring zones. Perfect for groups of 4 to 10, this thrilling experience promises fun and friendly rivalry as you aim for victory in just one hour.

tours.name: Puffin Cruise
tours.description: Sail around the Farne Islands for 2 hours during breeding season, spotting puffins, seabirds, and grey seals up close. Enjoy expert wildlife insights and soak in stunning natural scenery on this memorable boat trip.

tours.name: Breakfast Cruise
tours.description: Experience a delightful 1.5-hour cruise while savoring a traditional Full English Breakfast, complete with a glass of Bucks Fizz. Enjoy the picturesque scenery as you indulge in a hearty meal featuring sausage, bacon, eggs, and more. Elevate your breakfast with an upgrade for double portions of your favorites!

tours.name: Paddleboard Adventure - Saul Junction
tours.description: Glide along peaceful canals, spotting wildlife like swans and kingfishers, on a fun paddleboard safari. No experience needed—just bring your sense of adventure and enjoy scenic waterways, wildlife, and nearby cafes.

tours.name: Fabulous Family Fun
tours.description: Create sweet memories with your family as you craft colorful chocolate bark and fudge truffles under a theatrical chocolatier’s guidance. Leave with tasty treats and new skills in just 1.5 hours.

tours.name: Exmoor Flow Ride
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating full-day guided mountain bike ride through Exmoor, starting and ending at Porlock Weir. Experience flowing singletrack trails, scenic climbs, and thrilling descents over 35km, with 4,000ft of elevation gain. Perfect for intermediate riders, this adventure promises unforgettable views and a fantastic day in nature.

tours.name: Tank Passenger Ride - RUGBY
tours.description: Hop into a fast, agile tank for a 20-minute adrenaline rush across the countryside. Feel the power of a 200+ HP engine, stand in the turret, and enjoy an unforgettable ride in Britain’s finest armored vehicle.

tours.name: Team Building
tours.description: Boost teamwork and trust with a half-day of outdoor challenges like Spiders Web and problem-solving tasks. Energize your team, improve communication, and build bonds that last beyond the day.

tours.name: V.I.P Farm Experience Tour
tours.description: Experience farm life like never before with our VIP Experience! Shadow a farmer as you feed and care for animals, prepare their meals, and hand-feed them in their paddocks. Enjoy personal interactions with friendly creatures while learning about their unique personalities in this unforgettable, hands-on adventure.

tours.name: Cornish Coasteering: Live the Dream!
tours.description: Jump into the wild Cornish coast with swimming, climbing, and cave exploring. Feel the thrill of jumping and playing in waves, guided safely by experts, for an unforgettable seaside adventure.

tours.name: Cornish Kayaking: Explore the Camel Estuary
tours.description: Paddle through the stunning Camel Estuary, spotting wildlife and historic sites. Glide past abandoned quarries, enjoy scenic stops, and feel the tide guide your journey on this unforgettable kayaking adventure.

tours.name: Manchester Music Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Manchester’s legendary music scene in 1¾ hours, visiting iconic venues like the Hacienda, Ritz, and Boardwalk, while hearing stories of bands like Oasis, The Smiths, and Joy Division from a local expert.

tours.name: Newquay Kayaking Tour
tours.description: Learn to kayak in just 2 hours with expert guides, explore stunning coastlines, and enjoy a fun, beginner-friendly adventure—no experience needed. All gear included for your ocean escape.

tours.name: Blackhorse Lane Beer Mile Tour
tours.description: Explore London's vibrant craft beer scene on a guided tour of the Blackhorse Lane beer mile. Taste, learn, and deepen your beer knowledge with an expert in just 3 hours.

tours.name: Interactive Darts
tours.description: Experience the thrill of interactive darts, where real darts meet innovative technology that tracks your score! Perfect for groups of up to 18, this exciting activity offers a variety of games for everyone, from beginners to pros. Enjoy table service for food and drinks, ensuring you never miss a moment of fun!

tours.name: Amy Winehouse Tour
tours.description: Walk in Amy Winehouse’s footsteps through Camden’s vibrant streets, visiting her favorite pubs, historic venues, and the place she called home. A heartfelt tribute to her life, music, and lasting legacy.

tours.name: The Soho Music and Historic Pubs Tour 🍻
tours.description: Discover the vibrant history of London's Soho district on a 2.5-hour walking tour, led by a charismatic local guide. Explore iconic music venues, historic pubs, and hidden gems while hearing captivating stories of legends like The Beatles, Jimi Hendrix, and Mozart. Immerse yourself in Soho's rich artistic legacy and lively past.

tours.name: The Royal Pub Tour 👑
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour journey through London’s hidden royal pubs, where history and intrigue intertwine. Discover secret tunnels, hear tales of scandal and romance, and enjoy traditional British beers in unique settings. With an expert guide, experience the city like a local while uncovering its majestic secrets.

tours.name: The Great British Rock and Roll Tour 🎸
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-hour journey through London's rock and roll history, visiting iconic venues and hidden studios where legends like The Beatles and Jimi Hendrix once performed. Enjoy captivating stories from a local musician guide, and conclude with a refreshing beer at a classic rock venue, celebrating the golden age of music.

tours.name: The Forbidden Chronicles
tours.description: Uncover York’s dark, true history with tales of plague, murders, and legends. Walk through haunted sites, explore bizarre science, and face the city’s twisted past—no ghosts, just real stories that chill the spine.

tours.name: Distillery Tour
tours.description: Experience the captivating world of Kintyre Gin on a one-hour tour that delves into the distillery's rich history and production processes. Enjoy a perfectly crafted Kintyre G&T and sample a variety of gins while learning about the family estate. Group bookings and private tours are available for a memorable outing.

tours.name: Kintyre Gin School
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the art of gin-making at Kintyre Gin School! Discover the history and distillation process while blending your own unique gin. Enjoy a guided tasting of botanicals, create your personalized spirit, and take home two bottles, a branded glass, and a certificate. Experience the magic of distilling firsthand!

tours.name: Crossbow Shooting
tours.description: Try your hand at crossbow shooting in stunning Warwickshire. With expert guidance, modern gear, and fun competitions, you'll improve your aim and enjoy an outdoor adventure perfect for all skill levels.

tours.name: Ghost, Ghouls and Gallows Tours : London : French
tours.description: Uncover London's haunted secrets with a spooky ghost walk through royal parks and haunted sites, then relax on a nighttime Thames cruise with drinks, ending at the iconic Tower of London. Prepare for chills and thrills.

tours.name: Axe Throwing
tours.description: Test your precision at Keswick’s indoor axe throwing range. Learn techniques, then compete to hit the bullseye—who will claim the top score? Perfect for groups seeking fun and fierce competition.

tours.name: London Historic Pub Tour for Small Groups • Private
tours.description: Embark on the London Historic Pub Tour, a captivating 2.5-hour journey through the city’s iconic pubs. Explore ornate Victorian interiors, 17th-century haunts of literary legends, and a historic Irish pub. With a knowledgeable guide, uncover fascinating stories and secrets, all while savoring the charm of London’s rich pub culture.

tours.name: Amy Winehouse Tour • Private
tours.description: Walk through Camden’s vibrant streets and visit key spots linked to Amy Winehouse’s life—her favorite pubs, early gigs, and her home—bringing her story to life amid the area's creative energy and musical history.

tours.name: Free tour de Jack el destripador
tours.description: Uncover the chilling story of Jack the Ripper through theatrical scenes, dark humor, and haunting sites like Mitre Square and Ten Bells. Dive into the mystery of 1888’s Whitechapel murders and feel the terror firsthand.

tours.name: Free tour por Brixton
tours.description: Explore Brixton's vibrant streets, colorful murals like David Bowie’s, and lively markets. Dive into London's diverse culture and rich history on this engaging free tour through one of south London’s coolest neighborhoods.

tours.name: New Forest Vineyard & Wine Tasting Experience
tours.description: Cycle along the scenic New Forest coast and woodland on retro e-bikes, visit a vineyard for tastings, spot ponies and wildlife, enjoy local food, and explore charming towns—an adventure for all ages and riding styles.

tours.name: Angels TV & Film Costume Tour • Private
tours.description: Embark on the Angels Costume Tour for an unforgettable 1.5-hour journey through the heart of costume creation. Explore a treasure trove of iconic outfits from beloved films and shows, including Harry Potter and Game of Thrones. Discover the rich history of Angels, a key player in the entertainment industry since 1840.

tours.name: Looe to Polperro Coastal and Woodland Adventure: Walk, Boat & Refreshments
tours.description: Embark on a challenging 10 km walk through enchanting woodlands and stunning coastal paths, guided by Simon. Experience breathtaking views, explore the charming village of Polperro, and enjoy a delightful light lunch or cream tea. Cap off your adventure with a scenic boat trip past Looe Island for unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Bob Dylan London Tour • Private
tours.description: Discover the captivating connection between Bob Dylan and London on this immersive walking tour. Delve into the city's rich musical and cultural history while exploring the iconic locations that influenced one of the greatest songwriters. Whether a devoted fan or a curious music lover, this experience promises unforgettable insights into Dylan's artistic journey.

tours.name: Chester SUP Journey
tours.description: Paddle along Chester’s river Dee with your group, guided by pro instructors. No experience needed—just bring your sense of adventure. Glide under the Queens Park Bridge, spot birdlife, and enjoy a fun, personalized SUP trip.

tours.name: Thoulstone Climb & Clamber
tours.description: Conquer towering walls, leap from the faith challenge, and tackle daring climbs at Thoulstone Park. Push your limits, enjoy breathtaking heights, and feel the thrill of adventure in this action-packed 75-minute session.

tours.name: Silver Ring Workshops
tours.description: Experience the art of silver ring making in a private workshop led by expert Annie. Perfect for beginners, this hands-on session allows you to craft a unique piece of jewelry using traditional techniques, ensuring a memorable and personalized creative journey for you and your friends.

tours.name: Archery
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery in the enchanting Sherwood Forest, the legendary home of Robin Hood. With expert guidance, you'll master the art of shooting arrows in a serene woodland setting, making unforgettable memories as you channel your inner marksman. Join us for this unique adventure in Nottinghamshire!

tours.name: Assault Course
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure through the heart of Sherwood Forest with this unique assault course. Navigate challenging obstacles like the Burma Bridge and Black Hole while working as a team to dismantle and reassemble a 6-piece Cannon. Each challenge tests your limits and fosters teamwork, making for an unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Blindfold Driving
tours.description: Experience the thrill of driving blindfolded on a 770-metre slalom course in Sherwood Forest. Rely entirely on your teammates as they guide you through suspended gates, creating a unique challenge that tests your trust and teamwork. This unforgettable adventure promises excitement and camaraderie like no other!

tours.name: Combat Archery
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Archery Combat in Sherwood Forest, where you can unleash your inner hunter! Battle friends with state-of-the-art equipment and specially designed foam-tipped arrows, ensuring a safe yet exhilarating showdown. Feel the rush as you aim to knock your opponents off their feet in this unique adventure!

tours.name: Jungle Challenge
tours.description: Experience an exclusive adventure in Sherwood Forest, where the excitement of Cristal Maze meets the creativity of Scrapheap Challenge. Teams tackle unique missions using provided equipment, with challenges tailored to the day’s weather and group size, ensuring a memorable and dynamic experience in a stunning natural setting.

tours.name: Knife and Axe Throwing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of becoming a Jungle Warrior in the heart of Sherwood Forest! Test your skills with unique weaponry, including throwing knives and axes, in an exciting event perfect for groups seeking something different. This exclusive adventure promises a memorable challenge unlike anything seen in the movies!

tours.name: Gel Blaster

tours.description: Soar in an eco-friendly electric aircraft over Norfolk’s iconic sights, from historic cathedrals to lush countryside. Take the controls and enjoy a scenic flight that puts you in the pilot’s seat for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Pipistrel Explorer • 45-minutes Flight Experience / Trial Lesson
tours.description: Soar over Norfolk’s stunning coast and countryside in a sleek Pipistrel Explorer. Feel the thrill of flying, take the controls if you wish, and enjoy a fun, smooth flight with breathtaking views in a versatile, easy-to-fly aircraft.

tours.name: Pipistrel Explorer • 1-hour Flight Experience / Trial Lesson
tours.description: Soar over Norfolk’s stunning coast and countryside in a nimble Pipistrel Explorer. Feel the thrill of flying, take the controls if you wish, and enjoy a fun, low-noise adventure in a versatile, easy-to-fly aircraft.

tours.name: Diamond DA40 • 1-hour Flight Experience / Trial Lesson
tours.description: Soar over Norfolk’s stunning coast and countryside in a sleek Diamond DA40. Get a pre-flight briefing, then take the controls and feel the thrill of flying with breathtaking views all around.

tours.name: Historic Airfields • 1-hour experience - Diamond DA-40 (2 Guests)
tours.description: Take to the skies in a sleek Diamond DA40, soaring over Norfolk’s historic airfields. Feel the thrill as you take the controls and enjoy stunning views, blending adventure with a taste of aviation history.

tours.name: June • Craft of the Month: Summer Candle Painting Crafternoon
tours.description: Create personalized, colorful dinner candles with expert guidance, perfect for weddings or home decor. Enjoy a relaxing craft session paired with delicious teas, scones, or grazing platters for a memorable experience.

tours.description: Conquer rugged cliffs and hidden coves on this 2.5-hour coasteering adventure. Jump, scramble, and swim past smugglers’ caves, with breathtaking views of Ilfracombe’s cliffs and wildlife—an adrenaline rush in stunning scenery.

tours.name: Private Hire 60 minutes Sauna & Swim at TCR the Hub
tours.description: Unwind in a private Finnish lakeside sauna, then cool off with refreshing lake dips. Feel the heat relax your muscles, then dip into icy waters—pure bliss in nature’s tranquil setting.

tours.name: Soft Play Parties
tours.description: Host a memorable birthday with soft play fun at SPVR Arcade. Choose all-in-one packages with food and decorations or customize your own celebration in our flexible dry venue. Safe, lively, and hassle-free!

tours.name: London: Graffiti Workshop and Street Art Tour
tours.description: Explore Brixton’s vibrant street art scene with a guided tour and a hands-on graffiti class. Learn to create your own tag, hear artist stories, and leave with a unique piece of street art in just 2.5 hours.

tours.name: British Baking Masterclass - Royal Victoria Sponge
tours.description: Create your own perfect Victoria Sponge in a lively UK baking tent. Learn, decorate, and enjoy your cake with tea—no experience needed. All equipment and ingredients provided, plus a fun, hands-on atmosphere.

tours.name: British Baking Masterclass - Classic Scones
tours.description: Join the UK's top baking experience to craft perfect British scones with homemade jam and cream. Enjoy hands-on fun, expert tips, and delicious treats in a lively, welcoming setting—no experience needed!

tours.name: British Baking Masterclass - Iconic Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Get hands-on with the UK's top baking experience, crafting classic Afternoon Tea treats in a lively tent. No skills needed—just bring your enthusiasm and enjoy your delicious creations with friends or family.

tours.name: The Ultimate Guide to Edinburgh : German

tours.description: Step into Victorian Covent Garden’s hidden past with lively stories of music halls, markets, and famous writers. Walk through secret gardens and historic streets, bringing history alive for students and history buffs alike.

tours.name: Weymouth Self-Guided Food Tour
tours.description: Explore Weymouth’s hidden gems and iconic sights at your own pace within 1.5km. Savor local fish and chips, cream teas, and craft beers, uncovering lesser-known spots and classic landmarks in a flexible 6-hour tasting adventure.

tours.name: Xtra Games Party

tours.name: Paddleboard, Canoe & Kayak Day Launch Permit

tours.description: Walk through Camden’s vibrant streets and visit Amy Winehouse’s favorite spots, from pubs to markets, uncovering her story and Camden’s creative spirit in a heartfelt 2-hour tour.

tours.name: Cathedral Quarter Tour | Individual Seats

Discover iconic landmarks like the Albert Clock and City Hall while enjoying the lively atmosphere of arts, culture, and local bars. Perfect for special occasions, this experience promises unforgettable memories and the chance to refuel with delicious snacks along the way.

Discover iconic landmarks like the Albert Clock and City Hall, while enjoying local bars and eateries. Perfect for special occasions, this unique adventure combines culture, fun, and the chance to celebrate with friends.

Explore the sites of gruesome murders, uncover the gritty realities of Victorian life, and play detective as you delve into the mystery surrounding the infamous killer and his victims. A thrilling experience awaits!

Discover where literary legends lost their manuscripts and poets faced duels, all while enjoying a half pint at a favorite haunt of Charles Dickens. Experience the drama and history of London's drinking culture.

Discover the haunting stories of crime and suffering that linger in the air, and dare to walk among the midnight monsters that haunt the capital.

tours.description: Experience an adrenaline-fueled 2.5-hour session of Archery, Axe Throwing, and Static Archery Combat at Featherdown Farm. Get ready to aim, throw, and compete in an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Heretics and Horrors City Walk
tours.description: Uncover London's dark history with a 90-minute walk through fire, plague, and executions. Explore hidden stories of power, betrayal, and hauntings in the city’s most haunted streets and secret corners.

tours.name: Best of Blackfriars Walk
tours.description: Uncover Blackfriars' hidden history in 90 minutes—Roman villas, Tudor palaces, Victorian engineering, and modern architecture. Walk where Shakespeare, Pepys, and Dickens once strolled, and see London's evolving story come alive.

tours.name: Georgian London Walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating guided walk through Georgian London, exploring the vibrant transformation of North Clerkenwell. Led by a knowledgeable guide, uncover tales of radicals and entertainers, admire stunning architecture, and visit the historic Sadler’s Wells Theatre. Experience the lively contrasts of an era that shaped modern London.

tours.name: A Road to Ruin Walk
tours.description: Uncover London's lively drinking history on a 1.5-hour guided walk through Clerkenwell. Explore historic pubs, gin distilleries, and alleyways while learning stories behind famous phrases like "Mother’s Ruin" and Hogarth’s satirical art.

tours.name: Hampstead Village Walk
tours.description: Explore Hampstead Village’s rich artistic and literary history, charming streets, and stunning Heath views on a lively 90-minute guided walk. Discover hidden corners, famous residents, and timeless scenery with an engaging expert guide.

tours.name: Financial London Walk
tours.description: Uncover London’s financial secrets on a 90-minute walk through historic alleys, iconic landmarks, and stories of wealth and risk. Learn how London became the world’s top financial hub and see where history still shapes today’s markets.

tours.name: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde Walk
tours.description: Explore Victorian London’s dark side on a 90-minute walk through Soho, inspired by Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde. Live readings, eerie streets, and fascinating stories bring Stevenson’s gothic tale to life. Perfect for literature lovers and curious explorers.

tours.name: Euston to King's Cross Walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute guided walk through Euston and King’s Cross, where history intertwines with modern transformation. Discover hidden Georgian streets, iconic landmarks, and the literary legacies of Charles Dickens and John Betjeman. Led by an expert guide, this experience promises engaging stories and a unique glimpse into London’s evolving culture.

tours.name: Rock Climbing & Abseiling  at Croyde Bay
tours.description: Conquer North Devon’s rugged cliffs with a guided rock climbing and abseiling adventure tailored to your skill level. Feel the thrill, enjoy stunning coastal views, and build confidence on this unforgettable outdoor challenge.

tours.name: Medieval London Walk
tours.description: Explore medieval London’s bustling streets, rich trade, and deep religion. Uncover hidden landmarks, gritty sanitation, and lively stories from the past—all in 90 minutes of engaging storytelling through history’s most exciting era.

tours.name: Downton Abbey Walking Tour of London
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour walking tour through central London, exploring iconic filming locations from Downton Abbey. Discover charming streets and historic sites, relive pivotal moments from the series, and hear behind-the-scenes stories. Visit the Crawley residence, Grantham House, and more, ending your journey in the serene Green Park.

tours.name: Heartbeat Tour of Filming Locations
tours.description: Step into the world of Heartbeat with a 7-hour tour visiting Whitby’s seaside charm, Aidensfield’s iconic locations, and stunning North Yorkshire scenery—where TV magic, history, and nature collide.

tours.name: Midsomer Murders Tour of Locations
tours.description: Step into the eerie charm of Midsomer with visits to iconic villages, murder scenes, and filming locations from over 20 episodes. Enjoy scenic towns, a cream tea, and behind-the-scenes stories from the beloved series.

tours.name: Oxford private walking tour
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s historic sights on a private 3-hour walking tour. Discover famous colleges, libraries, museums, and stunning architecture while hearing stories of legendary alumni and university traditions tailored to your interests.

tours.name: Oxford Picnic Cruise - Private
tours.description: Sail along Oxford’s scenic river, passing historic landmarks and hidden spots like Port Meadow and Godstow. Enjoy a relaxing cruise with a delicious floating picnic amid timeless landscapes and literary inspiration.

tours.name: Southend Day Trip (departing Queenborough)
tours.description: Escape to Southend for a fun-filled day with fish and chips, seaside strolls, and a scenic train ride along the pier. Enjoy six hours of adventure, laughter, and seaside magic before heading back home.

tours.name: London Film Walk
tours.description: Explore London's iconic film locations in a 2-hour family-friendly walk, seeing landmarks from Mary Poppins to Spider-Man, with behind-the-scenes stories and interactive scenes from over 30 blockbuster movies.

tours.name: White Water Rafting - Private experience
tours.description: Conquer thrilling rapids like Serpents Tail and Town Falls on the River Dee. Surf waves, race in raft games, and enjoy expert guidance—all in a safe, adrenaline-packed 3-hour adventure with top gear and personalized fun.

tours.name: The Garden Village of Pimlico Walk
tours.description: Uncover Pimlico’s hidden charm on this 90-minute guided walk. See elegant terraces, lush squares, and bold 20th-century architecture, while hearing stories of visionary planners, famous architects, and London’s lesser-known neighborhood.

tours.name: Surf Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with our diverse selection of high-quality foam and hard surfboards, complemented by comfortable 5mm full-length wetsuits. Whether you choose a 2.5-hour session or an all-day adventure, ride the waves and create unforgettable memories. Just remember to return your gear by 4:45 PM!

tours.name: Freddie Mercury & Queen. The London Tour
tours.description: Join a lively tour through Kensington’s Queen history, visiting Freddie Mercury’s home, legendary gig spots, and iconic locations. Hear captivating stories, see photos, and relive the band’s rise from students to rock legends.

tours.name: Historic London Pub Walk around Belgravia
tours.description: Uncover Belgravia’s secret pubs, from haunted spots to Beatles hangouts. Walk through historic streets, hear legendary stories, and see where stars and criminals once mingled—all in a lively 3-hour tour.

tours.name: Women in the City: Power, Profit & Progress Walk
tours.description: Uncover London's hidden stories of pioneering women who challenged authority, fueled economic growth, and rewrote history. A lively 90-minute walk through historic streets reveals their resilience, achievements, and lasting legacy.

tours.name: Secrets of Spitalfields Walk
tours.description: Explore Spitalfields' rich history in 90 minutes: from Huguenot silk weavers and historic synagogues to vibrant street art and immigrant stories. Uncover untold tales of activism, resilience, and cultural transformation in East London.

tours.name: Doctor Who Walking Tour
tours.description: Join David Turnbull on a captivating Doctor Who walking tour through Waterloo and the Southbank, celebrating the show's 60th anniversary. Explore iconic filming locations, uncover hidden histories, and enjoy exclusive insights from a seasoned guide. This unique journey merges Whovian magic with London's rich culture, making it an unforgettable experience for fans and newcomers alike.

tours.name: Fleet Street Walk
tours.description: Explore Fleet Street’s legendary past in journalism, from historic pubs and iconic landmarks to secret courtyards. Walk where press barons, scandal, and stories shaped Britain’s media, all brought to life by an expert guide.

tours.name: Mystic Boat Hire
tours.description: Glide across the lake in a quiet, easy-to-drive electric boat with flexible covers, perfect for families and friends. Enjoy scenic views, simple steering, and bring your dog along for a relaxing day on the water.

tours.name: History of Horror Walk
tours.description: Explore London's haunted West End with a horror expert. Walk past iconic filming locations, uncover gothic legends, and learn how London shaped horror cinema from Dracula to modern classics. A chilling journey into fear.

tours.name: Magic Portal Outdoor Game Newtown
tours.description: Dive into the thrilling world of Magic Portal, an outdoor escape game where teams race against time to solve puzzles and collect crystals in a fantastical realm filled with goblins. Experience an unforgettable blend of treasure hunting, GPS geocaching, and augmented reality for an adventure like no other!

tours.name: Magic Portal Llanidloes

Experience an innovative blend of treasure hunting, GPS geocaching, and augmented reality for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Operation Mindfall Newtown

tours.name: Operation Mindfall Llanidloes
tours.description: Join a secret mission to stop Spider Tech in a high-tech adventure blending GPS geocaching, live escape challenges, gadgets, and augmented reality—test your skills and save the world in just 2 hours.

Enjoy modern safety features while relishing an authentic driving experience, whether for a self-drive adventure or a stylish wedding ride. Snowdrop is truly unforgettable.

Guided by an expert, you'll create a gourmet three-course meal, including a show-stopping soufflé and decadent chocolate fondant. Enjoy cocktails, canapés, and the joy of cooking together for an unforgettable evening.

tours.name: Book Inflatable Land Wristbands – Unlimited Fun
tours.description: Bounce, race, and slide through nine giant inflatables at Horsenden Hill’s outdoor park. Enjoy active fun, tasty food, and relaxing outdoor seating in a scenic nature reserve for a memorable family day out.

tours.name: Adult Paintballing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paintball with three exciting packages tailored for groups of 8 to 30. Each package includes essential gear, protective clothing, and a generous supply of paintballs, ensuring an action-packed adventure. Plus, enjoy the convenience of washable paint, making cleanup a breeze after your unforgettable day of fun!

tours.name: Junior Paintballing (Splatmaster)

With lightweight, spring-loaded guns and exciting missions like capture the flag, players enjoy a safe, fun environment focused on teamwork. Exclusive sessions with a qualified instructor ensure a memorable and engaging experience for all ages.

tours.name: Kayak, Fish, Forage & Feast

Forage for wild plants and seaweed to enhance your catch, then savor a professionally prepared meal in a seaside pavilion, all while learning sustainable techniques from expert guides.

tours.name: Coastal Foraging & Edible Seaweed
tours.description: Embark on a unique coastal adventure with expert forager Dan Scott in Dorset. Discover the secrets of edible seaweed and coastal plants, learn about their medicinal benefits, and harvest wild edibles. Conclude your experience by savoring a heartwarming wild soup made from your foraged treasures, perfect for all skill levels.

tours.name: Introduction to Foraging (2 Hour Course)
tours.description: Join a beginner-friendly foraging course designed for families, where you'll master essential outdoor skills like shelter building, water purification, and fire lighting. Guided by experienced foragers, this hands-on experience offers wild plant identification and tool techniques, making it an exciting adventure for youths aged 8 and up, rain or shine.

tours.name: Intermediate Sea Kayaking (Full Day)
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating full-day intermediate sea kayaking course, navigating the breathtaking Jurassic Coastline. Explore the enchanting caves and cliffs of Old Harry Rocks while honing your boat handling and safety skills. With expert coaching in a small group setting, prepare for unforgettable adventures on the water.

tours.name: Outdoor Adventure Party in Studland Bay
tours.description: Celebrate your child's birthday with an unforgettable outdoor adventure! Engage in den building, foraging, and bug hunts while enjoying outdoor games and slack lining. Delight in tasty frankfurter hot dogs and hot chocolate with mini marshmallows, all tailored for ages 5-12. Create lasting memories in nature with friends!

tours.name: Seasonal Family Bushcraft
tours.description: Embark on a seasonal bushcraft adventure with your family, where you'll master fire lighting, shelter building, and camp crafts. Enjoy cooking delicious treats like s'mores over the fire while learning essential outdoor skills from expert guides in a fun and interactive environment, perfect for all ages.

tours.name: Beginners Rock Climbing

In a small group, you'll master essential techniques like harness fitting, belaying, and top rope climbing against the breathtaking backdrop of the Dorset coast. Enjoy a memorable half-day adventure in a stunning natural setting.

tours.name: Night Paddle, Wild Bivy & Sunrise SUP
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable overnight sea kayaking adventure in Dorset! Paddle under the stars to Old Harry Rocks, camp in a Bivi bag, and wake up to a stunning sunrise while stand-up paddleboarding in Studland Bay. Perfect for those looking to enhance their kayaking skills while immersing in nature's beauty.

tours.name: Wild Camping, Sea Kayaking, Coastal Foraging and Bushcraft Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure along the stunning Dorset coast with a unique blend of sea kayaking, wild camping, and foraging. Paddle past the iconic Old Harry Rocks, explore hidden caves, snorkel in secret coves, and enjoy a sunset SUP session, all while savoring an outdoor BBQ lunch in a serene nature reserve.

tours.name: Outdoor SUP Party in Studland Bay
tours.description: Host an unforgettable stand-up paddleboarding party in Studland, designed for kids aged 12 and up! Enjoy thrilling games and challenges on the water, with all equipment provided. Celebrate with delicious hot dogs and hot chocolate topped with marshmallows, making this adventure a perfect birthday experience!

tours.name: Watersports & Woodland Party in Studland
tours.description: Celebrate your child's birthday with an unforgettable outdoor adventure in Studland! Tailored for curious kids, this party features exciting activities like den building, bug hunts, and thrilling watersports, including kayaking and paddleboarding. Enjoy tasty treats like hot dogs and hot chocolate, making it a memorable day filled with fun and exploration!
