tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5-hour journey through Scotland's five whisky regions, tasting exceptional 18-year-old whiskies. Guided by an expert, discover the unique flavors and characteristics of each region while savoring some of the finest spirits available. This exclusive event promises a memorable evening for whisky enthusiasts. Secure your spot now!

tours.name: Dream Drams
tours.description: Experience an exclusive one-on-one whisky tasting with Adelaide Hayes Elliott, the custodian of the Soho Whisky Club. Discover rare, sought-after whiskies from long-gone distilleries, guided by Adelaide's passion and expertise. This unique opportunity promises a memorable journey through the history and flavors of exceptional spirits. Secure your spot now!

tours.name: Solo SUP Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand-up-Paddle Boarding at Oddicombe Beach, a stunning location known for its calm waters and breathtaking sunrises. Perfect for beginners and families, each hire includes essential equipment. Enjoy the beauty of a marine conservation zone, where you might even spot seals and cetaceans during your adventure.

tours.name: Giant SUP Board Hire
tours.description: 30 minute - 2 hour hire

tours.name: Tandem Sit-On-Top Kayak Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of tandem sea kayaking with our easy-to-use Sit-on-Top kayaks, perfect for two paddlers. Explore the stunning coastline safely with a friend or family member, including children under 14. Enjoy a memorable adventure on the water, complete with all necessary gear for a smooth ride.

tours.name: Canoe Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable canoe adventure with our 16 Ft Mad River Canoes, perfect for families and couples alike. Paddle through the scenic bay to Babbacombe beach, where you might spot seals. Enjoy quality time together and don’t forget to pack a lunch for this memorable outing!

tours.name: Kayak Rolling Clinic
tours.description: Join our personalized kayaking rolling clinics on the scenic River Dee, perfect for all skill levels. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your technique, our qualified coach will guide you through essential skills in a safe environment. Build confidence and elevate your rolling abilities for future adventures!

tours.name: Family Adventure Stay - Activities & Accommodation
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable family getaway at Parkwood Outdoors Dolygaer this summer! Choose from camping or glamping accommodations and dive into thrilling family activities amidst the stunning scenery of the Brecon Beacons. Create lasting memories together in this perfect outdoor setting for adventure and fun.

tours.name: Christmas Evening Dining Tour
tours.description: Experience a unique Christmas Evening Dining Tour aboard the Red Bus Bistro, featuring a delightful four-course meal and festive fun. This memorable event promises to elevate your office Christmas party into an unforgettable experience, making it the talk of the season. Book early to secure your spot for this special night!

tours.name: Country Tour
tours.description: Join the big red bus bistro for a lively evening of sing-along country music, delicious food, and drinks. Experience the fun atmosphere as you don your stetson hat and boots, making unforgettable memories with fellow country music lovers. Don't miss this unique blend of entertainment and dining!

tours.name: Princess And Superhero Tour
tours.description: Join the enchanting Princess and Superhero Tour for a magical hour of fun aboard a big red bus in Glasgow! Meet beloved characters, indulge in delightful treats, and leave with a special party bag. This unique adventure promises unforgettable memories for all young adventurers!

tours.name: Early Morning Canoe Hire - 3 hours
tours.description: Experience the serene beauty of Derwentwater at dawn with a canoe adventure! Glide across the tranquil waters, spotting wildlife like deer and kingfishers, while enjoying a picnic with freshly baked scones. Perfect for families and beginners, this unique outing promises unforgettable moments amidst nature's wonders.

tours.name: Low Impact Splatball
tours.description: Experience the excitement of Splat Master, a thrilling low-impact alternative to paintball designed for ages 7 and up. Enjoy a safe and friendly environment at Skirmish Central, where you can easily lock, load, and fire with provided gear. Perfect for groups seeking fun without the intensity of traditional paintball!

tours.name: School/College/Academies 30+ Attendees
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable End of Term Activity Day at Skirmish Central, set in a stunning forest with themed arenas. Engage in thrilling games like Lasertag and Axe Throwing, with all equipment provided. Enjoy a meal deal in a comfortable reception area, perfect for team bonding and excitement!

tours.name: Reformation Walk: Private Walking Tour
tours.description: Uncover Cambridge’s role in the English Reformation with a 1.5-2 hour guided tour. Visit historic sites, explore colleges, and learn how reformers shaped modern society in this fascinating city walk.

tours.name: Disc Golf
tours.description: 👉 For all ages! ⏳ Play 9 or 18 holes in 1-2 hours. A fun mix of Frisbee & Golf

tours.name: Pontcysyllte Aqueduct Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of crossing the world's highest navigable aqueduct, the Pontcysyllte Aqueduct, on a guided canoe tour. Built in 1805, this engineering marvel offers breathtaking views and an unforgettable adventure for all fitness levels. Join us for a unique journey through history and nature, equipped with all necessary safety gear.

tours.name: Chirk Aqueduct & tunnel Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 3.5-hour adventure at the Chirk Aqueduct, where you can straddle the border between England and Wales. Experience a guided canoe tour through a stunning mountain tunnel, showcasing remarkable engineering from the 18th century. This unique journey promises breathtaking views and unforgettable memories for all fitness levels.

tours.name: Curling Lanes
tours.description: Experience a unique Christmas celebration with friends on our private curling lanes! Enjoy an hour of fun with drinks from our Alpine booth, including beers, mulled wine, or Prosecco. Embrace the festive spirit in Cambridge's outdoor setting—just remember to bundle up for this memorable winter activity!

tours.name: Private Hire
tours.description: Celebrate in style aboard a luxurious private bus, offering panoramic views of London's iconic landmarks. Indulge in gourmet catering, fine drinks, and personalized touches like décor and music. Whether for a wedding, corporate event, or special occasion, enjoy a tailored, unforgettable journey through the heart of London.

tours.name: Tour for Muggles - Evening Dark Arts Tour
tours.description: Uncover the dark secrets of the wizarding world on a thrilling walking tour through iconic Harry Potter locations in London, blending spooky stories with magical history for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Paintball (Adult)
tours.description: Dive into a thrilling 3-hour paintball adventure in woodland terrain, armed with Tippman FT-12 markers. Feel the rush as you hide, strategize, and aim for victory amidst natural and crafted cover.

tours.name: SSI Deep Diving
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the depths with the SSI Deep Diving Specialty course. Master planning and safety for deep dives while utilizing computers and gas calculations. Earn your certification and unlock access to stunning dive sites, paving the way for advanced training in your diving education.

tours.name: Free tour Historia del otro lado del Río Támesis
tours.description: Step into historic Southwark’s shadowy past, where crime, ghosts, and vibrant theaters intertwine along the Thames. Walk past St. Paul’s, Shakespeare’s Globe, and London Bridge—royal favorites and timeless stories await.

tours.name: Big Sights Tour – Iconic London Taxi Tour
tours.description: Discover the wonders of London in a classic black cab on this private tour. Enjoy panoramic views, expert insights, and a customizable itinerary that highlights the city's iconic sights. Perfect for first-time visitors, this hassle-free experience allows you to soak in the grandeur and history of the capital in just four hours.

tours.name: Roller Skating
tours.description: Experience the thrill of skating at our accessible Ice Rink, where everyone can enjoy the freedom of gliding on ice. With mandatory wrist guards for safety and the chance to be featured in our social media, this is a unique opportunity for fun and memorable moments.

tours.name: Ebrius Edinburgh Weekend Pub Crawl
tours.description: Join Edinburgh’s wildest night with free shots, lively bars, dance floors, and a buzzing crowd. Perfect for solo travelers or friends ready to party, make new friends, and create unforgettable stories on the move.

tours.name: Hard Hat Tour
tours.description: Uncover hidden secrets beneath the Clifton Suspension Bridge on a one-hour guided tour of sealed vaults, revealing lost history and engineering marvels once hidden for nearly 200 years.

tours.name: Vault Visit
tours.description: Explore the hidden underground vaults beneath Clifton Suspension Bridge, climb into cavernous chambers, and see the bridge from a whole new perspective. Perfect for curious adventurers and photo enthusiasts alike.

tours.name: Pre-School Group
tours.description: Little explorers can get muddy, dig in the mud kitchen, and enjoy imaginative play in a safe woodland setting. Perfect for building confidence, making friends, and loving the outdoors—rain or shine.

tours.name: Learn to Paddleboard
tours.description: Enjoy a friendly, small-group paddleboarding lesson on calm canals like Islington or Hackney. Learn stance, strokes, and safety at your own pace, with scenic tours available for a memorable water adventure.

tours.name: TREK Kids Bike: 26 inch wheel
tours.description: Cycle along stunning North Yorkshire coast and moorlands, riding the historic Cinder Track to Whitby or Ravenscar, or explore wild bridleways for a thrilling, off-the-beaten-path adventure.

tours.name: Kids Bike: 20 inch wheel
tours.description: Cycle along stunning North Yorkshire coast and moorlands, riding the historic Cinder Track to Whitby or Ravenscar, or explore hidden trails across wild, open moorland for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: TREK Kids Bike: 24 inch wheel
tours.description: Cycle along stunning North Yorkshire coast and moorlands, riding the historic Cinder Track to Whitby or Ravenscar, or explore hidden trails across wild, open moorland for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Henley Festival SUP Experience 2026
tours.description: Paddle to Henley Festival on a glow-lit SUP, soaking in live music and vibrant sights. After the show, enjoy a spectacular fireworks display on your return journey—an unforgettable night on the water.

tours.name: Endurance Adventure Gig Rowing Course
tours.description: Join a 10-week course to boost your strength, stamina, and rowing skills. Perfect for adventure seekers, it builds sea-ready crews while helping you meet passionate rowers and conquer long-distance challenges.

tours.name: Over 50s Group
tours.description: Join our weekly rowing sessions designed for over 50s, where you can enjoy the serene beauty of Weymouth bay and harbour. Experience a unique blend of wellness and gentle exercise that enhances flexibility, stamina, and strength, all while connecting with a friendly community of fellow rowers.

tours.name: Sirens Ladies Surf Club
tours.description: Join our Ladies’ Surf Club for supportive, fun-filled sessions in Widemouth Bay and Bossiney Bay. Perfect for all skill levels, these inclusive classes boost confidence, improve skills, and connect women through surfing.

tours.name: Start Young Driver Experience - Automatic Car
tours.description: Help your child gain confidence behind the wheel in a safe, private 52-acre track. Perfect for all ages, with expert instructors guiding nervous drivers and learners in a pressure-free, supportive setting.

tours.name: Couples Challenge Tank Driving Experience
tours.description: Feel the thrill of commanding a real tank with a partner—drive through challenging laps, aim and fire powerful paintball cannons, and switch roles for double the action in this adrenaline-packed military adventure.

tours.name: Tag Archery
tours.description: Unleash your competitive side with fast-paced combat archery! Tag opponents with foam-tipped arrows in a fun, team-based game that tests accuracy, strategy, and teamwork—perfect for groups, parties, or corporate events.

tours.name: Digital Disconnection Transport
tours.description: Skip the hassle with our convenient transport to Brecon Mountain Railway, making family trips easy. Relax and enjoy the scenic ride, then dive into the Digital Disconnection adventure at Dolygaer.

tours.name: The Shakespeare Express, with Flying Scotsman
tours.description: Climb aboard the legendary Flying Scotsman for a scenic steam train ride through Warwickshire. Relax, soak in the countryside views, and relive the golden age of rail travel on this unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Goat Yoga at Errington's Barn
tours.description: Unwind outdoors at Errington’s Barn with playful goat yoga. Enjoy gentle standing poses, fresh air, and the cheerful company of young goats, creating a joyful, nature-filled moment for all abilities.

tours.name: Exmoor MTB Weekend - The Best of Exmoor
tours.description: Ride the rugged, thrilling trails of Exmoor on expert-guided mountain bike weekends. Conquer steep descents, scenic hills, and technical singletracks, all with local tips, e-bike options, and stunning seaside finishes.

tours.name: Row - Beach Yoga - Row
tours.description: Glide across Weymouth Bay by boat, then unwind with a calming beach yoga session. Perfect for all levels, this 2.5-hour experience blends gentle exercise, coastal scenery, and community in a serene, revitalizing setting.

tours.name: REGENTS CANAL WATERBUS from CAMDEN MARKET→ LITTLE VENICE
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 45-minute Regents Canal Waterbus trip from Camden Market to Little Venice. Choose between a historic narrowboat with guided commentary or a comfort cruiser with refreshments. Experience vibrant Camden's culture, stunning architecture, and tranquil waters, all while enjoying picturesque views and unique wildlife along the route.

tours.name: Half Hour Jurassic Coast Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Jurassic Coast and take in breathtaking views of sandstone cliffs, golden beaches, and the towering Golden Cap. A fun, family-friendly 30-minute cruise revealing 16 miles of stunning coastline and ancient history.

tours.name: Henley Royal Regatta on modern day-boat
tours.description: Experience the vibrant Regatta like never before aboard a stylish Antaris day-boat. Gather up to six friends for a private party, complete with your choice of food and drink. Let a skilled skipper guide you through this iconic British summer event, departing from a picturesque riverside location.

tours.name: White Water Kayaking Half-Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a Half Day white water kayak session on the stunning River Dee! Perfect for ages 10 and up, this adventure combines skill-building with the excitement of running rapids. Enjoy hassle-free kayaking with sit-on-top kayaks, and all necessary gear is provided for an unforgettable day on the water.

tours.name: Private Guided Half Day Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling half-day guided kayaking adventure, perfect for beginners and seasoned paddlers alike. Explore stunning coastlines, navigate through caves, and enjoy the chance to spot dolphins and sea birds. With expert guidance and all equipment provided, this unique experience promises excitement and unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Steam Driver Experience
tours.description: Take control of a steam engine for a day, running full trips as driver, fireman, and guard. Enjoy hands-on train and shed tours, plus a safety briefing—step back into the golden age of rail travel.

tours.name: Windsor Day Tour From London with Windsor Castle tickets
tours.description: Travel from London to Windsor by train in under an hour, explore Windsor Castle and St George’s Chapel, stroll through historic streets, and enjoy free time for shopping and cafes—royal history made easy and fun.

tours.name: Around the Island
tours.description: Sail along Sheppey's stunning coast, passing wildlife reserves, towering cliffs, and historic sites. Enjoy 4 hours of scenic views, wildlife spotting, and island history on this captivating cruise.

tours.name: Arcade VR Gaming Session
tours.description: Dive into an exhilarating Virtual Reality experience with a vast selection of games, from family-friendly adventures to thrilling zombie encounters! Enjoy solo or group sessions, equipped with top-notch headsets and controllers. Immerse yourself in captivating worlds while your friends cheer you on. Unleash your imagination and explore the future of gaming!

tours.name: Christmas Boat Hire - Mince pie and a hot drink
tours.description: Experience the magic of Christmas on the tranquil Norfolk Broads! Indulge in freshly brewed beverages paired with homemade mince pies or delightful Christmas shortbread, all while enjoying the serene waters. This festive treat promises a cozy and memorable holiday escape.

tours.name: Maunsell Forts (Redsand Towers) departing Queenborough
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour journey from Queenborough to the haunting World War II Maunsel forts, known as the Redsand Towers. Experience stunning views of historic monuments and the chance to photograph Peregrine Falcons. Enjoy insightful commentary and onboard amenities as you explore this unique maritime adventure.

tours.name: Swallows & Amazons Cruise (Green Route)
tours.description: Sail through Coniston Water on an 80-minute cruise, exploring real locations from Swallows & Amazons like Wild Cat Island and the boathouse, with scenic views and engaging stories that bring the stories to life.

tours.name: Bike Maintenance Level 1
tours.description: Master bike repairs in just 5 hours! Learn to fix punctures, adjust brakes, tune gears, and more with expert guidance—save money and keep your bike in top shape. Perfect for beginners ready to get hands-on.

tours.name: Eastbourne Airshow Private Charter
tours.description: Sail to Eastbourne on a private boat, enjoy stunning views, a picnic, and your favorite tunes. Use the dive platform and stereo, then watch the airshow from the best seat in the house—an unforgettable day on the water.

tours.name: HEN BREAKS
tours.description: Celebrate the bride with a custom hen party—choose from action-packed Highland games, archery, or relaxed fun. We bring the adventure to your location across the Scottish Borders and beyond.

tours.name: Beginners - 2 Hour Family Session
tours.description: Join a fun-filled 2-hour family trials session to boost balance and control. Perfect for kids with some riding experience, it’s a lively, supportive way to improve skills together in a safe, outdoor setting.

tours.name: Intermediate - 2 Hour Family Session
tours.description: Join a 2-hour family trials session for experienced riders, tackling technical sections together. Perfect for confident kids and adults, with gear, refreshments, and expert coaching in a fun, safe environment.

tours.name: Exclusive York: Private Guided Tour
tours.description: Discover the rich history of York on a personalized 120-minute walking tour tailored to your interests. Explore key sights while delving into the city’s transformation from a Roman fortress to a Viking settlement and Georgian fashion hub. Experience York your way in a private group setting!

tours.name: Jungle Escape: Rainforest Run
tours.description: Race through Wales' biggest jungle escape, solving puzzles and covering ground in 60 minutes. Perfect for friends, family, or teams, this adrenaline-packed adventure tests your wits and stamina in an immersive rainforest setting.

tours.name: Gin Tour
tours.description: Sip your way through Norwich’s history on a 3.5-hour walking tour, sampling five local gins at five venues. Led by a sommelier, uncover the city’s gin secrets and enjoy expert tastings from award-winning makers.

tours.name: Sunset Cruise
tours.description: Enjoy a 2-hour sunset cruise around the Farne Islands, spotting nesting birds, seals, and playful dolphins, then watch the sun set behind Bamburgh Castle in a peaceful, scenic voyage.

tours.name: Holy Island/Lindisfarne
tours.description: Sail on Farne's Lass to Holy Island, experiencing tranquil island life at high tide. Explore castles, museums, and enjoy local treats before cruising back past stunning castles along the coast. An unforgettable 4.5-hour adventure.

tours.name: The Golden Hinde Sleepover - (31/07/26)
tours.description: Climb aboard the Golden Hinde for a night as a 16th-century sailor, complete with role-play, hands-on drills, and a shared dinner. Sleep on the historic ship and wake up to a breakfast—an adventure your family will never forget.

tours.name: Best of Liverpool
tours.description: Explore Liverpool’s brewing scene with 12 tastings across four breweries, behind-the-scenes tours, tasty food, and lively guides—all in a fun, all-inclusive 4-hour adventure.

tours.name: Multi-Day Custom Tour (Private)
tours.description: Explore beyond Bath with multi-day UK tours, visiting hidden sites, local pubs, and iconic landmarks like Stonehenge and Avebury. Enjoy personalized guides, secret stops, and unforgettable adventures.

tours.name: Seafest SUP Experience family sessions
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand-Up Paddle Boarding in a family-friendly session that covers essential skills, safety, and technique. Enjoy engaging games and races while exploring the breathtaking scenery of Firestone Bay and the Royal William Yard. Perfect for all ages and abilities, this adventure promises fun and unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Gruesome Walking Tour of Hexham
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 60-minute dog-friendly tour of Hexham, uncovering its darker history. Led by an experienced guide, explore hidden areas and hear immersive tales of the town's past. Enjoy scenic views as you walk through historic sites, making this a unique and memorable experience in Northumberland.

tours.name: Mixed Ability - Group Booking
tours.description: Join a lively group ride suitable for all skill levels, from beginners to pros. Enjoy tailored coaching, fun sections, and a hot homemade lunch. Perfect for friends, families, or groups of mixed abilities.

tours.name: London's Pride
tours.description: Experience London's vibrant queer history on a unique 7km running tour that spans 3000 years. Discover captivating tales of love, punishment, and civil rights, from ancient Celtic warriors to a 14th-century king's secret romance. This inclusive journey promises an eye-opening exploration of the city's rich LGBTQ+ heritage.

tours.name: Archery Session
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery in a private indoor setting! This 1.5-hour session includes safety briefings, personalized coaching, and exciting team competitions. Perfect for groups of up to 12, enjoy a refreshing break while honing your skills. Unleash your inner archer and create unforgettable memories year-round!

tours.name: Father’s Day Sailing Experience | Time Well Spent at Sea
tours.description: Set sail on a 3-hour adventure through Plymouth Sound, passing historic landmarks like Mayflower Steps, Drake's Island, and Royal William Yard, with stunning coastal views and stories of maritime history.

tours.name: Kayak tour | Bustling Birmingham
tours.description: Embark on the Bustling Birmingham tour, a unique kayaking adventure through Britain’s extensive canal system. Discover hidden heritage and iconic landmarks from a fresh perspective, all while enjoying the tranquility of quieter waterways. With no prior experience needed, this award-winning experience promises fun and exploration in the heart of Birmingham.

tours.name: Jungle Escape: Poachers Lair
tours.description: Race against the clock in Jungle Escape, a thrilling 75-minute adventure through a lush jungle and poacher’s lair. Solve puzzles, overcome challenges, and escape in under an hour—perfect for friends, families, or teams.

tours.name: One Hour Wander -  Any time of day
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s rich history in just one hour with a lively walking tour. Wander past ancient colleges, Gothic architecture, and legendary landmarks like the Radcliffe Camera. Discover stories of faith, scholarship, and creativity, all brought to life by expert guides. Perfect for busy visitors wanting a memorable taste of this historic university city.

tours.name: Public Group Beginner Lesson
tours.description: Learn to paddleboard on the scenic River Thames in just 1.5 hours. Get hands-on coaching, master safety and techniques, and enjoy views of Hampton Court Palace. Perfect for beginners eager to explore and have fun on the water.

tours.name: Oxford to Abingdon
tours.description: Set out from Christ Church Meadows to Abingdon, passing Oxford’s regatta course, historic locks, and scenic countryside. Enjoy waterside pubs, charming sights, and a peaceful journey through Oxfordshire’s beauty.

tours.name: Abingdon to Oxford
tours.description: Start in charming Abingdon, cruise past historic sights like Nuneham House and Oxford’s regatta course, then relax at waterside pubs. A scenic journey through countryside and iconic landmarks awaits.

tours.name: All things steak @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Learn to cook restaurant-quality British steak with chef tips, truffled mash, and rich mushroom sauce. Savor four beef cuts, enjoy a glass of bubbles, and impress everyone with your new culinary skills.

tours.name: The Gobbins & Glens Tour
tours.description: Explore Ireland’s stunning coast with a private tour: walk the dramatic Gobbins Cliff Path, cruise the scenic Glens of Antrim, visit charming villages, and marvel at waterfalls in Glenariff—all from Belfast.

tours.name: Magic Portal Rhayader
tours.description: Race through a fantasy world filled with goblins, solving puzzles and collecting crystals using GPS, gadgets, and AR. An adrenaline-fueled outdoor escape game that turns your adventure into a real-life treasure hunt.

tours.name: City Highlights Walk
tours.description: Uncover London's rich history in the heart of the Square Mile. Walk through ancient Roman sites, admire St. Paul’s Cathedral, and explore iconic landmarks like the Bank of England and Guildhall. With expert storytelling, you'll see how this vibrant area has transformed over two thousand years, blending tradition, resilience, and modern life.

tours.name: Sup Zero to Hero Course
tours.description: Join the Paddle Safer Course at Pontsticill Reservoir for a transformative 5-hour experience designed for beginners. Gain essential safety skills, learn to choose the right equipment, and navigate environmental conditions confidently. Enjoy a supportive atmosphere while earning a certification that enhances your paddleboarding journey and ensures your time on the water is safe and enjoyable.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddling Experience | Little America, Bideford
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling Stand Up Paddle Boarding adventure in North Devon's serene estuarial waters. With expert guidance tailored to your skill level, you'll learn essential techniques while surrounded by breathtaking scenery and wildlife. Enjoy a memorable experience in a sheltered location, perfect for both beginners and seasoned paddlers.

tours.name: Hen/Stag
tours.description: Celebrate your special day with a fun paddleboard tour through London's vibrant neighborhoods. Perfect for all skill levels, enjoy scenic views, lively spots, and plenty of memorable photos.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Ex-Files: Mystery at Area 51
tours.description: Solve a murder mystery on a scenic train through the Yorkshire Dales, featuring a 3-course meal and interactive clues. Question suspects, crack the case, and enjoy an unforgettable evening of intrigue.

tours.name: Hiver's Beekeeping Taster Workshop
tours.description: Get hands-on with bees in a fun, beginner-friendly workshop in London or Sussex. Handle hives, learn bee secrets, and taste honey—plus take home a bottle of Honey Beer. Perfect for nature lovers and curious explorers.

tours.name: Request an Activity
tours.description: Gather your group of four or more and choose your perfect date. We'll create a custom session just for you during quieter months—flexible, personalized, and ready when you are.

tours.name: Three Peaks Challenge
tours.description: Conquer the UK’s highest peaks—Ben Nevis, Scafell Pike, and Snowdon—in 24 hours. Tackle rugged trails, chase sunrise views, and push your limits in this epic test of endurance, teamwork, and adventure.

tours.name: Kings Cross to Islington Cruise (60 Minute Round Trip)
tours.description: Sail through London's historic Regent's Canal, passing landmarks like St Pancras and Coal Drops Yard, then venture into the 200-year-old Islington Tunnel—an industrial revolution gateway—before returning to Kings Cross.

tours.name: Camden Market to Kings Cross (One Way & Return)
tours.description: Sail from Camden to Kings Cross on a traditional narrowboat, passing historic landmarks, the 200-year-old St Pancras Lock, and vibrant modern developments—immersing you in London's rich industrial past and lively present.

tours.name: The Cathedrals Express to Portsmouth
tours.description: Explore Portsmouth’s rich maritime history, climb Spinnaker Tower for 23-mile views, or enjoy a seaside day with family. A perfect mix of culture, history, and stunning scenery awaits you.

tours.name: Ghyll Scrambling - Church Beck (Lower)
tours.description: Tackle mountain streams with jumps, climbs, and slides in the Lake District. Swim deep pools, conquer waterfalls, and enjoy a thrilling, tailored adventure perfect for groups seeking high-energy fun.

tours.name: Paddleboarding Introduction
tours.description: Glide across stunning lakes like Windermere and Coniston, mastering paddleboarding with expert instructors. Perfect for beginners, enjoy safe, fun, and scenic water adventures in the breathtaking Lake District.

tours.name: Paddleboarding Private Session
tours.description: Glide across stunning lakes like Windermere and Coniston, mastering paddleboarding with expert guidance. Perfect for beginners, enjoy safe, fun lessons amid breathtaking mountain scenery in the Lake District.

tours.name: Paddleboarding Guided Tour
tours.description: Glide across stunning lakes like Windermere and Coniston, mastering paddleboarding with expert guidance. Perfect for beginners, enjoy safe, fun lessons amid breathtaking mountain scenery in the Lake District.

tours.name: The Cambrian Coast Express
tours.description: Travel from Birmingham to the scenic Cambrian Coast on a historic train featuring vintage locomotives, double-headed engines, and a museum visit—celebrating 75 years of volunteer-run railways in a memorable journey.

tours.name: The Golden Hind
tours.description: Travel through 2,000 years of Carlisle’s history, from Hadrian’s Wall to stunning castles and museums, all aboard a historic train powered by a legendary Jubilee locomotive. An unforgettable journey into the past.

tours.name: Private Training (2 Hours)
tours.description: Boost your skills with personalized trials coaching—tailored to all levels, from beginners to pros. Book a private session year-round, bring your bike, and ride with expert guidance designed just for you.

tours.name: Quiz Cruise with Ultimate Party Nights
tours.description: Climb aboard for a lively waterborne quiz filled with daring challenges, mini-prizes, and hilarious surprises. Play via your phone, dance to the DJ, and compete for a £100 voucher in a night of nonstop fun and cheeky banter.

tours.name: The Cathedrals Express to Liverpool
tours.description: Travel from Birmingham to Liverpool on a historic steam train, passing through scenic Midlands and Crewe. Explore Liverpool’s docks, museums, and vibrant city life before returning aboard a nostalgic railway journey.

tours.name: Pre-65 & Twin Shock Full Day
tours.description: Boost your skills on classic trials bikes with expert coaching, tailored challenges, and a hearty lunch. Perfect for riders 12+ seeking to control, balance, and conquer traditional terrain in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Private Taster Sessions
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Taster Sessions with expert instructors on the scenic Bridgwater Canal! Choose between kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding for an hour of fun and adventure. Join a community-focused initiative that promotes outdoor learning and wellbeing while supporting local outreach programs. Make unforgettable memories on the water!

tours.name: Father's Day - Paddle to the Pub
tours.description: Treat Dad to an unforgettable 5-hour adventure on the River Thames! Starting at Lechlade, enjoy a scenic paddle through the Cotswold countryside, complete with three locks for added excitement. Conclude the day with a refreshing drink at Ye Olde Swan, making it a perfect outing for fathers and grandfathers alike.

tours.name: The Explorer High Ropes Adventure!
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating Explorer Adventure in the Wildcats Zone, designed for ages 5 and up. Navigate thrilling obstacles like the climbing wall, zipline, and tyre bridge, all while ensuring safety with a dedicated instructor. Perfect for families, this unique experience combines fun and fitness in a breathtaking outdoor setting.

tours.name: Alpaca Experience: Meet and Greet + Short Walk
tours.description: Get ready for an unforgettable 1.5-hour adventure with alpacas! Enjoy a hands-on introduction to these charming animals, including feeding, halter training, and a scenic walk. Perfect for families, this unique experience allows you to bond with the alpacas while learning about their care. Capture memorable moments with a photo opportunity!

tours.name: Canoe Aqueduct Trip
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking Llangollen Canal Aqueduct from a unique perspective—by canoe! Guided by qualified instructors, you'll learn essential paddling skills before navigating this UNESCO World Heritage site, soaring 38.4 meters above the River Dee. This unforgettable adventure promises stunning views and a memorable journey for all ages.

tours.name: First Class Return Train Travel (Premium Compartments)
tours.description: Enjoy a private 1-hour train ride through the countryside with your group, festive music, a visit from Santa, gifts for kids, mince pies, and mulled wine for adults in a cozy 1950s compartment.

tours.name: Kayak-steering
tours.description: Experience the thrill of cliff jumping with our unique kayak-steering adventure! Over two hours, you'll paddle to stunning coasteering spots, where you can leap into the waves and challenge yourself to nail the Nail jump. Perfect for adrenaline seekers aged 10 and up, this unforgettable experience combines excitement and natural beauty.

tours.name: 1hr Stand up Paddle Board Taster
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddle boarding with a one-hour taster session led by a qualified instructor. Perfect for beginners, you'll learn essential safety tips and basic techniques to get you started on the water. Bring your swimwear and suitable footwear for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Festive Express - The Classic
tours.description: Hop aboard a festive steam train, enjoy a mince pie, and watch holiday decorations light up Bolton Abbey. Kids get goody bags and coloring fun—perfect for a joyful, seasonal adventure in just one hour.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Death Down the Rabbit Hole: A Wonderland Mystery
tours.description: Solve a madcap murder in Wonderland aboard a steam train through Yorkshire Dales. Enjoy a 3-course meal, immersive clues, and a fun-filled evening of mystery and mayhem in just 3.5 hours.

tours.name: Arran Farm Tours
tours.description: Stroll through Bellevue Farm’s lively fields, meet friendly animals like donkeys, alpacas, and Highland cows, and hear stories of island farm life. Every visit offers a unique, hands-on farm adventure for all ages.

tours.name: Eid Summer Sightseeing Cruise
tours.description: Join an exclusive private sightseeing cruise along the River Thames, featuring live commentary by multi-award-winning guide AbdulMaalik Tailor. Discover fascinating stories of London's history, from pirates to treasures, while enjoying stunning 360-degree views. This unique experience promises memorable moments with family and friends on a beautifully designed boat.

tours.name: Stand Up and Paddle with Connor
tours.description: Experience the joy of stand-up paddle boarding with expert guidance from Connor in a relaxed setting. This two-hour session combines essential safety training with hands-on practice, allowing you to progress at your own pace. Perfect for families and small groups, it promises a memorable day on the water.

tours.name: Kayaking, canoeing or paddle boarding hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddleboarding on the scenic Bridgwater Canal! Perfect for families, this exciting watersport offers a unique way to explore while enjoying the outdoors. With all equipment provided and expert instructors to guide you, it’s an unforgettable adventure for paddlers of all skill levels.

tours.name: Bushcraft
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Bushcraft at Parkwood Outdoors! In this engaging 3-hour session, you'll master essential skills like shelter building, fire starting, and knife work. Perfect for families, this hands-on adventure draws inspiration from Scandinavian traditions and the excitement of modern explorers, making it an unforgettable outdoor experience.

tours.name: Hill and Mountain Walking
tours.description: Tackle scenic hills and mountains on a 6-hour walk, soaking in breathtaking views and escaping stress. Wear warm, stretchy clothes and enjoy the outdoors with optional gear provided.

tours.name: Canoe Hire
tours.description: Paddle across Pontsticill Reservoir in a lightweight open canoe, perfect for peaceful exploration or lively adventures. Team up with friends or family for two hours of fun, teamwork, and scenic views.

tours.name: Hovercraft
tours.description: Fly a hovercraft just a foot above the ground, mastering sharp turns and high speeds. Full tuition included, then race around a course for an adrenaline-filled hour of flying fun. Perfect for thrill-seekers!

tours.name: Ghost Stories from Portchester Castle
tours.description: Venture into Portchester Castle’s torchlit Norman keep, where ghostly figures like the White Lady, a cloaked monk, and a phantom rider reveal secrets from the past. An immersive, spooky journey into legend and history.

tours.name: Sunset Wildlife Cruise
tours.description: Set sail at sunset along Brighton seafront to spot dolphins, seabirds, and stunning views of the West Pier and i360. Support marine conservation while enjoying a relaxing, wildlife-filled cruise.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Sherlock Holmes Whodunit
tours.description: Solve a thrilling murder mystery on a scenic train through Yorkshire Dales, with suspects to question, clues to find, and a delicious 3-course meal—can you catch the killer before they escape?

tours.name: Eastbourne Airshow Join a group
tours.description: Sail on a luxurious Mediterranean boat to the Eastbourne Airshow, enjoying stunning views from the best vantage point. Relax, soak up the sun, and bring your picnic for a perfect summer day on the water.

tours.name: Cream Tea & Steam
tours.description: Embark on a nostalgic journey through Carmarthenshire aboard a working steam train, enjoying a delightful cream tea at your seat. This unique 90-minute round trip offers stunning countryside views and a taste of a more leisurely era, making it an unforgettable experience for you and your loved ones.

tours.name: Hen Party – Fragrance Design Experience
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in a fun, sensory-filled mixology class. Sip bubbly, explore scents, and craft a unique fragrance to take home—perfect for hen parties or special celebrations.

tours.name: Full Day Cave
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 3-hour adventure exploring ancient caves formed 300 million years ago. Experience breathtaking geological wonders and unique ecosystems beneath the surface. Suitable for all ages and skill levels, this caving journey provides essential gear for safety and comfort, ensuring an exhilarating exploration of South Wales' limestone caves.

tours.name: Holiday Food tour - ook als Kerstpakket!
tours.description: Experience the enchanting Holiday Food Tour in The Hague, a delightful 3-hour journey through local flavors and festive treats. Discover the stories behind traditional dishes, connect with local entrepreneurs, and enjoy a cozy atmosphere with small groups. This unique culinary adventure promises laughter, learning, and unforgettable tastes of the season!

tours.name: The Christmas White Rose to York Christmas Market
tours.description: Experience the charm of York with a day trip that combines rich history and stunning architecture. Explore iconic sites like York Minster and the Jorvik Viking Experience, all while enjoying the scenic journey on a steam train. This unique adventure offers a perfect blend of culture and nostalgia.

tours.name: Single Kayak Hire
tours.description: Paddle through tranquil creeks or glide to Trelissick Gardens with a flexible kayak hire. All gear included, plus safety tips and a shoreline push-off—your perfect adventure awaits at Loe Beach.

tours.name: The Beatles London Walking Tour
tours.description: Step into London's Beatles history with a 2.5-hour guided tour. Walk Abbey Road, visit iconic homes, and relive legendary moments from the band's legendary career. Perfect for fans craving a behind-the-scenes look.

tours.name: Beer & Cheese Tour
tours.description: Sample five local beers and cheeses while strolling Norwich’s historic streets. Led by an expert, learn tasting secrets, enjoy hidden city stories, and indulge in a relaxed, flavorful journey through history and flavor.

tours.name: Kids Surf / Water Safety Club
tours.description: Boost your surfing skills in 1.5 hours with expert coaching, safety tips, warmups, and in-water practice. Perfect for kids ready to ride waves confidently and safely.

tours.name: London Eid Night Sightseeing bus tour
tours.description: Join a lively night bus tour of London on Eid, seeing iconic sights like Big Ben, Tower Bridge, Buckingham Palace, and more, with live commentary by a top Muslim guide. Limited upper deck seats—book early!

tours.name: Inverclyde Sunset, Sea and Soiree Dining Tour
tours.description: Experience a serene sunset tour along the stunning Inverclyde coast aboard the vintage Red Bus Bistro. Enjoy a welcome glass of fizz, delectable canapes, and a comforting three-course meal while taking in breathtaking views of the Clyde and Dunoon. Capture unforgettable moments on this unique culinary journey.

tours.name: Fireworks from the Water | Plymouth’s Best Seat on Bounty
tours.description: Sail into an unforgettable night with prime water views of Plymouth’s Fireworks Championships, a fireside chat with sailing star Conrad Humphreys, and a dazzling display of colors lighting up the sky at 21:20.

tours.name: Henry VIII's Wives in Westminster with historian Heather Darsie 4k walking tour
tours.description: Join historian Heather Darsie for a captivating 2-hour walk through Westminster's Tudor history, exploring the legacy of England's infamous King and his wives. This unique tour combines expert insights, digital photos, and a snack at St James's Palace, making it a memorable experience for history enthusiasts.

tours.name: Sunrise street and urban art walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3k walking tour of London Bridge, discovering vibrant street and urban art before the city awakens. Delve into the stories behind stunning murals and community initiatives, capturing memorable photos along the way. Enjoy a guided experience, complete with digital photos and a tasty snack to finish.

tours.name: Shakespeare's London 5k running tour
tours.description: Join Shakespearean actor Emma Manton on a unique 5k running tour through Shakespeare's London. Explore iconic locations that inspired his life and works, while enjoying a guided experience from an expert. Capture memories with digital photos, receive informative insights post-tour, and indulge in a finish-line snack.

tours.name: The Secret Gin Run
tours.description: Embark on a unique 10km run through London's rich gin history, culminating in a refreshing G&T at the finish line. Discover the tales of gin's past, enjoy games along the route, and connect with fellow runners of all paces. Join us for an unforgettable blend of fitness and fun!

tours.name: Paddleboard Hire at Witton Castle
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding at Witton Castle Lake, a serene oasis surrounded by lush greenery and the majestic castle backdrop. Perfect for water enthusiasts, this 60-minute adventure offers stunning views and the chance to unwind with a picnic or explore nearby amenities after your session.

tours.name: Tour Misterios y leyendas de Londres
tours.description: Uncover London's dark history with tales of executions, royal secrets, hidden churches, and ghostly cemeteries as you stroll through the city's most haunted and mysterious sites.

tours.name: 2024 Festival Weekend
tours.description: Experience the vibrant Secret London Runs Festival Weekend, featuring running and walking tours, treasure hunts, and a thrilling murder mystery. Join historian Heather Darsie for captivating talks and engage in an interactive embroidery workshop. Explore East London's rich history while enjoying social events, quizzes, and exclusive festival perks.

tours.name: 3 Day Longboard / Midlength Surf Camps and 2 Night Stay Lunch & Dinner included
tours.description: Join a fun-filled surf course from Friday to Sunday, with lessons, video feedback, and practical tips on wave safety, board choices, and riding green waves—all in a relaxed, friendly atmosphere with local food and drinks nearby.

tours.name: The Distillery Tour
tours.description: Explore the craft behind award-winning Arran Single Malt on a guided tour, ending with a tasting of 10 Year Old whisky and creamy Arran Gold Liqueur—an authentic taste adventure in just one hour.

tours.name: Pasta Masterclass
tours.description: Immerse yourself in a delightful 2.5-hour pasta-making workshop where you'll master the art of crafting fresh pasta from scratch. Create delicious ravioli and tortellini, prepare flavorful fillings, and whip up a savory sauce, all while enjoying a glass of wine. A unique culinary experience awaits!

tours.name: Fish Filleting
tours.description: Master the art of fish filleting in this engaging 3-hour course! Learn to expertly fillet two types of fish, pan-fry to perfection, and prepare mussels and prawns. Enjoy hands-on cooking with experienced instructors in a fun, relaxed setting, and take home your delicious creations. Perfect for all skill levels!

tours.name: Sex and Scandal 10k running tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique 10km guided running tour through London's erotic history. Discover scandalous stories and infamous figures as you jog past the city's naughtiest landmarks. Perfect for solo adventurers, friends, or couples, this engaging experience combines fitness with fascinating tales, ensuring no one gets left behind on this memorable journey.

tours.name: Private Surfing
tours.description: Join a personalized 2-hour surf session with expert guidance, perfect for beginners or advanced surfers. Ride your first wave or refine your skills in a fun, tailored group just for you, family, or friends.

tours.name: Murder on The Shakespeare Express with Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Unravel a 1929 murder mystery at the Little Hampton Gold Cup. Interview suspects, follow clues, and help DI Archie Bauls solve the case amid horse racing excitement and vintage elegance.

tours.name: Tour político y de los murales de Belfast
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour journey through Belfast's tumultuous history with the Murals Tour. Explore the powerful stories behind the city's iconic murals, uncovering the deep-rooted conflicts of "The Troubles." Experience the contrasting perspectives of both Catholic and Protestant communities, and witness the resilience that led to peace amidst adversity.

tours.name: BBQ
tours.description: Join the Barbecue Course for an intense and enjoyable experience that combines expert instruction with hands-on cooking. Learn essential skills like lighting gas and charcoal grills, temperature control, and various cooking methods. Cook your own meat while collaborating with others to create delicious barbecue components, ensuring a memorable outdoor cooking adventure.

tours.name: London's Greatest Hits
tours.description: Embark on a unique 10k running tour through London's vibrant musical history with Secret London Runs. Guided by music enthusiast Josh, you'll explore iconic locations in Camden, Regents Park, and Soho, all while enjoying a soundtrack of legendary tunes. Perfect for all paces, this experience combines fitness with unforgettable musical heritage.

tours.name: VR Party
tours.description: Host an epic VR party in a private 800 sq ft space with up to 12 players, full multiplayer action, and exciting games. Customize with extras like cakes, pizza, and more for a stress-free, unforgettable celebration.

tours.name: The Secret Gin Distillery Run
tours.description: Experience London's vibrant gin history on an 11k running tour with Secret London Runs. Discover both classic and contemporary distilleries while enjoying a leisurely pace suitable for all. Led by expert guide Vanessa, this unique adventure culminates in a refreshing G&T, making it a memorable journey for gin enthusiasts.

tours.name: Mobile Adventure Service
tours.description: Dive into outdoor thrills with paddleboarding, archery, rock climbing, and more. Perfect for all ages, our mobile adventures bring excitement to your location—unforgettable fun in stunning surroundings.

tours.name: World Ocean Day Sailing Experience | Connect with the Sea
tours.description: Sail through Plymouth Sound on a replica vessel, guided by a pro yachtsman. Explore historic sites, spot dolphins and seals, and enjoy a swim or paddleboard. An unforgettable maritime adventure awaits.

tours.name: Goat Experience
tours.description: Experience the joy of interacting with our playful Pygmy and Boer goats in a delightful one-hour session. Feed, pet, and walk alongside your very own goat while exploring the farm. Capture memorable selfies with Nancy the Boer goat and encounter other friendly animals along the way for a truly unique adventure!

tours.name: Discovery Jet
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 45-minute adventure through the stunning Rakaia Gorge, where you'll navigate braided channels and exhilarating rapids. Experience breathtaking views of Mt Hutt and the Southern Alps, capturing unforgettable moments along the way. This journey promises excitement and is highly praised by past passengers.

tours.name: Private White Water Kayak Lesson
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 2.5-hour whitewater kayaking lesson tailored for beginners ready to conquer moving water. Experience the thrill of paddling down rapids, surfing standing waves, and mastering essential skills under the guidance of a qualified coach. All necessary equipment is provided, ensuring a memorable adventure on the river Deen.

tours.name: Private SUP Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddle Boarding on the scenic River Dee, guided by expert instructors from Paddle the Dee. Whether you're a beginner or looking to enhance your skills, this 1.5-hour session offers personalized tuition and all necessary equipment. Embrace adventure in the beautiful surroundings of Chester!

tours.name: Early Morning Rowing Boat Hire - 3 hours
tours.description: Sunrise sessions & early morning sessions.  Book by 6pm previous day.

tours.name: Street Art 5k running tour
tours.description: Experience Shoreditch like never before on a 5km running tour led by street art expert Vanessa. Discover stunning murals and sculptures while learning about the artists behind them. This inclusive run caters to all paces, ensuring no one is left behind, and concludes with a tasty snack to refuel.

tours.name: Top Ten Murals 10k running tour
tours.description: Experience the vibrant street art of East London on a unique 10km running tour, where you'll explore ten stunning murals created by talented artists. Enjoy guided insights, breathtaking views, and a finish-line snack, all while participating in the exciting Secret London Runs Festival weekend. Join us for an unforgettable artistic adventure!

tours.name: Ghost Patrol - Southbank
tours.description: Join the thrilling **Ghost Patrol** adventure, where you and your friends can explore a haunted manor in immersive VR! Armed with Hue Blasters, navigate enchanted hallways, zap colorful ghosts, and team up to defeat the formidable Ghost King. Experience free-roaming gameplay and cutting-edge technology for an unforgettable ghost-busting mission!

tours.name: Open Farm
tours.description: Get up close with farm animals—pet, feed, and interact with alpacas, sheep, ducks, chickens, and more in a fun, hands-on farmyard adventure.

tours.name: 2025 Festival Day
tours.description: Experience the vibrant spirit of London at the Secret London Runs Day Festival on September 20, 2025. Enjoy a mix of running and walking tours, treasure hunts, and a lively Pub Quiz with Josh & Vanessa. Join fellow enthusiasts for a memorable day filled with exploration and fun!

tours.name: The Golden Hinde Christmas Grotto
tours.description: Explore the ship’s decks and descend into a festive wonderland. Meet Father Christmas, enjoy seasonal treats, and soak in the magic of twinkling lights and carols in the cozy Grotto. A holiday adventure for all ages.

tours.name: Eco-Launch
tours.description: Sail an eco-friendly electric boat past iconic landmarks like Pendennis Castle and St. Mawes, enjoy stunning coastlines, lush gardens, and peaceful villages—all with easy controls and no experience needed.

tours.name: Jeanneau Sun 2500
tours.description: Sail from St. Antony’s Lighthouse through historic castles, lush gardens, and tranquil rivers. Enjoy responsive handling, easy sail management, and scenic stops like Helford River and Nare Head—perfect for adventure and relaxation.

tours.name: City Highlights
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through the historic City of London, where ancient landmarks like St Paul’s and Leadenhall Market coexist with hidden gems. Discover the intriguing stories behind winding streets, secret parks, and centuries-old architecture, blending the old with the new in a vibrant exploration of this iconic area.

tours.name: ITCHENOR HARBOUR trip - A memorable trip aboard oysterboat "Terror"!
tours.description: Sail through Chichester Harbour’s stunning inlets, spotting seals and wildlife. Feel the breeze, enjoy peaceful views, and maybe even steer the Terror yourself—an unforgettable adventure on the water.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Reading (Sulhamstead)
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours. Blend exclusive scents, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle. Enjoy bubbly and optional afternoon tea in a luxurious, sensory journey into perfumery.

tours.name: Thai Street Food @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Thai street food in this hands-on cooking class. Create three delicious dishes, including fragrant tom yum soup and sizzling stir-fried beef or aubergine. Learn to balance essential flavors while enjoying a delightful meal at the chef's table, complete with a complimentary drink.

tours.name: Tea & Tales: Walking in the Footsteps of Lewis & Tolkien in Malvern
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4-hour journey through the picturesque Malvern Hills, where the landscapes inspired literary legends C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien. Enjoy a scenic 3-mile walk, discover hidden gems, and indulge in a delightful afternoon tea at a charming Georgian hotel, complete with freshly baked treats and stunning views.

tours.name: Greenium
tours.description: Join a thrilling VR adventure on Greenium, where you and your team explore alien worlds, solve puzzles, and fight poachers to save a powerful energy source. Race against time in a fully immersive, private sci-fi quest.

tours.name: Parvus Box
tours.description: Get lost in a giant world where everyday objects tower over you. Solve clever puzzles, uncover secrets, and work as a team in this immersive VR escape adventure that flips perspective and sparks your imagination.

tours.name: Walking tour | More Canals than Venice
tours.description: Discover Birmingham's rich industrial heritage on a captivating 1.5-mile walking tour of its stunning canal system, which boasts more waterways than Venice. Enjoy a guided exploration of key landmarks, all while capturing picturesque views along the way. This unique experience blends history, beauty, and a touch of adventure.

tours.name: Building tour | Workers of the Roundhouse
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 40-minute tour of the Roundhouse, exploring its vibrant Victorian history and the intriguing architect behind its design. Engage with the past, ponder its unique round shape, and enjoy interactive games along the way. This immersive experience promises to be both enlightening and entertaining.

tours.name: Package tour | Roundhouse x Coffin Works
tours.description: Experience a captivating Birmingham day out, starting with an interactive tour of the historic Roundhouse, followed by a scenic canal walk to the unique Coffin Works. Discover the fascinating history of this Victorian factory, where royal coffin furniture was crafted, all while capturing stunning photos of these remarkable sites.

tours.name: Target Sports- Rotation Session
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery tag and axe throwing in an action-packed session! Hone your skills as you aim for the bullseye and engage in friendly competition, dodging arrows and navigating through trees. This unique blend of activities promises excitement and unforgettable memories with friends and family.

tours.name: The Voice of Elvis Tribute Night
tours.description: Travel through Yorkshire’s scenic Dales on a steam train, enjoy hearty Pie and Peas, then dance to a live Elvis tribute with hits like Jailhouse Rock—an unforgettable night of rock ‘n’ roll magic.

tours.name: Farewell to Steam Special
tours.description: Ride a historic steam train retracing the 1965 farewell journey from Paddington, passing through Bristol and Birmingham. Enjoy luxurious dining, scenic views, and a nostalgic voyage celebrating railway history.

tours.name: The Cambrian Coast Express (Aberystwyth)
tours.description: Ride a historic train through Wales to Aberystwyth, with scenic coastal views and family attractions like castles and railways. Enjoy luxurious dining or cozy compartments on this memorable journey.

tours.name: Secret London Runs -  Social Run
tours.description: Join a lively 7k social run through London's iconic sights, led by Josh. Learn local history, meet fellow runners, and unwind with a post-run drink. All paces welcome—just register and enjoy the city on foot.

tours.name: Menú Acoustic en el Hard Rock Cafe Piccadilly Circus
tours.description: Savor classic American dishes amid legendary rock memorabilia at London's largest Hard Rock Cafe. Located in Piccadilly Circus, enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and exclusive access to iconic music history. Book ahead!

tours.name: SUP with PUP: Dog Paddles
tours.description: Paddle along scenic canals with your dog, learning SUP basics or joining lively group socials. Enjoy fun, bonding, and expert tips in a relaxing, dog-friendly adventure near Victoria Park.

tours.name: Spirits By The Shore at The Copeland Distillery
tours.description: Celebrate Halloween at The Copeland Distillery with an evening of captivating storytelling, craft cocktails, and delicious cheese. Sip on unique drinks, enjoy engaging tales, and indulge in tasty bites as local experts create a memorable night. Join us for a spirited, flavorful experience that will leave you craving more.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Dungeons, Death & Dragons
tours.description: Solve a murder on a starship during a 3.5-hour journey with a 3-course meal, mystery clues, and suspects to interrogate. An immersive adventure blending sci-fi, suspense, and fine dining in North Yorkshire.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Death Down the Yellow Brick Road
tours.description: Solve a thrilling murder mystery aboard a train through Yorkshire Dales, featuring a 3-course meal, puzzles, and suspects to interrogate. Uncover the killer before the journey ends—an evening of fun and intrigue awaits.

tours.name: Mavericks • Over 40s Surf Session
tours.description: Join our monthly Sunday surf sessions for 40+ beginners and improvers at Summerleaze Beach. No experience needed—just bring your enthusiasm and ride the waves with like-minded adults. All equipment provided.

tours.name: Ireland – Celtic Magic: Ten Day Tour (with Tor)
tours.description: Journey through Ireland’s enchanting landscapes in ten unforgettable days. Explore ancient cairns, sacred wells, and dramatic cliffs, all infused with myth and music. From Dublin’s lively streets to the mystical Aran Islands, immerse yourself in Celtic history, spirituality, and warm Irish culture at every captivating stop.

tours.name: Four Day Tour of Sacred England – Tuseday to Friday
tours.description: Journey through England’s legendary landscapes in eight unforgettable days. Walk among ancient stones at Stonehenge, explore mystical Glastonbury, and visit Tintagel’s legendary castle. Encounter sacred waters, enchanted forests, and mythic sites that bring legends to life, blending history, magic, and spiritual discovery at every turn.

tours.name: Return train travel and Safari Express experience
tours.description: Climb aboard the Safari Express for a jungle adventure full of animatronic animals, lively shows, and photo opportunities. Kids get goody bags, and everyone can enjoy the wild fun on this unforgettable train ride.

tours.name: The Christmas White Rose to York Christmas Market
tours.description: Ride a historic steam train to York’s festive markets and ancient streets. Explore Viking, Roman, and medieval sites, visit York Minster, Jorvik Viking Centre, or the Railway Museum for a memorable holiday adventure.

tours.name: OA Meraud Experience
tours.description: Sail along Cornwall’s stunning coast, swim in crystal waters, and relax with a seaside picnic. Discover hidden coves, spot marine life, and enjoy optional watersports or live music for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Ghyll Scrambling - Church Beck (Upper)
tours.description: Tackle mountain streams with jumps, slides, and climbs in the Lake District. Swim deep pools, conquer waterfalls, and enjoy a thrilling adventure tailored to your group's skill level for an unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Ghyll Scrambling - Stickle Ghyll
tours.description: Tackle mountain streams with jumps, slides, and climbs in the stunning Lake District. Swim deep pools, conquer waterfalls, and enjoy a thrilling adventure tailored for all ages and fitness levels. Perfect for an unforgettable group challenge.

tours.name: Ghyll Scrambling - Church Beck Upper (Private Groups)
tours.description: Tackle thrilling ghylls, leap into deep pools, slide rocky features, and climb waterfalls in the stunning Lake District. Perfect for groups seeking high-adventure fun with safety gear included.

tours.name: Ghyll Scrambling - Church Beck Lower (Private Groups)
tours.description: Tackle mountain streams with jumps, slides, and climbs in the Lake District. Perfect for groups, this 3-hour adventure includes swimming, waterfalls, and gorges—an adrenaline-packed stag do activity for all ages.

tours.name: Rock Climbing @ Coniston
tours.description: Scale stunning Cumbrian cliffs with expert guidance, mastering belaying, safety, and climbing techniques. Perfect for beginners or thrill-seekers, enjoy three hours of fun, challenge, and breathtaking views.

tours.name: Rock Climbing @ Coniston (Private Groups)
tours.description: Scale stunning Cumbrian cliffs with expert guidance, mastering safety, belaying, and climbing techniques. Perfect for all levels—enjoy a thrilling outdoor adventure in the Lake District’s legendary peaks.

tours.name: Rock Climbing @ Langdale (Private Groups)
tours.description: Scale stunning Cumbrian cliffs with expert guidance, mastering safety, belaying, and climbing techniques. Perfect for all levels—enjoy fun, challenge, and breathtaking views in a 3-hour outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Rock Climbing @ Langdale
tours.description: Scale stunning Cumbrian cliffs with expert guidance, mastering safety, belaying, and climbing techniques. Perfect for all levels—enjoy a thrilling outdoor adventure in the Lake District’s iconic peaks.

tours.name: New Forest Food Safari
tours.description: Cycle through the scenic New Forest on comfy e-bikes, visiting charming villages, foodie hotspots, breweries, and vineyards. Enjoy tasting stops, wild ponies, and coastal views on a fun, family-friendly adventure.

tours.name: NEW for 2026: Full-Day Private Roman Legions and Landscapes Tour
tours.description: Explore the stunning Yorkshire Dales with a private tour visiting Bolton Castle, filming locations, and Wensleydale cheese. Enjoy scenic views, photo stops, and local charm in this 8-hour adventure.

tours.name: Tour la Ruta del cheers!
tours.description: Uncover London's hidden taverns, haunted tunnels, and historic pubs rebuilt after the Great Fire. Sip craft beers amid ghost stories, duels, and secret legends—an unforgettable night of mystery and history awaits.

tours.name: 2 Hour River Cleddau Cruise
tours.description: Sail through Wales’ largest estuary on a 2-hour cruise, passing lush landscapes, busy ports, and historic forts. Spot birdlife, enjoy maritime views, and soak in the region’s rich history on this scenic adventure.

tours.name: Rochester Afternoon Tea Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Medway on a Thames barge, enjoying homemade tea, sandwiches, and scones. Help set sail or relax as you take in Rochester, Chatham Dockyard, and Upnor Castle from the water.

tours.name: Private History of Food and Drink in Covent Garden Tour
tours.description: Explore Covent Garden’s rich food and drink history on a private 90-minute tour. Walk through historic markets, pubs, and famous restaurants, uncovering stories of London’s culinary past with your own expert guide.

tours.name: Private / Special Tours
tours.description: Explore tailored adventures with private or group tours, immersive retreats, and themed excursions designed to ignite your passion and create unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Bristol Day Trip from London by Train | Street Art & Harbourside
tours.description: Explore Bristol’s vibrant street art, harbourside charm, and iconic Clifton Suspension Bridge on a day trip from London. Enjoy guided tours, local eats, and optional SS Great Britain entry in just 10 hours.

tours.name: Private Villains Tour & Tasting
tours.description: Uncover York’s dark past with a private group tour blending chilling stories and six signature rums inspired by local villains. Take the Villain’s Oath and embrace your inner villain in this exclusive, immersive experience.

tours.name: Kayaking Adventure
tours.description: Paddle through the pristine Beaulieu River on a full-day kayak adventure, exploring quiet creeks, spotting wildlife, and enjoying scenic stops in historic villages. Perfect for adults and teens seeking a memorable water journey.

tours.name: Grime & Punishment Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 1.5-hour tour through London's wild history, exploring the outrageous lives of notorious criminals and the infamous London Beer Flood. Discover the gritty tales of debauchery and punishment as you stroll through the vibrant West End, leaving you both grateful for today and intrigued by the past.

tours.name: London's Lost City
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5-hour walking tour that unveils the hidden history of London. Explore ancient ruins, architectural marvels, and the enchanting lanes once walked by literary giants. From bloodthirsty temples to Arthurian legends, this adventure reveals a side of the city that modern sightseers rarely see.

tours.name: Curiosities of London Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5-hour tour through London's hidden history, uncovering forgotten gems like Soho's infamous Noses and a former prime minister's horse block. Delve into darker tales, explore the Titanic ticket office, and discover remnants of the past, including a concealed WWII bomb shelter and lost street markers.

tours.name: London's Conspiracy Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 1.5-hour walking tour through London’s shadowy past, uncovering gripping conspiracies and hidden histories. Explore royal murders, occult symbols, and infamous execution grounds as you navigate ancient alleyways. Delve into the mysteries of the Great Fire and more, leaving no stone unturned in this captivating adventure.

tours.name: Track Riding (Taster) - 15 Minute Ride
tours.description: Kids and adults of all skill levels can enjoy our spacious, multi-route quad bike track. With expert marshals and easy-to-ride automatic bikes, it's the perfect place to build confidence and have fun on four wheels.

tours.name: Track Riding - 20 Minute Ride
tours.description: Kids and adults can enjoy thrilling quad bike rides on a spacious, multi-route track. With expert marshals and automatic bikes, beginners and pros alike can safely build speed and confidence in a fun, lively setting.

tours.name: Track Riding - 30 Minute Ride
tours.description: Kids and adults of all ages can enjoy safe, exciting quad biking on a spacious, multi-route track. With friendly instructors and automatic bikes, beginners quickly gain confidence and have a blast.

tours.name: Mountain Bike Fineshade Woods Tour
tours.description: Ride through Fineshade Woods on a guided mountain bike tour, exploring scenic trails and hidden gems. Perfect for all skill levels, this half-day adventure combines expert guidance with woodland thrill.

tours.name: Churchill & World War 2 Walking Tour
tours.description: Walk through wartime London, visiting iconic sites like Downing Street, the Cenotaph, and Churchill’s statue. Feel the resilience of the Blitz and explore Churchill’s legacy at key landmarks, ending outside the historic War Rooms.

tours.name: City of London Walking Tour
tours.description: Walk through 2,000 years of London’s history in the City of London. See iconic sites like St Paul’s, Tower Bridge, and the Tower of London, while exploring financial hubs, markets, and historic landmarks on this immersive tour.

tours.name: Changing of the Guard Tour in London
tours.description: Watch the Royal Guards march past iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace and St James’s Palace from exclusive vantage points, avoiding crowds. Capture a rare photo with the Household Cavalry in this unforgettable tour.

tours.name: Signal Box Experiences
tours.description: Control trains yourself in a real signal box at Embsay Station, learn how levers work, and get a certificate. Perfect for train enthusiasts ready for a hands-on railway adventure.

tours.name: York Photo Walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour photography walk through York's historic sites, including the Minster, bar walls, and Museum Gardens. Learn creative techniques, composition, and camera settings from an experienced photographer. Enjoy a mindful experience while connecting with fellow enthusiasts, capturing stunning images, and exploring the city's rich history.

tours.name: Museum Gardens Photo Walk
tours.description: Join our engaging photowalk through the stunning Museum Gardens, where history and nature intertwine. Capture breathtaking sights like St. Mary’s Abbey and the secret garden while receiving expert photography tips tailored to all skill levels. Connect with fellow enthusiasts and enhance your creativity in a supportive, small-group setting.

tours.name: Street Photo Walk - Kings Square and The Shambles
tours.description: Join a captivating photowalk through York's iconic Shambles, where you'll explore vibrant street life while honing your photography skills. Led by an experienced tutor, this small-group experience offers personalized tips on composition, lighting, and creativity, making it perfect for all skill levels. Capture unforgettable moments and connect with fellow photography enthusiasts.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Exeter
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours. Blend exclusive scents, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle. Enjoy bubbly and optional afternoon tea for a luxurious, sensory journey into perfumery.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Harrogate
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours. Blend exclusive scents, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle. Enjoy bubbly and optional afternoon tea in a luxurious, sensory journey into perfumery.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience -  Reading (Aldermaston)
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours. Blend exclusive scents, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle. Enjoy bubbly and a sensory journey into the art of perfumery.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - York
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in a fun, sensory journey. Blend exclusive scents, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle—an unforgettable experience of luxury and creativity.

tours.name: The Whistling Ghost to Minehead
tours.description: Ride a historic steam train through lush Somerset countryside to the seaside town of Minehead, enjoying a nostalgic journey with vintage locomotives and scenic views on this charming West Somerset Railway adventure.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Oxford
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours. Blend exclusive scents, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle. Enjoy bubbly, expert guidance, and a memorable sensory journey into perfumery.

tours.name: Young Explorers Sailing Experience | Plymouth Sound Adventure
tours.description: Sail aboard the Bounty replica to explore Plymouth Sound’s history, wildlife, and forts. Discover Drake’s Island, Cawsand Bay, and hidden secrets in just four hours of adventure, learning, and fun for young explorers.

tours.name: 1-2-1 Paddle Boarding Lesson
tours.description: Enjoy a personalized 1.5-hour paddleboarding lesson on the scenic Thames, mastering skills from paddling straight to self-rescue, with expert coaching tailored to your level in a safe, private setting.

tours.name: The Dracula Experience
tours.description: Step into the chilling world of Dracula with animatronics, spooky effects, and live actors. Uncover Whitby's dark history, the Demeter shipwreck, and vampire legends in a 20-minute thrill that will leave you breathless.

tours.name: Historic London Pub Tour: Taverns, Tales & Hidden Streets
tours.description: Uncover London's hidden pub gems and historic taverns on a guided walk through secret alleyways, Victorian gin palaces, and centuries-old pubs, hearing stories of rebels, poets, and royal secrets along the way.

tours.name: Birmingham Walking Tour: History, Canals & Street Art
tours.description: Uncover Birmingham’s vibrant history, bold street art, and grand architecture on a lively 2.5-hour walking tour. Dive into stories of resilience, innovation, and culture in the UK’s second city.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Savor a handcrafted afternoon tea in The Old Barn, beautifully presented in a box. Freshly made on the day, this delightful treat offers a cozy, memorable taste of local craftsmanship in just 60 minutes.

tours.name: Relaxed Opening at The Golden Hinde
tours.description: Enjoy a peaceful, flexible visit to The Golden Hinde with limited visitors, soft lighting, and quiet spaces. Perfect for neurodiverse guests, families, or anyone seeking a calm, unstructured exploration of this historic ship.

tours.name: BBQ and Coo
tours.description: Experience the enchanting BBQ & Coo Date Nights in 2025, where you can meet friendly Highland cows and enjoy a private BBQ under the stars. With limited dates available, embark on a unique adventure that combines great food, stunning views, and a cozy atmosphere for an unforgettable evening on the farm.

tours.name: Early Morning Canoe Hire - 2 hours
tours.description: Experience the serene beauty of Derwentwater at dawn with a canoe adventure! Glide across the tranquil waters, spotting wildlife like deer and kingfishers. Enjoy a picnic with freshly baked scones on a quiet island, and let our instructors guide you, whether you're a beginner or a seasoned paddler.

tours.name: Kayak Harbour Session
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddling in our Harbour Sessions! Choose your craft and enjoy an hour of fun on the water, guided by a qualified instructor. Learn essential skills while soaking in the beautiful surroundings. Perfect for adventurers of all levels, this session promises unforgettable memories and excitement.

tours.name: Early Morning Paddleboard Hire - 3 hours
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of sunrise paddleboarding on Derwentwater, where the calm waters and early morning light create the perfect setting for wildlife spotting. Whether you seek peaceful reflection or a fun challenge with friends, this unique adventure offers laughter, stunning views, and a chance to connect with nature before the day begins.

tours.name: Party - Virtual Escape Rooms
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating escape room adventure with friends, choosing from 9 unique themes! Enjoy 50 minutes of immersive gameplay followed by 60 minutes in a party room, complete with food and drinks. This unforgettable experience promises excitement and fun for everyone, making it perfect for any celebration.

tours.name: Private - Historic London Pub Tour: Taverns, Tales & Hidden Streets
tours.description: Uncover London's rich pub history on a private 2.5-hour tour. Visit hidden taverns, historic gin palaces, and secret alleyways, all tailored to your interests. Enjoy stories of poets, royalty, and rebels in authentic, atmospheric settings.

tours.name: Private - Camden Walking Tour: Markets, Music & Alternative London
