tours.description: Explore Camden’s vibrant markets, street art, and legendary music scene on a personalized 2.5-hour walking tour. Discover hidden gems, iconic spots, and stories of rebellion and creativity with your expert guide.

tours.name: Private - Westminster Walking Tour: Royalty, Politics & Power
tours.description: Explore Westminster’s rich history with a private guide, visiting iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace and Parliament. Enjoy a flexible, storytelling walk through 1,000 years of royal and political drama.

tours.name: Game of Thrones Private Filming Locations Tour of Westeros - From Belfast
tours.description: Embark on an exclusive Game of Thrones tour with Flip Robinson, a former cast member, as your guide. Discover hidden filming locations, hear captivating behind-the-scenes stories, and enjoy luxury transportation. This unique experience promises to bring the iconic series to life, making it unforgettable for any fan.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Eastbourne
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours, blending exclusive scents with expert help. Enjoy bubbly, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle—an unforgettable, sensory journey into perfumery.

tours.name: Picarooner Hire
tours.description: Sail the River Fal in a stable, easy-to-control boat, passing historic castles, lush gardens, and charming villages. Enjoy sheltered comfort and stunning views, perfect for relaxed short trips and scenic exploration.

tours.name: Shrimpers
tours.description: Sail Cornwall’s stunning Fal Estuary on a classic Shrimper boat, passing historic castles, lush gardens, and tranquil coves. Enjoy hands-on adventure, scenic views, and peaceful waters—perfect for confident sailors seeking a memorable day.

tours.name: Stand-Up Paddleboard
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddle boarding in the serene waters of Mylor Creek and the scenic Fal River. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced paddler, enjoy guided tours, hourly rentals, or full-day adventures. Discover hidden beaches, wildlife, and charming spots like the historic Pandora Inn for a memorable day on the water.

tours.name: A Private 3 hour walking tour of The Beatles in London. The Long and Winding Road
tours.description: Follow the Beatles' journey through London, from Abbey Road’s beginnings to their rooftop finale, on a guided walk filled with stories and iconic sights that bring their history to life.

tours.name: Henley Private SUP Experience
tours.description: Gather your friends or colleagues for a memorable stand-up paddleboarding adventure on the stunning Henley on Thames! Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your skills, our expert instructors will customize the experience just for you, ensuring a fun and safe exploration of the local area.

tours.name: Tour Fuori Londra: Canterbury e Scogliere Dover
tours.description: Join a 9-hour guided Italian tour from London to explore the mystical Stonehenge, charming Cotswolds villages, Dover's dramatic cliffs, and Canterbury’s historic cathedral—an unforgettable mix of history, scenery, and culture.

tours.name: London's Dark History Tour
tours.description: Step into London's wild past with a daring tour through Covent Garden and Soho. Uncover stories of crime, decadence, and eccentric characters from the Georgian era. Feel the thrill of London's darker side as you explore tales of drunkenness, danger, and scandal in this adult-only adventure.

tours.name: Sea Kayaking Introduction

With expert guidance, you'll build confidence and prepare for future sea excursions, making this an unforgettable introduction to the world of kayaking.

tours.name: Target Night
tours.description: Join a lively crowd at Unit 26 for exciting team-based game modes that challenge your shooting skills and teamwork. Perfect for veterans and newcomers alike—don’t miss your chance to play tonight!

tours.name: Thursday Skirmish
tours.description: Join an exciting evening of varied game modes, starting at 5pm with a quick briefing. Dive into thrilling skirmishes until 9pm—Thursday nights you won’t want to miss!

tours.name: New Player Night
tours.description: Join new and seasoned players for an evening of fun starting at 5pm, with a quick briefing at 6pm, and wrapping up by 9pm. Dive into the action and connect with others in this lively game night.

tours.name: Sunday Skirmish
tours.description: Kick off your Sunday with an adrenaline-packed game day. Doors open at 10am, a quick briefing at 11am, and the action ends at 2pm—perfect for early risers craving fun and competition.

tours.name: Kayaking
tours.description: Paddle through calm or rushing waters with our easy-to-use kayaks. Perfect for all skill levels, enjoy a flexible, fun, and safe water adventure—no experience needed. Just grab a paddle and start exploring today.

tours.name: Group Surf Lessons
tours.description: Learn to ride your first wave in Newquay’s friendly surf lessons. With expert guidance, supportive vibes, and small groups, you'll gain confidence and enjoy the ocean’s thrill—no experience needed.

tours.name: Game of Thrones Studio & Belfast City Tour
tours.description: Visit the Game of Thrones studio, explore authentic sets and costumes, then dive into Belfast’s history with a Black Taxi tour of Peace Walls and murals. Enjoy city sights, local drinks, and a seamless return to your cruise.

tours.name: Snorkelling Skomer & Skokholm
tours.description: Get up close to Pembrokeshire’s seabird colonies during peak breeding season. Capture stunning photos of puffins, guillemots, and razorbills, with playful seals often joining the adventure for unforgettable wildlife encounters.

tours.name: Conwy - Seal Safari
tours.description: Sail along the breathtaking Great Orme coast, spotting seabirds, seals, and dolphins. Explore historic WW2 gun sites and enjoy close encounters with vibrant seabird colonies and playful marine life.

tours.name: Hosted Surf Stays
tours.description: Surf independently at top beaches, guided by local tips, while relaxing in cozy woodland tents. Enjoy daily transfers, social campfire nights, and the freedom to surf your way—no lessons, just good waves and great company.

tours.name: Private Alpaca Walking Experiences
tours.description: Embark on a unique private guided Alpaca Walking adventure in the stunning Peak District. Enjoy breathtaking views of Carsington Water while bonding with these charming animals. Feed them carrots, capture memorable selfies, and explore the friendly farm atmosphere, making this a delightful experience for families and friends alike.

tours.name: Weekend Drop & Shop  Workshop
tours.description: Join a vibrant craft workshop where kids can unleash their creativity! With exciting projects like colorful bookmarks, paper animals, and personalized tote bags, every young artist will find joy. This hands-on experience fosters imagination and fine motor skills in a safe, supportive environment, ensuring memorable take-home creations.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Lincoln
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours, blending exclusive scents with expert guidance. Enjoy bubbly, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle—an unforgettable sensory journey into perfumery.

tours.name: Stonehenge & Avebury – 6,000 Years in a Day
tours.description: Step into 6,000 years of history with awe-inspiring Stonehenge, the massive Avebury circle, and sacred sites filled with legends, energy, and ancient wisdom—an unforgettable journey through England’s mystical past.

tours.name: Liverpool Craft Beer Experience
tours.description: Explore Liverpool’s craft beer scene on a lively 4-hour tour, sampling diverse brews, hearing stories from a local guide, and learning tasting tips—all in a friendly, small-group setting.

tours.name: Ghyll Scrambling - Stickle Ghyll (Private Groups)
tours.description: Tackle thrilling ghylls, leap into deep pools, slide rocky features, and climb waterfalls in the stunning Lake District. Perfect for groups seeking high-adventure fun with safety gear included.

tours.name: Bounty Adventures: Summer Activity Week for Plymouth Schools
tours.description: Sail aboard the replica Bounty to explore Plymouth Sound’s history, wildlife, and forts. Discover Drake’s Island, Cawsand Bay, and hidden secrets on this fun, educational adventure designed for young explorers.

tours.description: Celebrate on your own private river cruise through Bath, passing historic sights and sipping chilled Prosecco. Perfect for birthdays, hen parties, or special gatherings—an elegant hour on the water just for you.

tours.name: Heathrow Hotel to Southampton Dock + Stonehenge

tours.description: Enjoy a full day of family fun at Horsenden Hill’s outdoor festival with nine giant inflatables, sports challenges, live entertainment, food stalls, and stunning nature views—unlimited activities for all ages.

tours.name: Literature Walking Tour for A level students: the City to Southwark
tours.description: Explore London's literary roots on a 90-minute walk from St. Paul’s, linking authors like Milton, Donne, Shakespeare, and Keats to iconic sites, blending history, print culture, and lively storytelling.

tours.name: Bridgerton London Tour
tours.description: Step into Bridgerton’s world with a 2-hour Greenwich walking tour. Visit iconic filming locations, stand on the Prime Meridian, and enjoy stunning views—perfect for fans eager to explore the show's secrets and history.

tours.name: Norton Priory Museum and Gardens.
tours.description: Sail to Norton Priory and explore its stunning gardens and historic house for 2.5 hours. Enjoy a scenic boat ride, relax at the café, and immerse yourself in centuries of history on this memorable day trip.

tours.name: Farm to Plate; Organic Oatcake making Experience on Farm
tours.description: Join a family farm tour to see sheep, cattle, and stunning Borders views, then learn how organic farming benefits wildlife. Experience farm life, hear stories, and enjoy fresh, handmade oatcakes in a relaxed countryside setting.

tours.name: Holiday Club
tours.description: Kids dive into four hours of outdoor fun with laser tag, Nerf wars, archery, and axe throwing. Enjoy a tasty pizza lunch and stay active, supervised by friendly staff for a day full of adventure and teamwork.

tours.name: Sunset Sax Sundays
tours.description: Sail into sunset along the Jurassic Coast with live DJ Sax, stunning views, and a lively atmosphere. Enjoy a welcome drink, tasty food, and open-air music as the sky turns golden—perfect for ending your weekend in style.

tours.name: The Chichester Ghost Walk
tours.description: Step into 1813 Winchester after dark, where ghosts, smugglers, and highwaymen come alive through vivid storytelling. Feel the thrill of history, mystery, and spooky tales in this immersive, theatrical night walk.

tours.name: 3h - Portland Harbour and Ringstead Bay.
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing on a tall ship along the stunning Jurassic Coastline with Moonfleet Adventure Sailing. In just three hours, you can participate in hands-on activities like hoisting sails or simply relax and soak in the breathtaking views of Portland Harbour and Ringstead Bay. No experience needed!

tours.name: 6h - Mupe or Worbarrow Bay
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 6-hour sailing adventure with Moonfleet Adventure Sailing in Dorset. Anchor in the stunning Mupe or Worbarrow Bay for a delightful picnic while taking in breathtaking sights like Lulworth Cove and Durdle Door. Experience hands-on sailing or simply relax and enjoy the picturesque views.

tours.name: Coastal Explorer
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 3-hour adventure exploring the stunning wildlife of West Wales. Guided by passionate experts, witness breathtaking sights from dramatic cliffs to hidden bays, and encounter puffins, seals, and more. With options for private charters, this unforgettable journey is perfect for all ages and special occasions.

tours.name: Glasgow Unique Dining Experience
tours.description: Savor authentic Italian flavors on a Glasgow sightseeing bus at dusk. Indulge in antipasti, fresh pizzas, or pasta while enjoying city landmarks and a glass of wine—an unforgettable blend of taste and sightseeing.

tours.name: Raft Building
tours.description: Build and race your own raft across the lake in a fun, competitive adventure. All safety gear included, with private changing and relaxing café options—perfect for families, groups, or solo thrill-seekers.

tours.name: Airsoft DofE Gold Residential
tours.description: Join a thrilling 5-day airsoft adventure on an RAF base, featuring tactical missions, team challenges, and fun social events. Build skills, make friends, and complete your Gold DofE in a unique, immersive setting.

tours.name: 🎄 Santa Tour 🎄
tours.description: Step into a Tudor Christmas with Santa guiding you through candlelit historic rooms filled with festive sights, sounds, and smells. A magical family experience in Stratford upon Avon’s ancient world.

tours.name: Twilight Paddle / Evening Paddle
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the coastline at night, illuminated by the moonlight. This one-hour tour offers a unique opportunity to witness the serene landscape and natural wonders after dark, creating unforgettable memories. Join us for an enchanting adventure, weather permitting, and discover the magic of the night sky.

tours.name: Kayak Tours : The Christchurch Loop Tour
tours.description: Embark on a serene 2.5-hour kayak tour through stunning waterways, perfect for all skill levels. Paddle past beautiful nature reserves and under charming bridges, while enjoying breathtaking views and wildlife. With qualified instructors and flexible equipment options, this memorable experience promises tranquility and adventure on the water.

tours.name: Girls on Wave Weekends
tours.description: Join the empowering Girls on Waves Weekends, where women of all ages learn to surf at Devon’s premier beach. Led by qualified female instructors, enjoy a supportive atmosphere while crafting unique surf-inspired jewelry. Experience the thrill of riding waves and gain confidence in a fun, friendly environment.

tours.name: Live Laser Games
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Live Laser Games in Sussex, where you’ll engage in fast-paced action across 130 acres of dynamic battlefields. Equipped with lightweight weapons and sensors, enjoy unlimited ammo and respawns while aiming through telescopic scopes. Choose from three unique weapons and immerse yourself in an exhilarating, safe adventure!

tours.name: Walking Bath Tour
tours.description: Stroll through Bath’s historic streets, passing Roman Baths, Georgian architecture, and film-set spots. Capture perfect photos, explore medieval alleys, and soak in the city’s timeless charm on this intimate 2-hour tour.

tours.name: Absolute Beginners Family Day - Full Day
tours.description: Enjoy a fun-filled family day learning to ride trials bikes together. No experience needed—just bring your family, get expert coaching, and share a hot homemade lunch in a relaxed, supportive environment.

tours.name: Intermediate Family Day - Full Day
tours.description: Join a full day of family-friendly mountain biking, with expert coaching, technical trails, and a homemade lunch. Perfect for confident riders 4+ and their loved ones seeking adventure and quality time together.

tours.name: Beginners Family Day - Full Day
tours.description: Enjoy a full day of family-friendly trials riding, perfect for beginners. Build skills, boost confidence, and share fun moments with loved ones, all while learning new techniques and savoring a homemade lunch.

tours.name: Paddle To The Pub
tours.description: Embark on a unique kayaking adventure along the picturesque River Soar, exploring charming spots like Barrow-On-Soar and Quorn. Enjoy refreshing drinks and delicious fried halloumi at riverside pubs, all while soaking in the scenic beauty. This self-guided or guided trip promises fun, laughter, and unforgettable memories with friends.

tours.name: 1hr 30min Silex Bay Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 1.5-hour cruise through Silex Bay, where stunning views of lighthouses await. As you glide along, keep an eye out for playful seals basking on the rocks or swimming nearby. Experience the beauty of the sea while enjoying the thrill of wildlife spotting!

tours.name: Sunset Party Nights with Just Coz
tours.description: Sail into Bridlington Bay as Coz belts out popular hits against a stunning sunset. Sip drinks, dance on the deck, and enjoy a lively summer night—an unforgettable musical cruise you’ll want to repeat.

tours.name: Seabird & Seal Cruise
tours.company: Golden Gate Farne Islands Boat Trips
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 1.5-hour cruise around the stunning Farne Islands, where you’ll witness Puffins, Grey Seals, and a variety of seabirds up close. Guided by the current Lighthouse Attendant, enjoy expert commentary on the area's rich history and wildlife while following Grace Darling's historic rescue route.

tours.name: 3 Week NICAS Level 1
tours.description: Join the NICAS Level 1 Course to embark on your climbing journey! Over three engaging lessons, you'll learn essential skills for safe climbing, teamwork, and risk management. This foundational program not only prepares you for higher levels but also fosters personal achievement and a deeper understanding of the sport.

tours.name: The Detectorists Tour
tours.description: Explore London's famous film spots from James Bond to Paddington on a 3-hour coach tour, passing iconic landmarks and hidden gems, with fun stories behind the scenes that bring movie magic to life.

tours.name: 6 Week NICAS Wild Climbers Course
tours.description: Join the NICAS Wild Climbers program, featuring six engaging 30-minute sessions designed for ages 3 and up. This fun, game-oriented experience introduces young climbers to indoor climbing, building essential skills and confidence while fostering a love for the sport in an inclusive and supportive environment. Perfect for budding adventurers!

tours.name: Grey Seal Cruise with Seabirds
tours.description: See thousands of Grey Seals and their pups basking on the rocks, plus nesting seabirds like Puffins and Terns, on a 1.5-hour boat cruise around the Farne Islands—an unforgettable wildlife adventure year-round.

tours.name: Paddling Adventurer – kids club - aged 8-14yrs
tours.description: Kids can enjoy a fun-filled 3-day adventure with kayaking, paddleboarding, and raft building, guided by expert instructors. All gear is provided—perfect for summer or half-term holidays.

tours.name: The Secret Gin Run
tours.description: Dash through London's gin history on a 10km run, uncovering tales of Dutch courage and gin crazes. Finish with a refreshing G&T, snacks, and photos—an energetic toast to London's spirited past.

tours.name: Hydro Buzz (Barnard Castle)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of hydrospeeding at the stunning High Force Waterfall on the River Tees! Guided by expert instructors, you'll surf down rapids, navigate waterfalls, and conquer rock jumps while enjoying breathtaking scenery. This adrenaline-pumping adventure promises an unforgettable day on the water, perfect for thrill-seekers!

tours.name: Indian Food Tour of Leeds
tours.description: Embark on a culinary adventure through Leeds, savoring the finest Indian cuisine at four exceptional restaurants. This unique tour promises an unforgettable experience, allowing you to indulge in a variety of authentic flavors and dishes that showcase the rich culinary heritage of India. Discover the best of Indian food in one exciting journey!

tours.name: Fitness DofE Residential
tours.description: Join a five-day adventure in Norfolk’s stunning countryside, blending tough fitness challenges, beach training, teamwork, and fun indoor games. Build confidence, make friends, and earn your Duke of Edinburgh award in an unforgettable setting.

tours.name: Hiver's Ultimate Beekeeping, Beer and Wine Tasting Experience
tours.description: Get hands-on with buzzing hives, taste local honey and cheeses, then sip award-winning wines on scenic vineyards. A perfect blend of nature, food, and drink in stunning countryside settings.

tours.name: The Heart of Wales: Cardiff’s Story with a True Local
tours.description: Uncover Cardiff’s vibrant history in a lively 2-hour walk. From medieval roots to Victorian grandeur, explore iconic landmarks, bustling markets, and proud Welsh culture that make this city truly unique.

tours.name: Changing of the Guard Tour with Expert Guide (Best Viewing Experience)
tours.description: Watch the iconic Changing of the Guard up close with a guide who shares its history, traditions, and royal stories. Enjoy prime viewing spots, explore royal landmarks, and immerse yourself in London's royal pageantry.

tours.name: Ramsey Island Experience
tours.description: Race across Ramsey Island’s rugged coastline on a fast boat, spotting seals, dolphins, and seabirds. Enjoy stunning cliffs, learn about wildlife, and create unforgettable family memories in just 1 to 1.5 hours.

tours.name: Hidden Cambridge
tours.description: Savor Cambridge’s hidden flavors in 5 hours: Italian pastries, deli tastings, street food, Indian lunch, tiramisu, sparkling wine, and cocktails. A delicious adventure away from the crowds—bring your appetite!

tours.name: City Centre, Parks And Cathedral
tours.description: Embark on a captivating cycling adventure through Cardiff, starting from a cozy café. Explore the grand Edwardian civic centre, glide through Bute Park's arboretum, and visit the historic Llandaff Cathedral. Enjoy a coffee at the Victorian Insole Court before discovering the charm of the city’s Victorian arcades and indoor market.

tours.name: Maunsel Fort Experience (departing Southend Pier)
tours.description: Set sail from Southend Pier to explore eerie WW2 forts, including Redsand, Shivering Sand, and Knock John Towers. Enjoy stunning views, photo opportunities, and a chance to glimpse Peregrine Falcons from the spacious deck.

tours.name: Full Brewery Experience
tours.description: Embark on a two-hour adventure perfect for large groups, featuring an in-depth tour of a microbrewery. Enjoy a bespoke guided tasting of six unique craft beers, and cap off the experience with your choice of a delicious burger, making it a memorable outing for beer enthusiasts.

tours.name: Full VIP Brewery Experience
tours.description: Experience the ultimate VIP craft beer adventure with a 2-hour journey tailored for couples or groups. Enjoy a curated 6-beer tasting flight, indulge in a delicious 3-course meal from the Tap Room Restaurant Menu, and explore the brewery on an exclusive tour. A memorable outing awaits!

tours.name: Custom Half-Day Tour (Private)
tours.description: Create your perfect half-day adventure with a personalized tour that explores hidden gems, stunning landscapes, and local culture—crafted just for you to leave unforgettable memories.

tours.name: British Museum Tour with an archaeologist guide.
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through the British Museum with a qualified archaeologist as your guide. Discover iconic artifacts like the Rosetta Stone and the Parthenon Marbles, along with hidden treasures that reveal the mysteries of ancient civilizations. Experience history like never before in this captivating 2-hour 45-minute tour.

tours.name: Winging Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of winging with our diverse selection of wings ranging from 4 to 6 meters. Choose between a winging board, foil, or even start on a windsurf board. This unique opportunity allows you to explore the exhilarating world of wind-powered sports in a way that suits your style.

tours.name: 8ft Soft Board
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with our 8ft soft board, designed for exceptional stability and effortless wave catching. Whether you choose to hire it for an hour, a day, or a week, this unique opportunity promises unforgettable moments on the water, perfect for surfers of all skill levels.

tours.name: 7ft Soft Board
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with our 7ft soft board, designed for exceptional stability and effortless wave catching. Whether you choose to hire it for an hour, a day, or a week, this unique opportunity promises unforgettable moments on the water, perfect for surfers of all skill levels.

tours.name: 9ft Soft Board
tours.description: Experience the thrill of riding waves with our 9ft soft board, designed for exceptional stability and effortless wave catching. Whether you choose to hire it for an hour, a day, or a week, this unique opportunity promises unforgettable moments on the water, perfect for surfers of all skill levels.

tours.name: White Water Tubing (Barnard Castle)
tours.description: Experience the ultimate thrill of hydrospeeding at the stunning High Force Waterfall on the River Tees! This exhilarating white water tubing adventure promises adrenaline-pumping excitement in a breathtaking natural setting. With expert guides, top-notch safety gear, and a focus on fun, prepare for an unforgettable ride through the rapids!

tours.name: 12 Pubs of Christmas Tour
tours.description: Join us for a festive journey through the Peak District with the unique '12 Pubs of Christmas' tradition. Enjoy 12 halves of beer (or equivalent) as you explore charming pubs over 6.5 hours, making this a memorable celebration of holiday cheer and community spirit.

tours.name: Haunted Peak District Pub Tour
tours.description: Join us this Halloween for a spine-chilling exploration of the Peak District's most haunted pubs. Discover eerie tales and ghostly legends that will send shivers down your spine. This unique experience promises to be both thrilling and memorable, perfect for those seeking a taste of the supernatural!

tours.name: Private - Changing of the Guard Tour with Expert Guide (Best Viewing Experience)
tours.description: Enjoy a personalized, stress-free view of London's iconic Changing of the Guard. Your guide takes you to the best spots, shares fascinating stories, and explores royal landmarks—all in a relaxed, private tour.

tours.name: Three Cliffs Bay Circular Walk - Gower Peninsula
tours.description: Hike through Gower’s stunning landscapes, from woodland to coastal cliffs. Explore Penmaen Castle, visit 3 Cliffs Bay and Pobbles Beach, and hear fascinating local stories on this scenic, full-day guided walk.

tours.name: Game of Thrones Private Filming Locations Tour of Westeros - From Ballycastle
tours.description: Embark on an exclusive tour of hidden "Game of Thrones" filming locations with Flip Robinson, a former cast member. Experience the magic firsthand as you visit iconic sites, hear captivating behind-the-scenes stories, and enjoy luxury transportation. This unique adventure promises an unforgettable journey into the world of Westeros.

tours.name: Causeway Coast Tour - From Ballycastle
tours.description: Join Flip Robinson, a former cast member, on an exclusive tour of breathtaking filming locations from "Game of Thrones." With his insider knowledge and personal experiences, you'll discover hidden gems and captivating stories that bring the series to life in a way only a true expert can provide.

tours.name: Canoe - 6 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience tranquility at the Wherry Cut, where you can immerse yourself in nature and observe wildlife. Paddle to the Hoveton Great Broad Nature Trail for a refreshing break and explore the stunning Broadland wilderness. Don’t miss the chance to kayak on Salhouse Broad for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Public Santa Cruises
tours.description: Climb aboard a cozy boat for a 75-minute festive cruise along Bridgewater Canal. Meet Santa, enjoy holiday crafts, sing carols, and sip mulled wine while soaking in stunning winter scenery—pure Christmas magic.

tours.name: River Nene Paddleboarding Tour
tours.description: Paddle 7km along the scenic River Nene, spotting wildlife and enjoying gentle exercise. Guided, safe, and fun—perfect for all skill levels. Includes gear, support, and a relaxing half-day adventure.

tours.name: Sea Safari 1 Hour Trip
tours.description: Set sail on a 1-hour sea safari to see Pendennis Castle, St. Anthony’s Lighthouse, and St. Mawes Castle. Enjoy stunning views, rich history, and the thrill of exploring Falmouth’s iconic coastal landmarks in one quick trip.

tours.name: Wildlife & History Tour 2 hours
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2-hour river adventure along the Truro River, where history and nature intertwine. Discover the rich heritage of Malpas and Turnaware Bar, glide past the scenic King Harry Ferry, and marvel at Trelissick House. Keep your eyes peeled for dolphins and seals in this picturesque Cornish landscape.

tours.name: Archery • Non-residents • Wild Boar Estate, Windermere
tours.description: Test your aim with a twist—start with traditional archery then trek through the woods on a fun hunt for foam animal targets, perfect for beginners and experts alike.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Killer Queens: Mystery at the Museum
tours.description: Unravel royal secrets and catch murderous queens in this thrilling museum mystery. Question suspects, examine clues, and solve puzzles while enjoying a delicious meal on a scenic train journey. Will you crack the case?

tours.name: Club Rafting
tours.description: Tackle thrilling rapids on rivers like Kent and Leven, guided by expert instructors. Feel the rush, navigate wild waters, and enjoy an unforgettable weekend of white water rafting in the stunning Lake District.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Crime at Cafe Rene
tours.description: Solve a thrilling murder mystery on a scenic train through the Yorkshire Dales. Question suspects, uncover clues, and enjoy a delicious 3-course meal—all in a captivating 3-hour interactive adventure.

tours.name: Winter Skills Courses
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-day winter skills course on Helvellyn, perfect for summer hill walkers eager to enhance their mountain safety skills. Learn essential techniques in route planning, equipment management, navigation, and emergency response, all while enjoying a challenging and fun-filled day in the stunning winter landscape.

tours.name: Walking tour | Icons and Industry: A City Tour
tours.description: Embark on a vibrant walking tour through Birmingham's rich history, exploring its innovative past and iconic figures. Engage in the fun of ‘Birmingham Bingo,’ ticking off famous spots as you go. With passionate guides and hidden gems, this adventure promises a unique and memorable experience in the heart of the city.

tours.name: Kayak tour | Green Escape
tours.description: Experience Birmingham like never before on the Green Escape kayak tour! Paddle through the historic Soho Loop, discovering hidden green spaces and local wildlife, including the chance to spot elusive otters. With no prior kayaking experience needed, glide along the tranquil canals while learning about the city’s rich industrial history.

tours.name: Meet the Highland Cows
tours.description: Get up close to Fergus and Merida, adorable Highland cows with shaggy coats and gentle eyes. Brush their thick fur, scratch their backs, and snap memorable photos. Feel their soft, fluffy textures and enjoy joyful moments that leave you smiling. An unforgettable farm encounter filled with charm and laughter awaits you.

tours.name: SUP Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a unique stand-up paddleboarding adventure with SUP Bristol, exploring the historic waterways of Bristol Floating Harbour. In just 1.5 to 2 hours, learn essential paddling techniques from passionate guides while enjoying a fresh perspective of the city. Experience the thrill of paddling in small groups, ensuring personalized attention.

tours.name: SSI Scuba Skills Update
tours.description: Revisit your diving confidence with a guided refresher, practicing key skills in the water. Perfect before your holiday, this course helps you dive smoothly and enjoy vibrant marine life with ease.

tours.name: SSI Advanced Open Water Diver Course
tours.description: Dive into the SSI Advanced Open Water course over a weekend: explore night diving, navigation, deep dives, and more. Experience five specialties firsthand and unlock new adventures beneath the waves.

tours.name: Ghost Stories from Netley Abbey
tours.description: Step into haunted Abbey ruins for a theatrical ghost tour filled with dark humor, chilling tales, and legendary legends. Uncover real history, eerie legends, and ghostly secrets that will make you laugh and scream.

tours.name: Guided Walking Tour of Stratford upon Avon
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute walking tour starting at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre, exploring Stratford-upon-Avon's rich history. Discover iconic sites like Shakespeare’s Birthplace and the Guild of the Holy Cross, all while enjoying a flat, wheelchair-friendly route. Experience 14 centuries of heritage in this unforgettable journey!

tours.name: Sunday Skirmish
tours.description: Join an action-packed skirmish day with thrilling games set in a one-of-a-kind environment that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

tours.name: SSI Basic Diver Course
tours.description: Discover the thrill of diving in the SSI Basic Diver program, where you'll gain essential skills to explore depths of up to 12 meters with a professional. This introductory experience not only immerses you in the underwater world but also paves the way for further diving adventures within six months.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful experience at our Tea Room, where you can savor freshly made sandwiches, homemade cakes, and scones with cream and jam. Enjoy these treats alongside a pot of Yorkshire Tea or filter coffee, all while surrounded by charming Mouseman wooden panelling and breathtaking views of the Ampleforth valley.

tours.name: A Full Day Exploring the Celtic Deep
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable offshore expedition in search of blue sharks and other magnificent marine life. Encounter rare orcas, playful dolphins, and majestic whales in their natural habitat. Each trip promises unique surprises, making every adventure a thrilling experience for ocean enthusiasts aged 16 and over. Join us for the adventure of a lifetime!

tours.name: Summer Sessions
tours.description: Sail along the Jurassic Coast for 3 hours of sun, sea, and live music. Sip cocktails, enjoy tasty snacks, and soak in stunning views—perfect for relaxing, celebrating, or capturing golden hour moments at sea.

tours.name: Late Start Pub Crawl
tours.description: Join a lively 3.5-hour pub crawl through Edinburgh’s top bars, with free shots, exclusive deals, fun games, and a nightclub finale—perfect for meeting new friends and dancing the night away.

tours.name: Craft Party
tours.description: Kids craft, create, and laugh at SPVR Arcade’s Craft Room Party. Choose from slime, jewelry, pottery, and more—each child leaves with a handmade keepsake and unforgettable memories of a fun-filled celebration.

tours.name: SSI Try Dive (Sea Dives)
tours.description: Dive into the stunning bays of Cornwall’s Roseland Peninsula for your first underwater adventure. Swim with crabs, sharks, and lobsters at just 5m deep—an unforgettable taste of scuba that sparks your passion.

tours.name: 2026 Cream Tea Cruise
tours.description: Indulge in freshly baked scones, Victoria sponge, and premium tea or coffee on a cozy, heated boat. Perfect for adults and kids, with vegan and gluten-free options—delight in a homemade treat on your cruise.

tours.name: Tour British Museum di Londra con Ingresso Prioritario
tours.description: Join a 4-hour guided tour of London's top sights, from Piccadilly Circus to Tower Bridge. Explore iconic landmarks, royal sites, and historic spots with an Italian guide, experiencing the city’s vibrant culture and history firsthand.

tours.name: Cheese, Chocolate & Christmas Lights
tours.description: Savor London's festive flavors with a cozy tour through twinkling streets, tasting six cheeses and six chocolates, while uncovering hidden stories and enjoying sparkling lights in a small, personalized group.

tours.name: Jack The Ripper Taxi Tour
tours.description: Experience the chilling history of Victorian London on the Jack the Ripper Tour. Walk the cobbled streets of Whitechapel, uncovering the mysteries of the infamous murders and dark figures like the Kray Twins. Conclude your eerie journey with a drink in a historic tavern, embracing the haunting tales of the East End.

tours.name: Beginners Hand Building Class (6 weeks)
tours.description: Join a 6-week pottery course at Tierra Pottery Studio, where you'll transform raw clay into beautiful creations. Learn hand-building techniques like pinching and coiling in a cozy, supportive environment. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, connect with others, and leave with your own unique piece, making for a memorable and creative experience.

tours.name: Solo Rowers
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of wellness rowing sessions that blend technique development with a steady workout. Enjoy the stunning coastline views while unwinding and connecting with new people. No prior rowing experience is necessary, making this a perfect opportunity for relaxation and camaraderie on the water.

tours.name: 'Bubbles and Baubles' Bottomless Brunch
tours.description: Celebrate Christmas on a 3-hour coastal cruise with festive beats, bottomless drinks, a tasty brunch, and sparkling decor. Dance, toast, and soak up holiday cheer on the stunning Dorset coast.

tours.name: Bushcraft Small Group Taster Session
tours.description: Join a calming outdoor adventure with firelighting, shelter building, tool making, and cooking—all crafted for neurodiverse individuals seeking a supportive, creative, and structured experience.

tours.name: The (abridged) History of Cambridge Town
tours.description: Step into Cambridge’s rich history in just one hour. Walk through centuries of stories, maps, and fun facts as the town’s vibrant character unfolds around you, ending where it all began at St Benet’s Church.

tours.name: Notting Hill Tour • Private
tours.description: Step into Bridget Jones’s London world with a 2.5-hour tour visiting iconic movie locations, from her apartment to Darcy’s office, plus famous landmarks. Capture photos, hear behind-the-scenes stories, and relive film magic.

tours.name: Indoor Climbing Club - Minehead Eye
tours.description: Climb, learn, and boost confidence in a fun 4-week indoor climbing club for kids. Our expert instructor guides skill-building and adventure, all starting at Minehead Eye—perfect for young explorers eager to scale new heights.

tours.name: Herbert Island Adventure
tours.description: Paddle to Herberts Island, warm up with a hands-on hot chocolate over a wood-fired kettle, then explore the island’s scenic beauty and enjoy a peaceful day on the lake. An adventure you won’t forget.

tours.name: Kings Cross Canal Cruise (30 Minute Round Trip)
tours.description: Sail through London's historic Kings Cross on a traditional narrowboat, passing 200-year-old landmarks, lush nature reserves, and vibrant markets—an immersive journey into the city's industrial past and lively present.

tours.name: Paddleboard Instructor Course
tours.description: Boost your paddling skills and inspire others with this practical two-day course. Learn to run fun activities, design mini journeys, and ensure safety—perfect for beginners and pros eager to teach and connect.

tours.name: VR Escape Room Party
tours.description: Join a thrilling VR escape challenge with friends, solving puzzles and racing against time in one of 16 immersive rooms. Gear up, work together, and break free before the clock runs out!

tours.name: Smash Point Party
tours.description: Join a vibrant VR battle in Smash Point, a colorful game like paintball and dodgeball. Compete or team up with friends using funky weapons—perfect for parties, families, and up to 6 players.

tours.name: Champ Fest
tours.description: Join the Surf Showdown to ride wild boards in a lively heat, paddle out in memory of Champ, then celebrate with live music, a BBQ, and camping. A day of waves, fun, and community awaits.

tours.name: Our Place In Space
tours.description: Gaze at the stars in Exmoor’s dark skies, explore planets through telescopes, and learn from expert astronomers. Enjoy laser-guided sky talks and virtual space experiences—an unforgettable night among the stars.

tours.name: Journey to the Moon
tours.description: Gaze at the stars under Exmoor’s dark sky with expert guidance, telescopes, and virtual sky talks. Discover planets, the Milky Way, and cosmic wonders in an unforgettable evening of celestial exploration.

tours.name: In The Night Sky
tours.description: Gaze at the night sky in Exmoor’s dark skies, explore planets through telescopes, and learn from expert astronomers. Enjoy laser-guided star talks, virtual sky views, and a VR space experience for an unforgettable evening.

tours.name: Family Mountain Bike Descent
tours.description: Climb Porlock Hill by vehicle, then descend through moorland and ancient woods on beginner-friendly trails. Enjoy stunning views, wildlife, and a fun, guided 8-10 km ride back to Porlock Weir.

tours.name: Paddle to the Pub (1 Way Trip)
tours.description: Glide along the scenic Beaulieu River in a cozy canoe, then unwind at the historic Master Builder’s pub. Enjoy wildlife spotting, a peaceful walk, and a relaxing riverside escape perfect for families, couples, and friends.

tours.name: 4hr Half-day Fishing Trip
tours.company: Starida Puffin Island Cruises & Sea Fishing Trips
tours.description: Join a 4-hour fishing trip from Beaumaris Pier for seasoned anglers and holidaymakers. Catch species like mackerel, whiting, and pollock. Bring your own gear or rent rods—enjoy a fun, challenging day on the water.

tours.name: 6hr Enthusiast Fishing Trip
tours.company: Starida Puffin Island Cruises & Sea Fishing Trips
tours.description: Join a 6-hour fishing trip from Beaumaris Pier for seasoned anglers and holidaymakers. Catch species like mackerel, pollock, and more, with optional rod hire. Weather-dependent, it’s perfect for a fun, leisurely day on the water.

tours.name: Harry Potter Tour
tours.description: Embark on a magical 2.5-hour walking tour through London, exploring iconic Harry Potter locations. Experience the thrill of a broom ride along the River Thames, search for the Leaky Cauldron, and discover hidden gems that muggles miss. Uncover your Hogwarts house and immerse yourself in the enchanting world of wizards.

tours.name: Wheelie School & Skills Training
tours.description: Refine your trials skills with a full day of expert coaching, mastering wheelies and control on a purpose-built park. Perfect for experienced riders ready to elevate their riding in a dynamic, small-group setting.

tours.name: 1 Hour Evening Cruise for Dolphin and Wildlife Spotting on Ermol VI
tours.description: Enjoy a one-hour evening cruise from New Quay, spotting dolphins, seals, and porpoises while soaking in stunning coastal views at golden hour. Stable boats, comfy seats, and wildlife stories await.

tours.name: Harry Potter • London and Oxford University Film Locations Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating full-day tour to Oxford, exploring iconic locations that inspired Hogwarts and featured in the films. Marvel at the stunning dining hall of Christ Church College and other magical sites, all while enjoying a guided walking tour of the enchanting City of Dreaming Spires.

tours.name: Tour to Stonehenge and Bath
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 11-hour journey from London to the enchanting city of Bath, renowned for its stunning Georgian architecture and the remarkable Roman Baths Museum. Delve into the mysteries of Stonehenge with a personal guided tour, exploring its secrets and visiting the impressive visitor center. A truly grand experience awaits!

tours.name: Stonehenge and Windsor Castle
tours.description: Experience an exclusive 11-hour private tour to Stonehenge and Windsor Castle, escaping the crowds in a luxurious Mercedes Benz. Enjoy a guided exploration of the iconic Stonehenge and its exhibition, then discover the grandeur of Windsor Castle, including the stunning State Apartments and St George's Chapel, at your own pace.

tours.name: 'Inspector Morse', 'Lewis', and 'Endeavour' Tour
tours.description: Step into Oxford’s world of mystery with a 1hr 45min tour exploring iconic filming sites from Morse, Lewis, and Endeavour. Uncover stories, see famous locations, and relive detective adventures in this popular, fully booked experience.

tours.name: Surfing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with expert instructors at Board Games in Pembrokeshire! Whether you're a beginner or have some experience, enjoy personalized attention while learning essential skills in a fun, supportive environment. All equipment is provided, ensuring a memorable day filled with laughter and excitement in the waves!

tours.name: Stand Up Paddleboarding (SUP)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding along the stunning Pembrokeshire coast! In just 2.5 hours, you'll learn essential skills and enjoy personalized guidance from our passionate team. Perfect for all ages and abilities, this adventure promises unforgettable views and fun, whether you're a beginner or a seasoned paddler.

tours.name: Axe Throwing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of axe throwing in a historic 18th-century mill in Llangollen! In just 30 minutes, learn expert techniques from seasoned instructors, practice your throws, and compete in a friendly contest. Perfect for ages 7 and up, this unique activity promises excitement and camaraderie in a one-of-a-kind setting.

tours.name: Air Rifles
tours.description: Experience the thrill of precision shooting in our custom-built indoor air rifle range! Perfect for ages 7 and up, this 30-minute session includes safety training, skill-building challenges, and friendly competitions. Test your aim with various targets, from tin cans to reactive ones, and enjoy a unique shooting adventure!

tours.name: Classic 2 Days Wild Camping Trip
tours.description: Paddle through rocky islands, spot a curious seal, explore hidden sea caves, fish for mackerel, and camp on a remote beach with a driftwood fire—an unforgettable wild coast adventure in just two days.

tours.name: Family Paddleboarding - Saul Junction
tours.description: Enjoy a fun-filled family paddleboarding adventure with expert guidance, playful challenges, and scenic waterways—perfect for all ages. No experience needed—just bring your enthusiasm and make lasting memories.

tours.name: Car Parking
tours.description: Experience the best value parking in Skipton at Bailey Car Park, conveniently located near the historic Skipton Castle and its enchanting woods. Enjoy oversized bays for family-friendly access, and explore the medieval charm of Skipton Castle, a remarkable landmark steeped in history, just a short walk away.

tours.name: Family Sessions (Must include at least one Adult)
tours.description: Join a fun-filled family bike session, exploring woodland trails together. Suitable for all abilities, it’s perfect for creating memories and enjoying nature as a team. Ride, laugh, and adventure await!

tours.name: Summer Holiday Activities (Happy Healthy Holiday Fund)
tours.description: Join the Holiday Activity & Food Project at YMCA Bridgwater this Easter for an unforgettable experience! Children aged 8-13 will engage in thrilling outdoor adventures while learning about nutrition and food preparation. Enjoy delicious meals and develop essential life skills in a supportive environment, all funded to help those in need.

tours.name: Large Rowing Boat
tours.description: Starting at £55 For all ages! • From 2 hs • 2 sets for oars • Upto 6 people• Family friendly

tours.name: Surf Lesson 1-1 Beginner to Advanced
tours.description: Catch waves with personalized coaching for all levels, from beginner to advanced. Suit up, hit the beach, and ride the surf—cold water fun and unforgettable memories await. All gear included, just bring your enthusiasm!

tours.name: Camp VC Training Session
tours.description: Join women’s outdoor adventure at Camp VC in Llangollen, where you can learn trials riding from beginner to pro, tackle obstacles, and build skills on electric or petrol bikes—all in a supportive, scenic setting.

tours.name: Crate Stacking
tours.description: Test your balance and teamwork by stacking upside-down crates as high as possible—then stand tall at the top. Will your team conquer the challenge before the stack crashes down?

tours.name: Diddy Dudes Skate Session
tours.description: Kids under 8 can enjoy a fun-filled 2-hour session at the skatepark and bouldering cave, boosting confidence on ramps and rocks with included gear, while parents relax in the cafe nearby.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Murder by Illusion
tours.description: Solve a thrilling murder mystery on a steam train, where magic, secrets, and suspects collide. Question clues, interrogate characters, and enjoy a 3-course meal as you race to catch the killer before they vanish.

tours.name: Red Bus Ride Along With Santa
tours.description: Experience the magic of Christmas on the Red Bus Ride Along With Santa! Enjoy a festive tour of Glasgow's twinkling lights, meet Santa, and receive a special goodie bag. Delight in tasty treats and sing along with holiday favorites, creating unforgettable memories for children and adults alike. Join the fun!

tours.name: Seal Watching
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 1.5-hour Seal Watching tour in Chichester Harbour, home to a growing colony of grey and harbour seals. Spot playful pups and, during winter, enjoy bird watching with wading species like oyster catchers and Brent geese. Dress warmly for an unforgettable maritime adventure!

tours.name: Tour The Beatles
tours.description: Explore the London where The Beatles rose to fame, visiting iconic sites like Abbey Road, the Cavern, and Carnaby Street. Uncover their story through legendary landmarks, secret moments, and cultural milestones in just 3 hours.

tours.name: Tour National Gallery
tours.description: Explore the National Gallery’s stunning masterpieces, from Van Gogh’s vibrant colors to Velázquez’s realism. A guided 3-hour journey through European art history, revealing secrets behind iconic works.

tours.name: Family Entertainment & Disco Cruise with Sparky Marky
tours.description: Join the Yorkshire Belle for a lively family cruise with dancing, games, and fun entertainment. Sing along to hits from every decade, enjoy audience participation, and make memories on this energetic, feel-good adventure.

tours.name: Camping
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Lake District at an exclusive SUP-friendly campsite. Enjoy spacious pitches equipped with fire pits and BBQ grills, perfect for family and friends. With stunning lakeside views, hot showers, and composting toilets, this unique camping adventure promises relaxation and unforgettable memories in nature.

tours.name: Day Camping
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Lake District at an exclusive SUP-friendly campsite. Enjoy a perfect day with family or friends, complete with a lakeside pitch, fire pit, and BBQ grill. Relax with hot showers and composting toilets, making your outdoor adventure both comfortable and memorable.

tours.name: High Ropes - Special Offer - Families Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure at Rock and Rapid Adventures' high ropes course! In this one-hour session, qualified instructors guide you through safety protocols and equipment, ensuring a memorable challenge for participants aged 5 and up. Perfect for families, this unique activity promises excitement and teamwork in a stunning outdoor setting.

tours.name: Private Stand up Paddleboarding - 3hrs
tours.description: Join a private, tailored paddleboarding session along Pembrokeshire's coast. Perfect for beginners or pros, with personalized tips, guided tours, and all gear provided—create unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Perfume Design Experience for Two (Private Event)
tours.description: Embark on a luxurious perfume-making journey for two, guided by a Senior Perfume Stylist in the comfort of your chosen venue. Create and refine up to three unique fragrances, select your favorite, and receive a beautifully presented Ultimate Collection. Enjoy ongoing access to your personal fragrance library for future re-orders.

tours.name: Inter School Comp Primary School
tours.description: Join an exhilarating climbing competition designed for students in years 3 to 6, featuring bouldering, speed climbing, and top roping. Compete for points across various routes, with prizes for top performers. Enjoy a day of fun, food, and friendly rivalry while showcasing your climbing skills!

tours.name: Inter School Comp Secondary School
tours.description: Join an exciting climbing competition designed for students in years 3 to 6, featuring Bouldering, Speed Climbing, and Top Roping. Test your skills on multiple routes, earn points, and compete for prizes. Parents can enjoy refreshments at the café while participants showcase their climbing talents in a fun-filled day!

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Fairytale Felony: Deadly Ever After
tours.description: Solve a thrilling murder mystery aboard a scenic Yorkshire Dales train, complete with a 3-course meal. Question suspects, uncover clues, and find the culprit in this interactive 3.5-hour adventure.

tours.name: Bermondsey Beer Mile Tasting
tours.description: Sip on five craft beers, learn brewing secrets, and enjoy a cheese platter in London's Bermondsey Beer Mile. Take home bee-friendly seeds and explore nearby sights after your lively guided tasting.

tours.name: Platinum
tours.description: Fire up your adrenaline with London's only airsoft range! Try realistic guns, play 11 game modes, and enjoy expert guidance in a safe, fun environment—perfect for beginners or seasoned shooters alike.

tours.name: Monster SUP
tours.description: Join a lively 2-hour Monster SUP session in Newquay, perfect for groups. Bond, laugh, and explore the coast while paddling out into the deep—fun for all skill levels, with expert guides and all gear included.

tours.name: Coasteering - Blue Lagoon Abereiddy
tours.description: Experience the thrill of coasteering at the stunning Blue Lagoon and Abereiddy Bay! This action-packed adventure is perfect for families and friends, catering to all adrenaline levels. Enjoy a safe and fun outing with provided wetsuits and safety gear, while exploring the breathtaking coastal scenery.

tours.name: Double Kayak Hire
tours.description: Paddle through calm, scenic waters at Loe Beach, exploring creeks or reaching Trelissick Gardens. Enjoy full gear, expert tips, and a shoreline push-off—perfect for families, friends, or solo adventurers.

tours.name: Paddleboard (SUP) Hire
tours.description: Glide across calm waters at Loe Beach on a stable paddleboard. Enjoy a full-body workout, scenic creeks, and expert tips, all with safety gear included. Perfect for beginners and adventure seekers alike.

tours.name: The Great Rock & Roll Walking Tour of London
tours.description: Walk through London’s legendary music scene in 3 hours! Visit Abbey Road, Soho Square, and historic venues, uncovering stories of The Beatles, Bowie, and more—perfect for fans and photo lovers alike.

tours.name: Yellow & Red Self Drive Boat Rides
tours.description: Experience the stunning St Ives Coast like never before with our self-drive boats! Perfect for all ages, including your furry friends, our easy-to-handle boats come with life jackets and expert guidance. Enjoy a memorable adventure on the water, surrounded by breathtaking scenery and the thrill of driving your own boat.

tours.name: 2 Hours Fishing Trip
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating two-hour fishing adventure along the stunning Jurassic Coast of Swanage. Perfect for all skill levels, this trip offers the chance to catch a variety of fish while enjoying breathtaking coastal scenery and abundant marine life. All equipment is provided, making it an ideal outing for families and beginners.

tours.name: 4 Hours Fishing Trip
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 4-hour fishing adventure along the stunning Jurassic Coast of Swanage. Perfect for all skill levels, this trip offers the chance to catch a variety of fish while enjoying breathtaking coastal scenery and observing diverse marine life. Ideal for families and those seeking a new experience!

tours.name: 8 Hours Fishing Trip
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour fishing adventure suitable for all skill levels, including kids. Explore diverse fishing grounds near Swanage, targeting exciting species like Conger Eel and Pollock. Enjoy ample fishing and social time while customizing your experience to catch your desired fish in stunning outdoor settings.

tours.name: Air Rifle & Archery Combo
tours.description: Test your skills with both air rifles and archery at Armourgeddon. Enjoy expert guidance, unlimited shots, and a fun, competitive atmosphere. Perfect for groups, with free museum entry included.

tours.name: Private Boat Hire
tours.description: Set sail with Captain Keith for a private 8-hour cruise to secluded beaches. Snorkel, swim, and enjoy personalized adventures with your group in stunning coastal scenery. Bring snacks and explore at your own pace.

tours.name: Sunrise 5k street and urban art running tour
tours.description: Experience the vibrant street art of London Bridge on a unique 5k running tour before the city awakens. Discover stunning murals and the stories behind them, all while enjoying a leisurely pace with fellow runners. Capture memorable photos and receive insights about the artists, finishing just in time for breakfast.

tours.name: After School Coached Sessions
tours.description: Join our exciting British Canoeing Paddle Discover Awards Kayaking Course in Kinver, designed for ages 10-15! Over four weeks, participants will learn essential kayaking skills and decision-making, guided by experienced instructor Monty. This unique opportunity fosters confidence on the water, culminating in a certificate of achievement. Don't miss out!

tours.name: Crime & Punishment 5k and 10k running tour
tours.description: Embark on a haunting 5k or 10k guided run through England's dark history, tracing the path of condemned prisoners from Newgate Gaol to Tyburn. Experience the chilling tales of the justice system while enjoying a finish-line snack. Suitable for all paces, this unique tour ensures no one is left behind.

tours.name: LIVE PODCAST: Henry VIII's wives and why we love them with historian Heather Darsie
tours.description: Join historian Heather Darsie for an engaging talk on the captivating wives of Henry VIII. With her deep knowledge and fresh insights from European archives, she’ll explore their enduring allure. Enjoy a private setting, followed by a book signing and Q&A, making this a memorable evening for Tudor history enthusiasts.

tours.name: Henry VIII's Wives in the City 8km running tour with Heather Darsie
tours.description: Join historian Heather Darsie on a captivating guided run through the City of London, exploring the intriguing stories of Henry VIII's six wives. Visit iconic Tudor locations like Charterhouse and the Tower of London, all while enjoying a supportive atmosphere where every runner is welcomed. A unique blend of history and fitness awaits!

tours.name: Literary London 4k walking tour
tours.description: Embark on an enchanting walking tour around London Bridge, exploring the haunts of literary giants like Dickens and Shakespeare. Led by passionate guide Josh, this sneak peek reveals iconic sites, including Bridget Jones' home and Chaucer's pilgrimage starting point. Enjoy digital photos and a tasty snack as you delve into literary history.

tours.name: Donnington Brewery Tour
tours.description: Experience a unique journey through Donnington Brewery, the only brewery still powered by a waterwheel. For the first time in 158 years, explore the historic brewhouse, witness the brewing process, and enjoy tastings with a complimentary glass. Join us every Friday for an unforgettable behind-the-scenes adventure in the Cotswolds.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - An Invitation to Murder: Golden Age
tours.description: Solve a murder mystery on a vintage train through the Yorkshire Dales, featuring famous detectives, a 3-course meal, and a thrilling race to uncover who killed Lord D’Arque before time runs out.

tours.name: 12 Seater Day Boat - Hire By The Hour
tours.description: Climb aboard a spacious, stable boat with shelter and safety gear, perfect for a fun, pet-friendly adventure. Easy to operate with expert tuition—set sail confidently on your own or with friends.

tours.name: 12 Seater Day Boat - Hire By The Day
tours.description: Enjoy a safe, stable boat ride with shelter, buoyancy aids, and easy instructions. Pet-friendly and perfect for groups, it’s your chance to explore the water comfortably—just remember the return times!

tours.name: 8 Seater Day Boat - Hire By The Hour
tours.description: Enjoy a flexible, pet-friendly boat rental with easy tuition, canopy protection, and quiet early mornings on the river. Perfect for 4 to 8 hours of relaxed adventure—book now and set your own pace.

tours.name: Castle Guided Tours
tours.description: Step into Ripley Castle’s 14th-century halls, hear tales of heroism, explore medieval rooms, and stroll through scenic gardens and lakes—an unforgettable journey through history and nature in North Yorkshire.

tours.name: River Tweed Innerleithen-Abbotsford day trip
tours.description: Float along the tranquil River Tweed from Innerleithen to Galafoot Bridge, soaking in stunning countryside views on a 5-hour adventure. Perfect for outdoor lovers craving a peaceful, scenic escape.

tours.name: SUP Launch/Access
tours.description: Experience the thrill of private stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) access at our stunning location! Ensure you have your BSUPA Ready2Ride card to join this unique adventure. Arrive early for a seamless check-in and prepare for an unforgettable time on the water, surrounded by breathtaking views and safety measures.

tours.name: City Centre, Parks and Bay
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour cycling adventure through Cardiff, exploring its rich history and stunning landmarks. Ride past the majestic Cardiff Castle, the iconic Principality Stadium, and the serene Bute Park. Enjoy a delicious Welsh cake at the indoor market, making this journey a unique blend of culture and scenery.

tours.name: Premium Tasting
tours.description: Experience the luxury of three exceptional Glen Scotia whiskies, aged 21, 23, and 25 years. This exclusive tasting features Limited Core releases and rare Single Casks, including the award-winning Double Platinum. Indulge in a memorable journey through rich flavors and craftsmanship that define the pinnacle of single malt whisky.

tours.name: On The Rocks
tours.description: Climb at Black Rocks with expert guides, tailored to your skill level. Enjoy safe rope climbing, stunning views, and get photos and videos of your adventure. No experience needed—just bring your enthusiasm and a sense of adventure.

tours.name: Transfer-Tour between Bath & Oxford (Custom & Private)
tours.description: Travel between Bath and Oxford in comfort, exploring scenic Cotswolds villages, hidden gems, and historic sites. Enjoy a relaxed day with personalized stops, a country inn lunch, and local insights—an authentic England adventure.

tours.name: Lasertag
tours.description: Dive into a thrilling outdoor laser tag adventure in woodland settings. Use high-tech infrared guns, hide, seek, and outsmart opponents in a safe, action-packed game perfect for ages 8 to 80.

tours.name: 1.5 Hour Wildlife Spotting, Evening Cruise on Suncatcher
tours.description: Join a 1.5-hour wildlife cruise from New Quay to spot dolphins, seals, and seabirds. Enjoy stunning coastal views, stable boats, and onboard snacks—perfect for all ages and even furry friends. Dolphins are wild, so sightings aren’t guaranteed.

tours.name: 'Besties' Thursdays!
tours.description: Sip three cocktails with canapés in a relaxed setting, or enjoy two drinks and a grazing board with a friend. Perfect for unwinding and catching up at Nantwich’s cozy Pepper Street spot.

tours.name: Private Kayak Lesson
tours.description: Embark on an exciting 1.5-hour kayaking adventure on the River Dee, perfect for beginners! With expert instruction, you'll learn essential skills and gain confidence in your boat. All necessary equipment is provided, and you can choose between stable inflatable or rigid kayaks. Get ready for unforgettable river exploration!

tours.name: Private Llangollen Whitewater Kayak Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of whitewater kayaking with personalized lessons on the River Dee! Suitable for all skill levels, you'll learn essential techniques like rolling and surfing on grade 3 rapids. Enjoy expert guidance, all necessary equipment, and the chance to find the perfect kayak for your adventures.

tours.name: 30 minute Dolphin Spotting trip on Dreamcatcher
tours.description: Set sail from New Quay for 45 minutes of marine magic, spotting playful dolphins, seals, and porpoises. Perfect for families, with expert guides sharing local legends and marine secrets along the stunning coast.

tours.name: The Dash at the Secret London Runs Festival 2024
tours.description: Join an exhilarating team treasure hunt with Team Magpie's app! In just one hour, race against the clock to find approximately 60 items around Victoria Park. Collaborate with your team, capture photos, and unlock bonus challenges. Will you conquer the leaderboard and claim victory? Adventure awaits!

tours.name: Private - Birmingham Walking Tour: History, Canals & Street Art
tours.description: Explore Birmingham’s vibrant history, stunning architecture, and lively street art on a personalized 2.5-hour walking tour. Discover hidden stories, iconic sights, and local culture at your own pace with an expert guide.

tours.name: Experiencia Tour Harry Potter Exprés
tours.description: Explore London's Harry Potter sites in just two hours on foot, guided by a passionate fan. Uncover filming spots, secrets of the wizarding world, and iconic landmarks—all packed with stories, fun, and magic.

tours.name: Friar's Bush Graveyard Whistlestop Tour
tours.description: Uncover Belfast’s rich history at a historic graveyard, once abandoned, now a peaceful site filled with stories of worship, remembrance, and transformation. Guided tours reveal secrets of this cultural landmark.

tours.name: Adult Solo Sit-On-Top Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of solo sea kayaking with our stable Sit-On-Top kayaks, perfect for beginners and seasoned paddlers alike. Explore the stunning coastline at your own pace, with the option to bring a child along in their own boat. Enjoy the freedom and adventure of the open water!

tours.name: Pasta Master @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create authentic Italian pasta from scratch in just 2 hours. Shape, cook, and pair three delicious sauces, then enjoy your handmade dish at the chef’s table with a fresh salad and a glass of bubbly.

tours.name: Discover Malvern: A Scenic Walk, Cream Tea, and the Water Wells
tours.description: Embark on a serene 3.5-hour journey through the picturesque Malvern Hills, exploring historic wells and savoring refreshing spring water. Conclude your adventure with a delightful cream tea featuring homemade scones and clotted cream at a charming Georgian hotel. This experience promises relaxation, nature, and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: SPVR Arcade School trips
tours.description: A fun-filled school day at SPVR Arcade combines immersive VR adventures, challenging escape rooms, and creative craft activities, all designed to boost teamwork, problem-solving, and imagination in a safe, engaging setting.

tours.name: Bespoke Walking Private Tour with Expert Guide
tours.description: Experience London like never before with our 'Best of London' private tour, designed for first-time visitors. Discover iconic landmarks such as Buckingham Palace and the Tower of London at your own pace, enjoying skip-the-line access and personalized guidance from a qualified tour guide. Relax and let us handle the details for a memorable adventure.

tours.name: Escape to the Countryside • Bespoke Cotswolds Private Tour with Expert Guide and Chauffeur
tours.description: Escape London’s hustle for a private Cotswolds tour in a luxury Mercedes. Wander charming villages, see Arlington Row, stroll riverside bridges, explore historic towns, and enjoy authentic local flavors in this serene English countryside.

tours.name: Mothers Day Sailing Adventure
tours.description: Set sail on a 3-hour adventure through Plymouth Sound, exploring historic landmarks like Mayflower Steps, Drake's Island, and Mount Edgecumbe, all led by a pro yachtsman. Perfect for a memorable Mother’s Day outing.

tours.name: Hidden London • Explore the City Like a True Local, Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating walking tour of London, navigating its hidden gems via public transport. Discover the literary history of Fleet Street, the vibrant culture of the East End, the charm of Covent Garden, and the artistic energy of Soho. Experience the city like a true local, rich in stories and sights.

tours.name: Royal Windsor Luxury Tour with Expert Guide • Experienced Chauffeur
tours.description: Embark on a personalized adventure at Windsor Castle, where luxury meets history. Enjoy a private ride in a V-Class Mercedes and be guided by an expert as you explore the opulent State Apartments, the stunning St. George’s Chapel, and the picturesque Long Walk, all steeped in royal heritage and captivating stories.

tours.name: Public Easter Craft Cruise
tours.description: Experience a delightful Easter half term cruise on the historic Bridgewater canal aboard the Francis Egerton. Enjoy stunning views while sipping tea or coffee, as children engage in festive arts and crafts, decorating Easter eggs and cards. Each child also receives a refreshing juice and a chocolate egg to celebrate!

tours.name: Target Sports- Axe Throwing
tours.description: Unleash your power with axe throwing, then challenge friends in fun games and competitions. Feel the thrill as you aim, throw, and compete in a lively, action-packed experience.

tours.name: SSI Try Scuba
tours.description: Step into a safe pool environment and breathe underwater for the first time. Guided by an instructor, earn your SSI Try Scuba card and unlock a world of underwater adventures waiting just beneath the surface.

tours.name: Chocolate Tasting Tour
tours.description: Stroll through London's Mayfair with a seasoned trader, visiting royal chocolatiers. Taste truffles and ganaches, uncover chocolate secrets, and explore perfect alcohol pairings on this flavorful guided tour.

tours.name: Cheese Tasting Tour
tours.description: Taste the finest artisan cheeses across four locations, including royal supplier. Discover intriguing cheese facts and perfect pairings with drinks on this flavorful journey.

tours.name: Paddle Board Hire
tours.description: Glide along the Thet River on a paddleboard, taking in Thetford’s sights from a fresh angle. Get close to local birds and enjoy a peaceful, scenic adventure on the water.

tours.name: Private Liverpool True Crime Tour
tours.description: Uncover Liverpool’s hidden past on a thrilling tour through crime scenes, secret streets, and legendary gangsters, revealing the city’s dark secrets behind its glitz and glamour.

tours.name: Discover Marine Science
tours.description: Set sail for five hours of marine wonder, spotting dolphins, whales, seals, and seabirds around Cornwall’s stunning coast. Limited to 10 guests, this immersive voyage offers expert insights and unforgettable wildlife encounters.

tours.name: All things steak @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Master the art of cooking perfect British steak with chef tips, truffled mash, and rich mushroom sauce. Savor four beef cuts, enjoy a gourmet dinner, and toast with a complimentary glass—impress friends with your new skills.

tours.name: Rope Bridge Safari
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 3.5-hour paddleboard tour through breathtaking locations with crystal clear waters. Experience the thrill of wild swimming or snorkeling, and glide beneath the iconic Carrick a Rede rope bridge. Perfect for those with paddleboarding experience, this adventure promises stunning views and unique coastal exploration.

tours.name: Indivdual Diving weekend, Skomer
tours.description: Dive into Pembrokeshire’s stunning coastline, home to vibrant marine life and breathtaking scenery. Join a flexible, two-day adventure where weather shapes your underwater journey in this top-rated coastal paradise.

tours.name: Private Charter - Spectre (Oxford)
tours.description: Sail from Oxford on a private Thames cruise, passing charming villages, lush meadows, and historic landmarks. Perfect for celebrations or relaxing escapes, enjoy personalized routes and breathtaking scenery on this unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Giant's Causeway Express Tour
tours.description: Journey along Ireland’s stunning coast to the UNESCO Giant’s Causeway, explore Dunluce Castle, and enjoy breathtaking scenery. Add thrilling rope bridge crossings or whiskey tastings for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Soho Soundtrack: A Rock and Roll Tour of London's Musical Heartland
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable rock and roll adventure through Soho, where the legacy of British music comes alive. Guided by passionate experts, explore iconic sites from The Beatles to Oasis, uncovering the stories behind legendary venues and the underground scene. Experience the vibrant pulse of London's musical heartland like never before.

tours.name: Sauna Sessions
tours.description: Relax in a warm, wood-fired sauna to melt stress away, refresh your senses, and enjoy a peaceful escape. Perfect after a swim or walk, with space for up to 8 people to unwind together.

tours.name: 3 Hour Island Explorer on Suncatcher
tours.description: Embark on a 3-hour adventure aboard the Suncatcher, exploring the stunning Ynys Lochtyn island in Cardigan Bay. Discover the breathtaking coastal scenery and the charm of this popular destination, just a short distance from Llangrannog. Experience the beauty of Wales from the water and create unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Ultimate Killers Tribute Night
tours.description: Ride through the Yorkshire Dales on a vintage train, enjoy hearty Pie & Peas, then rock out to a Killers tribute band at Bolton Abbey. Sing along, dance, and relive the hits in a stunning heritage setting.

tours.name: World War II Peckham & Dulwich 7k running tour
tours.description: Join a unique 1.5-hour guided running tour through Peckham and Dulwich, exploring the profound impact of WWII on the area. Covering 7km at a comfortable pace for all, this experience includes digital photos and insights about local history, ensuring no one is left behind. Discover the past while staying active!

tours.name: NYE Countdown Cruise
tours.description: Ring in 2026 on a lively Weymouth cruise with dancing, a BBQ, sparkling drinks, confetti, and fun fancy dress. Celebrate in style with live DJ, midnight toast, and chances to win prizes—an unforgettable New Year’s bash.

tours.name: The Allo Allo Comedy Dining Experience

tours.name: Bingo'in CraZy

tours.name: Halloween Quiz with Ultimate Party Nights

tours.name: 19/06/2026 - From St Cuthbert to the Wizard of the North: The Magical Legends of the North East
tours.description: Step into Newcastle’s legendary past with Icy Sedgwick, exploring dragons, wizards, and vampires through captivating tales of magic, heroism, and folklore—an enchanting journey into the region’s mystical history.

tours.name: Harry Potter • Round-Trip Transportation to Studio

tours.description: Kids aged 8-14 can enjoy a fun 3-day sailing course with games, expert instructors, and all gear provided. Most days are spent sailing and learning in a safe, lively water adventure—perfect for beginners and thrill-seekers alike.
