tours.description: Ride through the stunning New Forest on a scenic trek, then relax with a delicious, bespoke picnic. Suitable for all, this 2-4 hour adventure combines nature, good food, and gentle riding.

tours.name: Private Riding Lesson With Scarlett
tours.description: Enjoy a personalized 30-minute riding session with Scarlett, tailored for all ages and skill levels. Perfect for beginners or those looking to refine their riding in a private, focused setting.

tours.name: Father's Day BBQ Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate Father’s Day with a 2.5-hour cruise along Dorset’s Jurassic Coast, featuring stunning views, a tasty BBQ, and a free drink. Relax, enjoy great company, and toast to the important men in your life.

tours.name: Kids Club - 5 Day Windsurfing 10+
tours.description: Catch the thrill of windsurfing with expert instructors, all gear provided. Perfect for young adventurers eager to learn basics or master advanced skills over four fun-filled sessions.

tours.name: Solar Eclipse Celebration
tours.description: Watch the partial solar eclipse safely through a telescope, marvel at the Moon covering the Sun, and enjoy fun solar activities in the garden—all guided by an expert astronomer.

tours.name: Exmoor Dark Sky Festival Event
tours.description: Gaze at the stars under Exmoor’s dark sky, explore planets through telescopes, and learn from expert astronomers. Enjoy laser-guided sky talks, virtual sky views, and a VR space experience for an unforgettable night.

tours.name: Journey to the Moon
tours.description: Gaze at the stars under Exmoor’s dark sky with expert guidance, telescopes, and virtual space talks. Discover planets, the Milky Way, and cosmic wonders in an unforgettable night of celestial exploration.

tours.name: Space Rocks
tours.description: Gaze up at the Exmoor Dark Sky, where stars come alive. Uncover their secrets, explore myths, and marvel at the vast universe—all under a breathtaking night sky.

tours.name: MILKIN IT - Open Drag Night
tours.description: Step into Milkin It, the North West’s top open drag night, where at least 8 glamorous performers dazzle from the stage. Hosted by Tom the Drag Queen, enjoy stunning acts, lively intervals, and karaoke to end an unforgettable night.

tours.name: Diesel Hauled Goods Train
tours.description: Climb aboard a heritage freight train and relive the Forest of Dean’s industrial past. Feel the rumble of diesel engines, hear authentic freight sounds, and enjoy exclusive views on limited-seat rides—book early!

tours.name: Make a mosaic heart and Breath in a bauble with fizz and cake - group sessions
tours.description: Create a personalized glass heart and a colorful bauble with professional glassblowers, enjoy fizz and cupcakes, and take home your unique keepsake after a fun, relaxed Bath hen party.

tours.name: Glass Slipper Events - Superhero Takeover!
tours.description: Step into a tropical jungle filled with lively characters, interactive shows, and animal adventures. Meet heroes, snap photos, join contests, and explore over 40 species in a fun-filled, family-friendly day at Plantasia Zoo.

tours.name: Glass Slipper Events - Ice Princesses
tours.description: Step into a tropical jungle filled with lively characters, interactive shows, and over 40 species. Meet heroes, join sing-alongs, take photos, and enjoy themed activities—an unforgettable family adventure awaits.

tours.name: Blackbeard to Banksy the Ultimate Bristol Walking Tour
tours.company: Blackbeard to Banksy the Ultimate Bristol Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Bristol’s rich history on a 2-hour walk through old town and harbourside, from pirate haunts to street art, ending in a historic tavern with rum. Discover 1000 years of stories in every step.

tours.name: Christmas Canoe Paddle
tours.description: Experience a magical holiday adventure with our Christmas Canoe trip on the picturesque Beaulieu River. Families can enjoy a 90-minute guided tour, meet Santa on the water, and receive special gifts. Embrace the festive spirit and create unforgettable memories as you paddle through stunning winter scenery together!

tours.name: Group Lessons
tours.description: Join a fun 1.5-hour surf lesson with expert coaches who ensure everyone progresses and enjoys. All gear is provided, and it's perfect for families and friends seeking a balanced, memorable beach adventure.

tours.name: Half Day Kayaking
tours.description: Embark on an exciting introduction to kayaking with a 2.5-hour taster session on the stunning Llangollen Canal. Learn essential skills while enjoying the serene waters, making it a perfect blend of fun and education. Bring your adventurous spirit and prepare for a memorable experience on the water!

tours.name: Full Day Whitewater Canoe
tours.description: Master the art of canoeing from calm waters to thrilling whitewater rapids in just one day. Feel the rush, learn new skills, and enjoy an unforgettable adventure with a partner by your side.

tours.name: Full Day Rock Climbing & Abseiling
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 6.5-hour rock climbing and abseiling adventure in the stunning Escarpment of North Wales. Experience classic limestone climbs and breathtaking heights, guided by expert instructors. Enjoy a day filled with excitement, beautiful scenery, and the thrill of conquering the crags. Packed lunches can be arranged for your convenience.

tours.name: Mountain Biking
tours.description: Experience the thrill of biking in North Wales, a paradise for enthusiasts! Over 2.5 hours, explore diverse trails—from downhill to scenic uphill—guided by an expert instructor. Whether you choose our bikes or bring your own, prepare for an unforgettable adventure filled with stunning views and a taste of Welsh mud.

tours.name: Full Day Mountain Biking
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 6.5-hour adventure as you explore two distinct riding styles. Begin with a natural trail through scenic Welsh countryside, then transition to a thrilling ride at a local manmade center like Coed Llandegla or The Marin Trail. Perfect for those seeking variety and excitement in their riding experience!

tours.name: Whitewater Active Raft Guide School
tours.description: Master the art of whitewater guiding in North Wales with this intense 6-day all-inclusive course, blending hands-on river skills, safety training, and rescue techniques to turn you into a confident raft guide.

tours.name: Room 4: Double Room with a River View
tours.description: Perfect for a couple • Breakfast Included

tours.name: Room 5: Double Room with a Town View
tours.description: Great Double room • Breakfast Included

tours.name: Room 6 : Family Room with a Town View
tours.description: Fantastic family room • Breakfast Included

tours.name: Steam Day Rover
tours.description: Ride behind a steam locomotive through Dean Forest all day, hopping on and off at stations. Enjoy unlimited travel, tasty treats, and the charm of heritage trains—perfect for a relaxing, fun-filled adventure.

tours.name: London Highlights Private Car Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4-hour panoramic tour of London, guided by specialists who unveil both iconic landmarks and hidden gems. Experience the grandeur of Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, and the Tower of London, with engaging walking tours that bring the city's rich history to life.

tours.name: Best of London Private Car Tour
tours.description: Embark on an 8-hour panoramic tour of London, guided by specialists who unveil both iconic landmarks and hidden gems. Experience the grandeur of Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, and Big Ben, along with captivating photo stops at St Paul's Cathedral and Kensington Palace. Discover the essence of London like never before!

tours.name: Oxford and Blenheim Palace
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 10-hour journey through Oxford, the city of dreaming spires. Explore its historic university, visit the enchanting Christ Church, and marvel at the grandeur of Blenheim Palace. Experience stunning gardens and rich history, all with convenient pick-up and drop-off from central London for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Shakespeare's Stratford-Upon-Avon and The Cotswolds
tours.description: Embark on an enchanting 11-hour journey through the stunning Cotswolds, exploring Shakespeare's birthplace in Stratford-Upon-Avon. Marvel at ancient Tudor buildings, enjoy a scenic drive through picturesque villages, and relax in Bourton-on-the-Water. This romantic adventure offers a perfect blend of history and breathtaking landscapes, making it truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Gin and Whisky Distillery Private Tour in the Cotswolds for Locals
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour adventure in the stunning Cotswolds, where you'll savor brunch at a charming eatery, enjoy a scenic drive through picturesque villages, and indulge in a whiskey and spirits tasting at a renowned distillery. Experience the essence of English countryside hedonism with convenient London transport included.

tours.name: London Highlights and Windsor Castle
tours.description: Experience a private, leisurely tour of London and Windsor, tailored just for you. Enjoy a stylish ride in a Mercedes V Class MPV, with a knowledgeable driver-guide. Visit iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace and the Tower of London, and explore the grandeur of Windsor Castle and St George's Chapel.

tours.name: Alpaca Trek
tours.description: Meet friendly alpacas on a scenic 75-90 minute guided walk through the Cheviot Hills, surrounded by ancient forts and history. Feed, learn fun facts, and enjoy breathtaking views in this unforgettable Scottish Borders adventure.

tours.name: Level 2 Sea Kayak Course
tours.description: Master sea kayaking in two days: paddle past seals and dolphins, explore sea caves, learn rescue and navigation skills, and relax on remote beaches—all with expert guidance in a fun, relaxed setting.

tours.name: London E-Bike Tour (Semi-Private)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of cycling through London on an electric bike! Glide effortlessly past iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace and Big Ben on this 3-hour adventure. With a small group size and a scenic route primarily in cycle lanes, this tour promises a unique and memorable exploration of the city.

tours.name: Alpaca Walk Experience
tours.description: Meet adorable alpacas, goats, pigs, sheep, and more on a fun farm tour. Feed animals, take photos, and enjoy festive Santa visits in December—perfect for kids and family adventures.

tours.name: Meet Alpacas, Meerkats & Donkeys
tours.description: Experience a delightful day meeting alpacas, meerkats, and donkeys! Enjoy a scenic alpaca walk, feed playful meerkats in a hands-on environment, and groom friendly donkeys. This unique adventure offers unforgettable moments with adorable animals, perfect for families and friends looking to create lasting memories together.

tours.name: Meet Alpacas & Donkeys
tours.description: Experience the charm of a working farm with a delightful Alpaca walk followed by an engaging Donkey experience. Meet and groom friendly donkeys, feed them treats, and enjoy playful interactions. This unique opportunity to connect with adorable animals makes for a memorable day, especially during the magical Christmas season.

tours.name: Meet Alpacas & Meerkats
tours.description: Embark on a delightful 2-hour adventure starting with a charming Alpaca walk, followed by an intimate encounter with playful meerkats. With your own feeding bowl, you'll enjoy a hands-on experience, getting up close to these adorable creatures in a secure enclosure. This unique animal interaction promises unforgettable memories!

tours.name: Meet the Meerkats
tours.description: Get up close with curious meerkats in a secure enclosure, feed them by hand, and enjoy their playful antics. A fun, interactive experience that brings you face-to-face with these fascinating, lively animals.

tours.name: Cambridge E-Scooter Tour
tours.description: Discover the charm of Cambridge on a thrilling e-scooter tour! Glide through the city’s iconic landmarks and prestigious colleges, all while enjoying a unique twist on a classic experience. Perfect for small groups, this 2.5-hour adventure promises unforgettable sights and seamless navigation through the heart of this historic town.

tours.name: Return train travel (Paddington™)
tours.description: Hop aboard a steam train to meet Chase and Marshall from PAW Patrol, snap photos, enjoy snacks, and share a family adventure full of mischief and springtime fun at Embsay & Bolton Abbey Railway.

tours.name: Kids Club: Intermediate Pro Sailing
tours.description: Boost your sailing skills over three fun-filled days with expert instructors, racing drills, man overboard practice, and watersports. Perfect for kids 10+ with some sailing experience. Sail most of each day!

tours.name: Sailing Boat on the River Thames
tours.description: Embark on a luxurious sailing adventure on the River Thames, passing under the iconic Tower Bridge. Enjoy a unique experience with oak-panelled dining and a cozy log fire, while optional activities like clay pigeon shooting and gourmet meals enhance your journey. Create unforgettable memories on this extraordinary London cruise.

tours.name: Electric Bike Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-3 hour electric bike tour through London, exploring iconic landmarks like Big Ben and the Tower Bridge. Enjoy live commentary on Muslim history while capturing stunning photos. This unique experience combines adventure and culture, perfect for those aged 14 and up seeking an alternative way to discover the city.

tours.name: Crocodile Feeding
tours.description: Get up close to Caimen Crocodiles in Fort Crox, feed them from a feeding bridge, and learn from experts. A thrilling 30-minute adventure with unforgettable animal encounters included with Plantasia entry.

tours.name: Raft Building
tours.description: Build your own raft from barrels and wood, then test it on the water in a fun, team-bonding challenge. Perfect for adventure seekers, no swimming needed—just teamwork and a sense of fun.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddling Tidal Cruise | Instow Beach
tours.description: Embark on a unique 2-hour stand-up paddleboarding adventure along the picturesque Torridge River. With a maximum group size of 8, enjoy personalized guidance as you paddle from Instow beach to Appledore quay, soaking in breathtaking scenery and local wildlife. Experience fitness and nature in perfect harmony.

tours.name: Meet Santa & Friends
tours.description: Meet Santa and his friends at Beirhope Alpacas for 45 minutes of festive fun: feed animals, hunt for stockings, post letters, make treats, and enjoy photos and gifts in a cozy holiday setting. Perfect family outing.

tours.name: Halloween Target Sports
tours.description: Experience a thrilling Halloween night filled with archery, axe throwing, and air rifle challenges! Target ghosts, zombies, and pumpkins in a uniquely themed setting. Enjoy special games on a projected archery range, making it an unforgettable evening for all ages 7 and up. Join the spooky fun!

tours.name: Aqueduct Canoeing - Private Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of canoeing over the world's highest aqueduct, the Pontcysyllte, in the breathtaking Dee Valley. Enjoy stunning scenery, engaging games, and expert guidance from the Bearded Men Team. This family-friendly adventure promises unforgettable memories and a unique perspective of this World Heritage site. Perfect for a day of exploration!

tours.name: Harry Potter Walking Tour & Platform 9 3/4
tours.description: Walk through London's wizarding world: visit iconic film locations, explore Knockturn Alley’s dark charm, snap a photo at Platform 9 3/4, and see the House of Minalima’s magical art—an unforgettable Harry Potter adventure.

tours.name: Airsoft Party
tours.description: Experience the thrill of military simulation with Call of Duty Airsoft! This immersive activity offers a tactical gameplay style similar to paintball but without the mess, making it a unique and realistic adventure. Perfect for ages 12 and up, it's an adrenaline-pumping experience you won't want to miss!

tours.name: Southern Lake Explorer Cruise
tours.description: Embark on an 80-minute themed cruise on Coniston Water, exploring its stunning scenery and rich natural history. Discover the famous "Wild Cat Island" while enjoying insightful commentary from your guide. With a single ticket valid for all three routes, this experience promises a memorable day on the water.

tours.name: Women's Coastal Discovery (Full Day)
tours.description: Join a full-day sea kayak adventure along stunning UK coastlines, led by expert female guides. Paddle past cliffs, spot seals, explore caves, swim in secret coves, and enjoy a relaxing beach picnic—no experience needed.

tours.name: Paddleboard Rental
tours.description: Paddle on tranquil Towan Beach waters just steps from Pavillion Cafe and Newquay Harbour. Choose a compact or inflated SUP, then change and rinse easily with indoor and outdoor facilities nearby.

tours.name: Valley Ski Project (Intermediate)
tours.description: Kids who’ve mastered the small slope can sharpen their skiing skills over five fun weeks with friendly instructors, building confidence and making new friends in a supportive group environment.

tours.name: Divas Drag Brunch
tours.description: Experience a fabulous Drag Brunch at Bar Pop Manchester! Enjoy 3 hours of glitz and glamour with Viva La Diva and her show team, featuring delicious food, bottomless drinks, engaging games, and thrilling drag cabaret. It's a unique celebration filled with fun, laughter, and unforgettable memories!

tours.name: Inspiring Bankside Women
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Bankside, uncovering the remarkable stories of influential women like Octavia Hill and Mary Wollstonecraft. Explore charming backstreets and secret gardens, revealing hidden plaques and details that celebrate both renowned figures and unsung heroines. This enlightening walk begins at Southwark Station and concludes at Southwark Cathedral.

tours.name: St James's Trailblazers
tours.description: Discover the hidden stories of remarkable women in St James’s, a historic area known for its exclusive Gentlemen’s Clubs. This engaging 90-minute walk highlights the contributions of actresses, politicians, and trailblazers who defied conventions. Starting at the Goddess Diana statue, explore the legacies of those who shaped history.

tours.name: Return train travel (Carvery Express)
tours.description: Enjoy a delicious carvery meal on a scenic steam train ride through the Dales, with fresh meats, hearty sides, and a choice of drinks. Perfect for a special treat or Father’s Day celebration.

tours.name: Pizza and Targets
tours.description: Enjoy a 2-hour indoor adventure with stone-baked pizza, then master archery, axe throwing, and air rifles in a fun, competitive session guided by expert instructors—perfect rain or shine!

tours.name: Tour Fuori Londra: Stonehenge e Cotswolds
tours.description: Join a 9-hour guided tour from London to explore England’s wonders. Visit the mysterious Stonehenge with an expert guide, then wander through the charming Cotswolds villages like Bourton-on-the-Water. Enjoy scenic countryside, rich history, and picturesque landscapes, all in a comfortable bus trip filled with captivating stories and unforgettable sights.

tours.name: Charming day trip to Cambridge
tours.description: Experience a unique 10-hour adventure that emphasizes authenticity and professionalism. With strict booking policies in place, this activity ensures a secure and respectful environment. Engage in a memorable journey where your full legal name is essential, adding an intriguing layer to the experience.

tours.name: The Brickworks Murder Mystery
tours.description: Uncover dark secrets at Bursledon Brickworks in an immersive murder mystery. Interrogate suspects, piece clues together, and solve the crime before time runs out—tea and coffee await your final deduction.

tours.name: Spaced Out
tours.description: Join an exhilarating 60-minute adventure where you and your team must rescue a stranded alien from a secret government facility. Outsmart scientists, restore the alien's systems, and save his life before time runs out. Prove your heroism in this thrilling race against the clock!

tours.name: Oxford Walking Tour - 2 Tours In 1
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s iconic sites and hidden Harry Potter secrets with a magician guide performing illusions and creating magical spells. A fun, lively tour perfect for families and history lovers alike.

tours.name: Cannibal Cabin
tours.description: Trapped in an eerie cabin, you and your friends must race against time to escape before a cannibal returns. Solve puzzles and crack codes in this thrilling adventure that tests your bravery and teamwork. Can you outsmart the legend and make it out alive? Book your escape now!

tours.name: Custom Private Experience (with an expert local guide)
tours.description: Maximize your time in London with a personalized tour. Visit landmarks like Buckingham Palace or explore hidden alleys, quirky shops, and vibrant neighborhoods—all tailored to your interests by a local expert.

tours.name: London Music Free Walking Tour
tours.description: Discover London’s vibrant music history on a unique free walking tour that takes you to iconic spots like Tin Pan Alley, where Elton John and Adele made their mark. Visit legendary venues, including the rooftop of The Beatles' final performance and Trident Studios, where Queen recorded. Experience the essence of British music!

tours.name: Fishing Trip
tours.description: Catch your own fish amid North Yorkshire’s rugged cliffs, then savor your fresh catch or enjoy classic fish & chips by the harbor. A thrilling, memorable sea adventure with expert guidance awaits.

tours.name: Escape From Aurora
tours.description: Escape a failing space station in this immersive VR adventure. Solve puzzles, restore systems, and work as a team to unlock your escape before time runs out. Perfect for sci-fi fans and group challenges.

tours.name: Murder at the Manor
tours.description: Join Torchlight Mysteries for an immersive Murder Mystery at the enigmatic Wymering Manor. As you investigate alongside curious guests, interrogate suspects, and uncover dark secrets, your sleuthing skills will be put to the test. Piece together clues and solve the mystery before enjoying tea and coffee in this captivating experience.

tours.name: Bespoke Coached SUP Session
tours.description: Experience a personalized stand-up paddleboarding session tailored to your unique goals and skill level. With one-on-one coaching from a Level 3 PaddleUK SUP coach, you'll refine your technique, boost your confidence, and learn essential skills in a supportive environment. Customize your journey and paddle at your own pace!

tours.name: SeaPig Tiny Yacht Adventures
tours.description: Sail Windermere on Seapig, a stable electric yacht, and learn to steer, hoist sails, and feel the wind. Enjoy a scenic bay picnic, family-friendly tasks, and inclusive features in this hands-on lake adventure.

tours.name: Weymouth & Portland Sightseeing
tours.description: Set sail on a 2.5-hour cruise around Portland Harbour, with stunning cliffs, a working port, and possibly Weymouth Bay views. Enjoy swimming, tea, and scenic beauty in a relaxed, picturesque setting.

tours.name: Evening - Wildlife & Sea Cave Kayak Tour
tours.description: Paddle at sunset from Oddicombe Beach into Babbacombe Bay, spotting seals and dolphins in South Devon’s stunning Geopark. Warm jackets provided, bring snacks, and enjoy a memorable evening on the water.

tours.name: Private Llangollen Whitewater SUP Lesson
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 3-hour private whitewater SUP lesson on the stunning River Deen in Llangollen. Perfect for all skill levels, you'll receive expert coaching while navigating grade 2 rapids and surfing standing waves. All necessary equipment is provided, ensuring a memorable adventure on the water awaits you!

tours.name: Whitewater Kayaking Springboard Course
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 5-day whitewater kayaking course designed for beginners and semi-experienced paddlers. Under expert guidance, you'll master essential skills like boat control and safety while exploring stunning river locations. Connect with fellow enthusiasts, receive personalized coaching, and leave with a clear action plan for your kayaking journey ahead.

tours.name: The Enigma of the Kray Twins - 8k running tour
tours.description: Race through East London’s gritty streets, uncovering the Kray twins’ dark past. Guided storytelling, iconic landmarks, and a finish-line snack make this 8k run a thrilling blend of history and urban adventure.

tours.name: Brixton Private Food Experience: Markets, Culture & Flavours
tours.description: Explore Brixton’s vibrant streets on a 2.5-hour private food tour, sampling Caribbean, South American, and global flavors. Hear local stories, enjoy tastings, and experience the neighborhood’s rich culture firsthand.

tours.name: Kayak - 6 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience tranquility at the Wherry Cut, a serene spot perfect for wildlife watching and immersing yourself in nature. Paddle to the Hoveton Great Broad Nature Trail, where you can explore the untouched beauty of Broadland, stretch your legs, and connect with the wilderness in a truly memorable way.

tours.name: Camping Pod
tours.description: Bring your camping gear and essentials—this rustic hut has no furniture, so pack everything you need for a cozy outdoor stay, just without the tent.

tours.name: 2 Hour Junior Indoor Sports Dome Party
tours.description: Kids can unleash energy with thrilling activities like Nerf battles, bubble football, and giant inflatables in our lively Sports Dome. Perfect for up to 20 children seeking fun, laughter, and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: 90 Minute Adult Indoor Sports Dome Party
tours.description: Jump into a lively Sports Dome for an hour of thrilling activities like Nerf battles, Bubble Football, or Archery Tag, led by energetic entertainers. Perfect for up to 20 kids seeking fun and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Package • Archery & Axe Throwing • Non-residents • Wild Boar Estate, Windermere
tours.description: Experience 1.5 hours of thrilling fun with our Axe Throwing & Archery package! Unleash your inner Viking as you throw axes, then embrace your inner Robin Hood with archery. This unique adventure promises laughter and excitement, making it a memorable outing for everyone, whether you're a sharpshooter or just enjoying the challenge!

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Death by Chocolate
tours.description: Solve a nutty murder mystery on a scenic Yorkshire Dales train, enjoying a 3-course meal. Question suspects, examine clues, and uncover the truth in this 3.5-hour interactive adventure.

tours.name: School Interactive Videos
tours.description: Explore the fascinating world of the Tudors with our interactive educational video resources. Perfect for schools, this unique experience brings history to life, engaging students in an unforgettable learning journey. Book now through our website and unlock a treasure trove of Tudor knowledge for your classroom!

tours.name: Incredible Indonesian Rendang @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create authentic Indonesian rendang with spice-pounded beef or mushrooms, zingy salads, fluffy rice, and fresh garnishes. Hands-on class ends with you enjoying your flavorful feast at the chef’s table.

tours.name: South Indian prawn curry @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create a vibrant South Indian feast by making your own curry paste, zesty chutney, and fluffy rice. Enjoy a hands-on 1.5-hour class, then savor your spicy prawn curry at the chef’s table with a glass of bubbly.

tours.name: Women in the National Gallery
tours.description: Uncover the hidden stories of nine female artists at London's National Gallery. Marvel at Artemisia Gentileschi’s drama and Rachel Ruysch’s intricate flowers in a 90-minute tour full of inspiring tales and stunning art.

tours.name: Crafty Brunch: Handpainted Tote Bags
tours.description: Join our Crafty Brunches for a delightful morning of creativity! Learn a new skill while crafting alongside fellow artists. Enjoy all necessary materials, expert guidance, and a complimentary hot drink and pastry to fuel your inspiration. Create a beautiful piece to take home and cherish!

tours.name: Saturday Skirmish
tours.description: Join thrilling skirmish battles every other Saturday, testing your skills across various game modes. Doors open at 11am, with a quick briefing at noon—prepare for an action-packed day of fun and competition.

tours.name: Surf Rats - Community
tours.description: Join a supportive surfing community where all skill levels are welcome! Meet at the vibrant "Board Games" van, enjoy a safety briefing, and hit the waves for 2-3 hours of fun. Embrace the silliness, share tips, and ride together on any craft—it's all about enjoying the surf and each other!

tours.name: Pilgrims Crossings to Holy island
tours.description: Walk barefoot across tidal sands to Holy Island, tracing St. Cuthbert’s footsteps. Enjoy birdlife, seals singing, and a peaceful arrival, ending with coffee or a pub visit—an unforgettable, immersive journey into history and nature.

tours.name: Kayak & Pub (4hr) - Guided
tours.description: Glide along Leicestershire’s waterways for 4 hours, then pause at a cozy riverside pub for food and drinks. A relaxing, scenic kayak trip that combines nature’s beauty with a friendly pub stop.

tours.name: Kayak Introduction (1hr) - Guided
tours.description: Paddle through Leicestershire’s scenic waterways on a 1-hour self-guided kayak trip. Ideal for all skill levels, it’s a refreshing escape to nature and outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Kayak Exploration (2hr) - Guided
tours.description: Paddle through Leicestershire’s scenic waterways on a 2-hour self-guided kayak trip. Explore tranquil waters, enjoy peaceful nature, and set your own pace for a relaxing outdoor escape.

tours.name: Kayak & Glamp (2 Night) - Public
tours.description: Experience a rejuvenating 2-night Kayak and Glamp escape, where you’ll paddle through the serene Leicestershire waterways before unwinding in a charming riverside cabin. Embrace off-grid comfort and immerse yourself in nature, making this getaway a unique blend of adventure and tranquility.

tours.name: Large Capacity VR Escape Rooms - Southbank
tours.description: Join a large-capacity VR escape room for 40-45 minutes of immersive fun. Choose from prison breaks, haunted mansions, shrinking adventures, or space missions—all with wire-free, 360-degree VR for teams of 2-8 players.

tours.name: Large Capacity VR Escape Rooms - Aldgate
tours.description: Join a large-capacity VR escape room for 40-45 minutes of immersive fun. Choose from prison break, horror, quirky adventure, or sci-fi missions, all with wireless, 360-degree VR using lightweight, high-res headsets.

tours.name: The British Christmas Special Cooking Class
tours.description: Cook four festive dishes in a cozy London home, then enjoy a hearty Christmas dinner while uncovering their rich stories. An authentic, family-like experience blending food, history, and holiday cheer.

tours.name: Kayaking Safari - Saul Junction
tours.description: Glide along peaceful canals at Saul Junction, spotting kingfishers and swans. Perfect for beginners, this 1.5-hour kayaking safari offers a relaxing outdoor escape, with stunning scenery and nearby cafes to enjoy afterward.

tours.name: The Air Rifle Experience
tours.description: Test your focus and precision with expert guidance at the shooting range. Hit exciting targets, improve your aim, and enjoy a safe, fun experience perfect for all skill levels and group adventures.

tours.name: The Bushcraft Experience
tours.description: Master survival skills like fire-making, shelter-building, and foraging in a fun, hands-on outdoor adventure led by expert instructors. Build confidence and connect with nature in a safe, exciting environment.

tours.name: The Caving Experience
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 4-hour adventure in the enchanting cave systems of the Yorkshire Dales. Guided by expert instructors, this journey caters to all skill levels, allowing you to uncover breathtaking underground formations and navigate fascinating passages, making each exploration uniquely memorable. Embrace the excitement of the subterranean world!

tours.name: Sunset BBQ on the Bay
tours.description: Sail along Dorset’s Jurassic Coast for a 3-hour sunset BBQ cruise. Enjoy fresh grilled food, stunning sea views, and vibrant sunset colors—perfect for relaxing, sharing laughs, and making summer memories.

tours.name: Champion's Package
tours.description: Join our thrilling monthly airsoft challenge where you can test your skills and race against the clock! Compete in a high-stakes game mode for a chance to top the leaderboard. The best player will win an exclusive Tokyo Marui Desert Eagle - Black. Don't miss out on this exciting experience!

tours.name: Ubisoft Escape Games
tours.description: Step into immersive Ubisoft escape rooms where teamwork turns you into a hero, tackling daring challenges in a safe, virtual world. Choose from three thrilling adventures and boost your team spirit.

tours.name: Copeland Distillery X Le Contour Candles
tours.description: Join us for a unique Candle Painting Workshop at Copeland Distillery on August 15th! Unleash your creativity as you personalize your own candle with expert guidance. Enjoy a cozy atmosphere, sip on a complimentary cocktail, and immerse yourself in local craft. Limited spaces available—reserve your spot and ignite your artistic flair!

tours.name: River Tweed Descent
tours.description: Paddle five days along the scenic River Tweed, passing historic towns and lush landscapes. Camp wild or stay in cozy hotels, with support van carrying your gear—making this adventure easy, scenic, and unforgettable.

tours.name: The Lagg Whisky Tour and Tasting
tours.description: Sip on award-winning single malts while soaking in stunning views of Ailsa Craig and the Firth of Clyde. Dive into the world of whisky making through an immersive tour filled with sights, sounds, and flavors.

tours.name: Axe Throwing
tours.description: Unleash your inner warrior with military-style axe throwing at Armourgeddon. Sharpen your aim, test your nerve, and compete for bragging rights in this adrenaline-pumping, beginner-friendly adventure.

tours.name: The Spirits of Salisbury Tour
tours.description: Explore Salisbury’s haunted streets at dusk, uncovering tales of witchcraft, plague graves, and dark secrets. Enjoy stops at atmospheric pubs and immerse yourself in the city’s mysterious, shadowy history.

tours.name: Day Cruise
tours.description: Sail aboard the historic Wherry Albion, a classic 1898 trader, and enjoy close-up wildlife views on the scenic Broads. Join the crew or relax on deck—your adventure, your choice.

tours.name: Christmas Festive Picnic Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Bridgewater Canal on a cozy, heated boat with lunch, drinks, and scenic views. Enjoy prosecco, beer, or wine, plus sweet treats, all while cruising from Top Locks to Preston Brook and back.

tours.name: Return train travel (Peter Rabbit™)
tours.description: Hop aboard a steam train to meet Chase, Marshall, and Peter Rabbit, enjoy photos, snacks, and seasonal fun. A charming family adventure blending heritage railways with beloved characters and Easter festivities.

tours.name: Ultimate Agave Spirits Session with the Founder
tours.description: Join a private tasting with Jon, founder of The Sin Gusano Project, in his home. Savor rare Mezcals, hear captivating stories, and explore unique spirits tailored to your curiosity and palate.

tours.name: Bloc Bouldering Club (5 - 11 yrs)
tours.description: Bloc Bouldering Club (5 - 11 yrs)

tours.name: Golf DofE Residential
tours.description: Play on a stunning championship course, stay in luxury, and boost your golf skills with expert coaching. Enjoy themed dinners, fun competitions, and relax in spa and gym facilities—perfect for growth and confidence.

tours.name: Seafood Meal onboard Rib
tours.description: Savor a locally prepared seafood feast onboard, featuring lobster rolls, crab quiche, and more. Cruise past seals at Blakeney Point or Scolt Head Island, then relax in Blakeney or Brancaster Harbour—your choice.

tours.name: Natural History Museum Private Experience: Highlights with Expert Guide
tours.description: Explore London's Natural History Museum with a private guide, marvel at Hope the blue whale, Sophie the dinosaur, and ancient fossils. Enjoy a personalized, engaging journey through science and discovery at your own pace.

tours.name: London – Private Tour: Westminster Abbey, Big Ben & Buckingham Palace
tours.description: Skip the lines and dive into royal history at Westminster Abbey with a VIP tour. Explore tombs, Poets’ Corner, and iconic sights like Big Ben and Buckingham Palace on a family-friendly adventure in central London.

tours.name: Kids and Families Quiet and Calm SEND supportive canoe Session
tours.description: Enjoy a gentle, supportive water experience with quiet reflection, collaborative games, and sensory exploration—perfect for kids and families to connect, relax, and have fun in a safe, inclusive setting.

tours.name: 250 - Fossil Handling Sessions
tours.description: Uncover 150-million-year-old secrets by handling real Jurassic fossils like ammonites and belemnites. Feel the ancient history come alive as you explore the remnants of prehistoric sea creatures.

tours.name: GENNARO CONTALDO: HIDDEN ITALY A masterclass of Italy’s lost recipes
tours.description: Uncover Italy’s hidden culinary treasures with Gennaro Contaldo. Recreate forgotten recipes rooted in charming towns and scenic landscapes, bringing Italy’s rich food traditions back to life in your kitchen.

tours.name: Tour por el Southbank
tours.description: Explore London's rich history from St. Paul’s Cathedral to Tower Bridge, passing historic markets, medieval ruins, modern gardens, and iconic landmarks, revealing how the city evolved along the Thames in 2.5 hours.

tours.name: Discovery Adventure
tours.description: Set sail on a five-hour wildlife adventure with small groups, spotting seals, dolphins, seabirds, and more. Explore offshore habitats, enjoy better views, and learn about marine conservation on this immersive voyage.

tours.name: Torbay Airshow
tours.description: Enjoy front-row seats to Torbay's stunning airshow from a anchored boat. Relax with refreshments, soak in breathtaking aerial displays, and watch the spectacle unfold right over the bay. Bring a picnic and make it a day to remember.

tours.name: Discover The New Forest in Spring
tours.description: Stroll through the ancient New Forest, uncovering its rich history, unique wildlife, and local traditions. At a gentle pace, connect with nature and learn how conservation shapes this stunning landscape.

tours.name: Stonehenge Private Tour from London with an AI Guide
tours.description: Travel in style from London to Stonehenge in a luxury car, then explore with an AI archaeologist. Enjoy personalized insights, freedom to roam, and skip the crowds at this iconic prehistoric site.

tours.name: Taster Sessions
tours.description: Paddle through calm waters at Ballintoy Harbour in a fun 30-minute session. Perfect for beginners and families, enjoy stunning coastal views while learning basic kayaking skills in a safe, sheltered setting.

tours.name: Exmoor Dark Sky Festival Event
tours.description: Gaze at the stars under Exmoor’s dark sky, explore planets through telescopes, and learn from expert astronomers. Enjoy laser-guided sky explanations, virtual sky views, and a VR space talk for an unforgettable night.

tours.name: Birds and Breakfast on the Bay Cruise
tours.description: Set sail along Weymouth Bay for 2.5 hours of birdwatching and marine life sightings, all while enjoying a tasty breakfast and stunning Jurassic Coast views. Perfect for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.

tours.name: Sunrise Yoga and Sound Healing Cruise
tours.description: Rise with the sun on Weymouth Bay, flowing through gentle yoga on deck, then drift into deep relaxation with a soothing sound bath. Enjoy a healthy breakfast as the sea and sky inspire calm and connection.

tours.name: Adult Event Packages
tours.description: Enjoy a mix of fun and competitive activities like FootGolf, DiscGolf, Dodgeball, and FootDarts on scenic courses. For bigger thrills, try Bubble Football, Inflatable Land, or Glow Sports for high-energy team fun.

tours.name: The Ultimate GelBlaster Party
tours.description: Join a neon-lit GelBlaster battle inside Norwich’s glow-in-the-dark arena. Feel the rush of fast-paced, safe laser tag-style fun with glowing Gellets, plus pizza, drinks, and a stress-free party experience for all ages.

tours.name: Volunteer Week Open House
tours.description: Step inside Newcastle’s historic castle during our free Volunteer Open House. Meet staff, enjoy refreshments, explore the keep, and discover how you can help bring the city’s rich history to life.

tours.name: 24th, 25th & 26th July | Nottingham Pride Felt Badge
tours.description: Create a vibrant rainbow pride badge using colorful felt and embroidery threads, celebrating self-expression and community in a fun, hands-on craft that’s perfect for showing off your unique identity.

tours.name: Tour to the Westminster Abbey and the Houses of the Parliament
tours.description: Explore London's iconic landmarks with a guided tour of Westminster Abbey, Parliament, and Big Ben. Uncover their history, architecture, and secrets in just 4 memorable hours.

tours.name: Cream Tea Cruise
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful 3-hour experience featuring freshly made fruit scones served with whipped cream, strawberry jam, and butter. Enjoy a charming atmosphere while sipping on tea and coffee, making this a perfect treat for anyone looking to savor a unique and memorable culinary experience.

tours.name: Chocolate Factory Talk & Tasting
tours.description: Uncover the secrets of craft chocolate with a guided bean-to-bar tour, taste rich cacao flavors, and relax with a free hot drink at Leah's Yard café—an indulgent journey from bean to bar in Sheffield.

tours.name: Leeds Castle, Canterbury and White Cliffs of Dover
tours.description: Experience the enchanting Leeds Castle, renowned as 'The loveliest castle in the world,' with its fairytale towers and stunning gardens. Explore the medieval charm of Canterbury, marvel at its Gothic cathedral, and witness the iconic white cliffs of Dover. This unforgettable journey blends history, beauty, and family fun in one remarkable day.

tours.name: White Water Kayaking Taster
tours.description: Enjoy a fun 90-minute white water kayaking session on beginner-friendly sit-on-top boats, starting on calm waters before tackling exciting rapids, waves, and playful splashes—perfect for thrill-seekers of all levels.

tours.name: Target Sports 90 Minute Combo Session
tours.description: Test your skills with indoor archery, axe throwing, and air rifle shooting. Learn new techniques, compete in fun games, and improve your aim—all in a weather-proof, exciting environment perfect for all ages.

tours.name: Target Sports Half Day Combo Session
tours.description: Test your skills with indoor archery, axe throwing, and air rifles in a fun, weather-proof setting. Spend an hour on each, improve your aim, and enjoy friendly competitions under expert guidance.

tours.name: Gorge Walking
tours.description: Dive into North Wales' stunning gorges with thrilling slides, jumps, and waterfall abseils. Feel the cool water, conquer huge boulders, and enjoy an unforgettable adventure tailored for all ages.

tours.name: Rock Climbing and Abseiling Half Day
tours.description: Conquer real rock with expert guidance in a thrilling 3-hour outdoor climbing session. Learn to belay, tackle diverse routes, and boost your confidence—perfect for beginners or those transitioning from indoor walls.

tours.name: Free London Landmarks Tour (West)
tours.description: Explore the royal and political heart of London on a captivating Free Walking Tour of Westminster. Discover iconic landmarks like Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and Westminster Abbey, all while immersing yourself in the rich history of the area. This unforgettable experience is a must for any visitor to London!

tours.name: Meet the Donkeys
tours.description: Experience the charm of our playful miniature Mediterranean donkeys, the stars of our farm! Engage with these inquisitive animals as they entertain you with their antics and enjoy your company. Watch as they learn to walk on a lead and lift their hooves, making for a delightful and memorable visit.

tours.name: Children's Beginner Session
tours.description: Learn to ride offroad motorbikes on quiet trails with electric bikes perfect for beginners. Suitable for kids 4+, family-friendly, safe, and fun—no experience needed. All gear provided, just bring sturdy shoes!

tours.name: BattleZone Special OPS - Baileys Hard
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Battlezone, a 2-hour outdoor adventure tailored for ages 14 and up. Engage in tactical combat games using realistic, infrared gaming guns in a forest setting. Perfect for friends and groups, this action-packed experience combines strategy, competition, and unforgettable fun without the mess of traditional paintball.

tours.name: Air Raid Shelter + St. Nicholas Market Walking Tour
tours.description: Uncover Bristol’s hidden history with exclusive access to underground tunnels, WWII shelters, and legendary music rooms. Walk through vibrant markets, meet a friendly ghost, and enjoy local eats and gifts.

tours.name: Airsoft rental only - Half Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of airsoft at Ambush Airsoft, where both seasoned players and newcomers can enjoy unique facilities like covered seating, flushing toilets, and custom maps. Engage in strategic gameplay in natural woodlands, where honesty is key, and prepare for an adrenaline-pumping adventure that’s more intense than paintball!

tours.name: Simply The Best of The Cotswolds Private Car Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 10-hour journey through the enchanting Cotswolds, England's hidden gem. Explore iconic villages like Bibury and Bourton-on-the-Water, savor local delights, and soak in breathtaking landscapes of rolling hills. With customizable options and convenient London pick-up, this experience promises unforgettable memories in the heart of the countryside.

tours.name: Custom Paddling Tour
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic River Thames, spotting wildlife and hearing local stories. Choose from kayak, SUP, or canoe, and enjoy a tailored, fun-filled water adventure suitable for all ages and skill levels.

tours.name: Whitewater Body Boating Taster
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Body-boating on the River Dee, an exclusive adventure that combines excitement and safety. Navigate iconic rapids like Tombstones, Ski Slope, and Factory Falls from a unique perspective on a full-length bodyboard. This 90-minute session promises unforgettable moments on the water!

tours.name: Whitewater Body Boating (Half day)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Body-boating on the River Dee, an exclusive 3-hour adventure that takes you through exhilarating rapids and surfing waves. Guided by experts, you'll navigate from the mighty serpent’s tail to the Mile End Mill, making unforgettable memories in this unique and exciting water sport.

tours.name: An Introduction To Indian Cookery @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Learn to cook authentic Indian dishes in 5 hours, from spicy curries and fluffy naan to crispy bhajis and fragrant rice. Enjoy your homemade feast with a mango lassi and gain recipes to recreate the magic at home.

tours.name: BattleZone: The Great Grinchmas Heist
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-hour adventure to save Christmas from the Grinch! Families will team up in a festive outdoor BattleZone, using high-tech infrared guns for action-packed missions. Experience the excitement of combat games with a holiday twist, creating unforgettable memories while staying active in the winter wonderland.

tours.name: Rock Climbing and Abseiling Full Day
tours.description: Conquer North Wales limestone with a full day of climbing, knot-tying, and system setup. Feel the thrill of real rock as you build skills and confidence on stunning natural cliffs.

tours.name: Divas Drag Cabaret
tours.description: Enjoy a lively Saturday night with drag, singing, dancing, and comedy. Choose your package for reserved seats, drinks, and VIP access, making your 4-hour adult-only cabaret unforgettable.

tours.name: Social Paddle Boarding - Kingston 🏄🏻‍♂️🏄‍♀️
tours.description: Join a lively 2-hour evening paddle from Kingston’s The Boaters Inn. Bring your board, buoyancy aid, and sense of adventure. Paddle where the group decides, enjoy the water, and meet fellow paddlers in a fun, social setting.

tours.name: Kittywake Mothers Day Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate Mother’s Day with a 2-hour cruise, delicious food, and creative pottery painting. Relax, laugh, and make memories while enjoying treats, drinks, and a hands-on craft to take home or gift.

tours.name: WAKA WAKA BINGO
tours.description: Experience the most entertaining Bingo night in town, featuring vibrant drag performances and fun spot prize games. This unique event combines the classic game with a lively, camp atmosphere, ensuring a memorable evening filled with laughter and excitement. Grab your bingo tickets and get ready for a night of fabulous fun!

tours.name: Day pass
tours.description: Enjoy all-day access to Parc Glynllifon’s beautiful, accessible grounds. No queues, free parking, and dogs on leads welcome. Explore at your own pace and soak in the scenic, family-friendly surroundings.

tours.name: The Shap Mountaineer
tours.description: Travel back 2,000 years in Carlisle’s historic streets, from Hadrian’s Wall to stunning castles and museums. Enjoy scenic train rides with steam-powered engines, luxurious dining, and breathtaking views on the Settle & Carlisle line.

tours.name: Meet the Mini Moos
tours.description: Meet Europe's tiniest, friendliest cows up close! Feed, pet, groom, and even give them a cute hairstyle. Enjoy cuddles and playful mooing in a fun farm experience that’s perfect for animal lovers.

tours.name: Island Kayak Trail
tours.description: Adults & Children (8+) | 1 Hour

tours.description: Embark on a scenic 5-6 hour paddle from Henley to Marlow, gliding through the charming town and along the iconic Royal Regatta Course. Experience the beauty of the Thames as it widens, with stunning views of Hurley and Bisham. A memorable adventure awaits on this picturesque waterway!

tours.name: 4 Night Surf Camp
tours.description: Ride the waves with five days of lessons, video tips, and free surf sessions, all hosted at our exclusive camp. After surfing, unwind with BBQs, pond dips, and campfires—unforgettable fun awaits!

tours.name: Punchy Peruvian Ceviche @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Learn to make vibrant Peruvian ceviche with fresh sea bass or courgette, zesty marinade, glazed camote, and caramelized choclo al comino. Hands-on 2-hour class, delicious feast, recipe pack, all ingredients provided.

tours.name: Diesel Driving Experience
tours.description: Take the controls of historic diesel locomotives like TIC No.35 or Reyrolles No.2 in this thrilling 30-minute experience. Feel the power beneath your hands as expert guides teach you the basics of locomotive operation. Perfect for train lovers and curious adventurers—reserve your spot now for an unforgettable ride.

tours.name: Adrenaline Rush
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling virtual reality adventure where you can choose from a diverse selection of immersive experiences upon arrival. With options for all ages and group sizes, our friendly team is ready to help you find the perfect adventure. Dive into a world of excitement and unforgettable memories!

tours.name: Historic Houses & Grand Gardens in Spring (Private)
tours.description: Explore England’s spring gardens with vibrant blooms, woodland walks, and hidden gems. Visit a historic estate, enjoy a charming pub lunch, and uncover floral wonders on a memorable, guided day from Bath.

tours.name: Historic Houses & Grand Gardens in Spring (Shared)
tours.description: Explore England’s stunning spring gardens, blooming with bluebells, magnolias, and daffodils. Wander charming villages, scenic countryside, historic barns, and quaint shops on a 7.5-hour adventure full of beauty and surprises.

tours.name: IPT Merchandise & ADD ONS
tours.description: Enhance your experience at Inch Perfect Trials by taking home a memorable keepsake from your day of learning to ride trials. tours.name: Morning Tea Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a serene Morning Tea Cruise along Cornwall’s stunning rivers, where you’ll savor a delightful afternoon tea with prosecco. Enjoy breathtaking views of iconic landmarks and the chance to spot local wildlife, all from the comfort of a fully heated boat. It’s the perfect way to start your day!

tours.name: Evening Drinks Cruise
tours.description: Set sail at sunset on a cozy, heated boat along Cornwall’s tranquil rivers. Sip local gins and prosecco, nibble on a pasty, and enjoy stunning views of castles, lighthouses, and wildlife in a relaxing, scenic cruise.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Moulin Rouge
tours.description: Solve a murder mystery on a scenic Yorkshire Dales train, with clues, suspects, and a 3-course meal. Uncover secrets behind the Moulin Rouge’s glittering façade in this thrilling 3.5-hour interactive adventure.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - And then there were nun
tours.description: Unravel a murder mystery aboard a scenic train through the Yorkshire Dales, solving clues and questioning suspects while enjoying a delicious 3-course meal. Can you catch the killer before they strike again?

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Mystery at Bludgeonton Manor
tours.description: Unravel a Regency murder mystery aboard a scenic train through the Yorkshire Dales, solving clues while enjoying a delicious 3-course meal. Can you catch the killer before the final curtain falls?

tours.name: La Porte Ariel Archery
tours.description: Experience the thrill of clay pigeon style archery at Back 2 Bear, one of the few places in the UK offering this unique activity. Challenge your skills in a fun and competitive environment, where precision and focus are key. It's an unforgettable adventure that promises excitement for everyone!

tours.name: Brilliant Bao @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create soft, fluffy bao buns from scratch, fill them with spicy Kung Pao chicken or mushrooms, and enjoy your handmade feast at the chef’s table. All ingredients and expert guidance included.

tours.name: Cheese Club Tasting at Errington's Barn
tours.description: Join Errington's Barn Cheese Club each month for seasonal tastings, expert insights, and local pairings. Savor unique cheeses, learn their stories, and enjoy a warm, community-focused celebration of land, craft, and flavor.

tours.name: Team-Sport - Zorb Football

Join a public session for an exciting opportunity to meet new players and enjoy a memorable day filled with laughter and friendly competition.

tours.name: ABBA TOUR
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable afternoon in Glasgow aboard a vintage red sightseeing bus. Indulge in a delightful afternoon tea featuring homemade scones, savory treats, and a glass of fizz, all while enjoying a scenic journey through the city. Perfect for special occasions or a unique gift, this tour promises lasting memories.

tours.name: Self Drive Picnic Boat Hire - 9 Seater
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure with our fully-equipped boat, featuring buoyancy aids for safety, a gas burner and grill for delicious meals, and an onboard toilet and sink for convenience. Enjoy the sliding canopy roof for protection from the elements while you create unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: PickleBall
tours.description: Experience the excitement of Pickleball on our four courts, where this engaging sport blends elements of badminton, tennis, and ping pong. Perfect for socializing, it fosters community and camaraderie while providing a fun escape from routine. Join us for an unforgettable time filled with laughter and new friendships!

tours.name: Islington Tunnel Public Tour • Round trip from Kings Cross via Islington Tunnel • 45 Minutes
tours.description: Sail through London's historic canals on a skippered boat, passing landmarks like St Pancras and the Victorian Ice Well. Enter the 200-year-old Islington Tunnel for a rare, underground adventure before returning to Kings Cross.

tours.name: Family Kayaking - Saul Junction
tours.description: Glide along calm canals and rivers in a fun, family-friendly kayak session. Learn paddling skills through games and challenges, all with expert guidance—perfect for a relaxing day immersed in nature.

tours.name: The Cove Pool
tours.description: Relax in your private oasis with a welcome cocktail, flavorful mezze, and free towel rental—perfect for an intimate escape with friends or loved ones.

tours.name: The Founder's Tour & Tasting
tours.description: Uncover the secrets of craft spirits at Wharf Distillery, where traditional methods and local ingredients create award-winning gin, vodka, and more. Tour the stills, learn the stories, and toast to your new favorite drink.

tours.name: Whaly 500 Rental
tours.description: Experience a day of fun on the water with our stable and safe boats, powered by an 8HP engine. Featuring a user-friendly steering console and ample space, these boats are perfect for family outings, ensuring memorable adventures and relaxation for everyone on board.

tours.name: Diamond DA40 • 45-minutes Flight Experience / Trial Lesson
tours.description: Soar over Norfolk’s stunning coast and countryside in a sleek Diamond DA40. After a quick intro, take the controls and feel the thrill of flying with breathtaking views all around.

tours.name: Canal Boat Experience Day
