Learn essential boating skills, from handling locks to tying knots, and enjoy the option of an overnight stay aboard. Discover the joys of canal cruising in a stunning setting.

tours.name: Murder Mystery - Mile High Murder
tours.description: Solve a murder on a starship or train while enjoying a delicious 3-course meal. Interrogate suspects, uncover clues, and crack the case in a thrilling 3.5-hour adventure through scenic Yorkshire or aboard a historic train.

tours.name: Countess of Bridgewater Private Charter 2026
tours.description: Celebrate your special day aboard a luxurious canal boat for up to 50 guests. Enjoy gourmet dining, customizable menus, onboard music, and festive decorations in a cozy, heated setting—perfect for unforgettable moments on the water.

tours.name: Festive Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate the season on a festive two-hour cruise along the Jurassic Coast. Enjoy twinkling lights, warm mulled wine, and a mince pie as you take in stunning seascapes in a cozy, joyful holiday setting.

tours.name: Full Day Charter
tours.description: Sail aboard the historic Wherry Albion, a classic 1898 trader, and enjoy close-up wildlife views on the Broads. Join the crew or relax on deck—your adventure, your pace, with changing destinations based on tides and weather.

tours.name: Private Gin Tasting
tours.description: Sip on locally crafted spirits with friendly distillers in a relaxed, beautiful setting—perfect for gin lovers seeking an informal, fun, and informative tasting at Bristol’s top-rated distillery.

tours.name: The Twelve Bricks of Christmas – A Festive Escape at the Brickworks Museum
tours.description: Uncover a hidden Christmas treasure at the UK’s last Victorian brickworks. Search among twelve ceremonial bricks, solve festive puzzles, and make holiday history in this immersive industrial heritage adventure.

tours.name: GWTF Winter Series Race 3 - (18 Jan) Burghfield
tours.description: Kick off your year with a scenic 10km run around a stunning lake, perfect for all levels. Refine your technique, enjoy refreshments, and set the pace for upcoming races in a beautiful winter setting.

tours.name: Junior
tours.description: Join thrilling motorcycle track days suitable for all skill levels, guided by racing legends. Feel the adrenaline from 7am, with safety briefings and your first ride by 9am—an unforgettable racing experience awaits.

tours.name: 50% Discount Gift Voucher for ALL Experiences
tours.description: Get double the fun with a voucher worth twice its value at Rugby or Gatwick. Valid for 12 months, this deal lets you enjoy an unforgettable experience whenever you choose within a year.

tours.name: Sunset Firework & BBQ Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Jurassic Coast at sunset on Coastal Vibes, enjoy a tasty BBQ, live music, and relax with family or friends. End with dazzling fireworks lighting up the sky—an unforgettable summer evening on the water.

tours.name: Cream Tea on the Sea Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Jurassic Coast for 2.5 hours, savoring homemade cream tea and stunning sea views. Relax on comfortable decks, snap breathtaking photos, and toast with drinks—an unforgettable coastal escape.

tours.name: Bottomless Karaoke Brunch
tours.description: Sing your heart out on a moving stage, cruising past iconic landmarks with endless drinks and delicious bites. Unleash your inner star in this lively, unforgettable karaoke brunch adventure.

tours.name: Father's Day Brunch Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate Dad with a 2.5-hour Jurassic Coast cruise, savoring a tasty brunch and a free drink. Relax on deck, soak in stunning views, and create unforgettable memories together.

tours.name: Summer Solstice Sunset Cruise
tours.description: Sail into the sunset along the Jurassic Coast, sipping Sunset Punch as live acoustic melodies fill the air. Relax, enjoy light bites, and soak up breathtaking views on this unforgettable summer solstice cruise.

tours.name: ⁠WaterPark Sisters Only
tours.description: Enjoy two exclusive hours at Waterworld just for sisters, with private access to all rides and slides in a safe, respectful setting. Perfect for a fun, private waterpark experience with trained staff on hand.

tours.name: Prosecco Cruise
tours.description: Float along Bath’s scenic River Avon on a stylish launch, passing historic sights and the iconic Pulteney Weir. Sip crisp Prosecco, enjoy relaxed conversation, and celebrate in one of England’s most beautiful cities.

tours.name: RAF Beaulieu History Walk (Part 1 of 2) – The Living Area
tours.description: Walk through history at Roundhill Campsite, once home to 2,000 wartime personnel. Historian Marc Heighway reveals stories and remains of over 300 buildings from WWII, bringing the past vividly to life.

tours.name: Seafood Festival Launch Party
tours.description: Set sail on a lively 3-hour cruise along the Jurassic Coast, with sunset views, live music, fresh seafood, and flowing drinks—kicking off Weymouth’s Seafood Festival with energy, stunning scenery, and great company.

tours.name: Seafood Festival - Sunset Sax Sundays
tours.description: Celebrate the Weymouth Seafood Festival with a 3-hour sunset cruise, live sax beats, stunning Jurassic Coast views, a welcome drink, and delicious food—ending the weekend in unforgettable style.

tours.name: Stonehenge Private Tour from London with an AI Guide new
tours.description: Travel from London in style to the mysterious Stonehenge, where a personal guide and interactive AI reveal its secrets. Enjoy a private, flexible tour of this prehistoric wonder and its fascinating visitor center.

tours.name: Flamborough Head Coastal Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the coast to Flamborough Head, passing Sewerby and Danes Dyke. Marvel at cliffs and the lighthouse from a rare vantage point, offering breathtaking views away from the crowds.

tours.name: Family Bushcraft
tours.description: Join a 90-minute guided kayak or canoe tour on the scenic Beaulieu River, perfect for families. Paddle, spot wildlife, and create lasting memories in a safe, fun outdoor adventure suitable for all ages.

tours.name: TREK Marlin E-bike SMALL
tours.description: Cycle along stunning North Yorkshire coast and moorlands, riding the historic Cinder Track to Whitby or Ravenscar, or explore hidden paths across wild, open moorland for a thrilling outdoor escape.

tours.name: Ebrius™ Glasgow Pub Crawl
tours.description: Join Glasgow’s Ebrius Pub Crawl for five hours of lively bars, free shots, exclusive discounts, and VIP club access. Meet new friends, enjoy party games, and dive into the city’s legendary nightlife.

tours.name: Trame Storiche: Chiesa dei Templari e Wallace Collection
tours.description: Explore London's rich history in 3.5 hours: visit Temple Church, stroll historic alleys, see the Victorian Court of Justice, stop at Twinings' 300-year-old shop, and discover the Museum of London near St. Paul’s Cathedral.

tours.name: Museo di Storia Naturale e Kensington Gardens
tours.description: Explore London's top museums, stroll through Hyde Park, see Kensington Palace, and enjoy art, history, and nature—all in 3.5 hours perfect for families and art lovers alike.

tours.name: La Passeggiata del Millennio
tours.description: Explore London's rich history and vibrant art scene in 3.5 hours: from the Tower of London and Tower Bridge to Tate Modern and St. Paul’s Cathedral, with stunning views, markets, and cultural insights all in one unforgettable tour.

tours.name: Westminster e National Gallery
tours.description: Join a 3.5-hour walk from Big Ben to Trafalgar Square, exploring iconic landmarks like Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, and the National Gallery’s masterpieces. Perfect for all ages, with easy access and stunning sights.

tours.name: Private Lessons
tours.description: Boost your surfing skills with a personalized 1.5-hour lesson, tailored to your level. Enjoy free surfboard and wetsuit hire, plus half a day of practice—perfect for all ages and skill levels.

tours.name: Paddle Boarding
tours.description: Join a 1.5-hour surf lesson with expert coaches who tailor the session to your skill level. Enjoy free gear, stunning views, and a relaxed vibe—perfect for fun, progress, and catching your first wave.

tours.name: Coasteering
tours.description: Join a thrilling coastal adventure near Whitsand Bay, featuring rock formations, wildlife, and daring challenges like a 35ft free-fall or exploring submerged caves—perfect for families and groups seeking excitement.

tours.name: London Film Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 2-hour journey through iconic film locations, guided by a hero who reveals the secrets of pop culture. Explore where Bridget Jones found love, Alfie's escapades, and cinematic landmarks from James Bond to Harry Potter. Experience the thrill of movie magic in the heart of the city!

tours.name: British Museum e Camden Town
tours.description: Explore London's treasures with a guided British Museum tour, then wander Camden's vibrant Stables Market and stroll along Regent's Canal to Primrose Hill for stunning city views.

tours.name: 1hr - Sunset Sail Around Portland Harbour
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of a sunset sail at Portland Harbour with Moonfleet Adventure Sailing. In just one hour, immerse yourself in the thrill of tall-ship sailing, whether you want to actively participate or simply relax and enjoy the stunning views. No experience needed—just come and embrace the adventure!

tours.name: 4x4 Private Tour of Salisbury Plain Highlights
tours.description: Embark on a unique 2-hour adventure through the Larkhill range area of Salisbury Plain, exploring stunning archaeology, rich history, and diverse wildlife. Enjoy photography opportunities and a delightful picnic, all while discovering iconic sites like Stonehenge and the Wiltshire White Horses. Tailor your experience to create unforgettable family memories!

tours.name: Minehead Bike Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of exploring Minehead and its stunning surroundings on a mountain bike! With easy access to scenic cycle paths, you can visit charming villages and beautiful beaches or tackle the hills for breathtaking views of the Bristol Channel and Exmoor National Park. Perfect for all ages!

tours.name: Morning Trip
tours.description: Glide across Ullswater's stunning waters, passing islands, bays, and beaches. Feel the breeze and soak in breathtaking scenery on this peaceful morning paddle suitable for teens and adventurers alike.

tours.name: Lyme to West Bay - Water Taxi
tours.description: Hop on a stylish RIB cruise from West Bay or Lyme Regis for just £17. Enjoy a scenic boat ride and explore a new town in one hour—perfect for a hassle-free day trip with stunning coastline views.

tours.name: Summer Evenings Pay & Play
tours.description: Experience the thrill of summer evenings with our Pay & Play sessions! From 6pm to 8pm, enjoy discounted rates on canoes, kayaks, and paddleboards while soaking up the evening sun. Perfect for friends and family, this is an unforgettable way to make the most of your summer nights!

tours.name: Kids Spooky Halloween Tour and Meal
tours.description: Join Count Duck’u’la for a 45-minute spooky tour filled with eerie stories, creepy decorations, and a ghoulish goodie bag. Enjoy a free drink and a two-course meal at The Royal Windsor—perfect for little monsters and grown-ups alike.

tours.name: London Cocktail Tour - Soho
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable evening exploring four of London’s top cocktail bars, guided by renowned cocktail expert Susan L. Schwartz. Savor unique, handcrafted cocktails paired with delightful nibbles, while learning the fascinating history behind each bar. Meet talented bartenders and enjoy a vibrant atmosphere filled with fun and excitement.

tours.name: Adults Spooky Halloween Tour and Meal
tours.description: Uncover Windsor’s haunted past on a 45-minute spooky tour, then indulge in chilling tales and delicious fang-tastic food. Meet at The Royal Windsor, enjoy a free drink, and prepare for a night full of scares and flavor.

tours.name: Glasgow Whisky Tour Experience
tours.description: Experience Glasgow like never before on a vintage London Bus whisky tour! Begin at Glengoyne Distillery with a captivating three-part tour and blind tasting. Enjoy a delightful trio of Scottish tapas paired with expertly selected whiskies, all while learning about Scotch from our knowledgeable guide, Camilo. A truly memorable adventure awaits!

tours.name: Stand-up Paddleboarding - Porlock Bay Marshland Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding through the unique flooded marshlands of Porlock Bay, accessible only during spring tides. Guided by qualified instructors, this 2.5-hour adventure offers wildlife encounters and scenic channels. Perfect for those with prior SUP experience, it promises an unforgettable exploration of nature's beauty.

tours.name: Ocean Skills Paddle Clinic
tours.description: Join our Ocean Paddle Skills Clinic for an exhilarating 2-day experience that enhances your Stand Up Paddleboarding skills in the open ocean. Master rough water techniques, refine your stroke with video analysis, and enjoy guided paddles while assessing conditions. Perfect your skills and make unforgettable memories on the water!

tours.name: Meet-A-Paca
tours.description: Experience a delightful 45-minute adventure with alpacas, perfect for the whole family! Engage in an informative talk from an expert, hand-feed these charming creatures, and capture memorable selfies. This unique opportunity allows everyone, including young children, to connect with these woolly friends in a fun and educational setting.

tours.name: Bespoke Oxford Walking Tour with a private Green or Blue Badge Guide
tours.description: Experience Oxford like never before on a private walking tour tailored just for your group. Explore iconic landmarks such as the Bodleian Library and the Sheldonian Theatre, while delving into the rich history of the prestigious university. Enjoy an intimate atmosphere and personalized service, making your visit truly memorable.

tours.name: Canoe Hire - Half Day
tours.description: Experience the stunning Llangollen Canal on a half-day canoe adventure! Suitable for all ages and skill levels, this unique journey includes a paddle across the iconic UNESCO Pontcysyllte Aqueduct. With stable canoes and a friendly atmosphere, it's the perfect outing for families and even your furry friends!

tours.name: Archery
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery in a unique indoor setting, where you can shoot at traditional targets or even fend off a zombie attack! With a stunning view of Castel Dinas Bran, this 30-minute session combines safety, skill, and creativity, allowing pre-arranged groups to bring their own images to shoot.

tours.name: Single Kayak Hire - Quick Cruise
tours.description: Experience the thrill of independent kayaking at Shepperton Marina! Enjoy two hours of exploration on a wildlife-rich river, where you can choose your own route or follow recommended paths. Bring a picnic and capture memories while navigating the serene waters, making it a perfect escape from everyday stress.

tours.name: Single Kayak Hire - Mini Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of independent kayaking at Shepperton Marina! Enjoy four hours of exploring wildlife-rich rivers at your own pace. With recommended routes and the freedom to choose your adventure, it's the perfect escape from daily stress. Bring a picnic and capture unforgettable moments on the water!

tours.name: Tandem Kayak Hire - Quick Cruise
tours.description: Experience the thrill of independent kayaking at Shepperton Marina! Rent a tandem kayak for two hours and explore the scenic, wildlife-rich river at your own pace. With optional maps and the freedom to choose your route, this adventure promises relaxation and unforgettable memories amidst nature's beauty.

tours.name: Tandem Kayak Hire - Mini Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of independent exploration with a tandem kayak hire at Shepperton Marina. Paddle through scenic, wildlife-rich rivers at your own pace, with recommended routes to guide your adventure. Perfect for stress relief, this unique outing invites you to connect with nature while enjoying a leisurely day on the water.

tours.name: Tandem Open Canoe Hire - Quick Cruise
tours.description: Experience the freedom of independent canoeing at Shepperton Marina! Paddle through scenic, wildlife-rich rivers on your own adventure. With open canoe hire, you can explore recommended routes or chart your own course. Bring a picnic and enjoy a refreshing escape from the everyday hustle in a beautiful natural setting.

tours.name: Tandem Open Canoe Hire - Mini Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of independent canoeing at Shepperton Marina! Enjoy four hours of exploring wildlife-rich rivers at your own pace. With an open canoe, paddles, and buoyancy aids included, you can create your own adventure. Don’t forget to bring a picnic and capture memorable moments along the way!

tours.name: Wetsuit Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of summer water activities with our wetsuit hire at the seafront centre, right across from Minehead beach! With a variety of sizes for all ages, you can dive into adventure and enjoy the ocean comfortably. Choose your collection time and make unforgettable memories this season!

tours.name: The Ghost Hunt of York
tours.description: Step into York’s haunted streets with a lively ghost tour that blends spooky stories, hilarious pranks, and stunning medieval scenery—an unforgettable evening of fun, fright, and laughter.

tours.name: Dreamcatcher, 30 minutes trips around the New Quay Bay
tours.description: Set sail on The Dreamcatcher for a 30-minute tour around New Quay Bay, where friendly crew share local legends, marine history, and conservation stories amid stunning coastal views.

tours.name: First Class Return Travel With Fish & Chips
tours.description: Travel through the Yorkshire Dales on a steam train while savoring award-winning Fish & Chips or vegetarian lasagna, with stunning views, live music, and first-class service—an unforgettable dining adventure.

tours.name: An Alpaca Walk..'Just The Walk'
tours.description: Experience a delightful 30-minute alpaca walk, perfect for those familiar with these gentle creatures. Enjoy at least 20 minutes of walking alongside your alpaca, creating memorable moments. This unique opportunity allows you to bond with these charming animals in a serene setting, making it an unforgettable outing for all.

tours.name: The Alpaca Meet and Greet. 'Alpaca Meander and Babe Watch'
tours.description: Discover the charm of alpacas in a delightful one-hour experience! Stroll through the paddocks, learn about their care, and enjoy a close encounter with these gentle creatures. Capture memorable photos while ensuring a peaceful environment—just leave your dogs at home. Join us for an unforgettable day on the farm!

tours.name: E-bike Night Ride
tours.description: Ride through Exmoor’s dark skies on a guided night e-bike tour, climbing moorlands and descending trails illuminated by powerful lights. Perfect for confident riders seeking adventure under the stars.

tours.name: St Ives Pirate Walk
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 75-minute pirate adventure filled with captivating tales, lessons in "the Code," and interactive pirate-speak. Perfect for families and adventurers alike, this lively experience encourages dressing up and audience participation, ensuring a memorable journey of laughter and swashbuckling fun on the high seas!

tours.name: The Way of Lost Souls
tours.description: Experience a unique blend of comedy and tragedy with a 90-minute black and white film shot in stunning Cornish locations. Featuring the legendary Pola Negri, this captivating story of a prostitute, a lighthouse keeper, and a murderer sparked local riots during filming. Includes a fascinating documentary about Negri.

tours.name: St Ives Storywalk
tours.description: Discover the rich tapestry of St Ives through its captivating stories with storyteller Shanty. In this 75-minute outdoor experience, you'll explore the town's history, folklore, and customs, bringing its vibrant past to life. Join in for an unforgettable journey filled with humor, tragedy, and the essence of St Ives.

tours.name: Cornish Folklore Storywalk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating storywalk through St Ives, where enchanting tales of witches, giants, and mermaids come to life. Discover the rich tapestry of Cornish folklore and learn about the legendary William Bottrell, all while enjoying the beauty of the outdoors. Bring your enthusiasm for an unforgettable experience!

tours.name: How to Survive a Cornish Horror Film
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 90-minute journey through 24 Cornish horror films, expertly reimagined by Shanty Baba into a humorous survival guide. With a mix of laughter and chills, you'll learn how to navigate the terrifying tales from "Plague of the Zombies" to "Straw Dogs." Survive the night with wit and humor!

tours.name: By Word of Mouth
tours.description: Experience the magic of storytelling in a captivating 60-minute performance. Shanty weaves together a diverse tapestry of tales, from Cornish folklore to Greek myths and Celtic legends, exploring the enchanting and darker sides of classic narratives. Bring your enthusiasm and prepare to be transported into a world of imagination.

tours.name: 1001 Arabian nights
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 75-minute journey through the enchanting world of storytelling. Discover the origins and influence of timeless tales, including the renowned translation by Capt Sir Richard Burton. This unique experience blends storytelling with film and animation, offering an adult twist on classic narratives that will leave you spellbound.

tours.name: That blackguard Burton!
tours.description: Experience an engaging 60-minute illustrated talk with Shanty, exploring the fascinating life of Captain Sir Richard Francis Bacon. Discover the intriguing stories behind his translations of 1001 Arabian Nights and the Kama Sutra, all while navigating the captivating themes and imagery of this Victorian icon's remarkable journey.

tours.name: Paper theatre "Cornish Horror"
tours.description: Experience the enchanting world of Miniature Victorian Paper Theatre, a unique form of puppetry that allows you to recreate classic plays at home. With its charming paper cut-out figures and delightful special effects, this quirky activity offers a nostalgic glimpse into 19th-century entertainment, making it a truly memorable experience.

tours.name: Kama Sutra Show
tours.description: Embark on a 60-minute comedic journey with Captain Sir Richard Burton, the iconic figure behind the sexual revolution. This unique parody blends animation, film, and a spoof lecture, offering a humorous exploration of erotic literature. Prepare for laughter and surprises, but don’t forget your smelling salts!

tours.name: Crusades, Muslims, and City of London
tours.description: Embark on a unique 5-hour guided tour through London, exploring 20 captivating locations. Discover the rich history of the Temple Church, St. Paul's Cathedral, and the city's first coffee shop, while learning from esteemed historians. Experience the intriguing connections between London and the Crusades, all from expert guides.

tours.name: London Night Taxi Panoramic Tour
tours.description: Experience the magic of London at night on a unique two-hour tour in a traditional black taxi with a panoramic roof. Enjoy breathtaking views of iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge, while uncovering fascinating stories about the city's rich Muslim heritage. Perfect for unforgettable memories and stunning photos!

tours.name: Ertugrual, Ottomans and Britain
tours.description: Join us for an engaging exploration of the Ottoman Empire's rise and its lasting impact on history. Led by expert speakers Dr. Stef Keris and Brother Abu Musa, this event delves into the revival of Muslim heroes and the misconceptions surrounding their legacy. Discover the hidden Islamic heritage that shaped our world.

tours.name: Sightseeing Cruise
tours.description: Experience the stunning sights of London on a one-hour River Thames sightseeing cruise. Glide past iconic landmarks like Big Ben and the London Eye aboard all-weather boats, with cafes onboard for refreshments. Enjoy live or recorded commentary as you soak in the best views from four central piers.

tours.name: Eid Buffet Brunch Cruise Experience
tours.description: Experience the unique Eid Cruise 2022 on the Thames, featuring a delightful halal buffet and stunning 360-degree views of London's iconic landmarks. Celebrate with friends and family aboard a luxurious three-deck boat, enjoy a welcome drink, and take part in prayers on the open deck for a memorable Sunday brunch.

tours.name: Staple Island Tour
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Farne Islands on a 2.5-hour adventure that combines stunning boat views with an hour of exploration on the islands themselves. Discover unique wildlife, rich history, and the striking volcanic rock formations while guided by knowledgeable skippers. An unforgettable journey into nature awaits!

tours.name: 1 to 1 Session
tours.description: Kids as young as 4 can safely learn to ride offroad electric bikes on quiet tracks. With adjustable power and expert guidance, beginners gain confidence while having fun on noise-free, easy-to-handle bikes.

tours.name: Heritage Centre Admission
tours.description: Explore a rich history at the Blue Town Heritage Centre, home to artifacts, memorabilia, and the restored Criterion Music Hall. Discover fascinating stories, enjoy a relaxing cream tea, and walk through centuries of local entertainment.

tours.name: One-Hour Cruise with Driver
tours.description: Sail the Thames on the historic MV Olympic, a 1968 police launch. In just one hour, enjoy stunning views, relax with loved ones, and get a true feel for the river—perfect for small groups and special moments.

tours.name: Half-Day Cruise with Driver
tours.description: Sail the Thames on the historic MV Olympic, a versatile half-day cruise for up to 10. Customize your route through scenic countryside, perfect for relaxing with family, friends, or colleagues in a peaceful river setting.

tours.name: All-Day Cruise with Driver
tours.description: Sail the Thames on the MV Olympic, a vintage police launch, for a personalized 8-hour cruise. Perfect for small groups to relax, explore scenic spots like Henley and Hambleden, and create unforgettable memories afloat.

tours.name: Self-Drive 4 Seater
tours.description: Set sail on a self-driven boat along the scenic Thames near Henley. Relax, explore at your own pace, and enjoy quality time with loved ones on this flexible, fun-filled adventure.

tours.name: Self-Drive 6 Seater
tours.description: Set sail on a self-drive boat along the scenic Thames near Henley. Relax, explore at your own pace, and enjoy stunning countryside views with friends or family on a flexible 2-10 hour adventure.

tours.name: Lundy Island SUP Tours
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding around Lundy Island, a stunning granite outcrop in the UK's first marine conservation area. Explore pristine beaches, caves, and vibrant marine life, all while soaking in breathtaking views. Enjoy a relaxing sail, a packed lunch, and an unforgettable adventure in nature's paradise.

tours.name: SUP Experience
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding in a fun and safe environment! In just 1.5 hours, you'll learn essential paddling techniques and be standing confidently on the board. With expert guidance and small group sizes, this unforgettable adventure will leave you eager for more on the water.

tours.name: SUP Harbourside Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling stand-up paddleboarding adventure with SUP Bristol, exploring the historic waterways of Bristol Floating Harbour. Over two hours, learn essential paddling techniques and safety skills while enjoying stunning views from the water. Experience personalized instruction in small groups, making this a unique and memorable outing.

tours.name: Private SUP Adventure
tours.description: Experience Bristol like never before with a private paddleboarding session through the historic Floating Harbour. Perfect for parties or special occasions, you'll learn essential paddling techniques while enjoying stunning views. Tailor your adventure to your preferences, and benefit from expert guidance and safety briefings for a memorable outing on the water.

tours.name: Family SUP Adventure
tours.description: Experience a thrilling family day out with a personalized stand-up paddleboarding session in Bristol! Enjoy 1.5 hours of fun-filled activities, learning essential skills while boosting your kids' confidence in the water. With expert guidance, safety briefings, and all necessary equipment provided, create unforgettable memories together on the water.

tours.name: SUP Fundamentals
tours.description: Join our engaging SUP Fundamentals course to gain the confidence and skills needed for independent paddling adventures. Over four weeks, experienced instructors will guide you through essential techniques, safety practices, and trip planning. Perfect for those ready to elevate their paddleboarding experience while exploring with friends and family in a supportive environment.

tours.name: SUP Sea Skills
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-day SUP touring course designed to enhance your paddling skills for coastal exploration. Over six hours, you'll master tidal navigation, beach launching, and paddling in challenging conditions, all while building confidence to safely navigate Britain's stunning coastline. Perfect for those ready to elevate their SUP experience!

tours.name: Pembrokeshire SUP Weekend
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable weekend of coastal paddleboarding and camping in Pembrokeshire Coast National Park. Explore breathtaking cliffs and pristine beaches while encountering marine wildlife. Enjoy a clifftop BBQ under the stars or cozy up in a local pub, all while surrounded by great company and stunning natural beauty.

tours.name: Aqueduct adventure
tours.description: Embark on a memorable 6-mile paddle along the stunning Kennet and Avon canal, navigating between two picturesque aqueducts. Perfect for beginners, this adventure offers guided group options or independent exploration. Enjoy breathtaking scenery and a delightful lunch stop, ensuring a fun-filled day for everyone involved.

tours.name: Discover the Coast - Bantham
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable one-day paddleboarding adventure along Britain’s stunning coastline. Glide through the picturesque estuary of South Devon, savoring breathtaking views of Burgh Island and Bigbury-on-Sea. With expert guidance and tidal assistance, this unique experience combines natural beauty, thrilling currents, and a delightful lunch break on the banks.

tours.name: Splatmaster Party
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable kids' paintball party at Warzone! Tailored for ages 8 and up, this 2.5-hour adventure includes top-notch gear, expert supervision, and exciting games. Parents can relax while kids enjoy thrilling action and delicious catering options, ensuring a day filled with laughter, excitement, and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Discover the Coast- Salcombe
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 12-hour paddleboarding adventure along Britain's stunning coastline! Starting in Kingsbridge, glide through a vibrant estuary teeming with wildlife, including seals and dolphins. Enjoy a picnic in secluded coves before experiencing the excitement of coastal paddling, culminating on the beautiful sandy beaches of Salcombe.

tours.name: Hire A Day With Our Glassblower
tours.description: Create your own glass masterpiece in a full-day workshop with master glassblowers. Handle the heat, learn the craft, and craft a unique piece in a vibrant, hands-on setting. Perfect for ages 16 and up.

tours.name: Hire A Half of A Day With Our Glassblower
tours.description: Create your own glass masterpiece in a half-day session with master glassblowers. Make a bauble, paperweight, or decorative piece using vibrant colors—an unforgettable hands-on experience. Ages 16+ only.

tours.name: Paintball Party
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 3-hour adventure designed for ages 12 and up! Enjoy spacious safe zones equipped with modern amenities, including snack shops, flushing toilets, and comfortable seating. With complimentary tea and coffee available all day, this unique blend of excitement and comfort makes for an unforgettable outing.

tours.name: Kayak Taster Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of kayaking in our one-hour taster lesson, perfect for ages 8 and up. Learn essential skills like equipment handling, basic controls, and safety tips in a fun, supportive environment. Whether a beginner or looking to refine your skills, this session offers a memorable introduction to the sport.

tours.name: Paddle Start Award
tours.description: Embark on a 3-hour kayaking adventure with the Paddle Start Award, perfect for beginners and those looking to enhance their skills. Learn essential techniques, safety tips, and explore the stunning Christchurch Harbour. With expert guidance from a qualified coach, gain confidence and prepare for thrilling kayaking experiences ahead.

tours.name: Paddle Discover or Explore Awards
tours.description: Experience the thrill of kayaking at Christchurch Harbour, where you can enhance your skills with the Paddle Discover and Explore Awards. Under expert guidance, learn to make confident choices on the water, from basic techniques to advanced maneuvers. This unique opportunity caters to all ages, ensuring a memorable adventure for everyone.

tours.name: Kayak Tours: Mudeford Quay to Christchurch Priory
tours.description: Embark on a serene 2-hour kayaking adventure across Christchurch Harbour, where stunning views and diverse wildlife await. Guided by a BCU qualified instructor, paddle to the historic Priory, explore Christchurch Quay, and spot rare birds, horses, and cows. No experience needed—just bring your spirit of adventure!

tours.name: Raft Building Sessions
tours.description: Experience the thrill of teamwork in a unique raft-building challenge! Gather your group on a picturesque deserted land, where you'll design and construct a raft using barrels, logs, and ropes. Test your creation on the serene waters of Christchurch Harbour, ensuring it withstands the ultimate test of buoyancy and teamwork.

tours.name: Windsurf Taster Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of windsurfing with a one-hour taster lesson at ShoreSports! Suitable for ages 8 and up, our expert instructors use the latest equipment to ensure you’re up and riding in no time. Just bring your towel and swimwear; we provide everything else for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Beginner Windsurfing Courses - 2 Part Beginner Windsurfing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of windsurfing with our two-part course, perfect for ages 8 and up. Over four hours, you'll learn essential skills like tacking and gybing, alongside safety tips. Enjoy the flexibility of scheduling your sessions and dive into an unforgettable adventure on the water with provided wetsuits and buoyancy aids.

tours.name: Beginner Windsurfing Courses -  2 days/ 4 x 2hours
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating two-day journey with the Start Windsurfing Course! Led by RYA qualified instructors, you'll master essential skills like rigging and sailing techniques. With all equipment provided, just bring your trunks and towel for an unforgettable introduction to the thrilling world of windsurfing.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddle-Boarding Taster Session
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding in just one hour! Our SUP Taster Lesson introduces you to this exciting sport in a safe environment, covering essential techniques and safety tips. You'll even have the chance to try different boards and paddles, helping you find the perfect fit for your paddling adventure.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddle-Boarding Tours : Mudeford Quay to Christchurch Priory
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding on a scenic 3-hour tour from Mudeford Quay to Christchurch Priory. Paddle across the harbor and up the picturesque River Avon, surrounded by stunning views and the camaraderie of fellow adventurers. It's the perfect way to embrace the sport and nature together!

tours.name: Self-Drive 6+ Seater Deluxe (skipper can be supplied)
tours.description: Set sail on the Thames in a self-drive boat, exploring scenic countryside with friends or family. Choose your route, enjoy the freedom, and create unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddle-Boarding Tours: Poole to Wareham
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding on a scenic 3-hour tour along the Wareham channel and the picturesque river Frome. Explore the charming town of Wareham, savor lunch at the Old Granary, and enjoy a leisurely paddle back, making unforgettable memories with fellow adventurers.

tours.name: Sailing Taster Lessons
tours.description: Try sailing in just one hour! Join a small group, learn to steer and feel the wind, all with expert guidance. Wetsuits and buoyancy aids included—no experience needed. Book your adventure today!

tours.name: Learn2sail
tours.description: Learn to sail with expert guidance, mastering turns and sail control in just two days. Build confidence, earn a Level 2 certificate, and enjoy all gear included—perfect for ages 8 and up.

tours.name: Sailing to Improver Racing Techniques
tours.description: Elevate your sailing skills with our improver courses, designed to solidify your knowledge and prepare you for independent sailing. Choose between 2 or 4-day options, and enjoy the included wetsuits and buoyancy aids. Take the next step towards owning your own boat and sailing confidently on your own!

tours.name: Lets Get Out of Here!
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddle boarding with our exclusive three-session package! Join us on consecutive Saturdays for a fun introduction to SUP, where you'll learn essential skills and tips. Book all three sessions in advance and enjoy a free session—perfect for first-time or novice paddlers eager to explore the water!

tours.name: Kayak Tours: Poole Harbour Round the Islands
tours.description: Embark on a unique 2.5 to 3-hour paddle from Lake Pier at Hamworthy, exploring the hidden gems of Poole Harbour. Encounter rare birds, wild deer, and a charming family of common seals as you navigate through this stunning natural landscape, typically inaccessible to most.

tours.name: Bridgwater Adventure Club! (summer term 5.30 - 7pm)
tours.description: Join the Bridgwater Adventure Club for an exciting summer of outdoor fun! Designed for children aged 8-13, this not-for-profit club offers thrilling activities like watersports and campfires. With a focus on adventure and environmental awareness, it's a perfect opportunity for young adventurers to explore and connect with nature.

tours.name: Archery - The Ancient Noble Sport
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery at Craufurdland, where you can step back in time amidst stunning woodland and the majestic Craufurdland Castle. Perfect for beginners, our fun taster sessions teach you the basics of shooting a bow. Celebrate with friends by booking an unforgettable archery party!

tours.name: Portland Bill Cruise
tours.description: Journey along 18 miles of Portland’s rugged coast, passing castles, secret coves, and Portland Bill. Keep an eye out for playful seals and dolphins on this 90-minute adventure into history and wildlife.

tours.name: Family SUP Fundamental Skills Course
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddling together as a family with our new SUP Fundamentals course! Gain essential skills in personal paddling, safety, and rescue techniques. Leave empowered to choose safe paddling spots and navigate various conditions, ensuring unforgettable adventures while keeping your loved ones safe on the water.

tours.name: Beer and Spirit Runs
tours.description: Explore Canterbury’s historic streets on a 5km guided tour, then savor local craft beers or gins at the Foundry brew pub and distillery. Uncover secrets and enjoy a flavorful, memorable experience in just one hour.

tours.name: Seafest SUP History Tour
tours.description: Celebrate the Royal William Yard's 200th anniversary with a unique stand-up paddleboarding adventure! Explore Plymouth Sound's hidden treasures while enjoying a guided history tour. Parents can unwind with a warm beverage and shop for delicious, home-reared produce, making it a delightful outing for all.

tours.name: PicTours Edinburgh

tours.name: Half Day Hire
tours.description: Explore the scenic Oxford canal near Thrupp with family or pets. Paddle for 4 hours, enjoy provided gear, and soak in peaceful waters—perfect for adventure seekers aged 12 and up.

tours.name: Full Day Hire
tours.description: Paddle all day to scenic Kirtlington Quarry or historic Oxford, with family and pets welcome. Enjoy provided gear, stunning views, and a fun adventure suitable for experienced paddlers and beginners alike.

tours.description: Swing into the ultimate indoor golf experience with high-def simulators, global courses, and a lively bar. Perfect for honing your skills, socializing, or hosting private events—gear included, just bring your game.

tours.name: Trackman 2 hour session
tours.description: Swing into the ultimate indoor golf experience with high-def simulators, global courses, and a lively bar. Perfect for practice, fun rounds, or private events—everything you need is included.

tours.name: Trackman 3 hour session

tours.name: High Definition 1 hour session

tours.name: High Definition 2 hour session

tours.name: High Definition 3 hour session
tours.description: Play top courses indoors with friends or practice your swing in Holywood’s premier golf lounge. Enjoy HD simulators, a bar, and entertainment—perfect for fun, games, or private events. All gear included.

tours.description: Join the Silver Surfers for 1.5 hours of fun in the sea, trying surfing, paddleboarding, or kayaking. Small groups, personalized lessons, and a friendly vibe make it perfect for ages 40 to 78. No experience needed!

tours.name: BSUPA Level 1 Ready to Ride
tours.description: Join the BSUPA Level 1 “Ready to Ride” course for an exhilarating introduction to stand up paddling! Over two hours, a qualified instructor will teach you essential techniques, safety tips, and paddling skills in a fun, supportive environment. Complete the course and earn your BSUPA Level 1 certificate!

tours.name: Happisburgh Lighthouse Open Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of climbing 112 steps to the top of the UK's only independently operated working lighthouse. Enjoy a guided tour that delves into its rich history while taking in breathtaking views of the Norfolk coast. This unique adventure offers an unforgettable glimpse into maritime heritage.

tours.name: BSUPA Ready to Tour Level 2
tours.description: Master touring with this 6-hour Level 2 course, gaining skills to explore confidently, plan adventures, and enjoy the water like a pro. Perfect for those ready to take their paddling to the next level.

tours.name: London: Downton Abbey Private Tour, including entry to Highclere Cogges Farm and Bampton Village
tours.description: Join a full-day tour visiting iconic Downton Abbey filming locations: Cogges Manor Farm, Bampton village, and Highclere Castle. Explore the sets, learn behind-the-scenes secrets, and immerse yourself in the world of the beloved series.

tours.name: London: Private Tour to Stonehenge and Highclere Castle
tours.description: Visit Stonehenge’s ancient stones and Highclere Castle’s grand halls in one day. Explore prehistoric mysteries, walk through Downton Abbey’s iconic rooms, and uncover Egypt’s secrets—all with your own private guide.

tours.name: Master Craft Chocolate Experience
tours.description: Visit Ireland’s first bean-to-bar chocolate factory for an 85-minute tour. Watch the craft, taste global cacao flavors, and see how pure, ethical chocolate is made in a scenic seaside setting.

tours.name: Zoo Keeper Experience
tours.description: Get hands-on with meerkats, tortoises, and monkeys during a 1-hour behind-the-scenes tour with a zoo keeper, plus unlimited access to Plantasia’s animal wonderland.

tours.name: Coasteering
tours.description: Experience the thrill of coasteering along the breathtaking North Devon Coast at Baggy Point. This 2.5-hour adventure invites strong swimmers to explore hidden caves and rugged crevices, making it an unforgettable journey for adrenaline seekers. Gear up with provided wetsuits and safety equipment for an exhilarating day by the sea.

tours.name: Outdoor Climbing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of outdoor climbing at the stunning Valley of the Rocks on the Exmoor Coastline. Under expert guidance, you'll learn essential skills like belaying and climbing on real rock formations. No prior experience is necessary, making it a perfect adventure for everyone seeking excitement in nature!

tours.name: Bouldering Taster
tours.description: Experience the thrill of indoor climbing at North Devon's largest climbing and bouldering centre! Join a daily taster session led by qualified instructors, perfect for beginners. With all equipment provided, just come in comfortable clothing and get ready to conquer the walls in a safe and supportive environment.

tours.name: Olympic Climbing Taster - Special Offer!
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Olympic climbing in a unique 1.5-hour session at Rock and Rapid Adventure Centre. Learn the basics of Top Rope climbing, compete in a Speed Climbing challenge, and unleash your energy in the Bouldering area, all under the guidance of qualified instructors. Perfect for ages 6 and up!

tours.name: Monday Fun Day!
tours.description: Join our family fun session for an unforgettable day of adventure on the water! Enjoy two hours of paddling, games, and relaxation in nature, guided by a qualified instructor. Create lasting memories, challenge your kids, and earn the Paddle Start Award while disconnecting from screens and connecting with each other.

tours.name: Youth Climbing Club
tours.description: Join our Kids Club for an exciting 1.5-hour climbing experience that follows the NICAS scheme! Perfect for ages 7 and up, this program enhances climbing skills, teamwork, and safety awareness while providing a structured path for personal achievement and future climbing adventures. Enjoy expert guidance and all necessary safety equipment!

tours.name: Squad Coaching
tours.description: Join our exclusive Youth Squad, designed for kids eager to climb competitively! With specialized training sessions led by fully qualified instructors, your child will master essential climbing techniques in a supportive environment. Experience top-notch coaching and elevate their skills to new heights in North Devon's premier kids' climbing program.

tours.name: Wingsurf Introductory Lesson
tours.description: Experience the exhilarating sport of winging in this 2-hour introductory lesson! With just a wing and a board, you'll learn to fly and control the wing, mastering techniques for power and direction. Our expert instructors ensure a fun and informative experience, perfect for both seasoned watersports lovers and newcomers alike.

tours.name: WingFoil Lesson
tours.description: Experience the exhilarating new sport of winging with two engaging lessons! Perfect for both seasoned watersports lovers and beginners, you'll learn to fly and control a wing, master techniques on high flotation boards, and discover essential rescue skills. Join us for a fun and informative introduction to this thrilling activity!

tours.name: Firework Special
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable firework evening in Weymouth every Monday in August aboard our boats. Enjoy an up-close view of the dazzling display while savoring drinks and snacks. Arrive early and dress appropriately for a unique night filled with excitement and stunning visuals on the water.

Plus, the birthday child receives a special gift, making this adventure truly unforgettable!

tours.name: Mixed Skate
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a two-hour skatepark session, welcoming all ages and abilities on skateboards, scooters, and BMXs. Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere, with an onsite café offering refreshments and great views. Equipment rentals are available, ensuring everyone can join in on the fun and excitement of skating!

tours.name: 6 Week NICAS Level 1 Course
tours.description: Join the NICAS Level 1 Course and embark on an exciting journey into the world of climbing! Over six engaging lessons, you'll learn essential skills for safe climbing, teamwork, and risk management, all while preparing for the next levels. Experience personal growth and discover the thrilling challenges that await in climbing!

tours.name: Cruise trip to Greenwich
tours.description: Embark on a delightful cruise from Westminster to Greenwich, featuring stunning views and a visit to the Greenwich Maritime Museum. Enjoy a leisurely day with family and friends, complete with a panoramic hilltop view of London, an Islamic reminder, and the option to bring your own food and games.

tours.name: Corporate Virtual Chocolate Challenge
tours.description: Create fun, tasty chocolate truffles with your team in a lively online workshop. Receive a kit, learn pro techniques, and compete for prizes—all from your kitchen. Perfect for bonding and boosting spirits remotely.

tours.name: Bristol Charity Santa SUP
tours.description: Join us for the annual Santa SUP, a festive paddle on the water where dressing up is a must! Enjoy a fun-filled day supporting Caring at Christmas, complete with warm drinks at a local pub afterward. Bring your own craft or rent one, and make unforgettable holiday memories on the water!

tours.name: Dollar Hunt
tours.description: Compete in adrenaline-pumping activities like quad biking, archery, and off-road driving. Form teams, earn dollars, and battle for victory in a thrilling, social adventure designed for large groups.

tours.name: Special Offer Climbing Induction
tours.description: Embark on an exciting climbing induction that equips you with essential skills like harness fitting, knot tying, and belaying in just 1.5 hours. Once completed, gain independence as a climber at our centre, with all necessary equipment provided. Perfect for aspiring climbers and parents wanting to supervise their kids!

tours.name: Paperweight Making
tours.description: Create your own glass paperweight in 1.5 hours with expert glassblowers. Choose colors, design, and learn techniques in a heated studio. Carefully cooled for durability—take home a unique, handcrafted keepsake.

tours.name: Scheduled Trip
tours.description: Experience a serene 55-minute river cruise on the eco-friendly Kentish Stour. Glide through stunning landscapes while your skipper shares captivating historical anecdotes. Enjoy the fresh air, tranquility, and the option to bring refreshments or your well-behaved dog, making this a perfect escape for relaxation and memorable moments.

tours.name: Special Trip
tours.description: Embark on a unique 2-4 hour exclusive cruise with your personal skipper, perfect for any celebration. Enjoy the serene beauty of the river, indulge in a picnic, or capture stunning photographs. Whether for relaxation or special occasions, this memorable experience welcomes well-behaved dogs and allows you to bring your own refreshments.

tours.name: iSUP Rentals: Click & Collect Day rentals
tours.description: Escape the everyday hustle with a paddleboard adventure along the stunning NW Norfolk coast. Choose from two premium boards, perfect for exploring dramatic cliffs, serene beaches, and vibrant wildlife. Whether you seek tranquility or excitement, this experience promises unforgettable moments on the water, complete with the option for a picnic companion.

tours.name: Christmas Storywalk
tours.description: Join Shanty for a captivating 75-minute journey into the enchanting world of seasonal stories, uncovering the ancient pagan origins of Christmas. Perfect for adults and older children, this outdoor experience promises to be both educational and memorable. Don’t forget to dress appropriately and bring your enthusiasm!

tours.name: Full Moon Storywalk
tours.description: Join Shanty for a captivating 75-minute journey through St Ives, where chilling tales of horror, werewolves, and the supernatural come alive in enchanting locations. Experience the thrill of moonlit storytelling as you explore the town's dark history, making for an unforgettable night filled with suspense and intrigue.

tours.name: The Carrick-a-rede rope bridge trip
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 45-minute boat trip to explore breathtaking sites like the Carrick-a-Rede rope bridge and Sheep Island. Experience the beauty of local wildlife, with chances to spot dolphins and porpoises. Enjoy a safe adventure with a family-run business dedicated to showcasing the wonders of the area.

tours.name: 90-Minute Trip
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 90-minute boat trip exploring stunning sights like Carrick-a-rede rope bridge and Kinbane Castle. Operated by a dedicated family business, this adventure promises safety and value, featuring the reliable ‘Stackaboy’ boat equipped with the latest safety gear. Experience the beauty of local wildlife and breathtaking landscapes!

tours.name: Andy's Ales, Alleyways, and Christmas Spirit Tour!
tours.description: Experience the magic of Manchester during the festive season with S-Andy Claus! This one-hour tour takes you through scenic routes, uncovering hidden gems and iconic attractions. Learn about heartwarming initiatives by homelessness organizations that bring joy and warmth to the community, making this a truly memorable holiday experience.

tours.name: LOVERS' HEART BAUBLE
tours.description: Create a romantic keepsake by blowing your breath into a hand-blown heart. Choose your colors, share a special moment, and take home a unique symbol of love—perfect for anniversaries, Valentine’s, or just celebrating you.

tours.name: Vintage Train Trip
tours.description: Experience a nostalgic journey on a vintage steam train through the stunning South West Wales countryside. This 90-minute ride features charming 1950s carriages, scenic views, and two delightful stops to explore heritage collections. Enjoy a warm welcome at Abergwili Junction and create unforgettable memories with family and fellow heritage enthusiasts.

tours.name: Birthday Party
tours.description: Celebrate your birthday at Rock and Rapid Adventures with an exhilarating climbing party! Enjoy a safety briefing, expert supervision, and 90 minutes of climbing and bouldering fun. Guests can bond, build confidence, and learn new skills, while you relax in the café. Alternative activities like High Ropes and Archery are also available!

tours.name: Harbour Tour & Bird Watching
tours.description: Experience the serene beauty of Chichester Harbour on a 45-minute wildlife tour. Witness stunning migrant waders, including Oyster Catchers and Curlews, along with majestic Brent Geese and the occasional osprey. This unique adventure offers a peaceful escape, vibrant yacht views, and a chance to connect with nature from the water.

tours.name: Free Tour Londres Imprescindible + Cambio de Guardia*
tours.description: Explore Westminster in 3 hours with a Spanish-speaking guide, seeing iconic sights like Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, and the Changing of the Guard, plus stories that bring London's royal history to life.

tours.name: Free Tour la City de Londres
tours.description: Explore the hidden heart of London’s ancient City, where history meets modern finance. Walk medieval streets, see iconic landmarks, and uncover 2,000 years of stories in just 3 hours with a Spanish-speaking guide.

tours.name: 30 Minutes VR Racing
tours.description: Experience the adrenaline of race driving in immersive GT Omega ART cockpits equipped with VR headsets. Compete against a friend in the thrilling Project Cars Pro game for an unforgettable 30-minute adventure. Perfect for ages 8 and up, this unique experience promises excitement and challenges in virtual racing!

tours.name: 60 Minutes VR Racing
tours.description: Experience the adrenaline rush of race driving in our immersive GT Omega ART cockpits! With VR headsets and the thrilling Project Cars Pro, you can challenge a friend for an unforgettable racing showdown. Perfect for ages 8 and up, this unique experience promises excitement and competition like no other.

tours.name: Level 2 MTB Skills Coaching (Group session)
tours.description: Enhance your mountain biking skills with our Level 2 Course, led by expert British Cycling MTB Coaches. Experience a thrilling guided loop in the scenic Horner area, mastering techniques like bunny hops and cornering. Perfect for those ready to tackle challenging terrain and elevate their riding confidence.

tours.name: Introduction to Winter Mountaineering
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating two-day winter climbing course in Glen Coe, led by seasoned instructor Andy Spink. Master essential techniques for navigating steep terrain, including advanced crampon skills and rope work. Gain confidence and independence as you explore Scotland's challenging mountains, bridging the gap between winter walking and climbing.

tours.name: 1 Hour Event Hire
tours.description: Transform your event with an immersive arena-scale VR experience! Perfect for corporate gatherings, birthday parties, or school groups, this unique setup accommodates up to 16 players in an hour. Enjoy thrilling gameplay in a custom arena, ensuring unforgettable fun for everyone aged 9 and up.

tours.name: 3 Hour Event Hire
tours.description: Transform your event with an immersive 4-player VR arena experience brought directly to you! Perfect for corporate gatherings, birthday celebrations, or school groups, this thrilling adventure accommodates up to 16 players per hour. Dive into a unique virtual world for three unforgettable hours of excitement and teamwork.

tours.name: Half-Day Boat Hire
tours.description: Embark on a memorable half-day canoe or kayak adventure along the scenic Thames from Reading Marine Services Boatyard. Explore tranquil spots like Mapledurham and Caversham, where you can enjoy wildlife sightings, charming beaches, and delightful cafés. With safety briefings and all gear provided, it's an exciting outing for all ages!

tours.name: Full-Day Boat Hire
tours.description: Experience a full day of adventure on the Thames with canoe and kayak rentals from Thames Canoe Hire. Paddle through scenic routes to charming destinations like Mapledurham and Pangbourne, enjoying leisurely stops for lunch. With safety briefings and all necessary gear provided, this unique journey promises unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Two-Day Hire without Drop off & Collection
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling weekend adventure with Thames Canoe Hire! Rent canoes or kayaks and explore the scenic Thames River from Tilehurst, Reading. Enjoy a full day of paddling, with picturesque stops at Mapledurham and Caversham, all while receiving expert safety guidance. Perfect for families and friends seeking outdoor fun!

tours.name: Seven-Day Boat Hire
tours.description: Experience the beauty of the Thames at your own pace with a week-long canoe or kayak hire from Thames Canoe Hire. Enjoy a safe and guided start at The Boat Yard, then explore scenic spots like Mapledurham and Caversham, making unforgettable memories on the water with family and friends.

tours.name: Half-Day SUP Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddleboarding (SUP) with Thames Canoe Hire! This exciting half-day adventure allows you to glide across the water, combining the best of kayaking and surfing. Perfect for all skill levels, it’s a unique opportunity to enjoy the beauty of the water while mastering your balance.

tours.name: Full-Day SUP Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddleboarding (SUP) with Thames Canoe Hire! This exciting water sport combines elements of kayaking and surfing, offering a unique way to explore the water. With larger, buoyant boards for better balance, it's the perfect opportunity to enjoy a full day of adventure at The Boat Yard.

tours.name: Two-Day SUP Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddleboarding (SUP) on the Thames with a two-day hire. This exciting water sport combines elements of kayaking and surfing, offering a unique way to explore the river while enjoying the balance and buoyancy of larger boards. Don’t miss the chance to try something new!

tours.name: Seven-Day SUP Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddleboarding on the river with Thames Canoe Hire! For an entire week, enjoy the freedom to explore at your own pace on these buoyant boards, perfect for balancing while you paddle. Dive into this exciting water sport and create unforgettable memories on the water!

tours.name: South Stoke to Thames Canoe Hire, The Boat Yard
tours.description: Embark on a memorable one-way canoe trip along the scenic Thames, paddling approximately 10 miles from South Stoke to Reading. Experience charming stops like Goring and The Swan at Pangbourne, explore historic landmarks, and enjoy picturesque views, making this adventure a perfect blend of relaxation and exploration.

tours.name: Wallingford Bridge to Thames Canoe Hire, The Boat Yard
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-way canoe trip from Wallingford to Base, paddling through stunning countryside and abundant wildlife. This 14-mile adventure offers the perfect opportunity for a picnic stop at Pangbourne or a refreshing swim at Purley beach, culminating in a warm welcome back at Thames Canoe Hire.

tours.name: Thames Canoe Hire, The Boat Yard to Henley
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour canoe adventure from Reading to Henley, paddling through serene countryside and iconic landmarks like the Henley Royal Regatta course. Encounter swan-filled Caversham, enjoy coffee at Sonning Bridge, and savor lunch in Wargrave, all while navigating picturesque waterways before a convenient boat collection awaits.

tours.name: Multi-Day Adventure: Oxford to Thames Canoe Hire The Boat Yard
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 2 or 3-day canoeing adventure from Oxford to Reading, covering 35 miles and 11 locks. Experience stunning countryside, diverse wildlife, and charming overnight stops. With expert guidance and safety briefings, this journey promises excitement and tranquility as you paddle through picturesque landscapes and navigate serene waterways.

tours.name: Multi-Day Adventure: Abingdon to Thames Canoe Hire, The Boat Yard
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-day canoe adventure from Abingdon, paddling 27 miles through scenic waterways and navigating 8 locks. Experience the charm of Wallingford and Moulsford as you camp or stay in B&Bs. Enjoy a mix of challenging and relaxing stretches, culminating in a memorable return to Reading.

tours.name: Multi-Day Adventure: Thames Canoe Hire, The Boat Yard to Marlow
tours.description: Embark on a memorable 2-day adventure from our Base to Marlow, covering 20 miles and 8 locks. Enjoy a scenic paddle, with a comfortable overnight stay in Henley. Experience personalized safety briefings and equipment setup, ensuring a smooth journey as you soak in the beautiful surroundings at your own pace.

tours.name: Multi-Day Adventure: Thames Canoe Hire, The Boat Yard to Maidenhead
tours.description: Embark on a memorable three-day paddle from our base to Maidenhead, navigating 26 miles and 9 locks. Enjoy scenic views, cozy B&Bs, and a quirky pub stop at The Bounty. With expert staff support and safety briefings, this adventure promises relaxation and exploration along beautiful waterways.

tours.name: Multi-Day Adventure: Thames Canoe Hire, The Boat Yard to Windsor
tours.description: Extend your adventure with a four-day paddle from Maidenhead to Windsor, covering 32.5 miles and 12 locks. Enjoy scenic routes, charming B&Bs, and unique stops like The Bounty pub. Experience breathtaking views of Windsor Castle and the racecourse as you glide along the river, creating unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Seven-Day Adventure with Drop and Collection
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day paddle adventure from Cheese Wharf to Teddington, covering 136 miles and navigating 44 locks. Experience stunning scenery as you glide past historic landmarks like Windsor Castle and Hampton Court Palace, all while following the historic route of cheese transport from the 17th to 19th century.

tours.name: Stag/Hen Parties
tours.description: Ride crashing waves with surf, glide along calm waters coasteering, or paddle on a Super SUP—activities perfect for any weather, with flexible timing to match the tides.

tours.name: Pippin
tours.description: Rent the Pippin boat for a fun family adventure on the water. Enjoy easy handling, safety gear, and scenic maps. Bring your picnic, wear suitable clothes, and capture memories on this comfortable, family-friendly vessel.

tours.name: Merry
tours.description: Rent "Merry," a family-friendly boat with easy handling and plenty of space, for half or full days. Includes safety gear, maps, and training. Bring your picnic, dress for the weather, and enjoy a memorable day on the water.

tours.name: Sea Breeze
tours.description: Set sail on the Sea Breeze with comfy seating for seven, perfect for family and furry friends. Enjoy a relaxing day with included gear, picnic options, and scenic views—adventure awaits on the water!

tours.name: Solothorn
tours.description: Sail with family and furry friends on our spacious Hardy Fisher boat, complete with shelter, comfy seating, and picnic space. Enjoy a day on the water with included gear, training, and scenic maps—perfect for a fun, relaxing outing.

tours.name: Moorhen
tours.description: Set sail on Moorhen, a spacious boat perfect for family outings, picnics, or celebrations. Enjoy safety, comfort, and stunning views with included gear, maps, and optional picnic services—book online or by phone today.

tours.name: Fleet Street Secrets
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute walk through London's hidden history, uncovering medieval ruins, a disused tube station, and one of the city's oldest pubs. This unique tour reveals the intriguing stories of the past and introduces you to surprising former residents, all while exploring the lesser-known side streets of the City.

tours.name: The City: Power and Sacrifice
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5-hour walk through the historic heart of London, uncovering 2,000 years of economic power. Explore ancient sites hidden among modern skyscrapers, and discover the fascinating shifts in control and wealth. This unique journey reveals the city’s secrets that many overlook in their daily lives.

tours.name: The Spirit of Spitalfields
tours.description: Discover the vibrant spirit of Spitalfields on a 1.5-hour walking tour that unveils its rich history and transformation. Explore the lives of past residents, learn about Frying Pan Alley, and trace the routes of Jack the Ripper's victims, all while celebrating the resilience of this dynamic East End community.

tours.name: Bankside Behaving Badly
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute walk along the Thames, exploring Southwark's vibrant past filled with intrigue. Discover hidden Medieval and Elizabethan relics while uncovering tales of scandal, secrecy, and entertainment that once thrived in this lively area. Experience a unique blend of history and excitement in every step!

tours.name: Smithfield: Guts and Glory
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute journey through London's shadowy history, exploring the narrow alleys of Smithfield and Clerkenwell. Discover the stories of martyrs and rebels, uncover hidden plague pits, and visit the atmospheric St Bartholomew the Great. This immersive experience reveals the city's dramatic past in all weather conditions.

tours.name: Sordid Soho
tours.description: Discover the intriguing and risqué history of Soho on this captivating 1.5-hour tour. Uncover hidden stories and meet the characters who shaped this vibrant area, all while exploring its narrow streets. Embrace the thrill of its past, filled with tales of sex, drugs, and rebellion—an unforgettable experience awaits!

tours.name: Bermondsey: Off the Beaten Track
tours.description: Embark on a captivating walking tour through Bermondsey, where London's industrial past meets vibrant community life. Discover tales of rebellion, social reform, and the area's transformation from a gritty industrial hub to a desirable neighborhood. Conclude your journey at the delightful Maltby Street Market, savoring the essence of this unique locale.

tours.name: Kings Cross: Wrong Side of the Tracks?
tours.description: Discover the fascinating blend of history and modernity in Kings Cross on this 1.5-hour walking tour. Explore the charming backstreets, iconic stations, and vibrant new developments like Coal Drops Yard, while learning about the influential figures and ambitious projects that transformed this dynamic area into London's 'Knowledge Quarter.'

tours.name: City Secret Gardens
tours.description: Discover London's hidden botanical treasures on a captivating 1 hour and 45-minute walking tour. Explore the City’s 376 green spaces, uncovering the stories behind famous secret gardens like St Dunstan-in-the-East and Postman’s Park, along with delightful surprises that make this urban oasis truly unique. Experience nature's beauty amidst the bustling city!

tours.name: The Feminist Jack the Ripper Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique journey through East London's 19th-century streets with the Feminist Jack the Ripper tour. This two-hour experience shifts the focus from the infamous killer to the lives of his victims, celebrating the resilience of women like Mary Ann Nichols and Annie Chapman while exploring their stories in a historically rich setting. Enjoy a hot drink and snack at a charming 18th-century café along the way.

tours.name: SUP yoga - Balloon fiesta special
tours.description: Experience a unique morning at the Balloon Fiesta with Trika Yoga, combining stand-up paddleboarding in Bristol’s historic harbourside and the tranquility of SUP Yoga. Challenge your balance on the water, enjoy expert guidance, and unwind with breathwork and savasana, all while surrounded by stunning scenery and a supportive small group.

tours.name: Beer Festival
tours.description: Join us for a unique weekend experience aboard as Aitchesons Brewery showcases their exceptional handcrafted beers from a traditional cask. Enjoy a 1.5-hour journey filled with delightful tastings, all while our regular bar remains open for your favorite drinks. Don’t miss this chance to savor real ale on the water!

tours.name: Private Photo Walks
tours.description: Embark on a unique private photo walk through York, where history and creativity intertwine. Over three hours, you'll explore iconic sites like York Minster and the Shambles while receiving personalized photography guidance. Perfect for all skill levels, this experience enhances your artistic vision and boosts your confidence behind the camera.

tours.name: Advanced
tours.description: Test your skills at London's only airsoft range with 350 bullets, 6 game modes, and a variety of rifles and pistols. Perfect for beginners or thrill-seekers craving a new challenge.

tours.description: Try London's only airsoft range with realistic guns, 9 game modes, and expert guidance. Shoot over 600 rounds with authentic pistols and rifles—perfect for beginners or thrill-seekers.

tours.name: Private Hire

tours.name: Private Small Group (3 - 12 people)
tours.description: Join a private lane for an adrenaline-pumping airsoft battle with 6 game modes, top weapons, and 500 bullets. Perfect for groups of 3-12, with safety training and a prize for the best shooter.

tours.name: Private Large Group (13-24 people)
tours.description: Join London's only private airsoft range for groups of 13-24. Enjoy 6 game modes, expert guidance, and a variety of realistic rifles and pistols. Perfect for beginners or thrill-seekers—book your exclusive session today.

tours.name: Private Small Upgraded Group (3 - 12 people)
tours.description: Enjoy exclusive access to London's only private airsoft range for 1-2 hours. Shoot over 900 bullets across 9 game modes, with expert guidance, safety gear, and a prize for the top shooter. Perfect for groups of 3-12.

tours.name: Private Large Upgraded Group (13-24 people)
tours.description: Join London's only private airsoft range for a thrilling battle with upgraded guns, 8 game modes, and personalized lanes. Perfect for groups of 13-24, enjoy longer sessions, expert guidance, and a chance to be the top shooter.

tours.name: Half Day Picnic Hack
tours.description: Ride through the stunning New Forest on a gentle trek, then relax with a delicious, bespoke picnic in scenic surroundings. Perfect for all levels, with a peaceful 3-hour adventure and tasty food.

tours.name: Kayaking Adventure Day
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure along the stunning North Pembrokeshire coast! Spend a full day kayaking to hidden beaches and caves, enjoying sea foraging and snorkeling in pristine waters. With breathtaking scenery and unique experiences, this exploration promises excitement and discovery at every turn. Don't miss out on this coastal journey!

tours.name: Kayaking - Blue Lagoon Abereiddy
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sea kayaking in Abereiddy Bay! This 3-hour tour is perfect for families and beginners, offering a chance to explore stunning caves and coves while learning about the area's rich history. Join the many who return for this unforgettable adventure on the water!

tours.name: White Water Rafting Trip
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating White Water Rafting adventure on the River Dee, starting at the breathtaking Horseshoe Falls. Navigate thrilling rapids like the infamous Serpent's Tail, guided by experienced instructors. Perfect for ages 11 and up, this unforgettable journey promises excitement and stunning scenery at every turn.

tours.name: Overnight Tudor Maritime Workshop - KS3
tours.description: Spend a night aboard the Golden Hinde, exploring Tudor maritime life through hands-on workshops. Sleep in authentic gundeck quarters and uncover secrets of Drake’s voyage or the Armada’s failure.

tours.name: Ship Ahoy! - EYFS
tours.description: Climb aboard a Tudor galleon for a lively pirate adventure! Load cannons, find the treasure map, and raise the anchor in a fun, hands-on exploration that sparks imagination and teamwork for young explorers.

tours.name: Blood, Bones & Bile: the art of the Barber Surgeon - KS2
tours.description: Step aboard The Golden Hinde for a 1-hour journey into 16th-century seafaring life. Handle replica medical tools, role-play as sailors, and explore history, medicine, and daily life on an Elizabethan ship.

tours.name: Daytime Living History - KS2
tours.description: Climb aboard the Golden Hinde for a 3-hour adventure as you dress as a 16th-century sailor, learn navigation, handle weapons, hear gripping tales, and experience life on an Elizabethan ship through hands-on role-play.

tours.name: Triple Kayak Hire
tours.description: Paddle through calm, safe waters at Loe Beach, exploring creeks, reaching Trelissick Gardens, or heading to Pandora. Enjoy full gear, expert tips, and a shoreline push-off for a memorable kayaking adventure.

tours.name: Giant Paddleboard Hire
tours.description: Glide across calm waters on a stable paddleboard, enjoy a full-body workout, and soak in tranquil creek views. Perfect for groups—up to 6 adults or 10 kids—with full guidance included.

tours.name: Canoe Hire - Full Day Trip
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable day of canoeing on the stunning Llangollen canal! Perfect for all ages and skill levels, this adventure includes paddling through two tunnels and over two aqueducts. With stable canoes and a friendly atmosphere, you can even bring your dog along for the journey. Join us for a memorable outing!

tours.name: Group Surf Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing at Westward Ho! Beach, where lessons cater to all skill levels, from beginners to advanced surfers. Enjoy uncrowded, gentle waves perfect for learning, surrounded by the charming seaside village. Tailored instruction and the option to use your own gear make this an unforgettable surf adventure.

tours.name: Private Surf Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing at Westward Ho! Beach, where lessons cater to all skill levels, from beginners to advanced surfers. Enjoy uncrowded, gentle waves perfect for learning, surrounded by the charming seaside village and its vibrant amenities. Tailored instruction ensures a memorable surf adventure for everyone!
