Glide along the scenic Torridge River, exploring breathtaking views of forests, cliffs, and charming villages. Choose from popular routes like the Bideford to Appledore cruise, making unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Level 1 Snowboard
tours.description: Build confidence on your snowboard as you learn to slide on your heel edge, guided by friendly instructors. Perfect for beginners ready to take the next step in their snowboarding journey.

tours.name: Level 2 Snowboard
tours.description: Elevate your snowboarding skills in Level 2, where you'll master sliding on your toe edge with expert guidance from friendly instructors. This one-hour lesson builds on your previous experience, ensuring a supportive and engaging environment as you progress on the slopes. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Level 3 Snowboard
tours.description: Level 3 snowboarding takes your skills to new heights! Under the guidance of friendly, experienced instructors, you'll master sliding on your heel and toe edges. This one-hour lesson builds on your previous experience, ensuring a fun and supportive environment as you progress on the slopes. Get ready for an unforgettable ride!

tours.name: Level 4 Snowboard
tours.description: Elevate your snowboarding skills in Level 4, where you'll master linking your turns under the guidance of friendly, experienced instructors. This one-hour lesson builds on your previous knowledge, ensuring a supportive environment as you progress. Get ready to enhance your technique and enjoy the thrill of the slopes!

tours.name: Level 5 Snowboard
tours.description: Elevate your snowboarding skills with the exciting Flexi Level 5 lesson! Perfect for those who have completed level 4, this one-hour session teaches you to navigate the big slope using the button tow, guided by friendly, experienced instructors. Experience expert coaching and take your snowboarding to new heights!

tours.name: 50% OFF Monthly Rental (3 months)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of exploring Leeds and the stunning Yorkshire countryside on an electric bike with Talio. Whether for work, study, or leisure, enjoy the freedom of the open road while saving money. With flexible rental options and complimentary helmets and locks, adventure awaits at every turn!

tours.name: Social Paddle Boarding - Weybridge 🏄🏻‍♂️🏄‍♀️
tours.description: Join a lively 2-hour evening paddle from Elmbridge Canoe Club, led by safety experts. Bring your board, buoyancy aid, and sense of adventure for a fun, self-guided trip on Weybridge waters.

tours.name: Inner Farne landing Boat Trip
tours.description: Take a 2.5-hour boat trip around the Farne Islands, home to thousands of seabirds and seals. Visit historic sites, follow Grace Darling’s rescue route, and enjoy stunning wildlife views, with an hour on Inner Farne Island.

tours.name: Sea Kayak Taster/Intro
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating two-hour sea kayaking adventure, perfect for beginners! Learn essential paddle strokes and safety techniques before exploring the scenic bay. With all equipment provided, this unique experience offers a fantastic introduction to the world of sea kayaking, ensuring unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Kayak Hire
tours.description: Experience the stunning beauty of St Ives from the water with our flexible kayaking adventure. Paddle at your own pace in sturdy sit-on kayaks, perfect for all skill levels. Explore designated areas, enjoy fishing, or relax at Porthminster beach. Safety boats ensure a worry-free outing while you soak in the scenery.

tours.name: Stand Up PaddleBoards (SUP)
tours.description: Experience the stunning beauty of St Ives from the water with our Stand Up Paddleboarding adventure! Suitable for all skill levels, you can choose from single, double, or quadruple boards. Paddle at your own pace, explore the bay, and enjoy a picnic at Porthminster beach, all while surrounded by breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: Decades Tour
tours.description: Dance through legendary venues from the 70s to the 90s, hearing backstage stories and singing hits from ABBA, Spice Girls, and more. Perfect for celebrating any special occasion with a nostalgic twist.

tours.name: Deansgate Tour • Individual Seats
tours.description: Experience Manchester like never before on a unique cycle tour that combines sightseeing with socializing. Pedal through the city’s iconic landmarks, raise a toast with friends, and visit renowned local pubs. Perfect for special occasions, this adventure promises unforgettable memories and a lively atmosphere as you explore the vibrant streets.

tours.description: Cycle through Manchester’s landmarks, raising a toast at local pubs. Enjoy a lively, stylish tour perfect for celebrations—snacks, drinks, and party supplies available to make it unforgettable.

tours.name: Albert Dock Tour Tour • Individual Seats
tours.description: Embark on a unique cycle tour through Liverpool, where you can toast with friends while exploring iconic landmarks. Experience the city's vibrant pub culture as you pedal to local favorites. Perfect for special occasions, this tour promises a memorable adventure filled with fun, laughter, and unforgettable moments.

tours.description: Experience the vibrant city like never before on The Ultimate Wee Toast Tour! Gather up to 15 friends on a unique bike, enjoy unlimited draught beer and prosecco, and pedal through historic streets. This lively tour promises unforgettable moments and joyous celebrations, perfect for all ages with parental supervision.

Gather up to 15 friends for a unique cycling adventure filled with unlimited draught beer and prosecco. Enjoy the lively atmosphere as you pedal through historic streets, creating unforgettable memories and spreading joy with every toast!

tours.description: Embark on a unique cycle tour through Liverpool, raising a toast as you explore iconic landmarks and visit world-famous pubs. This memorable experience combines cycling with camaraderie, making it perfect for celebrations. Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere and local flavors while creating unforgettable memories with friends and family.

Join up to 15 fellow cyclers for a fun-filled ride with unlimited draught beer and prosecco. Perfect for all ages, this unique tour combines exploration, celebration, and unforgettable memories in a lively atmosphere.

tours.name: WTT Ultimate Experience - Private Bike
tours.description: Experience the vibrant streets of the city on the Ultimate Wee Toast Tour! Gather up to 15 friends for a unique cycling adventure filled with unlimited beer and prosecco. Pedal together while toasting to good times, making unforgettable memories in a lively atmosphere. Book your private bike for an extraordinary outing!

tours.name: Whitstable Oyster Farm Tour
tours.company: The Whitstable Oyster Trading Co Ltd
tours.description: Dive into the world of sustainable oyster farming with a genuine oyster farmer in Whitstable! This unique two-hour experience offers insights into the history of oyster production, followed by a delightful tasting of fresh oysters and drinks onshore. Gather your friends for an unforgettable culinary adventure!

tours.name: Tank Paintball Battle
tours.description: Transform into a tank crew in 2 hours: drive, aim, and fire giant paintballs from a real tank, then battle opponents in an adrenaline-pumping tank paintball fight. No license needed, all gear provided, and free museum entry included.

tours.name: Tank Driving Taster
tours.description: Take control of a WWII tank on a real track, driving two laps in and out of battle conditions. Feel the power, sit in the turret, and enjoy a thrilling, hands-on experience with free museum entry included.

tours.name: Adult & Child Experience
tours.description: Race a tank, learn to shoot giant paintballs, and enjoy thrilling track rides in this family-friendly hour of adventure. No license needed—just bring your excitement and a sense of fun!

tours.name: Tank Driving Experience
tours.description: Drive a real tank on a WWII bombing range, control it in battle mode or open hatch, and enjoy a thrilling hour of hands-on fun. No license needed, suitable for all, with free museum entry included.

tours.name: Woodland Paintball Games
tours.description: Join an adrenaline-pumping paintball battle at Chaos Paintball, with tactical games, full safety gear, and 500 paintballs included. Perfect for groups, parties, or team events—book now for non-stop action!

tours.name: Archery
tours.description: Test your aim with unlimited shots under expert supervision at Armourgeddon. Perfect for groups, ages 12+, includes free museum entry, and offers a fun, competitive shooting experience in a lively setting.

tours.name: Air Rifle Shooting x 56 shots
tours.description: Test your marksmanship with 60 shots using high-tech air rifles in a fun, competitive bunker. Perfect for groups, ages 12+, includes free museum entry, and fun for friends and family to watch.

tours.name: Military Vehicle Driving x 2 vehicles
tours.description: Drive two different military vehicles, like a fire tender or a tracked carrier, on a track with expert guidance. Feel the power, maneuver skills, and thrill of commanding these iconic machines in just one hour.

tours.name: Military Vehicle Driving x 3 vehicles
tours.description: Drive three different military vehicles, including a truck, fire engine, and armored carrier, on a track. Enjoy safety gear, a brief history, and six laps total—an adrenaline-filled, hands-on military adventure.

tours.name: Museum Admission Ticket
tours.description: Explore a vast military museum with historic tanks, movie star vehicles, interactive exhibits, and WWII scenes. Watch tanks on maneuvers, enjoy the café, and try thrilling tank rides—perfect for history buffs and adventure seekers alike.

tours.description: Celebrate Christmas in style aboard the Red Bus Bistro, blending festive sights, holiday tunes, and cocktail-making fun. Enjoy tasty nibble boards as you craft your favorite drinks and soak in Glasgow’s sparkling lights.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Edinburgh

tours.name: Single Kayak hire

tours.name: Double Kayak hire

tours.description: Catch mackerel with handlines, then enjoy a stunning fireworks show over Portland Harbour. Perfect for families and beginners, this adventure combines fishing, scenic views, and a dazzling sky display.

Dive, climb, and navigate the rugged shores for an unforgettable outdoor experience that connects you with nature in an exhilarating way.

tours.name: Kids Summer School - 18th -21st August 2025

Create delicious breads, desserts, and main meals while enjoying step-by-step instruction and support from qualified chefs.

tours.name: Private Manchester City Centre & Northern Quarter Tour
tours.description: Uncover Manchester’s vibrant heart on a 1.5-hour walk through historic sites, colorful street art, lively pubs, and hidden gems in the City Centre and Northern Quarter. Dive into the city’s rich, dynamic story.

tours.name: Indian breakfast @ Oxford Street

tours.name: Bristol City Walking Tour
tours.description: Uncover Bristol’s vibrant history from medieval trade to modern art. Walk past pirates, protestors, and graffiti, ending at stunning Bristol Cathedral. A lively 1.5-hour tour full of stories and hidden gems.

tours.name: Private Bristol City Walking Tour
tours.description: Uncover Bristol’s rich history from pirates to Banksy on a lively 1.5-hour walk. Visit iconic landmarks, hidden spots, and hear captivating stories that bring the city’s vibrant past to life.

tours.description: Taste Norwich’s rich history while savoring top sausage rolls and pastries. Walk through historic streets, enjoy local pubs, and get judged by an international food expert—an irresistible foodie adventure you won’t forget.

Learn essential paddle skills and water safety while enjoying a unique perspective of the city. Enjoy a fun-filled day on the water, tailored just for your group, ensuring memorable moments and skill development.

tours.name: Corporate SUP Session
tours.description: Create your perfect adventure with a customizable session that combines team-building, clean-up efforts, or SUP Pilates. Choose between a scenic lake or river, and enjoy expert guidance as you learn to paddle, turn, and self-rescue. Experience the thrill of mastering a new sport in a supportive group setting.

tours.name: Kin: Caribbean Recipes for the Modern Kitchen @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create vibrant Caribbean dishes like flaky Buss Up Shut Roti, flavorful Curry Chicken, and sweet Potato Pudding. Learn secret recipes, master bold flavors, and enjoy a lively 3-hour cooking adventure with Marie Mitchell.

tours.name: Kidding Tour and Experience
tours.description: Meet newborn kids, learn how goats help make award-winning cheese, and see farm life in action during kidding season. Engage with passionate farmers and explore sustainable practices on this authentic farm tour.

tours.name: Boat tour | Heritage Working Boat Trip
tours.description: Experience Birmingham like never before on a Heritage Working Boat trip! Step into a 1930s cargo hold and glide through the city’s historic canal loops. Enjoy unique insights from passionate volunteers while discovering the hidden gems of the waterways and the lives of families who once navigated these routes.

tours.name: Junior Sail Clinic
tours.description: Join a thrilling one-day sailing clinic designed to enhance your skills and prepare you for advanced levels. With hands-on practice in rigging, sailing techniques, and exciting races—including sail, paddle, and duck races—this experience promises fun and camaraderie for all participants from Stage 1 and up.

tours.name: Beginner Paddleboard lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding in the stunning coastal town of Christchurch! Our expert instructors will guide you through tailored lessons, ensuring you gain confidence while exploring the beautiful waters. Whether you're a beginner or looking to enhance your skills, this unique adventure promises excitement and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Progress Paddleboard lesson
tours.description: Elevate your paddleboarding skills with personalized progress lessons that focus on refining your technique and boosting your confidence. Enjoy expert coaching in a stunning location, where you can ask questions and tackle new challenges at your own pace. Experience a fun, safe, and rewarding journey on the water!

tours.name: Advanced Paddleboard Lesson
tours.description: Elevate your paddleboarding skills with our Advanced Paddleboard Lessons! Tailored to your goals, this 2-hour session combines expert land-based instruction with hands-on water practice. Perfect your technique, learn advanced maneuvers, and gain confidence to tackle any conditions, all while enjoying a stunning paddling location. Transform your experience on the water!

tours.name: Paddleboard Group Lesson
tours.description: Join a group beginner paddleboarding lesson for a unique blend of skill-building and camaraderie. Under expert guidance, you'll learn essential techniques in a fun, supportive atmosphere. Enjoy the thrill of the water while making new friends and experiencing friendly competition, all designed to boost your confidence and progress together.

tours.name: Mackeral Fishing Rod & Line - Coastal Catcher
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable family adventure with mackerel fishing! Perfect for kids and beginners, this experience offers the chance to catch fish while learning the basics. Enjoy stunning views of the Jurassic Coast and explore the picturesque Portland Harbour, making memories that will last a lifetime.

tours.name: Evening Fishing & Fireworks Rod & Line - Coastal Catcher
tours.description: Embark on a memorable family adventure with an introduction to angling! Perfect for kids and beginners, this hands-on experience allows you to learn the basics, reel in fish, and enjoy a scenic boat ride. Conclude your day with a breathtaking firework display lighting up the night sky!

tours.name: Sunset Firework & BBQ Cruise
tours.description: Embark on the Coastal Vibes Sunset BBQ & Fireworks Cruise for an unforgettable 4-hour journey along Dorset's Jurassic Coast. Savor a delicious onboard BBQ while witnessing a breathtaking sunset and a spectacular fireworks display. With great music and a relaxed atmosphere, this evening promises magical moments on the water.

tours.name: Donut Tasting Tour
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful journey through London's best donut offerings! Experience a mouthwatering selection of Donuts, Cronuts, Yumnuts, and Cinnamon buns from renowned spots like Dunkin', Krispy Kreme, CrossTown, Donut Time, and Buns at Home. This is a sweet adventure you won't want to miss!

tours.name: Gelato Tasting Tour
tours.description: Embark on a delightful journey through renowned and hidden Gelato and Ice Cream parlours. Discover the rich history of Gelato, savor unique flavors, and uncover fascinating facts that set Gelato apart from Ice Cream. This experience promises a sweet adventure for all dessert lovers!

tours.name: How to start up a business
tours.description: Experience transformative business coaching in a stylish London hotel lounge, led by a seasoned expert with over 30 years in banking and business management. Gain invaluable insights on business strategy, marketing, and finance, tailored to help small enterprises thrive. Unlock your potential and elevate your business journey today.

tours.name: Mountain Biking
tours.description: Experience the thrill of mountain biking on diverse trails designed for all skill levels. With a looped pump track and three exciting forest trails featuring rollers, berms, and step-ups, you can challenge yourself while enjoying the ride. Bring your bike and explore at your own pace for endless fun!

tours.name: The art of choux @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create stunning choux pastries with expert tips—sweet pistachio profiteroles and savory smoked salmon éclairs. Learn piping, baking, decorating, and enjoy tasting your delicious creations in a fun, hands-on masterclass.

tours.name: The art of choux @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create stunning choux pastries with expert tips—sweet pistachio profiteroles and savory smoked salmon éclairs. Learn piping, baking, decorating, and enjoy tasting your delicious creations.

tours.name: The Dunnage & Drams Experience
tours.description: Step into our warehouses to see the magic of maturation, then taste rare cask-dripped drams straight from the barrel. An outdoor adventure that reveals the spirit’s unique character—dress warmly and enjoy the high season.

tours.name: Big Veg Energy: ridiculously good plant-based food @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create vibrant vegan dishes with chef Christina Soteriou, from whipped tofu and herb-dressed courgettes to spicy squash and rich chocolate tart. Learn to craft bold, flavorful plant-based meals you'll love to make again.

tours.name: Guided Tour - Beaulieu River
tours.description: Embark on a serene 2-hour guided tour of the Beaulieu River Nature Reserve, where you’ll paddle through stunning landscapes in stable kayaks or canoes. Perfect for all skill levels, this adventure offers captivating stories of local history and wildlife, making it an unforgettable experience in one of the South's most beautiful settings.

tours.name: Package tour | Roundhouse x Brindley Cruises
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Birmingham's rich history with a unique blend of boat and walking tours. Glide along historic canals, explore iconic sites, and engage in the fun of 'Birmingham Bingo' as you uncover hidden gems. Experience the city's vibrant past like never before, all while capturing stunning photos.

tours.name: Guided Walks
tours.description: Step into Northumberland’s stunning landscapes on guided walks that reveal rich history and vibrant wildlife. Whether strolling through gentle hills or watching sunsets under starry skies, each journey fosters connection with nature. Embrace the peaceful rhythm of the land and rediscover the simple joy of being outdoors.

tours.name: Fliteboard eFoiling
tours.description: Experience the thrill of eFoiling with a personalized introductory lesson! Enjoy a dry land briefing followed by one-on-one coaching on the water. All necessary equipment is provided—just bring your swim costume and towel for an unforgettable adventure on the waves!

tours.name: Henley Royal Regatta • A special Riverboat Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Thames during Henley Regatta, with stunning views and a lively Elvis tribute by Alvin. A one-of-a-kind cruise blending iconic music with breathtaking scenery—unforgettable from start to finish.

tours.name: Abbey Church Tour
tours.description: Uncover hidden corners of the church, including the Crypt, and explore its rich history and stunning architecture. Enjoy browsing the Visitor Centre, shop, and savor hearty meals in the cozy Tea Room.

tours.name: Inshore Mixed Fishing Summer
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable full-day fishing adventure in Pembrokeshire, where you’ll explore prime inshore and offshore spots. Experience the thrill of catching diverse species like bass, pollack, and turbot, with options for all skill levels. Enjoy the stunning scenery and great fishing, rain or shine, from April to October.

tours.name: Mediterra with Ben Tish @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Learn from London’s top chef, Ben Tish, as he shares his Mediterranean secrets. Create vibrant, seasonal dishes inspired by his new book, then enjoy your flavorful masterpieces in this exclusive cooking class.

tours.name: Relax with Baby Alpacas
tours.description: Experience the joy of sitting in a serene field surrounded by adorable baby alpacas for 30 minutes. This unique opportunity allows you to connect with these gentle creatures, creating unforgettable memories in a peaceful setting. Enjoy the charm and warmth of these playful animals in a delightful outdoor escape.

tours.name: Ropes & Rigging: Sailor Skills for Summer (25/07-01/08)
tours.description: Climb aboard The Golden Hinde for Knot School, where kids learn real sailor skills through hands-on ropework, rigging, and knot challenges. Create a keepsake and dive into the maritime world in this fun, screen-free adventure.

tours.name: London: Stonehenge & Cotswolds (Private)
tours.description: Journey through England’s timeless charm with visits to Stonehenge and the Cotswolds. Enjoy personalized guiding, scenic villages, and a relaxing day exploring history, nature, and storybook scenery—all in one unforgettable trip.

tours.name: London: Cotswolds & Bath (Private)
tours.description: Escape to England’s charm in a day: explore picturesque Cotswolds villages, stroll historic Bath, enjoy scenic drives, and savor a countryside lunch—all led by a local guide for a relaxed, unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: London: Stonehenge & Bath (Private)
tours.description: Visit Stonehenge’s mysterious stones then stroll through Bath’s Roman baths and Georgian streets. Enjoy expert insights, a delicious lunch, and seamless travel—an unforgettable day exploring England’s rich history and charm.

tours.name: GLUTEN-FREE CHRISTMAS BAKING: THE PERFECT EDIBLE GIFT
tours.description: Join Becky Excell to master gluten-free baking, creating three delicious treats—chocolate orange cookies, lemon amaretti, and mince pies—without sacrificing flavor. Perfect for festive celebrations!

tours.name: Row The Races Weekend - Individual & Private Hire
tours.description: Join seasoned rowers for a challenging 41 km journey around Portland, battling tidal races and passing iconic landmarks. Enjoy scenic coastal exploration and optional extra days on the Jurassic Coast.

tours.name: London: Jane Austen's Bath & Beyond (Private)
tours.description: Step into Jane Austen’s world with a scenic trip from Bath to countryside filming locations, then explore Bath’s historic sites. A perfect blend of literature, history, and charming scenery in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: London: Bath Walking Tours + Freetime (Private)
tours.description: Enjoy a flexible day in Bath with a guided walk, free time to explore, and scenic train rides from London. Perfect for first-timers who love wandering and discovering hidden city gems at their own pace.

tours.name: London: Filming Locations from London (Private)
tours.description: Uncover Bath’s film magic with visits to iconic TV and movie sites, blending stunning architecture, local stories, and behind-the-scenes secrets. Perfect for film fans eager to see Bath from a new perspective.

tours.name: Bushcraft Full Day Experience
tours.description: Master ancient skills like firelighting, shelter building, and outdoor cooking amid 11 acres of lush woodland. Connect with nature, learn new crafts, and enjoy a relaxing, hands-on outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Novice
tours.description: Join thrilling motorcycle track days for all skill levels, guided by racing legends. Feel the adrenaline from 7am, with safety briefings and your first ride starting at 9am—an unforgettable day on the circuit.

tours.name: Intermediate
tours.description: Join thrilling motorcycle track days suitable for all skill levels, led by legends from BSB, WSBK, and Road Racing. Feel the adrenaline and nurture rising British talent on the fast-paced circuit.

tours.name: Advanced
tours.description: Join thrilling motorcycle track days for all skill levels, guided by racing legends. Feel the adrenaline from early morning circuit access to your first session—an unforgettable ride awaits.

tours.name: Farm Toddlers 2026 - ALL remaining blocks
tours.description: Join farm-themed toddler sessions near Jedburgh for hands-on outdoor fun, messy play, and close-up animal encounters. Seasonal activities and crafts make each week unique for children 12 months and up.

tours.name: WaterPark Male + Coach
tours.description: Enjoy exclusive, private access to Waterworld for two hours of pure fun, away from crowds. Relax, socialize, and unwind with a safe, halal-friendly environment, all arranged with stress-free transportation and perfect timing.

tours.name: Strawberry Field and Calderstones School Tour
tours.description: Step into John Lennon’s world with a guided tour of his old school, then wander Strawberry Field’s peaceful gardens and iconic gates, tracing his journey from childhood to the inspiration behind "Strawberry Fields Forever."

tours.name: Abseiling near Keswick
tours.description: Tackle a rocky slope, master your gear, and then conquer a thrilling 25m abseil amid Borrowdale’s stunning oak trees—an exciting way to embrace nature and test your limits.

tours.name: Book an Inflatable Land Wristband Party
tours.description: Jump into non-stop fun at Horsenden Hill’s Inflatable Land, featuring nine giant inflatables, including West London’s largest obstacle course. Celebrate with music, food, and laughter in a lively outdoor setting.

tours.name: Spooky Halloween River Tour
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 2-hour canoe tour on the Beaulieu River, where friendly guides share spooky tales under the moonlight. Dress up for a unique twist on trick-or-treating, paddle in illuminated canoes, and create unforgettable memories with family in the great outdoors. Safety gear provided for a worry-free adventure!

tours.name: 8hr General Fishing Trip
tours.company: Starida Puffin Island Cruises & Sea Fishing Trips
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour fishing adventure tailored for experienced anglers! Explore diverse fishing spots, from drift to deep water, with opportunities to catch a variety of species, including mackerel, cod, and even tope. Enjoy a day of excitement and challenge, all while soaking in the stunning coastal scenery.

tours.name: 8hr Wreck Fishing Trip
tours.company: Starida Puffin Island Cruises & Sea Fishing Trips
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour fishing adventure along the stunning North Wales coast, perfect for seasoned anglers. Explore various wrecks and target species like cod, pollock, and mackerel. With optional rod hire available, this unique experience promises a memorable day on the water, surrounded by breathtaking scenery and thrilling catches.

tours.name: The London Classic Scooter Tour
tours.description: Experience the vibrant heart of London on a thrilling scooter tour! Glide past iconic Royal Palaces, lush parks, and historic monuments while uncovering fascinating local insights. With a small group and expert guide, this 2.5 to 3-hour adventure promises an unforgettable exploration of the city's rich heritage.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea Cruise
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful 3-hour afternoon tea experience featuring an exquisite array of sandwiches on fresh bread, warm fruit scones with clotted cream and jam, and a tempting selection of cakes. Enjoy this charming culinary journey accompanied by a pot of tea or coffee, perfect for a memorable gathering.

tours.name: Axe Throwing and Archery - Brokerswood
tours.description: Unleash your inner Viking with a 90-minute session of axe throwing and archery. Learn expert techniques, compete in fun games, and challenge yourself in a lively, hands-on adventure suitable for ages 10 and up.

tours.name: The Hidden Temple
tours.description: Uncover ancient secrets, outsmart traps, and race against time to recover a stolen Aztec artifact. Avoid angering the gods or risk being trapped forever in this thrilling 60-minute escape adventure.

tours.name: Alpaca Stroll
tours.description: Meet gentle alpacas, feed them, and enjoy a scenic 45-minute walk in the Scottish Borders. Take in stunning views, capture photos, and create lasting memories on this outdoor adventure for all ages 7+.

tours.name: Belfast Literary Tour
tours.description: Walk Belfast’s streets and hear vivid readings from famous local writers like Heaney and Carson, brought to life by a Belfast-born actor guide. Dive into the city’s literary soul in this immersive 3-hour tour.

tours.name: Coasteering | Private Group
tours.description: Experience the thrill of coasteering at Baggy Point, Croyde, where expert guides lead you on an unforgettable adventure. Scramble over rocks, swim through hidden gullies, and leap into the ocean, all while soaking in the breathtaking North Devon coastline. Perfect for families, this unique experience promises lasting memories.

tours.name: Bespoke Weekends for Groups
tours.description: Escape to remote beaches with friends, kayak along stunning coastlines, spot wildlife, and relax around campfires. All meals and gear provided for a memorable 2-day adventure in secluded, crowd-free spots.

tours.name: Full Day Hadrian’s Wall Guided Tour
tours.description: Step back 2000 years and walk along Hadrian’s Wall, exploring archaeological gems, meeting costumed guides, and visiting top museums. Immerse yourself in Roman Britain’s fascinating history on this full-day adventure.

tours.name: PicTours Manchester
tours.description: Embark on Manchester's top photography tour, guided by a local expert who will unveil the city's most Instagrammable spots. Over 90 minutes, enhance your photography skills, capture stunning images, and immerse yourself in captivating stories about Manchester. Leave with unforgettable memories and newfound techniques to elevate your photography game!

tours.name: Winter Toddlers 2024
tours.description: Join fun winter farm sessions for kids 12 months+ to explore outdoors, get messy, meet animals, and enjoy seasonal crafts. Dress warmly, bring an adult, and experience farm life in a safe, lively environment.

tours.name: RLSS Beach Lifeguard
tours.description: Earn your ILS-recognised Beach Lifeguarding qualification in just five days! This essential certification opens doors to exciting roles as a surf instructor, coasteering guide, or RNLI beach lifeguard in the UK. Gain practical skills, enjoy provided equipment, and join a community dedicated to water safety at events.

tours.name: London E-Bike Tour (Private)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of cycling through London on an electric bike! Glide effortlessly past iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace and Big Ben on this 3-hour adventure. With a small group size and a scenic route primarily in cycle lanes, this tour promises a unique and memorable exploration of the city.

tours.name: Bath City Sights
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic River Avon, enjoy lunch by Pulteney Weir, cruise through Bath’s waterways, and finish with a relaxing walk to the pub. A perfect blend of adventure, stunning views, and local charm.

tours.name: E-Scooter Training Session
tours.description: Join our free e-scooter training sessions in London, where you'll learn safe riding techniques through a safety tutorial, practice, and a guided scoot. With expert trainers and a complimentary helmet, this unique experience is perfect for beginners. Just bring your driving license and get ready to ride!

tours.name: Natural History Museum London Family Tour
tours.description: Explore the world of dinosaurs in a private, family-friendly tour at London's Natural History Museum. Discover ancient giants, hands-on activities, and fascinating stories in just 2 hours. Limited spots!

tours.name: National Art Gallery London Family Tour
tours.description: Explore the National Gallery with your family on a fun, interactive 2-hour tour. Discover stories behind famous paintings, legends of gods, and spark curiosity through engaging activities for kids and adults alike.

tours.name: Raft building
tours.description: Build your own raft with friends, then see if it floats! Get hands-on designing, constructing, and testing your creation on the water for an exciting, teamwork-filled adventure.

tours.name: Hidden Wonders of Waterloo
tours.description: Uncover the hidden gems of Waterloo on a captivating 90-minute walk. Explore film-like streets, secret gardens, and a remarkable Cathedral while learning about the area's intriguing history and its unlikely heroes, from theatrical champions to beloved street sweepers. Experience a unique blend of culture and storytelling in this often-overlooked part of London.

tours.name: Kids Fun Club
tours.description: Join the Player Ready Gaming Fun Club for an exhilarating three-hour adventure filled with VR, gaming, and racing! Supervised by dedicated staff, kids aged 8 and up can connect with peers in a safe environment. Perfect for budding gamers and future coding enthusiasts, this experience promises unforgettable fun!

tours.name: Blackpool Illuminations Explorer
tours.description: Join us on Saturday, November 15th, as we journey to Blackpool, renowned for its spectacular illuminations. Experience the magic of the lights after dark, and explore iconic attractions like Blackpool Tower and Madame Tussauds. This unforgettable day promises fun, adventure, and cherished memories to take home.

tours.name: VIP Animal Encounters including General Admission
tours.description: Get up close with friendly rainforest creatures like bearded dragons and giant snails in a hands-on zoo experience. Meet a zookeeper, handle animals, then explore the lush tropical setting at your own pace.

tours.name: Square Mile Sisters
tours.description: Explore the City of London on a captivating 90-minute walk that highlights the remarkable women who have shaped its history. From Regency businesswomen to modern trailblazers, discover inspiring stories that challenge the status quo. Led by an engaging guide, this experience offers a fresh perspective on the Square Mile's legacy.

tours.name: East End Women
tours.description: Embark on an inspiring walk through the East End, uncovering the remarkable stories of pioneering women like Mary Wollstonecraft and Eva Luckes. This engaging journey highlights the tireless efforts of those who fought for equal rights and better living conditions, offering a unique glimpse into their impactful legacies.

tours.name: Night Photo Walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating Night Photo Walk through York, starting at Clifford’s Tower and exploring iconic sites like the Shambles and Lendal Bridge. Led by a professional photographer, you'll enhance your skills in composition, lighting, and creativity while enjoying the city's nighttime beauty in a small, supportive group.

tours.name: Brighton Seabound Adventure
tours.description: Sail from Newhaven on a luxury boat, feeling the sea breeze and speeding past stunning coastlines. Reach lively Brighton, enjoy city sights, and maybe take a swim—creating unforgettable memories in just 90 minutes.

tours.name: Mobile Planetarium
tours.description: Embark on an extraordinary journey through the cosmos with Dark Sky Wales! In just a few hours, discover the mysteries of the Universe from a comfortable venue. Explore constellations, their mythologies, and venture into deep space, encountering planets, star clusters, and nebulae for an unforgettable celestial experience.

tours.name: Sailors’ Carving: The Roots of Scrimshaw - 22/08-29/08
tours.description: Uncover the maritime art of sailors with a hands-on workshop and lively talks. Carve symbols, initials, and ships inspired by historic scrimshaw, bringing Elizabethan seafarers’ creativity to life for all ages.

tours.name: Christmas Dinner Cruise
tours.description: Experience a delightful Christmas roast dinner aboard a charming narrowboat as you cruise through the scenic Lancashire waterways. Enjoy a choice of turkey, chicken, honey glazed ham, or nut roast, complemented by herb roasted potatoes and unlimited drinks. This unique combination of gourmet dining and picturesque views promises a memorable holiday experience.

tours.name: Journey Through The Ages
tours.description: Embark on a captivating Journey Through The Ages Experience, exploring 30 years of Arran Whisky history. Begin in the still house, savor a dram straight from the cask, and taste iconic whiskies in the tasting room. Perfect for whisky enthusiasts eager to deepen their knowledge of Arran's rich distilling heritage.

tours.name: Womens Paddle Board Guided Trip
tours.description: Enjoy a half-day paddleboarding adventure with top gear, wildlife sightings, secret coves, and a beach fire. Perfect for all skill levels, this trip offers stunning scenery and fun memories on the water.

tours.name: Thai Street Food @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Thai street food in 2 hours: make spicy tom yum soup, sizzling stir-fry, vibrant salad, and fluffy rice. Cook, taste, and enjoy a colorful feast at our chef’s table—no experience needed.

tours.name: Embers Campsite Hire
tours.description: Embark on a full-day kayaking adventure along the serene River Thames, perfect for families and adults alike. Paddle through picturesque reaches, enjoy stops at charming pubs and ice cream shops, and create lasting memories in nature. Experience the tranquility of the river while ensuring safety with provided buoyancy aids.

tours.name: Fox Fascination Experience
tours.description: Meet charming, friendly foxes in private magical spots at Somerset Reindeer Ranch. Spend 40 minutes capturing unforgettable moments with these enchanting creatures guided by experts.

tours.name: Paddle Activity Fun Session @ Westbury Lake
tours.description: Splash into adventure at Westbury Lake with WOLT instructors! Paddle canoes, stand-up boards, and a giant SUP in a fun 1-hour 45-minute session for ages 7+. Get ready to get wet and enjoy the water!

tours.name: Alpaca and Goat Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Experience a charming afternoon tea surrounded by friendly alpacas and goats. Spend time feeding and pampering these delightful animals, then unwind in a scenic picnic area with breathtaking views of the fields and distant sea. This unique blend of animal interaction and relaxation creates a truly memorable outing.

tours.name: Christmas Charm in Festive England (Shared, Half-Day)
tours.description: Step into a winter wonderland with a 4-hour tour from Bath, exploring charming villages, historic cottages, and festive shops. Warm up with seasonal treats amid England’s timeless holiday scenery.

tours.name: Curling at Bristol Christmas Village, Castle Park
tours.description: Try a fun, eco-friendly twist on curling on our recycled-surface rink. Perfect for family, friends, or colleagues, it offers all the thrill of ice curling with a sustainable touch. Book your game now!

tours.name: Book a party!
tours.description: Experience a memorable paddle boarding adventure on the River Thames, tailored for any occasion. Enjoy a fun-filled session with expert guidance, engaging games, and the chance to learn a new sport while exploring the scenic river. Create lasting memories in a safe and supportive environment.

tours.name: Kids Activities Party
tours.description: Create an unforgettable party by selecting from a variety of exciting activities! Whether you’re paddling in kayaks, constructing rafts, navigating a low ropes course, or engaging in bushcraft, each option promises a unique adventure. Enjoy teamwork and fun with options like Earthball, Tag Rugby, and Two-man Trikes for an exhilarating experience!

tours.name: Inspiring Chelsea Women
tours.description: Discover the inspiring stories of bold women who shaped history in Chelsea. This 90-minute walking tour, starting at the National Army Museum, reveals the humorous and tragic tales of a soldier, a singer, a queen, and a fashion icon, all while exploring the charming back streets of this iconic area.

tours.name: Holiday Club Half Day

With activities like feeding animals, engaging in crafts, and exploring nature, kids create lasting memories while learning new skills. Choose between a half or full day for a tailored farm adventure!

tours.name: Introduction to Fishing Rod & Line - Coastal Catcher
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2.5-hour fishing adventure perfect for families and beginners! Learn essential angling skills while enjoying hands-on practice with casting and reeling in your first catch. With expert guidance and stunning coastal views, this interactive experience promises fun and unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Evening Fishing Trip (4 hr) - Lone Shark III
tours.description: Catch lively bass, rays, and more as the sun sets on Weymouth’s famous waters. A 4-hour evening trip targeting top inshore species, perfect for all skill levels in stunning coastal scenery.

tours.name: Bairnkine Lambing Tour

tours.description: Embark on a unique private taxi tour of London, guided by an expert driver. Discover hidden alleyways, historic landmarks, and untold stories that most tourists overlook. tours.name: Fishing

Perfect for anglers of all levels, this tranquil setting offers the thrill of reeling in a big catch or simply enjoying nature's beauty. Every cast promises relaxation and excitement in a memorable outdoor escape.

Enjoy engaging commentary from a family-run team with over 80 years of experience.

tours.name: Breadmaking
tours.description: Unleash your creativity in a lively breadmaking workshop, where you'll learn about yeast, grains, and craft your own delicious loaves alongside experts with mill experience. Fun, hands-on, and rewarding!

tours.name: Jazz Cruise

tours.name: Hen Party River Cruise on The Thames • Private Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate in style on a 90-minute Thames cruise with stunning views, a professional skipper, and bubbly. Tailored routes showcase riverside villages, lush meadows, and scenic waterways—perfect for unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Low Season Private Charter
tours.description: Celebrate with friends on a private Oxford cruise, customizing your journey with entertainment and catering. Enjoy scenic views of riverside villages, lush meadows, and wildlife—an unforgettable, stylish river adventure.

tours.name: Giants Causeway and Carrick a Rede Ropebridge Small Group Tour

tours.name: Celtic Deep Tuna Fishing

tours.description: Kids aged 9+ can enjoy a fun, safe SUP program with expert guidance, small groups, and all gear provided. They’ll build skills, confidence, and make new friends while staying active and having a great time.

tours.name: Hillsborough Royal Brew Walk & Picnic Experience
tours.description: Embark on the Hillsborough Royal Brew, a captivating 5K guided walk through the enchanting landscapes of Royal Hillsborough. Discover its rich royal and brewing history while enjoying a locally sourced picnic amidst stunning scenery. Led by heritage enthusiast Nikki Elliott, this small-group experience promises an immersive journey into the area's charm.

tours.name: STAG BREAKS
tours.description: Swap pub crawls for thrilling river canoe trips, camping under the stars, and cooking over open fires. Biggar Adventure crafts custom outdoor stag parties across Scotland for unforgettable adventures.

tours.name: Low Tide Harbour Tour (Paddle + Walk)
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure along Norfolk's stunning natural coast! Paddle through shallow creeks, explore picturesque scenery, and enjoy wildlife spotting before swimming in deeper waters. Experience the thrill of the tide carrying you home while learning essential skills in small groups. Perfect for outdoor enthusiasts seeking excitement and connection with nature!

tours.name: Mariners Mile Swim Event
tours.description: Join the Mariners Mile Open Water Swim on September 27, 2025, at HYMB in Cheshunt, Hertfordshire. With distances for all skill levels, participants aged 14 and over can enjoy a scenic swim in the beautiful Lea Valley. Each swimmer receives a medal, and a portion of fees supports Cancer Research UK.

tours.name: Belfast Ukulele Festival  | Individual Seats
tours.description: Experience the vibrant streets of Belfast on a unique cycling tour, where you can pedal past iconic landmarks like City Hall and the Opera House. Enjoy a bespoke adventure filled with laughter, drinks, and your favorite ukulele tunes, making it the perfect outing for celebrations and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Best of British Beer Tasting
tours.description: Taste five top British craft beers, learn their stories, and enjoy a free drink in Hiver’s Taproom. Take home a branded glass, seasonal seeds, and a new appreciation for Britain’s brewing innovation.

tours.name: Bellyboard Lesson
tours.description: Catch unbroken green waves and master bellyboarding in a fun, friendly group. Perfect for beginners and all ages, this 1.5-hour session offers expert guidance, equipment, and a chance to enjoy Newquay’s beaches.

tours.name: Tunnel Walk
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 3-hour journey through the Torpantau Tunnel, the highest tunnel on the UK's standard gauge network. Stretching 666 yards, this unique experience combines breathtaking views with rich history, as you navigate the impressive masonry arch under the guidance of an instructor, completing an unforgettable tunnel challenge.

tours.name: Woman's Surf & Wild Camp Weekend
tours.description: Join a thrilling weekend of surfing, bellyboarding, and wild camping in Cornwall. Enjoy ocean waves, woodland games, fire-cooked meals, and starry nights—perfect for solo travelers or friends seeking outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Cornish Surfing
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating surfing adventure at Polzeath Beach with Cornish Surfing lessons! Over three hours, you'll learn essential skills like catching waves and paddling, guided by experienced instructors. Perfect for all skill levels, this unforgettable experience is ideal for families, friends, and groups looking to ride the waves together.

tours.name: Ladies Night (Big slope)
tours.description: Join a unique skiing experience designed exclusively for women, where you'll receive personalized tips from friendly instructors on the big slope. After enhancing your skills, unwind with coffee and cake, fostering new friendships in a supportive atmosphere. Perfect for those looking to improve while enjoying a relaxed, social environment.

tours.name: Prosecco Boat Trip - Private Hire
tours.description: Embark on a stylish 50-minute cruise aboard the charming Lady Pamela, a classic 60’s vessel. Enjoy two glasses of Prosecco as you glide down the River Avon, taking in stunning sights like Bath Abbey. With a knowledgeable crew to guide you, this experience promises unforgettable moments and picturesque photo opportunities.

tours.name: Cornish Surfing Small Group Session (Max 5 Persons)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with Cornish Surfing's Small Group Sessions at Polzeath Beach. With personalized attention from instructors, these sessions cater to both beginners and those with prior lessons. Enjoy the perfect waves while making unforgettable memories in a supportive and fun environment. Join us for an exhilarating adventure!

tours.name: Cornish Surfing Private Lessons
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with Cornish Surfing Private Lessons at Polzeath Beach! Enjoy personalized instruction tailored to your skill level, whether you're a beginner or more advanced. With dedicated attention from your instructor, you'll make unforgettable memories while riding the waves in a stunning coastal setting.

tours.name: Sightseeing - Dancing Ledge
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-hour sightseeing adventure from Swanage Pier to Dancing Ledge. Marvel at stunning views of Durlston Castle and Anvil Point lighthouse, while spotting diverse wildlife, including guillemots and possibly puffins. Enjoy exceptional photography opportunities and witness the excitement of cliff climbing and coasteering from a unique perspective.

tours.name: GelBlaster Open Session
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the Gelblaster Surge in a unique WW2 RAF Hospital and Bunker Complex! Perfect for ages 6 and up, this exciting 2-hour session offers unlimited Gellets, high-quality face masks, and a safe, mess-free environment. Join the fun and unleash your competitive spirit in this unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Beginners SUP Group Session
tours.description: Join fellow beginners for an exciting introduction to paddleboarding! In this two-hour session, you'll learn essential techniques, water safety, and self-rescue skills from experienced instructors. Enjoy a supportive environment as you gain confidence on the water, making new friends while embarking on your adventure-filled paddling journey.

tours.name: Family SUP Session
tours.description: Experience unforgettable family fun on the water with a private paddleboarding session! Enjoy laughter and games while learning essential skills and safety tips from our Paddle Cabin Crew. Perfect for all ages, this two-hour adventure promises joy and bonding as you navigate the waves together. Make lasting memories on this unique outing!

tours.name: SUP & Blue Therapy
tours.description: Experience a rejuvenating 3-hour mini-retreat at Paddle Cabin, blending paddle boarding, yoga, and meditation under the stars. Enjoy calming herbal teas and nourishing snacks by the campfire, all while connecting with nature. Perfect for all abilities, this unique evening promises relaxation and mindfulness in a serene setting.

tours.name: SUP & Campfire Adventure
tours.description: Join our unique SUP & Campfire event for a memorable evening of adventure and connection. Paddle along a serene river at sunset, then gather around a cozy campfire to enjoy s'mores and share stories with fellow outdoor enthusiasts. All skill levels are welcome for this adults-only experience!

tours.name: Paddlesport Safety Rescue Course
tours.description: Join a one-day British Canoeing multicraft course to master paddlesport safety and rescue techniques for kayaks, canoes, and paddle boards. With expert trainers guiding you through practical skills and safety practices, this immersive experience ensures you gain confidence on the water, making it a memorable step towards becoming a skilled paddler.

tours.name: Paddlesport Instructor
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-day journey with the British Canoeing qualification, designed for newcomers to paddlesports. This hands-on course covers essential skills, safety, and fun activities across kayak, canoe, and SUP. Gain confidence and expertise while enjoying the adventure of learning in a supportive environment, perfect for aspiring paddling instructors.

tours.name: Surfing Lessons
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing on the breathtaking North Devon coast! Tailored lessons for all skill levels ensure personalized attention and safety. Beginners will learn the essentials, while advanced surfers can refine their techniques. With professional instructors and all equipment provided, dive into an unforgettable ocean adventure!

tours.name: Canoe
tours.description: Experience the serene beauty of Frisby Lakes with an hour of canoeing on a picturesque open water lake. Choose from a variety of kayaks, canoes, and paddle boards, all equipped with buoyancy aids for safety. Enjoy the stunning views and create unforgettable memories in this tranquil setting.

tours.name: SUP & Hike: Lake District (Teal)
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable Adventure Weekend in the stunning Lake District! Over four days, you'll paddle breathtaking lakes, hike iconic mountains, and connect with fellow adventurers. Experience guided explorations, learn navigation skills, and unwind in hot tubs, all while creating epic memories in a beautiful natural setting.

tours.name: Clovelly Paddleboard Tours
tours.description: Embark on a memorable two-hour paddleboarding adventure along the breathtaking North Devon coastline with Sandy SUP & Surf. Guided by expert James, this customizable tour welcomes all skill levels and includes all necessary equipment and admission to Clovelly Estate. Experience stunning views and create lasting memories on the water!

tours.name: Private Babbacombe Bay Boat Tour
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Babbacombe Bay on a private VIP boat tour. Glide along stunning coastlines, witness marine wildlife, and enjoy the flexibility to swim or relax. With luxury amenities and customizable options, this unforgettable adventure promises a unique day at sea, perfect for creating lasting memories with friends or family.

tours.name: Babbacombe Bay Boat Tour
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Babbacombe Bay on a VIP boat tour! Glide along stunning coastlines, witness marine wildlife, and enjoy a refreshing swim if you choose. With luxury amenities and a chance to relax with food and drinks onboard, this two-hour adventure promises unforgettable memories at sea.

tours.name: River Exe Tour
tours.description: Experience a serene one-hour cruise on The River Exe, where breathtaking scenery and vibrant wildlife await. Departing from Exmouth Marina, you'll glide past Dawlish Warren and along Exmouth's sandy seafront. Enjoy the luxury of a comfortable Italian rib, complete with a sound system and swim platform for a memorable adventure.

tours.name: RLSS Drowning Prevention Week Event
tours.description: Join us for a Free Water Safety Session on June 17th, designed for young people aged 8 and up, along with families. Learn essential rescue and survival techniques from qualified instructors, get in the water, and enjoy additional activities like open water swimming and CPR introduction. No pre-booking required!

tours.name: Summer fun Afternoon Tea Bus experience & live commentary
tours.description: Join us for a unique afternoon of networking aboard a classic Routemaster bus in London! Enjoy a delightful afternoon tea featuring scrumptious treats while taking in iconic sights like Buckingham Palace and the London Eye. With live commentary on hidden Muslim gems, this unforgettable experience is perfect for friends and family alike.

tours.name: Easter Holiday SUP Club Fit and Fed
tours.description: Kids aged 9+ can enjoy a fun, safe week of learning SUP skills, building water confidence, and making friends. Small groups, expert guidance, and all equipment provided—plus snacks and lunch daily.

tours.name: Family Adventure Day
tours.description: Experience a day of connection and adventure at Unplug and Play Day. Families will lock away their devices to engage in archery, explore the picturesque Beaulieu River by canoe, and stroll through the charming village of Beaulieu. Create unforgettable memories while enjoying the beauty of the New Forest together.

tours.name: Jurassic Coast Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey along the breathtaking Jurassic Coast aboard a luxurious Italian RIB. With only seven spots available, enjoy an intimate exploration of ancient red sandstone cliffs, spot local wildlife, and experience the thrill of passing a Royal Marines firing range. Swim, relax, and create lasting memories in this stunning UNESCO World Heritage Site.

tours.name: Gennaro Contaldo: Cucina
tours.description: Join Gennaro Contaldo for a 3-hour Italian cooking class, making hearty, budget-friendly dishes like cheesy polenta, creamy pasta, and flavorful mackerel. Leave inspired, full, and with a signed cookbook.

tours.name: SUP Adventure Day
tours.description: Join over 40 exciting paddling trips each year, open to all adventurous souls! Explore stunning locations across Kent, Sussex, Surrey, Essex, and London, while enjoying engaging conversations with fellow paddlers. With qualified leaders guiding you through unique spots and a supportive atmosphere, every outing promises unforgettable outdoor connections and experiences.

tours.name: Hallowe'en at Hilden Brewery
tours.description: Experience a thrilling family day at Hilden House with a spooky walk featuring skeletons and ghosts! Kids can enjoy Halloween games, pumpkin carving, and delicious treats from the Stables café. Warm up with spiced cider or hot chocolate, and toast S'mores by the fire pit for a memorable outing!

tours.name: Welsh White Water SUP Weekend
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable weekend in the stunning Dee Valley, North Wales, with Stand Up Paddleboard UK and Sup Lass Paddle Adventures. Enjoy luxury bunkhouse accommodation, delicious Welsh cuisine, and expert coaching in white water paddling. Perfect for all skill levels, this adventure promises thrilling river journeys and camaraderie in a breathtaking setting.

tours.name: VR Free Roam Arena
tours.description: Dive into the exhilarating world of Festive Point VR this Christmas! Experience cutting-edge, wireless virtual reality in a vast arena with thrilling themes like Pirates and Haunted Mansion. Engage in epic battles with friends or foes, creating unforgettable memories in Bournemouth's unique gaming adventure. Join the fun and unleash your imagination!

tours.name: NEW MULTIPLAYER VR
tours.description: Experience the thrill of six unique games at Festive Point! From the teamwork of "Cook'd Out" in a bustling virtual kitchen to the adrenaline-pumping "Espionage Express Escape Room," each title offers a memorable adventure. Battle zombies in "Dead Ahead," defend against trolls in "Arrowsong," or compete in the futuristic "Quantum Arena."

tours.name: White Water SUP Weekend
tours.description: Join us in Devon for an exhilarating white water paddleboarding experience, perfect for adventurers of all levels! Learn essential skills with expert coaches, navigate thrilling rapids, and boost your confidence on the water. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your technique, this unique adventure promises unforgettable memories.

tours.name: SUP & Hike: Slovenia (Teal)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day adventure in Slovenia's stunning Soca Valley! Experience the perfect blend of hiking, cliff jumping, whitewater rafting, and paddleboarding on breathtaking alpine lakes. Connect with fellow adventurers while exploring iconic sites like Lake Bled, all while enjoying guided activities and comfortable accommodations. Create unforgettable memories!

tours.name: WWSUP & Raft: Slovenia (Navy)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day adventure in the stunning Julian Alps, where you'll conquer iconic white waters and serene alpine lakes. Connect with fellow paddlers while honing your skills under expert guidance. Experience breathtaking landscapes, unforgettable camaraderie, and the perfect blend of excitement and relaxation in this unforgettable getaway.

tours.name: SUP & Camp: River Wye (Navy)
tours.description: Join our thrilling 3.5-day Adventure Weekend, where you'll paddle through the stunning Wye Valley, camp under the stars, and connect with fellow adventurers. Experience expert coaching, tackle moving water, and enjoy wild swims, all while creating unforgettable memories. This is the ultimate SUP expedition for those ready to elevate their paddling skills!

tours.name: Fire & Wild Camp: East Sussex (Teal)
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable two-day Adventure Weekend in a private woodland, where you'll master essential bushcraft skills like fire lighting and outdoor cooking. Connect with fellow adventurers, enjoy group activities, and immerse yourself in nature while creating lasting memories. Experience the thrill of wild camping and living off-grid!

tours.name: SUP & Sauna: Bath (Teal)
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable four-day Adventure Weekend, where glamping meets thrilling outdoor activities! Experience breathtaking paddles through Bath, learn bushcraft skills, and hike the stunning Mendip hills. Connect with like-minded adventurers while enjoying a private campsite, sauna, and indoor pool. Create lasting memories in nature’s embrace!

tours.name: Serial Killers: The Blood & Tears London Walk • Private
tours.description: Embark on a chilling two-hour journey with "Serial Killers: The Blood and Tears Walk," led by passionate storyteller Declan McHugh. Explore the haunting tales of eleven notorious serial killers, including Jack the Ripper, in eerie locations. This immersive, victim-centered experience promises to enlighten and thrill, leaving a lasting impression.

tours.name: Traditional British Afternoon High Tea by the Riverside
tours.description: Experience the charm of Oxford's Folly Bridge with an exquisite afternoon high tea. Delight in freshly made sandwiches, fluffy scones with cream and jam, and an array of delectable cakes, all complemented by a sparkling glass of prosecco. Enjoy serene riverside views in a setting that embodies tradition and elegance.

tours.name: Brancaster Staithe Saltmarsh Stand Up Paddleboard Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling Stand Up Paddleboard Safari, exploring the stunning saltmarsh habitat and picturesque Brancaster Staithe Harbour. Guided by expert coaches, tailor your adventure to your group's pace, mastering skills while enjoying breathtaking scenery. Unique experiences include paddling along flooded roads and the chance to bring your dog along for the fun!

tours.name: Corporate SUP Experience
tours.description: Join us for an exhilarating 2-hour paddleboarding adventure designed for teams of all skill levels! Experience the thrill of the water while engaging in fun activities, river litter picks, and campfires. Capture unforgettable memories with free group photos, and enjoy a refreshing break from the office in a unique outdoor setting.

tours.name: Xtra Games
tours.description: Dive into an exhilarating virtual reality experience with over 50 top-tier games at your fingertips! Choose to play solo, team up with a friend, or compete against each other. With the freedom to switch games anytime, every session promises unique thrills and unforgettable moments.

tours.name: VR Escape Room
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a VR Escape Room in just 60 minutes! Gather your team—friends, family, or couples—and dive into one of 13 unique storylines. Collaborate to solve puzzles and escape before time runs out, making unforgettable memories along the way. Adventure awaits!

tours.name: Gennaro Contaldo: Verdure @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Join Gennaro Contaldo for a lively 3-hour Italian veggie cookery class. Make vibrant dishes like spinach gnocchi and baked courgette, then enjoy your creations with a slice of carrot cake and limoncello.

tours.name: Paddleboarding Parties
tours.description: Create unforgettable memories with our exciting two-hour birthday party on the water! Tailored for children aged 8 and up, enjoy fun games, a picnic in our outdoor lounge, and even a mermaid paddleboarding theme. Capture the day with free photos while your child and friends embark on this unique adventure!

tours.name: Hen & Stag SUP Experience
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable 2-hour paddling adventure perfect for hen or stag parties! Enjoy fun games, SUP Polo, and even a wild swim, all while creating lasting memories. With free photos to capture the day, this unique experience promises laughter and excitement on the water for everyone involved!

tours.name: Lewis Carroll and Alice in Wonderland
tours.description: Explore Oxford’s rich history and the origins of Alice in Wonderland with a personalized, expert-guided tour. Visit iconic sites, hidden gems, and learn fascinating stories about Lewis Carroll, Alice, and Oxford’s legendary landmarks.

tours.name: Silent Disco Tour
tours.description: Experience the vibrant streets of Bath like never before on this unique dance tour! With high-tech headphones, groove to timeless tunes while exploring iconic sights like Bath Abbey and Queens Square. Join lively guides who’ll dance alongside you, making this an unforgettable blend of music, movement, and city exploration.

tours.name: Prosecco Boat Trip - Private Hire
tours.description: Embark on a stylish 50-minute cruise aboard the charming Lady Pamela, a classic 60s vessel. Enjoy two glasses of prosecco while soaking in stunning views of Bath Abbey and Pulteney Weir. With a knowledgeable crew to guide you, this unique experience promises unforgettable moments and the perfect backdrop for memorable photos.

tours.name: Dinner & Tour (The George inn, Gallery)
tours.description: Experience a thrilling blend of history and cuisine at The George Inn in London! Enjoy a delectable 2 or 3-course meal featuring classic dishes like steak and ale pie and sticky toffee pudding. Immerse yourself in the past while savoring flavors, and prepare for spine-chilling tales that await you!

tours.name: Smash Point
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Smash Point, a vibrant VR game where you can compete or collaborate with up to 10 players! Armed with an array of funky weapons, engage in exhilarating battles reminiscent of paintball and dodgeball. Perfect for families, parties, and younger players, this activity promises unforgettable fun!

tours.name: A 'Taylor Swift & Friends' Silent Disco Adventure in Liverpool
tours.description: Join a thrilling 60-minute Taylor Swift themed Silent Disco Adventure, where you can dance like nobody's watching! With hi-tech headsets and expert guides, unleash your inner Swiftie and experience the city in a whole new light. Bring your family, wear comfy shoes, and prepare for an unforgettable hour of fun!

tours.name: Arcade Free-Roam VR
tours.description: Dive into an exhilarating VR adventure with our Arcade Free-Roam experience! Choose from six thrilling games, including zombie shooting and cooking challenges, all in your own private arena. Perfect for groups of 2 to 4, this immersive journey promises unforgettable fun and excitement for everyone involved!

tours.name: Free-Roam VR Party
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 60-minute Arcade Free Roam party, where you and your friends can battle zombies, whip up culinary delights, or groove to infectious beats while fending off computer viruses. Choose from six thrilling games, split into two private arenas for an unforgettable adventure with your team!

tours.name: Xtra Games Party
tours.description: Dive into an exhilarating 60-minute virtual reality party featuring over 50 top-tier games! Enjoy the freedom to switch between titles, play solo, or compete with friends. Experience premium favorites like Super Hot and Job Simulator, making it the perfect blend of collaboration and individual excitement for all guests.

tours.name: VR Escape Room Party
tours.description: Experience the thrill of our Escape Room VR Parties, where you and your friends race against the clock in one of 13 unique virtual escape rooms. Collaborate to solve challenges and escape before time runs out, making for an unforgettable adventure filled with excitement and teamwork!

tours.name: Smash Point Party
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable hour of fun with Smash Point, a vibrant VR game where you can compete or collaborate with friends. Choose your game modes and teams while wielding an array of quirky weapons. Perfect for parties, this exciting game accommodates up to 10 players for an action-packed adventure!

tours.name: 'Back to the 90s' Silent Disco Adventure
tours.description: Experience the vibrant energy of the 90s in Manchester with a unique Silent Disco Adventure! Dance to iconic hits while wearing hi-tech headsets, guided through a nostalgic journey filled with laughter and unforgettable moments. Embrace the spirit of the decade and discover a new side of yourself in this exhilarating hour-long tour!

tours.name: A Eurovision Silent Disco Adventure in Liverpool
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 60-minute Eurovision adventure with our lively Disco Hosts! Experience the magic of disco as you dance through Liverpool's iconic spots, including Mathew Street and the Cavern Club. Perfect for families, this unique tour invites you to unleash your inner pop star and create unforgettable music video moments!

tours.name: Kids Paddleboarding Party
tours.description: Create unforgettable memories with our children's paddleboarding parties! Enjoy two hours of fun on the water filled with games and races, followed by exclusive access to our outdoor lounge. Capture every moment with complimentary digital photos, and relax with family while the kids paddle away. Join the adventure today!

tours.name: Kids Adventure Day
tours.description: This summer, let your child embark on an unforgettable outdoor adventure! With paddleboarding as the highlight, they'll also enjoy campfires, team games, and orienteering. Led by qualified instructors, each day promises fun, skill-building, and the chance to forge lasting friendships in a vibrant, nature-filled setting.

tours.name: Learn to Hydrofoil Experience
tours.description: Elevate your board sports skills with our learn-to-hydrofoil experience! Enjoy 30 minutes of exhilarating on-water time, complete with all necessary equipment and expert coaching. This advanced watersport is perfect for intermediate wakeboarders, kiteboarders, surfers, and SUPboarders ready to embrace the thrill of foil riding.

tours.name: SUP & Explore
tours.description: Join a thrilling 3-hour paddleboarding adventure that enhances your skills and builds confidence on the water. Guided by experienced instructors, explore scenic riverside landscapes while connecting with fellow paddlers. Enjoy tips and breaks as you glide past meadows and woodlands, making this journey both memorable and enjoyable for all skill levels.

tours.name: Sophie Wyburd: Tucking In
tours.description: Join Sophie Wyburd for a flavorful cooking class featuring crab pasta, vibrant beetroot salad, crispy corn pakoras, and hazelnut tiramisu. Leave with new recipes and her debut cookbook, Tucking In.

tours.name: Japanese Feast @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Japanese dishes in a lively 2-hour class. Make miso soup, crispy gyoza, silky nasu dengaku, and perfect sticky rice. Enjoy your feast at the chef’s table with drinks and a recipe pack to recreate at home.

tours.name: Next-level gnocchi @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Italian gnocchi from scratch, learning to make fluffy dumplings, rich sauces, and whipped ricotta. Enjoy your homemade meal with wine or soft drinks in a lively, hands-on cooking class.

tours.name: Wine & Cheese Tasting with optional lunch
tours.description: Savor local wines and cheeses amid Somerset’s stunning countryside on a private vineyard tour. Optional lunch at top spots adds a delicious touch—perfect for special groups seeking a memorable tasting experience.

tours.name: Flavours of the West Country
tours.description: Explore Somerset’s lush countryside on a 6-7 hour tour with local food, organic gardens, cheese-making, and cider tasting. Enjoy stunning scenery, delicious flavors, and expert insights—all in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: Brilliant Bao @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create soft, fluffy bao buns from scratch, fill them with spicy Kung Pao chicken or mushrooms, and enjoy your handmade dumplings at the chef’s table. All ingredients and expert guidance included.

tours.name: VEX Play • 60 Mins
tours.description: Experience the thrill of VEX Play, a 60-minute free-roam VR adventure where you and your friends become the heroes of immersive stories. Choose from action-packed games like battling zombies or uncovering pirate secrets. With total freedom to move and interact, this unforgettable experience redefines virtual reality fun!

tours.name: London: Jack the Ripper Guided Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-hour guided tour through London's East End, delving into the chilling mystery of Jack the Ripper. Explore historic cobbled streets, visit key murder sites, and uncover the dark theories surrounding the infamous killer. Experience the haunting legacy of Victorian London with a knowledgeable guide.

tours.name: Spring Lamb & Baby Animals Experience
tours.description: Experience an exclusive lambing adventure in April 2026, where you'll meet not just lambs, but also playful kid goats, adorable piglets, and charming baby alpacas. Enjoy private access to the animals, ensuring ample time for cuddles and memorable photos in a serene, intimate setting away from larger crowds.

tours.name: Cotswolds, Antiques & Autumnal Colours (Private)
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour journey through the enchanting Cotswolds this autumn. Discover the historic town of Tetbury, renowned for antiques and design, savor a delightful lunch, and explore the breathtaking Westonbirt Arboretum, showcasing stunning fall colors. Experience rural England's charm with a knowledgeable local guide.

tours.name: Woodland Ranger Full Day Experience
tours.description: All ages • 4 hours • Become a ranger for the day in the Scottish Borders, includes lunch and journal

tours.name: BCAB Paddle SAFER Award - Water safety course
tours.description: Join us for a hands-on water safety session designed for beginner to intermediate paddlers! Over 2.5 hours, you'll learn essential self-rescue techniques, equipment knowledge, and how to assist others in distress. Gain confidence and earn your BCAB Paddle Safer Award while enjoying the thrill of paddling safely on the water!

tours.name: Mission Z • Part 1&2
tours.description: Experience the thrill of survival in **Mission Z** and **Mission Z II**, where you and your team face relentless zombies in a fully immersive VR world. Navigate a cursed manor, solve intense puzzles, and escape on a chaotic train ride. Can you conquer the undead and emerge victorious?

tours.name: Mission Z
tours.description: Experience the thrill of survival in **Mission Z**, where you and your team are trapped in Lord Grave’s haunted manor. Navigate dark corridors, solve puzzles, and battle relentless zombies in a fully immersive VR environment. Teamwork and quick reflexes are essential—can you escape before it’s too late?

tours.name: Mission Z II
tours.description: Join the thrilling "Mission Z II" where you and your team must navigate a hidden mine, escort a bomb, and escape a relentless horde of zombies. Experience next-level free-roam VR, intense puzzles, and a heart-pounding train ride. Will you survive Lord Grave's ultimate undead challenge? Book your adventure now!

tours.name: Lunarscape
tours.description: Experience the thrill of being stranded on the Moon in "Lunarscape: Breakdown," a fully immersive VR escape room. Team up with 2-6 players to solve intricate puzzles, repair critical systems, and uncover hidden secrets before time runs out. Can you restore power and make it back home?

tours.name: Birds of prey experience
tours.description: All ages • 2 hours • Enjoy a fantastic hands on birds of prey experience!

tours.name: Dead Ahead (the Trilogy)
tours.description: Experience the ultimate zombie survival challenge in "Dead Ahead: The Trilogy." Team up with 2-6 players to navigate three harrowing locations: the claustrophobic hospital, the chaotic city, and the final stand at the church. With intense VR action and no random players, your survival depends on teamwork and strategy. Will you escape?

tours.name: Italian Masterclass at Jamie's Home
tours.description: Join a fun-filled day at Jamie’s Essex home to make authentic Italian dishes. Bake focaccia, craft fresh pasta, create vibrant antipasti, pick garden veggies, and enjoy a delicious outdoor feast with wine.

tours.name: Uyen Luu: Quick & Easy Vietnamese
tours.description: Create vibrant Vietnamese dishes in 3 hours: prawn ravioli with lime chili, fragrant chicken noodle soup, fresh summer rolls, and sweetcorn rice pudding. Learn from Uyen Luu’s cookbook and take home your own recipes.

tours.name: Kingston Hospital Charity event
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable evening of paddling on SUPs, kayaks, and canoes while supporting Kingston Hospital Charity. Enjoy a self-guided session, receive optional tuition, and savor freshly made pizza with a refreshing drink. Join us for a fun-filled adventure that combines outdoor excitement with a meaningful cause!

tours.name: Agak Agak: Everyday Recipes From Singapore
tours.description: Join Shu Han Lee for a lively 3-hour cooking class, mastering Singaporean favorites like Hainanese Chicken Rice, flavorful sauces, Rojak salad, and frothy Teh Tarik. Enjoy your homemade feast with expert tips and a cookbook to take home.

tours.name: Bristol Hotspots & Hidden Treasures
tours.description: Taste Bristol’s best with 7-8 stops of local eats and drinks, from hearty burgers to cocktails. Explore hidden gems and iconic spots, savor delicious samples, and uncover the city’s vibrant stories on this flexible, private tour.

tours.name: Next-level gnocchi @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create perfect, fluffy gnocchi from scratch, cook a rich tomato sauce, whip creamy ricotta, and enjoy your homemade Italian feast at the chef’s table. All ingredients and tips included—bring your appetite!

tours.name: Tandem Sit-In Sea Kayak
tours.description: Experience the thrill of tandem sea kayaking with our Sit-on-Top kayaks, perfect for two paddlers. Explore the coastline safely with a friend or child, enjoying a stable and comfortable ride. Glide effortlessly through the water while creating unforgettable memories on this unique aquatic adventure. Equipment rental included for your convenience.

tours.name: Chinese Made Easy: Simple, Modern Recipes For Every Day @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Join chef Kwoklyn Wan to master tender Sweet Vinegar Ribs and vibrant Chinese dishes. Learn simple tricks, make flavorful sauces, and recreate restaurant favorites in just 3 hours—plus, take home his cookbook.

tours.name: Other booking
