tours.description: For calendar management

tours.name: Ethical Dairy Farm Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique walking tour of our farm, where you'll meet friendly cows and their calves. Discover our innovative farming practices that promote climate positivity and biodiversity. Engage in insightful discussions tailored to your interests, and feel free to ask questions as you learn about sustainable agriculture firsthand.

tours.name: SSI Drysuit Course
tours.description: Experience the thrill of dry suit diving with the SSI Dry Suit Diving specialty program. Learn essential techniques and safety measures while mastering specialized equipment. Enjoy warmth during multi-dive days and gain confidence in handling unique dry suit emergencies. Complete the course and earn your certification for unforgettable underwater adventures.

tours.name: SSI Explorers Kids half-term Club (6 sessions)
tours.description: Dive into adventure with our flexible snorkel and scuba diving programs! Tailored to fit your busy lifestyle, enjoy half and full term sessions without the constraints of school terms. Explore the underwater world at your own pace, with the freedom to make up any missed sessions for a stress-free experience.

tours.name: Bespoke Private Experience
tours.description: Embark on a personalized private tour tailored to your interests and pace. Explore stunning coastlines, secret woodland trails, or enjoy a relaxing boat trip. Perfect for families and friends, this exclusive experience includes breathtaking locations and a knowledgeable local guide, ensuring unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Level 2 Paddleboard Course
tours.description: Master paddleboarding in Dartmouth’s stunning waters, spotting seals and dolphins, exploring sea caves, and boosting your skills on premium boards—an adventure that combines wildlife, challenge, and confidence.

tours.name: Level 1 Paddleboard Course
tours.description: Learn to paddleboard in Dartmouth’s stunning waters, spotting seals and dolphins, exploring sea caves, and mastering balance on premium boards—all in a fun, confidence-boosting two-day course.

tours.name: Private Charter
tours.description: Experience the beauty of Blakeney Harbour with a private sailing adventure to view seals at Blakeney Point. Choose between one or two-hour hire slots, allowing for a personalized journey tailored to your desires. Enjoy stunning scenery and the thrill of sailing in this picturesque coastal setting.

tours.name: Ash Scatterings
tours.description: Create a heartfelt tribute by scattering ashes in a stunning location or celebrate a life with a unique seal-watching experience. Tailored to your wishes, this memorable journey combines personal reflection with the beauty of nature, ensuring a meaningful farewell. Contact us to explore the options that honor your loved one.

tours.name: Media / Photography
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Norfolk coast as you sail through stunning harbours and marshlands. Perfect for photography enthusiasts and film crews alike, this unique adventure offers unforgettable views and the chance to capture the landscape's magic. Join us for a memorable sailing experience tailored to your requests.

tours.name: Educational Trips
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable educational adventure on the water with our charter designed for schools. Guided by knowledgeable staff, students will explore the stunning landscape and wildlife, witnessing the powerful tides firsthand. This unique outing combines fun and learning, making it a memorable treat for both children and teachers alike.

tours.name: Fabulous Felt Making
tours.description: Unleash your creativity by crafting a vibrant felt picture inspired by nature’s beauty. Guided gently by Harvest Rose, you'll explore rich colors and textures, transforming your imagination into a heartfelt masterpiece. Take this special time for yourself, leaving with a unique artwork you'll cherish forever.

tours.name: Sunset Firework & Fish And Chips
tours.description: Sail along the Jurassic Coast at sunset, savor fresh fish and chips, enjoy lively music, and end with a spectacular fireworks display—an unforgettable evening of stunning views, great food, and vibrant atmosphere.

tours.name: Festive Thursdays
tours.description: Set sail on a 3-hour winter cruise with live music, mulled wine, and festive bites. Enjoy city lights, holiday cheer, and cozy vibes—perfect for celebrating with friends or loved ones under the stars.

tours.name: Santa on the Sea
tours.description: Sail along Dorset’s coast on a festive 2-hour boat trip with Santa! Kids get personalized gifts, face painting, and crafts, while adults enjoy mulled wine and mince pies. A joyful holiday adventure for all ages.

tours.name: Lochwinnoch Sauna
tours.description: Experience the ultimate relaxation in our cozy wood-fired sauna, where you can tailor your own rejuvenating flow. Enjoy invigorating cold dips, soothing heat, and the freedom to listen to your body. Whether you prefer quiet reflection or a refreshing cup of tea, this unique nature-based experience is all about you.

tours.name: Prestwick Sauna
tours.description: Experience the ultimate relaxation in our wood-fired sauna, where you can tailor your own journey of warmth and refreshment. Enjoy invigorating cold dips, soothing heat, and the freedom to flow at your own pace. This nature-based retreat is designed to rejuvenate your body and mind, leaving you feeling revitalized and glowing.

tours.name: Camber Sands Beach Trip
tours.description: Experience the allure of a pristine sandy beach, where golden shores meet the gentle waves. Relax under the sun, build sandcastles, or take a refreshing dip in the ocean. This idyllic setting promises a perfect escape, inviting you to unwind and create unforgettable memories by the sea.

tours.name: 3 hour: Science and Medicine
tours.description: Step into Oxford’s rich scientific past on a captivating 2-hour tour. Walk cobbled streets, visit historic landmarks, and hear stories of groundbreaking discoveries by legendary scientists like Harvey and Boyle. With expert guides sharing hidden gems and fascinating anecdotes, this journey reveals Oxford’s vital role in shaping medicine and science today.

tours.name: Halloween SUP
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling Halloween adventure with a spooky stand-up paddleboarding experience along Regent’s Canal. As darkness falls, navigate the eerie waters while listening to chilling ghost stories and discovering haunted spots. This unique journey promises excitement for skilled paddlers seeking a memorable night filled with tricks and treats.

tours.name: Keepsake of a Killer
tours.description: Step into Victorian Whitechapel in 1889, where a brutal murder sparks a tense investigation. Explore Toynbee Hall’s authentic setting as you examine evidence, interview witnesses, and revisit the crime scene in immersive virtual reality. Uncover the truth behind the mysterious death and bring justice to a forgotten victim.

tours.name: Summer Showdown 5
tours.description: Race along the scenic Thames in Henley, tackling a 9km course with options for shorter distances. Enjoy riverside camping, delicious food, and a lively race atmosphere—an unforgettable summer adventure awaits.

tours.name: GWTF Winter Series Race 1 (2 Nov 2025)
tours.description: Race along the scenic Thames, passing Temple Island on a 7km winter paddle. Enjoy stunning views, refreshments, and the thrill of racing on this rare river course—stay active and energized all season long.

tours.name: Jurassic Coast Adventure Weekend
tours.description: Join an advanced rowing adventure along the Jurassic Coast, passing dramatic cliffs, historic harbors, and stunning scenery. Optional third day with sauna, wellness, or fireworks—perfect for seasoned paddlers seeking challenge and beauty.

tours.name: Weekend History Tour
tours.description: Row through Weymouth’s rich history, from 1800s torpedo factories to D-Day sites, with scenic harbor views, historic castles, shipwrecks, and optional recovery rowing with a sauna—an immersive adventure in time and nature.

tours.name: GWTF Winter Series Race 2 (7 Dec) Marlow
tours.description: Paddle across a scenic lake in a fun, challenging course with other paddlers. Enjoy a lively race or relaxed paddle, then refuel with bacon sarnies at this family-run water sports spot. Perfect for fitness and fun.

tours.name: Short Sailing Trip
tours.description: Sail aboard the historic Wherry Albion, built in 1898, and enjoy a hands-on adventure on the Broads. Spot wildlife, feel the breeze, or relax on deck—your journey is guided by expert skippers with flexible plans.

tours.name: Valentine’s Day Pottery Workshop
tours.description: Celebrate love this Valentine’s season at Tierra Pottery Studio with a cozy, hands-on pottery workshop. Create unique ceramic pieces while enjoying soft music and a relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for couples or friends, this intimate experience fosters creativity, connection, and lasting memories as you shape and decorate your own heartfelt gifts.

tours.name: Mother’s Day Pottery Workshop
tours.description: Join a cozy workshop at Tierra Pottery Studio to celebrate motherhood through creativity. Shape and decorate your own ceramic pieces in a relaxed atmosphere, guided by simple techniques. Enjoy calming music, connect with others, and leave with a meaningful keepsake or heartfelt gift, making it a memorable and enriching experience.

tours.name: Father’s Day Pottery Workshop
tours.description: Celebrate Father’s Day with a unique pottery workshop at Tierra Pottery Studio! Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere as you shape and decorate ceramic pieces, perfect for gifting or creating together with dad. This hands-on experience fosters creativity and connection, ensuring memorable moments and a cherished handmade keepsake.

tours.name: Private Charter Coach & Tour Groups 2026
tours.description: Host a memorable day on our luxury canal boat with onboard dining, scenic views, and flexible timings. Perfect for groups up to 50, with options to combine nearby attractions like gardens, museums, and shopping for a full day out.

tours.name: GWTF Winter Series Race 4 (15 Feb) Marlow
tours.description: Race or relax at Westhorpe Water Sports, a scenic family-run lake with thrilling joker laps, tasty bacon sarnies, and a lively atmosphere. Perfect for testing skills and enjoying a fun day on the water.

tours.name: GWTF Winter Series Race 5 (29 March) Henley
tours.description: Race along the scenic Thames, passing Temple Island on a 7km course. Feel the thrill of winter paddling, enjoy refreshments, and stay active in this unique river adventure.

tours.name: 200 - Guided Favourites Tour
tours.description: Step into Broadway Museum’s rich history, from ancient Beaker People and Romans to 17th-century tales and legendary artists. Explore fascinating stories and iconic artworks in an engaging, family-friendly tour.

tours.name: Aviation Summer School
tours.description: Join a two-week aviation adventure at Norwich Airport, flying real planes, mastering simulators, exploring aircraft, and meeting industry pros. Boost skills, build confidence, and ignite your future in aviation.

tours.name: Introduction to Paddlesports
tours.description: Gain confidence on gentle waters with personalized coaching, mastering paddling skills, safety, and water awareness. Perfect for beginners, this small-group course boosts your control and enjoyment on lakes and slow rivers.

tours.name: Bubbles and Highland Cow
tours.description: Enjoy a peaceful evening with Highland cows, gentle interactions, and stunning countryside views. Sip Prosecco while live music by Teresa De Roberto creates a relaxed, unforgettable atmosphere in nature’s embrace.

tours.name: 🎓 Oxford Academic Escape: Colleges, History & Hidden City (From London by Train)
tours.description: Travel from London to Oxford for a day of historic colleges, iconic landmarks, storytelling, and scenic river walks. Explore Harry Potter sites, famous alumni, and enjoy a personalized, immersive university experience.

tours.name: HAMAX Child’s bike seat (9months-22kg) currently NOT compatible with Powerfly E-bike
tours.description: Pull your little one along in a safe, comfy bike trailer designed just for children, making family rides fun and easy for everyone.

tours.name: Tumbler Making Course
tours.description: Create your own glass paperweight or tumbler with expert guidance in Bath or Ashley Wood Farm. Choose colors, design, and learn glassblowing techniques in a hot, hands-on studio. Perfect for a memorable, artistic experience.

tours.name: Dayboat - 2 hour hire on the day - staff only
tours.description: Sail the peaceful River Waveney in a quiet, electric boat for four. Glide past scenic broads, fish with the engine off, and enjoy a relaxing day with canopy protection—perfect for exploring, fishing, and wildlife.

tours.name: Canoeing - Brokerswood
tours.description: Paddle across a scenic 4-acre lake in colorful Canadian canoes, enjoy fun games, and boost your paddling skills in a lively, instructor-led session. Perfect for ages 5 and up—adventure awaits!

tours.name: Magical Santa Trip
tours.description: Climb aboard the festive *Cobbydale* for a 75-minute Christmas cruise along Skipton’s canal. Children meet Santa, who calls them by name and hands out goodies, while adults relax with coffee and mince pies. Twinkling lights, joyful music, and Yorkshire scenery create a magical holiday experience for all ages.

tours.name: Public Roast Dinner Cruise
tours.description: Experience a unique dining adventure aboard a floating restaurant as you cruise the Canal while enjoying a sumptuous hot roast dinner. Indulge in hand-carved roast beef and delightful desserts, all served with stunning views. With a fully licensed bar, this unforgettable experience is perfect for gifts or surprises.

tours.name: Drinks Ahoy Cruise
tours.description: Set sail on the Dalesman canal boat for a Drinks Ahoy cruise filled with laughter, great music, and unforgettable moments! Choose from 10 specialty cocktails, a variety of whiskeys, gins, and more. Enhance your experience with a delicious Graze Box, perfect for sharing or savoring solo.

tours.name: Henley Festival on modern day-boat
tours.description: Host an exclusive party for up to 6 on a private boat, enjoy music and fireworks, bring your own food or choose professional catering, and set sail from Mill Meadows for a memorable celebration.

tours.name: Adventure Mud Run Party - Muddy, Fun & Challenging
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Adventure Mud Runs, where teamwork meets muddy fun! Navigate through scenic woodlands, rivers, and fields tailored to your group's fitness level. Perfect for team building or a unique party, this exhilarating outdoor challenge promises laughter and unforgettable memories, followed by a refreshing hose down to clean up!

tours.name: Crate Stacking - What's your limit?
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating team-building challenge with crate stacking! Work together to construct a towering stack while balancing on top, testing your trust and coordination. This unique activity fosters teamwork and camaraderie as you compete to see how high you can go. Perfect for groups seeking an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Kent Wine Tour Experience
tours.description: Private Tour • 9 Hours • Visit two of Kents finest wine estates!

tours.name: Mobile Climbing Wall Hire
tours.description: Scale a 7-meter wall with friends or students, guided by trained instructors. Perfect for festivals, schools, and events, it offers safe, fun climbing for all ages—creating unforgettable active memories.

tours.name: Level 3 Sea Kayak Course
tours.description: Join a fun two-day sea kayaking course to master paddling skills, explore stunning coastlines, spot seals and dolphins, and navigate sea caves and rocky headlands with expert guidance.

tours.name: Paddle UK  Paddle Explore Training and Assessment
tours.description: Boost your kayaking skills in just two days, gaining confidence, environmental awareness, and rescue techniques. Perfect for planning safe trips and improving efficiency on sheltered waters.

tours.name: Paddle UK Sea Kayak Award Training
tours.description: Boost your sea kayaking skills in just 2 days, gaining confidence, mastering navigation in winds and tides, and earning an award that proves your seaworthiness. Perfect for paddlers ready to elevate their adventure.

tours.name: Private Tour | Camden Walking Tour
tours.description: Step into Camden’s vibrant streets, where legendary music, colorful murals, and rich history collide. Visit Dickens’ childhood home, explore Camden Lock, and end at bustling Camden Market for food, shopping, and unforgettable stories.

tours.name: De Chirico and the Metaphysical Dreamscape
tours.description: Immerse yourself in "The Metaphysical Dreamscape," a captivating animated film documentary by Shanty that delves into the enigmatic world of influential paintings. Experience a rich tapestry of shadows and deserted plazas, followed by an engaging Q&A session that invites deeper exploration of the stories behind the art.

tours.name: Margate to Canterbury Bike Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through stunning bays and charming villages, including Britain's smallest town. Enjoy a quirky teashop visit and a delightful lunch in a country pub, all while Col shares intriguing stories about the area's rich history and culture, culminating in a memorable tour of Canterbury.

tours.name: Rampion Offshore Wind Farm
tours.description: Set sail on a 2-hour adventure to the South Coast's offshore wind farm, with a chance to spot dolphins. Get close to turbines, enjoy stunning coastal views, and feel the thrill of ocean wildlife.

tours.name: Intermediate Windsurfing Course
tours.description: Elevate your windsurfing skills with our intermediate course! In just two hours, master faster takes and gybes, beach starts, and advanced techniques like using a harness and getting into footstraps. This experience promises to transform your windsurfing from basic to exhilarating, making every moment on the water unforgettable.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddle-Boarding Tours: Around Poole Harbour’s Islands
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding on a guided tour around two stunning islands in Poole Harbour. Perfect for both beginners and seasoned paddlers, this 3-hour adventure offers a unique opportunity to connect with nature and enjoy the sport alongside fellow enthusiasts. Join us for an unforgettable day on the water!

tours.name: Henley Festival on Hebe
tours.description: Celebrate on Hebe, a charming Edwardian launch, with up to 6 friends. Play your music, enjoy fireworks, bring your own food, and relax on a private boat with a skipper—your perfect party on the water.

tours.name: SUP Yoga
tours.description: Float, stretch, and find your balance on tranquil Firestone Bay with guided SUP Yoga. Improve core strength, connect with nature, and enjoy organic treats afterward in a peaceful, immersive setting.

tours.name: Private Sea Fishing Trip
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 3-hour private inshore fishing tour guided by a local expert. Experience the thrill of targeting pollack and cod using light tackle while enjoying the stunning reefs. Perfect for beginners and seasoned anglers alike, all equipment is provided for an unforgettable fishing adventure.

tours.name: Axe Throwing at Thoulstone Park
tours.description: Unleash your inner Viking in a 45-minute axe throwing session at Thoulstone Park. Learn expert techniques, compete in fun challenges, and try different axes—perfect for adventurers aged 10 and up.

tours.name: Free Tour Jack el Destripador
tours.description: Step into Victorian London’s dark past with a 2.5-hour tour exploring Jack the Ripper’s crimes, eerie alleyways, and unresolved mysteries. Visit crime scenes, see historic photos, and analyze clues in the haunting Whitechapel district.

tours.name: Free Tour Soho y China Town
tours.description: Explore Soho’s vibrant streets in 2.5 hours, uncovering stories of artists, rebels, and legends. From Piccadilly Circus to Chinatown, see historic sites, famous characters, and hidden tales that shaped this lively neighborhood.

tours.name: Roller Coaster Motion Simulator
tours.description: Experience the adrenaline rush of three exhilarating roller coasters in just 5-10 minutes! Our YawVR motion simulator chair offers a unique and immersive ride that will leave you breathless. Perfect for thrill-seekers aged 8 and up, this is an unforgettable adventure you won't want to miss!

tours.name: Motor Boat Hire
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of the river with our motor boat hire for up to 6 people. Enjoy up to 2 hours of adventure as you escape the crowds, bringing along a coolbox and picnic for a perfect day of relaxation and fun on the water.

tours.name: Waitlist: Mayor of London Event at City of London Tour
tours.description: Join the waitlist for the exclusive Mayor of London Event during the City of London Tour on August 24th, 2022. Experience the vibrant history and culture of the city while engaging with its leadership. Don't miss this unique opportunity to explore London through a special lens!

tours.name: Waitlist: Mayor of London Event at British Museum
tours.description: Join the waitlist for the exclusive Mayor of London Event at the iconic British Museum on August 8th, 2022, at 11am. Experience a unique opportunity to engage with the city's leadership in a historic setting, making this a memorable occasion you won't want to miss.

tours.name: Level 2 Women's Sea Kayak Course
tours.description: Join a fun two-day female-led kayak course to explore stunning UK coastlines, spot seals and dolphins, learn paddling and safety skills, and relax on remote beaches with expert guidance.

tours.name: Level 1 Ski
tours.description: Start your skiing journey with a friendly instructor guiding you from flat ground to sliding down beginner slopes, building confidence and balance in just one hour. Perfect for first-timers ready to take the first step.

tours.name: Level 2 Ski
tours.description: Advance your skiing skills in Level 2, where you'll master the snowplough technique to control your speed. Guided by friendly, experienced instructors, this one-hour lesson builds on your previous knowledge, ensuring a supportive and engaging experience on the slopes. Prepare for an exciting journey toward becoming a confident skier!

tours.name: Level 3 Ski
tours.description: Elevate your skiing skills with Level 3, where you'll master turning techniques while building on your snowplough foundation. Guided by friendly, experienced instructors, this one-hour lesson promises expert support and a fun learning environment. Get ready to glide confidently down the slopes and discover your next steps in skiing!

tours.name: Level 4 Ski
tours.description: Elevate your skiing skills in Level 4, where you'll master linking turns and controlling speed. Guided by friendly, experienced instructors, this one-hour lesson builds on your previous knowledge, ensuring a supportive and engaging experience. Prepare for an exciting journey on the slopes as you take your skiing to the next level!

tours.name: Level 5 Ski
tours.description: Elevate your skiing skills with our Level 5 lesson on the big slope! Under the guidance of friendly, experienced instructors, you'll master the button tow and tackle larger challenges safely. This one-hour session builds on your previous lessons, ensuring a memorable and exciting progression in your skiing journey.

tours.name: Eskuta SX-250
tours.description: Experience the island like never before with our stylish and technologically advanced e-bikes. Perfect for those 18 and older, these bikes offer a unique way to explore, ensuring you navigate effortlessly while enjoying the stunning surroundings. Rent one today and make unforgettable memories on your adventure!

tours.name: Merchandise (Back End)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of exclusive access with "Back End Only," a unique opportunity that immerses you in behind-the-scenes action. Discover the secrets and stories that shape the experience, making it a memorable adventure unlike any other. Engage with the inner workings and gain insights that are typically hidden from view.

tours.name: Easter Bunny Tour - Glasgow
tours.description: Join us for a delightful Easter breakfast featuring pancakes, croissants, and fruit kebabs! Enjoy an hour filled with fun games, chocolate treats, and an exciting egg hunt with the Easter Bunny. Every child will leave with a special goody bag, making this a memorable celebration for all!

tours.name: Rowboat - 4 seats
tours.description: Experience the joy of rowing in our stunning traditional boats! Enjoy a unique hour-long adventure on the water, complete with complimentary buoyancy jackets. Bring your furry friend along, as dogs are welcome on board, making this a memorable outing for both you and your pet.

tours.name: Rowboat - 6 seats
tours.description: Experience the charm of traditional rowing in our stunning boats! Enjoy a unique hour-long adventure on the water, complete with complimentary buoyancy jackets. Bring your furry friend along, as dogs are welcome on board, making this a memorable outing for both you and your pet.

tours.name: Canoes (3 Person)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddling in a traditional canoe as you connect with local wildlife. Choose from various durations to suit your adventure, and enjoy the added safety of complimentary buoyancy jackets. This unique opportunity promises an unforgettable encounter with nature in a serene setting.

tours.name: Canoes (4 Person)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddling in a traditional canoe as you connect with local wildlife in their natural habitat. With options ranging from one to four hours, this adventure promises unforgettable moments and a unique perspective on nature, all while ensuring your safety with complimentary buoyancy jackets.

tours.name: Paddle board
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddleboarding on our sturdy, rigid boards. Choose from a variety of durations to suit your adventure. Enjoy the water with confidence, as buoyancy jackets are provided at no extra cost, ensuring a safe and memorable outing on the waves.

tours.name: City to City Pub Tour. 2000 years of history visiting some of London's Unique Pubs
tours.description: Uncover London's secret alleys, historic pubs, and legendary stories of fire, war, and literature. Sip a pint on a vintage Route Master and walk through the city’s hidden past in this captivating tour.

tours.name: Exclusive Seafood Meal on the Beach
tours.description: Savor fresh lobster and crab on a private beach table on Scolt Head Island, with stunning sands and clear waters. Enjoy birdwatching, seal sightings, and a scenic boat trip through unspoiled coastal beauty.

tours.name: Mobile Archery
tours.description: Mobile Activity Booking

tours.name: Private Coaching (full day)
tours.description: Experience a full day of personalized coaching tailored to your specific goals. With seven hours of dedicated instruction from qualified and passionate coaches, you'll receive expert guidance and support, ensuring a unique and memorable learning experience in your chosen sport. Unlock your potential and elevate your skills like never before.

tours.name: Alpaca Picnic
tours.description: Experience a delightful 2-hour alpaca picnic in the scenic Warwickshire countryside. Enjoy a brief introduction to these charming animals, relax on picnic benches with your own food, and savor the unique opportunity to hand-feed the alpacas at the end. It's a memorable way to connect with nature and these gentle creatures.

tours.name: Private Coaching (half day)
tours.description: Unlock your potential with a personalized 3-hour coaching session, led by passionate experts dedicated to helping you improve exactly what you want. Tailored, focused, and designed for your growth.

tours.name: Sausage Roll Tour
tours.description: Taste five unique sausage rolls across Norwich’s historic streets, guided by expert Cheryl Cade. Savor local flavors, learn their history, and enjoy a fun, flavorful 2-hour tour perfect for sausage lovers.

tours.name: Free London Music Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating free walking tour through London’s legendary music history, exploring iconic sites linked to stars like Queen, The Beatles, and Adele. Led by a knowledgeable guide, you'll visit Tin Pan Alley, the rooftop of The Beatles' last performance, and more, uncovering the stories behind Britain's greatest hits.

tours.name: Manchester's Northern Quarter & Street Art Tour
tours.description: Explore Manchester’s vibrant Northern Quarter on a 1.5-hour walk through colorful street art, historic buildings, indie shops, and music legends. Uncover hidden gems and stories behind the city’s creative spirit.

tours.name: Krowd Keepers Magic Theatre
tours.description: Step into a secret Bath room where top magicians perform stunning sleight-of-hand, hilarious comedy, and mind-bending illusions in an intimate 90-minute show. No rabbits, just pure magic and wonder.

tours.name: Infinity Pool Canyon
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour adventure in a stunning canyon between Ambleside and Keswick. Experience thrilling abseils and a massive zipwire, making this advanced trip a unique and unforgettable journey for families, as each adult can bring along up to two children for the excitement.

tours.name: River Tubing
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 4-hour adventure down the river Lune, navigating thrilling rapids and tackling Wipeout-style challenges. This unique experience culminates in an exhilarating cliff jump, perfect for families as each adult can bring along two children for an unforgettable day of fun and excitement on the water.

tours.name: Distillery Tour Gin Tasting Experience
tours.description: Experience the art of gin-making with a 90-minute behind-the-scenes tour of Brighton Gin's distillery. Discover the craft's history, participate in hands-on activities like waxing your own bottle, and enjoy a complimentary gin and tonic. Take home a personalized miniature and explore unique merchandise in the charming shop.

tours.name: Coding Club & Alternative Provision
tours.description: Coding Clubs | After School | Weekend | Holidays | SEND | Alternative Provision

tours.name: Paddleboard Safety Course
tours.description: Master paddleboarding in a day! Learn to navigate rivers, estuaries, and coastlines safely with expert tips on techniques, hazards, rescue, and trip planning—all on top-quality boards with small, focused groups.

tours.name: Jack the Ripper and Victorian London: Beyond the Shadows
tours.description: Embark on a haunting 2.5-hour tour through Victorian London, exploring the chilling legacy of Jack the Ripper. Guided by experts, you'll uncover the lives of his victims and the vibrant society of the East End, revealing the complexities of a city marked by both terror and resilience. An unforgettable historical journey awaits!

tours.name: Tour & Tasting
tours.description: Discover the art of spirit-making at Essex Spirits Co's distillery tour in Chelmsford! Enjoy a welcome drink, explore the production process, and taste a selection of gins, vodka, and rum. Led by the founder, this immersive experience offers insights into local craftsmanship and a chance to purchase your favorites at a discount.

tours.name: Climbing & Abseiling Sessions - Private Activity
tours.description: Experience the thrill of climbing in North Wales, a premier destination renowned for its breathtaking scenery. This exciting activity promises fun for everyone, whether you're a beginner or an experienced climber. Join us for an unforgettable adventure amidst stunning landscapes that will leave you in awe.

tours.name: Mini Mal 7'9
tours.description: Elevate your surfing experience with our advanced boards, designed for improved maneuverability and performance. Available for hourly, daily, or weekly hire, these boards offer the perfect opportunity to enhance your skills and take your surfing to new heights. Unleash your potential and ride the waves like never before!

tours.name: Long Board 8'6
tours.description: Elevate your surfing experience with our advanced boards designed for improved maneuverability. Whether you choose to rent for an hour, a day, or a week, these boards will help you master new techniques and enhance your skills, making every wave an exciting opportunity for growth and adventure.

tours.name: Body Boards
tours.description: Dive into a world of aquatic adventure with flexible hourly, daily, or weekly rentals! Enjoy thrilling water activities that promise fun for everyone, regardless of skill level. Experience the joy of splashing around and creating unforgettable memories in the water, making every moment a unique escape from the ordinary.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddle Board
tours.description: Experience the thrill of exploration with our hourly, daily, and weekly rentals! Perfect for those calm days, this activity offers a unique opportunity to discover new places at your own pace, making every moment memorable. Embrace the freedom to adventure and create lasting memories in a relaxed setting.

tours.name: Level 6 Ski
tours.description: Master the big slope in this exciting Level 6 ski lesson! With expert guidance from friendly instructors, you'll learn to navigate safely and confidently from the top. Successfully completing this level means you can ski independently. Prepare for an unforgettable experience on the slopes, building on your skills and knowledge!

tours.name: Spymaster Pub Tour
tours.description: Discover the intriguing history of the Peak District Pubs frequented by Britain's most decorated Cold War spy. Join author Martin Pearce for a captivating 6.5-hour guided tour, enjoying an inclusive drink at each of the six pubs as you uncover the secrets behind their significance.

tours.name: Alpine Lodge Bar Booth
tours.description: Celebrate the festive season in style at the Alpine Lodge Bar! Enjoy a cozy atmosphere adorned with Christmas decor, steins, and mulled wine, while taking in breathtaking views of Bournemouth's Christmas Market. Join in on lively entertainment like quizzes, karaoke, and bingo, or simply relax with friends and family.

tours.name: Belfast Whiskey Experience
tours.description: Embark on a sensory journey that combines delightful samples with captivating stories. Starting at The Dark Horse Cafe in the Cathedral Quarter, this unique tour culminates at The Reporter, one of the city's premier bars, promising an unforgettable experience filled with flavor and local lore.

tours.name: Accra through the Ages: A Blend of Old, New, and Legendary
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Ghana's vibrant culture and history. Explore the Brazil House, wander the lively streets of Ga Mashie, and visit the poignant Ussher Fort Museum. Enjoy stunning coastal views while savoring local cuisine, and reflect on Ghana's legacy at the Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park.

tours.name: A North Indian Thali @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Learn to make a vibrant vegan thali in 2 hours, mastering spices, lentil daal, chickpea masala, crispy okra, and soft chapatis. Enjoy your creations at the chef’s table with drinks, recipes, and all ingredients provided.

tours.name: Mexican Street Food @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create authentic Mexican street food in just 2 hours! Make your own tortillas, smoky chipotle chicken, fresh salsas, and guacamole, then enjoy your flavorful feast at the chef’s table. No experience needed—just bring your appetite.

tours.name: Fragrance Design Experience - Sheffield
tours.description: Create your own signature perfume in just 2 hours. Blend exclusive scents, name your fragrance, and take home a personalized bottle. Enjoy bubbly and optional afternoon tea in a luxurious, sensory journey into perfumery.

tours.name: Sunday Roast Cruise
tours.description: Sail along scenic canals on the Elleswake for 2.5 hours, enjoying a hearty Sunday roast with tender meat, crispy potatoes, and rich gravy, plus homemade desserts—perfect for a relaxing, memorable day afloat.

tours.name: Kayak Rolling
tours.description: Enhance your kayaking skills with tailored rolling sessions designed for all levels, from beginners to experienced paddlers. Focus on comfort and technique through capsize drills, personalized feedback, and essential body movements. Build confidence and master your roll in a supportive environment, ensuring a memorable and empowering experience on the water.

tours.name: Discover Paddlesports Award
tours.description: Experience the beauty of the Beaulieu River Nature Reserve while learning paddlesport skills in a supportive environment. This introductory course offers a unique blend of kayaking and canoeing, tailored to help you earn your first paddlesports award. Perfect for beginners, it promises an exciting adventure on the water!

tours.name: British Canoeing Personal Performance Awards
tours.description: Refine your paddling skills in wind and moving water, mastering boat handling and rescue techniques. Journey through Hampshire or Dorset, planning and executing trips that boost confidence and expertise in your favorite sport.

tours.name: Seasonal event: Mother’s Day Hummingbird cake
tours.description: Create a tropical Hummingbird cake with fluffy sponge, zesty cream cheese, pecan brittle, and edible flowers. Bake, decorate, and take home a beautiful gift—perfect for celebrating Mom or making new memories together.

tours.name: Meet the Pigs Experience
tours.description: Embark on a delightful adventure with round-nosed friends, starting with a warm hot chocolate and an informative talk on animal care. Enjoy hands-on interactions as you pet and feed these lovable creatures, creating unforgettable memories while connecting with their charming personalities.

tours.name: Drag Arty Brunch Party: Galgos Latino
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable Drag Arty Brunch Party, where creativity meets entertainment! Enjoy a lively multimedia collage workshop led by an award-winning drag host, complete with a delicious two-course lunch and cocktails. Perfect for all skill levels, this unique event promises fun, inspiration, and a chance to create your masterpiece!

tours.name: Wildlings HomeEd Club
tours.description: Join our weekly HomeEd Club for children ages 5-10, where adventure awaits! From Nerf battles to archery and tree climbing, kids will engage in thrilling outdoor activities that foster teamwork and skill development. Every Tuesday, they’ll explore nature while making lasting memories with friends in a vibrant, fun-filled environment.

tours.name: Wanderers Home Ed Club
tours.description: Home-schooled kids aged 8-15 can join our weekly club to try bushcraft, target sports, team games, and more. Kids explore new skills, challenge themselves, and have fun in a supportive, rotating activity program.

tours.name: Adventurers Home Ed Club
tours.description: Join our Adventurers HomeEd Club for ages 11-15, where kids engage in thrilling target sports and strategic games every Tuesday. From Nerf battles to archery and axe throwing, this dynamic program encourages skill development and teamwork while pushing boundaries in a fun outdoor setting. Adventure awaits!

tours.name: 18 Miles Hereford to Hoarwithy
tours.description: Paddle 18 miles along the scenic Wye River from Hereford to Hoarwithy. Enjoy a full day of adventure with safety tips, stunning views, and plenty of time to soak in the river’s beauty—bring snacks and water for the journey.

tours.name: Indian breakfast @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create a vibrant Indian breakfast with spicy omelettes, crispy potatoes, flaky parathas, and rich curry. Roll up your sleeves, cook, and enjoy a flavorful feast at the chef’s table.

tours.name: Overplay • Swanley Park
tours.description: Experience endless fun at our all-weather indoor inflatable play zone, featuring a thrilling labyrinth of rope climbs and netting for adventurers of all ages. On dry days, explore our outdoor inflatable zone connected by a tunnel, ensuring a unique and exciting adventure for everyone. Safety is our top priority!

tours.name: Trial Game
tours.description: Step into the UK's top-rated airsoft arena and feel the adrenaline rush as you strategize, dodge, and fire in an action-packed battle. Perfect for thrill-seekers ready for an unforgettable challenge.

tours.name: MaccPacas Experience
tours.description: Meet adorable alpacas on a scenic farm tour, then lead a gentle walk through lush countryside. Feel their soft fur and share laughs during a charming tea party feeding session. This delightful experience blends nature, bonding, and fun, creating unforgettable memories for all ages in the peaceful Macclesfield countryside.

tours.name: 2025: Canoe Storage
tours.description: Experience the convenience of keeping your boat at Nichol End, where easy access to the water enhances your adventures. Enjoy seamless outings and the freedom to explore at your leisure, making every moment on the water memorable and hassle-free.

tours.name: 2025: Kayak & Paddleboard Storage
tours.description: Experience the convenience of keeping your boat at Nichol End, where easy access to the water enhances your adventures. Enjoy seamless outings and the freedom to explore at your leisure, making every moment on the water memorable and hassle-free.

tours.name: Day Tour (Stonehenge, Bath & Cardiff)
tours.description: Embark on an extraordinary journey to three iconic destinations: the mystical Stonehenge, the historic city of Bath, and the lively capital of Cardiff. Enjoy a luxurious coach ride while immersing yourself in rich history, stunning architecture, and vibrant culture, creating unforgettable memories along the way.

tours.name: Kayak special | Kayak Litter Picks
tours.description: Join a unique paddle clean-up experience that combines kayaking with environmental action! Help reduce pollution in England’s waterways while enjoying the tranquility of nature. No prior experience is needed, as professional guides will ensure your safety and enjoyment. Make a difference for wildlife and your community while paddling through scenic canals.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea on the Sea
tours.description: Sail along the stunning Jurassic Coast for 2.5 hours, enjoying delicious Afternoon Tea, panoramic sea views, and a fully stocked bar. Perfect for relaxing, celebrating, or simply soaking up coastal beauty.

tours.name: 10 Hour Manual Course
tours.description: Master the art of driving with our manual transmission course, where you'll gain essential skills like clutch control and smooth gear changes. Perfect for learners seeking confidence and flexibility, this experience empowers you to navigate both manual and automatic vehicles safely and efficiently, making you a versatile driver on the road.

tours.name: Santa SUP
tours.description: Experience the magic of winter on a festive SUP adventure down Regent’s Canal! Paddle through a twinkling wonderland, dressed as Santa or an elf, while enjoying the sounds of carols and the beauty of holiday lights reflecting on the water. It's a unique blend of fun and seasonal cheer!

tours.name: Sunset Fish and Chips Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Jurassic Coast at sunset, savoring fresh fish and chips, with a fully stocked bar, stunning views, and relaxed vibes—perfect for creating unforgettable summer memories with family and friends.

tours.name: Tina Turner
tours.description: Experience a delightful Tina Turner-themed afternoon tea, complete with a musical sing-along! Enjoy a delicious selection of treats paired with a glass of prosecco, all while celebrating the iconic music of Tina Turner. This unique 90-minute event promises to be a memorable blend of flavors and fun.

tours.name: Snow & Glow Mini Golf
tours.description: Experience the magic of the holidays at Snow & Glow Golf in Bournemouth’s enchanting Lower Gardens! This unique outdoor mini-golf adventure features glowing balls and twinkling holes, creating a festive atmosphere perfect for families and friends. Enjoy a fun-filled evening of putting under the dazzling Christmas lights!

tours.name: London: A Christmas Carol & Dicken's Inspiration Walking Tour
tours.description: Walk through Victorian London’s historic streets and landmarks that inspired Dickens’ A Christmas Carol. Uncover the real stories behind Scrooge, Marley, and Tiny Tim with vivid tales, festive sights, and Dickensian charm.

tours.name: Sauna Wellness Row
tours.description: Join us on the last Saturday afternoon each month for a rejuvenating trip to a wood-fired sauna, combining the health perks of rowing, swimming, and relaxing in warm, soothing heat—perfect for unwinding and recharging.

tours.name: Valentine's on Le Grand Bus
tours.description: Explore London's iconic sights in style with panoramic views, gourmet bites, and luxury service. From Buckingham Palace to Trafalgar Square, enjoy an unforgettable, elegant journey through the heart of the city.

tours.name: Twilight Cruise - Music Special
tours.description: Sail into sunset with live ambient music by Roan Kearsey-Lawson, while enjoying a complimentary drink and light bites. Feel the river’s glow and soothing melodies on this unforgettable evening from Thunderbolt Pier.

tours.name: 250A - Bronze Age Beaker pots
tours.description: Craft a Bronze Age-style beaker using ancient pinch-and-coil techniques, then decorate with traditional patterns. After firing, you'll take home a unique piece of 4,000-year-old pottery craftsmanship.

tours.name: Looe lugger event
tours.description: Join the bi-annual Looe Lugger festival for a full day on the water, maneuvering heritage sailing vessels and racing among traditional luggers. Be part of this lively maritime celebration from start to finish.

tours.name: Nature Detectives: A Family Wildlife Ramble
tours.description: Uncover wildlife secrets in the New Forest with a lively 45-minute adventure. Hunt for animal tracks, feathers, and clues, complete fun challenges, and learn nature’s hidden stories in a playful, hands-on exploration.

tours.name: National Gallery Tour
tours.description: Step into the National Gallery’s world of masterpieces, from Renaissance religious scenes to bold Post-Impressionist experiments. Marvel at Rubens, Rembrandt, and iconic portraits in London's historic art treasure.

tours.name: Brighton Beach Bike Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of cycling along Brighton's stunning seafront with Brighton Beach Bike Hire. Enjoy safe rides for over 15 miles without busy roads, while exploring iconic sights like the white cliffs and Hove beach huts. With local expertise and comfortable Californian-style bikes, your adventure awaits right at the beach!

tours.name: Axe Throwing | Bodiam | 1 Hour
tours.description: Experience an hour of thrilling precision throwing with family and friends! Guided by expert coaches, you'll learn safety and technique while enjoying fun challenges and games. With minimal wait times and a focus on skill development, this engaging activity is perfect for groups, making unforgettable memories together.

tours.name: Party Cask for Hire
tours.description: Elevate your next event with our delicious craft beer, complete with all necessary dispensing equipment and a personalized pump clip. Enjoy free collection from the brewery, and opt for delivery and branded glasses to make your gathering truly memorable. Choose from a variety of cask beers for a unique experience!

tours.name: Urban Discovery Tour of Belfast
tours.description: Explore Belfast’s vibrant street art, sculptures, and historic architecture in a 2-hour walk through the Cathedral Quarter, revealing the city’s inspiring regeneration and lively cultural scene.

tours.name: Ploughman’s Lunch Cruise
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful 3-hour culinary experience featuring a selection of Lakeland Ham, local cheeses, and fresh-baked bread rolls, complemented by a scrumptious Bramley Apple Pie with ice cream. Enjoy a pot of tea or coffee as you savor this unique taste of local flavors, perfect for food lovers.

tours.name: Summer Club
tours.description: Join the Summer Club in Sandown for an exhilarating 2-hour adventure tailored for ages 8-16! Experience a variety of water activities like surfing, paddle boarding, and snorkeling, all while enjoying the beautiful seaside. With all equipment provided, just bring your swimwear and get ready for unforgettable fun!

tours.name: Full Day Kayaking
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 6.5-hour adventure that combines skill-building on flat water with thrilling rapids in the afternoon. Under expert guidance, you'll learn essential techniques and gain confidence, ensuring you leave with unforgettable memories and a big smile. Perfect for those seeking excitement and personal growth on the water!

tours.name: Room 8: Double Room with a River View
tours.description: All ages welcome! • Breakfast Included

tours.name: Aqueduct Adventure - Kennet & Avon Canal
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic Kennet & Avon Canal, crossing two aqueducts, then relax at a charming pub. Enjoy wildlife, stunning views, and expert guidance on this fun, safe 6-mile adventure suitable for all skill levels.

tours.name: Rome Adventure Running Tour
tours.description: Run through Rome's peaceful early hours, visiting iconic landmarks and hidden gems. Cover more ground in 1.5 hours than most see in days, with a flexible route tailored to your pace and interests.

tours.name: London In a Day
tours.description: Explore London's top sights in one day: visit St. Paul’s, watch the Changing of the Guard, tour the Tower of London, and enjoy a private boat cruise along the Thames with stunning city views.

tours.name: First Class Return Train Travel (Santa Specials Picnic)
tours.description: Enjoy a festive train picnic with Santa onboard, complete with sandwiches, mini cakes, and silver service. Watch Santa come down the train, and each child receives a special present in a cozy, elegant setting.

tours.name: 2 Hour Hadrian’s Wall Guided Tour
tours.description: Walk along Hadrians Wall and explore 2,000-year-old ruins, a well-preserved Milecastle, and stunning moorland views. Hear stories from Roman and native perspectives in this immersive, scenic 2-hour guided tour.

tours.name: Lopwell Dam end of summer SUP party!
tours.description: Join us at Lopwell Dam for an unforgettable end-of-summer celebration! Enjoy a guided paddle, skill-building sessions, and a fun mini sports day. With beautiful surroundings and a cozy barn for refreshments, this event promises adventure, laughter, and camaraderie. Don’t miss this chance to bid farewell to summer in style!

tours.name: Experiencia Rock Británico
tours.description: Explore the roots of British rock in Soho and West End, visiting legendary spots like Denmark Street, Trident Studios, and Ronnie Scott’s. Walk through history, culture, and music that shaped icons like The Beatles, Bowie, and Hendrix.

tours.name: River Wye Wonders
tours.description: Paddle 12 miles along the stunning River Wye, navigating rapids and glassy waters. Enjoy snacks, a picnic, and breathtaking views, all guided by friendly instructors. An adventure blending thrill, relaxation, and scenic beauty.

tours.name: BattleZone: Apocalypse!
tours.description: Experience a thrilling Halloween twist on combat games in a spooky woodland setting! Join our friendly instructors for two hours of action-packed fun using safe infra-red gaming guns. Engage in mysterious mini-games and eerie scenarios, making unforgettable memories as you battle against the clock and each other at dusk!

tours.name: The Cathedrals Express to Hereford or Cardiff
tours.description: Travel from Birmingham to Cardiff along scenic rivers, exploring a vibrant city full of attractions for all. Enjoy luxurious dining, comfortable seats, and a memorable journey through stunning Welsh landscapes.

tours.name: Evening Fishing Trip
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable evening fishing trip where the thrill of catching larger species awaits as dusk falls. Enjoy the excitement of targeting Bream, Mackerel, and Conger Eels while witnessing a stunning sunset. Prepare for a memorable adventure on the water, but don’t forget your warm clothing for the cool night breeze.

tours.name: Tour along the Promenade by Heritage Tram
tours.description: Experience the charm of Blackpool on a specially chartered heritage tram ride, exclusively for Vintage Trains passengers. This unique tour along the Promenade offers a nostalgic journey through the town's sights. With limited availability, secure your spot now for an unforgettable seaside adventure!

tours.name: Birthday parties at the farm
tours.description: Host an unforgettable birthday celebration at our charming farm, where children can enjoy 2.5 hours of exclusive fun! Customize your party with exciting add-ons like farm activities, themed decorations, and delicious treats. Create lasting memories in a picturesque setting that delights kids of all ages. Get ready to party!

tours.name: Muslim Mobile Museum
tours.description: Elevate your Eid or summer event by booking the Muslim Mobile Museum! Experience a unique guided tour showcasing rare books, antiquities, and more. This captivating display, paired with AbdulMaalik Tailor's presentation on Muslim cultural ties to Britain, promises an unforgettable experience for you and your guests.

tours.name: Pluckley Ghost Walk
tours.description: Step into Haunted Pluckley and uncover ghostly legends, dark mysteries, and eerie tales of restless spirits in this 1.5-2 hour spooky adventure through a historic village full of secrets.

tours.name: 3 Hour Wetsuit Hire
tours.description: Experience the perfect fit with a quality wetsuit from Lords of Downend! In just three hours, discover how a wetsuit should feel like a second skin. Choose between warmth and ease of entry, ensuring your adventure is both comfortable and enjoyable. Dive into the excitement of water sports with confidence!

tours.name: 24 Hour Wetsuit Hire
tours.description: Experience the perfect fit with a quality wetsuit from Lords of Downend! Tailored to feel like a second skin, you’ll choose between warmth and ease of entry. Whether you prefer a snug or slightly looser fit, this unique service ensures you’re ready for your aquatic adventures in style and comfort.

tours.name: 48 Hour Wetsuit Hire
tours.description: Experience the perfect fit with a quality wetsuit rental from Lords of Downend! Discover the ideal balance between warmth and comfort as you choose the right size for your aquatic adventures. Whether you prefer a snug embrace or easier entry, this service ensures you’re ready to dive in style.

tours.name: 72 Hour Wetsuit Hire
tours.description: Experience the perfect fit with a quality wetsuit from Lords of Downend! Designed to feel like a second skin, these wetsuits offer the ideal balance between warmth and ease of entry. Choose your size wisely for an unforgettable aquatic adventure that keeps you comfortable and ready for action.

tours.name: Weekly Wetsuit Hire
tours.description: Experience the perfect fit with a quality wetsuit from Lords of Downend! Tailored to feel like a second skin, this unique service helps you choose between warmth and ease of entry, ensuring your wetsuit enhances your aquatic adventures. Dive in and discover the ideal fit for your needs!

tours.name: Fishermens Feast Experience
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable coastal adventure with Ballintoy Fisherman's Feast. Enjoy breathtaking views of rugged cliffs while fishing for fresh local catch. Afterward, savor your haul at a local restaurant, transformed into a delicious sharing platter. This unique experience blends sightseeing, fishing, and dining for an authentic taste of coastal life.

tours.name: A Sailor's Walking Tour of North End, Portsmouth UK
tours.description: Sip local brews and explore Portsmouth’s maritime past on a lively 2.5-hour pub crawl, visiting five historic pubs with a guide. Enjoy tastings, learn naval stories, and get a half-price food voucher to finish your day.

tours.name: Skirmish Sunday Airsoft Sunday (Every Other Sunday) Half Day AM & PM
tours.description: Join a welcoming community of airsoft enthusiasts aged 12 and up in a vibrant setting featuring woodland terrain, a full-size airplane, and multi-level forts. Enjoy the thrill of team play, learn from experienced players, and choose to rent or bring your own gear for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Blackpool Illuminations Express
tours.description: Travel to Blackpool for a day of dazzling illuminations, iconic sights, and seaside fun. Enjoy the vibrant lights, historic trams, and lively attractions before returning home with unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Alpine Lodge Reserved Table
tours.description: Celebrate the holiday season in style at the Alpine Lodge Bar! Reserve a cozy table for you and your festive friends and family, and immerse yourself in an authentic Christmas atmosphere. Experience the warmth and charm of our lodge as we welcome you to create unforgettable holiday memories together.

tours.name: Friar's Bush Graveyard Halloween Special Tour
tours.description: Step into ancient Celtic rituals with haunting Gaelic chants, a resurrected harp master, and special SAMHAIN ceremonies at Friar’s Bush Graveyard. Limited spots—reserve now for a mystical journey into history.

tours.name: The Belfast Story (Food & Show)
tours.description: Experience the vibrant essence of Belfast with 'The Belfast Story.' This unforgettable show features talented dancers, musicians, and storytellers who bring the city's rich history and culture to life. Join in the fun with classic sing-alongs, creating cherished memories that celebrate the spirit of Belfast.

tours.name: Belfast Boasts
tours.description: Experience the thrill of an unforgettable adventure with our unique activity. Engage in exciting challenges that will test your skills and ignite your passion. Create lasting memories as you connect with others and immerse yourself in a one-of-a-kind experience that promises to be both exhilarating and enriching.

tours.name: Ostend at Anchor
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable North Sea sailing adventure to the vibrant Oostende voor Anker festival! Experience traditional ships, maritime crafts, and lively music while enjoying Belgian culture and cuisine. After a thrilling 24-hour sea crossing, celebrate with fellow sailors and immerse yourself in the festivities before returning home as a close-knit crew.

tours.name: Tall Ships Races: Ipswich to Le Havre
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable sailing adventure with Excelsior to the Tall Ships Races in Le Havre, France. Experience the thrill of navigating the English and French coasts while enjoying vibrant festivities, including the Crew Parade and Party. Join fellow boat enthusiasts for a celebration of maritime heritage and culture.

tours.name: Rollahub Session at Bristol Christmas Village, Castle Park
tours.description: Glide across our 15x20m Rollahub to classic tunes, feeling the rhythm beneath your skates. Join disco nights and soak up the lively atmosphere at Bristol Christmas Village’s ultimate skating spot.

tours.name: Jamie's Ultimate Cooking Experience
tours.company: Jamie Oliver Cookery School in Spains Hall
tours.description: Join a three-day culinary adventure at Jamie Oliver’s Essex home. Master fish filleting, pasta making, and BBQ skills, then enjoy delicious meals, wine tastings, garden tours, and unforgettable foodie memories.

tours.name: Hay-on-Wye to Whitney (Half-Day)
tours.description: Glide along the scenic River Wye, soaking in lush landscapes and wildlife on a two-hour canoe trip from Hay-on-Wye to Whitney-on-Wye. Feel the gentle current, pass under historic bridges, and enjoy the peaceful countryside—an ideal adventure for nature lovers seeking a memorable, relaxing escape.

tours.name: White Water Kayaking Introduction
tours.description: Experience the thrill of white water kayaking on the River Stour in Christchurch! This 3-hour introduction offers expert coaching as you navigate moving water features and learn essential techniques and rescues. Gain confidence and skills, preparing you for future adventures on grade 1/2 waters with a club or on day trips.

tours.name: Learn to Sea Kayak - Full Day
tours.description: Boost your paddling skills with expert coaching, gaining confidence and safety tips. Perfect for all levels, this fun-filled day helps you enjoy water sports while mastering essential techniques.

tours.name: Canoeing Introduction
tours.description: Experience the stunning Beaulieu River Nature Reserve on a three-hour canoeing introduction. Launch from Bailey's Hard and immerse yourself in the serene estuary while learning essential canoeing techniques. Guided by an expert coach, you'll gain confidence and be ready for future adventures on canals or rivers.

tours.name: Guided Needles Trip
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating one-day sea kayaking adventure from the New Forest to the iconic Needles on the Isle of Wight. Designed for intermediate paddlers, this journey features stunning coastal views, diverse marine life, and the thrill of crossing the Solent, culminating in the breathtaking sight of the towering chalk stacks.

tours.name: Scotland's West Coast Wonders
tours.description: Paddle through Scotland’s wild coast, exploring secluded islands, hidden coves, and stunning cliffs. Encounter wildlife, camp under stars, and immerse yourself in the rugged beauty of the Atlantic on this unforgettable four-day adventure.

tours.name: Home Education Water Sports
tours.description: Join our thrilling Paddle Sports Course for home-educated children, where you'll dive into kayaking, canoeing, and stand-up paddle boarding over six weeks. Experience teamwork, build confidence, and explore nature while earning nationally recognized Paddle UK awards. Enjoy exciting trips, hands-on learning, and memorable moments, including a scenic finale on the River Severn!

tours.name: Private Coaching
tours.description: Elevate your paddling skills in a personalized one-day coaching session designed for all levels. With expert instructors offering tailored guidance, you'll build confidence, refine techniques, and prepare for challenges in a fun, supportive atmosphere. Achieve your paddling ambitions and make the most of your day on the water!

tours.name: Paddlesport Leader Training
tours.description: Boost your paddling skills and leadership with expert coaching from Steve. This focused prep course sharpens your techniques, builds confidence, and prepares you to ace your Paddlesport Leader Assessment.

tours.name: The South Devon Explorer
tours.description: Ride behind the historic D1015 ‘Western Champion’ on a scenic journey from Birmingham to Plymouth, then explore Dart Valley and Buckfastleigh, with luxurious dining options and stunning coastal views.

tours.name: Holiday Club Full Day
tours.description: Frampton Farm’s holiday clubs offer children aged 5 to 12 an unforgettable day filled with hands-on farm activities. From feeding animals to engaging in outdoor games and crafts, kids will create lasting memories while learning new skills. Choose between half-day or full-day sessions for a tailored farm adventure!

tours.name: Paint and Pudding Night: The Brown Jug
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable evening at our Paint and Pudding Night! Enjoy a guided acrylic painting workshop where you can unleash your creativity, regardless of skill level. Indulge in a trio of delicious seasonal puddings while crafting your own masterpiece, making this event a perfect blend of art and culinary delight.

tours.name: Paint and Pudding Night: Watson Hall, Tewkesbury
tours.description: Unleash your creativity in a fun-filled acrylic painting session, guided by an expert. Enjoy a delicious trio of seasonal puddings, all materials provided—perfect for artists of all levels to craft and indulge.

tours.name: Paint and Pizza Night: Cattivo, Cirencester
tours.description: Join us for Paint & Pizza Nights, where creativity meets deliciousness! Gather your friends for a guided painting session led by an art-coach, perfect for all skill levels. Enjoy premium materials and indulge in a trio of puddings while creating your own unique masterpiece in a fun, relaxed atmosphere.

tours.name: Pioneers Home Ed Club
tours.description: Join Pioneers to gain real skills, earn qualifications like the Duke of Edinburgh’s Award, and build your CV. Enjoy volunteering, work experience, outdoor adventures, hiking, and overnight camping in a fun, supportive environment.

tours.name: HSC Ladies that Launch Beginner Course £97.50 (£195)
tours.description: Learn to sail in six fun, hands-on sessions. Feel the wind, master basic skills, and build confidence on the water—rain or shine—guided by friendly instructors in a relaxed, safe environment.

tours.name: The Alpaca Tea Party
tours.description: Experience the enchanting "Alpaca Tea Party," where a traditional tea gathering meets the delightful antics of friendly alpacas. Enjoy a guided tour of a picturesque farm, learn about these charming creatures, and create unforgettable memories while feeding and interacting with them. It's a unique blend of relaxation, education, and joy.

tours.name: Landwatch Training - Practical - Sheerness
tours.description: Join the Kent Dolphin Project to explore the fascinating marine mammals of the Kent Coast! Learn to identify whales, dolphins, porpoises, and seals while contributing to vital research. With expert guidance and provided equipment, this hands-on experience promises to deepen your appreciation for these incredible creatures and their habitat.

tours.name: The Western Mountaineer
tours.description: Ride behind the powerful D1015 ‘Western Champion’ through scenic valleys to Carlisle’s historic streets. Explore ancient cathedrals, castles, and museums—then hop back on for a memorable journey through stunning landscapes.

tours.name: Land watch training course - Southwick
tours.description: Join the Sussex Dolphin Project for an engaging 2-hour practical session where you'll learn to identify marine mammals along the stunning Sussex coast. Meet dedicated researchers, gain hands-on experience in land watching, and contribute to vital conservation efforts. Bring your binoculars and immerse yourself in the fascinating world of dolphins and seals!

tours.name: Walking tour | Litter Picking Walks
tours.description: Join us for a rewarding litter pick along Birmingham's scenic canal network, where you’ll help combat plastic pollution while enjoying the outdoors. All equipment is provided, and your participation supports the Roundhouse's mission to serve the community. Make a difference during Great Big Green Week and create lasting memories!

tours.name: 2-hour Explorer Safari
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 1-hour RIB safari tour from Fort William, where you'll explore stunning landscapes and wildlife. Witness iconic sights like Ben Nevis, Seal Island, and Loch Eil, all while enjoying the thrill of speed on the water. This adventure promises unforgettable views and memorable experiences in nature.

tours.name: The Polly Crook School of Magic
tours.description: Uncover ghostly secrets in a candlelit house, where mysterious strangers share chilling tales. Will you follow them into the dark? A spooky, immersive experience perfect for thrill-seekers aged 16 and up.

tours.name: HOW I COOK: A CHEF'S GUIDE TO REALLY GOOD HOME COOKING
tours.description: Cook alongside chef Ben Lippett to master four delicious dishes, unlocking secret flavors and boosting your home cooking skills in a fun, hands-on evening of culinary discovery.

tours.name: Private Charter - Spice Merchant (Oxford)
tours.description: Sail from Oxford on a private Thames cruise, passing charming villages, lush meadows, and historic landmarks. Perfect for celebrations or relaxing escapes, enjoy personalized routes and breathtaking scenery on this unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Creative Mornings Sketch & Paint
tours.description: Unwind with a relaxed morning of sketching and painting still life at SPVR Arcade. No experience needed—just bring your creativity, enjoy coffee and pastries, and take home your own artwork in a friendly, inspiring setting.

tours.name: Halloween Target Sport sessions
tours.description: Celebrate Halloween with 90 minutes of archery and axe throwing, featuring spooky surprises like exploding pumpkins and ghouls. Test your skills in a fun, fright-filled adventure you won’t forget.

tours.name: Private Booking
tours.description: Experience the thrill of rowing in a private Pilot Gig with a skilled coxswain guiding your group of up to 6. Enjoy personalized coaching while exploring the breathtaking bays and marinas of Weymouth and Portland, immersing yourself in the area's rich history and stunning coastal scenery.

tours.name: Ladies Wellness Rowing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of ladies rowing, where fitness meets friendship on the water! Gather your crew, strengthen your bodies, and embrace the adventure as you explore the river from a refreshing new angle. This unique activity promises unforgettable moments and a chance to bond while enjoying the great outdoors.

tours.name: Private National Gallery Tour with Expert Guide
tours.description: Enjoy a personalized tour of London's National Gallery, where your expert guide reveals the stories behind masterpieces by Van Gogh, da Vinci, and Monet, making art come alive at your own pace.

tours.name: Pequeños Exploradores del Museo Británico
tours.description: Explore the National Gallery’s stunning masterpieces, from Van Gogh to Velázquez, in a 3-hour guided tour. Marvel at iconic paintings and uncover art history’s secrets in an engaging, immersive experience.

tours.name: Fathers Day Paddle
tours.description: Paddle through the scenic Beaulieu River, surrounded by wildlife and nature. End at the cozy Master Builder’s pub for drinks and relaxation—perfect for family fun or celebrating Dad on Father’s Day.

tours.name: Tour Westminster en Familia: Historia de España e Inglaterra
tours.description: Explore London's iconic landmarks with a family-friendly tour full of stories, surprises, and fun facts. From Buckingham Palace to Big Ben, kids will connect history and adventure in a lively, engaging way.

tours.name: Copeland Distillery X Le Contour, Easter Candle Painting Workshop, Friday 27th March
tours.description: Unleash your creativity at a candle painting workshop inside Copeland Distillery. Personalize three candles, sip cocktails, and enjoy a lively evening blending art, flavor, and festive fun this Easter.

tours.name: HSC Blokes in Boats  Beginner Course £97.50 (£195)
tours.description: Join a lively 6-week sailing course that gets you on the water from day one. Build confidence, learn basic skills, and enjoy hands-on practice in a relaxed, safe environment—weather permitting, of course.

tours.name: Arte Urbano para Pequeños Exploradores
tours.description: Explore London's vibrant art scene with a family-friendly street art tour in Shoreditch. Kids will spot murals, learn about famous artists like Banksy, and see how a historic neighborhood became an outdoor gallery full of surprises.

tours.name: 'Learn to Fix' Bike Maintenance - FREE!
tours.description: Master bike repairs in just 2 hours with expert guidance. Learn to fix punctures, brake pads, chains, and more—no experience needed. Join our free, hands-on session and ride away confident in your skills.

tours.name: Kids Holiday Camp
tours.description: Paddle along the stunning Beaulieu River in a kayak or canoe, guided by friendly experts. Enjoy a family-friendly 90-minute adventure full of wildlife, scenic views, and outdoor fun—perfect for creating lasting memories.

tours.name: London Museum Combo Tour: British Museum & National Gallery with Expert Guide
tours.description: Explore London's top museums in one day with an expert guide. Marvel at ancient artifacts like the Rosetta Stone and masterpieces by Van Gogh and Monet, all curated for a deep, engaging cultural journey.

tours.name: Jalisco with Esteban Morales - May 14th
tours.description: Sip rare raicilla, hear Esteban Morales’ inspiring story, and taste exclusive bottles from Casa Endemica. Dive into Jalisco’s spirit scene and explore sustainable tequila innovations—an unforgettable tasting awaits.

tours.name: Andre from Bar Clavel in Baltimore - one off tasting
tours.description: Sip rare agave spirits with Andre Barnhill, a James Beard-recognized expert, and taste exclusive samples unavailable in the UK. Limited spots—reserve now for a truly unique mezcal experience.

tours.name: Wonders of Civilisation:  A crash course in archaeology at the British Museum
tours.description: Embark on an adventurous journey through the British Museum, guided by a qualified archaeologist. Discover the fascinating science of archaeology, explore ancient treasures, and unravel historical mysteries. Engage with ancient scripts and even play the world's oldest board game, making this experience both educational and unforgettable.

tours.name: Heritage Diesel Train Ride
tours.description: Climb aboard a heritage diesel train for a scenic 1.5-hour ride through Dean Forest, with charming stops at Lydney Junction and Parkend. Enjoy tasty treats and soak in the peaceful countryside.

tours.name: Welsh Valley Escape - Monmouthshire & Brecon Canal
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic Monmouthshire & Brecon Canal, spot wildlife, and enjoy tranquil waters. Pause at The Star Inn for lunch, then glide back through stunning countryside on this relaxing, guided adventure.

tours.name: Ashes Scattering
tours.description: Enjoy a serene one-hour river cruise from Maidenhead, stopping at Bray Weir for a quiet, heartfelt moment to scatter ashes. A peaceful, private farewell surrounded by nature’s calm.

tours.name: Member Session (Children Only)
tours.description: Join us for a 1.5-hour adventure that boosts your riding confidence while connecting school skills to real-life experiences. With all equipment provided, including bikes and helmets, you'll be fully equipped to take your riding to the next level. Just bring wellies, spare clothes, and your favorite snacks!

tours.name: Nerf Fun!
tours.description: Transform the skatepark into a lively Nerf battlefield with hideouts and team games. Kids 7-12 can enjoy an hour of safe, action-packed fun while spectators relax with a view and refreshments.

tours.name: Land watch training course - Eastbourne
tours.description: Join the Sussex Dolphin Project for an engaging 2-hour session where you'll learn to identify marine mammals along the stunning Sussex coast. Meet dedicated researchers, gain hands-on experience in land watching, and deepen your understanding of local dolphin and seal populations. Bring your binoculars and prepare for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Eckington Avon Explore
tours.description: Paddle 6.5 miles along the stunning River Avon, stopping for snacks, a picnic, and water play. Learn paddling skills, enjoy breathtaking views, and have fun in moving water—an adventure perfect for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike.

tours.name: CORPORATE EVENTS
tours.description: Escape the office with tailored outdoor team games in Scotland’s scenic Borders. Achieve your goals, boost team spirit, and relax with local food and drinks after your memorable adventure.

tours.name: SCHOOL TRIPS
tours.description: Unleash your energy with tailored adventure sports across Scotland. From camping to outdoor activities, expert instructors craft unforgettable experiences for youth and college groups, all set in scenic locations.

tours.name: Jamie's Ultimate Burger @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Master the art of juicy burgers with expert tips, quick-pickled onions, crispy bacon, and smoky sauce. Create, stack, and enjoy your perfect burger with sides and a cold beer in a fun, hands-on class.

tours.name: Loving Veg: Plant-Based Cooking @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Join a 5-hour veggie cooking class to master bold flavors, make fresh pasta, and create a vibrant Thai salad, curry, and veggie sauce. Enjoy your plant-based feast with expert demos and all ingredients provided.

tours.name: The White Rose to York & Scarborough
tours.description: Stroll through York’s historic streets, marvel at York Minster, or visit the Railway Museum. Or hop a steam train to Scarborough’s sandy beaches for a seaside escape you won’t forget.

tours.name: Henley Royal Regatta on Nicely Chilled
tours.description: Experience the vibrant Regatta like never before aboard a luxurious 8.2 metre Interboat Intender. Gather up to 8 friends for a private party as a skilled skipper guides you through this iconic British summer event. Enjoy your own refreshments or opt for catering, all while soaking in the stunning scenery.

tours.name: Canoe the River Dart
tours.description: Embark on a serene canoe paddle tour from Totnes Dewerstone Store, guided by experienced instructors through picturesque river landscapes. Perfect for all skill levels, this three-hour adventure includes all necessary equipment. Enjoy nature's tranquility and create lasting memories on the beautiful waterways of Totnes. Book your unforgettable experience today!

tours.name: Whisky Heritage Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2-hour walking tour through Campbeltown, the Victorian Whisky Capital of the World. Guided by an expert, uncover the fascinating history of the region, including tales of lost distilleries and remarkable figures who shaped its whisky legacy. Experience the essence of Campbeltown's enduring whisky tradition.

tours.name: Individual Beer Making and Tasting Workshop
tours.description: Join a 4.5-hour hands-on beer brewing session, where you'll craft, taste, and tweak recipes with fellow enthusiasts. Leave with new skills and a £25 credit to explore more brews at our shop.

tours.name: Package • Clay Shooting, Axe Throwing, & Archery • Kirkby Lonsdale
tours.description: Unleash your inner marksman with archery, axe throwing, and clay shooting in a thrilling 2.5+ hour outdoor adventure. Test your skills, challenge friends, and enjoy nonstop action in a fun, adrenaline-filled setting.

tours.name: Jamie's Ultimate Burger @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create your perfect burger with expert tips, from pickled onions to crispy bacon. Enjoy your juicy masterpiece with a beer, side salad, and recipe pack—delicious fun and new friends await!

tours.name: Shoulders of Giants: Making the modern world at the Science Museum
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey at the UK's largest science attraction, the Science Museum. Guided by an expert, explore groundbreaking inventions from timekeeping to space travel, uncovering the fascinating stories behind them. Experience science like never before, connecting historical milestones with the remarkable individuals who shaped our understanding of the universe.

tours.name: Intro to Paddlesports
