tours.description: Join the Intro Paddlesports program for a unique five-week adventure, perfect for beginners in canoeing, kayaking, and paddleboarding. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere while mastering new skills each week, with the freedom to choose your craft. Experience the joy of paddling in a fun and supportive environment starting March 1st!

tours.name: Paint & Pudding Night: The Farmers Yard, Arlingham
tours.description: Unleash your creativity in a lively 2.5-hour acrylic painting session, guided by an expert. Enjoy crafting your own masterpiece while indulging in three delicious seasonal puddings—perfect for all skill levels.

tours.name: Guided Paddle Session
tours.description: Embark on a unique adventure as you canoe or stand-up paddleboard down the scenic River Thet. Guided by an experienced instructor, you'll not only enjoy stunning views of Thetford town but also enhance your paddling skills through engaging games and a memorable journey.

tours.name: Traditional pie-making masterclass  with Calum Franklin @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Master the art of pie-making with Calum Franklin, the "pie king." Create and bake authentic pork and apple pies, learn pastry secrets, and enjoy your freshly baked masterpiece with a glass in hand.

tours.name: Southport
tours.description: Enjoy a lively day in Southport with thrilling fairground rides, tasty street food, lakeside boat fun, sandy beaches, and charming shops—perfect for adventure, relaxation, and delicious discoveries.

tours.name: Betws y Coed Christmas Market and Llandudno
tours.description: Celebrate the holiday season with a festive visit to Betws y Coed Christmas Market, then stroll along Llandudno’s charming seaside shops for a perfect day of shopping and seaside magic.

tours.name: Overplay • Cottage Field, Central Park, Plymouth
tours.description: Experience the thrill of our unique all-weather indoor inflatable play zone, featuring a cutting-edge labyrinth of rope climbs and netting. On dry days, venture into our exciting outdoor inflatable fun zone, accessible through a tunnel. Safety is our priority, ensuring a memorable adventure for all participants.

tours.name: Overplay • Danson Park
tours.description: Experience the thrill of our unique all-weather indoor inflatable play zone, featuring a state-of-the-art labyrinth of rope climbs and netting. Enjoy healthy family-friendly dining, and on dry days, explore our exciting outdoor inflatable fun zone connected by a tunnel. Safety is our priority, ensuring a memorable adventure for all!

tours.name: Land watch training course - St Leonards
tours.description: Join the Sussex Dolphin Project for an engaging 2-hour session where you'll learn to identify marine mammals along the stunning Sussex coast. Meet dedicated researchers, gain hands-on experience in land watching, and enhance your skills with provided equipment. Prepare with an online theory session to maximize your adventure!

tours.name: The Cathedrals Express to Newcastle
tours.description: Travel to Newcastle on a historic train, see a rare Castle Class locomotive, explore Newcastle Castle, visit interactive museums, and enjoy vibrant city sights—all in a day filled with history and adventure.

tours.name: Freestyle Session
tours.description: Build on your snowboard skills in a fun, supervised session for ages 7+, featuring beginner freestyle features, jumps, and tricks. Perfect for improving your riding and trying new moves on the slopes.

tours.name: Sharpen Your Knife Skills @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Master essential knife skills, learn to chop and season like a pro, and create vibrant dishes like pad Thai and pickled giardiniera. Enjoy your culinary creations at the chef’s table with drinks and take home jars of your sauces.

tours.name: Abseiling Taster Session
tours.description: Experience the thrill of descending real rock faces in our Abseil Taster Session. Designed for beginners, this exciting adventure combines learning the fundamentals of abseiling with a fun and supportive atmosphere, allowing you to conquer your fears and embrace the adrenaline rush like never before.

tours.name: Rock Climbing Taster Session
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure with our Rock Climbing Taster Session, designed for beginners. Experience the thrill of climbing on real rock while receiving guidance in a fun and supportive atmosphere. This unique opportunity promises to ignite your passion for climbing and create unforgettable memories in the great outdoors.

tours.name: Paddleboarding Taster Session
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddle boarding in a beginner-friendly session that combines skill-building with the beauty of Scotland's stunning landscapes. Immerse yourself in nature while gaining confidence on the water, making this an unforgettable adventure for newcomers and nature lovers alike.

tours.name: Bushcraft Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling Bushcraft Adventure Session where you’ll immerse yourself in nature while mastering vital survival skills. Learn to build fires, create shelters, and cook over a campfire, all guided by seasoned instructors. This unique experience promises to deepen your connection with the outdoors and enhance your survival knowledge.

tours.name: Climb and Abseil Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 3-hour Climbing and Abseiling Adventure at Glasgow Outdoor Pursuits! Whether you're a seasoned thrill-seeker or a curious beginner, this experience promises heart-pounding excitement as you conquer heights and descend cliffs, all within a supportive and enjoyable atmosphere. Unleash your adventurous spirit today!

tours.name: Loch Lomond SUP Adventure
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Loch Lomond as you explore its enchanting islands. Discover the rich history and diverse wildlife that thrive in this stunning Scottish landscape, making for an unforgettable adventure that connects you with nature and heritage in a truly remarkable setting.

tours.name: Paddle Boarding Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a Stand Up Paddle Boarding Adventure in Scotland, where you can immerse yourself in breathtaking natural beauty. This experience caters to all skill levels, blending relaxation with exploration and skill enhancement, making it a perfect outing for both beginners and seasoned paddlers alike.

tours.name: Bushcraft Birthday Party
tours.description: Transform your birthday into an unforgettable adventure with our 2-hour Birthday Bushcraft Session! Ideal for all ages, this unique celebration blends fun and learning in a beautiful natural environment, offering hands-on experiences that foster creativity and teamwork. Celebrate in style while exploring the great outdoors!

tours.name: Rock Climbing Birthday Party
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating birthday celebration with a Rock Climbing Birthday Party at Glasgow Outdoor Pursuits! Ideal for both beginners and adventure enthusiasts, this unique event combines learning climbing fundamentals with the thrill of scaling heights, ensuring unforgettable memories and a fun-filled day with friends.

tours.name: Rock Climbing Development Course
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 2-day Rock Climbing Development Course in Scotland's stunning landscapes. Tailored for climbers eager to enhance their skills, this experience focuses on real rock climbing techniques, efficient movement, and becoming a competent second in traditional climbing, all while surrounded by breathtaking natural beauty.

tours.name: Intro to Trad Climbing
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure with our one-day Intro to Trad Climbing Course at Glasgow Outdoor Pursuits! Perfect for beginners, this course immerses you in traditional climbing on natural rock, teaching essential skills and equipment use while boosting your confidence. Take your first step towards mastering the art of climbing!

tours.name: Burns Remembered, For Olde Lang Syne
tours.description: Join us for a heartfelt tribute to Scotland's national poet, featuring a moving procession to his Mausoleum. Experience an enchanting evening of music and verse in a historic church, culminating in light refreshments and a celebratory toast in our Church Hall and lawn. A memorable celebration of culture and community awaits!

tours.name: The Spirited Tour
tours.description: Embark on Bladnoch's Heritage Tour and explore 208 years of whisky-making history. Discover the captivating stories and traditions that define this iconic distillery, followed by an exclusive guided tour of the production site. Conclude with a tasting of four unique Bladnoch expressions, celebrating both past and present.

tours.name: The Sunday River Run
tours.description: Embark on a serene Sunday cruise along the River Thames, departing from the Voco Oxford Thames hotel to The Folly restaurant. Enjoy picturesque views as you glide through the city’s scenic waterways, then relax at The Folly’s private moorings with a delightful lunch or warm drink before exploring Oxford's historic charm.

tours.name: Christmas Tree Maze
tours.description: Experience the magic of Christmas Tree Wonderland in Bournemouth's Lower Gardens. Navigate the enchanting Christmas Tree Maze, filled with towering evergreens and twinkling lights. Perfect for all ages, this festive adventure invites you to explore a sparkling labyrinth where getting lost adds to the joy of the season.

tours.name: London Private Christmas Lights Tour In Iconic Black Cab
tours.description: Enjoy a private, cozy tour of London's most dazzling Christmas lights and festive landmarks. Glide through iconic streets, explore historic shops, and capture magical moments without the crowds. A festive adventure tailored for you.

tours.name: Christmas Charm in Festive England (Private, Half-day)
tours.description: Travel through charming towns like Bradford-upon-Avon and Lacock, soaking in festive sights, historic architecture, and cozy treats. A magical half-day journey into England’s Christmas spirit.

tours.name: Sushi Workshop and Japanese Mannerism in London
tours.description: Unleash your inner sushi chef in this lively workshop, where you'll craft three types of rolls and nigiri from fresh ingredients. Feel the textures, smell the flavors, and enjoy tasting your creations. With expert guidance and cultural stories, this fun experience turns beginners into sushi artists in a friendly London setting.

tours.name: Sushi Workshop Team building
tours.description: Create perfect sushi from scratch with a fun, hands-on class. Learn to make rolls, Nigiri, and Inari, enjoy a welcome drink, and dive into Japanese culture—all in a private, interactive setting.

tours.name: Bermondsey Cheese, Meat And Beer Tour
tours.description: Taste the vibrant flavors of Bermondsey with craft beers, rich cheeses, and artisanal meats. Wander lively taprooms, savor perfect pairings, and dive into London's local food scene on this flavorful beer tour.

tours.name: Home Education: Jungle Explorer's Trail
tours.description: Kids become jungle detectives in Swansea’s indoor rainforest, following a fun trail to uncover tropical animal facts. With personalized certificates, a free digital photo, and the freedom to explore at their own pace, this self-guided adventure offers a warm, educational escape—rain or shine—that sparks curiosity and creates lasting memories.

tours.name: Luxury Stargazing Cottage Break (2 Nights)
tours.description: Relax in luxury while gazing at the stars under dark skies. Enjoy guided telescope sessions, spa relaxation, and daytime solar viewing—perfect for beginners and stargazing enthusiasts alike.

tours.name: Full Day Paintballing (Fully Loaded)
tours.description: Gear up for an adrenaline-fueled day with 8-10 paintball battles, full gear, unlimited gas, and pyrotechnics like smoke and flash bangs—immerse yourself in the ultimate battlefield experience.

tours.name: Dine & Unwind Cruise
tours.description: Sail through Wigan waterways on a 2-hour cruise with live music, tasty food, and a relaxed vibe. Enjoy freshly prepared supper, sip drinks, and unwind to a talented singer—perfect for a memorable night on the water.

tours.name: Beginner Epoxy Resin Class: Create Your Own Seascape Coasters
tours.description: Create four stunning seascape coasters using epoxy resin and reclaimed wood. Guided by Jim, you'll craft wave effects, learn woodworking secrets, and take home unique, handcrafted pieces—perfect for gifts or your own collection.

tours.name: Outside In • Christmas Wreath workshop
tours.description: Create a festive wreath with Alice’s guidance, personalize your design, and enjoy a complimentary York Gin & Tonic. Leave with a beautiful spring bulb basket, aftercare tips, and a sturdy bag to take it home.

tours.name: INSPIRE:Innovate
tours.description: Explore how emergency response and aviation technology save lives. Engage with real employers, learn quick decision-making, and try basic CPR in a friendly, hands-on environment that sparks your curiosity and skills.

tours.name: Perfume Workshop
tours.description: Craft your own 30ml gin-inspired perfume blending juniper, citrus, rose, and lavender at York Distillery. Learn eco-friendly scent-making, distilling parallels, and take home a personalized fragrance with gin & tonics included.

tours.name: Creatures of the Twilight – An Evening Guided Walk
tours.description: Venture into the New Forest at dusk to spot deer, bats, and owls. Use bat detectors and sound guides to unveil the secret nocturnal world, experiencing nature’s magic as day turns to night.

tours.name: Autumn Treasures: Woodland Discoveries & Forest Traditions
tours.description: Stroll through the vibrant New Forest as it turns gold, spotting colorful leaves, berries, and fungi. Learn about seasonal treasures, folklore, and rural traditions on this gentle autumn walk. Dogs welcome on a short lead.

tours.name: Open Farm Sunday - Errington Farm Tour - 7th June 2026
tours.description: Join a free farm tour to meet friendly sheep, goats, and pigs, explore lush landscapes, and see where your cheese begins. Learn from expert farmers and get up close to adorable lambs and kids.

tours.name: Working Farm Tour
tours.description: Meet friendly farm animals, explore lush fields, and see how Errington Cheese makes its award-winning products. Feed goats, ask questions, and enjoy stunning countryside views on this engaging family tour.

tours.name: Bottomless Prosecco Boat Trip
tours.description: Experience a delightful 50-minute river cruise on the charming Lady Pamela, a vintage 1960s cruiser. Sip endless Prosecco as you glide along the scenic River Avon, taking in iconic sights like Pulteney Bridge. Enjoy personalized music and capture unforgettable moments with friends in this intimate setting.

tours.name: Overnight Ipswich – Lowestoft
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable overnight voyage aboard the historic wooden ship Excelsior, departing from Ipswich Haven Marina. Experience sailing firsthand with expert crew guidance, enjoy cozy accommodations, and take in the stunning views as you journey to Lowestoft. This unique adventure is perfect for those seeking a memorable maritime experience.

tours.name: Bed & Breakfast Harwich Shanty Festival
tours.description: Experience the Harwich Shanty Festival like never before by staying aboard the historic vessel Excelsior. Enjoy gourmet breakfasts and cozy bunks for two nights, immersing yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the festival. This unique accommodation offers a memorable maritime adventure for those aged 16 and over.

tours.name: Heritage Diesel Railcar Train Ride
tours.description: Climb aboard a heritage diesel train for a scenic 1.5-hour tour through Dean Forest, with panoramic views, charming stops at Lydney Junction and Parkend, and optional tasty treats at Norchard Station.

tours.name: Santa Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate Christmas on a 1.5-hour Santa Cruise, where Santa drives the boat, visits families, and hands out small gifts. Enjoy private tables, festive treats, and holiday fun on the water.

tours.name: Mountain Bike Night Leader Award - Training
tours.description: Enhance your mountain biking skills with the Night Leader Award, designed for experienced leaders ready to guide groups after dark. This one-day training focuses on safe leadership in night conditions, covering navigation, emergency procedures, and risk management. Gain the confidence to lead thrilling nighttime adventures while ensuring safety and enjoyment.

tours.name: Easter Archery Tournament
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 90-minute archery session perfect for ages 8 and up, featuring expert guidance and fun Easter-themed games. Enjoy chocolates and compete for exciting prizes while creating lasting family memories. Challenge yourself and share laughter with loved ones in this unique twist on traditional Easter activities!

tours.name: Fundamentals of MTB Leadership Award
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey to become a certified mountain bike leader! This comprehensive course blends online learning with hands-on training, equipping you with essential skills in leadership, route planning, and emergency management. Perfect for anyone eager to guide groups through diverse terrains, it promises unforgettable adventures in the great outdoors.

tours.name: Adult Swim
tours.description: Experience the thrill of open water swimming in a beautifully maintained lake at HYMB. Perfect for those aged 14 and up with prior experience, enjoy up to 3.5 hours of refreshing fun on Wednesday evenings or Saturday mornings. Facilities include changing rooms and refreshments to enhance your adventure.

tours.name: RYA Level 1 Start Sailing
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-day sailing adventure designed for complete beginners! This comprehensive course offers hands-on experience with dinghies, expert supervision, and essential sailing knowledge. Complete the program to earn your RYA Level 1 Certificate and gain confidence on the water, making unforgettable memories along the way.

tours.name: Christmas Swim 2025
tours.description: Dive into the festive spirit at our annual Christmas swim on Saturday, December 14th! Enjoy a refreshing swim while wearing your favorite Christmas hat, followed by delicious mince pies, mulled wine, and hot drinks. Celebrate the season with a unique and memorable experience during our last swim of the year.

tours.name: Christmas Cruise 14th December 2024
tours.description: Join us for a festive 3-hour Christmas paddle where creativity meets celebration! Dress up in fancy attire, choose your craft, and enjoy delicious hot drinks, soup, mince pies, and mulled wine afterward. This memorable event is perfect for juniors aged 10+ when accompanied by an adult.

tours.name: Ghost Stories from Michelham Priory
tours.description: Step into the haunting past of Michelham Priory on a thrilling torchlight tour. Uncover hidden secrets of monks, murder, and treason as you navigate the eerie halls. With spine-chilling stories and unexpected scares, this adult-only experience promises to transform your perception of this historic site forever.

tours.name: The Turn of the Screw
tours.description: Please note! This event is being rescheduled for February 2022.

tours.name: Stargazing and Astrophotography • Brecon Beacons
tours.description: Join expert astronomers for a 3-hour night sky tour in Wales. View planets, nebulae, and galaxies through telescopes, learn astrophotography, and capture stunning images under some of the darkest skies. No experience needed.

tours.name: Coasteering - Private activity
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 3-hour coasteering adventure along the stunning North Wales coastline. Experience thrilling cliff jumps, explore coastal caves, and discover diverse wildlife. With expert guides ensuring your safety and enjoyment, this unforgettable journey promises breathtaking views and exciting challenges, making it perfect for friends, families, or special occasions.

tours.name: Attack Sense
tours.description: Experience a revolutionary tactical training with Attack Sense, an electronic target system for airsoft and simulation rounds. Engage in dynamic training simulations and competitive games using a wireless app that tracks your performance. Set in a unique bunker complex, this activity sharpens your skills while providing thrilling CQB challenges.

tours.name: Ghost Stories from Wymering Manor
tours.description: Step into Wymering Manor by candlelight, hear chilling tales from its haunted past, and brace for dark surprises. This adult-only tour reveals the house’s eerie secrets—staircases, jump scares, and spine-tingling stories await.

tours.name: Seven Sisters Boat Trip
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating RHIB ride along the stunning Seven Sisters with the Sussex Dolphin Project. Experience breathtaking views of Seaford Bay and Beachy Head Lighthouse while learning about local cetaceans and seabird colonies. This unique adventure not only offers unforgettable sights but also supports marine conservation efforts in Sussex.

tours.name: FREE Easter Egg Hunt
tours.description: Join us for a delightful Under 5's Easter Egg Hunt on Easter Saturday! Watch your little ones dash around our golf course, searching for hidden chocolate eggs. This family-friendly event encourages older siblings to join in the fun. Make sure to book online and arrive early for an unforgettable experience!

tours.name: Acoustic Nights
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable evening of acoustic performances from talented bands across the UK, all while enjoying Minehead's finest pizzas and a fully licensed bar. Embrace the spirit of exploration and create lasting memories as you navigate the sea with fellow adventurers.

tours.name: River Ouse To Lewes E-bike Tour 3 Hours
tours.description: Cycle along the scenic River Ouse to Lewes, passing charming villages and river houses. Explore medieval streets, old churches, and visit Sussex’s oldest brewery. A lively, picturesque adventure awaits.

tours.name: Coastal Flat Ground E-bike Cruise Tour 1.5 Hours
tours.description: Cycle along a scenic coast, explore 200-year-old Tidemills ruins, and watch kittiwakes on dramatic cliffs—all in a relaxed 1.5-hour ride with ice cream stops and stunning views.

tours.name: Seven Sisters Guided E-bike Tour
tours.description: Cycle along stunning coastlines, explore the iconic Seven Sisters cliffs, and hear tales of smuggling gangs. Choose a relaxed or thrilling ride on scenic tracks—an unforgettable 2-hour adventure along the South Downs.

tours.name: Friston Forest Downhill E-bike Track Tour
tours.description: Race down thrilling downhill tracks in Friston Forest, weaving through bomb crater jumps and scenic trails. Feel the rush on our E-bikes, perfect for adventure seekers and families alike in stunning South Downs National Park.

tours.name: Ladies Night (Beginners)
tours.description: Join our unique beginner ski lessons designed exclusively for women, led by experienced female instructors. Enjoy a supportive environment as you learn essential skiing skills, then relax with coffee and cake while sharing your progress with new friends. Experience the joy of skiing in a friendly, empowering atmosphere!

tours.name: Ski Party
tours.description: Celebrate your birthday uniquely with an exciting ski lesson for you and up to nine friends! Enjoy an hour of instruction tailored for beginners, followed by relaxation in a cozy party hut. Learn the basics, play games, and create unforgettable memories in a fun, snowy setting.

tours.name: Snowboard Party
tours.description: Celebrate your birthday with an unforgettable snowboarding adventure! Gather up to nine friends for an hour of thrilling instruction tailored for beginners, followed by relaxation in a cozy party hut. Enjoy learning the basics while creating lasting memories and having fun together in a unique winter setting.

tours.name: Race workshop
tours.description: Join our exciting race workshops designed to enhance your skiing skills! Perfect for aspiring racers, you'll learn to navigate race stubbies and improve your times in preparation for the SSSA race and Ayrshire Schools Snowsports Championship. Elevate your performance and gain confidence on the slopes!

tours.name: Race time trial
tours.description: Experience the thrill of racing with timed sessions designed to prepare skiers for upcoming competitions. Under the guidance of an instructor, participants can discover their speed on the race course, building excitement for the SSSA race in October and the Ayrshire Schools Snowsports Championship in March.

tours.name: Snowboard Fun Day
tours.description: Kids on skis or snowboards will love this fun-filled day of lessons, games, and tubing, perfect for beginners. They’ll build skills, make friends, and enjoy a memorable winter adventure in just five hours.

tours.name: 2 Hour - Private Ski Lessons
tours.description: Experience personalized 2-hour ski lessons tailored for all skill levels, from beginners to advanced skiers. Enjoy individual attention from friendly instructors as you learn at your own pace, ensuring maximum slope time. Perfect for groups of 1 to 10, these lessons promise a memorable and effective skiing experience.

tours.name: Jacobs UK SUP Activity
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 30-minute introduction to stand up paddleboarding, where you'll gain essential safety tips for enjoying the water with your family this summer. Dive into this unique adventure and discover the joy of paddleboarding while ensuring a safe and memorable experience for everyone involved.

tours.name: Return Train Travel (Day Rover) including Breakfast on the Dales Diner
tours.description: Experience a delightful Day Rover Ticket adventure, featuring a hearty Full English Breakfast served at 10:30 AM from Embsay. This unique combination of scenic exploration and a traditional meal promises a memorable day filled with delicious flavors and beautiful views, perfect for food lovers and adventure seekers alike.

tours.name: Cruises will be decided the day before
tours.description: Experience the thrill of spontaneous September cruises, where each day’s adventure is determined by the sea’s conditions. Join us for unique journeys crafted just a day in advance, ensuring an exhilarating and memorable outing. Stay updated here or call the skipper for the latest cruise opportunities.

tours.name: Backend bookings - bespoke canoe, kayak, SUP Hire
Heritage Steam Train Rides
tours.description: Climb aboard a vintage steam train with charming Victorian carriages for a scenic 6-mile round trip through lush countryside and a stunning wooded valley. With unlimited travel all day, you can hop on and off at any station, making every journey unique. Book online to save and enjoy a nostalgic railway adventure.

tours.name: Private - London Christmas Experience: Lights, Markets & Festive Magic
tours.description: Enjoy a private, relaxed walk through London's festive lights, iconic streets, and hidden corners. Soak up holiday magic, hear Christmas stories, and capture unforgettable moments in the city’s most enchanting seasonal spots.

tours.name: Soho
tours.description: Dive into dark comedy at Soho’s Rum Monkey, where twisted jokes and unapologetic laughs push boundaries. A wild, raunchy show for adults seeking bold humor in the heart of London’s West End.

tours.name: Santa Special
tours.description: Embark on a magical journey through Sherwood Forest Railway, culminating in a personal visit to Santa in his enchanting grotto. Each child receives a thoughtfully wrapped gift tailored to their age, making this festive experience truly unforgettable and filled with holiday cheer.

tours.name: Gondola Experiance at Bristol Christmas Market, Broadmead
tours.description: Climb into a transformed ski gondola for a cozy winter escape, perfect for romantic moments or groups. Enjoy stunning snowy views in a unique, unheated setting—arrive on time for your full 80-minute adventure.

tours.name: Peel to Ardglass, TT Races:
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey from Ardglass marina to Peel Harbour, immersing yourself in the thrilling atmosphere of the TT races. Experience the excitement of high-speed motorcycle racing while enjoying stunning coastal views, making this trip a memorable adventure for motorsport enthusiasts and nature lovers alike.

tours.name: Spirit of Wales Evening, Dinner & Show
tours.description: Experience the captivating Spirit of Wales, where traditional culture comes alive through enchanting harp melodies, stirring anthems, and iconic prose in a stunning Chapel setting. Savor a delicious three-course meal crafted from local produce while immersing yourself in the rich heritage of Wales, celebrating its unique spirit and vibrant community.

tours.name: RYA Powerboat Level 1
tours.description: Experience the thrill of power boating with the RYA Powerboat Level 1 course! Learn essential skills like safe handling, launching, and mooring, all while enjoying hands-on training. Perfect for beginners, this course also contributes to the Duke of Edinburgh Award and Scout Coxswain Badge, making it both fun and rewarding.

tours.name: The Big 450 Bess-tival Concert
tours.description: Experience a unique live music concert celebrating Queen Elizabeth I's historic visit to Elmley Castle in 1575. Enjoy performances from three bands in an open-air venue, with food and drinks available. Join us for a memorable evening filled with music, history, and community spirit under the stars.

tours.name: Welcome To Wrexham (unofficial) Public Walking Tour of Wrexham.
tours.description: Experience Wrexham like never before with a passionate local guide who shares the club's rich history and behind-the-scenes stories from *Welcome to Wrexham*. Explore iconic locations, meet fellow fans, and discover how Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney have transformed the city, celebrating its vibrant community and unforgettable legacy.

tours.name: Canoe Half Day Session
tours.description: Embark on a half-day canoe adventure at a stunning local Loch, perfect for families and friends. Experience the tranquility of nature while paddling through serene waters, creating unforgettable memories together. This unique outing promises excitement and bonding in a picturesque setting, making it an ideal escape from the everyday.

tours.name: Canoe River Trip Experience
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through the stunning Tweed Valley, perfect for small groups seeking adventure. Whether you're with family, celebrating a stag party, or enjoying time with friends, this expedition promises breathtaking scenery and memorable experiences as you navigate the river together.

tours.name: Mountain Bike Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of biking with Kayantics! Choose the perfect bike size for your adventure and set off on an unforgettable journey. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced rider, this activity promises excitement and exploration in a stunning outdoor setting. Get ready for an exhilarating ride!

tours.name: Raft Building & Team Building
tours.description: Experience the thrill of teamwork with raft building! Collaborate with your team to construct a sturdy raft on the banks, then put your creation to the test on the water. With a safety boat accompanying you, this unique challenge promises excitement and unforgettable memories as you navigate together!

tours.name: Bushcraft Survival
tours.description: Experience the thrill of wilderness living in this introductory session! Learn essential skills like fire lighting, shelter building, and outdoor cooking. Embrace the great outdoors and gain confidence in your survival abilities while connecting with nature in a unique and memorable way.

tours.name: Traditional Bushcraft - Wood Craft
tours.description: Discover the art of traditional woodcraft as you create unique artifacts using basic tools. Engage in hands-on activities like whistle making, crafting walking sticks, and building bushcraft stools. This immersive experience offers a chance to connect with nature while honing valuable skills in a creative and memorable way.

tours.name: Adventure Combo Day
tours.description: Experience a full day of excitement by combining various activity sessions tailored to your interests. Enhance your adventure with our catering options, ensuring a delightful day filled with fun and memorable moments. Reach out to customize your perfect day with us!

tours.name: 2 Days River Tweed Canoe Expedition
tours.description: Experience the river like never before on this unforgettable wildlife adventure. Spot fascinating creatures such as otters, grey seals, and kingfishers while enjoying the serene beauty of nature. With each trip offering unique encounters, this journey promises to be both exciting and memorable. Join us for an extraordinary exploration!

tours.name: Workshops: After Hours Clay Crafts
tours.description: Join our engaging pottery workshops and create your own unique piece! From Highland Cows to Spring Flowers, and even festive pumpkin carving and Christmas wreaths, each session offers a chance to explore your creativity in a fun and supportive environment. Unleash your artistic side and craft memorable keepsakes!

tours.name: Special Occasions
tours.description: Secure your spot for those sought-after special occasions that everyone wants to be part of! Don't miss the chance to celebrate in style and create unforgettable memories on those busy days that matter most.

tours.name: After Hours: Themed Nights
tours.description: Join us for themed painting sessions celebrating your favorite pop culture icons! From Taylor Swift to Shrek, Harry Potter to ABBA, and Disney classics, unleash your creativity while connecting with fellow fans. This unique experience promises fun, laughter, and memorable masterpieces inspired by the things you love!

tours.name: Lantern Tour
tours.description: Step into history with a flickering lantern, exploring the vaults beneath Clifton Suspension Bridge. Feel like an engineer of the past as guides reveal stories of the laborers and construction secrets in this unforgettable hour-long adventure.

tours.name: SSI Diver Stress and Rescue
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with the SSI Diver Stress and Rescue Specialty program! Gain essential skills to identify stress, prevent accidents, and execute rescues through hands-on pool and open water training. Complete the course and earn your certification, empowering you to confidently handle emergency situations in diving.

tours.name: 20 Hour Manual Course
tours.description: Master the art of driving with confidence in a manual transmission vehicle. This course focuses on essential skills like clutch control and smooth gear changes, empowering learners to navigate the roads with ease. Gain the flexibility to drive both manual and automatic cars, enhancing your driving experience and independence.

tours.name: 30 Hour Manual Course
tours.description: Master the art of driving with confidence in a manual transmission vehicle. This course focuses on essential skills like clutch control and smooth gear changes, empowering you to navigate hills and traffic with ease. Perfect for learners seeking greater control and the ability to drive both manual and automatic cars.

tours.name: 40 Hour Manual Course
tours.description: Master the art of driving with confidence in a manual transmission vehicle. This hands-on course focuses on essential skills like clutch control and smooth gear changes, empowering you to navigate any road with ease. Perfect for learners seeking greater control and the ability to drive both manual and automatic cars.

tours.name: Test In A Week (Manual)
tours.description: Master the art of driving with confidence in a manual transmission vehicle. This course focuses on essential skills like clutch control, smooth gear changes, and hill starts, empowering learners to navigate the road with greater control and flexibility, enabling them to drive both manual and automatic cars safely and efficiently.

tours.name: Test In A Week (Auto)
tours.description: Experience the freedom of driving with our automatic driving course, where you'll master essential skills like smooth acceleration, steering, and safe navigation. Gain confidence in handling junctions and roundabouts, all while simplifying the learning process—perfect for preparing you to pass your driving test with ease.

tours.name: 30 Hours Automatic Lessons
tours.description: Experience the joy of driving with ease in this course designed for beginners. Focus on mastering smooth acceleration, braking, and steering while enhancing your road awareness. Perfect for those seeking a relaxed approach, this program helps you develop strong, safe driving habits quickly and confidently.

tours.name: 40 Hours Automatic Lessons
tours.description: Experience the joy of driving without the complexities of gears or a clutch in this unique course. Focus on mastering smooth acceleration, braking, and steering while enhancing your road awareness. Perfect for learners seeking a relaxed environment to develop strong, safe driving habits quickly and confidently.

tours.name: Couples Day Pool
tours.description: Relax by the pool on a comfy daybed, sip a refreshing cocktail jug, enjoy chef’s tapas, and indulge in tasty mezze—all with a complimentary towel to complete your perfect day.

tours.name: Shared Christmas Party Night
tours.description: Experience the magic of the season at our renowned Christmas Party Nights! Perfect for festive work gatherings or joyful celebrations with friends and family, these events promise a memorable evening filled with holiday cheer and camaraderie. Join us for an unforgettable celebration that captures the spirit of Christmas!

tours.name: Squid Fishing - Sole Venture
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating squid fishing adventure with rod and line, perfect for families and beginners! Experience the thrill of catching squid while exploring the stunning Jurassic Coast and Weymouth Harbour. This unique outing promises fun on the water and a chance to learn the basics of fishing.

tours.name: Advanced White Water Kayak Leader Training
tours.description: Boost your skills in just two days with expert-led training to confidently lead groups on challenging white water rivers, mastering boat control, rescue, safety, and leadership for safe, fun adventures.

tours.name: Half Day Charter
tours.description: Sail aboard the historic Wherry Albion, built in 1898, and enjoy a hands-on adventure on the Broads. Spot wildlife, help crew, or relax on deck as the skipper navigates tides and weather—your perfect day on the water.

tours.name: Private Sushi Workshop at Your Home
tours.description: Create authentic sushi from scratch in your own kitchen with a complete kit. Master perfect rice, craft 20 rolls—including inside-out and Nigiri—and learn Japanese traditions. All ingredients and tools are provided, along with recipes and stories. A fun, hands-on experience that transforms your cooking skills and cultural knowledge.

tours.name: Festive craft with elfs + Santa meet and greet
tours.description: Children craft holiday decorations with Santa’s elves, sip warm hot chocolate, and write letters to Santa in a cozy grotto. They’ll meet friendly farm animals, creating joyful Christmas memories. This festive adventure combines creativity, fun, and heartwarming moments for the whole family to cherish during the holiday season.

tours.name: Sketch & Sip - draw who / what you love!
tours.description: Unleash your creativity at a relaxed distillery sketch night with expert tips, free gin & tonic, and an open bar. Perfect for all skill levels to draw, laugh, and socialize in a cozy, welcoming space.

tours.name: School Holiday Honey Harvest Workshop
tours.description: Kids aged 7+ dive into the world of bees, extracting real honey and crafting beeswax candles in a fun, hands-on workshop near London Bridge. A sweet, educational adventure they’ll never forget.

tours.name: Pancake Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate Pancake Day with a lively 1.5-hour canal cruise featuring live lock experiences, tasty hot food, pottery painting, and scenic views—perfect for families and friends to enjoy together.

tours.name: London – Private Exclusive Tour: British Museum & Changing of the Guard
tours.description: Explore London's treasures with a private guide: see Egyptian mummies and the Rosetta Stone at the British Museum, then witness the Changing of the Guard at Buckingham Palace—an exclusive, personalized adventure through history and tradition.

tours.name: Sunday Carvery
tours.description: Relax with family at Magheramorne Estate’s Sunday carvery, featuring seasonal delights crafted by Jane’s Kitchen. Enjoy good food, warm company, and a beautiful setting—perfect for making lasting memories.

tours.name: Steam Locomotive Driver Experience
tours.description: Take control of historic diesel or steam locomotives in a thrilling 30-40 minute session. Learn, drive, and feel the power of these mighty machines under expert guidance. Limited spots—book now for an unforgettable ride.

tours.name: Brecon Canal Basin to Pencelli (5 miles)
tours.description: Paddle through tranquil countryside, crossing the iconic Brynich Aqueduct with stunning views of the Brecon Beacons. Spot wildlife along peaceful banks and unwind at the charming Royal Oak pub before your return trip.

tours.name: 250A - Children's Pet Figurine Workshop with Dave Short
tours.description: Create charming animal figurines in terracotta using pinching and sculpting techniques with finalist Dave Short. Shape lively poses, add color details, and make multiple figures in a fun, fast-paced 2-hour session.

tours.name: Liverpool Highlights Walking Tour (RCN Congress)
tours.description: Stroll through Liverpool’s historic streets and lively waterfront, uncovering stories of trade, music, and local legends. Enjoy iconic sights and hidden gems, all brought to life by passionate guides in a relaxed, engaging tour.

tours.name: Liverpool Beatles Walking Tour (RCN Congress)
tours.description: Walk through Liverpool’s streets and relive The Beatles’ rise from local lads to global icons. Visit iconic spots, hear behind-the-scenes stories, and feel the city’s musical heartbeat on this immersive guided tour.

tours.name: Taste of Tokyo
tours.description: Create authentic Tokyo flavors in a fun, hands-on class. Make three delicious dishes, learn tips from a friendly chef, and enjoy your homemade meal. Take recipes and leftovers home—no fuss, just flavor.

tours.name: Summer in Bosnia
tours.description: Explore Bosnia’s rich history and stunning landscapes in 7 days. From Sarajevo’s panoramic cable car rides to Mostar’s iconic bridge, waterfalls, memorials, and scenic lakes—an unforgettable adventure awaits.

tours.name: Father's Day Sunday Carvery
tours.description: Celebrate Father's Day with a leisurely carvery at Magheramorne Estate. Savor seasonal dishes crafted by Jane’s Kitchen, relax with loved ones, and enjoy a welcoming setting perfect for making special memories.

tours.name: La Vala - Food pop up
tours.description: Enjoy a free Mezcal and reserved seating at La Vala Fonda’s first London food pop-up, blending authentic flavors and exciting new dishes in a cozy, unforgettable tasting experience.

tours.name: London: The Jack the Ripper Obsession
Tour serale
tours.description: Join a 3-hour adventure exploring iconic sights, with flexible meeting points. Bring your Oyster Card or card, wear comfy shoes, and prepare for an unforgettable journey through London's vibrant streets.

tours.name: Archery | Bodiam  | 1 hour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery with expert coaches guiding you through safety and precision shooting. Perfect for families, school groups, and parties, this one-hour session includes fun challenges and games, ensuring everyone can participate. With limited waiting time and focused tuition, you'll quickly develop your skills in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Brighton Beach Tandem Bike Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of tandem biking along Brighton's stunning seafront cycle lane, free from busy roads. With over twenty years of local expertise, Brighton Beach Bikes offers personalized recommendations for your adventure. Enjoy hassle-free access to the beach and create unforgettable memories with family and friends in this vibrant coastal city.

tours.name: Group Christmas Dinner Cruise
tours.description: Experience a unique private dinner cruise for 20 to 50 guests, featuring a delightful 3-course meal including homemade soup, traditional Roast Turkey Dinner, and festive Christmas Pudding. Enjoy stunning views and a fully stocked bar for three unforgettable hours, making it the perfect setting for a memorable holiday celebration.

tours.name: Londra in un giorno - Tour privato
tours.description: Explore London's top sights in a 6.5-hour tour: from Parliament and Westminster Abbey to Buckingham Palace, the National Gallery, Tower of London, and vibrant Borough Market, all with expert guides and scenic views.

tours.name: More Than The Troubles - Group Tour
tours.description: Uncover Belfast’s dramatic journey from conflict to peace in a 2-hour walk. Explore 400 years of history, from Irish roots to Victorian grandeur and Troubles turmoil, with expert guides revealing the city’s resilient spirit.

tours.name: Battello e visita di Greenwich - Tour privato
tours.description: Climb aboard for a 40-minute boat tour past Westminster, the City, and Docklands. See the Cutty Sark, Greenwich Observatory, and the Prime Meridian—an unforgettable journey through London's maritime history.

tours.name: Paintball Rednal
tours.description: Experience an adrenaline-pumping paintball session featuring 6-7 different games across dynamic battle zones. With 2 hours of action-packed gameplay, you'll engage in thrilling challenges alongside friends. Perfect for groups of 6 to 40, this unforgettable adventure promises excitement and camaraderie in a high-energy environment.

tours.name: Intro to SUP - Brokerswood
tours.description: Try paddleboarding in a safe, fun setting with games and basic skills. Perfect for all ages, it’s a great way to dip your toes into water sports before hitting the river. All gear included—just bring your clothes and towel.

tours.name: Glorious Scotland
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking tour of central Scotland, exploring stunning landscapes, including Loch Lomond and the Arrochar Alps. Capture unforgettable photographs, enjoy charming villages like Inveraray, and indulge in local delicacies. With options for scenic walks and unique souvenirs, this experience promises a memorable taste of Scotland's natural beauty.

tours.name: Scotland in TV and Film
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Scotland's cinematic history, exploring iconic locations from "Braveheart," "Outlander," and more. Walk the battlefields, engage in thrilling battle simulations, and visit the resting place of Rob Roy, all while surrounded by breathtaking scenery. Experience the rich tapestry of Scotland's past like never before.

tours.name: Time Traveler Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Scotland's rich history, from ancient burial grounds to iconic film locations like Outlander and Braveheart. Explore the stunning landscapes of the Bathgate hills, visit Stirling Castle, and marvel at the majestic Kelpies. This immersive experience blends history, culture, and breathtaking sights in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: The Outlander Experience
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Scotland's stunning landscapes as you explore iconic filming locations from the hit series Outlander. Visit historic castles, including Doune Castle and Linlithgow Palace, while immersing yourself in the rich history and breathtaking scenery. This customizable tour promises a unique blend of adventure and nostalgia.

tours.name: Edinburgh City Highlights
tours.description: Explore the enchanting city of Edinburgh on a customizable tour that takes you from the historic Royal Mile to the stunning Edinburgh Castle. Discover the charm of both the old and new towns, visiting iconic sites like Holyrood House Palace and the Royal Yacht Britannia, all tailored to your interests.

tours.name: Glasgow City Highlights
tours.description: Experience the best of Glasgow on this unique walking and driving tour, blending the city's rich history with modern attractions. Explore iconic sites like Glasgow Cathedral and George Square, then venture to the stunning Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Riverside Museum. Customize your journey to ensure you see your must-visit spots!

tours.name: Your Roots
tours.description: Embark on a personalized journey to your Scottish roots with a tailored tour that connects you to your ancestral home and its surroundings. Discover local history and culture, making this an unforgettable experience for those with Scottish heritage. Let us help you explore your family's legacy in a meaningful way.

tours.name: Experience New Lanark
tours.description: Experience a unique journey through New Lanark, a historic Scottish Wool Mill where social reform transformed workers' lives in the late 18th century. Discover the innovative practices of David Dale and Robert Owen, including free healthcare and education, all set against the stunning backdrop of the River Clyde.

tours.name: Corporate Hospitality
tours.description: Escape the office and explore the beauty of Scotland with Designer Tour. Choose from curated tours or customize your own adventure, complete with a luxury hamper of local delicacies. Capture unforgettable moments with a professional photographer, ensuring a memorable experience for you and your guests. Enjoy a day of relaxation and discovery!

tours.name: Tour Designer
tours.description: Experience Scotland like never before with a fully personalized tour designed just for you and your group of up to seven. From whisky distilleries to historic castles, your unique itinerary will be crafted to match your interests, ensuring an unforgettable adventure in the heart of Scotland.

tours.name: Stirling Castle, Hairy Coo's and the Trossachs
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through Scotland with a private tour to Stirling Castle, where you'll uncover the legendary tales of William Wallace and Robert The Bruce. After immersing yourself in history, enjoy the stunning countryside, meet the iconic Highland Coo's, and explore the serene Village of Luss in the Trossachs.

tours.name: Golf, Whisky and Palaces (A very Scottish Tour)
tours.description: Embark on a unique Scottish adventure that blends golf, whisky, and history. Explore St Andrews, the birthplace of golf, visit its historic cathedral, enjoy a whisky distillery tour in Kingsbarns, and discover the charming town of Falkland, a filming location for Outlander, capped off with a visit to its Royal Palace.

tours.name: Stag Do Surfing
tours.description: Catch waves at Newquay’s famous beaches with a fun, beginner-friendly 2-hour surf lesson. All gear included, led by expert guides—perfect for stag groups craving adventure and a true taste of British surfing.

tours.name: Half Day Mens Wetsuit Rental
tours.description: Stay warm and flexible with the Legend 4:3 wetsuit, featuring Xtend neoprene, seamless zones, and reinforced seams. Perfect for paddling comfort during your 4-hour adventure.

tours.name: Mens Wetsuit Rental All Day
tours.description: Stay warm and flexible with the Legend 4:3 wetsuit, featuring Xtend neoprene for stretch, reinforced seams, and a sleek back zip. Perfect for paddling comfort and durability in any water adventure.

tours.name: Half Day Womens Wetsuit Rental
tours.description: Dive into 4 hours of surfing in the Surflite 4:3 Back Zip wetsuit, designed for warmth, flexibility, and style with sealed seams, Xtend neoprene, and reinforced zones—your perfect gear for hitting the waves.

tours.name: Womens Wetsuit Rental
tours.description: Feel the warmth and flexibility of the Surflite 4:3 Back Zip wetsuit, featuring sealed seams, Xtend neoprene, and reinforced panels for maximum comfort and durability in the water.

tours.name: VIP Colosseum under the Moon, Ghosts of the Gladiators
tours.description: Step inside the Colosseum after dark, when the crowds are gone and history comes alive in silence. A rare, 1.5-hour guided tour that reveals the ancient wonder in a truly unforgettable, exclusive setting.

tours.name: Haunted Ghost Tour, the Dark Side of Venice
tours.description: Explore Venice after dark on a thrilling 1-hour tour through haunted streets, secret alleys, and ghostly legends. Encounter vampires, mermaids, and spirits lurking behind ancient walls—brace yourself for a spooky adventure.

tours.name: Colosseum VIP Underground & Dungeons Tour
tours.description: Step into history with VIP access to the Colosseum’s undergrounds and stand at the heart of the arena. Explore secret chambers once home to gladiators and wild beasts—an exclusive journey into ancient Rome’s legendary past.

tours.name: Haunted Rome, Ghosts in the Eternal City
tours.description: Explore Rome’s dark side after sunset on a spooky 2-hour tour through secret streets, haunted ruins, and ghostly legends of emperors, popes, and artists—where eerie stories and hidden corners bring history to life.

tours.name: Pompei Tour
tours.description: Step into ancient Pompeii with a local guide, skipping lines to explore temples, baths, mosaics, and the tragic casts of its last residents. Uncover stories from 2,000 years ago and get tips for your next adventure.

tours.name: Rome's Bar Scene Tour
tours.description: Sip, stroll, and uncover Rome’s secrets in a lively 2-hour tour blending local pubs, hidden memorials, and vibrant piazzas—perfect for socializing, learning history, and enjoying authentic pizza and drinks.

tours.name: Stonehenge Direct Tour
tours.description: Explore the mystery of Stonehenge with a 6-hour self-guided tour, including an extended visit, audio guide in multiple languages, and transportation. Uncover ancient secrets at this iconic world heritage site.

tours.name: Young Family Sea Kayak Camp (Kids 5 to 11)
tours.description: Paddle through rocky islands, spot a seal, explore hidden sea caves, fish for mackerel, and camp on a remote beach. No experience needed—just bring your sense of adventure for this unforgettable 2-day coastal escape.

tours.name: Level 4 Sea Kayak Course
tours.description: Paddle along stunning coastlines, spot seals and dolphins, explore sea caves, and relax on remote beaches. Build your kayaking skills, boost confidence, and enjoy a fun, tailored adventure with expert guides.

tours.name: Paddle UK Coastal Sea Kayak Award Training
tours.description: Master coastal sea kayaking in Dartmouth, tackling tidal planning, swell, and wind up to force 4. Build confidence, refine skills, and prepare for assessment in this immersive two-day course.

tours.name: SUP Hire | Tonbridge
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic River Medway at your own pace, stopping for snacks or relaxing on the bank. Perfect for groups and adventure seekers ready to enjoy water fun and stunning views.

tours.name: Political Cab Mural Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating one-hour journey through Belfast's history with a knowledgeable local guide. Explore the iconic wall murals and hear firsthand accounts of life during the conflict. This private tour offers a unique perspective on the city's transformation, making it an unforgettable experience for history enthusiasts.

tours.name: Giants Causeway Tours - Costal Drive
tours.description: Discover the breathtaking Giant’s Causeway, often called the 'Eighth Wonder' of the world, on an 8-hour private tour. Experience stunning coastal views and delve into captivating myths with knowledgeable local guides who share personal stories from Ireland's rich history. This unforgettable journey is a highlight of any visit to Ireland.

tours.name: Game of Thrones Location Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour journey through the iconic landscapes of Northern Ireland, where "Game of Thrones" was filmed. With a personal driver and guide, explore legendary sites like Ballintoy Harbour and the Giant’s Causeway, while gaining unique insights from local guides who share their rich stories and history.

tours.name: Derry Londonderry Private Guided Minivan Tour From Belfast
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour private tour of Derry, exploring its rich history and stunning architecture. Discover the iconic Derry’s Walls, St. Columb’s Cathedral, and the poignant sites of Bloody Sunday. Enjoy breathtaking views from the Tower Museum and relax at Ireland's highest pub, the Ponderosa, in the scenic Sperrin Mountains.

tours.name: Belfast Mural Private Guided Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute journey through Belfast's rich history with a local guide. Explore the powerful murals that tell the story of The Troubles, including the iconic Peace Wall. Enjoy a personalized experience in a private minivan, gaining unique insights into the city's divided past and vibrant street art.

tours.name: Derry Londonderry Private Day Trip From Belfast
tours.description: Embark on a one-of-a-kind private tour of Derry, led by a local historian and political activist. Explore the poignant sites of the Battle of the Bogside and Bloody Sunday, while discovering the city's ancient walls and vibrant murals. This customizable experience offers an in-depth look at Derry's unique history.

tours.name: Belfast Private Guided Mountain Trekking Tour
tours.description: Escape the hustle of Belfast with a private hiking tour of Divis and the Black Mountain. Enjoy personalized guidance as you trek through stunning landscapes, with hassle-free round-trip transfers from your hotel. This customizable adventure is perfect for moderate and experienced hikers seeking a memorable outdoor experience.

tours.name: Armagh Private Day Tour From Belfast
tours.description: Embark on a unique 7-hour private tour of County Armagh, exploring its rich history and culture away from typical tourist spots. Visit ancient sites like Navan Fort and the stunning St. Patrick's Cathedrals, guided by a professional historian. Experience a fully customizable adventure tailored just for your group.

tours.name: IRA Troubles Conflict Private Tour Museum Graves Murals and Political Analysis
tours.description: Embark on a unique 4-hour tour of Belfast, guided by a Sinn Féin member and Irish Republican activist. Gain exclusive insights into the region's tumultuous history, from 1969 to the present, and explore hidden areas and a private museum not accessible to the public. Experience Belfast's rich narrative like never before.

tours.name: Official World Famous Belfast Conflict Taxi Tour
tours.description: Experience Belfast's captivating history on a private 90-minute tour led by a local guide. Explore iconic sites like Queen’s University and the Titanic Quarter, while delving into the impactful stories of The Troubles. Enjoy personalized attention and convenience with hotel pick-up and drop-off, making this an unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Belfast Official Private City Sightseeing Political Murals Guided Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour private tour of Belfast, exploring its rich history through the eyes of a local guide. Discover the city's significant landmarks, including the iconic murals and the Titanic Quarter, while enjoying personalized attention and convenient transport. Experience Belfast's complex past like never before.

tours.name: Belfast Official Private City Sightseeing Political Murals Guided Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5-hour journey through Belfast's vibrant streets, guided by a local expert. Explore the powerful murals that tell the story of The Troubles, witness the iconic Peace Wall, and gain insight into the city's complex history. Enjoy a private, customizable tour with convenient hotel transport.

tours.name: Private Tour Northern Ireland Top Sights Giants Causeway Belfast Adventure
tours.description: Experience the best of Northern Ireland with a unique two-day private tour tailored just for you. Explore major attractions in Belfast at your own pace, guided by an expert who shares rich history and culture. Enjoy hassle-free transport, personalized itineraries, and the luxury of a private experience.

tours.name: Private Luxury Tour From Belfast Giants Causeway Game of Thrones Ropebridge
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking 8-hour private tour of Northern Ireland's stunning attractions, including the iconic Giant’s Causeway and the exhilarating Carrick-A-Rede Rope Bridge. Enjoy luxury transportation and a customizable itinerary, allowing you to explore highlights like Dunluce Castle and the Dark Hedges, all while receiving expert guidance.

tours.name: Private Tour Ards Peninsula Saint Patrick Trail with Strangford Lough and Ferry
tours.description: Embark on a unique 7-hour private tour exploring lesser-known historic sites related to Saint Patrick. Customize your itinerary, enjoy seamless transport from Belfast, and visit iconic landmarks like Saint Patrick’s grave and ‘Winterfell’ from Game of Thrones. Experience Ireland’s rich heritage in a way that’s truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Private Belfast Exploration Sightseeing and Political Murals Tour
tours.description: Experience Belfast like never before on a private tour that takes you to iconic attractions such as the Peace Wall and St Peter’s Cathedral. With a flexible itinerary and a knowledgeable guide, delve into the city's rich history while enjoying comfortable transport and personalized attention throughout your journey.

tours.name: Social Group Paddles
tours.description: Join our relaxed Thursday evening paddles at Saul Junction to unwind, enjoy scenic waterways, and connect with fellow paddlers. Bring your gear for free or rent at special rates—no instruction, just good company and beautiful views.

tours.name: Private Soho-Ho Treasure Hunt
tours.description: Unleash your inner explorer with a lively 1.5-hour treasure hunt through Soho-Ho. Solve clues, follow maps, and uncover hidden gems with mobile packs—perfect for groups of all ages seeking adventure.

tours.name: Private Pokemon Go London Bridge Adventure
tours.description: Join a seasoned Pokemon Trainer on a 90-minute adventure from London Bridge to the Tower of London, hunting water, psychic, rock, and grass Pokemon while exploring iconic landmarks and battling at gyms.

tours.name: Swan Uppers Picnic Cruise
tours.description: Join a unique Thames tradition with a delightful 3-hour cruise dedicated to Swan Upping. Enjoy a shared picnic featuring delicious local fare while listening to live commentary from your skipper. Experience the charm of the river and its customs, all from the comfort of The Georgian vessel.

tours.name: Ploughmans Lunch Cruise
tours.description: Experience a delightful 3-hour Ploughmans Lunch Cruise along the scenic Thames. Enjoy stunning views from the open-air deck or cozy lower level while savoring a delicious lunch featuring mature cheddar, cured ham, and fresh salad. With live commentary and convenient pickup from Windsor or Maidenhead, this trip promises relaxation and enjoyment.

tours.name: Cheese and Wine Tour
tours.description: Embark on a delightful cheese and wine tour along the Thames, perfect for unwinding before or after exploring Windsor. Enjoy a selection of exquisite British cheeses paired with a premier glass of wine, all while soaking in stunning riverside views. A unique culinary experience awaits aboard our iconic vessel!

tours.name: Fish and Chips Lunch Tour
tours.description: Experience a delightful three-hour fish and chips lunch cruise on the River Thames, where you can savor freshly cooked meals while soaking in stunning views. Enjoy insightful commentary from the skipper about the river's rich history, making this a unique and memorable way to embrace a classic British tradition.

tours.name: Windsor Champagne Lunch Cruise
tours.description: Embark on an elite luxury cruise along the serene River Thames, featuring a delightful three-course meal and a glass of champagne. Indulge in exquisite dishes like slow-cooked pork belly and a decadent dessert while enjoying the stunning views. This three-hour experience promises a perfect blend of relaxation and culinary delight.

tours.name: Windsor Afternoon Tea Cruise
tours.description: Experience the charm of Windsor on a delightful afternoon tea cruise. Enjoy breathtaking views of Windsor Castle while savoring a selection of finger sandwiches, warm scones, and exquisite cakes. With live commentary and classical music, this unique three-hour journey combines local culture with a relaxing atmosphere for an unforgettable afternoon.

tours.name: Murder Mystery Cruise
tours.description: Join Sherlock Holmes for an unforgettable three-hour murder mystery cruise! Engage in an interactive experience filled with intriguing clues, captivating performances, and delicious dining. Dress up as a suspect, search for evidence, and enjoy a delightful meal as you unravel the mystery aboard the scenic waters of Windsor and Maidenhead.

tours.name: The Thames At War Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating Thames at War cruise, immersing yourself in the atmosphere of World War II aboard a victory-themed vessel. Enjoy live commentary, discover historical facts, and spot the Windsor Hurricane replica. Savor a delicious wartime-inspired menu while cruising through this iconic waterway. A unique journey through history awaits!

tours.name: Windsor Race Night
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable evening at Windsor Race Course with a scenic Thames cruise. Enjoy a half bottle of champagne and a delightful afternoon tea while you prepare for the races. After the excitement, relax with a two-course buffet and drinks on the return journey, making for a truly memorable night.

tours.name: Typically British Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a delightful three-hour river cruise, savoring a traditional British meal of Chicken & Leek Pie and Apple & Berry Crumble. Enjoy live commentary filled with local insights and sing along to classical tunes, making this a memorable afternoon with friends on the scenic Thames.

tours.name: The Homes Of The Rich and Famous Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour cruise along the River Thames, exploring the luxurious homes of celebrities and aristocrats. Discover intriguing stories of the rich and famous, from Diana Dors to the Astor family, while enjoying a delicious lunch. Experience the glamour and secrets of the elite in a unique setting.

tours.name: Christmas Lunch Cruise
tours.description: Experience the magic of the season on a festive Christmas lunch cruise along the River Thames. Enjoy a warm welcome with mulled wine, a delicious holiday meal, and lively caroling, all while soaking in captivating stories from your Skipper. This three-hour journey promises to create unforgettable holiday memories.

tours.name: Breakfast Meeting Package
tours.description: Elevate your corporate events with a unique breakfast experience aboard a boat! Enjoy two hours of networking with unlimited tea, coffee, and morning pastries, all while utilizing AV equipment. Depart from convenient locations in Windsor or Maidenhead for a memorable escape from the office atmosphere.

tours.name: Full Day Package
tours.description: Elevate your corporate events with a unique full-day package aboard a scenic vessel. Enjoy unlimited tea and coffee, morning pastries, and a delicious two-course buffet while utilizing AV equipment. Depart from Windsor or Maidenhead and experience a refreshing alternative to the office setting, ensuring an unforgettable day for your team.

tours.name: Evening Hire Package
tours.description: Elevate your corporate events with a unique evening boat hire experience! Enjoy a 3-hour cruise featuring a welcome drink, a delicious 2-course buffet, and unlimited beverages. Dance to a resident DJ on the water, creating unforgettable memories away from the office. Make your next event truly special with us!

tours.name: Lunch Cruises
tours.description: Embark on a delightful 2-hour Thames Lunch Cruise, departing from Riverside Gardens Maidenhead. Enjoy a changing three-course menu tailored to your preferences, ensuring a unique dining experience. Relax and take in the scenic views while savoring exquisite dishes, making this cruise a memorable culinary adventure on the water.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea Cruises
tours.description: Embark on a delightful Afternoon Tea Cruise along the Thames, where you can savor a selection of sweet or savory treats while enjoying stunning riverside views. Departing from Riverside Gardens, this two-hour experience combines exquisite flavors with the charm of the river, making it a truly memorable outing.

tours.name: Dinner Cruises
tours.description: Embark on a delightful 2-hour Thames Dinner Cruise, featuring exquisite canapés and a three-course meal crafted by talented chefs. Departing from Riverside Gardens Maidenhead, this unique dining experience offers a changing menu each month, ensuring a fresh and memorable culinary journey on the water.

tours.name: Pudding Cruises
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful 2-hour Pudding Cruise along the Thames, departing from Riverside Gardens Maidenhead. Savor a changing selection of five exquisite desserts served with a variety of accompaniments. This unique experience combines stunning riverside views with a sweet culinary adventure, perfect for dessert lovers and special occasions.

tours.name: Stonehenge e Castello di Windsor in taxi
tours.description: Explore iconic UK landmarks in 9 hours with a private taxi to Stonehenge and Windsor Castle. Enjoy skip-the-line tickets and self-guided audio tours for a personalized, hassle-free adventure.

tours.name: Consultation Call
tours.description: Chat with our team to explore Rome’s top sights, from the Colosseum to the Vatican, plus hidden gems and dining spots. Free consultation, personalized plans, and a 20% discount await your perfect Roman adventure.

tours.name: Sea Kayak Surf Course (2 Day)
tours.description: Boost your kayaking skills by riding waves from tiny 6-inch swells to 6-foot surf at Bigbury Beach, where sheltered waters and perfect conditions make every paddle an adrenaline rush.

tours.name: Speed Jet on Thames
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a high-speed boat ride on the River Thames! Soak in iconic sights like Big Ben and Tower Bridge before racing through the fast zone near Canary Wharf. With expert skippers guiding you, enjoy twists, turns, and breathtaking views, making it an unforgettable adventure on London’s waters.

tours.name: York Pass
tours.description: Discover the best of York with the York Pass, offering free entry to top attractions like York Minster and the JORVIK Viking Centre. Enjoy a complimentary hop-on, hop-off bus tour, a helpful guidebook, and exclusive discounts on dining and entertainment. Experience seamless sightseeing for one or two unforgettable days!

tours.name: Christmas Mulled Wine Walk
tours.description: Discover the enchanting charm of Winchester, England's most magical Christmas town, on a 90-minute guided tour. Enjoy a glass of Mulled Wine as you explore historic sites, including the Great Hall and stunning Christmas lights, while immersing yourself in captivating stories and the festive atmosphere of the renowned Christmas Market.

tours.name: Winchester Literary Pub Crawl
tours.description: Enjoy an evening of laughs, storytelling, and pub visits with an actor/comedian. Walk historic sites like Winchester Cathedral, hear legends of King Arthur and Jane Austen, and soak in the scenic river views—all in 3 lively hours.

tours.name: Hampton Court In Treno
tours.description: Step into Tudor history at Hampton Court: meet Henry VIII, explore stunning gardens, see priceless art, walk historic halls, and enjoy ghost stories—all in a lively, immersive experience.

tours.name: Londra Romana - Scopri Londinium!
tours.description: Explore Roman walls, underground temples, and ancient artifacts in London. Learn about Boudica’s rebellion, the Roman amphitheater, and daily life 2000 years ago in this fascinating journey through history.

tours.name: Un Avventura Nel Porto Di Londra
tours.description: Ride the Emirates Air Line cable car at 90 meters for stunning views of London’s skyline and Docklands. Explore historic docks, vibrant markets, and enjoy water sports or a pint at a centuries-old riverside pub.

tours.name: Tour Serale Dei Pub Storici
tours.description: Step into centuries-old pubs, sip authentic English ales, and uncover beer secrets. Immerse yourself in lively stories of famous characters and London's vibrant night scene on this captivating evening tour.

tours.name: Improver Session
tours.description: Enhance your surfing skills with a focused two-hour improver session! Under expert guidance, refine your paddling, pop-up, and turning techniques while eliminating bad habits. Gain essential knowledge for self-care and equipment maintenance in the surf, ensuring a memorable experience on the waves. Bring refreshments and enjoy the ride!

tours.name: Wetsuit Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the waves at Whitesands Beach with top-of-the-line surf and watersports equipment available for rent. Whether for a day or longer, unleash your surfing skills and enjoy an unforgettable adventure on the water. Just bring your refreshments and get ready for an exciting day!

tours.name: Da Tate a Tate: Viaggio Artistico lungo il Tamigi
tours.description: Explore world-class art at Tate museums, from Henry Moore’s sculptures to Turner’s vibrant paintings. Dive into social themes, innovative mediums, and diverse voices shaping contemporary and historical art narratives.

tours.name: Cambridge in treno
tours.description: Travel from King’s Cross to Cambridge, explore stunning Gothic architecture, glide along the Cam River, visit world-famous colleges, enjoy botanical gardens or a museum, and hear stories of legendary scholars in this vibrant university city.

tours.name: Cattedrale di Canterbury e Bianche Scogliere di Dover in taxi
tours.description: Explore Kent’s lush orchards, historic Canterbury Cathedral, and stunning white cliffs of Dover. Encounter wildlife, enjoy seaside views, or relax with tea and cake—adventure or tranquility awaits.

tours.name: Oxford in treno
tours.description: Travel from London to Oxford by train, exploring historic colleges, medieval halls, and iconic sites like the Bodleian Library and Hogwarts-inspired hall. Enjoy panoramic views and a vibrant market filled with local crafts and flavors.

tours.name: Brighton in treno (IT)
tours.description: Travel from London to Brighton through scenic countryside, then explore its vibrant streets, historic Royal Pavilion, colorful graffiti, quirky shops, lively pier, and maybe spot famous artists in this creative seaside city.

tours.name: Sulla scia del Maghetto
tours.description: Join a magical tour through London’s iconic Harry Potter sites: Diagon Alley, Leadenhall Market, the Millennium Bridge, and King’s Cross. Capture memories, hear behind-the-scenes stories, and step into the wizarding world.

tours.name: Private Skippered Charter
tours.description: Embark on a private skippered charter for a unique adventure with friends, family, or colleagues. Choose from various durations and explore stunning locations like Seaford Beach or Brighton Marina. Enjoy personalized experiences, safety briefings, and the freedom to create unforgettable memories on the water. Your extraordinary journey awaits!

tours.name: Add Food
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful culinary experience with California Kitchen's preordered meals for your trip or gathering. Choose from packed lunches, classic or vegetarian Graze Boxes, and a sumptuous Afternoon Tea. Each option offers a variety of flavors, perfect for sharing or savoring solo, ensuring a memorable outing filled with deliciousness.

tours.name: Birmingham Gallows & Ghosts: Halloween Tour
tours.description: Join us for the thrilling Halloween Gallows and Ghosts Tour in Birmingham, where you'll explore the city's chilling history. Walk among the shadows of infamous murderers and ghosts, uncovering tales of public hangings and notorious gangs. This 1.5-hour after-dark adventure promises an unforgettable glimpse into Birmingham's dark past.

tours.name: Leeds: The Dark Side Tour
tours.description: Join us for a spine-chilling Halloween walking tour in Leeds, where you'll uncover the city's dark secrets, from alien abductions to haunted pubs. Explore eerie tales of restless spirits and gruesome deaths as you navigate the shadows of history. This unforgettable experience promises thrills and chills around every corner.

tours.name: Kayak Tours: Iford Bridge Tour to Mudeford Quay:
tours.description: Embark on a scenic paddle along the Stour River, choosing between a tranquil one-way trip to Iford or a full round trip. Experience picturesque views, wildlife sightings, and a relaxing lunch at the Iford Sizzler pub. This memorable adventure combines nature, exploration, and leisure in a stunning setting.

tours.name: Stand Up Paddle-Boarding Tours : Iford Bridge/Mudeford Quay
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of a stand-up paddleboarding tour along the scenic river Stour. Glide past Christchurch Priory and enjoy the serene beauty of nature, with options for a round trip or a one-way journey. Perfect for both beginners and seasoned paddlers, this 2.5-hour adventure promises unforgettable moments on the water.

tours.name: Nottingham: The Dark Side Tour
tours.description: Experience the chilling history of Nottingham on a special Halloween walking tour. Led by guide Sam, delve into tales of riots, executions, and hauntings over 1.5 hours. Explore the city’s dark past, from cursed pubs to ghostly legends, and uncover the sinister secrets that linger in its shadows.

tours.name: Le Terme Romane di Bath e la Cattedrale di Salisbury
tours.description: Travel through scenic Berkshire and Wiltshire, explore Bath’s Georgian architecture, Roman Baths, and Pulteney Bridge, then visit Salisbury’s stunning Gothic cathedral, historic clock, and Magna Carta—rich history in every step.

tours.name: Windsor in Treno (IT)
tours.description: Explore Windsor Castle’s stunning art, royal chambers, and historic chapel. Walk along the walls for panoramic views, visit Queen Mary’s intricate dollhouse, and follow in royal footsteps—then enjoy Windsor’s charming town and river cruise options.

tours.name: Cotswolds e opzioni speciali in taxi
tours.description: Explore the grand halls of Highclere Castle, stroll through historic gardens like the Rose Arbor and Herb Garden, and wander across 1,000 acres of stunning parkland designed by legendary landscaper Capability Brown.

tours.name: Blenheim Palace e Christ Church College a Oxford
tours.description: Explore Oxfordshire’s stunning landscapes, visit Blenheim Palace’s historic art and gardens, walk through film-famous locations, and uncover the rich history of Christ Church College and Oxford’s ancient cathedral.
