tours.name: Level 2 Sea Kayak Course - 5 Day
tours.description: Join a 5-day sea kayak course to explore stunning coastlines, spot seals and dolphins, master paddling and rescue skills, navigate tides, and relax on remote beaches—all with expert guidance in a fun, relaxed setting.

tours.name: Level 3 Sea Kayak Course - 5 Day
tours.description: Join a 5-day sea kayaking adventure along stunning UK coastlines, spotting seals and dolphins, exploring caves, and mastering skills like rescue, navigation, and paddling—all in a fun, relaxed setting.

tours.name: Community Cinema
tours.description: Join a welcoming group for an inclusive experience that invites everyone to participate and enjoy. No matter your background, this activity offers fun and connection for all.

tours.name: SUP Improver
tours.description: Elevate your paddle boarding skills in this immersive SUP improver session! Tailored to your experience, you'll receive personalized coaching on equipment selection, planning, and safety techniques. Gain confidence and master paddling in diverse conditions, while enjoying expert advice on future adventures. Get ready for an unforgettable water experience!

tours.name: Full Moon and Moonlight paddles
tours.description: Glide across the water at sunset, then paddle under the glowing full moon on a 1.5-hour adventure. Perfect for experienced paddlers craving a magical evening of nature’s spectacle.

tours.name: Lopwell SUP and Yoga Retreat
tours.description: Join the 7th annual SUP and yoga retreat at the stunning Lopwell Dam, where you’ll reconnect with nature through a full day of personalized SUP coaching, invigorating yoga sessions, and serene meditation. Enjoy a picturesque journey down the river Tavy, delicious meals, and evening relaxation by the firepit.

tours.name: 1 Day Board Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable stand-up paddleboarding adventure along Devon's stunning beaches and scenic rivers. With all equipment provided, including boards and paddles, you can explore picturesque spots like Bantham and Wembury. Enjoy expert advice on the best locations for a day filled with excitement and natural beauty.

tours.name: 2 Day Board Hire
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-day paddleboarding adventure along Devon's stunning beaches and rivers. Enjoy full access to top-notch equipment and expert guidance as you explore picturesque locations like Bantham and Wembury. With wetsuits and safety gear available, this experience promises unforgettable moments on the water.

tours.name: 3 Day Board Hire
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 3-day stand-up paddleboarding adventure along Devon's stunning beaches and scenic rivers. With all equipment provided, including wetsuits and buoyancy aids, you'll explore breathtaking locations like Bantham and Wembury. Enjoy expert advice on the best spots for an unforgettable experience on the water.

tours.name: Henley Royal Regatta on Edwardian-style 'Hebe'
tours.description: Experience the vibrant Regatta like never before aboard Hebe, our charming Edwardian-style launch. Gather up to six friends for a private party as our skipper guides you through this iconic British summer event. Savor your own food and drinks while enjoying the stunning sights along the river.

tours.name: Baedeker Raids - The Bombing of Bath Tour
tours.description: Discover the hidden history of Bath during World War II on this unique walking tour. Explore significant sites affected by the April 1942 attack, uncovering untold stories and viewing historical photos. This immersive experience reveals how three days of devastation transformed the city, making it a memorable journey through time.

tours.name: The Cotswold Full Day Tour - by Car
tours.description: Escape the hustle and bustle for a captivating 9-hour journey through the enchanting Cotswolds. Discover timeless villages, stunning architecture, and picturesque landscapes, all while exploring the rich history of Old England. Experience the charm of iconic locations like Bourton-on-the-Water and Castle Combe, making memories that will last a lifetime.

tours.name: The Stonehenge Tour Including Avebury
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 6-hour journey from Bath to Stonehenge and Avebury, exploring ancient wonders and picturesque landscapes. Enjoy guided commentary as you stroll among the stones, visit exhibitions, and wander through charming villages. This unique experience combines history, beauty, and the thrill of discovery in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: Bath with Lacock and Castle Combe by Car
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 6-hour car tour of Bath, blending comfort with exploration. Discover hidden gems like Lacock, a village steeped in film history, and the picturesque Castle Combe, known for its timeless charm. Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views and delightful photo opportunities, making this a memorable day of discovery.

tours.name: Belfast Traditional Music Trail
tours.description: Explore Belfast’s vibrant Cathedral Quarter on a 2.5-hour journey through cobbled streets, private bars, and lively performances of Irish tunes, stories, and traditions—dancing shoes encouraged for a fun-filled night.

tours.name: Autumn Toddlers 2025
tours.description: Join weekly farm adventures for kids 12 months+ to explore outdoors, get messy, and meet farm animals in a safe, seasonal environment. Dress for weather, and enjoy crafts and farm tasks with a responsible adult.

tours.name: Eye Explorers (1st session of each month: Little Explorers Messy Play special!)
tours.description: Little explorers can enjoy two hours of toys, soft play, and fun in a relaxed setting while parents relax with coffee and cake. Monthly messy play sessions add sensory fun—perfect for kids up to 5 years old.

tours.name: Home Education Weekly Group
tours.description: Join our engaging 2-hour session designed exclusively for Home Education families! Explore a variety of activities tailored for children aged 3 and up, while parents enjoy the experience alongside. With special themes and an open café, this is a unique opportunity for fun and learning in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Stargazing Smartphone Experience at High Force
tours.description: Gaze up at the night sky above High Force Waterfall, where stars shimmer and illuminate the darkness. Bring your smartphone to capture the magic in this 2-hour stargazing adventure under the open sky.

tours.name: Private
tours.description: Experience a unique celebration aboard The Georgian with a 3-hour boat charter, complete with a skipper, crew, and a licensed bar. Enjoy a welcome drink and a buffet menu tailored to your group size. Secure your special occasion with a non-refundable deposit and create unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Party Package 1
tours.description: Escape reality and dive into 60 minutes of immersive VR gaming with friends, endless game choices, and free drinks—perfect for a fun-filled birthday or celebration.

tours.name: Party Package 2 [Private Hire]
tours.description: Celebrate in a whole new way with a 90-minute VR gaming party, featuring immersive virtual worlds, multiplayer consoles, and laser tag. Perfect for up to 12 guests, with nonstop fun and exclusive use of the venue.

tours.name: Party Package 3 [Private Hire]
tours.description: Celebrate in a virtual world with 2.5 hours of epic gaming, including VR, Xbox, and Nintendo. Perfect for 15-20 guests, with nonstop fun, gaming, and time for cake—making birthdays unforgettable.

tours.name: Private Stargazing
tours.description: Gaze at dazzling constellations, learn to navigate stars with binoculars, and explore the night sky under expert guidance at Brecon Beacons. Clear views or indoor talks—your celestial adventure awaits.

tours.name: Twilight Paddle
tours.description: Escape the office and unwind on a 2-hour twilight kayak trip at sunset. Paddle through peaceful riverways, reconnect with nature and friends, and enjoy a relaxing evening on the water before night falls.

tours.name: Minehead Youth Club
tours.description: Join the Minehead Youth Club for an exhilarating 2-hour session packed with diverse activities like arts and crafts, archery, climbing, and dodgeball. Led by qualified Youth Workers, this unique experience fosters fun and friendship for children in school years 5 and above. Advance booking is essential for this exciting term-time adventure!

tours.name: Bristol InstaTours
tours.description: Explore Bristol's most Instagrammable locations on this 1.5-hour tour, where you'll discover stunning backdrops while learning expert photography tips. Capture the essence of the city and elevate your social media game with unique insights from your guide, making this experience both memorable and visually captivating.

tours.name: Off-site paddles
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable paddleboarding adventure along breathtaking coastlines and serene river estuaries. With options for all skill levels, enjoy stunning scenery, wildlife encounters, and a cozy hot drink stop. Led by an experienced instructor, this unique experience promises both challenge and camaraderie in a picturesque setting.

tours.name: ITC Level 3 Award in Outdoor First Aid
tours.description: Join this immersive two-day Outdoor First Aid course, designed to equip you with essential skills for managing emergencies confidently in outdoor settings. With a focus on practical learning and real-life scenarios, you'll gain a recognized Level 3 Award, ensuring you're prepared for any situation where professional help is delayed.

tours.name: Guided Tour RWY to Cawsand
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking South West Coast Path from a unique water perspective with SWSUP. Paddle through secret coves, mystical woodlands, and stunning architecture, guided by an expert instructor. Enjoy a refreshing break in the charming fishing villages of Kingsand & Cawsand, all while surrounded by spectacular scenery and wildlife.

tours.name: Free Tour Camden Town
tours.description: Explore Camden Town’s vibrant markets, legendary music venues, and trendy neighborhoods where stars like Amy Winehouse and the Rolling Stones once played. Walk along Regent’s Canal and see London’s iconic views.

tours.name: Paca Picnic & Ice Cream
tours.description: Relax in the Cheviot Hills with a private picnic, tasty ice cream, and friendly alpacas. Feed the animals, enjoy scenic views, and stay cozy rain or shine in this peaceful Scottish Borders escape.

tours.name: Mothers Day Cruise
tours.description: Treat your mother to an unforgettable Mother’s Day cruise on the scenic River Thames aboard The Georgian. Indulge in a delightful Lunch or Afternoon Tea while creating cherished memories together. This luxurious 2-hour experience promises to make her feel truly special and loved.

tours.name: Escape The Lost Pyramid
tours.description: Step into the thrilling world of Assassin’s Creed Origins with Escape The Lost Pyramid, a unique virtual reality escape game. Team up with 2 to 4 players to uncover the mystery of a vanished 1928 expedition. Experience heart-pounding adventures in a safe environment as you search for the Lost Pyramid of Nebka.

tours.name: Beyond Medusa's Gate
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 60-minute escape game, "Beyond Medusa’s Gate," set in Ancient Greece, 445 B.C. Team up with 2 to 4 players to uncover hidden treasures and face mythical challenges in a safe, immersive environment. Experience the next generation of social virtual reality and become the hero of your own adventure.

tours.name: Prince of Persia : Dagger of Time
tours.description: Step into the enchanting world of Prince of Persia with The Dagger of Time, a thrilling Virtual Reality Escape Game. Collaborate with friends to harness the power of time control, solving intricate puzzles in the Fortress of Time. Experience the excitement of teamwork as you race against an evil Magi in this unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Alice
tours.description: Immerse yourself in a magical adventure inspired by Alice in Wonderland! Unravel the Queen of Hearts' time spell, navigate twisted mazes, and assist the Hatter at a chaotic tea party. With guidance from the Cheshire Cat and the wise Caterpillar, embark on a thrilling quest to save Wonderland from darkness.

tours.name: Chernobyl
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling journey to Chernobyl, where you’ll explore the haunting past of a catastrophic event. In this immersive experience, uncover hidden truths and attempt to alter fate as you piece together the mystery of the night of the accident. Can you change history in just 60 minutes?

tours.name: Survival
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling survival adventure after your vacation turns into a plane crash on a deserted Pacific island. With a malfunctioning transmitter and no supplies, you must use your wits to navigate the wild, find resources, and secure shelter as you await rescue. Can you survive the challenge?

tours.name: Jungle Quest
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure as you stumble upon a portal to a mysterious world filled with enchanting flying islands and captivating animals. Team up with 2 to 6 players to solve intriguing puzzles within 60 minutes, testing your wits and creativity to find your way back home.

tours.name: Signal Lost
tours.description: Join an emergency team tasked with saving the secret research station "Asgard" from imminent disaster! Integrate your consciousness into advanced engineer robots and uncover the mysteries within the lifeless station. With only an hour to restore systems and prevent catastrophe, every second counts in this thrilling, immersive experience.

tours.name: Sanctum
tours.description: Dive into the chilling world of H.P. Lovecraft as you embark on a thrilling 60-minute investigation to rescue your friend Anna from a sinister fate. Explore an abandoned monastery, confront dark forces, and unravel ancient puzzles to uncover horrifying secrets. Will you survive the mysteries that lurk within?

tours.name: House of Fear
tours.description: Step into an eerie, abandoned cabin where shadows dance and secrets lurk. With only a flickering candle to guide you, unravel the mystery of this dilapidated space. Can you escape the trap before it’s too late? Gather your courage and prepare for a thrilling 60-minute adventure into the unknown.

tours.name: The Prison
tours.description: Join your police force team in a thrilling escape room challenge where you must outsmart your captors and clear your name. With only 60 minutes to strategize and execute your plan, gather your courage and cunning to break free from unjust imprisonment and continue the fight for justice.

tours.name: Christmas
tours.description: Join the thrilling quest to save Christmas! In just 60 minutes, you and your team must navigate the North Pole, revive the magic elves, and light the grand Christmas tree. With Santa's presents at stake, this exciting adventure promises fun and teamwork for players aged 7 and up.

tours.name: Mission Sigma
tours.description: Step into a thrilling mission where you must navigate a high-rise filled with intricate traps to defuse a ticking nuclear warhead. With only 60 minutes on the clock, teamwork and quick thinking are essential. Can you outsmart the obstacles and prevent disaster? The fate of the city rests in your hands!

tours.name: Muslim Stories of Westfield and White City
tours.description: Join us on May 8th for captivating 30-minute tours exploring the rich Muslim heritage of London’s Westfield Shepherd's Bush. Led by Britain's first qualified Muslim tour guide, AbdulMaalik Tailor, uncover hidden stories, murals, and historical connections that shaped the community. Experience a unique journey through time and culture!

tours.name: Private Tour - Belfast Cavehill Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour hike through the historic Belfast Hills, featuring stunning views of Belfast Lough and Scotland. Explore ancient sites, including Bronze Age settlements and Belfast Castle, while immersing yourself in the rich culture and history of the region. A perfect blend of adventure and heritage awaits!

tours.name: The Mersey Express to Liverpool
tours.description: Travel in style on a vintage steam train to Liverpool, enjoy four and a half hours to explore its vibrant waterfront, shops, and theaters—an unforgettable day of culture, scenery, and classic rail charm.

tours.name: The Welsh Marches Express to Hereford
tours.description: Travel through scenic English and Welsh countryside on a vintage steam train, stopping in Hereford to explore the cathedral and Mappa Mundi. Enjoy full meals, luxurious seating, and a memorable day out.

tours.name: Quirky Bloomsbury
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute walking tour through Bloomsbury, where you'll uncover its hidden treasures. Explore abandoned railways, London's narrowest alley, and vibrant street art while wandering serene streets filled with quirky sculptures and intriguing plaques. Experience the area's unique charm beyond the typical literary landmarks.

tours.name: The Drakes Island Paddle 2024
tours.description: Join the Drake's Island Paddle on September 22nd for a thrilling charity SUP race that combines fun and philanthropy! Navigate a scenic 3km course around Drake's Island, enjoy full safety support, and connect with fellow paddlers. Experience the excitement of racing while raising funds for The Chestnut Appeal!

tours.name: Rent a Headset
tours.description: Experience the thrill of virtual reality like never before! With access to over 30 games, you can switch between shooters, puzzles, and sports at any time. Perfect for solo play or multiplayer fun, our VR Arcade offers an unforgettable adventure guided by expert game masters. Join the excitement today!

tours.name: Huxley VR
tours.description: Step into a post-apocalyptic world in Huxley VRn3007 AD, where machines have taken over and nature is in ruins. As the last survivors, you have 44 minutes to solve puzzles and work together to reverse the apocalypse. Can you save humanity before time runs out? The challenge awaits!

tours.name: Save Notre-Dame on Fire
tours.description: Experience the gripping rescue of Notre-Dame de Paris in "Save Notre-Dame On Fire," a virtual reality escape game inspired by the heroic firefighters of the 2019 blaze. For 45 minutes, immerse yourself in a thrilling mission to save the cathedral and its sacred crown of thorns amidst the chaos.

tours.name: Vietnamese Street Food @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Vietnamese dishes in 2 hours: master pho, fiery pork balls, summer rolls, and vibrant salads. Cook, taste, and enjoy a flavorful street-food feast at our chef’s table. All ingredients and recipes included.

tours.name: A Flying Visit To Spain @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Join a lively 2-hour Spanish cooking class to master flavorful paella, fiery patatas bravas, and rich red-wine chorizo. Cook, eat, and share a vibrant feast with fellow food lovers in a fun, hands-on experience.

tours.name: Muslim Death Workshop and Tour
tours.description: Embark on a profound educational journey at the Gardens of Peace Cemetery, where you and your children can explore the significant stages of Islamic Ghusl, shrouding, and burial. This unique experience fosters understanding and respect for cultural practices, making it a memorable opportunity for personal growth and reflection.

tours.name: House of Fear - Cursed Souls
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 60-minute adventure in an eerie, abandoned cabin shrouded in darkness. As you navigate through cobwebs and dust, uncover the chilling secrets hidden within. With no escape in sight and a mysterious silhouette lurking, will you conquer your fears or become part of the cabin's haunting tale?

tours.name: Cyberpunk
tours.description: Step into a thrilling 22nd-century world where society has crumbled and technology reigns. As a team of skilled cyborgs, you’ll embark on a daring mission to infiltrate a corporate stronghold and steal valuable data. Prepare for a challenging adventure filled with strategy and excitement as you navigate this high-stakes heist!

tours.name: VIRTUAL: Christmas Lights Walk 2025 (online event)
tours.description: Stroll through London's enchanting Christmas streets from the comfort of your home. Marvel at dazzling lights, hidden alleys, and festive decorations while hearing captivating stories from Mayfair to St Pancras. With stunning visuals and surprising tales, this virtual tour brings London's holiday magic directly to you.

tours.name: Tubing With Elves
tours.description: Zoom down snowy slopes in big rubber rings, feeling the thrill of elf mischief. After 45 minutes of sliding fun, warm up with hot chocolate and maybe a gift—perfect for families with little adventurers.

tours.name: Historic Belfast Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour walking tour through Belfast, exploring its rich history and vibrant culture. Discover iconic landmarks like the Titanic's birthplace and the world's most bombed hotel, while immersing yourself in the lively Cathedral Quarter. Experience the city's transformation into a hub of creativity, nightlife, and stunning street art.

tours.name: The City of London Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through London's historic City, the heart of England's commerce and finance. Explore iconic landmarks like St. Paul’s Cathedral and the Tower of London, while uncovering tales of wealth, power, and intrigue that shaped the British Empire over 2000 years. Experience the vibrant pulse of this ever-evolving area.

tours.name: Royal London Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through London's West End, where royal history and political power intertwine. Explore iconic sites like Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, and Trafalgar Square, while uncovering tales of the Tudors and the evolution of the city. Experience the elegance and grandeur that define this unique area.

tours.name: Tour of Arkell’s Brewery
tours.description: Discover the fascinating history of one of the UK's last operational Victorian tower steam breweries on this unique 2-hour tour. Explore the brewery's museum, learn about the ingredients in each pint, and enjoy a guided walk around the brewery, concluding at The Grape and Grain Brewery Shop.

tours.name: Race gates out
tours.description: Experience the thrill of unsupervised skiing practice on a dedicated race course! Perfect for honing skills before the SSSA race in October and the Ayrshire Schools Snowsports Championship in March, these sessions offer a unique opportunity to familiarize yourself with the course and enhance your racing techniques.

tours.name: Ayrshire Schools Snowsports Championship
tours.description: Join the thrilling Ayrshire Schools Snowsports Championship, where primary and secondary school teams compete in exciting head-to-head relay races on side-by-side courses. With categories for all ages, this fun-filled event offers a chance to win the prestigious Pollock Cup and create unforgettable memories for racers and spectators alike!

tours.name: The Discover Real London Tour
tours.description: Experience the best of London on this signature half-day tour, showcasing iconic landmarks like Big Ben and Buckingham Palace from the comfort of a classic Black Taxi. With expert guides, enjoy fascinating insights and ample photo opportunities at must-see sights, ensuring an unforgettable exploration of the city's rich history and culture.

tours.name: London De-Tour
tours.description: Discover the hidden gems of London on a unique half-day tour in an iconic black taxi. Venture off the beaten path with expert guides, uncovering fascinating facts and secret spots known only to locals. Enjoy multiple stops for memorable photos while experiencing the city's rich history and culture in comfort.

tours.name: The City Sunrise Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique early morning adventure through London's serene streets, starting at the iconic Tower Bridge. Experience the city in its quietest moments, capturing stunning photos during the golden hours. Enjoy insightful presentations from expert guides while traveling in the comfort of a luxury black cab.

tours.name: Touchdown Tour
tours.description: Experience the best of London in just five hours with a luxurious Black Taxi tour. Discover iconic landmarks like Big Ben and Buckingham Palace, along with hidden gems, all while enjoying informative commentary from expert drivers. Capture unforgettable moments with scheduled photo stops, and conclude your adventure at your hotel.

tours.name: Heathrow Layover Tour
tours.description: Experience a memorable 6-hour layover tour of London in an iconic Black Taxi. Discover famous landmarks like Big Ben and Buckingham Palace, along with hidden gems, all while enjoying comfortable transport. With expert guides providing insights and ample photo opportunities, this tour ensures you make the most of your time in the city.

tours.name: Stonehenge & Bath Day Trip
tours.description: Embark on a captivating full-day private excursion from London to the historic wonders of Stonehenge and Bath. Enjoy a scenic drive in a luxurious black cab, explore the ancient mysteries of Stonehenge, and marvel at Bath's stunning regency architecture, all while gaining insights from expert guides.

tours.name: Discover Rural England On A Cotswolds Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 10-hour journey through the enchanting Cotswolds, where time stands still in charming villages. Experience breathtaking landscapes, historic architecture, and atmospheric pubs, all while guided by expert drivers in luxurious black cabs. Enjoy informative presentations and ample photo opportunities, making this adventure truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Discover Royal Windsor
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 6-hour journey to Windsor Castle, the world's oldest inhabited castle, steeped in 11th-century history. Experience regal splendor with insightful presentations and stunning photo opportunities, all while your knowledgeable driver guide ensures you don’t miss the castle's highlights on this unforgettable royal adventure.

tours.name: Stonehenge Rocks
tours.description: Experience the awe of Stonehenge, a UNESCO World Heritage site over 4000 years old, on this unique 6-hour tour. Travel in the comfort of a classic Black Cab, with expert guides sharing fascinating insights and ample photo opportunities. Discover the mystery of these ancient stones while enjoying a personalized journey.

tours.name: The Ultimate London Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour city adventure, exploring iconic landmarks and hidden gems in London. Enjoy a sit-down lunch, witness the changing of the guard, and have free time to discover on your own. With expert guides and luxurious black cab transport, this experience promises to inspire and delight.

tours.name: The Taxi Takeover Tour
tours.description: Create your own unforgettable London adventure with a tailor-made experience designed just for you and your group. Share your interests, and let us craft a personalized itinerary that maximizes your time exploring the city. Enjoy the freedom to bring your own refreshments or stop for snacks along the way.

tours.name: Panoramic Christmas Lights Tour
tours.description: Embark on a magical 2.5-hour Christmas adventure through London in our Panoramic cabs. Discover dazzling lights, iconic West End displays, and hidden festive gems. This unforgettable tour is filled with stunning illuminations and perfect photo opportunities, ensuring a truly enchanting holiday experience for everyone.

tours.name: Big Sights & Hidden Secrets Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique 6-hour adventure through London in an iconic Black Taxi, exploring both famous landmarks and hidden gems. Enjoy scheduled stops for unforgettable photo opportunities while your expert driver shares the city's rich history and culture. Experience London like never before, blending comfort with discovery.

tours.name: Castles and Cliff tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 6-hour tour exploring the rich history of Belfast and Carrickfergus castles, while driving the stunning Antrim Coast Road. Led by a local historian, discover tales of ancient kingdoms and influential emigrants, with the option to experience the breathtaking Gobbins Cliff Path for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Irish Linen Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 6-hour journey through the historic rise of the Irish Linen Industry. Starting in Belfast's Linen Quarter, explore iconic sites like City Hall and the Lagan Canal, before visiting the Linen Museum in Lisburn. Discover the rich heritage and craftsmanship that shaped a global industry.

tours.name: Ulster-Scots heritage Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 6-hour journey tracing the rich connections between the USA, Canada, and North East Ireland through the emigration of Ulster-Scots. Explore Belfast, the stunning Antrim Coast, and historic sites like the US Rangers Museum, while uncovering the fascinating stories of families who shaped history across the Atlantic.

tours.name: London : The Natural History Museum Guided Tour
tours.description: Explore the Natural History Museum’s breathtaking exhibits, from a 25-meter blue whale to dazzling minerals and ancient fossils. Let our guide reveal nature’s secrets and ignite your curiosity—book your tour now.

tours.name: Stocks and Sauces
tours.description: Master the art of sauces in a fun, hands-on day with expert guidance. Make stocks, reductions, and dressings, then enjoy lunch and take home your creations—no fuss, just delicious results.

tours.name: Introduction to Patisserie
tours.description: Create delicious French pastries like éclairs, tarts, and mousse in a relaxed full-day class with expert tutor James Piloni. Hands-on, social, and perfect for beginners—bake, taste, and take home your creations.

tours.name: Taste of France
tours.description: Master French cooking in a relaxed class with a trained chef, creating bistro starters to rich dishes. Enjoy hands-on fun, a delicious lunch, and take home recipes—perfect for food lovers eager to recreate Parisian flavors.

tours.name: Champagne Sunset Trip
tours.description: Sail into summer evenings with champagne as the sun dips below the sea, then drift back past glowing lights and scenic views. A relaxing, unforgettable voyage to cherish.

tours.name: EatsSide Food and Drink Tour
tours.description: Discover the vibrant food scene of East Belfast on a guided tour with Nicky, where you'll savor both new venues and beloved classics. Enjoy an intimate experience filled with fascinating food and drink history, complemented by the opportunity to indulge in local flavors while exploring the area's rich culinary heritage.

tours.name: VR Meal Deal
tours.description: Experience an hour of thrilling virtual reality gaming or an escape room adventure, followed by a delicious meal at a nearby inn. With a variety of menu options, including vegetarian dishes, this unique outing combines excitement and culinary delight, making it a memorable day for both adults and children.

tours.name: House of Fear - Call of Blood
tours.description: Step into the chilling world of the Delusion Psychiatric Clinic, where you and your team must navigate dark corridors to uncover the truth behind Emily's torment. As forensic investigators, you face terrifying encounters and unravel a haunting mystery in a race against time. Will you bring her serenity or succumb to the darkness?

tours.name: The Cathedrals Express to Salisbury
tours.description: Travel from Birmingham to Salisbury on a historic train, passing charming towns and passing through iconic tunnels. Explore Salisbury’s cathedral, market, or visit Stonehenge—an unforgettable journey through history.

tours.name: The Ffestiniog Express
tours.description: Ride behind historic steam and diesel trains through scenic valleys, then choose between an exhilarating zip wire or a scenic railway ride past lakes and mountains in a vintage carriage.

tours.name: Arvi Escape Games (Affiliate Only)
tours.description: Experience the future of gaming at Arvi Escape Games, where virtual reality transforms escape rooms into thrilling adventures. Choose from diverse themes like a mysterious space station or an ancient temple, and test your wits with friends in immersive environments. Each challenge promises a unique and unforgettable journey!

tours.name: London Bridge Ghost Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 1.5-hour journey through London's dark past at London Bridge. Explore notorious sites like the oldest operating theatre and haunted pubs, while uncovering tales of ghostly encounters, bear baiting, and more. This unique tour combines history with spine-chilling stories, making it an unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Wild Camp Dartmoor Adventure
tours.description: Experience the enchanting wilderness of Dartmoor on a two-day wild camping adventure. Hike through stunning landscapes, learn navigation skills, and explore local history and wildlife. Enjoy a refreshing morning dip in natural pools, all while embracing sustainable camping practices. Connect with nature and create unforgettable memories in this breathtaking setting.

tours.name: Wildlife Trips
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-hour wildlife boat trip around Whitby, where you'll encounter seals lounging on rocks and seabirds gliding above. Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Yorkshire coastline while discovering its diverse marine life. Don’t forget to dress warmly for this unforgettable adventure on the North Sea!

tours.name: Summer Mackerel Fishing Trip
tours.description: Set sail from Whitby for a 2-hour fishing adventure along the stunning North Yorkshire coast. Reel in your catch, enjoy fresh fish & chips, and learn from a seasoned skipper in the wild sea breeze.

tours.name: SUP Tour          COMING SOON
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Croyde Bay on a guided two-hour stand-up paddleboard tour. Perfect for all skill levels, this adventure offers a unique perspective of England's stunning coastline, making it an unforgettable way to connect with nature and explore the area's hidden gems.

tours.name: Coasteering Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Coasteering in Croyde Bay! This 2-hour adventure features exhilarating cliff jumps, exploration of sea caves, and refreshing swims along the stunning North Devon coastline. Guided by experts, you'll navigate dramatic cliffs and hidden coves, creating unforgettable memories in a breathtaking natural setting.

tours.name: Brecon Canal Basin to Pencelli
tours.description: Paddle through serene waters, marvel at Pen Y Fan, and cross an aqueduct on a 2.5-hour canoe trip. Reach charming Pencelli for a countryside lunch before being driven back—an unforgettable outdoor adventure.

tours.name: Brecon to Talybont-on-Usk
tours.description: Paddle through stunning scenery from Brecon, crossing aqueducts and passing Pen Y Fan. Enjoy a countryside pub lunch in Pencelli, then cruise to Talybont-on-Usk for a relaxing finish with drinks and easy collection.

tours.name: Suffolk and Essex Coast Weekender
tours.description: Experience a leisurely weekend sail from Ipswich along the stunning River Orwell, exploring the picturesque Suffolk and Essex coastline. Visit Mersea Island and catch a glimpse of the world's smallest country, Sealand. Engage with the crew to learn sailing skills and discover Suffolk's rich maritime heritage, all while enjoying a delightful dinner.

tours.name: SUP Coached taster session
tours.description: Try SUP on the River Severn with a friendly coach! In 90 minutes, learn to paddle, launch, and self-rescue, then explore the calm river. Perfect for beginners eager to build confidence and enjoy the water.

tours.name: 3 Hour Hire Board Hire
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 3-hour surfing adventure with a variety of boards tailored for all skill levels. From the stable Soft Board for easy wave catching to the advanced Mini Mal and Long Boards for enhanced maneuvers, there's something for everyone. Enjoy the thrill of bodyboarding or explore with a Stand-Up Paddleboard!

tours.name: 24 Hour Hire Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with a premium board from Lords of Downend! Choose from soft boards for easy wave catching, specialized boards for kids, or advanced options like Mini Mal and Long Boards for improved maneuvers. Enjoy bodyboarding or stand-up paddleboarding for a versatile water adventure, perfect for all skill levels!

tours.name: 48 Hour Hire Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with a premium board from Lords of Downend! Choose from soft boards for easy wave catching, specialized options for kids, or advanced models for improved maneuvers. Whether you’re bodyboarding or stand-up paddleboarding, this 48-hour adventure promises unforgettable fun on the water!

tours.name: 72 Hour Hire Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with a premium board from Lords of Downend! Choose from a variety of options, including soft boards for beginners, advanced mini mals, and versatile SUPs for exploration. Perfect for all skill levels, this 72-hour rental promises unforgettable moments on the water.

tours.name: Weekly Board Hire
tours.description: Experience a week of thrilling water adventures with Lords of Downend! Choose from a variety of quality boards, including soft boards for stability, specialized options for kids, and advanced models for improved maneuvers. Whether surfing, bodyboarding, or stand-up paddleboarding, there's something for everyone to enjoy in the waves!

tours.name: LEGATO live 90s dance party
tours.description: Dance the night away at a 90s-themed party with TikTok star Legato, bringing back iconic hits and vibrant energy for one unforgettable evening.

tours.name: Shred Club
tours.description: Join our monthly Shred Club for an exhilarating 1.5-hour surfing experience! With expert instructors guiding you, you'll progress from beginner to independent surfer while enjoying the ocean. Perfect for all ages, this fun and healthy activity at Down End is a great way to unplug and embrace the waves!

tours.name: Waterside Surf Club
tours.description: Join a lively Friday evening wakesurf session from May to September. Ride for 15 minutes, meet fellow surfers, and unwind on the water as you kick off the weekend in style. Limited spots for experienced riders only.

tours.name: WhatSUP
tours.description: Glide across peaceful creeks and secret beaches on a 2-hour paddleboard adventure. Spot seals, learn new skills, and enjoy stunning wildlife—perfect for all ages and experience levels.

tours.name: Rhoscolyn guided history and local interest walk
tours.description: Join Andy, a trained guide, for a captivating 3-hour walk along Anglesey’s stunning coastal path. Experience breathtaking views of Snowdonia, ancient wells, and sea arches while learning about local history and folklore. Encounter diverse wildlife, including Choughs and seals, on this memorable adventure through a picturesque landscape.

tours.name: Moelfre guided history and local interest walk
tours.description: Explore Moelfre’s rich history and geology on a 4-hour guided walk. Discover ancient limestone, shipwreck stories, and stunning coastal views, but be ready for a challenging 5-mile trek over uneven terrain.

tours.name: Ynys Llanddwyn guided history and local interest walk
tours.description: Join Andy, a trained guide accredited by GeoMon, for a captivating 3.5 to 4-hour walk on Anglesey. Discover the island's rich history, folklore, and geological wonders against the stunning backdrop of Snowdonia. Experience ancient landscapes and learn about the formation of the UK on this unforgettable journey through time.

tours.name: Kids Party Pottery Event
tours.description: Experience a unique and creative kids' party at our Ceramic Studio, where children can unleash their artistic talents by painting pottery. With themes like monsters and fairies, each child creates a personal keepsake, while groups can collaborate on special mementos. Enjoy a fun, messy atmosphere without the cleanup at home!

tours.name: Private Hire With Buffet Or Hotpot
tours.description: Embark on a unique 90-minute cruise aboard the Royal Sovereign, one of the largest barges on the Leeds to Liverpool canal. Savor a mouthwatering steak hotpot, complemented by fresh crusty bread and red cabbage, all while enjoying a relaxing atmosphere in a cozy, heated cabin with ample seating.

tours.name: Private Hire With 3 Tier Tea or Cream Tea
tours.description: Experience a delightful 2-hour private canal cruise aboard the spacious Royal Sovereign. Choose between a luxurious 3-tier afternoon tea or a comforting homemade soup, complemented by scones with fresh cream and jam. Enjoy the scenic views and cozy atmosphere, perfect for intimate gatherings of up to 20 guests.

tours.name: Hire Only
tours.description: Sail the Leeds-Liverpool canal aboard the spacious Royal Sovereign, a luxurious barge with heated cabins, a fully stocked bar, and room for 60 guests. Perfect for relaxing family or work gatherings on the water.

tours.name: Children Party
tours.description: Host an unforgettable children's party aboard the Royal Sovereign! Choose from five exciting packages, including a magical show, live DJ, or delicious pizza buffet. With private hire for up to 50 guests and a dedicated crew, this unique experience promises fun and entertainment for kids aged 3-8.

tours.name: Run it Gala 2026
tours.description: Hop aboard historic steam and diesel trains during Tanfield Railway’s end-of-season Run it Weekend. Watch coal wagons shunt, relive mining days with authentic passenger trains, and enjoy a full day of lively train rides, sights, sounds, and smells that bring industrial history vividly to life.

tours.name: How to Preserve
tours.description: Join a delightful 2.5-hour workshop to master the art of making jams and chutneys! Experience hands-on learning as you create a seasonal chutney and enjoy it with a cheeseboard. Take home recipes, a free pot of your creations, and savor locally produced food and drink in a charming farmshop setting.

tours.name: Mothers Day Causeway Coast Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Join Amanda Hanna at Ballykenver Farmshop for a delightful 2-hour afternoon tea experience! Learn to make lemon curd from scratch, savor locally sourced treats, and enjoy a warm exchange of stories and recipes. Each participant leaves with a free pot of lemon curd and other tasty goodies to cherish.

tours.name: The Alter Girls Cabaret Show VIP
tours.description: Get front-row seats to a dazzling Drag Spectacular filled with laughter, jaw-dropping moments, and stunning glam. Limited VIP spots ensure you won't miss a single dazzling detail—reserve now!

tours.name: Dream Hackers
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 60-minute adventure with the Dream Hackers, where you’ll explore a surreal world of dreams and memories. Navigate through bizarre landscapes, encounter extraordinary creatures, and uncover the ancient Citadel to find the powerful Book of Memories, all while evading lurking nightmares. Experience a journey beyond reality!

tours.name: Jumpers VR
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling VR adventure as a treasure hunter for Unravel Corp! Your mission: recover a 5,000-year-old artifact from a perilous mine in Mexico. With only 50 minutes to succeed, navigate mysteries and dangers using a teleportation machine. Gather your team and prepare for an unforgettable experience!

tours.name: Open Canoeing Windermere
tours.description: Experience a serene 6-hour canoe adventure on Lake Windermere, gliding past steam trains and exploring secluded spots for a delightful lunch. This inclusive journey caters to all abilities, ensuring everyone can enjoy the stunning views of the central fells while savoring tasty treats and warm drinks along the way.

tours.name: Rock Climbing (level Access Venue)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of rock climbing in a safe and inclusive environment. This 6-hour adventure caters to all abilities, including those with mobility disabilities. Enjoy expert guidance, comfortable equipment, and a delicious lunch featuring local produce, all while exploring the stunning outdoor crag just minutes from the climbing wall.

tours.name: Canoe Bushcraft
tours.description: Embark on a unique 6-hour Canoe Bushcraft adventure on Windermere, where you'll enhance your paddling skills while cooking a delicious three-course meal over a campfire. Learn to ignite flames from a spark and enjoy the tranquility of a remote peninsula, making this experience both exciting and memorable for all abilities.

tours.name: Canoe Sailing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of canoe sailing in a unique, accessible way! Designed for everyone, including those with mobility challenges, this 6-hour adventure includes expert instruction, safety gear, and a delicious local lunch. Glide across the water with confidence, guided by a safety boat and equipped with handy communication radios.

tours.name: Caving
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 6-hour adventure beneath the Yorkshire Dales, exploring ancient limestone passages and discovering fascinating fossils. Experience the wonder of an underground waterfall and tackle optional challenges in a safe environment. Enjoy a delicious lunch while immersing yourself in this unique subterranean journey.

tours.name: Kayak 9 Days Or More
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 9-day kayaking adventure across the UK! Choose from standard, fast, or fishing kayaks, all available for pick-up. Enhance your experience with life jackets, phone cases, and dry bags. Explore stunning waterways at your own pace and create lasting memories on the water.

tours.name: Paddleboard 1 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding on the serene River Blackwater from Maylandsea. Perfect for families, each board accommodates one adult or an adult with a child, ensuring safety and fun. Enjoy complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases, with support available if needed for a memorable adventure on the water.

tours.name: Paddleboard 2 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding on the scenic Maylandsea River Blackwater! Perfect for families, each board accommodates one adult or an adult with a child. Enjoy complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases, with support available if needed. Create unforgettable memories while exploring the beautiful waterways together!

tours.name: Paddleboard 3 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding on the scenic Maylandsea River Blackwater! This 3-hour adventure allows you to bond with family, as children aged 6-12 must paddle alongside an adult. Enjoy complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases, ensuring a safe and memorable outing on the water.

tours.name: Paddleboard 4 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding on the scenic Maylandsea River Blackwater! Perfect for families, each board accommodates one adult or an adult with a child, ensuring safety and fun. Enjoy complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases, with support available if needed. Create unforgettable memories on the water!

tours.name: Paddleboard 1-2 Days Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding across the UK with our flexible daily or weekly rentals. Enjoy the freedom to explore stunning waterways at your own pace, equipped with essential safety gear. Perfect for solo adventurers or a parent-child duo, this unique outdoor activity promises unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Paddleboard 3-4 Days Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 3 to 4-day paddleboarding adventure across the UK! Enjoy the freedom to explore stunning waterways at your own pace, with options for daily or weekly rentals. Safety gear is available, ensuring a memorable experience for you and a child, as you navigate the great outdoors together.

tours.name: Paddleboard 5-6 Days Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5 to 6-day paddleboarding adventure across the UK! Enjoy the freedom to explore stunning waterways at your own pace. With rentals available for pick-up or delivery, plus essential gear like life jackets and dry bags, this experience promises excitement and memorable moments on the water.

tours.name: Paddleboard 7-8 Days Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 7 to 8-day paddleboarding adventure across the UK! Enjoy the freedom to explore stunning waterways at your own pace, with the option for daily or weekly rentals. Safety gear is available, ensuring a memorable experience for you and a child on board.

tours.name: Paddleboard 9 Days Or More
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding across the UK with our 9-day rental option. Enjoy the freedom to explore at your own pace, with the convenience of pick-up or delivery. Safety gear is available, ensuring a memorable adventure on the water for you and a child or solo.

tours.name: Palmers Beer Festival
tours.description: Sip craft beers in historic cellars, enjoy live music, and support local charities. Bring your dog to the yard, but leave them outside the main bar area. Join us for a lively, community-focused beer festival.

tours.name: London at War
tours.description: Uncover the fascinating wartime history of London on our London At War tour. Journey through the capital's transformation into a military powerhouse, exploring the legacies of the British Empire, World War II, and the Cold War. Experience a captivating narrative that reveals the resilience and strength of this iconic city.

tours.name: Bicycle Rental
tours.description: Experience the stunning coastline like never before with our premium bike hire service! Choose from comfortable regular or tandem bikes and explore picturesque routes to St. Mary’s Lighthouse, Seaton Sluice, and Tynemouth. Enjoy scenic stops for picnics or dining at charming local eateries. Adventure awaits on two wheels!

tours.name: SUP Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding with our comprehensive rental service! Enjoy 2 to 4 hours on the water, equipped with a paddle, leash, and buoyancy aid. No prior experience is needed, making it perfect for everyone. Safety is our priority, ensuring a memorable adventure in suitable conditions.

tours.name: Surfboard Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing at stunning local beaches like Tynemouth Longsands and Seaton Sluice. Rent a surfboard and wetsuit for an unforgettable adventure, whether you're a beginner or seasoned pro. Enjoy the freedom to explore the waves with custom board options available, all while surrounded by breathtaking coastal scenery.

tours.name: Kayak Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of kayaking at Whitley Bay Beach with Northerly Swell! Choose from single or double Tahe kayaks, perfect for both calm waters and sea adventures. Enjoy a two-hour rental, complete with paddles and buoyancy aids, while soaking in the stunning coastal scenery. No experience needed—just bring your sense of adventure!

tours.name: Adventure Party
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable birthday party filled with high-energy activities for kids aged 7 and up! Led by an engaging instructor, participants will enjoy two hours of thrilling options like High Ropes, Climbing, and Archery, ensuring everyone has a blast. Add a party room for extra celebration time!

tours.name: Introductory Sup Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding in our 1.5-hour introductory lesson, designed for all skill levels. With expert guidance, you'll spend an hour on the water, mastering the basics while enjoying the beauty of nature. Just bring your swimsuit and a positive attitude—everything else is provided for you!

tours.name: Intermediate Sup Lesson
tours.description: Join our intermediate paddleboarding lesson for a thrilling 1.5-hour experience that enhances your skills and confidence on the water. Perfect your paddle stroke, learn effective turning techniques, and master essential skills like bracing and footwork. With expert guidance, you'll become a proficient paddler ready for any adventure!

tours.name: Sunrise - Wildlife & Cave Kayak Tour
tours.description: Watch the sunrise over Babbacombe as you paddle through calm waters, spotting seals and dolphins. Feel connected to ancient ways, enjoy peaceful meditation, and explore stunning geology and secluded coves.

tours.name: Sea Kayak Setting Sun Tour & Wild Food Experience
tours.description: Experience a unique evening paddling through the stunning English Riviera Unesco Global Geopark. Explore scientific sights, hunt for fossils on a secluded beach, and savor fresh line-caught Mackerel cooked on hot stones, paired with local breads and Prosecco. Enjoy the company of seals and cetaceans during this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Geology & Wildlife Private Boat Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique 60-minute boat tour of the English Riviera UNESCO Global Geopark, exploring stunning rocks, caves, and wildlife. Led by an experienced skipper, discover the geological wonders and marine biodiversity of Babbacombe Bay and beyond, while keeping an eye out for seals and seabirds in their natural habitat.

tours.name: Full-Day Intro To Sea Kayaking Course
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 6-hour sea kayaking adventure designed for beginners! This comprehensive course teaches essential skills like launching, maneuvering, and observing marine wildlife, all while building your confidence on the water. With expert guidance and all equipment provided, you'll be ready to paddle into new horizons from Oddicombe Beach.

tours.name: Afternoon G & Tea
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful afternoon featuring three double gin and tonics of your choice, complemented by an array of mini sandwiches, cakes, and treats. This unique experience promises a perfect blend of flavors and relaxation, making it an unforgettable gathering for friends or a special celebration.

tours.name: Kayak Safari Session
tours.description: Embark on a two-hour guided Kayak Safari through the stunning creeks and marshes of Wells-next-the-Sea. Experience the thrill of spotting diverse sea birds and seals in their natural habitat, making each trip a unique adventure. Prepare for an unforgettable exploration of nature's beauty!

tours.name: Animal Enrichment Building Session
tours.description: Unleash your creativity in a 30-minute session where you design enrichment items for animals! Guided by experienced staff, you'll craft unique treats and toys, enhancing their well-being. Whether you choose to donate your creation or take it home, this hands-on experience promises fun and learning for all animal lovers.

tours.name: The Gobbins Tour from Carrickfergus
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking Gobbins Cliff Path from a unique vantage point on our guided boat tours. Marvel at dramatic cliffs, capture stunning photographs, and spot incredible wildlife, all while enjoying an accessible adventure suitable for all ages. This unforgettable journey showcases the iconic beauty of the coastline like never before.

tours.name: Kids Adventure Tour
tours.description: Ages 5+ • 1.5 hours • Set Sail for Adventure: Join the Ultimate Kids' Treasure Hunt!

tours.name: Gin School (Distilling Experience)
tours.description: Create your own gin in just 3 hours! Pick rare botanicals, distill with expert guidance, enjoy tastings and lunch, then take home a personalized 70cl bottle sealed with your label.

tours.name: Inflatable Land: Race for £500
tours.description: Experience the thrill of London’s wildest inflatable race this August! Compete on a 100m Mega Obstacle Course for a chance to win daily cash prizes, including a £1,000 Grand Prize in the Champions Final. With adrenaline-pumping challenges, food, and music, it’s an unforgettable summer event for adults only!

tours.name: Operation Secret Agent!
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating outdoor adventure with "Operation Secret Agent," where your team must locate a missing operative amidst enemy spies. Solve puzzles, crack codes, and uncover clues as you traverse the town center. Perfect for families and friends, this thrilling 1940s mystery promises teamwork and excitement in every step!

tours.name: Bloom After School Club
tours.description: Join the Bloom After School Club every Wednesday for a unique 1.5-hour drop-in session designed for children with SEND needs and their siblings. Each week features engaging activities like arts, sports, or music, fostering community and understanding while providing a supportive space for parents to connect and relax.

tours.name: Custom Tours
tours.description: All ages! • Private Customized Tours of Ireland

tours.name: The Private / Bespoke - Food and Drink Walking Tour
tours.description: Discover the charm of a stunning medieval city on a bespoke walking tour designed for small groups. Experience the rich history, savor delicious local food and drink, and immerse yourself in the vibrant culture. Perfect for tourists and couples seeking a memorable adventure filled with exploration and delight.

tours.name: Eating Norwich Tour – The Big One
tours.description: Embark on a delightful guided tour through the city, led by a local foodie. Savor an array of local bites, enjoy sit-downs, and relax at a pub stop, all while soaking up fascinating insights about the area. This experience promises a perfect blend of taste and knowledge.

tours.name: Tasting Norwich Tour – The Mini One
tours.description: Experience a delightful mini food tour showcasing the best local bites and a refreshing gin. This unique journey offers a taste of the city's culinary highlights, ensuring you savor every moment while gaining insider knowledge about the vibrant food scene. Join us for a memorable gastronomic adventure!

tours.name: The Cocktails & Nibbles Evening One
tours.description: Embark on a delightful mini cocktail tasting adventure in Norwich, where you'll savor delicious nibbles while exploring the city's finest cocktail spots. Enjoy a blend of foodie facts and quirky trivia, ensuring a fun and flavorful experience that will leave you both satisfied and entertained.

tours.name: The Brighton Christmas Party Tour
tours.description: Embark on a delightful 3-hour festive food and drink tour in Brighton, perfect for groups celebrating the season. Discover the city's independent culinary gems while enjoying a meal and drinks, all tailored to your dietary needs. End the adventure at a local bar for continued merriment and camaraderie.

tours.name: Ardglass to Peel, TT Races:
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey from Ardglass to Peel aboard a comfortable 11m RIB, perfect for Isle of Man TT Race fans. Experience the stunning Irish Sea while staying warm and dry. With a skilled crew and a thrilling atmosphere, this adventure promises unforgettable memories on the open water.

tours.name: Ted Lasso Taxi Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable road trip with fellow Diamond Dogs as you explore the iconic filming locations of Ted Lasso. Visit the charming Crown and Anchor Pub and AFC Richmond's training ground, while enjoying engaging 'TED TALKS' and recreating memorable scenes with your knowledgeable driver guide.

tours.name: Ghost Stories for Christmas
tours.description: Step into Wymering Manor’s candlelit Christmas scene, cozy by the fire with mulled wine, as ghost stories come alive. Relive a treasured holiday tradition in a hauntingly beautiful historic setting.

tours.name: Paddle Sport Rescue Course (PSRC)
tours.description: Master essential paddling safety and rescue skills in a fun, hands-on 6-hour course. Learn to handle common issues, perform rescues, and stay safe on sheltered waters with expert guidance.

tours.name: Somerset Cider & Cheese
tours.description: Sample Somerset’s finest: learn about traditional cider and cheese-making, tour orchards, and enjoy tastings of local cheeses and craft cider in scenic farm settings. A delicious journey into local flavors.

tours.name: A Taste of Türkiye @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create authentic Turkish lamb köftes in a lively 2-hour class. Mix, fry, and flavor with spices, make fresh sides, and enjoy your feast at the chef’s table. All ingredients and recipes included—no spectators allowed.

tours.name: Showstopping Ravioli @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create perfect ravioli with seasonal fillings and simple sauces in a fun 2-hour class. Learn pasta shaping, filling, and sauce skills, then enjoy your handmade dishes at the chef’s table with a glass of bubbly.

tours.name: A Taste Of Sushi @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Master sushi rolling in 2 hours! Learn to make perfect rice, slice fresh veggies, and create spicy crab or salmon rolls. Enjoy your handmade sushi at the chef’s table with drinks and a recipe pack to recreate at home.

tours.name: Italian favourites @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create an authentic Italian feast in 2 hours: layer eggplant parmigiana, whip up a citrus-inspired salad, and finish with a quick, creamy tiramisù. Perfect for food lovers eager to master Italy’s flavors.

tours.name: The Welsh Chieftain
tours.description: Feel the power of Class 37 engines roaring through scenic Welsh uplands on a 121-mile journey. Vintage carriages with open windows let you soak in the sights and sounds of this thrilling diesel adventure.

tours.name: The Cathedrals Express to Swansea – Saturday 5th July
tours.description: Travel along the scenic River Severn on the historic Cathedrals Express, celebrating 175 years of Welsh rail history with luxurious Pullman dining or cozy first-class comfort.

tours.name: Thai Street Food 'Red'
tours.description: Create authentic Thai street food from scratch, including Money Bags, Chicken Satay, and Red Curry. Learn flavor balance, use fresh ingredients, and enjoy your tasty creations in a fun, hands-on session perfect for all!

tours.name: Animal Care Club TASTER SESSION
tours.description: Join the Animal Care Club on February 18, 2025, for a hands-on experience with farm animals! Children will learn to feed, care for, and interact with sheep, pigs, goats, and more. This unique opportunity fosters responsibility, empathy, and confidence while promoting physical activity and a connection to nature.

tours.name: Saturday Animal Care Club
tours.description: Frampton Animal Care Clubs offer children aged 5 to 11 a unique opportunity to connect with farm animals while developing essential life skills. Through hands-on activities like feeding, grooming, and walking animals, kids cultivate empathy, responsibility, and confidence, all while enjoying a fun and engaging outdoor experience.

tours.name: Votes For Women - The Power of Protest’ Tour.  Newcastle Upon Tyne
tours.description: Stroll through Newcastle’s city center and uncover inspiring stories of brave women who fought for suffrage. Immerse yourself in their resilience and pivotal role in shaping history, all in 90 memorable minutes.

tours.name: Guided Boat Dive
tours.description: Dive into the stunning underwater world of Cornwall with Karleyth Diving. Explore vibrant marine life, including Sardines, Tunas, and Octopus, while discovering unique seabeds of sand and rocky outcrops. Experience the breathtaking diversity of Nudibranchs and Anemones, making this an unforgettable adventure for nature enthusiasts.

tours.name: Canoe Hire
tours.description: Experience the beauty of Thetford like never before as you paddle down the serene River Thet in a canoe. Whether you choose to go solo or share the adventure with up to two friends, this unique journey offers stunning views and a memorable connection to nature.

tours.name: Half Day Rock Climbing Experience
tours.description: Scale natural rock faces in Northumberland with a half-day of climbing and abseiling, perfect for all ages. Feel the thrill as you conquer the cliffs on a tailored adventure for kids and adults alike.

tours.name: Half Day Canoe Trip
tours.description: Experience the beauty of Northumberland with our half-day canoeing sessions, perfect for beginners and families. Paddle along the picturesque rivers Tweed, Tyne, Till, or the serene Druridge Bay, guided by an expert coach. Enjoy personalized attention in small groups, ensuring a memorable adventure on the water.

tours.name: Full Day Canoe Trip
tours.description: Experience the beauty of Northumberland through canoeing on its picturesque rivers and bays. Perfect for beginners and families, this full-day adventure includes expert guidance, essential safety gear, and refreshments. Enjoy a memorable day on the water, setting the stage for future multi-day paddling expeditions.

tours.name: Archery and Axe Throwing
tours.description: Experience the ancient art of archery and the thrill of axe throwing at Northern Outdoor. With expert coaching, you'll master the skills of these time-honored activities, whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro. Unleash your inner warrior and enjoy a unique blend of history and recreation!

tours.name: A Day In The Wilderness (Bushcraft And Survival Skills)
tours.description: Escape to a private Northumberland woodland to learn essential survival skills through hands-on guidance, recharging your mind and body in a peaceful, natural setting away from everyday life.

tours.name: Game Butchery Course
tours.description: Immerse yourself in a unique woodland classroom experience where you'll learn the art of deer skinning and butchering from seasoned experts. Gain hands-on skills in breaking down a deer, preserving meat, and crafting delicious venison dishes, all while connecting with nature and embracing sustainable practices. Take home fresh cuts of meat!

tours.name: Wood Carving Workshop
tours.description: Create your own eco-friendly product while connecting with nature. Enjoy the sounds of the wilderness, learn an ancient skill, and leave with a handmade item and new tools—an enriching, hands-on experience.

tours.name: Adult Prosecco & Paint After Hours Session
tours.description: Escape the everyday hustle and indulge in a carefree painting experience with friends. Sip on your favorite Jack Daniel's or Champagne while unleashing your creativity. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere free from distractions, making it the perfect opportunity to unwind and create memorable art together.

tours.name: Take home kits
tours.description: Unleash your creativity from the comfort of home by gathering your paints, brushes, and palettes. This unique experience allows you to explore your artistic side at your own pace, transforming your space into a personal studio where imagination knows no bounds. Dive into a world of color and expression!

tours.name: Bibimbap @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create your own vibrant bibimbap with marinated eggs, spicy pickles, and perfect sticky rice. Sit at the chef’s table to enjoy this colorful, flavorful Korean rice bowl—an unforgettable taste adventure.

tours.name: Dermot & Nia Byrne le Steve Cooney
tours.description: Join Nia Byrne, a talented young fiddler from Donegal, as she shares her deep-rooted passion for traditional Irish music. With influences from renowned musicians and a commitment to teaching, her performances promise to be a vibrant celebration of culture. Experience the magic of Irish music through her captivating artistry.

tours.name: Whitchurch Silk Production Tour
tours.description: Explore Britain's oldest working silk mill on a guided tour. Watch historic looms, hear captivating stories, and witness centuries of craftsmanship in an authentic Victorian setting.

tours.name: Offvine Tour
tours.description: 18+ • 5 hours 45 minutes • Discover England’s Wine Revolution

tours.name: Natural Wine Tour
tours.description: Sip on six or more raw, unfiltered wines from natural vineyards, savor local cheeses and bites, and explore biodynamic methods—an adventurous journey into bold flavors and sustainable winemaking.

tours.name: Offvine Margate
tours.description: Sip on over 8 premium wines from local vineyards, paired with Kentish cheese or charcuterie. Enjoy a scenic full-day tour from Margate, with transport included—perfect for wine lovers and foodies alike.

tours.name: English Sparkling Wine Tour
tours.description: 18+ • 5 hours 45 minutes • Find out why English wine has the hype

tours.name: Hen Wine Tour
tours.description: Sip on over eight wines, from sparkling to still, at two scenic Kentish vineyards. Savor local cheese or charcuterie, all while relaxing in comfort as we handle the driving and tunes.

tours.name: Sheer Rocks Day Pass
tours.description: Relax on a cliffside daybed by the Rock Pool, sip a welcome cocktail, and enjoy panoramic Caribbean views. Indulge in award-winning cuisine and soak up the sun in pure Antigua paradise.

tours.name: Single Kayak Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you paddle through the stunning River Dart. Experience the thrill of kayaking while surrounded by breathtaking scenery, making memories that will last a lifetime. This unique journey offers a perfect blend of nature and excitement, inviting you to discover the beauty of the river like never before.

tours.name: Paddle Board Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding on the River, where fun meets relaxation for all ages. Enjoy breathtaking views while standing tall, and discover local sea life and distant horizons. This engaging activity not only offers adventure but also serves as a full-body workout, enhancing your strength, balance, and fitness.

tours.name: Early May Weekend
tours.description: Set sail on a relaxing journey along Suffolk or Norfolk’s coast, where you’ll spot native birds and wildlife. Participate in sailing, navigation, and meal prep, then enjoy dinner on deck and sleep peacefully to the tide’s lullaby. Wake to coastal sounds, share stories, and return refreshed after a memorable weekend at sea.

tours.name: Spring Bank Holiday Weekend
tours.description: Set sail on a relaxing journey along Suffolk or Norfolk’s coast, where you’ll spot native birds and wildlife. Help with sailing tasks, enjoy onboard meals, and sleep peacefully to the sound of the tide. Wake to coastal serenity, then explore, learn, and share unforgettable moments with fellow adventurers.

tours.name: OA Make It Yours!
tours.description: Enjoy a private, customizable yacht experience with Meraud and crew. Stay as long as you like, craft your perfect itinerary, and explore in luxury—your dream getaway, tailored just for you.

tours.name: Introduction to Sheep Keeping Course
tours.description: Get hands-on with sheep care in a one-day course covering health checks, handling, feeding, and legislation. Meet the flock, learn practical skills, and ask farmers your questions in an engaging, informative session.

tours.name: Amsterdam - visite Privée à pied des lieux historiques
tours.description: Explore Westminster Abbey’s royal secrets with VIP access, skipping lines for a rich history tour, or enjoy a relaxed self-guided visit during services. An exclusive, family-friendly experience in London’s heart.

tours.name: Outside In •  Gin Bottle Terrarium Workshop
tours.description: Create your own miniature tropical garden in a repurposed York Gin bottle, guided by Alice. Enjoy a complimentary Gin & Tonic, personalize your design, and leave with a beautiful, handcrafted terrarium to cherish.

tours.name: Eid in Paris
tours.description: Travel from London to Paris in just over two hours via Eurostar, passing through the Channel Tunnel. Explore iconic sights on a hop-on, hop-off bus tour, then return at your own pace.

tours.name: Short Cruise - Norton Priory to Top Locks Return
tours.description: Sail along the scenic Bridgewater Canal for 1.5 hours, gliding past lush gardens and historic locks. Perfect for families, this relaxing cruise offers a peaceful escape from the everyday.

tours.name: Saxon Air's Aviation Discovery Club
tours.description: Young explorers dive into green aviation with hands-on drone, simulator, and coding activities, sparking curiosity about sustainable flight and teamwork in a fun, future-focused environment.

tours.name: Brent Community Iftar
tours.description: Join a vibrant sunset feast with Brent Iftar, where fragrant spices and warm conversations create an unforgettable evening of cultural flavor and community.

tours.name: Tulip Festival
tours.description: Explore charming Cotswold villages like Bibury and Bourton-on-the-Water, with stunning countryside views, private guides, and photo spots. Perfect for a picturesque day out in England’s most beautiful rural areas.

tours.name: British Museum Tour
tours.description: Explore the British Museum’s treasures: the Rosetta Stone, ancient mummies, Greek sculptures, and the Lewis Chessmen. Walk through history, marvel at stunning artifacts, and soak in the grandeur of the Great Court.

tours.name: Sunset Chasers Paddling Tour
tours.description: Experience a memorable 2-hour guided tour on the stunning Beaulieu River, where you can paddle in stable canoes or kayaks while enjoying breathtaking sunset views. This all-inclusive adventure offers a chance to witness vibrant wildlife and create lasting memories in a picturesque setting, perfect for everyone.

tours.name: Pasta Master @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Italian pasta from scratch in just 2 hours. Shape, cook, and pair three delicious sauces, then enjoy your handmade dish at the chef’s table with a glass of bubbly. All ingredients and skills included.

tours.name: An Introduction To Thai Cookery @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Thai dishes in a 5-hour hands-on class. Make fragrant soups, spicy curries, and vibrant salads, then enjoy your feast at the chef’s table with expert guidance and a recipe pack to recreate at home.

tours.name: Beachy Head Boat Trip
tours.description: Set sail along Seaford Bay to see seabird colonies, stunning cliffs, and the iconic Beachy Head lighthouses. Spot Harbour Porpoises and learn about Sussex’s marine life in a 90-minute family-friendly adventure.

tours.name: Aerial Adventure
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 2-hour adventure designed for families and groups, featuring three thrilling aerial activities: soar down a zip line, take the daring Leap of Faith to a trapeze bar, and master the art of abseiling from a climbing wall. Professional instructors ensure safety and fun in any weather!

tours.name: Margam Park Wildlife Events
tours.description: Explore Margam Park’s wildlife with guided walks—bird, insect, or plant spotting, sky views from the viewpoint, or sketching deer. Discover nature’s secrets with expert guidance on every step.

tours.name: Hurley Campsite Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of self-service boat rental at Marlow Boating. Navigate the scenic riverside at your own pace, enjoying the freedom to explore the beautiful waterways. This unique adventure allows you to create unforgettable memories while connecting with nature and discovering the charm of the river.

tours.name: Skirmish Sunday Airsoft Games (Every Other Sunday) ALL DAY
tours.description: Join a welcoming community of players aged 12 and up for an exhilarating airsoft experience! Explore diverse woodland terrains, including a full-size airplane and multi-level forts. Whether you bring your own gear or rent from an extensive selection, enjoy friendly competition and expert guidance in a vibrant, supportive environment.

tours.name: Adult Care Farming Monthly Sessions
tours.description: Join a lively group for a hands-on farm experience! Collaborate on essential tasks like feeding animals, harvesting veggies, and maintaining fields. Enjoy social time over coffee and lunch while immersing yourself in the joys of farm life. This unique day promises fun, teamwork, and a deeper connection to nature.

tours.name: Londres en un día coche
tours.description: Explore London's top sights in a full-day tour: from Buckingham Palace and Westminster Abbey to Tower of London and Big Ben. Enjoy a delicious lunch break and see the city’s most iconic landmarks all in one day.

tours.name: Private charter
tours.description: Experience a personalized day on the water with our Private Charters, where you can customize food, drinks, and itineraries. Relax on a heated boat as you cruise through Cornwall’s breathtaking rivers and coastline, enjoying local beverages and stunning sunset views—ideal for couples, groups, or special celebrations.

tours.name: Christmas Wreath Making 2024
tours.description: Join Isle of Cumbrae Distillers for a festive wreath-making workshop where you'll craft a stunning indoor wreath to impress your guests. Enjoy a welcome cocktail and a delightful G&T while a professional guides you through the creative process. Make this Christmas memorable with a personal touch!

tours.name: Racing the Limfjorden Rundt
tours.description: Join the Limfjorden Rundt 2025, one of the Nordic region's largest wooden sailing races! Over seven days, sail through Denmark's stunning Limfjord, visiting charming harbors while immersing yourself in Scandinavian culture. Experience flat-water sailing, vibrant festivities, and forge international friendships in this unforgettable maritime adventure.

tours.name: Festive Alpaca Walk
tours.description: Experience the magic of Christmas with a Festive Alpaca Walk at Lucky Tails Alpaca Farm! Stroll through the countryside with your own alpaca and Santa’s playful elves, capturing unforgettable moments. Enhance your visit by meeting Santa in his cozy grotto and receiving a special gift. A heartwarming adventure for all!

tours.name: Landwatch Training - Practical - Dungeness Beach
tours.description: Join the Kent Dolphin Project to explore the fascinating marine mammals of the Kent Coast. Learn from experts about identifying whales, dolphins, porpoises, and seals while participating in a land watch. This unique opportunity combines education and adventure, allowing you to contribute to vital marine research. Bring your binoculars for an enhanced experience!

tours.name: Land watch training course - Hove
tours.description: Join the Sussex Dolphin Project for an engaging 2-hour practical session where you'll learn to identify marine mammals along the stunning Sussex coast. Meet dedicated researchers, gain hands-on experience in land watching, and enhance your skills with provided equipment. Dive into the fascinating world of dolphins and seals while contributing to vital research!

tours.name: Paddlesport Leader Training
tours.description: Embark on a transformative 2-day training course to become a Paddlesport Leader, mastering the art of leading kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards in serene waters. Gain essential skills in risk assessment and group management through expert instruction and hands-on training, setting the stage for your leadership journey in paddling.

tours.name: Saturday Morning Puppy Socials
tours.description: Join our Saturday Morning Puppy Socials at Doghouse in Bradford on Avon, where your puppy can safely socialize with peers under expert guidance.
