Designed for vaccinated pups under six months, these sessions offer playtime, training tips, and a chance to connect with fellow puppy owners in a welcoming community.

tours.name: 4 Hour Dolphin Spotting
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 4-hour marine adventure from Conwy Quay, exploring the breathtaking North Wales coastline in search of wild dolphins. Experience the beauty of the Great Orme and Anglesey, enjoy a charming stop at Amlwch Port, and gain insights into marine life from our knowledgeable crew. Perfect for all wildlife enthusiasts!

tours.name: Junior Climbing
tours.description: Join us for an engaging introductory session that promises fun and excitement! Experience a unique opportunity to explore new ideas and connect with others in a lively atmosphere. This memorable event is perfect for those looking to spark their curiosity and dive into something fresh and enjoyable.

tours.name: Discover Team Building
tours.description: Boost your team’s energy and connection in nature with our free woodland taster session. Engage in fun activities that improve communication and teamwork—perfect for leaders planning future away days.

tours.name: Boachella Bottomless Brunch
tours.description: Dance, sip, and sparkle on a 3-hour Dorset boat cruise with top DJ, bottomless drinks, tasty brunch, and Coachella-style fun. Dress in festival glam and capture unforgettable coastal party moments.

tours.name: Pick Your Own Apples
tours.description: Experience the charm of Ampleforth Abbey’s historic 200-year-old orchard, one of the largest in Northern England. With 1,500 apple trees and over 60 varieties, you can pick your own apples and witness the unique process of pressing apple juice and cider at the Abbey’s traditional Cider Mill.

tours.name: Wild Women's Kayaking
tours.description: Paddle through scenic waters on a guided kayak adventure just for Wild Women. All gear provided—just bring yourself and a smile. Feel the thrill as you glide through changing locations, embracing nature’s beauty.

tours.name: The Rose Circle
tours.description: Join a peaceful Sunday gathering at Laverock Law Farm, where gentle meditation, mindful sharing, and creative activities help you relax and reconnect. Surrounded by nature, you'll recharge your mind and spirit, express yourself through art, and enjoy homemade treats in a supportive community focused on self-care and inner balance.

tours.name: Painting Class
tours.description: Unleash your creativity in a relaxed 2-hour pottery painting class. Guided step-by-step, you'll decorate a ceramic piece with vibrant colors and personal flair—no experience needed, just bring your imagination.

tours.name: Valentine's Day Paddle
tours.description: Enjoy a peaceful, guided paddle along the scenic Beaulieu River, ending at a cozy hotel for drinks and relaxation. Perfect for a romantic, outdoor escape with loved ones or a special Valentine’s date.

tours.name: Mothers Day Paddle
tours.description: Glide along the scenic Beaulieu River in a stable canoe, then unwind at the historic Master Builder’s pub with a drink or a celebration for Mum. Perfect for families, couples, and outdoor lovers seeking relaxation and stunning views.

tours.name: Snowboard 2 day Camp (beginners)
tours.description: Kids learn to snowboard through fun games, making friends and building confidence on gentle slopes. Perfect for beginners, this 2-day camp offers lessons, snacks, and tubing—an exciting way to start their snowy adventure.

tours.name: Aberffraw guided history and local interest walk
tours.description: Explore Anglesey’s rich history, from Bronze Age rocks to Celtic legends, on scenic coastal walks. Discover shipwreck stories, ancient churches, and stunning views—an adventure full of history, wildlife, and breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: Mini Basket Weaving
tours.description: Create charming mini baskets with expert guidance in a relaxing willow weaving workshop. Learn traditional techniques, explore different weaves, and craft practical, decorative pieces for your home—no experience needed.

tours.name: IntraFest Sailings
tours.description: Climb aboard a historic Thames sailing barge for an 80-minute cruise from Ship Pier, passing Rochester and Upnor. Enjoy scenic views and refreshments as you glide along the iconic river.

tours.name: Road & Rail Weekend
tours.description: Watch lively passenger and freight trains run all day, swap engines, and get behind-the-scenes shed tours. Enjoy classic vehicles, scenic picnic spots, and the thrill of seeing steam engines lit up at this vibrant rail and vehicle event.

tours.name: Fitzwilliam Museum Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 90-minute tour of the Fitzwilliam Museum, one of the UK's finest regional museums. Explore an extraordinary collection of art and artifacts, from masterpieces by Titian to ancient relics. Discover hidden gems and treasured possessions in a setting that showcases unparalleled variety and depth.

tours.name: Private Tour & Tasting
tours.description: Max 10 people | call or email to book

tours.name: North Sea Voyage | Lowestoft - Bruge - Lowestoft
tours.description: Embark on a memorable four-night voyage aboard the historic Excelsior, sailing across the North Sea to the enchanting city of Bruges. Enjoy comfortable accommodations, delicious meals, and the chance to learn sailing skills from experienced crew members, creating unforgettable memories on this unique maritime adventure.

tours.name: After School Club at The Tower, Barnstaple
tours.description: Join our exciting after-school climbing club, where local students can connect, stay active, and develop essential skills while having fun! With access to a 7.5-meter wall and various routes, participants will learn climbing techniques, safety practices, and teamwork in a supportive environment. No experience needed—just bring your enthusiasm!

tours.name: Evening Steam Train Fish & Chip Supper
tours.description: Climb aboard a vintage steam train for a 90-minute scenic ride through Dean Forest, topped with a delicious fish and chip supper served at your table. Relax, enjoy the views, and indulge in classic British comfort food.

tours.name: Adult Paddle
tours.description: Experience the freedom of the water at HYMB with your choice of kayaking, canoeing, or stand-up paddle boarding. Enjoy a leisurely session in a stunning environment, perfect for those who have completed the necessary courses. Unleash your adventurous spirit every Thursday and Saturday in a relaxed, non-instructor-led setting.

tours.name: Coldwater Swimming Induction
tours.description: Experience the thrill of winter swimming in open water with our expert-led induction sessions. Perfect for seasoned swimmers looking to embrace colder temperatures, this unique opportunity ensures safety and enjoyment. Join us for a refreshing 30-minute dip and discover the invigorating benefits of swimming in winter conditions.

tours.name: Discover Stand Up Paddle Boarding
tours.description: Embark on a full-day canoeing adventure designed for all skill levels! Learn essential techniques from professional coaches, including body positioning and paddle techniques, while exploring sheltered waters. Gain confidence and earn Paddle UK awards, ensuring a memorable experience that fosters a lifelong passion for paddling. Perfect for beginners and those looking to refine their skills!

tours.name: Speed & Safari (Half Day)
tours.description: Tackle 100 acres of mud, hills, and water on quad bikes, then drive a Landrover through rugged terrain, and finally hover over grass tracks in a hovercraft—an adrenaline-packed, team-building adventure.

tours.name: Tree Top Trials by Night - Thrilling, Exciting and Dark
tours.description: Climb up to 6 meters into the treetops for a thrilling adventure through obstacle zones like the Spider and Adder, ending with fast zip lines. By night, the course transforms into an electrifying challenge, heightening your senses and adrenaline. Perfect for thrill-seekers ready to conquer the darkness and the heights.

tours.name: The Golden Gavel
tours.description: Step into a lively music hall show filled with catchy tunes, vibrant performances, and classic entertainment that will keep you entertained from start to finish.

tours.name: Cambrian Mountains - Stargazing Weekend
tours.description: Join expert astronomers for an unforgettable weekend at Dark Sky Wales, where you'll delve into the wonders of the night sky. Enjoy hands-on astrophotography, engaging lectures, and breathtaking views in luxurious glamping cabins. This immersive experience caters to all skill levels, making it a perfect getaway for astronomy enthusiasts.

tours.name: Halloween Lights of the Valley Train
tours.description: Experience the enchanting charm of vintage steam trains illuminated by vibrant neon lights this October and November in South West Wales. Enjoy a magical journey perfect for capturing stunning photos, with optional spooky surprises for thrill-seekers. Arrive early to fully immerse yourself in this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Ghost Stories from The Brickworks
tours.description: Venture into the shadowy Brickworks at night, where ghostly figures and hidden secrets lurk. Interact with actors, uncover eerie stories, and face the restless spirits in this thrilling, immersive after-dark tour.

tours.name: Rampion Windfarm Boat Trip
tours.description: Hop aboard a fast RHIB to see the Rampion Windfarm, spot Sussex dolphins, and learn about marine life. Cruise past turbines, enjoy coastal views, and support dolphin conservation—all in 2 exciting hours.

tours.name: Ghost Stories from Fort Brockhurst
tours.description: Step into the haunting past of Fort Brockhurst on a thrilling torchlight tour. Explore its shadowy corridors and uncover ghostly secrets that reveal the fort's mysterious decline. With spine-chilling stories and unexpected scares, this immersive experience promises a captivating blend of history and adventure for brave explorers aged 12 and up.

tours.name: Forest Flyer
tours.description: Enjoy a scenic 45-minute heritage train ride through the Forest of Dean, with on-board Railway 200 displays and family activities. Travel freely all day, with options to add tasty pre-ordered food and bring your dog along.

tours.name: Medway Canoe Challenge
tours.description: Join the Medway Canoe Challenge on September 10th and paddle 29kms from Tonbridge to Allington Lock to support Hospice in the Weald. Experience the thrill of paddling together on MegaSUPs with friends or family, making it a fun and memorable day while contributing to a great cause.

tours.name: Summer Solstice Paddle Trip
tours.description: Experience the magic of the Summer Solstice on a pre-dawn paddle trip from HYMB to Broxbourne. Departing at 3 am, you'll witness a breathtaking sunrise before enjoying a hot drink and breakfast roll upon your return. Camping is available for those who prefer a leisurely start. Join us for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: The Adventurer Kids Outdoor Activity Day - Bushcraft, Archery, and Team Building.
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating outdoor day filled with Bushcraft, Archery, and Team Building! Engage with nature while challenging yourself and your team in a variety of fun activities. Perfect for adventurous spirits, this 6-hour event promises memorable moments and the thrill of hitting the bull's eye. Join the excitement!

tours.name: The Daredevil Kids Outdoor Activity Day - Highwire Course, Crate Stacking and Archery.
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating outdoor adventure with a day packed full of Highwire obstacle courses, Crate Stacking, and Archery. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the woods and engage in thrilling activities that promote teamwork and skill. This unique blend of fun and challenge makes for an unforgettable day in nature!

tours.name: Alpaca Date for Two
tours.description: Experience a unique two-hour Alpaca Date for Two at Frankly Alpacas, set in a picturesque 14-acre field. Enjoy feeding and learning about these charming animals while sipping prosecco and indulging in chocolates. Revel in stunning panoramic views of the Shropshire countryside and engage with the team to satisfy your curiosity.

tours.name: Unique Pedal Boat
tours.description: Experience the serenity of the Wey Navigation like never before in our custom-built pedal boat. Glide through tranquil waters at your own pace, powered by a unique geared mechanism that transforms your pedaling into smooth propulsion. Perfect for families and adventure seekers, this is a memorable way to explore nature!

tours.name: Fragrant Thai Green Curry @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Learn to make authentic Thai green curry from scratch, balancing five flavors, pounding fragrant paste, and cooking perfect rice. Enjoy your creation at our chef’s table with expert guidance and a digital recipe pack.

tours.name: Dog Friendly Trip
tours.description: Embark on a 45-minute coastal adventure around the stunning shores of Carnlough and Glenarm. Enjoy music, binoculars for wildlife spotting, and breathtaking views of the Glens of Antrim. Keep an eye out for seals and dolphins, and explore the iconic harbour steps where Arya Stark once swam. Dog-friendly fun awaits!

tours.name: First Aid at Work Course
tours.description: £240 per person

tours.name: Alpaca Meet & Greet with Afternoon Tea for Two
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable 90-minute encounter with our charming alpacas, where you can feed, bond, and learn about these unique animals in a serene farm setting. After your hands-on interaction, indulge in a delightful afternoon tea, making this a perfect blend of nature and relaxation.

tours.name: Open Session
tours.description: Experience two hours of exhilarating outdoor laser tag in a vibrant, all-ages environment! Join open sessions with no minimum player requirement and enjoy multiple fast-paced games. Bring your friends and family for an unforgettable adventure, while ensuring everyone has suitable footwear for the action-packed fun.

tours.name: Lambing & Kidding Visit April 2026
tours.description: Experience an exclusive one-hour visit to Frampton Farm in April 2026, where you can interact with adorable baby lambs, kids, and pregnant ewes and goats. This intimate setting offers a unique opportunity to connect with these animals away from the hustle of larger commercial farms, making it a memorable outing.

tours.name: RYA Level 2 Basic Sailing
tours.description: Embark on a transformative 2-day sailing course designed to enhance your skills and boost your confidence on the water. With 7 hours of hands-on instruction each day, you'll learn to sail competently in light winds and earn a Level 2 Certificate, marking your achievement in this exhilarating adventure.

tours.name: Sightseeing - Old Harry Rocks
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-hour sightseeing trip from Swanage Pier to Old Harry Rocks and The Needles. Experience stunning views of dramatic chalk cliffs and towering rock stacks, while keeping an eye out for wildlife like Cormorants, Peregrine Falcons, and even playful seals and dolphins. A memorable coastal adventure awaits!

tours.name: 1:1 SUP Session
tours.description: Elevate your paddling skills with a personalized two-hour session from our expert Paddle Cabin Crew. Whether you're overcoming fears, refining techniques, or boosting confidence, this tailored experience ensures you achieve your goals. Enjoy dedicated attention, expert guidance, and a chance to reflect on your adventure after paddling.

tours.name: The art of pie decorating with Julie Jones
tours.description: Unleash your inner pastry artist with Julie Jones, mastering elegant pie decorations, lattices, spirals, and shaping. Leave with two stunning homemade pies and newfound confidence in pastry art.

tours.name: Wetsuit Hire: Half Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure with a high-quality wetsuit rental from Cornish Adventure HQ. Enjoy personalized sizing assistance from our trained staff to ensure the perfect fit. Stay warm and comfortable as you dive into your next aquatic escapade, all while benefiting from our exceptional service and clean gear.

tours.name: Kayak Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable kayaking adventure along the scenic River Nene, where you can choose between sleek sit-in kayaks or stable sit-on models. Paddle through over 8 miles of stunning countryside and wildlife, perfect for both casual explorers and thrill-seekers. Experience nature like never before!

tours.name: Nightjar Special - Caerphilly
tours.description: Join a 2.5-hour evening tour to spot migrating Nightjars, bats, and other birds. Walk through scenic sites at dusk, listen for churring, and get close-up views with a scope—an unforgettable nature adventure.

tours.name: Exmouth Marina To Turf Locks Return Trip
tours.description: Experience a scenic 3-hour adventure as you cruise the River Exe to Turf Locks, a pub with stunning views of Exeter Canal and Powderham Estate. Enjoy a luxurious ride on an Italian Rib, savor delicious food and drinks, and relax on a stable pontoon before returning to Exmouth Marina.

tours.name: Macaron Masterclass
tours.description: Create perfect French macarons in a fun, hands-on class. Learn piping, make fresh curds, and leave with your own delicious treats to enjoy or gift. All skills, ingredients, and take-home boxes included.

tours.name: Turkish Meze
tours.description: Create authentic Turkish meze in a lively, hands-on class. Prepare dishes like boregi, lamb koftes, flatbreads, and dips, then enjoy your creations. Perfect for social cooking and tasting fresh, homemade flavors.

tours.name: Rock Climbing & Abseiling
tours.description: Climb in a scenic, safe setting with expert guidance. Perfect for beginners and seasoned climbers alike, all gear included. Bring sturdy shoes and weather gear—conquer the wall and feel the thrill of your first ascent.

tours.name: Canoe Tour on Derwentwater
tours.description: Paddle across Derwentwater’s stunning waters on a 3-hour open canoe adventure. Learn basic skills with expert guidance, enjoy breathtaking scenery, and connect with nature in a fun, safe way. Book now!

tours.name: Paddleboarding Taster Session
tours.description: Learn to paddleboard with expert guidance in a fun, 2-hour session. Boost your confidence, get a full-body workout, and enjoy scenic waters. Perfect for beginners 12+—book now and start paddling!

tours.name: Ghyll Scrambling
tours.description: Jump into crystal-clear pools, slide down waterfalls, and explore ancient rocks on this thrilling ghyll scrambling adventure. Perfect for ages 10+, led by expert guides—an unforgettable splash-filled day awaits. Book now!

tours.name: Mountain Scrambling
tours.description: Conquer iconic Lakeland peaks like Striding Edge or Sharp Edge on a full-day scramble. Feel the thrill of heights, navigate rugged terrain, and enjoy stunning mountain views—adventure awaits for active explorers.

tours.name: Row Boat Hire  - The Agnes Evelyn
tours.description: Sail the tranquil waters in a historic 15ft rowboat, gliding smoothly past Trelissick Gardens or to the Pandora Inn. Enjoy full guidance, safety gear, and flexible hire options for a memorable day on Loe Beach.

tours.name: A Dickens Murder Mystery at Wymering Manor
tours.description: Step into a Victorian Christmas mystery at Wymering Manor, where a festive party turns into a thrilling whodunit. Interrogate Dickensian characters, search by torchlight, and piece together clues to find the missing host. Engage in lively parlour games and uncover secrets in this immersive, 2.5-hour detective adventure.

tours.name: Alpaca Meet & Greet with Winter Afternoon Tea
tours.description: Experience the charm of our alpaca farm, where you can interact with our friendly herd, learn about these unique animals, and enjoy feeding them. After bonding with the alpacas, indulge in a delightful winter-themed afternoon tea served in a cozy marquee, making for a memorable and relaxing day.

tours.name: Gold Steam Footplate Driving Experience
tours.description: Take control of a real steam locomotive on a classic Great Western branch line. Enjoy hands-on driving, firing, and a behind-the-scenes tour, all in a fun, relaxed day suitable for beginners.

tours.name: Tryweryn Festival 3rd - 5th July 2026.
tours.description: Join the Tryweryn Festival for thrilling paddling, lively parties, and delicious food. Enjoy water releases, coaching, and vibrant events—perfect for water lovers aged 12 and up. Book your spot now!

tours.name: Paranormal Activity Tour in Old London
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-hour paranormal investigation through London's haunted history. Armed with K2 Meters and Dowsing Rods, explore chilling sites like the largest execution ground and the notorious Scratching Fanny of Cock Lane. Dare to connect with the supernatural while visiting a traditional Gin Palace. Adults only, limited to 10 guests.

tours.name: Haunted London Pub Tour (Private Tour)
tours.description: Gather your friends for a spine-tingling tour of London's haunted pubs! Explore eerie tales, including Sweeney Todd's history and the Professor of Profanity, while visiting three historic locations. Experience the chilling atmosphere and perhaps catch a glimpse of a ghost, all while enjoying the city's most iconic public houses.

tours.name: Paranormal Activity Tour in Old London (Private Tour)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling paranormal investigation through London’s haunted history. Explore chilling sites like the largest execution ground and the infamous Cock Lane, while using ghost-hunting tools to connect with the supernatural. This adults-only tour promises spine-tingling stories and eerie encounters, all within a captivating two-hour experience.

tours.name: Climb Dartmoor
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating outdoor rock climbing adventure in Dartmoor National Park, where breathtaking scenery meets expert guidance. Tailored for all skill levels, this inclusive experience provides all necessary gear, ensuring a safe and memorable climb. Join fellow adventurers and discover the thrill of conquering the cliffs!

tours.name: Discover Bath & Bridgerton With Music
tours.description: Experience the charm of Bath on a captivating walking tour that brings Bridgerton to life! With high-tech headphones enhancing your journey, explore iconic filming locations while learning about Regency life. Discover major landmarks and enjoy exclusive behind-the-scenes insights from passionate guides, making this a truly unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Surf Instructor Course
tours.description: Learn to teach surfing safely with a 20-hour course, combining theory and beach training. Perfect for beginners aged 16+, it leads to certification as a surf instructor, ready to inspire others in waist-deep waves.

tours.name: Motorboat Hire - The Agnes Evelyn
tours.description: Enjoy a 3.5-hour or full-day adventure on the Agnes Evelyn, a classic rowing or motor boat. Glide silently through water, visit scenic spots, or fish—perfect for explorers ready to get wet and make memories.

tours.name: Wing SUP Lesson
tours.description: Experience the thrill of "winging," a rapidly growing water sport that combines simplicity with excitement. In this lesson, you'll master the basics of flying a wing on a stable SUP, learn to select the perfect venue, and safely set up your equipment, paving the way to your first maneuvers.

tours.name: Light Up The Lake at Witton Castle
tours.description: Experience a magical evening as you paddle illuminated boards and kayaks on the lake, surrounded by soothing music. This unique event, perfect for families, transforms the water into a stunning spectacle at sunset. Don’t forget your change of clothes and warm layers for a cozy finish after the adventure.

tours.name: First Class Evening Steam Train Fish & Chip Supper
tours.description: Climb aboard a steam train for a scenic 90-minute journey through Dean Forest, topped with a delicious, fully served fish and chip supper in first class comfort. A memorable meal on rails awaits you.

tours.name: Junior Ice Hockey
tours.description: Experience a unique ice skating session designed for those under 18, accompanied by a parent, guardian, or carer. Enjoy the thrill of gliding on ice while creating unforgettable memories together, even if the adult chooses to stay off the rink. A perfect bonding opportunity for families!

tours.name: Private: Discover Oxford with Recent Graduate
tours.description: Embark on a personalized journey through Oxford University with a recent graduate as your guide. Explore a millennium of history, stunning architecture, and the vibrant student life. Tailor your experience by choosing your own route or adding unique stops, ensuring an unforgettable adventure in one of the world's greatest universities.

tours.name: Fragrant Thai Green Curry @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Create authentic Thai green curry from scratch, mastering spice blending, cooking perfect jasmine rice, and garnishing with fresh herbs. Enjoy your flavorful dish at the chef’s table with a glass of bubbles included.

tours.name: Springtime Fun on the Farm 2026 EARLY BIRD BOOKING
tours.description: Get up close with adorable lambs, playful rabbits, and curious alpacas at a charming Shropshire farm. Pet, bottle-feed, and snap selfies with friendly animals in a fun, interactive day out.

tours.name: Chirk Tunnel & Aqueduct Canoeing
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling family adventure as you paddle across the Chirk Aqueduct and navigate the 421-meter Chirk tunnel, equipped with headtorches. With small group sizes for personalized instruction, you'll learn new skills while soaking in the breathtaking scenery of the Ceiriog Valley and its rich history. Create unforgettable memories together!

tours.name: THREE ZERO
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a 30-minute ride across Seaford Bay, where you can soak in the fresh sea air and stunning views of the Seven Sisters. This unique adventure offers an exhilarating escape on the water, perfect for those seeking a refreshing and scenic journey without distractions.

tours.name: Return Trains (Green Timetable)
tours.company: Sittingbourne and Kemsley Light Railway Limited
tours.description: Experience a unique journey on a heritage industrial railway, operating since 1905, that connects Sittingbourne to Kemsley Down. Travel over a historic viaduct through the rugged North Kent landscape, while enjoying original steam engines and rolling stock. Explore the Footplate Cafe, shop, and museum at Kemsley Down for a memorable visit.

tours.name: Festival 2026 - Lagg Orchard Mini Tour
tours.description: Stroll through the orchard with Andy and Davy, breathing in fresh June air while learning about the apple varieties that create our small-batch cider. Enjoy a relaxing walk filled with good company and orchard secrets.

tours.name: Coasteering Guided Trip - Devon
tours.description: Dive into Devon’s rugged coast with thrilling jumps, wildlife sightings, and seaweed tasting. Swim, climb, and explore hidden spots on a half-day coasteering adventure—no experience needed, all gear included.

tours.name: 3 Countries in 1 Tour (England, Scotland & Wales)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day journey through England, Scotland, and Wales, exploring 19 unique experiences. From the birthplace of Shakespeare in Stratford-Upon-Avon to the breathtaking Scottish Highlands and majestic Welsh castles, this adventure promises a rich tapestry of history, culture, and stunning landscapes that will leave lasting memories.

tours.name: New to Paddleboarding Course - Four Evening Sessions - Adults Only
tours.description: Join our Evening Intro to SUP Course for a relaxed, structured introduction to paddle boarding! Over four weeks, you'll gain essential skills, confidence, and nationally recognized certifications while enjoying the water. Perfect for beginners, this course covers everything from balance to safety techniques, ensuring a memorable paddling experience.

tours.name: Sharpen Your Knife Skills @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Transform your cooking skills with a hands-on class: learn knife techniques, chop veggies, and master pad Thai and pickled giardiniera. Enjoy your creations, sip bubbly, and take home jars of your delicious sauces.

tours.name: Return Trains (Yellow Timetable)
tours.company: Sittingbourne and Kemsley Light Railway Limited
tours.description: Experience a journey on a historic narrow gauge railway, operating since 1905, that connects Sittingbourne to Kemsley Down. Travel over a century-old viaduct through the unique industrial landscape of North Kent. Enjoy the charm of original steam engines and explore the Footplate Cafe, museum, and gardens at your destination.

tours.name: Low Season Private Charter (Package deal) • Hot Buffet
tours.description: Celebrate on a private Oxford cruise with scenic views, delicious hot buffet, and lively entertainment. Customize your journey through charming villages and lush countryside for an unforgettable river adventure.

tours.name: Paddle Safer - SUP
tours.description: Boost your water confidence with a 2-hour safety course. Learn to plan trips, assess conditions, and master rescue techniques to paddle smarter and safer on any water. Perfect for beginners and seasoned paddlers alike.

tours.name: Ocktoberfest Party Cruise
tours.description: Sail into Oktoberfest on the water with flowing steins, bratwurst bites, and lively beats. Dance under the stars, dress up in festive gear, and enjoy stunning views on this 3-hour Bavarian celebration.

tours.name: Pirates of Coastal Vibes Party Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate Weymouth’s Pirate Fest with a lively 3-hour cruise along the Jurassic Coast. Enjoy live music, stunning sea views, and a fully stocked bar—perfect for making unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Pirates of Coastal Vibes Cruise
tours.description: Set sail on a 2-hour pirate-themed cruise along the stunning Jurassic Coast. Dress up, enjoy lively music, spot sea monsters, and capture unforgettable family photos in a fun-filled seaside adventure.

tours.name: Neon Nights 80s Party Cruise
tours.description: Dance your way through an 80s-themed cruise with nonstop hits from DJ Steve Mullins. Three hours of neon, big hair, and retro moves on the water—an unforgettable throwback party you can't miss.

tours.name: Bingoing Mad
tours.description: Join a lively 4-hour boat party blending high-energy bingo, cash prizes, and DJ Steve’s infectious tunes. Enjoy tasty food, hilarious games, and unforgettable fun on the water.

tours.name: Boos and Booze Party Cruise
tours.description: Dance into Halloween on a 3-hour Jurassic Coast cruise filled with spooky décor, lively music, and costume contests. Enjoy haunting views, drinks, and unforgettable scares on the open water.

tours.name: Astro Photography Workshop
tours.description: Join experienced astro-photographer Steve Bell for an unforgettable evening of capturing the night sky's beauty. Enjoy an informative talk, refreshments, and an outdoor photography session, where you'll learn to master low-light techniques. Whether under the stars or amidst the Abbey, this experience promises stunning shots and lasting memories.

tours.name: Private Group Kayaking - Saul Junction
tours.description: Paddle through scenic waterways with friends or colleagues in a tailored private session. No experience needed—just fun challenges, stunning views, and a memorable adventure designed to suit your group’s needs.

tours.name: Wellness Retreat
tours.description: Join a wellness retreat with rowing, beach yoga, relaxing saunas, a cacao ceremony, and a sound bath. Rebalance your body and mind while soaking in stunning coastal views and enjoying healthy food and deep relaxation.

tours.name: Spring Steam Gala
tours.description: Enjoy a thrilling weekend of steam locomotives in action amid the autumnal Forest of Dean, with visiting engines, passenger trains, and lively shuttles at the Royal Forest of Steam Gala 2025.

tours.name: Wildlife Events - Forest Farm Cardiff
tours.description: Get up close to incredible wildlife with our expert-led tour, where you'll see animals in their natural habitat and create unforgettable memories in the wild.

tours.name: Penmon guided history and local interest walk
tours.description: Explore Anglesey’s rich history and stunning scenery on invigorating 5-mile walks. From ancient ruins and shipwreck stories to coastal views and birdlife, uncover the island’s secrets with a lively, expert guide.

tours.name: Nightjar & Nocturnal Special - Forest of Dean
tours.description: Join a 2.5-hour evening adventure to spot elusive Nightjars, bats, and migrating birds. Walk through scenic, rugged terrain with scopes and bat detectors, and enjoy a close-up look at nature’s nocturnal wonders.

tours.name: Fathers Day 2026
tours.description: Celebrate Father’s Day with a 45-minute distillery tour, tasting Scotland’s oldest single malt, and enjoying a local pie and beer pairing in a cozy café—an unforgettable day for Dad.

tours.name: Trail Riding - One2One
tours.description: Race through 12km of pristine UK trails on a personalized ride that blends speed and skill for an unforgettable adventure. Feel the thrill as you conquer top terrain designed just for you.

tours.name: The Seven Sisters and Birling Gap
tours.description: Set sail along Sussex coast to see the Seven Sisters, Beachy Head Lighthouse, and wildlife like Harbour Porpoise. Capture stunning views, enjoy a safety briefing, and stay warm on this 1-hour scenic cruise.

tours.name: Festive Cream Tea
tours.description: 1.5 Hours

tours.name: Heritage Diesel Day Rover
tours.description: Climb aboard a heritage diesel train and glide through Dean Forest all day, soaking in scenic views and the nostalgic charm of vintage locomotion—perfect for a relaxing family adventure.

tours.name: Kittywake Santa Cruise
tours.description: Climb aboard a festive cruise filled with sweets, surprises, and Santa visits. Kids meet Santa and elves, while adults enjoy mulled wine and treats. A magical holiday adventure for all ages on the water.

tours.name: Down Hill Bike Shred Kona
tours.description: Experience the thrill of downhill biking with the Shred Kona in a stunning forest setting. This robust bike offers unmatched stability and versatility, perfect for tackling jumps and navigating diverse terrain. Enjoy a memorable 4-hour adventure that combines adrenaline and nature, making every ride an exhilarating escape.

tours.name: Road Bike Hire All Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of cycling through the stunning South Downs with our all-day road bike hire. Choose between two high-quality Giant Defy 1 bikes, designed for comfort and performance. Perfect for adventurers seeking to explore the scenic routes, this unique opportunity promises an unforgettable day on two wheels.

tours.name: Road Bike Hire 2 Hours
tours.description: Experience the thrill of cycling through the stunning South Downs with our 2-hour road bike hire. Choose between a lightweight carbon frame or a durable aluminum frame bike, and enjoy the freedom of the open road. Perfect for adventure seekers looking to explore beautiful landscapes at their own pace.

tours.name: Signalling Experience - Lydney Junction
tours.description: Step into the shoes of a signalman for a day, controlling two trains and mastering railway signalling from dawn to dusk at Lydney Junction. An exclusive, hands-on experience you won’t forget.

tours.name: Meet the Reindeer Experience
tours.description: Get hands-on with Santa’s reindeer, feed them lichen, learn fun facts, and snap photos. Enjoy a cozy hot chocolate as you experience the magic of these friendly, majestic creatures at Somerset Reindeer Ranch.

tours.name: Family Activity Sessions July 24th - 26th
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable 1.5-hour adventure with your family! Choose from thrilling activities like kayaking or paddleboarding on the lake, honing your archery skills, or exploring a realistic cave system. Perfect for groups of 2 adults and 2 children or 1 adult and 3 children, this is a memorable outing for all!

tours.name: Meet & Greet Tour
tours.description: Experience the charm of farm life by meeting a variety of friendly animals, including pygmy goats, alpacas, and sheep. Engage with these delightful creatures and learn about their care, making for a unique and memorable day on the farm. Perfect for animal lovers and families seeking a fun outing!

tours.name: Hike Navigation Training Day
tours.description: Join us for an immersive day at Thoulstone Park, where you'll enhance your map reading and navigation skills under the guidance of experienced Mountain Leaders and D of E assessors. After a theory session, venture into the hills and woods to apply your newfound knowledge in a practical setting.

tours.name: Kayak Rolling Session / Tuition
tours.description: Experience a personalized kayak rolling session in the warm, inviting waters of the Rainbow Lagoon pool. Whether one-on-one or shared, you'll receive expert guidance from a skilled coach to enhance your skills and perfect your technique in a supportive environment. Dive into this unique opportunity for growth and fun!

tours.name: Paddlesport Touring Leader Training
tours.description: Join a two-day course to become a Paddlesport Touring Leader, enabling you to run safe, fun trips on inland waters with mixed craft. Develop skills, lead adventures, and inspire others in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Barre & Brushstrokes: Brasserie Blanc, Cheltenham
tours.description: Join us for a unique summer evening at Brasserie Blanc in Cheltenham on the 13th! Enjoy a relaxing ballet barre class followed by an intuitive painting session with therapeutic art coach Brydie Niland. This memorable night combines fitness, creativity, and self-care, making it the perfect escape. Spaces are limited!

tours.name: Sheep Shearing Young Farmers Session
tours.description: Join our young farmers for a unique annual sheep shearing experience! Help drive sheep through the race to the shearers, roll fleece, and participate in morning feed rounds. This hands-on activity offers a memorable opportunity to connect with farming traditions and learn valuable skills in a lively, engaging environment.

tours.name: Quiz night
tours.description: Join us for an exciting May-themed quiz night hosted by The Nest team! Test your knowledge, enjoy a lively atmosphere, and compete for fantastic prizes. Gather your friends for a memorable evening filled with fun, laughter, and friendly competition. Don't miss out on this engaging experience!

tours.name: 2 Hour - Private Snowboard Lessons
tours.description: Boost your snowboarding skills with personalized, 2-hour lessons for all levels. Enjoy ample slope time, expert guidance, and a fun, tailored experience for individuals or groups of up to 10.

tours.name: Joint Ops – Skirmish & Rental
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating day of airsoft adventure, where new and seasoned players unite for thrilling skirmishes. This unique event fosters camaraderie, allowing beginners to learn from veterans while exploring diverse airsoft gear. Join the excitement, enhance your skills, and discover why this sport captivates enthusiasts time and again!

tours.name: Frampton Farm Open Day
tours.description: Meet tutors and students at Frampton Farm's open day, explore farm life, and see what opportunities await young visitors. Wear wellies or washable shoes for a hands-on farm experience.

tours.name: Paddlesport Safety and Rescue Course
tours.description: Master rescue skills and boost safety confidence in this hands-on paddlesport course. Perfect for all paddlers, learn practical techniques to stay safe and help others on sheltered waters.

tours.name: 7-Day UK Christmas Market Tour
tours.description: Experience the magic of the holiday season on a captivating journey through the UK's most enchanting Christmas markets. From London’s Winter Wonderland to the historic charm of York, the stunning backdrop of Edinburgh Castle, and the festive atmosphere in Bath, this tour promises unforgettable sights, treats, and unique gifts.

tours.name: 2-Day "Jet Set Go!" An  Introduction to Cabin Crew Training
tours.description: Prepare for takeoff with hands-on safety drills, real aircraft scenarios, and expert interview tips—all designed to launch your cabin crew career in just two exciting days.

tours.name: Whitchurch Silk Mill Flower Festival
tours.description: Celebrate spring with stunning floral displays across three floors, a hanging garden, colorful pom-poms by kids, and charming stalls. A vibrant, family-friendly event supporting Whitchurch Silk Mill.

tours.name: Chill Out with goats! - Breathwork & Sound Bath
tours.description: Unwind with gentle breathwork alongside friendly goats, then relax in a soothing sound bath. Cuddle adorable goats afterward and capture memories before sinking into pure calmness. Perfect for all ages and levels.

tours.name: Wildlife Walks- Carew Castle
tours.description: Uncover strange and fascinating creatures at Carew Castle with Wild Science. Use special tools to explore wildlife and learn about nature’s wonders in an engaging, hands-on adventure.

tours.name: Half Term Session - Call of duty style experience
tours.description: Join a thrilling Airsoft session with fast-paced team deathmatches and capture-the-flag battles, perfect for adrenaline seekers wanting a fun, action-packed experience this half term.

tours.name: Cruise from Looe to Brixham
tours.description: Sail along Cornwall’s rugged coast, tracing the historic route of Our Daddy. Enjoy stunning sea views, a scenic voyage, and the lively Lugger festival in Looe before returning to Brixham.

tours.name: RAF Beaulieu History Walk (Part 2 of 2) – The Airfield
tours.description: Step onto a WWII airfield: walk the old runway, explore the bomb store, and uncover where RAF Regiment defended. Historian Marc Heighway shares stories of the brave men and women who served here.

tours.name: The Great Northern
tours.description: Travel behind the legendary Tornado on a scenic journey through Yorkshire and the Settle & Carlisle line, with time to explore Carlisle’s historic sites before racing along the East Coast Mainline.

tours.name: SUP 1 Hour Taster | Tonbridge
tours.description: Glide across the scenic River Medway, surrounded by vibrant wildlife and blooming wildflowers. Join expert guides for a safe, fun paddleboarding adventure perfect for families and friends in Kent’s stunning outdoors.

tours.name: SUP 2 Hour Adventure | Tonbridge
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 2-hour stand-up paddling adventure on the River Medway! Guided by expert instructors, you'll learn essential paddling techniques while enjoying a fun-filled experience with friends or new acquaintances. All equipment is provided—just bring your sense of humor and get ready for an exciting mini adventure!

tours.name: London Insta-Spots: Landmarks and Gems
tours.description: Capture London's iconic landmarks and secret spots in a private 6-hour photoshoot, creating stunning memories with a professional photographer in the heart of the city.

tours.name: Fun London Shopping Tour
tours.description: Uncover London's West End secrets on a 4-hour private tour. Shop unique boutiques, explore vintage finds, snap Insta-worthy spots, and enjoy treats—all tailored to your style in this off-the-beaten-path fashion adventure.

tours.name: The Hidden Gems Food Tour
tours.description: Embark on a delightful foodie crawl through historic York, exploring five hidden culinary gems. This 2.5 to 3-hour guided tour offers tastings of local delicacies while you stroll through one of Europe’s most charming cities. Meet passionate food artisans and savor unforgettable treats that showcase York’s vibrant food scene.

tours.name: Fabulous Chelsea and Belgravia Walk
tours.description: Uncover London's hidden fashion gems in Chelsea and Belgravia. Stroll past iconic stores, charming streets, and secret spots, enjoy a cream tea, and capture perfect photos on this personalized 3-hour tour.

tours.name: Trendy Covent Garden and Soho Walk
tours.description: Stroll through Covent Garden and Soho’s hidden alleys, shop unique boutiques, hear stories of music legends, enjoy cream tea, and snap photos at iconic spots on this personalized 4-hour London adventure.

tours.name: The Ultimate London Fashion Experience
tours.description: Uncover London's hidden fashion gems, from historic stores to trendy concept shops. Enjoy tastings, stunning architecture, and exclusive stories in a personalized 6-hour tour through the city's most stylish districts.

tours.name: Historic London: Secrets of the City
tours.description: Uncover London’s hidden secrets with a 4-hour walk along the Thames, exploring ancient sites, modern terraces, historic markets, and stunning views—an exclusive glimpse into the city’s surprising contrasts.

tours.name: Custom group
tours.description: Reserve your exclusive spot for on-beach equipment hire with up to 30 guests. Secure your group and block out others—perfect for large gatherings. Custom arrangements tailored just for you.

tours.name: Half Day Kayaking 1 -1
tours.description: Embark on an exciting 2.5-hour kayaking adventure on the stunning Llangollen Canal! This personalized one-on-one session introduces you to the essentials of kayaking, from getting in and out of your boat to enjoying the serene waters. Experience a perfect blend of fun and learning as you start your new hobby!

tours.name: Magical London Christmas Lights Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating Christmas walk through London's hidden gems, featuring dazzling decorations and enchanting illuminations. Discover secret alleyways, charming streets, and unique buildings while hearing quirky stories about the city's festive history. This unforgettable tour promises Instagrammable moments and a glimpse into the West End's best-kept secrets.

tours.name: SUP 1 Hour Taster | Bodiam
tours.description: Glide across the river on a safe, guided paddleboard adventure in stunning Sussex. Perfect for friends, family, or new acquaintances—experience the thrill in a unique, scenic setting you won’t find anywhere else.

tours.name: SUP 2 Hour Adventure | Bodiam
tours.description: Join a thrilling 2-hour stand-up paddling session with expert guides in Kent. Learn to paddle, turn, and sit comfortably on the water—fun, safe, and perfect for families or friends. All gear included!

tours.name: Kayaking 1 Hour Taster | Bodiam
tours.description: Paddle in stunning Sussex waters with expert guides in a safe, fun hour. Perfect for friends, family, or new connections—bring your wet shoes and towel for an unforgettable kayaking adventure.

tours.name: Kayaking 2 Hour Adventure | Bodiam
tours.description: Join a 2-hour kayaking adventure in stunning Sussex waters, guided by expert instructors. Learn paddling skills, spot wildlife like kingfishers, and enjoy fun, safe water exploration with all gear provided.

tours.name: On Train Drinks Order
tours.description: Pre-order your drinks for the journey—choose from refreshing soft drinks, fine wines, craft beers, or spirits. Have your favorites ready at your table, as on-board bar service isn't available that evening.

tours.name: London to Paris Day Trip with Eiffel Tower
tours.description: Travel from London to Paris in just over two hours on Eurostar, then explore iconic sights like the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, and Champs-Élysées with a guided tour. Free time to enjoy the city’s magic.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea Cruise (Windsor)
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful Afternoon Tea Cruise along the Thames, featuring a sumptuous selection of finger sandwiches, savory pastries, and exquisite desserts. Enjoy breathtaking views while savoring unique flavors, from smoked salmon to mini pavlova, making this two-hour experience a perfect blend of relaxation and culinary delight.

tours.name: Intermediate Skateboard School (Level 4)
tours.description: Boost your skate skills in a fun, inclusive 2-hour session with expert coaching. Learn tricks, safety, and skatepark etiquette while building confidence and making new friends. Perfect for all ages 6 and up.

tours.name: Pilton CC Bouldering
tours.description: Join the Barnstaple indoor bouldering sessions at Pilton Community College, where local climbers can train, socialize, and stay fit. With a diverse climbing wall featuring slabs, overhangs, and corners, this unique venue offers an exciting opportunity to challenge yourself and improve your skills in a supportive community atmosphere.

tours.name: Wild Weekend ‘North’
tours.description: Join the Wild Weekend 'North' for an unforgettable retreat filled with camping, outdoor skills, and inspiring talks. Set in the scenic Bowley Campsite, this inclusive event offers yoga, bushcraft workshops, and personal development sessions, perfect for relaxation and adventure. Connect with fellow women and embrace nature in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Wild Weekend 'South'
tours.description: Join the Wild Weekend 'South' for an unforgettable retreat filled with camping, outdoor skills, and inspiring talks. Connect with like-minded women while enjoying yoga, bushcraft, and personal development workshops. Nestled in nature at Runways End Outdoor Centre, this inclusive event promises relaxation, adventure, and new friendships. Don't miss out!

tours.name: Spring Toddlers 2026
tours.description: Join six weeks of outdoor farm adventures for toddlers, with messy play, seasonal crafts, and close-up animal encounters on a family-run farm near Jedburgh. Perfect for curious little explorers.

tours.name: LHW End2End Film Launch!
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable evening celebrating the Women's End2End relay, where 700 women journeyed across the UK, overcoming challenges and raising funds for the Woodland Trust. Experience the premiere of the inspiring relay film, enjoy outdoor-themed raffles, and honor the incredible community that made this adventure possible.

tours.name: Windsor & Stonehenge Day Trip
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 10-hour journey to Windsor Castle, the world's oldest inhabited castle, steeped in 11th-century history. Enjoy insightful presentations and stunning photo opportunities, all while being transported in a luxurious black cab. Experience regal charm and rich culture with expert guides ensuring you make the most of your visit.

tours.name: Intro to York: The Ultimate Breakfast Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on the Intro to York Breakfast Tour for a delightful morning adventure! Discover the city's historical sights at dawn while savoring hidden breakfast gems. With a local guide, enjoy a unique blend of sightseeing and culinary delights at three exceptional eateries, making your York experience truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Wild Scotland
tours.description: Embark on a unique weekend adventure in the breathtaking Knoydart, Scotland's remote gem. Accessible only by boat or foot, enjoy marine wildlife sightings, exhilarating hikes, and snorkeling. Engage in local crafts, share stories at open-mic sessions, and savor wholesome meals—all while supporting the community. Limited spaces ensure an intimate experience!

tours.name: *SOLD OUT* Santas Grotto For 1-2 Children
tours.description: Join cheerful elves on a magical trail to a private Santa visit. Share a special moment, snap free photos, and receive a gift and personalized letter—making Christmas unforgettable in just five festive minutes.

tours.name: Wildlife Events - Swansea
tours.description: Join a leisurely wildlife walk in Singleton Park, using binoculars and microphones to spot birds, listen to their songs, and explore nature up close—perfect for all ages and skill levels.

tours.name: Cotswolds, Antiques & Autumnal Colours (Shared)
tours.description: Discover the charm of the Cotswolds in autumn with historic towns, regal links, antique treasures, and stunning fall colors at Westonbirt Arboretum. A perfect blend of history, nature, and elegance.

tours.name: Enchanting Evensong at Wells Cathedral (Private)
tours.description: Attend a stunning choral Evensong at Wells Cathedral, explore the medieval city, enjoy refreshments, and end with a cozy country dinner. A soulful day blending history, music, and delicious food near Bath.

tours.name: Cider, Stories & Scrumptious Dining in a Medieval Inn (Private)
tours.description: Step into historic southwest inns, hear local tales over cider, enjoy a traditional dinner at an ancient inn, and end with a cozy nightcap. A 4.5-hour journey filled with charm, stories, and warm memories.

tours.name: Classic Inns, Curious Tales & Contemporary Dining (private)
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4.5-hour evening adventure from Bath, exploring three unique drinking venues steeped in history, from engineering marvels to hidden bunkers. Enjoy a delightful meal at a historic inn and unwind with a nightcap, all while uncovering fascinating stories that make this experience truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Christmas Lights & Festive Delights in Merry England (Private)
tours.description: Explore historic Frome’s charming streets, marvel at Longleat’s dazzling Festival of Lights, and enjoy festive shopping and a cozy meal. A magical 7-hour journey into authentic Christmas England awaits you.

tours.name: River Dee\Avon Dyfrdwy
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of the River Dee as you navigate thrilling grade 1/2 rapids. This unique adventure invites those with prior canoe experience to challenge themselves while exploring the stunning landscapes that straddle two countries. Embrace the excitement and create unforgettable memories on this epic water journey!

tours.name: Christmases of London's Past Walk
tours.description: Step into London's festive history with a guided walk past iconic landmarks, royal tales, historic shopping, and holiday traditions, ending with a joyful panto at the West End—immerse yourself in Christmas magic.

tours.name: Festive Dinner Cruise
tours.description: Enjoy a cozy 2.5-hour candlelit canal cruise with festive food, drinks, carols, and a canal lock experience. Perfect for celebrations, with vegetarian and wheelchair-friendly options. Make holiday memories afloat.

tours.name: Wine & Cheese in the Somerset Valleys
tours.description: Explore Somerset’s scenic countryside with wine tastings, cheese tours, and a gourmet lunch at The Pony Chew Valley. Visit biodynamic vineyards, Cheddar village, and enjoy a full day of delicious local flavors and stunning views.

tours.name: Flavours of the West Country
tours.description: Taste the best of Somerset with a flexible tour featuring top local producers, stunning scenery, and delicious eats. Customize your day of organic gardens, cheese, cider, and scenic drives—an authentic flavor adventure.

tours.name: Legends of Industry Gala 2026
tours.description: Step back in time with steam trains, Victorian carriages, and lively demonstrations. Perfect for families and history buffs alike, this weekend brings industrial railway heritage vividly to life.

tours.name: Signalling Experience - Parkend
tours.description: Step into the shoes of a signalman for a day, controlling railway traffic with hands-on guidance. Feel the thrill of managing two trains and mastering the signals in an immersive, full-day experience.

tours.name: Landwatch Training - Practical - Botany Bay
tours.description: Join the Kent Dolphin Project's land watch team to explore the fascinating marine mammals of the Kent Coast. Learn to identify whales, dolphins, porpoises, and seals while contributing to vital research. Enjoy hands-on guidance and the chance to observe these incredible creatures in their natural habitat. Bring your binoculars for an enhanced experience!

tours.name: 4 Day Dartmoor Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 4-day adventure that combines the rugged beauty of Dartmoor with the serene River Dart. Experience wild camping, learn essential outdoor skills, and enjoy tranquil canoeing. Connect with nature and fellow adventurers as you create unforgettable memories amidst stunning landscapes and peaceful riverside campsites.

tours.name: Discover Paris by open top bus
tours.description: Travel from London to Paris in just over 2 hours via Eurostar, then explore iconic sights like the Champs-Elysees and Eiffel Tower on an open-top bus tour. Return the same day with flexible options.

tours.name: Shared Christmas Party Cruise
tours.description: Celebrate the holidays on a beautifully decorated 3-hour Christmas cruise with festive drinks, lively music, and seasonal treats. Dance, mingle, and soak up the joyful holiday spirit on the water.

tours.name: A Delicious History of the Apple, with Sally Coulthard
tours.description: Sally Coulthard shares her passion for apples through a captivating talk, blending history, nature, and craft. Enjoy a welcome drink, engaging reading, Q&A, and a chance to get your copy signed.

tours.name: Santas Workshop - Bauble Decorating
tours.description: Experience the joy of the holiday season at our enchanting Christmas crafting session! Children will unleash their creativity as they design and decorate their own baubles using glitter, paint, and festive cheer. It's a delightful opportunity to make cherished memories and kick off the festivities in style!

tours.name: Santas Workshop - Biscuit Decorating
tours.description: Unleash your creativity this holiday season! Children can delight in decorating their own Christmas biscuits with colorful icing and festive sprinkles. This hands-on experience promises sweet treats to take home or savor immediately, making it a memorable celebration filled with joy and holiday spirit.

tours.name: Santas Workshop - Story Time with Santa
tours.description: Join Santa for a captivating Christmas storytelling session that will delight young hearts! Experience the magic as he shares enchanting tales brimming with joy, laughter, and holiday spirit, creating unforgettable memories for children and families alike. Don't miss this chance to celebrate the season with Santa's festive stories!

tours.name: Queso Y Mezcal with Brindisa
tours.description: Join Rupert Linton and Jon Darby for an evening of bold Spanish cheeses paired with rare mezcal. Savor surprising flavor combos, enjoy exclusive discounts, and indulge in a memorable tasting experience.

tours.name: Children's Painting Workshop: Dunkerstons Park
tours.description: Kids unleash their creativity in a fun, hands-on painting session at Dunkertons Park. Messy, relaxed, and inspiring—perfect for young artists to craft their masterpieces while adults relax nearby.

tours.name: Valentine's Cruise
tours.description: Sail along the Bridgewater Canal on a cozy, heated boat, savoring handmade chocolates, a glass of prosecco, and delicious lunch options. Relax, enjoy scenic views, and indulge in a romantic afternoon cruise.

tours.name: Mother's Day Cruise
tours.description: Enjoy a relaxing 2.5-hour Mother’s Day cruise along Bridgewater canal with prosecco, drinks, and delicious lunch. Savor scenic views, warm comfort, and special treats in a cozy, fully heated boat.

tours.name: Whitewater Rescue Technician - Professional
tours.description: Master life-saving skills with hands-on whitewater rescue training in North Wales. Tackle real scenarios, learn rope systems, and earn your Rescue 3 WRT-Pro certification—prepare for any river emergency.

tours.name: Saturday brewhouse and pub visit
tours.description: Step into history with a 2-hour guided tour of Palmers Brewery, dating back to 1794. See traditional brewing, then enjoy tastings at The Crown Inn in a scenic riverside setting.

tours.name: Weave a Wall Hanging - HOBBYCRAFT Salisbury
tours.description: Create your own wall hanging with expert guidance on a Louet tabletop loom. Perfect for beginners, enjoy hands-on tips, explore textures, and leave with a unique piece you made yourself.

tours.name: Wildlife Events - Gower
tours.description: Explore Swansea’s rivers with nets in hand, discovering fascinating creatures like dragonfly nymphs and stonefly larvae. Learn how rivers support local wildlife in this fun, hands-on adventure.

tours.name: BLOOD, BONE & BRINE
tours.company: Blackbeard to Banksy the Ultimate Bristol Walking Tour
tours.description: A sharp slice of Bristols darker and lesser-told history

tours.name: Santa Express 2026
tours.description: Ride the Santa Express through the Durham Dales, filled with festive music, laughter, and dazzling decorations. Meet Santa onboard for a joyful, magical family adventure full of holiday wonder and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Amazing Albania
tours.description: Explore Albania’s stunning landscapes, from Tirana’s vibrant city life and mountain views to the waterfalls of Theth and historic castles of Kruja. Five days of adventure, culture, and breathtaking scenery await.

tours.name: Trek Hybrid [not electric] Bike Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure with a day hire of a Trek Hybrid bike. Perfect for exploring scenic routes, this bike offers a smooth ride and versatility for both on-road and off-road journeys. Discover new landscapes and create unforgettable memories as you pedal through nature's beauty.

tours.name: Dads and kids day (children aged 5 and over)
tours.description: Enjoy a fun-filled day in ancient woodland with your kids, featuring missile sports, campfires, canoeing, laser tag, and team games. Bring your own food, dress for adventure, and create unforgettable family memories.

tours.name: Private 1:2 Surfing Lesson
tours.description: Experience personalized instruction in a private 1:2 lesson tailored to any skill level. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your expertise, this unique opportunity ensures focused attention and a customized approach, making your learning journey both exciting and memorable.

tours.name: Airsoft
tours.description: Join a full-day airsoft adventure with exclusive access to fields, facilities, and hot food. Play with your own gear, enjoy full auto or semi-fire, and experience adrenaline in a safe, insured UKARA-registered site.

tours.name: Gift Card
tours.description: Give the gift of adventure with a customizable gift card! Choose from thrilling one-hour land activities or refreshing water taster sessions, perfect for anyone seeking excitement. This unique gift offers unforgettable experiences tailored to individual preferences, making it a memorable present for friends and family.

tours.name: Quiz with Tea & Biscuits
tours.description: Join us for a delightful afternoon quiz featuring tea and biscuits during the break. Whether you come with friends or solo, you’ll have the chance to form new connections. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, accommodating seating, and friendly volunteers, making this a memorable experience for everyone.

tours.name: Beginners Skateboard School (Level 1)
tours.description: Learn skateboarding basics in a friendly, supportive environment. Build confidence, master safety, and express yourself while enjoying weekly sessions with expert guidance and community spirit.

tours.name: South Lakes Adventure
tours.description: Tackle thrilling rapids on England’s scenic rivers in the Lake District. About 2 hours on water, with safety gear, guides, and fun for ages 10+. Perfect for adventure seekers craving wild water and stunning views.

tours.name: Paddleboard Progression Course (Intermediate to confident)
tours.description: Boost your paddleboarding skills with our advanced course. Learn to paddle efficiently, stay stable in wind, turn smoothly, and paddle faster—transform into a confident paddler in just two sessions.

tours.name: Social Paddle & Cocktail
tours.description: Experience a serene evening on the River Medway with a social paddle, perfect for all skill levels. Enjoy an EpicLife cocktail while relaxing on your board as the sun sets, creating unforgettable memories with like-minded paddlers. This unique midweek escape combines adventure and relaxation in one delightful package.

tours.name: Archery in Peebles
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery in a safe and fun environment! Perfect for ages 8 and up, this 1.5-hour session invites you to shoot arrows and develop your skills. Just bring waterproofs and a long-sleeved top for an unforgettable adventure in precision and focus.

tours.name: Meeting Room Facility
tours.description: Host your next big idea in a professional meeting room designed for productivity and comfort, perfect for team discussions, presentations, or brainstorming sessions.

tours.name: Canoe Hire
tours.description: Call to arrange your hire

tours.name: Mexican Street Food @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Mexican street food in 2 hours: make fresh tortillas, smoky chipotle chicken, vibrant salsas, and guacamole. Cook, eat, and impress your friends with your homemade feast. All ingredients included.

tours.name: A North Indian Thali @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Learn to make a vibrant vegan Indian thali in 2 hours. Master spices, cook flavorful dishes like chickpea masala, daal, and crispy okra, then enjoy your homemade feast at the chef’s table with all ingredients and recipes provided.

tours.name: We Love Fish @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Master fish prep and filleting in just 3 hours, then cook and enjoy up to three delicious dishes like goujons, sea bream, and stuffed sea bass. Hands-on lessons, expert demos, and a chef’s table experience await.

tours.name: Ultimate knife skills masterclass @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Master knife skills in 5 hours by learning to buy, sharpen, and maintain knives. Deconstruct a chicken, create tasty dishes like saltimbocca and teriyaki, prep fish, and enjoy a chef’s table feast with recipes to recreate at home.

tours.name: The complete guide to pasta @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Master the art of pasta in 5 hours: make four shapes, craft ravioli, cannelloni, and sauces from scratch. Enjoy your creations at the chef’s table with a glass of bubbles. All ingredients and tools provided—just bring your appetite.

tours.name: Kids learn for free: Pasta master @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create fresh pasta from scratch, shape it into three styles, and cook a flavorful tomato sauce. Enjoy your homemade meal with your child at the chef’s table, learning easy techniques in just 1.5 hours.

tours.name: Waiting List
tours.description: Join our waiting list for an exclusive opportunity! Secure your spot by selecting a date, and be among the first to know when a space opens up. With a first-come, first-served policy, your prompt action could lead to an exciting experience. Don’t miss out on this chance!

tours.name: Newent Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1.5-hour walking tour through Newent, where history and ghostly tales intertwine. Explore ancient sites like the Old Jail and Tudor Fish & Chip Shop, while uncovering stories of monks and spectral residents. Discover the town's rich past and eerie legends in this unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Rock and Rapid Youth Club and Squad Event
tours.description: Discover an unforgettable experience tailored just for you! Dive into the details provided in your email and prepare for an engaging event that promises excitement and memorable moments. Don't miss out on this unique opportunity to connect and create lasting memories.

tours.name: Waitlist: London Eid Cruise 2023
tours.description: Waitlist Only: For May 1, 2023

tours.name: The Curry Club
tours.description: Create authentic Indian curries from scratch in a fun 3-hour class. Blend spices, cook dishes like butter chicken and prawns, then enjoy your meal. Perfect for foodies seeking a lively, hands-on night out.

tours.name: Couples Cooking
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable evening of culinary creativity with a hands-on cooking class! Collaborate on a seasonal main course and delightful dessert, all while enjoying each other's company. With no cleanup required, focus on the fun and flavors. Perfect for couples, friends, or family—just bring your appetite and adventurous spirit!

tours.name: Introduction to proper pizza with Gozney
tours.description: Create authentic Neapolitan-style pizza from scratch in just 3 hours. Learn to make perfect dough, fresh toppings, and passata, then cook in a pizza oven while enjoying prosecco. No washing up, all ingredients included.

tours.name: Tryweryn Kayakers
tours.description: Tackle thrilling white water rapids with expert guidance, pushing your skills to the limit. Perfect for seasoned paddlers craving adrenaline and adventure on challenging rivers.

tours.name: Archery and Axe Throwing
tours.description: Age 7+ • 2h • Test your skills

tours.name: Bushcraft Skills Workshop
tours.description: Experience an engaging 2-hour bushcraft session designed for families and groups, where you'll learn essential survival skills in a dedicated outdoor classroom. Build your own shelter, master fire-lighting techniques, and enjoy brewing bush tea and roasting marshmallows. This hands-on adventure promises unforgettable memories and valuable skills for all ages.

tours.name: Sunset Evening Sail - Blackwater Estuary | Maldon
tours.description: Sail on a vintage barge at sunset, passing Osea and Northey Islands, with stunning estuary views, historic photos below deck, and optional seafood or drinks—perfect for a peaceful, scenic escape.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea & Prosecco Sail - Blackwater Estuary | Maldon
tours.description: Sail on a vintage barge past islands, bird sanctuaries, and colorful beaches, soaking in peaceful estuary views. Relax with a drink, explore historic decks, and enjoy the gentle sun—perfect for a tranquil escape.

tours.name: Nostalgic Steam Train Experience & Enchanting Glass Dome Museum with Afternoon Tea | Bucks Rail Centre
tours.description: Climb aboard a vintage Buckinghamshire steam train, run by passionate enthusiasts. Feel the nostalgia and charm of historic rail travel on this 6.5-hour heritage journey through scenic landscapes.

tours.name: 3 Hour Cowes Trip
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating RIB boat trip through the breathtaking eastern Solent, featuring iconic sights like the Solent Forts and Ryde Pier. Enjoy a 75-minute exploration of charming Cowes Old Town, where you can soak in the local culture. This adventure combines scenic beauty, history, and high-speed thrills for an unforgettable day.

tours.name: Majesty in Motion: Exploring Westminster's Royal Legacy
tours.description: Experience the grandeur of British royalty on "The Royal Tour of Westminster." This captivating 2.5-hour journey takes you from Trafalgar Square to Buckingham Palace, where you’ll witness the iconic Changing of the Guard. Explore Westminster Abbey and the Houses of Parliament, enriched by fascinating stories from your knowledgeable guide.

tours.name: Urban Canvas: Exploring Shoreditch's Vibrant Street Art
tours.description: Discover the vibrant world of street art in London's East End on this immersive 2.5-hour tour. Explore stunning murals, learn from renowned artists, and unleash your own creativity in hidden alleys. This unique experience celebrates self-expression and the dynamic subculture of urban art, making it an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Hidden Gems Tour of the City of London
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour journey through London's oldest section, where ancient Roman ruins meet iconic landmarks like the Tower of London and St. Paul's Cathedral. Discover hidden gems and architectural marvels, each revealing a unique story in the city's rich history. Experience an unforgettable expedition through time!

tours.name: Hour Morning  Cruise
tours.description: Sail along Whitby’s scenic coast, soaking in historic harbor views and iconic landmarks. Relax on calm waters, enjoy panoramic scenery, and create unforgettable memories—perfect for solo explorers or family adventures.

tours.name: Sea Kayak Safety & Rescue Award
tours.description: Learn essential sea kayak safety and rescue skills in real conditions. Practice self-rescues, towing, and first aid to stay safe on the water. Be prepared for hazards with hands-on training in sheltered and moderate seas.

tours.name: St Johns May Ball Fireworks - Private Boat - Tuesday 23 June
tours.description: Celebrate with a stunning fireworks display on the river, surrounded by a lively flotilla of punts. Arrive early, bring your own drinks, and enjoy a vibrant, memorable night at one of the world's top party spots.

tours.name: Couples Cooking Curry Night
tours.description: Join a fun couples’ evening to craft authentic Indian curries from scratch, taste your creations, and learn flavor secrets. No fuss, just fresh ingredients, great company, and a delicious night out.

tours.name: Kayak 1 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating hour on the water at Maylandsea River Blackwater! Enjoy the thrill of kayaking with complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases. Plus, a support RIB is on standby for added safety, ensuring a memorable adventure as you explore the scenic waterways.

tours.name: Kayak 2 Hour Hire
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 2-hour adventure on the Maylandsea River Blackwater. Enjoy the thrill of exploring the waters with complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases, ensuring your safety and convenience. Plus, a support RIB is on standby for added peace of mind, making this a memorable outing for all.

tours.name: Kayak 3 Hour Hire
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 3-hour adventure along the stunning Maylandsea River Blackwater. Enjoy the thrill of exploring the waters with complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases, ensuring a safe and memorable experience. Plus, a support RIB is on standby for added peace of mind during your journey.

tours.name: Kayak 4 Hour Hire
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 4-hour adventure from Maylandsea River Blackwater, where you can explore the waters with complimentary life jackets and waterproof phone cases. Enjoy peace of mind with a support RIB on standby, ensuring a safe and unforgettable experience as you navigate the beautiful surroundings.

tours.name: Kayak 1-2 Day Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable kayaking adventure across the UK with our Standard, Fast, and Fishing Kayaks. Enjoy the freedom to explore stunning waterways at your own pace, while ensuring safety with available life jackets and gear. Experience the thrill of paddling through diverse landscapes for 1 to 2 days of excitement!

tours.name: Kayak 3-4 Day Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 3 to 4-day kayaking adventure across the UK! Choose from standard, fast, or fishing kayaks, all available for pick-up. Enhance your experience with life jackets, phone cases, and dry bags, ensuring a safe and enjoyable journey on the water. Explore at your own pace!

tours.name: Kayak 5-6 Day Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5 to 6-day kayaking adventure across the UK! Choose from standard, fast, or fishing kayaks, and explore stunning waterways at your own pace. With essential gear like life jackets and dry bags available, you're set for a memorable outdoor experience.

tours.name: Kayak 7-8 Day Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 7 to 8-day kayaking adventure across the UK! Choose from standard, fast, or fishing kayaks, all available for pick-up. Enhance your experience with life jackets, phone cases, and dry bags, ensuring safety and convenience as you explore stunning waterways at your own pace.

tours.name: Benwell Kitchen Lunch Menu
tours.description: Secure your spot daily before 10:30, pay easily with Apple or Google Pay, and plan your week's lunches in advance—flexible, convenient, and tailored to your schedule.

tours.name: NICAS Level 1 Taster Session
tours.description: Experience an exciting free taster session at our Youth Club, where you'll learn climbing skills and meet other adventurous kids. Discover the fun and camaraderie that awaits you before deciding to join our vibrant community. Don’t miss this chance to explore new heights and make lasting friendships!

tours.name: Climbing Adventure Day - Bath area
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating day of climbing and abseiling with two expert instructors in the stunning quarries near Bath. Enjoy personalized guidance as you tackle the challenges of the rock face, with transportation provided for a seamless adventure. Discover the thrill of outdoor climbing in a breathtaking setting!

tours.name: Come Trod Ghana with Us!
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Ghana, exploring its rich culture, history, and stunning landscapes. From the cocoa farms and lush botanical gardens to historic sites like Cape Coast Castle and vibrant markets, each day offers unique experiences that connect you deeply with the heart and soul of this captivating country.

tours.name: Farms, Forests & Falls A Journey Through Ghana's  Eastern Region
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Ghana's Eastern Region, exploring the birthplace of cocoa at Tetteh Quarshie Farm, wandering the lush Aburi Botanical Gardens, and hiking to the breathtaking Umbrella Rock. Conclude with the enchanting Boti Waterfalls, where folklore and nature intertwine in a stunning display of beauty.

tours.name: Heritage and Hustle: The Heart of Accra
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Ghana's vibrant culture and history. Explore the historic Osu Castle, stand at the iconic Independence Square, and immerse yourself in the artistic treasures of the Accra Arts Centre. Conclude your adventure at the bustling Makola Market, where local flavors and lively energy await.

tours.name: Kingdom of the Ashanti: A Journey Through Royal History and Living Culture
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2-day journey through Ghana's Ashanti region, where you'll explore Kente weaving, adinkra crafts, and the historic Manhyia Palace. Engage in a traditional naming ceremony with a local king, visit vibrant markets, and create your own art piece, all while savoring authentic Ashanti cuisine.

tours.name: Tall Ships Races: Leg 3 Aberdeen to Kristiansand
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 12-day adventure with Excelsior during the Tall Ships Races, where you'll race alongside stunning tall ships while exploring the beautiful coasts of Denmark and Norway. Experience camaraderie, participate in festive events, and enjoy hands-on sailing aboard a historic vessel, all while forming lasting bonds with fellow crew members.

tours.name: Beers in the Brewery
tours.description: Join us for a memorable evening at Hilden Brewery, featuring live music, delicious pies, and a variety of beers in our cozy, heated Nordic tipis. Experience the charm of our Georgian Courtyard while enjoying a unique culinary twist with steak and vegan pies, all set against the backdrop of great tunes.

tours.name: A Flying Visit To Spain @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Join a lively 2-hour Spanish cooking class to master paella, fiery patatas bravas, and red-wine baked chorizo. Cook, eat, and share vibrant flavors with fellow food lovers in a fun, hands-on feast.
