tours.name: Bread baking: Knead to Know @ Oxford Street
tours.description: Bake three stunning breads, including a stuffed loaf, in this hands-on 3-hour class. Learn kneading, shaping, and baking skills, then enjoy your creations with a gourmet BLT and fresh drinks. All equipment included.

tours.name: Scotland Classics
tours.description: Boost your kayaking skills on thrilling rivers in the Highlands, from confident beginner to adrenaline-fueled expert. Five days of classic Class 4+ rapids, cozy accommodations, and stunning river scenery await.

tours.name: Epic Life SUP Club Membership
tours.description: Join the Epic Life SUP Club to improve your paddleboarding skills, boost fitness, and enjoy year-round adventures on rivers, coastlines, and surf spots with expert coaching and a friendly community.

tours.name: Hay-On-Wye to Hereford (2 Days)
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic River Wye on a two-day canoe or kayak adventure from Hay-on-Wye to Hereford. Enjoy stunning views, wildlife, and peaceful stops at riverside campsites. Experience the thrill of gliding through gentle rapids, then unwind in charming towns with great food, drinks, and local charm.

tours.name: Abbamagic UK
tours.description: Join Abbamagic UK for an unforgettable afternoon filled with the iconic songs of Abba. Experience the joy of singing and dancing along to timeless hits in a vibrant atmosphere, making memories that will last a lifetime. Don’t miss this chance to celebrate the magic of Abba with fellow fans!

tours.name: White Water SUP Fest Scotland 2026
tours.description: Join WWSUP Fest 2026 in Scotland’s stunning rivers for thrilling races, expert workshops, lively music, and a traditional ceilidh. Camp by the Tay and Tummel, connect with paddlers, and enjoy an epic white water adventure.

tours.name: Land watch training course - Brighton Marina
tours.description: Join the Sussex Dolphin Project for an engaging 2-hour session where you'll learn to identify marine mammals along the stunning Sussex coast. Meet dedicated researchers, gain hands-on experience in land watching, and deepen your understanding of local dolphin and seal populations. Bring your binoculars and immerse yourself in marine conservation!

tours.name: Winter Toddlers 2025
tours.description: Join our Farm Toddlers sessions for children aged 12 months and up, where outdoor exploration meets hands-on fun! Each week features seasonal themes, crafts, and close encounters with farm animals. Experience the joy of messy play in a safe environment, all while creating lasting memories with your little ones.

tours.name: Bonfire Night BBQ Cruise
tours.description: Enjoy a 3-hour scenic cruise along the Jurassic Coast at sunset, topped with spectacular fireworks, live music, and a tasty BBQ. Relax on deck with drinks, great views, and festive cheer for all ages.

tours.name: Haunted Harbour Cruise
tours.description: Set sail on a 2.5-hour haunted boat adventure with spooky stories, face painting, and creepy snacks. Enjoy Jurassic Coast views, costume fun, and surprises for the whole family during Weymouth’s Zombie Week.

tours.name: Heritage Open Day Tours
tours.description: Uncover the rich history of Ampleforth Abbey and College, home to the famous “Mouseman” furniture and Sir Giles Gilbert Scott’s stunning architecture. Explore heritage, craftsmanship, and a peaceful monastic community since 1802.

tours.name: Paint and Pizza Night: Cattivo, Cirencester
tours.description: Join us for Paint & Pizza Nights, where creativity meets deliciousness! Enjoy a fun evening with friends as our art-coach guides you through creating your own unique masterpiece. With all materials provided and a trio of desserts included, it's the perfect blend of art, laughter, and tasty pizza!

tours.name: Weave a Wall Hanging 17 June 2026
tours.description: Create your own wall hanging on a tabletop loom with expert guidance. Explore patterns and textures in a friendly group, then take home your handmade masterpiece—perfect for beginners eager to try weaving.

tours.name: River Spey Canoe Expedition
tours.description: Paddle through Scotland’s stunning landscapes on the River Spey, navigating rapids, forests, and open valleys. Camp under the stars, learn river skills, and end your journey at the sea in a true adventure from source to sea.

tours.name: River Wye Canoe & Camp Weekend
tours.description: Paddle through lush Wye Valley, glide past woodlands and meadows, then camp under the stars. Relaxed, scenic, and perfect for all levels—this weekend adventure combines gentle flows, outdoor vibes, and memorable wild camping.

tours.name: Paint and Sip Night: Rose & Crown, Redmarley
tours.description: Unleash your creativity at our Paint & Sip Night, where friends gather to sip, laugh, and paint together. No experience needed—just follow our art-coach and create your own winter masterpiece in a fun, relaxed setting.

tours.name: Paint and Pizza Night: Cattivo, Cirencester
tours.description: Unleash your creativity with a guided paint and pizza night—no experience needed. Enjoy delicious pizza, learn new art skills, and create your own masterpiece in a fun, relaxed atmosphere.

tours.name: Creative Afternoons: Sip, Stitch & Crochet
tours.description: Create cozy memories with a beginner-friendly crochet workshop. Learn to make classic granny squares, enjoy tea and good company, and take home your handmade masterpiece in a relaxed, welcoming setting.

tours.name: Beer Tasting with Snack Pairings
tours.description: Sip your way through ten diverse beers, from crisp lagers to rich stouts, expertly paired with British cheeses and crisps. Emma Moore’s lively guidance reveals the secrets behind perfect beer pairings and Yorkshire’s brewing pride.

tours.name: Monthly Wine Club
tours.description: Sip six premium wines with a friendly expert at York Distillery. Explore surprising pairings, learn tasting tips, and enjoy a relaxed, fun evening connecting with fellow wine lovers—no experience needed.

tours.name: Team Building
tours.description: Boost team spirit with tailored outdoor challenges in the Lake District, from ghyll scrambling to mountain climbs. Fun, safe, and adaptable for all ages and fitness levels—perfect for building bonds and conquering fears.

tours.name: Pottery Painting and Pizza Evening at Cattivo, Cirencester
tours.description: Unleash your creativity with a guided pottery painting night at Cattivo Pizza. Decorate a ceramic, enjoy a 12" pizza, and celebrate love with heart-shaped boxes—no experience needed, just fun and friends.

tours.name: Alice in Wonderland Storytime
tours.description: Join Alice from Tiny T’s Theatre for a magical storytime, meet her for photos, then enjoy coloring in the tearoom. Perfect for kids, with space for one adult per child to explore and relax.

tours.name: Port to Port with Ashley Smith
tours.description: Join Master Blender Ashley Smith to explore Campbeltown’s trading history, uncovering how maritime casks like Sherry, Rum, and Port shape Glen Scotia’s unique whisky style rooted in tradition.

tours.name: Pottery Painting and Pizza Evening at Cattivo, Cirencester
tours.description: Unleash your creativity with a ceramic painting night at Cattivo Pizza. Enjoy a 12" pizza, guided by an art-coach, and craft a unique piece—perfect for friends and fun, no experience needed.

tours.name: Dunnage Warehouse Tasting with Ashley Smith
tours.description: Uncover Glen Scotia’s rich flavors with Master Blender Ashley Smith in our historic Dunnage Warehouse. Taste exclusive casks and experience the essence of this renowned distillery in an intimate, memorable setting.

tours.name: Deconstructed Festival Release with Gary Mills
tours.description: Sip on award-winning Glen Scotia, rich Ruby Port, and the exclusive 2026 Festival Release as Gary Mills reveals the secrets behind this special whisky collection.

tours.name: Big Campbeltown Character with Michael Henry
tours.description: Uncover Glen Scotia’s signature spirit with a guided tasting of our 12 and 25 Year Old whiskies. Savor tropical fruit, coastal spray, and a rich, oily texture that defines our Big Campbeltown Character.

tours.name: Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Campbeltown’s whisky history with a distillery expert, wandering through historic harbors, vanished distilleries, and trading routes that shaped its legendary spirit-making legacy.

tours.name: Social Paddle - Bodiam
tours.description: Glide gently along the River Rother and Medway, guided by expert instructors. Perfect for all levels, this 1.5-hour paddle offers a relaxing, social water adventure in scenic Kent.

tours.name: Creative Patching Workshop
tours.description: Learn to mend holes in your clothes with easy, step-by-step techniques. Use provided tools and fabrics to repair, decorate, and breathe new life into your favorite garments in a fun, eco-friendly workshop.

tours.name: The Gruffalo's Child Storytime
tours.description: Join our lively story time as the Gruffalo's child sneaks out on a woodland adventure, meets the Gruffalo and fairy, then enjoys coloring fun—an interactive experience for kids and a magical photo opportunity.

tours.name: Sunrise Row
tours.description: Watch the sunrise on an exclusive date, where the sky awakens in vibrant colors. Feel the cool morning air and enjoy a peaceful moment as the world begins anew.

tours.name: Willow Leaf Basket Weaving
tours.description: Create your own unique willow leaf basket in a relaxing, hands-on workshop. Guided by expert basket makers, enjoy rhythmic weaving, explore natural colors, and leave with a beautiful, practical piece for your home.

tours.name: Raft Building
tours.description: Build a sturdy raft with your team using wood, barrels, and ropes, then navigate a lake course. Plan, design, lash, and test your creation—expect laughs, teamwork, and a splashy adventure in stunning surroundings.

tours.name: Canadian Canoeing
tours.description: Paddle across lakes and rivers in open Canadian canoes, packed with gear or sails, and enjoy a fun, outdoor adventure. Perfect for all ages, with expert guidance and memorable moments on the water.

tours.name: Rafted Canoeing Orientering
tours.description: Navigate rushing waters on a 3-hour rafted canoeing adventure suitable for ages 7 and up. Feel the thrill of the river, steer your way through scenic landscapes, and create unforgettable memories on this exciting journey.

tours.name: Aquaseiling
tours.description: Slide down waterfalls in the Lake District with guided aquaseiling, feeling the rush as you control your descent. All gear provided—just bring your shoes and swimsuit for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Chippenham Tree Climb & Zipwire Event
tours.description: Experience the thrill of tree climbing and soaring down a 50m zip-wire at the Chippenham Tree Climb Event! Suitable for ages 7 to 85, join one of three 90-minute sessions in the scenic Monkton Park. Enjoy an unforgettable adventure along the river, making memories in nature.

tours.name: Home Educator Session - Roundwood
tours.description: Join thrilling activities like laser tag, archery, axe throwing, crate stacking, and Jacobs Ladder in Roundwood—adventure awaits with fun challenges for all! Adults must stay; no other children allowed.

tours.name: Murder Mystery
tours.description: Join a thrilling murder mystery train ride with a delicious two-course meal, solving crimes from Sherlock Nolmes to Blackbeard. Unravel secrets, enjoy scenic steam journeys, and immerse yourself in captivating stories.

tours.name: Paddleboard Progression Course (Beginner to Intermediate)
tours.description: Boost your paddleboarding skills in a full-day course. Learn to paddle efficiently, turn confidently, master safety rescues, and plan trips—all on scenic waters with expert guidance.

tours.name: EFAW+F NORTHUMBERLAND
tours.description: Join our comprehensive 7-hour Emergency First Aid at Work course tailored for forestry professionals. Gain essential skills in managing severe injuries, hypothermia, and emergency situations without mobile signal. With expert guidance and practical training, you'll be equipped to handle real-life challenges in your unique working environment, ensuring safety in the field.

tours.name: Adult only Climbing at The Tower
tours.description: Join an exciting adult-only climbing club where local climbers connect, enhance their skills, and enjoy a fun, active lifestyle. With sessions for all experience levels and a 7.5-meter wall featuring over 25 routes, it's the perfect place to challenge yourself and meet new friends.

tours.name: Navigation Skills & Training
tours.description: Embark on an exciting journey to become a skilled navigator in the stunning Exmoor National Park. This hands-on course covers essential topics like route planning, map reading, and emergency procedures, all tailored to your pace. Experience the thrill of outdoor adventure while enhancing your navigation skills in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Good Friday Family Sing a Long
tours.description: Join a lively Frozen 2 sing-along, dress up, and enjoy an Easter egg hunt in a welcoming, accessible setting with free parking and accommodations for all needs.

tours.name: Folk featuring international folk singers
tours.description: Enjoy a lively Celtic musical journey with harmonies, 16 instruments, and traditional Fish n Chips. Accessible, friendly, and perfect for a relaxing afternoon of folk melodies.

tours.name: One-to-one Surf Lesson
tours.description: Experience personalized one-to-one surf coaching designed to enhance your skills and confidence on the water. With dedicated attention from an expert instructor, you'll learn at your own pace, starting with beach basics before hitting the waves. Perfect for all levels, this session guarantees you'll be riding by the end!

tours.name: Navigation and Hill Walking
tours.description: Escape into the countryside with walks for all levels, from gentle strolls to challenging mountain peaks. Enjoy scenic routes, cozy cafes, and epic summits guided by experts—perfect for adventure seekers of every ability.

tours.name: Illuminations Tours
tours.description: Experience the magic of Blackpool's Illuminations aboard an iconic Heritage tram! Choose between the illuminated HMS Blackpool or the vintage 1930s Balloon tram for stunning views. Journey along the Promenade, soaking in the vibrant lights and sights, with the option to disembark at key stops. A memorable ride awaits!

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (London)
tours.description: Join Dennis and friends on a thrilling adventure through London to find the mischievous Gnasher! This interactive walking game combines puzzles, clues, and comic characters, allowing you to explore iconic locations at your own pace. Perfect for families, it promises fun and excitement without a time limit.

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (Dundee)
tours.description: Embark on an exciting 90-minute adventure through Dundee as you help Dennis and his friends find the mischievous Gnasher! Solve puzzles, follow clues, and enjoy a leisurely walk with no time limit. This interactive outdoor game, featuring beloved Beano characters, promises fun for families and friends alike.

tours.name: THE CRITERION ALLSTARS
tours.description: Join the Criterion Allstars and groove to hits with special guest Karl Green of Hermans Hermits—an unforgettable night of live music, nostalgia, and pure energy you won't want to miss.

tours.name: BSUPA Ready to Ride SUP
tours.description: Join the BSUPA Level 1 “Ready to Ride” course for an exhilarating 2-hour introduction to stand-up paddleboarding! Perfect for beginners, you'll learn essential skills like paddling techniques and safe falling. Enjoy a fun, hands-on experience in flat water, and earn your certification while getting wet and having a blast!

tours.name: One Hour Bay Rental
tours.description: Experience the future of golf with Golf365's Virtual Golf 2 by TrackMan! Enjoy a revolutionary one-hour session filled with stunning graphics and innovative features. Whether you're training, playing casually, or hosting friendly tournaments, this immersive experience guarantees fun and engagement for players of all skill levels.

tours.name: Santa Special
tours.description: Embark on a magical 75-minute steam train journey through the stunning South Wales countryside, where Santa awaits! Enjoy nostalgic 1950s carriages, receive a special gift for children under 12, and capture unforgettable moments with Santa. Experience the warmth of the season at our charming vintage station.

tours.name: Fabulous 50's
tours.description: Step back into the swinging 50s with lively music, dazzling costumes, and nostalgic fun that will make you feel like you're part of the era’s biggest hits and brightest moments.

tours.name: 45-minute City Walking Tours
tours.description: Experience the charm of historic Canterbury on a fully-guided walking tour that showcases iconic sights like the Old Buttermarket, Cathedral Gate, and Canterbury Castle. Tailored to your interests, this 45-minute adventure promises an entertaining and informative exploration of the city's rich heritage and stunning architecture.

tours.name: 90-minute City Walking Tours
tours.description: Experience the charm of historic Canterbury on a fully-guided walking tour that showcases iconic sights like the Old Buttermarket, Cathedral Gate, and Canterbury Castle. Tailored to your interests, this 90-minute adventure promises an entertaining and informative exploration of the city's rich heritage and stunning architecture.

tours.name: Private Group Paddleboarding - Saul Junction
tours.description: Enjoy a private paddleboarding adventure with scenic waterways, fun challenges, and expert guides. Perfect for all skill levels, it’s a memorable mix of relaxation and excitement tailored just for your group.

tours.name: Alpaca Picnic
tours.description: Relax among gentle alpacas on a rustic farm, feed and bond with them, then enjoy a peaceful picnic outdoors or indoors—perfect for unwinding and reconnecting in nature.

tours.name: Chocolate & Wine Pairing
tours.description: Taste three craft chocolates paired with wines from around the world, uncover your palate, and hear stories from the bean-to-bar process in this engaging chocolate and wine pairing event.

tours.name: An Afternoon with The Swingtime Sweethearts
tours.description: Enjoy a heartfelt tribute as Swingtime Sweethearts, the UK's top wartime duo, fill the Criterion with nostalgic melodies, honoring Remembrance Day in a moving, unforgettable performance.

tours.name: Queens Platinum Jubilee Paddle & Picnic
tours.description: Celebrate the Queen's Platinum Jubilee with a unique 1.5-hour paddle around Tonbridge, followed by a delightful picnic in the park. Gather your friends and family for a memorable day of relaxation and socializing, making this a perfect opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and commemorate a special occasion together.

tours.name: Tweed Valley - big day out
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking 5-hour guided ride through the hills, featuring scenic trails and the option for thrilling singletrack. Enjoy a leisurely picnic at a stunning lunch spot while leaving navigation stress behind. Perfect for all skill levels, this adventure promises unforgettable views and a memorable outdoor experience.

tours.name: Tweed Valley - enduro explore
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking trails of the Tweed Valley with a personalized 5-hour ride led by a local expert. Tailored to your riding style, this adventure promises unique landscapes and thrilling paths, making it an unforgettable journey for mountain biking enthusiasts. Bring your own food, hydration, and safety gear for an exhilarating day.

tours.name: Dracula at Portchester Castle
tours.description: This legendary tale returns as an immersive experience deep within the Castle's walls.

tours.name: archery 1 hour taster
tours.description: Try your hand at archery in a fun, one-hour beginner session perfect for families. Feel the thrill as you aim and shoot, building confidence and enjoying a memorable outdoor activity during summer holidays.

tours.name: Rifle Shooting 1 hour taster
tours.description: Try rifle shooting in a fun, one-hour session perfect for families and beginners. Feel the thrill as you aim and fire, building confidence in a safe, friendly environment during summer holidays.

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (Ipswich)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 90-minute adventure through Ipswich to help Dennis find his mischievous dog, Gnasher! Solve fun puzzles and challenges with your family while exploring the city. With no time limit, enjoy a leisurely walk filled with excitement, laughter, and comic characters guiding your journey.

tours.name: A Day with a Perfumer
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of fragrance in London with a Master Perfumer. Over 6.5 hours, explore perfume history, enjoy a delightful 3-course lunch, and create your own signature scent to take home. This unique experience combines artistry, expertise, and personal expression in a captivating group setting.

tours.name: First Class Diesel Train Ride
tours.description: Travel in style on a luxurious First Class Hawksworth Saloon, riding behind a diesel locomotive through scenic Dean Forest. Limited seats—book early for a memorable, comfortable journey with optional treats.

tours.name: Basics Skateboard School (Level 2)
tours.description: Join a fun, one-hour weekly skate lesson with expert Albert, perfect for beginners aged 6+. Learn tricks, safety, and skatepark manners while expressing yourself in a supportive, inclusive environment.

tours.name: Outward bounds Trips/ Expeditions
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure with activities like kayaking, mountain climbing, and high ropes. Push your limits, embrace nature, and create memories that last a lifetime. Ready for your ultimate trip?

tours.name: Thoulstone Park Activity Session
tours.description: Join us at Thoulstone Park for thrilling outdoor activities perfect for ages 6 and up! Experience the adrenaline of a high ropes course and the fun of kayaking. Parents or carers must accompany participants, ensuring a memorable day filled with adventure and excitement for everyone. Come prepared for an unforgettable experience!

tours.name: Sunset Fat Biking - timed to suit sunset!
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking sunsets of Islay while riding 5 miles along the stunning Big Strand beach on a Fat Bike. These unique bikes effortlessly glide over sand and pebbles, making your adventure both thrilling and accessible. Enjoy wildlife spotting, historical exploration, and a delicious flapjack with a hot drink along the way.

tours.name: Dairy Farm Tour
tours.description: Experience the charm of farm life at Covington with a unique opportunity to meet the Baillie family and their cows. Participate in milking and feeding friendly calves while learning about the journey of milk from cow to bottle. This hands-on adventure is perfect for all ages and promises unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Surfboard Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with our premium board rentals at Cornish Adventure HQ. Choose from a variety of sizes, complete with leashes and fresh wax. Our expert staff will ensure you find the perfect fit, making your surfing adventure unforgettable. Hit the waves and embrace the dream!

tours.name: Wetsuit Hire: Full Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure with a high-quality wetsuit rental from Cornish Adventure HQ. Enjoy personalized sizing assistance from our trained staff to ensure a perfect fit. Stay warm and comfortable as you dive into your next aquatic escapade, all while receiving exceptional service in a welcoming environment.

tours.name: Wetsuit Hire: Multiple Days
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure with a high-quality wetsuit rental from Cornish Adventure HQ. Enjoy personalized fitting by trained staff to ensure the perfect size for your needs. Stay warm and comfortable as you dive into your next aquatic escapade, all while receiving exceptional service and a fresh wetsuit.

tours.name: Wetsuit Hire: Full Week
tours.description: Experience the thrill of adventure with our high-quality wetsuit rentals! Enjoy personalized service as our trained staff ensures the perfect fit for your size. Stay warm and comfortable while exploring the great outdoors, all from our convenient Cornish Adventure HQ location. Dive into your next adventure with confidence!

tours.name: Buoyancy Aids Hire
tours.description: Experience thrilling water adventures with our kayak rentals! Enjoy a full day of exploration, guided by expert instructors who ensure your buoyancy aid is perfectly fitted. Conveniently located at Cornish Adventure HQ, embark on an unforgettable journey on the water, making memories that will last a lifetime.

tours.name: Helmet Hire
tours.description: Experience thrilling watery adventures with our kayak rentals! Our expert instructors ensure you’re equipped with properly fitted helmets for safety. Conveniently located at Cornish Adventure HQ, you can easily pick up your kayaks and embark on a memorable day of exploration. Enjoy a full day of fun on the water!

tours.name: Motor-Boat Hire
tours.description: Discover the River Nene like never before by hiring a self-drive motorboat! Cruise through 8 miles of stunning countryside and wildlife, perfect for up to six people. Enjoy the thrill of navigating your own boat, with staff support to ensure a safe and memorable adventure on the water.

tours.name: Tandem Kayak Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure with a tandem kayak experience on the scenic River Nene. Perfect for families or friends, this comfortable two-seater kayak allows you to explore over 8 miles of stunning countryside and wildlife. Enjoy the thrill of paddling together while soaking in the natural beauty around you.

tours.name: Canoe Hire
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure with our traditional Canadian canoes, perfect for families and friends. Paddle along the scenic River Nene, exploring over 8 miles of stunning wilderness. Enjoy the comfort of three bench seats and lightweight wooden paddles, making this a unique and relaxing outing for everyone involved.

tours.name: Moth Morning - Parc Cwm Darran
tours.description: Uncover the secrets of night-flying moths with a hands-on session at Parc Cwm Darran. Examine colorful specimens, learn about their role as pollinators, and enjoy a tasty breakfast by the lake.

tours.name: Royal Forest of Steam Gala
tours.description: Join the Royal Forest of Steam Gala on Nov 1-2, 2025, for a thrilling weekend of visiting and home locomotives in action amid autumnal Forest of Dean scenery, featuring special engines like BR Standard 2 No. 78019 and the restored Lost Engine.

tours.name: Dale's Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3.5-hour walking tour of Liverpool with expert guide Dale Roberts, exploring iconic Beatles locations and hidden musical gems. With over a decade of experience and thousands of 5-star reviews, Dale’s engaging storytelling and personal insights promise an unforgettable journey through the city’s vibrant music scene.

tours.name: Inclusive Mountain Biking Session
tours.description: Enjoy inclusive cycling at Irnham Road with adapted bikes and friendly staff, perfect for all abilities. Or hit North Hill for a fun, offroad mountain biking adventure on Exmoor—no experience needed, just bring your enthusiasm.

tours.name: Bushcraft
tours.description: Learn essential bushcraft skills like fire lighting, shelter building, and plant identification in just 2 hours. Perfect for adventurers over 10, with all safety gear provided—gear up and connect with nature.

tours.name: GelSoft
tours.description: Feel the thrill of Gelsoft, a high-energy blend of airsoft and paintball that ignites your adrenaline. Perfect for ages 12 and up, with safety gear required for younger players.

tours.name: Orca Extreme
tours.description: Tackle raging rapids in a two-person raft with expert guidance. Designed for experienced paddlers, this intense 4.5-hour adventure tests your skills and adrenaline on wild white water.

tours.name: Raft Guide Training Courses
tours.description: Kickstart your rafting career with a 3-day course that builds core guiding skills, meets international standards, and boosts confidence on the water. Perfect for beginners aiming to guide recreationally or commercially.

tours.name: Immune Boosting Support Through Nutrition
tours.description: Join a transformative 5-week course that delves into the intricacies of the immune system. Discover how to enhance your wellbeing through key nutrients, combat inflammation, and support your body's defenses. This engaging experience empowers you with knowledge to maintain robust immunity year-round, ensuring you feel your best.

tours.name: Tour por el Londres de Harry Potter
tours.description: Step into the magical world of Harry Potter with a 2.5-hour tour through London’s iconic filming locations, from Diagon Alley to the Ministry of Magic. Walk where Harry and friends once roamed.

tours.name: Tour Soho
tours.description: Explore Soho’s vibrant history in 2.5 hours, from its royal roots to its role in music, fashion, and culture. Walk lively streets, visit iconic spots like Chinatown, Liberty, and Piccadilly Circus, ending at Leicester Square.

tours.name: Canoe rafts and Giant SUP's - The wet one!
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 3-hour water adventure perfect for families and groups aged 7 and up! Begin with buoyancy gear and paddles, then navigate stable Canadian canoes and giant stand-up paddle boards. Enjoy fun games, challenges, and the thrill of splashes, all while learning new skills in a safe environment.

tours.name: Roller Skating
tours.description: Experience the joy of skating at the Festive Point Roller Rink! Enjoy 30 minutes of themed sessions filled with lively music and festive cheer, perfect for children and their accompanying adults. With roller skate hire available, don’t miss out on this fun-filled holiday activity—book your spot early!

tours.name: Doggy Paddleboarding
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Stand Up Paddleboarding with your dog in a stunning outdoor setting! This unique 3-hour session combines fun and bonding as you and your furry friend learn to navigate the water together. Enjoy tailored coaching, all necessary equipment, and a memorable adventure on sheltered waters.

tours.name: Conservation Corridor Work Party
tours.description: Join us this winter to enhance biodiversity in Shoreham Port's unique conservation corridor. Collaborate with habitat rangers to revitalize overgrown areas through 'scalloping,' allowing rare native plants to thrive. Experience the surprising variety of habitats while contributing to the vital support of migratory butterfly species in this urban landscape.

tours.name: Market Days & Free Gardens & Grounds Access
tours.description: Browse local food, crafts, and makers in Ripley Castle’s courtyard, with free estate access. Support small businesses, enjoy scenic gardens, and explore the castle—an authentic Yorkshire market experience.

tours.name: Santa Kayak Aqueduct Tour
tours.description: Experience a unique kayaking adventure on the Llangollen Canal, complete with a festive Santa hat and a delicious mince pie. Paddle over the breathtaking UNESCO Pontcysyllte Aqueduct, the highest and longest in the world, while soaking in stunning views of the Dee Valley. A memorable two-hour journey awaits!

tours.name: Valentine's Lambs & Fizz Evening
tours.description: Experience a unique Valentine's evening at our farm in Shropshire, surrounded by adorable ewes and newborn lambs. Enjoy an intimate setting in The Old Barn, where you can hold and feed the lambs, savor prosecco and chocolates, and capture memorable moments. Limited to just five couples for a truly special night.

tours.name: Sri Lankan feast with Karan Gokani of Hoppers
tours.description: Create a Sri Lankan feast with Karan Gokani, mastering dhal, chicken curry, pol roti, and coconut relish. Enjoy your dishes at the chef’s table, take home a signed cookbook, and boost your cooking confidence.

tours.name: Premium Free-Roam VR
tours.description: Dive into an exhilarating 30-minute Premium Free-Roam VR Experience, where you and your friends can explore immersive zombie-filled worlds. With a private arena just for your group of 2 to 4 players, you'll engage in thrilling stories that promise unforgettable fun and adventure. Get ready for lifelike excitement!

tours.name: Jack the Ripper Tour (Private Tour)
tours.description: Experience London's only private Jack the Ripper Ghost Tour, where you'll delve into the chilling history of Whitechapel. Explore haunted sites, including a historic pub and key murder locations, while uncovering the stories of notorious suspects. This unique journey blends eerie tales with the vibrant backdrop of London's past.

tours.name: Sex, Drugs and Sausage Rolls (Private Tour)
tours.description: Embark on the Naughty London tour, a private adventure through the city's scandalous past! Explore the Tudor era's vices, hear outrageous tales of executions, and uncover the origins of colorful language. Perfect for those with a sense of humor, this unique walking tour promises unforgettable stories and a glimpse into London's gritty history.

tours.name: London Bridge Ghost Tour (Private Tour)
tours.description: Embark on a private tour for up to 20 guests, exploring London's most captivating sites, from the historic Clink Prison Museum to the eerie Crossbones Graveyard. Experience the thrill of the world's oldest operating theatre and visit haunted pubs, all while capturing stunning photos at iconic landmarks like The Shard and St. Paul's Cathedral.

tours.name: Royal Maritime Greenwich Ghost Tour (Private Tour)
tours.description: Uncover the chilling tales of Greenwich on this captivating ghost tour. Explore haunted sites, including London's oldest park and a notorious pub favored by Charles Dickens. Encounter the spirits of sailors, jilted lovers, and royal secrets as you navigate hidden alleys and the UK's creepiest tunnel. A thrilling experience awaits!

tours.name: Pioneer XDJ-RX3
tours.description: Experience the Pioneer XDJ-RX3, a top-tier all-in-one DJ system featuring a two-channel mixer and built-in media players. With its impressive 10.1-inch touchscreen and professional-grade features, it's perfect for both mobile gigs and home mixing. Elevate your DJ skills and create unforgettable performances with this cutting-edge equipment.

tours.name: Outlander Private Day Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour journey through the enchanting landscapes that inspired 'Outlander.' Visit iconic filming locations like Doune Castle and Linlithgow Palace, guided by a knowledgeable local chauffeur. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and bottled water as you explore Scotland's rich history and breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: Stirling Private Day Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-hour private tour of Historic Stirling, the gateway to the Scottish Highlands. Discover iconic sites like The Kelpies, Stirling Castle, and the National Wallace Monument, all guided by an experienced local chauffeur. Enjoy a scenic journey with complimentary Wi-Fi and bottled water, ensuring a memorable adventure.

tours.name: Highlands & Lowlands Whisky Day Tour
tours.description: Embark on a memorable 7-hour journey through the stunning Scottish Highlands and Lowlands, visiting two renowned whisky distilleries. Enjoy expert guidance from a local chauffeur, indulge in tasting experiences, and capture unforgettable moments with Highland Coos. Relax with complimentary Wi-Fi and bottled water as you escape the city.

tours.name: Home Education Sessions
tours.description: Experience a unique blend of history and nature at Weston Park! This engaging 2-hour session for children 6+ combines learning with riding electric Oset bikes, perfect for beginners. Explore the stunning 1,000-acre estate while discovering its rich history, all in a fun and supportive environment.

tours.name: Deer Photography Workshop - Margam
tours.description: Capture stunning moments in nature as you learn to photograph deer up close, guided by an expert. Enhance your skills and see wildlife through a new, exciting lens in this immersive workshop.

tours.name: Seafest SUP Journey
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable paddleboarding adventure in Plymouth Sound, guided by expert instructors. Explore the breathtaking coastlines of Drake's Island and Mount Edgecumbe, surrounded by stunning scenery and wildlife. This adults-only experience promises a unique blend of skill, nature, and camaraderie, perfect for those seeking an exciting outdoor challenge.

tours.name: Ghost Hunt & Paranormal Experience
tours.description: Uncover ghostly legends at the Haunted Swan Inn, where historic charm meets spine-tingling tales. Join the Pluckley Ghost Walk for supernatural thrills and a delicious meal—dare to see what you believe.

tours.name: Adult Care Farming Taster Days
tours.description: Experience a unique 3-hour taster session designed for adults with additional learning needs. Engage with animals through feeding and petting, while assisting farmers in their morning routine. With a limited group size, this intimate setting offers a chance to explore the farm and assess future participation in small group sessions.

tours.name: The Ultimate GIANT 2 Day Private Filming Locations Experience Tour - From Belfast
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through stunning Game of Thrones filming locations with expert guide Flip Robinson, who brings firsthand experience from the show. Explore the breathtaking Causeway Coastal Route and other iconic sites in Northern Ireland, immersing yourself in the real-world Westeros like never before on this ultimate tour.

tours.name: Saturday Young Farmers Pregnancy Scanning Session
tours.description: Join our young farmers for an engaging animal pregnancy scanning session! Participants will guide ewes and goats, watch expert scanning demonstrations, and mark lamb counts. This hands-on experience also includes vital farm tasks like feeding and bedding, making it a unique opportunity to learn about animal care and farming firsthand.

tours.name: Private Charter
tours.description: Embark on a Private Sea Adventure along Falmouth’s stunning coastline, where you can tailor your experience to celebrate special moments or enjoy a family outing. With fully customizable charters, this unique opportunity allows you to explore the sea at your own pace in a private group setting.

tours.name: Party (Group) booking
tours.description: Experience an adrenaline-fueled adventure with a variety of thrilling activities! From archery and axe throwing to survival skills and team-building challenges, each experience promises excitement and camaraderie. Unleash your competitive spirit and create unforgettable memories in a dynamic environment designed for fun and teamwork.

tours.name: RYA First Aid
tours.description: Join this unique 1-day Royal Yachting Association-approved first aid course, tailored for boating enthusiasts. Learn essential skills like resuscitation, recovery position, and treatment for common injuries. With expert instruction and a complimentary RYA First Aid book, this immersive experience is perfect for anyone looking to enhance their boating safety knowledge.

tours.name: Senior Ice Hockey
tours.description: Join us for an exciting evening on the ice! Meet the coaches, get kitted up, and learn about our session formats and available gear. Experience the thrill of skating while connecting with fellow enthusiasts in a fun and informative atmosphere. Don’t miss this unique opportunity to dive into the world of ice sports!

tours.name: Try Freediving over the Winter– Pool Intro Course
tours.description: Dive into freediving with a half-day course that boosts your water confidence through breathing, relaxation, theory, and pool practice—no experience needed, all gear included, and safety is our top priority.

tours.name: Ancestral Journeys & Cultural Tour
tours.description: Embark on a profound journey through Ghana's history and culture, visiting significant sites like Assin Manso and Cape Coast Castle. Experience emotional connections to the past, savor delicious local cuisine by the sea, and explore the breathtaking Kakum National Park, culminating in a unique blend of education and natural beauty.

tours.name: Tall Ships Races: Leg 4 Kristiansand to Esbjerg
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey with Excelsior during the thrilling final leg of the Tall Ships Races. Experience the camaraderie of a small crew as you sail from Norway to Denmark, participate in vibrant festivities, and immerse yourself in the rich tradition of historic sailing. Adventure awaits—no experience necessary!

tours.name: Wye Valley Canoe Experience
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling multi-day paddle and camping adventure along the stunning River Wye. Navigate gentle rapids while soaking in the lush scenery, unwind by the riverbank at night, and enjoy campfire stories. With expert guides ensuring your safety and sharing local insights, this experience promises unforgettable memories.

tours.name: RYA Power Boat Level 2
tours.description: Master the art of powerboat driving with this comprehensive course! Gain essential skills in low-speed handling, man-overboard recovery, and collision regulations, while also learning to launch, moor, and anchor effectively. Perfect for those seeking to enhance their boating expertise in a practical and engaging environment.

tours.name: Hay-on-Wye to Preston-on-Wye (Full Day)
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic River Wye, passing historic bridges, lush gardens, and abundant wildlife. Glide through tranquil waters, stopping at charming riverside campsites and exploring rural landscapes. Whether for a half-day or full-day adventure, this journey offers breathtaking views, peaceful nature, and unforgettable moments on the water.

tours.name: Parent / Toddler Farm Session
tours.description: Experience the joy of farm life with our Parent and Toddler Farm Sessions! Designed for young children and their guardians, these sessions offer hands-on interactions with friendly animals like goats and lambs, fostering quality bonding time while exploring the wonders of the farm together. Join us for unforgettable memories!

tours.name: London Landmarks
tours.description: Experience the essence of London in just three hours on a unique tour in an iconic black taxi. With a passionate guide at the wheel, you'll explore the city's most famous landmarks, including Buckingham Palace and St. Paul's Cathedral, all while enjoying a panoramic view of the bustling capital.

tours.name: Classic London
tours.description: Experience the essence of London on a captivating 4-hour tour led by a knowledgeable cabbie. Discover iconic landmarks and hidden gems as you navigate through back-streets and alleyways. Enjoy personalized stops for photos and insights, making this tour a perfect introduction to the city's rich history and vibrant culture.

tours.name: London Explorer
tours.description: Embark on a 6-hour London Explorer Tour for an unforgettable sightseeing experience. Led by a knowledgeable cabbie, discover iconic landmarks and hidden gems off the beaten path. Enjoy leisurely photo stops and insightful stories, making it perfect for both first-time visitors and seasoned travelers. Explore London like never before!

tours.name: London Adventurer
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 8-hour London Explorer tour, where a knowledgeable cabbie reveals the city's hidden gems and iconic landmarks. Enjoy leisurely walks, photo stops, and a classic pub lunch, all tailored to your interests. Experience London like never before, from bustling streets to secret alleyways, making unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Harry Potter Tour
tours.description: Embark on a magical Big City Taxi Tour through London, exploring iconic Harry Potter film locations like Diagon Alley and Platform 9¾. Visit the enchanting House of MinaLima, and capture memories at Kings Cross Station. Discover famous landmarks along the way, making this an unforgettable adventure for every Potter fan.

tours.name: Haunted London
tours.description: Experience the chilling allure of London on the Cockney Cabbie’s Haunted London Taxi Tour. Discover the city’s eerie past as you visit haunted sites like the Tower of London and Newgate Prison, while listening to spine-tingling ghost stories. This unforgettable evening promises thrills and the chance to spot a ghostly apparition!

tours.name: Christmas Lights Tour
tours.description: Experience the enchanting beauty of London during the festive season on a Christmas Lights Taxi Tour. Marvel at iconic displays on Regent and Oxford Streets, explore hidden gems, and enjoy delightful Christmas markets. Capture memorable moments with photo stops, all while soaking in the city's holiday spirit and stunning landmarks.

tours.name: Illuminated London
tours.description: Experience the magic of London after dark on a captivating 2-hour night tour. Discover iconic landmarks like the Tower of London, Buckingham Palace, and the London Eye, all beautifully illuminated. With stops for photos and fascinating insights, this tour offers a unique glimpse into the city's vibrant night-time charm.

tours.name: Monthly Paint and Sip Night: Rose & Crown, Redmarley
tours.description: Join our Paint & Sip Nights for a fun-filled evening of creativity and camaraderie! Guided by an art-coach, you'll explore your artistic side while sipping drinks with friends. Each session features a unique painting, ensuring a memorable experience as you create your own masterpiece alongside others.

tours.name: Paint and Pizza Night: The Ark Cafe
tours.description: Join us for Paint & Pizza Nights, where creativity meets deliciousness! Enjoy a fun evening with friends as our art-coach guides you in creating your own unique masterpiece. With all materials provided and a trio of desserts included, it's the perfect blend of art, laughter, and tasty pizza!

tours.name: Weekly Pool Sessions
tours.description: Join us for an exciting weekly pool night every Tuesday! Starting at 7:30pm, you'll have the chance to refresh your scuba skills, try new equipment, or explore Sidemount diving in a supportive environment. Dive into an hour of fun and camaraderie while honing your underwater abilities!

tours.name: Tall Tales And Sea Shanties - Geopark Discovery Experience
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-mile circular walk from Maidencombe, where stunning coastal and woodland views await. Led by local storyteller Ziggy, uncover tales of smuggling, war, and the supernatural. Conclude your adventure with a lively sing-along by the beach, creating unforgettable memories as the sun sets over the English Riviera.

tours.name: Scottish canoe and wild camp expedition (River Spey)
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking 3-4 day canoe journey through the Scottish Wilderness, paddling 60 miles of pristine river. Experience wild camping, self-sufficiency, and the stunning landscapes of whisky country. This unique adventure is accessible to all abilities, offering an unforgettable expedition in a truly special environment.

tours.name: Paddlesport Leader Assessment
tours.description: Embark on a transformative 2-day assessment to become a qualified Paddlesport Leader. This unique experience hones your skills in managing diverse watercraft in sheltered environments, emphasizing real-world leadership and decision-making. Prove your technical prowess and group management abilities while gaining the confidence to lead paddlesport adventures safely.

tours.name: Whitewater Leader Training
tours.description: Enhance your paddling prowess with this immersive 2-day training course, tailored for aspiring leaders in Grade 2/3 whitewater. Gain hands-on experience in risk assessment, group management, and rescue techniques, all while learning from seasoned instructors. Elevate your confidence and skills to ensure safe, enjoyable adventures on the river.

tours.name: Whitewater Leader Assessment
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 1-day assessment for aspiring paddling leaders in Grade 2/3 whitewater. Showcase your skills in group management, risk assessment, and rescue techniques while navigating real-world conditions. Under the watchful eye of seasoned assessors, this unique opportunity combines adventure with professional development in an exhilarating outdoor setting.

tours.name: Paddlesport Safety and Rescue
tours.description: Enhance your paddling prowess with this hands-on 1-day course focused on vital rescue skills for kayaks, canoes, and paddleboards. Perfect for aspiring coaches, you'll learn to manage emergencies, perform rescues, and recover equipment, boosting your confidence and readiness for real-world paddlesport challenges.

tours.name: Canoe & Kayak Coached Sessions (Adults)
tours.description: Join us for an exciting monthly session designed for adults eager to master canoeing or kayaking! Whether you're a beginner or looking to enhance your skills, these engaging sessions offer expert guidance and a chance to connect with fellow enthusiasts. Experience the thrill of paddling on the water every last Saturday!

tours.name: Paint and Pudding Night: The Farmers Yard
tours.description: Experience a delightful painting workshop at The Farmers Yard, Arlingham, where you'll create your own version of 'Little Boo Peep' under the guidance of a skilled artist. Enjoy three delicious seasonal puddings from Wellfed Kitchen Ltd, making this a unique blend of creativity and culinary indulgence.

tours.name: Seaweed and Sushi
tours.description: Unearth the bounty of the coastline with a hands-on foraging adventure. Collect fresh seaweeds and edible plants, learning tips to identify and enjoy them safely. This lively experience sparks your confidence to forage independently, turning nature’s treasures into delicious, nutritious ingredients—perfect for aspiring sushi chefs and curious food lovers alike.

tours.name: Wings & Things
tours.description: Join the fun at Wings & Things, a hands-on cooking class where comfort food reigns supreme! Over 2.5 hours, you'll whip up mouthwatering dishes like crispy chicken wings and gooey mac & cheese. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, learn culinary skills, and savor the delicious feast you've created—all with no cleanup required!

tours.name: Paint and Pudding Night: Swan Theatre, Worcester
tours.description: Join us for a unique Paint & Pudding Night at The Swan Theatre on August 29, 2025. Guided by art coach Brydie, you'll create an enchanting 'under the sea' masterpiece while savoring three delicious seasonal puddings. Perfect for all skill levels, this evening promises creativity and indulgence in a vibrant atmosphere.

tours.name: Santa's arrival Party
tours.description: Join the festive celebration at Birkacre Garden Centre as Santa arrives for a magical evening! Enjoy a delightful 20-minute Christmas show featuring music and laughter, meet Santa on his sleigh for memorable photos, and explore delicious seasonal treats. Don’t miss the enchanting VR Sleigh Ride for an unforgettable experience!

tours.name: Paint and Pizza Night: Cattivo, Cirencester (SEPTEMBER)
tours.description: Join our Paint & Pizza Nights for a fun-filled evening of creativity and deliciousness! Guided by an art-coach, you'll create your own unique masterpiece while enjoying a 12" pizza. Perfect for friends, these sessions blend skill-building with laughter, ensuring a memorable night out for everyone, regardless of experience!

tours.name: Lamb feeding Experience
tours.description: Experience the joy of bottle-feeding adorable "sock lambs" during an exclusive one-hour visit! Connect with nature as you meet playful lambs, goat kids, and expectant ewes in a cozy barn setting. This unique opportunity is perfect for families, creating unforgettable memories in a charming farm environment.

tours.name: Alpaca walk and pumpkin carving🎃
tours.description: Experience a unique autumn adventure at our farm! Enjoy a gentle alpaca walk, where you can connect with friendly alpacas and capture memorable photos. Then, unleash your creativity during a pumpkin carving session, complete with your own pumpkin and candle. Explore the farm and meet a variety of adorable animals afterward!

tours.name: Paint and Sip Night: The Brown Jug
tours.description: Join us for a fun-filled Paint and Sip Night at The Brown Jug, where you'll unleash your creativity by handpainting a unique tote bag. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, sip on drinks from the bar, and connect with friends. Perfect for all skill levels, this event promises a memorable midweek escape!

tours.name: Paint and Pizza Night: Cattivo, Cirencester
tours.description: Join our Paint & Pizza Nights for a fun-filled evening of creativity and delicious food! Guided by an art-coach, you'll create your own unique masterpiece while enjoying pizza and indulging in a trio of desserts. Perfect for friends, this experience blends skill-building with laughter and artistic expression.

tours.name: Monthly Paint and Sip Night: Rose & Crown, Redmarley
tours.description: Join us for Paint & Sip Nights, where creativity meets camaraderie! Guided by an art-coach, you'll craft your unique version of a featured painting while enjoying drinks with friends. Perfect for all skill levels, this fun-filled evening promises laughter, learning, and memorable masterpieces. Don't miss the upcoming session on Little Boo Peep!

tours.name: The Magic of Halloween (for 3-4 children)
tours.description: Experience a thrilling Halloween adventure at The Witch's Grotto! This 10-minute spooky journey is perfect for families with children aged 5 and up. Enjoy the enchanting atmosphere and stay longer to explore additional Halloween activities. Join us for a memorable celebration filled with magic and excitement!

tours.name: The Magic of Halloween (for 1-2 children)
tours.description: Experience a thrilling Halloween adventure at The Witch's Grotto! This 10-minute spooky journey is perfect for families with children aged 5 and up. Enjoy the enchanting atmosphere and stay longer to explore additional Halloween activities. Join us for a memorable and spine-tingling celebration of the season!

tours.name: Birds and Landscapes of the Ampleforth Valley and Beyond
tours.description: Experience the captivating world of Jonathan Pomroy's watercolours in his exhibition showcasing the Ampleforth Valley's natural beauty. With a focus on swifts and their habitats, this collection reflects his decade-long passion for conservation. Discover unique sketches and vibrant landscapes that celebrate the region's rich wildlife and history.

tours.name: Paint and Sip Night: Rose & Crown, Redmarley
tours.description: Join us for Paint & Sip Nights, where creativity flows as freely as the drinks! Guided by an art-coach, you'll craft your own unique version of a featured painting, making for a fun and memorable evening with friends. No experience necessary—just bring your enthusiasm and let the colors shine!

tours.name: K-Pop Demon Hunters Art Workshop
tours.description: Join the K-Pop Demon Hunters Workshop at SPVR Arcade for an afternoon of music, creativity, and adventure. Perfect for families, it’s a fun-filled experience blending fantasy and rhythm you won’t forget.

tours.name: Mens Wellness Rowing
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure that combines history and maritime lore! Experience the excitement of rowing while uncovering captivating sea-faring tales. This unique opportunity invites you to leave the land behind and dive into the rich stories of the ocean, making it an unforgettable journey for history enthusiasts and adventurers alike.

tours.name: FESTIVE Paint and Sip Night: Rose & Crown, Redmarley
tours.description: Join us for Paint & Sip Nights, where creativity meets camaraderie! Guided by an art-coach, you and your friends will explore your artistic side while enjoying drinks. No experience is necessary, making it a fun and unique way to learn new skills and create your own masterpiece.

tours.name: Sea Shanty Experience Corp Team Building Away Day BESPOKE
tours.description: Join a lively group to sing authentic sea shanties, capture memories with instant photos, and enjoy Brighton’s vibrant beachside scene—an unforgettable nautical adventure tailored just for you.

tours.name: Science Workshop - Margam Park
tours.description: Uncover nature’s secrets with hands-on workshops: study owl diets and tracks, analyze fossils from the age of dinosaurs, or explore animal bones to learn about life and anatomy. Perfect for curious minds of all ages.

tours.name: Viking Weave Jewellery Workshop
tours.description: Create stunning Viking weave jewelry using copper, draw plates, and anvils. Under Holly Berkley's guidance, craft a necklace, earrings, bracelet, and ring in a scenic mill setting—no experience needed.

tours.name: Climb the PPM Mountain with the Production Team
tours.description: Climb PPM Mountain by exploring peat and mastering smoke levels, starting with unpeated Lagg. Feel the rising intensity as you challenge yourself to reach the peak of this smoky adventure.

tours.name: From The (Pour Your Own) Archives with the Tour Guides
tours.description: Sip through exclusive distillery casks, reliving past favorites or uncovering hidden gems. Join the Lagg Tour Team for a flavorful journey into our Pour Your Own Archives.

tours.name: Natural Straw Decorations for the Festive Season: a beginner's Corn Dolly workshop
tours.description: Create festive corn dollies with expert Sally Murdoch at Whitchurch Silk Mill. Weave straw, learn folklore, and craft beautiful decorations—perfect for Christmas or thoughtful gifts—while enjoying a calming, hands-on experience.

tours.name: The Salisbury City Tour
tours.description: Stroll through Salisbury’s historic streets, uncovering iconic landmarks and England’s best Doom painting. Immerse yourself in centuries of local culture, ending your journey in the stunning Cathedral Close.

tours.name: Lino Printing Workshop
tours.description: Design your own lino print inspired by Ampleforth’s swifts and house martins, guided by expert Sally Zaranko, then enjoy a tasty lunch in a charming oak-paneled Tea Room.

tours.name: Inclusive Mountain Biking Session for with ASD
tours.description: Enjoy a fun, inclusive cycling session with adapted bikes for all abilities, or explore offroad mountain biking on Exmoor with games and skills—perfect for children with ASD or additional needs. All gear provided.

tours.name: Chicken Sculpture Willow Weaving Workshop
tours.description: Create your own bird sculpture using simple weaving techniques, blending tradition with creativity. Chat and craft as you bring your unique bird to life, all while supporting a local charity. No experience needed!

tours.name: Nalbinding Workshop
tours.description: Uncover Viking craft secrets with nalbinding, an ancient needle technique. Create a sampler, learn stitches, and take home tools to continue making warm, sturdy textiles like socks or mittens.

tours.name: Hand Spinning with Flax
tours.description: Unleash your inner artisan as you spin rare, century-old flax into beautiful thread, guided by expert Carey Fleiner. Feel history in your hands with this exclusive, hands-on heritage craft experience.

tours.name: Pied Fly & Spring Migrants Walk - RSPB Nagshead, South Wales
tours.description: Join a 2.5-hour evening tour to spot elusive Nightjars, bats, and migrating birds at scenic sites. Walk through twilight, listen for churring, and get close-up views with a scope—an unforgettable nature adventure.

tours.name: Childhood Memories
tours.description: Walk in the Beatles' footsteps through South Liverpool, visiting their childhood homes, Penny Lane, and Strawberry Field. Enjoy guided stories, stunning gardens, and exclusive memorabilia in a day full of musical history.

tours.name: Snowboard 2 day Camp (intermediate)
tours.description: Kids can learn snowboarding skills, make friends, and enjoy fun lessons on beginner slopes during a lively 5-hour holiday camp. Perfect for new skiers eager to start their winter adventure.

tours.name: Private Group - Eckington
tours.description: Enjoy a tailored paddleboarding adventure with scenic waterways, fun games, and expert guides. Perfect for all skill levels, it’s a relaxing yet exciting way to connect with nature and create unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Skateboard School Taster Sessions
tours.description: Kick off your skateboarding journey with a fun, one-hour beginner session led by GB instructor Albert. Enjoy coaching, a relaxed vibe, and the chance to unwind with drinks or pizza at the on-site café.

tours.name: Creepy Crawl Open Water Swim
tours.description: Join us at HYMB for the thrilling Creepy Crawl Swim this Halloween night! Swim under the eerie glow of floodlights along a 330m course. Enjoy the festive atmosphere, and indulge in delicious hot food and drinks available for purchase afterward. Make this Halloween unforgettable!

tours.name: Riding Hack
tours.description: Gallop through lush forests on a guided ride, showcasing scenic trails. Perfect for experienced riders ready to walk, trot, and canter amid nature’s beauty.

tours.name: Walk/Trot Hack
tours.description: Gallop through scenic country lanes and into vast, open forest on a guided horseback ride. Perfect for confident walkers and trotters seeking an adventurous escape into nature’s beauty.

tours.name: Valentines Cruise
tours.description: Enjoy a romantic 2.5-hour candlelit cruise on The Elleswake Barge, with private booths, delicious two-course meals, drinks, charcuterie, and chocolate fondue—all set against the scenic Leeds & Liverpool Canal.

tours.name: Stoned
tours.description: Experience the electrifying energy of a Rolling Stones cover band that captures their iconic sound without the costumes. Enjoy a night filled with classic hits and a vibrant atmosphere, making it a unique musical journey that pays homage to one of rock's greatest legends. Don't miss this unforgettable tribute!

tours.name: Admission Tickets
tours.description: Uncover the wartime legacy of HM Factory Gretna, where 30,000 workers, including many women, made explosive history. Explore interactive exhibits in this award-winning museum and learn how they helped shape women’s rights.

tours.name: Full Day Private Charter
tours.description: Experience a tailor-made adventure on the River Exe or along the stunning coastline. Enjoy lunch at a teak table on board or visit charming local spots like The Turf Lock pub. With options for swimming in secluded bays and dog-friendly policies, this customizable trip promises unforgettable memories.

tours.name: St Johns May Ball Fireworks - Shared Boat - Tuesday 23 June
tours.description: Watch St John’s fireworks from a cozy shared punt, where music and choreographed displays create a romantic, unforgettable night on the water. Perfect for couples seeking a magical, intimate experience.

tours.name: Heritage Diesel Railcar Day Rover
tours.description: Climb aboard a heritage diesel train through Dean Forest, with unlimited hop-on, hop-off rides all day. Bring your dog, enjoy tasty treats, and soak in scenic views on this relaxing railway adventure.

tours.name: Guided Tour, Drinks Reception at the London Coliseum | Option 1: Balcony | Christmas
tours.description: Enjoy a festive evening with a private tour of London's grand Coliseum, a glass of Prosecco, and a magical performance of The Nutcracker by the English National Opera in a stunning Edwardian setting.

tours.name: Young Farmers Taster Session
tours.description: Experience the joy of farming in our engaging 2-hour young farmers club session! Perfect for newcomers and returning members, you'll meet our friendly animals and dive into hands-on farming tasks, making it a unique opportunity to connect with nature and learn valuable skills in a fun, interactive environment.

tours.name: Wildlife Sketching Workshop
tours.description: Capture the beauty of wildlife at Parc Cwm Darran with a hands-on sketching workshop. Draw birds and animals near the cafe and lake, practicing quick and detailed sketches with all materials included.

tours.name: After Work Club - Evening Coasteer
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Evening Coasteering as the sun sets and wildlife awakens. Embrace the unique atmosphere filled with ghost stories and adrenaline-fueled adventures. This unforgettable journey combines nature's beauty with the excitement of exploring the coastline under the stars, making for a truly memorable night.

tours.name: Paddlesport Safety & Rescue
tours.description: Boost your paddling safety with a practical 6-hour course. Learn rescue skills, safety tips, and build confidence in sheltered water—perfect for all ages and experience levels. Practice, connect, and stay safe on the water.

tours.name: Introduction to White Water (Grade 1–2)
tours.description: Learn to control your kayak or canoe on moving water with personalized coaching, river reading, and safety skills. Build confidence on Grade 2 rivers and earn your White Water Award in a fun, supportive setting.

tours.name: Paddleboard Hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddleboarding near the iconic Hampton Court Palace! Enjoy flexible rental durations, explore scenic islands and beaches, and unwind at The Albany Pub with delicious refreshments after your adventure. Capture unforgettable moments on the water while surrounded by stunning views and vibrant riverside spots.

tours.name: Friar's Bush Graveyard Private/Corporate Tour
tours.description: Uncover Belfast’s hidden past in a historic graveyard, transformed from neglect to serenity. Guided tours reveal centuries of secrets, culture, and stories, supporting a local non-profit.

tours.name: After school Kids Crafts
tours.description: Join a vibrant craft workshop where kids can unleash their creativity! With exciting projects like colorful bookmarks, paper animals, and personalized tote bags, every little artist will find joy. Enjoy hands-on guidance, take home unique creations, and play in a soft play area, all in a safe, imaginative environment.

tours.name: Regency Picnic
tours.description: Experience the elegance of the Regency era at the River Test this summer! Enjoy a delightful afternoon filled with picnicking, beverages, and unique crafts. Dress in your finest Regency attire and immerse yourself in this charming event, returning bigger and better than ever. Don’t miss out on this unforgettable experience!

tours.name: Explore the Cotswolds: Cream Tea and a Visit to Broadway Tower
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through the Cotswolds, starting in charming Broadway Village. Enjoy a scenic walk past rolling hills and grazing sheep, culminating in a delightful cream tea. Explore the historic Broadway Tower, savor breathtaking views, and perhaps spot red deer, making this experience truly unforgettable.

tours.name: Kittywake Easter Crafty Cruise
tours.description: Join a scenic 2-hour Easter cruise with craft activities for kids, relaxing cream teas for adults, and plenty of treats. Wheelchair accessible, festive, and fun for the whole family—set sail on this springtime adventure today!

tours.name: Llama Sanctuary Visit & Talk
tours.description: Discover the charm of our llama sanctuary with an engaging talk about these fascinating animals and our rehoming program. Perfect for those who wish to meet and photograph llamas without extensive walking, this experience offers a unique opportunity to connect with these gentle creatures in a serene setting.

tours.name: Super Special SUP Tours
tours.description: Embark on the Super Tour, a thrilling paddle exploration lasting 3.5 to 5 hours, tailored for adventurous paddlers. Discover stunning creeks, golden beaches, and the open sea while navigating unique routes shaped by the tide. Enjoy a personal experience in small groups, gaining confidence and unforgettable memories on the water.

tours.name: Easter event (Mini 3-6)
tours.description: Discover a unique opportunity to engage with captivating information presented in an eye-catching poster. Dive deeper into the details and connect for further insights, ensuring you don't miss out on this intriguing experience that promises to enlighten and inspire. Reach out to learn more and enhance your understanding!

tours.name: Spring Posy Flower Arranging Masterclass
tours.description: Experience a delightful evening of creativity as you indulge in food and drinks while learning the art of flower arranging with The Dutch Flower Shop. This unique event combines culinary delights with floral design, making it a memorable opportunity to enhance your skills and enjoy a vibrant atmosphere.

tours.name: Orleton Court Farm WiId Spa
tours.description: Experience the tranquility of a breathtaking rural setting while stimulating your heat shock proteins. Afterward, rejuvenate with our invigorating sauna shower, designed to help regulate your body temperature. This unique combination of nature and wellness offers a memorable escape for both body and mind.

tours.name: 1.5 Hour Private Tour/Party (Islington via Kings Cross or Regents Park)
tours.description: Embark on a private narrowboat tour to Kings Cross or Little Venice, accommodating up to 12 passengers. Enjoy a customizable experience with your music, flexible seating, and the freedom to bring your own food and drinks. Explore historic landmarks, lush parks, and even glimpse wildlife along the scenic waterways of London.

tours.name: Royal Welsh Show
tours.description: Watch stunning Welsh Cobs showcase their grace and strength in exciting competitions. Perfect for horse lovers or curious visitors, Cob Day at the Royal Welsh Show promises a memorable, awe-inspiring experience.

tours.name: Brushstrokes and Bruschetta: Topoly's, Gloucester
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable evening at our new workshop, where you'll craft your own decorated skulls using paints and decoupage. Guided by an expert artist, create a mini-masterpiece for your Halloween decor while savoring delicious Italian small plates from Topoly's. Join us for this unique artistic adventure!

tours.name: Embroidery Workshop
tours.description: Create your own nature-inspired embroidery in a calming workshop with Abigail Rose. Perfect for all skill levels, this hands-on session blends relaxation and creativity, leaving you with a beautiful keepsake to cherish.

tours.name: RDS 10K 2026
tours.description: Race through historic St Davids, with a scenic two-mile Coastal Path stretch. Enjoy a festive finish with medals, optional T-shirt, and warm cawl to celebrate your 10K achievement.

tours.name: RDS Marathon 2026
tours.description: Conquer 26 miles of stunning Pembrokeshire Coast Path, including coastal views and cathedral hill. Enjoy aid stations, a finisher’s medal, and hearty cawl—an epic trail run through breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: Songs, Rhymes & Story Times
tours.description: Kids sing, dance, and explore sounds in a lively, interactive morning filled with music and storytelling. A playful session that sparks imagination and joyful movement for little ones.

tours.name: White Water Leadership: Advanced Week
tours.description: Boost your white water leadership skills on Grade 3/4 rapids with expert coaching. Build confidence, master rescue techniques, and lead safely in real river scenarios—perfect for paddlers ready to take the next step.

tours.name: Cocktail Masterclass with Sip 'n' Swig
tours.description: Create three seasonal cocktails in a lively two-hour workshop, starting with a welcome drink. Shake, stir, and learn expert tips for unforgettable drinks—perfect for a fun, flavorful Friday night.

tours.name: Hay Festival or Hereford
tours.description: Explore Hay-on-Wye’s lively festival scene with pop-up bookshops and performances, then wander charming streets filled with unique shops, historic sites, and the stunning Hereford Cathedral—an enriching day of culture and discovery.

tours.name: Under the Mistletoe: Christmas date night at Magheramorne Estate
tours.description: Stroll through twinkling woodland, meet festive characters, toast marshmallows, and visit Father Christmas. Stay overnight in a Victorian manor, enjoy a hearty breakfast, and soak up the holiday magic with friends or a loved one.

tours.name: Inaugural MAS meeting 11/02/25
tours.description: Explore Mexico’s rich terroirs with agave expert Gaby Moncada, tasting diverse Derrumbes spirits and uncovering the flavors that make each region unique. A must for spirit lovers seeking authentic Mexican taste.

tours.name: Intermediate Weekend Surf Camp
tours.description: Boost your skills on green waves with expert coaching, video analysis, and insider tips. Ride better, turn sharper, and read the lineup confidently in this 2-day surf program at Croyde Bay. All gear included.

tours.name: NETA tasting: Thurs 5th Feb
tours.description: Taste rare NETA agave spirits from Oaxaca, hear their story, and explore exclusive unreleased bottles. Join us for a unique, immersive journey into the heart of agave craftsmanship—limited spots available.

tours.name: Science Workshop - Sea Trust Ocean Lab, Pembs
tours.description: Explore the ocean's secrets with Wild Science at Sea Trust Wales. Use special tools to uncover fascinating creatures and dive into hands-on wildlife discovery in a fun, engaging environment.

tours.name: Pantone Pours - The Small Batch Series with the Tour Guides
tours.description: Explore rare Lagg Small Batches with expert guides, tasting exclusive distillery secrets, unique cask finishes, and surprising flavors—an unforgettable journey into the world of craft whisky.

tours.name: The Lagg House Style - Bourbon Maturation with Graham
tours.description: Learn the secrets of bourbon cask aging with our expert Graham in Warehouse 1. Discover how these barrels shape our signature flavors in an engaging, behind-the-scenes masterclass.

tours.name: Scotland to Spain - Smoke and Sherry with Fred
tours.description: Sip through a curated selection of sherried whiskies with Fred, our expert ambassador. Discover smoky flavors, perfect pairings, and the art of maturation in this flavorful journey.

tours.name: Mural Painting Workshop with Charlie Mcfarley @ Henry Davey Ground, Watchet
tours.description: Create stop-motion magic with Andy Spradbery, the lead sculptor behind Wallace & Gromit, in a lively animation workshop. Learn to craft characters and bring stories to life in just 90 minutes!

tours.name: The Ultimate Masterclass
tours.description: Taste rare Arran Single Malts, including cask strength and limited editions, in an intimate setting. Sample surprises from the warehouse and archives—an exclusive whisky journey you won’t forget.

tours.name: Isle of Arran Whisky Festival Ceilidh
tours.description: Sample rare Arran Single Malts, including cask strengths and exclusive releases, in an intimate setting. Savor unique flavors, enjoy surprises from the archives, and deepen your whisky knowledge in just 1.5 hours.

tours.name: Sunday Survivors Gala Masterclass
tours.description: Sample rare, cask-strength Arran whiskies and exclusive releases in an intimate setting, guided by experts. Savor unique flavors, surprises from the archives, and elevate your whisky knowledge in just 1.5 hours.

tours.name: In It For The Long Haul
tours.description: Sample rare Arran Single Malts, including cask strength and limited editions, in an intimate 1.5-hour tasting. Savor exclusive whiskies, surprises from the archives, and deepen your whisky knowledge in a cozy setting.

tours.name: World Cup Whiskies: Spirit of the Cup
tours.description: Sample rare, cask-strength Arran whiskies and uncover hidden gems in a cozy tasting room. Savor limited editions, surprises, and exclusive drams, all while exploring rich flavors and bold stories in just 1.5 hours.

tours.name: A Wee Warehouse Wander
tours.description: Sample rare cask strength and limited-edition Arran whiskies in our cozy Dramming Room, or wander warehouses with Pam before savoring handpicked drams at the Eyrie bar—an exclusive journey into rich whisky flavors.

tours.name: Cask & Keg
tours.description: Sample rare cask-strength Arran whiskies in our cozy Dramming Room, with surprises from the archives. Perfect for whisky lovers eager to explore limited editions and deepen their tasting journey.

tours.name: Icons of the Past
tours.description: Uncover rare Lochranza whiskies in an intimate tasting, sampling cask strengths, limited editions, and surprises from the archives. A 1.5-hour journey into 30 years of whisky craftsmanship awaits you.

tours.name: Festival Dinner 2026
tours.description: Kick off the Campbeltown Malts Festival 2026 with a night of fine food, exclusive Glen Scotia whiskies, and special speakers in historic Town Hall. Enjoy a complimentary single cask bottle—an unforgettable start to the week.

tours.name: Titanic First Class
tours.description: Explore Southampton’s maritime history with a private walk from the port, visit the Mayflower Memorial, learn Titanic secrets on Oxford Street, then relax in VIP transport to Heathrow. All ages welcome!

tours.name: The Skerries 100 Road Race- 5th July 2026
tours.description: Ride comfortably to see Skerries 100 motorcycle race, enjoy seaside views, high-speed thrills, and a lively atmosphere. Relax with hassle-free transport, no parking worries, and plenty of time to soak up the excitement.

tours.name: Budding Botanists - May 2026
tours.description: Kids get messy and learn about pollinators, then plant their own pollinator-friendly plant to take home. A fun, hands-on gardening adventure that sparks curiosity about nature and the environment.

tours.name: Budding Botanists - August 2026
tours.description: Kids get messy and creative in our gardening club, building bug hotels, making leaf art, and hunting for wildlife. Perfect for curious young explorers eager to learn about nature and conservation.

tours.name: Budding Botanists - May 2026
tours.description: Kids get messy and learn about pollinators by exploring plants, spotting friendly species, and planting their own pollinator-friendly plant to take home in this fun, hands-on gardening session.

tours.name: Budding Botanists - August 2026
tours.description: Kids get messy and creative in our Gardening Club, building bug hotels, making leaf art, and hunting for wildlife. Perfect for curious young explorers eager to learn about nature and conservation.

tours.name: Summer Scheme - Senior
tours.description: Join an adrenaline-filled week of paintball, archery, bushcraft, and team challenges. Every day brings new adventures—test skills, build teamwork, and unleash your wild side in a fun-packed outdoor escape.

tours.name: Summer Scheme - Junior
tours.description: Join four exciting days of adventure with paintball, kayaking, bushcraft, team games, and more. Each day offers new challenges and fun, keeping kids active and engaged from morning to afternoon.

tours.name: Science Workshop - Carew Castle
