tours.description: Uncover the secrets of local wildlife with hands-on science activities at Carew Castle. Use special equipment to explore nature’s mysteries in an engaging, interactive adventure.

tours.name: Private Riding Lesson With Fay
tours.description: Join a personalized 30-minute riding lesson with expert Fay Lai, a top-level rider. Perfect for all ages and skills, she’ll boost your confidence and build a strong, enjoyable connection with horses.

tours.name: Songs of the Nightingale Experience - Kent
tours.description: Join a 2.5-hour evening tour to spot elusive Nightjars, listen for migrating birds, and catch bats with a detector. Walk through scenic sites before dark, immersing yourself in nature’s nocturnal symphony.

tours.name: 250A Slime Workshop
tours.description: Kids get messy and creative making their own slime in a safe, fun environment at Broadway Museum and Art Gallery. Enjoy 30 minutes of slimetastic excitement and take home a personalized masterpiece.

tours.name: Mammals at Night - Forest of Dean
tours.description: Uncover the forest’s secret nightlife with thermal cameras, bat detectors, and glow worms. Spot wild boar, deer, foxes, and maybe a pine marten on this thrilling night adventure into nature’s hidden world.

tours.name: Charlita - Spanish social club (16th April)
tours.description: Join Sorbito’s Charlita on April 16th for lively Spanish chats, Mexican culture, and rare agave mezcals. Perfect for travelers and language learners eager to bring their skills to life in a fun, authentic setting.

tours.name: Interactive Lego Robots
tours.description: Bring Lego robots to life with easy coding on iPads in this fun workshop for kids 8-12. Build, program, and watch your creations move—space is limited, so book your spot now!

tours.name: Butterflies of the Blues - Somerset
tours.description: Join a 2.5-hour evening tour to spot Nightjars, bats, and migrating birds. Walk through scenic limestone hills, listen for churring, and enjoy close-up views with a scope. Bring binoculars, insect repellent, and a sense of adventure.

tours.name: Raptors of the Somerset Plains
tours.description: Join a 2.5-hour evening tour to spot Nightjars, bats, and migrating birds. Walk through scenic sites, listen for churring, and use scopes for close views—an unforgettable nature experience.

tours.name: 216 - The Willersey Swords: The story of Iron Age and Roman Willersey
tours.description: Uncover the secrets of rare Roman cavalry swords and Iron Age history at this engaging talk. Archaeologist Buzz Busby reveals the story behind Willersey’s ancient treasures—join us for an evening of discovery and history.

tours.name: Glass Slipper Events - KPOP Kids Party!
tours.description: Step into a tropical jungle filled with lively characters, interactive shows, and over 40 animal species. Enjoy sing-alongs, meet-and-greets, creative activities, AR dinosaurs, and magical photos for a fun-filled family adventure.

tours.name: Group Stargazing: Moonlight Experience - Brecon Beacons
tours.description: Gaze at the Moon’s craters and distant galaxies through telescopes in Wales’ first Dark Sky Reserve. Enjoy guided constellation stories, expert insights, and a warm indoor talk if clouds roll in—an unforgettable night under the stars.

tours.name: Santa Specials
tours.description: Ride a real steam train through the forest, meet Santa and his elves onboard, and collect your presents at Lydney Junction. Enjoy festive treats, shop for gifts, and make magical Christmas memories in just over an hour.

tours.name: Diesel Gala
tours.description: Feel the roar of powerful diesel engines as they race through scenic forest routes, climbing steep gradients and weaving around tight curves. Two days of thrilling train action, lively atmosphere, and on-board drinks await.

tours.name: Mince Pie Special
tours.description: Enjoy a 90-minute steam train ride through scenic forests, topped with warm mince pies, mulled wine, and a relaxing walk—perfect for celebrating the holiday season and making lasting memories.

tours.name: Brake Van Special
tours.description: Hop aboard a vintage brake van behind a heritage diesel, feel the wind, and relive the railway’s freight past through lush forests. Unique themed trips with special locomotives make every ride unforgettable.

tours.name: New Foxtrot Serenaders Jazz
tours.description: Enjoy a lively 3-hour show with the New Foxtrot Serenaders, featuring delicious fish and chips at noon. Accessible for all, with free parking, flexible seating, and friendly staff ready to make your experience memorable.

tours.name: Cockney Sing a Long
tours.description: Join Tom Carradine for a lively, feel-good sing-along in Covent Garden. Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere with accessible seating, free parking, and friendly staff ready to make your experience unforgettable.

tours.name: Christmas Variety Show
tours.description: Enjoy a lively holiday show with festive music and comedy, spreading warmth and cheer. Perfect for all ages, with inclusive seating and friendly staff to ensure a joyful, memorable Christmas experience.

tours.name: Adults Only BattleZone (Bull's Wood)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Battlezone, a 2-hour action-packed adventure in a forest setting. Perfect for ages 14 and up, this unique combat experience uses non-projectile infrared guns for pain-free fun. Engage in tactical challenges and competitive games, making unforgettable memories with friends or during adult celebrations.

tours.name: Evening Carol Service Steam Train
tours.description: Enjoy a magical evening with a scenic steam train ride, festive carols at St Mary's Church, and warm mulled wine. Sing along with local choirs, soak in holiday cheer, and create unforgettable Christmas memories.

tours.name: Dinomania and the Giants of the Past!
tours.description: Step into the prehistoric world at Dinomania in Plantasia! Experience the thrill of meeting both giant and baby dinosaurs, enhanced by captivating augmented reality. Explore the tropical zoo and uncover the fascinating connections between ancient creatures and their modern relatives. A memorable adventure awaits the whole family!

tours.name: Kids learn for free: Good-for-you meatballs @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Cook and shape juicy meatballs with your child, then enjoy a vibrant tomato sauce and rainbow couscous together. A fun, hands-on family class that teaches healthy eating and kitchen skills in 1.5 hours.

tours.name: New Year Lights of the Valley Train
tours.description: Ride a glowing vintage steam train through festive South West Wales, perfect for photos and social media. Enjoy a cozy evening with bright lights, lively atmosphere, and drinks on board.

tours.name: Paddle & Yoga trip in the Lake District
tours.description: Join Epic Life for a unique 3-day Paddle & Yoga trip in the breathtaking Lake District, perfect for beginners. Enjoy serene paddling sessions on stunning lakes, complemented by invigorating yoga tailored for paddlers. Stay at YHA Windermere, savoring panoramic views and communal evenings, creating unforgettable memories amidst nature's beauty.

tours.name: Full Moon Paddle
tours.description: Embark on a magical evening of paddling beneath the full moon on the serene waters of Six Mile Water or Lough Neagh. Experience the tranquility of moonlit glides, followed by a cozy gathering around a crackling fire, where you’ll engage in mindfulness and reflection under a starry sky.

tours.name: Walk the Wirral
tours.description: Join an unforgettable long-distance walk from Chester to Liverpool, traversing scenic routes like the North Cheshire Way and Wirral Way. Covering 40 kilometers, this adventure offers easy terrain and the option to walk half the distance. Enjoy shared accommodations, meals, and camaraderie while supporting community initiatives.

tours.name: Children's Inclusive Cycling
tours.description: Pedal into fun with inclusive cycling at Irnham Road Courts. Ride a variety of bikes and trikes designed for all abilities, guided by friendly, qualified staff. All gear provided—just bring your smile!

tours.name: Stratford Town Ghost Walk
tours.description: Step into Stratford’s haunted streets with lively storytellers revealing true tales of ghosts, witches, and murder. A spooky, entertaining walk through history that will leave you questioning what’s real.

tours.name: Parkend Carnival Shuttle
tours.description: Ride a vintage diesel train to Parkend Carnival this August Bank Holiday. Multiple shuttles arrive early, ensuring you catch the parade. Enjoy scenic trips and return options—perfect for a fun, hassle-free day out.

tours.name: Witches & Wizards Weekend
tours.description: Step into a magical world with a wizard-themed train ride, a live magician, and a real owl visiting on board. Limited seats—book early for this enchanting October adventure at Norchard Station.

tours.name: Intro to White Water Safety
tours.description: Boost your white water skills with this hands-on course, mastering safety, rescue techniques, and risk management. Perfect for all paddlers, it builds confidence and teamwork in grade 2 rapids.

tours.name: Wild Surf
tours.description: Experience a rejuvenating long weekend in Mawgan Porth, Cornwall, with beginner surfing sessions, coastal strolls, yoga, and sound baths. Stay at the charming Blue Bay House, enjoy wholesome vegetarian meals, and connect with fellow adventurers. This unique retreat offers relaxation and fun in a supportive, non-judgmental environment.

tours.name: Raft Guide School - 6 Days
tours.description: Join Guide School for an immersive 6-day program tailored for aspiring and current Raft Guides. Enhance your skills through practical assessments, including Grade 2 and Grade 3 opportunities, while gaining insights from observing others. Equip yourself with essential safety training and gear to elevate your guiding qualifications in thrilling white water environments.

tours.name: Stargazing
tours.description: Gaze at the night sky with expert astronomers, lying on our viewing net under dark skies. Warm up with soup from The Hungry Otter as stars twinkle above—an unforgettable stargazing adventure for all ages.

tours.name: Snowdonia Rafting
tours.description: Explore hidden gems in Snowdonia’s rivers this November. Enjoy thrilling class three rapids, stunning scenery, and expert guidance on lesser-rafteed waters, rain or shine, just 30 minutes from the center.

tours.name: Apres Hutte - Private Ski Gondola
tours.description: Experience the Alpine Lodge Ultimate Gondola, a private, heated retreat on the festive front decking of Christmas in Cambridge. Perfect for groups of up to 12, this unique 90-minute ride offers a cozy atmosphere to enjoy breathtaking views and create unforgettable memories together.

tours.name: Apres Hutte - Private Ski Gondola
tours.description: Experience the Alpine Lodge Ultimate Gondola, a private, heated retreat that accommodates up to 12 guests. Nestled on the festive front decking of Christmas in Bournemouth, this unique 90-minute ride offers a cozy and memorable way to enjoy the holiday atmosphere with friends and family.

tours.name: Good Friday Family Day Sail
tours.description: Experience a serene sail on the River Orwell, journeying towards Felixstowe and Harwich. Enjoy breathtaking landscapes, diverse birdlife, and the tranquil charm of the river. This unique adventure offers a refreshing escape from daily life, allowing you to connect with nature and unwind in a peaceful setting.

tours.name: PRIVATE Target Sports - 90 minutes
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a unique mix of axe throwing, archery, and air rifle shooting in a private indoor session. Perfect for ages 7 and up, this 90-minute adventure includes expert instruction, personalized feedback, and friendly competition, ensuring a memorable time regardless of the weather.

tours.name: Private Hire Party Dome 2
tours.description: Turn any day into a lively celebration inside the massive inflatable dome at Horsenden Hill. Kids and adults race through a 23-meter obstacle course, while warm lighting and heating keep everyone comfortable. Add pizza, drinks, and a private room for a fun-filled, weather-proof party that creates unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Cotswold Lavender Adventure: A Scenic Walk with Cream Tea Picnic
tours.description: Ages 16+ • 5 hours

tours.name: Content Creater Showdown - Airsoft Noob vs Bag Of Hammers
tours.description: Join adrenaline-pumping airsoft battles with exciting games and prizes, ending with a fun awards presentation. Perfect for thrill-seekers ready to test their skills and enjoy a summer day of action.

tours.name: The Rochester High Street Ghost Tour
tours.description: Embark on the Rochester High Street Ghost Tour for a thrilling exploration of haunted locales and chilling tales. Encounter a ghostly pub, a mysterious shop fitting room, and the most haunted building in town. Each stop reveals spine-tingling stories that will leave you captivated and questioning what lies beyond the grave.

tours.name: The Original Rochester Spooky Tour
tours.description: Embark on the Original Rochester Spooky Tour and uncover the chilling tales of Dickens' eerie city. Experience unsettling ghost stories, shocking discoveries, and spine-tingling encounters that will leave you breathless. From haunted parks to historical revelations, this tour promises a memorable journey into Rochester's dark past.

tours.name: Rochester Revealed!
tours.description: Embark on an engaging guided tour through Rochester's captivating history, uncovering iconic landmarks and hidden secrets. Explore the stunning Rochester Cathedral, the majestic Rochester Castle, and the charming Minor Canon Row, while discovering intriguing tales at The Guildhall and The Queen Charlotte pub. Experience history like never before!

tours.name: From Camden Market (Hawley Wharf) to Kings Cross (Granary Square)
tours.description: Embark on a scenic journey along London's historic Regent's Canal aboard a professionally skippered narrowboat. Experience the tranquil beauty as you glide from Camden to Kings Cross, passing iconic landmarks and lush nature reserves. Enjoy guided commentary that enriches your adventure, making it a memorable exploration of the city's waterways.

tours.name: Kings Cross (Granary Square) to Camden Market (Hawley Wharf)
tours.description: Embark on a unique journey along London's historic Regent's Canal aboard a professionally skippered narrowboat. Experience the vibrant Kings Cross area, glide through scenic nature reserves, and navigate iconic locks, culminating in the lively atmosphere of Camden Market. This memorable trip combines history, nature, and urban charm in one unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Liverpool
tours.description: Liverpool offers a vibrant mix of music, sports, art, shopping, and history. Visit The Beatles sites, tour Anfield, explore Tate Liverpool, shop at Liverpool ONE, or cruise the Mersey—an unforgettable city for every traveler.

tours.name: Barry Island - Gavin & Stacey Tour
tours.description: Enjoy a fun-filled day at Barry Island with sun, sea, and sand. Play arcade games, grab ice cream, and soak up the lively atmosphere. Bring friends, pack sun cream, and make memories by the seaside.

tours.name: Bakewell or Chatsworth House
tours.description: Stroll through Bakewell’s charming streets, savor the famous jam-filled pudding, then explore Chatsworth House’s grand rooms, stunning gardens, and peaceful grounds—an unforgettable blend of history, beauty, and flavor.

tours.name: Blackpool and Illuminations
tours.description: Enjoy a lively afternoon in Blackpool, then relax on a luxury coach as you marvel at the world-famous lights—an unforgettable experience for all ages.

tours.name: Eisteddfod
tours.description: Join Dan for a cultural day at Wrecsam’s Eisteddfod, celebrating Welsh music, dance, arts, and literature. Immerse yourself in a vibrant showcase of Wales’ rich artistic traditions.

tours.name: Manchester Christmas Market
tours.description: Explore Manchester’s festive wonderland with over 200 stalls, delicious international treats, unique gifts, and lively entertainment. Enjoy ice skating, twinkling lights, and holiday cheer in this vibrant Christmas market.

tours.name: Liverpool Christmas Market & Shopping
tours.description: Step into Liverpool’s festive wonderland at St George’s Hall, with twinkling lights, delicious treats, lively rides, and panoramic views from the Ferris wheel. A joyful, hassle-free holiday experience you won’t forget.

tours.name: Chester Christmas Market
tours.description: Travel stress-free to Chester’s magical Christmas Market, nestled in historic streets filled with twinkling lights, festive stalls, delicious treats, and lively entertainment—perfect for holiday shopping and seasonal cheer.

tours.name: Indoor Play
tours.description: Enhance your farm visit with a trip to our Indoor Play area in The Old Barn! Kids can dive into themed zones featuring Construction, Farm Shop, Sand Tray, Lego, and Vets, ensuring hours of imaginative fun. Enjoy unlimited playtime for an unforgettable experience that sparks creativity and adventure.

tours.name: Hot Air Balloon Table at Bristol Christmas Market, Broadmead
tours.description: Float above Bristol’s Christmas Market in a tethered hot air balloon dining pod. Savor festive flavors with up to 8 friends or family, surrounded by holiday magic and stunning views—an 80-minute experience to remember.

tours.name: Liverpool Late Night Shopping
tours.description: Explore Liverpool’s vibrant mix of music, football, art, shopping, and history. Visit The Beatles Story, tour Anfield, enjoy waterfront views, shop unique boutiques, and savor diverse cuisines—an unforgettable city for all interests.

tours.name: Winter Fair - Builth Wells
tours.description: Browse Wales’ top festive market with local cheeses, gourmet doughnuts, and spiced rum. Find unique gifts, crafts, and Welsh treats in a lively, holiday-filled atmosphere at the Royal Welsh Winter Fair.

tours.name: Chester & Cheshire Oaks NYD
tours.description: Kick off the New Year with a day trip to Chester’s historic streets or score big at Cheshire Oaks’ designer outlets. Explore, shop, and create memories—all for just £10. Don’t miss this exciting start!

tours.name: Golden Putter Yorkshire Wildlife Park • 18 holes
tours.description: Challenge your family or friends to a lively round of mini golf on our 36-hole course in Birmingham. Navigate tricky obstacles, test your skills, and enjoy friendly competition. Perfect for all ages, this exciting activity guarantees fun-filled moments and a chance to outplay your mates in a vibrant, energetic setting.

tours.name: Golden Putter Yorkshire Wildlife Park • 36 holes
tours.description: Challenge your friends to a lively 36-hole mini golf adventure in Birmingham. Navigate tricky obstacles and test your skills on our exciting course, perfect for all ages. Whether you're competing with family or friends, enjoy a fun-filled day of laughter, friendly rivalry, and unforgettable moments.

tours.name: Santa Sunday
tours.description: Escape holiday stress with a festive Sunday lunch at Magheramorne Estate. Savor seasonal dishes, meet Santa, and enjoy family fun in a cozy, enchanting setting before Christmas.

tours.name: Blackpool
tours.description: Enjoy a lively afternoon in Blackpool, where fun and magic captivate visitors of all ages. Feel the vibrant atmosphere and create unforgettable memories in this iconic seaside town.

tours.name: Two Mile Bottom Campsite
tours.description: Gather friends or family for a memorable outdoor escape. Book a spacious campsite, breathe in fresh air, and enjoy nature’s beauty—perfect for groups up to 60. Create unforgettable moments under the open sky.

tours.name: Emergency First Aid at Work
tours.description: Learn vital lifesaving skills in an 8-hour course with hands-on practice in CPR, choking, bleeding, and more. Gain confidence to act effectively in emergencies and earn a recognized certification.

tours.name: Emergency First Aid at Work for teachers
tours.description: Learn vital lifesaving skills tailored for teachers, from CPR and choking to managing shock and injuries. Hands-on practice and real scenarios prepare you to respond confidently in emergencies.

tours.name: Quilting and Sewing Show - Builth Wells
tours.description: Browse stunning quilt displays and textile art, shop for patchwork supplies, and enjoy a lively day connecting with fellow crafters at this inspiring quilting event.

tours.name: Girls only Mountain Biking Session 9yrs + - North Hill
tours.description: Kids and teens aged 5-15 can boost confidence on exciting off-road trails with skills, games, and guided rides. Perfect for beginners to advanced riders ready to conquer rocky single-tracks.

tours.name: Paint and Sip Night: Rose & Crown, Redmarley
tours.description: Unleash your creativity with a relaxed evening of painting, drinks, and laughter at The Rose & Crown. No experience needed—just bring your fun side and take home a unique masterpiece to cherish.

tours.name: Blackpool & Blackpool Airshow
tours.description: Enjoy a lively afternoon in Blackpool, where fun and magic captivate visitors of all ages. Feel the vibrant atmosphere and create unforgettable memories in this lively seaside town.

tours.name: Porthcawl Elvis Festival or St Fagans Museum
tours.description: Enjoy Cardiff’s Winter Wonderland with ice skating at Cardiff Castle, a magical ice bar, thrilling rides, festive food stalls, and stunning lights. Explore the city’s markets and historic sights for a festive day out.

tours.name: Mural Design Workshop with Charlie Mcfarley @ Minehead EYE
tours.description: Join a lively animation workshop with expert Andy Spradbery, who worked on Wallace & Gromit. Create stop-frame models, see familiar characters, and unlock your creativity in just 90 minutes.

tours.name: Mountain Biking Session for 12-15yr olds
tours.description: Boost your confidence off-road with 1.5-hour mountain biking sessions for 12-15-year-olds, blending skills, games, and guided rides at scenic locations. Bring your bike, helmet, and a sense of adventure.

tours.name: Boat trip to Hoveton Great Broad Nature Trail
tours.description: Explore Hoveton Great Broad by water, then stroll at your own pace with a personal guide. Enjoy peaceful scenery, wildlife, and a relaxing boat trip—all in a memorable, nature-filled adventure.

tours.name: Distillery Tour
tours.description: Uncover the secrets of Campbeltown whisky with a free guided tour of Glen Scotia Distillery. See the craft behind our unique single malt and experience the art of whisky-making up close.

tours.name: Rum Tasting Experience
tours.description: Join a guided rum tasting with three neat samples, then savor three cocktails crafted from each rum. Perfect for rum lovers eager to explore flavors and enjoy a fun, flavorful experience every month.

tours.name: Emergency First Aid at Work Level 3 (VTQ)
tours.description: Learn life-saving skills in just one day: CPR, defibrillator use, choking, bleeding control, and handling unconscious casualties. Be prepared to respond confidently to workplace emergencies.

tours.name: Golden Putter Stratford Upon Avon
tours.description: Challenge friends or family on our exciting 18-hole mini golf course. Test your skills, enjoy friendly competition, and create fun memories in a lively, family-friendly setting. Perfect for all ages and skill levels.

tours.name: Easter Sunday Lunch
tours.description: Celebrate Easter with a hearty roast—pork, chicken, beef, or a trio—served with all the trimmings. Perfect for family gatherings, with options for kids too. Savor a traditional feast this holiday.

tours.name: Jazz Night - 30th May
tours.description: Secure your spot early and savor a night of live jazz and mezcal. Enjoy two sets of soulful music by award-winning artists while sampling a variety of flavorful mezcals in a stylish, relaxed atmosphere.

tours.name: Paper Pots & Paper Flowers
tours.description: Create vibrant portraits inspired by Pop Art, adding speech bubbles, glitter, and tie-dye effects. Perfect for young artists, this fun workshop celebrates creativity and the Jane Sanders exhibition. All ages welcome!

tours.name: Home Ed Mountain Biking Session. Ages 5-8yrs +
tours.description: Junior riders aged 8-11 build confidence with skills, games, and guided rides on scenic trails. Perfect for young adventurers eager to conquer off-road biking in a fun, safe environment.

tours.name: CARTEL vs DEA Theme Game
tours.description: Join an intense showdown between Cartel and DEA, where strategy, teamwork, and adrenaline fuel immersive missions. Pick a side, face firefights, and test your skills in a high-stakes battle you won’t forget.

tours.name: Intro to kayaking session
tours.description: Learn to kayak in a scenic setting with a qualified instructor. Perfect for ages 5 and up, this 1.5-hour session introduces sit-on kayaks, basic skills, and adventure—gear up, stay safe, and start your paddling journey.

tours.name: The Hand Hotel
tours.description: Experience the charm of The Hand Hotel in Llangollen, where historic elegance meets modern comfort. Nestled along Bridge Street, this inviting destination offers a unique blend of traditional hospitality and stunning views, making it the perfect spot for relaxation and exploration in the heart of picturesque Wales.

tours.name: Cream Tea & Steam Train Ride
tours.description: Enjoy a scenic 1.5-hour steam train through Dean Forest with a delicious cream tea on board. Add a splash of sparkle with prosecco for a luxurious twist. Reserve your seat now for this charming experience.

tours.name: Silver Steam Footplate Driving Experience
tours.description: Get hands-on with a steam locomotive! Drive, fire, and learn signal operations on a scenic line, then enjoy a round trip with family and friends. No experience needed—just a passion for trains and adventure.

tours.name: London Christmas Lights Tour
tours.description: Experience the magic of London's festive season on a three-hour private car tour showcasing the city's most stunning Christmas lights. Marvel at iconic displays on Regent Street, Oxford Street, and hidden gems, with plenty of photo opportunities and refreshments. Enjoy convenient pick-up and drop-off in central London for a memorable holiday treat.

tours.name: Chilling Tales - Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on the Chilling Tales tour and explore Canterbury's dark history through spine-tingling stories of ghostly sightings, gruesome torture, and beheadings. This 45-minute journey reveals the hidden horrors of the city by night, offering a unique and thrilling experience for those brave enough to uncover its sinister past.

tours.name: Educational School Group Tour
tours.description: Experience history like never before with our interactive school group tour in Canterbury! In just 45 minutes, students will engage with the captivating stories of Thomas Becket and Henry VIII, all while practicing their English. Led by enthusiastic guides, this tour promises laughter, learning, and a memorable cultural adventure.

tours.name: Shepperton Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 45-minute Shepperton Cruise, starting from Cowey Sale and winding through the beautiful Desborough Channel to D’Oyly Carte Island. Enjoy views of charming bungalows and gardens as you glide along the river, all while being cared for by our qualified crew on board.

tours.name: Café Pre-Order
tours.description: Pick up delicious sandwiches, pasties, and salads from Whistles Café at Norchard to enjoy on your train journey. Pre-order a week ahead and indulge in hot drinks, cakes, and light snacks on the go.

tours.name: Spencer J - I can’t believe its not Buddy
tours.description: Join Spencer J as Buddy in a lively, heartwarming show that delights all audiences. With accessible facilities, friendly staff, and close parking, everyone can enjoy the fun. Experience a memorable 3-hour performance filled with laughter and joy, specially designed to welcome and include every guest.

tours.name: Chilling Tales - Shared Tour
tours.description: Embark on a spine-chilling journey through Canterbury's dark history with the Chilling Tales tour. In just 45 minutes, uncover haunting ghost stories, gruesome torture tales, and shocking beheadings that reveal the city's hidden horrors. Perfect for those seeking a thrilling exploration of the past, tailored to your comfort level.

tours.name: The Royal Forester Sunday Lunch Train
tours.description: Savor a hearty Sunday roast on a scenic steam train through the Forest of Dean. Enjoy freshly cooked mains and desserts served at your seat, with drinks pre-ordered for a relaxing, delicious journey.

tours.name: Shared Historic Tour
tours.description: Glide along Canterbury’s historic river, passing under ancient bridges, serene islands, and iconic sites like the Old Weavers’ House and Blackfriars’ Monastery, while your guide shares captivating stories of the city’s rich past.

tours.name: Steam Gala
tours.description: Climb aboard for two thrilling days of steam-powered locomotives racing through the forest, with our own engines and guest trains. Feel the roar, smell the smoke, and enjoy a nostalgic journey you won’t forget.

tours.name: Axe & Knife Throwing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of axe throwing at one of the UK's premier ranges! Under the expert guidance of nationally recognized instructors, you'll quickly master the art of hitting targets with axes, knives, and more. Enjoy a fun, technique-focused challenge that promises memorable moments and a unique skill to showcase.

tours.name: Group Coached Kinver Kayak Session
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 1.5-hour kayak adventure along the Kinver Canal, perfect for all skill levels. Paddle in sturdy sit-on-top kayaks, guided by qualified instructors who can customize the experience to your group's needs. Enjoy the tranquility of nature while exploring this picturesque waterway, starting and finishing at The Vine Inn.

tours.name: Trad Night @ St George’s Market feat. Pólca 4 + support
tours.description: Experience the exhilarating sounds of Pólca 4 as they fuse traditional Irish music with lively polkas, jigs, and reels. Their dynamic performances and unique arrangements create an infectious energy that will have you dancing in your seat, showcasing the vibrant spirit of West Kerry through their captivating chemistry on stage.

tours.name: Cream Tea/ Lunch
tours.description: Sip Prosecco and savor cream tea as you ride vintage buses and steam trains through Epping Forest, explore Ongar’s historic sites, and enjoy scenic views—an indulgent day of history, nature, and delicious treats.

tours.name: Master the Tryweryn
tours.description: Join Matt for a lively half-day on the Upper Tryweryn, where you'll master river play and boost your skills. Perfect for confident paddlers ready to treat the river as their playground.

tours.name: Guided trip Bridgnorth to Hampton Loade
tours.description: Glide through scenic countryside on a 5-mile canoe trip along the Severn River, passing under bridges and past lush landscapes. Perfect for groups seeking adventure and nature’s beauty.

tours.name: Guided trip Bridgnorth to Arley
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 10.5-mile paddle through the picturesque Severn Valley, gliding past charming countryside and under bridges from Bridgnorth to the delightful village of Arley. Experience the tranquility of the river while enjoying the sights and sounds, making this adventure perfect for older or more physically active groups.

tours.name: Wildlife Walks - Parc Cwm Darran
tours.description: Wake up with a dawn chorus walk, using parabolic microphones to hear birdsong clearly as the sun rises. Or capture stunning wildlife photos with expert tips—perfect for beginners eager to improve their shots.

tours.name: River SUP Tour
tours.description: Experience the beauty of the River Dart with Dewerstone Adventures' scenic stand-up paddleboard tour. Perfect for all skill levels, this 3-hour adventure offers morning, afternoon, or evening sessions guided by experts. Immerse yourself in nature and create lasting memories on the water—book your unforgettable journey today!

tours.name: Home Ed Mountain Biking Session. Ages 9yrs +
tours.description: Junior riders aged 8-11 can boost their off-road skills through fun games and guided rides in scenic locations. Bring your bike, helmet, and a snack for 1.5 hours of adventure and confidence-building.

tours.name: Wine tasting evening
tours.description: Join a friendly, small-group wine tasting led by a Palmers expert, exploring six curated wines around a unique theme in an engaging, relaxed setting that lasts about an hour.

tours.name: Tanker Train Days
tours.description: Watch historic tanker trains run alongside steam passenger trains, offering stunning sights and sounds. Capture photos, enjoy full-length round trips, and relive railway history on select dates this year.

tours.name: Intermediate White Water (grade 3)
tours.description: Boost your white water skills in North Wales with expert guidance on grade 3 rapids, wave surfing, and safe paddling tactics. Tailored for intermediates eager to build confidence and master new techniques.

tours.name: Advanced White Water (grade 3/4)
tours.description: Boost your skills on Grade 3/4 rapids with personalized coaching in dynamic rivers. Improve control, decision-making, and confidence in challenging conditions—perfect for paddlers ready to elevate their white water game.

tours.name: Weaving Course: Two Day Workshop
tours.description: Create your own wall hanging from scratch in this beginner-friendly weaving class. Guided by silk experts, you'll learn to design, warp, and weave, leaving with a beautiful handmade piece and new skills to continue on your own.

tours.name: Groms River Skills - White Water Kayak
tours.description: Boost your whitewater skills and confidence in a fun, two-day course for under-18s. Small groups, expert coaching, and leadership training help young paddlers progress safely across UK and Europe.

tours.name: Paddlesport Leader Assessment
tours.description: Join a relaxed, supportive paddlesport assessment focused on safety, skills, and leadership. Demonstrate your paddling, rescue, and knowledge while actively participating in a personalized, engaging process designed to boost confidence.

tours.name: Christmas Tree Maze
tours.description: Embark on a whimsical journey through the Christmas Tree Maze this holiday season! Wander among towering evergreens adorned with twinkling lights and festive decorations, creating unforgettable memories with family and friends. Experience the magic of the season in this enchanting outdoor adventure that captures the true spirit of Christmas.

tours.name: Festive Wreath Making Masterclass
tours.description: Experience a delightful evening of festive cheer with food, drinks, and wreath making at our charming mezzanine space, offering a unique view of the venue below. Join us for a creative and cozy gathering, perfect for adults looking to celebrate the season in style.

tours.name: East Asian Fusion To Go
tours.description: Embark on a flavorful journey through East Asia in this 2.5-hour cooking course, where you'll master dishes like Korean Fried Chicken, Chicken Satay, and Prawn Toast. Enjoy a hands-on, social experience, cooking with fresh, local ingredients while savoring your creations. Perfect for adventurous eaters looking to elevate their culinary skills!

tours.name: Creepy Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 3-hour Halloween cruise aboard the narrowboat Juniper, departing from Odiham. Enjoy a scenic journey to Odiham Castle, where you can explore its historic grounds. With fancy dress encouraged and fun activities for kids, this unique experience promises memorable moments for the whole family.

tours.name: Lúnasa
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable night of traditional Irish music featuring masters Matt Molloy, John Carty, and pianist Brian McGrath. Experience the extraordinary talent of these award-winning musicians, whose rich histories and collaborations promise a captivating performance that celebrates the heart and soul of Irish culture.

tours.name: XMAS PACKAGE
tours.description: Experience the joy of our Festive Xmas Package with unlimited access to a uniquely designed indoor mini-golf course. Perfect for friends or solo adventurers, enjoy cheeky challenges, drinks, and a delicious 12" pizza. Join us for unforgettable fun from 5pm-10pm on weekdays and 12pm-5pm on Saturdays!

tours.name: Muslim History in Britain Online presentation
Jack the Ripper Haunted Walking Tour
tours.description: Walk through Whitechapel’s dark alleys where Jack the Ripper struck, hearing chilling stories of the murders, victims, and mysteries. An eerie, immersive journey into London’s most infamous true crime legend.

tours.name: LONDON’S BEST: A PRIVATE CLASSIC 3-HOUR TOUR
tours.description: Embark on a private day trip from London to discover Southern England's gems: Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. Guided by a Blue Badge expert, enjoy seamless transportation, complimentary refreshments, and an immersive experience at each iconic site. This personalized journey promises unforgettable memories and insights into England's rich history.

tours.name: AN AFETRNOON WITH MARILYN
tours.description: Experience an enchanting evening filled with laughter, captivating music, and a touch of nostalgic Hollywood glamour. This unique event promises to transport you to a world of charm and entertainment, making it a memorable night that celebrates the magic of comedy and the allure of classic cinema.

tours.name: Paddlesport Touring Leader Assessment
tours.description: Join a supportive, engaging paddling assessment focused on your skills, safety, and leadership. Prepare with tailored training and resources, all designed to make your journey safe, enjoyable, and confidence-boosting.

tours.name: Gift Card
tours.description: A gift card with a value of your choosing!

tours.name: Supper Club with North by Sud-Ouest
tours.description: Join the Love Lane Supper Club for an extraordinary 4 hands dinner featuring award-winning rare breed charcuterie and meats by Andrew Rodgers of North By Sud-Ouest. Experience a culinary celebration with two exquisite courses from each chef, perfect for foodies and meat lovers alike, on Wednesday, April 16th.

tours.name: 90 Minute Woodland Walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 5 km journey through Cornwall's largest valley, home to majestic 400-year-old oak and Victorian beech trees. Traverse uneven paths while discovering a rich tapestry of birds and wildlife, making this guided walk a unique blend of history and nature that promises unforgettable moments.

tours.name: Supper Club with Chris Mackett
tours.description: Join us for a remarkable Spring Supper Club featuring a four-hands dinner with renowned chef Chris Mackett. With over 25 years of culinary experience, including a Michelin-starred pub launch, Chris brings his passion for seasonal ingredients to create an unforgettable evening of exceptional food and dining excellence.

tours.name: Fueling Resilience: Nutrition & Lifestyle Tools to Beat Burnout
tours.description: Join this transformative 60-minute workshop to uncover the hidden effects of chronic stress on your body. Discover how to restore balance through nutrition, understand the impact of burnout, and learn simple habits to boost your energy and resilience. Empower yourself to thrive, even amidst life's challenges.

tours.name: Paddle Like a Pro - Masterclass with Anthony Ing
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-day SUP white water paddling adventure with expert coach Anthony Ing. Tailored to your goals, this masterclass enhances your skills in navigating rapids and perfecting footwork. Experience dynamic learning in an ever-changing environment, ensuring no two sessions are alike as you elevate your paddling prowess.

tours.name: Grove Ferry to Fordwich
tours.description: Test your paddling skills on a scenic river journey past rare wildlife, ending at a cozy pub. Perfect for all levels, this 1-hour paddle offers a fun way to track your progress and enjoy nature’s beauty.

tours.name: Biofluorescence Walk with David Atthowe
tours.description: Venture into darkness with UV torches to see fungi, insects, and plants glow in vibrant colors. Witness nature’s hidden light show and uncover the mesmerizing world of biofluorescence on this guided, family-friendly walk.

tours.name: Dino Doom - Creepy Day walk
tours.description: Step back in time and immerse yourself in the fascinating worlds of the Jurassic, Triassic, and Cretaceous periods. This unique experience offers an unforgettable journey through prehistoric landscapes, perfect for all ages. Discover the wonders of ancient life and create lasting memories in a thrilling adventure through time!

tours.name: Extinction after Dark - Spooky night walk
tours.description: Step back in time and immerse yourself in the fascinating worlds of the Jurassic, Triassic, and Cretaceous periods. This all-day experience offers a unique opportunity for all ages to explore the wonders of prehistoric life, making it an unforgettable adventure for dinosaur enthusiasts and curious minds alike.

tours.name: Grade 2 Raft Guide Training
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey to master grade 2 white water rafting! This hands-on training course equips you with essential skills in river running, guiding strategies, and safety techniques. Learn from experienced trainers and gain the confidence needed to excel as a professional raft guide or enhance your existing skills.

tours.name: Stadium Raft Guide Training
tours.description: Enhance your rafting expertise with a hands-on training course designed for aspiring professional guides. Learn essential river running techniques, safety protocols, and effective crew communication from experienced trainers. This course not only prepares you for the BCAB Stadium Raft Guide Assessment but also boosts your confidence in dynamic river environments.

tours.name: Winter Bird Spotting
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking sight of migratory birds in Chichester Harbour this winter. Glide through the waters to observe Brent Geese and other fascinating species like Curlew and Oyster Catchers as they feed along the shore. This unique boat tour offers an unforgettable connection with nature's winter spectacle.

tours.name: Wild
tours.description: Experience the captivating theatre production "Wild," where an ensemble cast explores the meaning of wildness through powerful storytelling and immersive soundscapes. Engaging with themes of nature and humanity, this unique performance invites reflection and connection, culminating in a post-show conversation that encourages audiences to share their own interpretations of wild.

tours.name: Black Muslim history of Britain
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable adventure that promises excitement and unique moments. Engage in thrilling activities that will leave you with lasting memories. This course focuses on enhancing techniques and introduces lead climbing indoors, ensuring a thrilling experience. Perfect for those aged 10 and up, it promises structured guidance for climbers aiming to reach new heights.

Discover the local environment, learn about its flora and fauna, and gain skills for future explorations, all while enjoying the beauty of nature with an experienced guide.

tours.name: Dr Jazz

Benefit from practical training designed by industry experts, ensuring you’re prepared for real-life challenges in the field.

tours.name: Dianchúrsa an Earraigh - Meánrang íochtarach/Lower Intermediate
tours.description: Jump into Irish with two immersive days of beginner-friendly lessons, either online or in person. Explore a lively Irish-speaking environment and cover a wide range of topics—perfect for newcomers or a quick refresher.

tours.name: Evening Dome Hire
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable dining adventure in our exclusive riverside Private Dining Domes, accommodating up to six guests. Enjoy stunning views of the River Thames and Folly Bridge while savoring your meal in a cozy, warm setting. Book your two-hour escape for a truly memorable culinary experience in the heart of Oxford.

tours.name: One to One Telescope Tuition
tours.description: Learn to master your telescope with expert guidance in the stunning Brecon Beacons. In 2 hours, unlock the secrets of stargazing and boost your confidence—weather permitting, your cosmic adventure awaits.

tours.name: The Voice Squad
tours.description: Join The Voice Squad for a 2.5-hour concert of stunning unaccompanied Irish singing, blending unique voices and rich harmonies that celebrate tradition with a fresh, powerful sound.

tours.name: 5 week Introduction to Climbing
tours.description: Join our exciting 5-week beginner climbing course every Wednesday! Perfect for ages 8 and up, you'll learn essential techniques, equipment safety, and enjoy fun games and challenges. Experience the thrill of climbing on our big wall while making new friends and building confidence in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Private sessions: (Call to book)
tours.description: Experience the stunning salt marshes and creeks of NW Norfolk with a personalized paddleboarding session tailored just for you. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced paddler, enjoy unique adventures like sunset tours, dawn excursions, or secret wave spots, all while surrounded by breathtaking scenery and expert guidance.

tours.name: iSUP Rentals by the hour: click & collect from Brancaster Staithe!
tours.description: Experience the stunning NW Norfolk coast like never before by renting a premium paddleboard. Glide past dramatic cliffs, serene beaches, and vibrant wildlife, including seals. Whether you're an independent paddler or seeking guided tours, this adventure promises tranquility and unforgettable moments on the water, perfect for families and nature lovers alike.

tours.name: Meánrang Íochtarach 1/Lower Intermediate 1
tours.description: Advance your Irish skills beyond Bunrang 5 with a 10-week course on verbs and the Conditional Mood. Join online or in person—flexible options to boost your language journey.

tours.name: Sunset Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a stunning 90-minute sunset cruise, where you'll marvel at the breathtaking views of Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge, Kenbane Castle, and Sheep Island. Experience the beauty of Whitepark Bay as the sun sets, all while enjoying the expertise of a family-run business dedicated to safety and showcasing local wildlife.

tours.name: Private Sunset Cruise
tours.description: Embark on a stunning 90-minute sunset cruise, where you'll marvel at the breathtaking views of Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge, Kenbane Castle, and Sheep Island, all set against the picturesque backdrop of Whitepark Bay. Experience the beauty of nature with a family-run business dedicated to safety and unforgettable local adventures.

tours.name: Minehead Musical Theatre Group
tours.description: Join the Minehead Musical Theatre Group at the EYE for an exciting experience that combines singing, acting, and movement! Develop your skills while working on mini musicals featuring songs from beloved shows like Wicked and Hamilton. Gain confidence and prepare to shine on stage in the future!

tours.name: Roller Disco
tours.description: Join a lively family roller disco with flashing lights, loud music, and smoke effects. Bring your own skates or rent ours in advance, and enjoy pizza and snacks after fun-filled skating together.

tours.name: McFarley's Art Club
tours.description: Unleash your creativity with Charlie McFarley's Art Club. Experiment with new techniques, work on personal projects, and connect with fellow art lovers in a relaxed, inspiring setting led by a gallery-exhibited artist.

tours.name: Have a Go Climbing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of climbing in a one-hour introductory session! Guided by an expert instructor, you'll learn essential techniques for using equipment, climbing, and belaying. Perfect for ages 7 and up, this engaging taster session invites newcomers to discover the excitement of climbing, with a café available for spectators.

tours.name: Belfast e-Bike hire
tours.description: Experience the thrill of exploring Belfast like never before with an eBike! Overcome fitness barriers and tackle hills effortlessly, while enjoying the freedom to travel further and faster. With adjustable power modes and gears, you’ll discover breathtaking sights in just a day, making this an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Experience Ride: Portrush
tours.description: Experience the thrill of electric biking with Ride Electric's free guided sessions in Portrush. Enjoy a warm welcome with coffee before exploring stunning routes in a picturesque setting. Discover the joy of eBikes as you ride along scenic paths, with expert guidance and answers to all your questions.

tours.name: e-Bike Consultation: Portrush
tours.description: Discover the world of e-Bikes in a personalized 30-minute consultation! Tailored to your lifestyle, this casual conversation will boost your confidence and provide essential insights, ensuring you make an informed choice. Perfect for beginners or those hesitant to jump into an experience ride, it’s the first step to your e-Bike journey.

tours.name: Recording Studio
tours.description: Experience a top-notch recording studio, recently refurbished for optimal sound quality. With advanced Mac recording equipment, a professional mixing desk, and excellent soundproofing, this space is perfect for musicians looking to create. Enjoy the convenience of available microphones and leads, making your recording session both seamless and memorable.

tours.name: Music Lounge
tours.description: Experience the perfect band rehearsal in our newly refurbished recording studio. Equipped with a top-notch sound system, amps, and soundproofing, you'll have everything you need to create music. With guitars, drums, and keyboards available, it's an exciting space for collaboration and creativity, making every session memorable.

tours.name: Music Suite
tours.description: Experience the ultimate musical getaway in our Music Suite, featuring a state-of-the-art recording studio and a vibrant music lounge. Perfect for recording or band rehearsals, enjoy top-notch equipment, soundproofing, and a variety of instruments. Book from one to four hours for an unforgettable creative session!

tours.name: Eastbourne International Airshow
tours.description: Soar along Sussex’s stunning coast, passing white cliffs and the Beachy Head Lighthouse, then enjoy over an hour at the Eastbourne Airshow. Feel the sea breeze, see breathtaking views, and capture unforgettable moments.

tours.name: Archery - Brokerswood
tours.description: Test your aim with expert instructors on a 10m archery range, competing in fun games and challenges. Perfect for beginners, bring outdoor gear, and enjoy a unique, active experience in a scenic setting.

tours.name: Beginners Kayaking  2-day Course
tours.description: Embark on a two-day adventure to master essential paddling skills! From safely entering and exiting your boat to navigating with confidence, this experience promises to enhance your enjoyment on the water. Gain valuable knowledge while having fun, ensuring you feel secure and ready for any aquatic challenge.

tours.name: Guided Tour Rame Head
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking Rame leg of the South West Coast Path from a unique water perspective with SWSUP. Paddle through secret coves, enchanting woodlands, and stunning architecture on a guided 7-mile round trip. Enjoy expert tips, spectacular scenery, and a lunch break at a remote beach for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Taster Trips
tours.description: Join a fun-filled family adventure in the Lake District with a two-hour white water trip. Play games, spot wildlife, and enjoy thrilling Grade 2-3 rapids—perfect for ages 8 and up, rain or shine!

tours.name: Experience London by Night in English
tours.description: Todas las edades • 2.5 horas en 🇬🇧 • Un paseo por el West End

tours.name: Tour Privado Historia LGTBQ de Londres
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour journey through Soho, London, exploring its rich LGBTQ history. Guided by a professional in Spanish, discover iconic landmarks and hidden alleys while learning about pivotal moments, influential figures, and the vibrant nightlife that shaped this bohemian neighborhood. Experience a unique blend of past struggles and present triumphs.

tours.name: Tour Privado Harry Potter
tours.description: Embark on a magical 3-hour tour of London, where the enchanting world of Harry Potter blends seamlessly with iconic muggle landmarks. Led by a knowledgeable Spanish-speaking guide, explore famous filming locations and hidden gems, ensuring an unforgettable experience for both wizards and muggles alike. Discover the magic behind the scenes!

tours.name: Tour Privado The Beatles: Música y Fama
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour journey through London's iconic Beatles landmarks. Led by a professional Spanish-speaking guide, explore the origins of Beatlemania, visit legendary venues, and discover personal stories behind the band's rise to fame. Experience the rich history that transformed Paul, John, George, and Ringo into music legends.

tours.name: Tour Privado The Beatles: Cine y Vida Privada
tours.description: Embark on a captivating three-hour journey through London's iconic Beatles landmarks. Led by a professional Spanish-speaking guide, explore the legendary sites that shaped Paul, John, George, and Ringo's careers, from the famous Abbey Road studios to the Apple shop. Experience the rich history and unforgettable stories of music's greatest band.

tours.name: Un Día en la Vida con The Beatles: Música, Cine, Fama y Vida Privada
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 6-hour journey through the heart of The Beatles' legacy in London. Led by a professional Spanish-speaking guide, explore iconic sites like Abbey Road, the Apple Corps building, and the venues that sparked Beatlemania. Relive the band's history with fascinating anecdotes and unforgettable locations that shaped their legendary status.

tours.name: Tour Pubs Históricos de Londres
tours.description: Solo +18 años • 3h horas en 🇪🇸 • La historia de los locales y de la cerveza inglesa

tours.name: Tour Privado Greenwich
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour journey through Greenwich, a historic district shaped by Romans, Vikings, and English royalty. Discover iconic sites like the Cutty Sark and the Royal Observatory, while enjoying insights from a professional guide. Experience the charm of this UNESCO World Heritage site and savor traditional British cuisine.

tours.name: Tour Privado Greenwich + Crucero por el Támesis
tours.description: Todas las edades • 4h horas en 🇪🇸 • ¡Todo incluido!

tours.name: Tour Privado National Gallery
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour journey through the National Gallery, home to an extraordinary collection of European art. With a professional Spanish-speaking guide, explore masterpieces by Van Gogh, Rembrandt, and Monet, uncovering the rich history behind iconic works. Experience the beauty and depth of art like never before.

tours.name: Tour Privado Arte Urbano
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour tour through London's trendy East End, where vibrant street art transforms urban landscapes. Led by a professional Spanish-speaking guide, discover stunning works by renowned artists, including Banksy. Experience the dynamic nature of urban art, where every visit reveals fresh expressions and creative surprises.

tours.name: Tour Privado Westminster
tours.description: Experience the heart of London on a captivating 3-hour private tour of Westminster. Led by a professional Spanish-speaking guide, explore iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, and the Churchill War Rooms. Discover fascinating stories and hidden gems that bring the city's rich history to life, making you feel like a true Londoner.

tours.name: Tour Privado La City de Londres
tours.description: Discover the hidden gem of the City of London on a captivating 3-hour tour led by a professional Spanish guide. Explore iconic landmarks like the Tower of London and St. Paul's Cathedral while delving into over 2000 years of history, from Roman origins to modern financial power, in this unique urban experience.

tours.name: Tour Privado Museo Británico
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour private tour of the British Museum, guided by a professional in Spanish. Discover iconic artifacts like the Rosetta Stone, Egyptian mummies, and the Parthenon friezes. Experience history and culture come alive as you explore one of the world's most significant collections of antiquities.

tours.name: Tour Privado Soho
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour private tour through Soho, where vibrant streets reveal tales of history and iconic figures. Discover landmarks like Piccadilly Circus and China Town, while exploring the neighborhood's transformation from elite residence to a hub of bohemian culture. Experience Soho's rich legacy like never before.

tours.name: Tour Privado Londres de Noche
tours.description: Discover the vibrant nightlife of London on a captivating 3-hour tour through the West End. Led by a professional Spanish guide, explore hidden alleys, historic pubs, and iconic sites like Covent Garden and Piccadilly Circus. Experience the city's rich contrasts and lively atmosphere as London comes alive after dark.

tours.name: Tour Privado Camden Town
tours.description: Explore Camden Town, the vibrant heart of Rock & Roll, on a captivating 3-hour tour. Discover legendary concert venues, iconic pubs frequented by Britpop stars, and the charming Regent’s Canal. Immerse yourself in the rich musical history and unique atmosphere of this eclectic neighborhood, where music legends once lived and thrived.

tours.name: Tour Privado Notting Hill – Portobello
tours.description: Explore the vibrant Notting Hill on a captivating 3-hour tour, where film history meets celebrity culture. Discover iconic movie locations, the lively Portobello Road Market, and hidden gems like Banksy's graffiti and Jimi Hendrix's last hotel. With a professional Spanish guide, uncover the rich stories and secrets of this enchanting neighborhood.

tours.name: Tour Privado Rock Británico
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 3-hour journey through London's rock history in the vibrant Soho district. Led by a professional Spanish guide, explore iconic sites like Denmark St, Ronnie Scott’s, and the legendary Apple Records. Discover the stories behind rock legends like The Beatles and David Bowie in this unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Tour Privado Jack el Destripador
tours.description: Step into the chilling world of Victorian London on a captivating 3-hour tour exploring the infamous Jack the Ripper murders. Guided by a professional in Spanish, you'll delve into the dark alleys of 1888, analyze evidence, and uncover the mysteries that still haunt this historic neighborhood. Are you ready to unravel the enigma?

tours.name: Tour Privado A Orillas del Támesis
tours.description: Explore the captivating Southwark area of London on a three-hour guided tour, led by a professional Spanish-speaking guide. Discover iconic sites like the Shakespeare Theatre, Borough Market, and Tower Bridge, while enjoying stunning riverside views and the unique blend of medieval history and modern culture in this lesser-known gem of the city.

tours.name: Self Drive Electric Boat Hire
tours.description: Embark on a serene journey along the picturesque River Wey in your own Edwardian-style electric launch. Perfect for family or friends, this one-hour adventure invites you to unwind and enjoy a picnic while exploring Surrey’s hidden gem. Experience the tranquility of the waterway and create unforgettable memories together.

tours.name: PADI Open Water Diver
tours.description: Unlock the underwater world with a 1.5-hour PADI Open Water Diver course. Gain lifelong certification, explore depths up to 18m, and dive anywhere in the world—adventure awaits beneath the waves.

tours.name: SUNSET XXL PADDLE
tours.description: Float on a giant paddleboard in Carnlough Bay, perfect for friends or family. Glide across the water, connect with nature, and enjoy a fun, social adventure on a massive, stable platform that brings everyone closer together.

tours.name: Canterbury to Whitstable
tours.description: Experience the charm of Whitstable, where seafood lovers can indulge in fresh oysters and fish n chips. Journey through the historic Blean, featuring a 13th-century church and stunning woodlands, including Clowes Wood, renowned for its enchanting nightjar songs. This adventure promises unforgettable sights and tastes in a picturesque setting.

tours.name: Whitstable to Margate
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through breathtaking bays and charming seaside towns, exploring coastal nature reserves and ancient Roman ruins. Enjoy a delightful lunch at a Victorian resort, tour historic Margate, and savor post-ride pints, all while uncovering fascinating stories and hidden local secrets shared by your guide, Colin.

tours.name: Whitstable to Canterbury
tours.description: Embark on a captivating seven-mile cycling journey along the Crab and Winkle Way, connecting Whitstable and Canterbury. Experience the rich history and culture of east Kent as Col shares intriguing stories and hidden gems at various stops, making this nearly traffic-free adventure both unique and memorable.

tours.name: St Georges Day Tea Party
tours.description: Join a lively St. Georges Day tea party filled with delightful treats and entertaining performances that bring the celebration to life.

tours.name: Open water Swimming Induction
tours.description: Experience the thrill of open water swimming in a safe and supportive environment. Led by a skilled coach, this 30-minute session is perfect for beginners eager to explore the unique sensations of open water. Equip yourself with essential skills while enjoying a refreshing dip in nature.

tours.name: E-Bike Consultation: Belfast
tours.description: Discover the world of e-Bikes with a personalized 30-minute consultation! Tailored to your lifestyle, this casual conversation will boost your confidence and provide essential insights, ensuring you choose the perfect electric bike for your needs. Start your journey into e-Biking with expert guidance and informed decision-making.

tours.name: Experience Ride: Belfast
tours.description: Experience the thrill of electric biking with Ride Electric's free sessions in Belfast! Enjoy a guided ride through picturesque routes, where you'll discover the excitement of eBikes while exploring scenic paths. Friendly staff will share insights and answer your questions, making this a memorable adventure for all.

tours.name: Bournemouth - Upside Down House
tours.description: Experience a mind-bending adventure at this unique family attraction, where you can walk on the ceiling and capture unforgettable photos. With accessible options and multiple locations, this 20-minute journey promises fun for all ages. Don't miss the chance to create lasting memories in a world of optical illusions!

tours.name: Teddy Bears Picnic
tours.description: Enjoy a charming picnic at the Criterion with your Teddies in tow, complete with a goody bag. Perfect for a fun, relaxing day out with your favorite plush friends.

tours.name: Pirate & Mermaid Picnic & Film
tours.description: Embark on an adventurous treasure hunt, navigating a map to uncover hidden prizes. Enjoy a delightful lunch with fellow pirates and mermaids, and cap off the day with a screening of a themed film. This unique experience promises camaraderie, excitement, and a touch of whimsy for all participants.

tours.name: Easter Egg Hunt (must be pre-booked in advance)
tours.description: Uncover hidden clues around the Criterion this Good Friday, solve the puzzle, and claim your prize in an exciting, interactive adventure that sparks curiosity and rewards your detective skills.

tours.name: Family Easter Afternoon Teas
tours.description: Pre-book now to secure your spot in this exclusive experience. Enjoy a seamless, stress-free adventure designed to leave lasting memories. Don't miss out on this unforgettable journey—reserve today!

tours.name: A Tribute to Elton John
tours.description: Max Bresnahan channels Sir Elton John in a captivating performance at the Criterion, bringing the legendary artist’s spirit to life with energy and flair.

tours.name: Andante - Latin Fever
tours.description: Feel the heat of Latin rhythms with Andante’s Latin Fever, a lively show that will make you dance and leave you craving more of the vibrant, infectious energy.

tours.name: 'SOLD'
tours.description: Witness Mary Prince’s powerful journey from slavery to freedom in a gripping live performance that inspired change. Award-winning and emotionally charged, it brings history vividly to life on stage.

tours.name: Group booking
tours.description: Experience the exclusivity of private bookings, where you can tailor your event to your unique vision. Enjoy personalized service and a dedicated space, ensuring an unforgettable atmosphere for gatherings, celebrations, or special occasions. Make lasting memories in a setting designed just for you and your guests.

tours.name: The Restaurant Tour
tours.description: Embark on a delightful culinary adventure with our popular restaurant hopping tour! Over approximately four hours, savor tastings from four to six unique establishments while enjoying inspiring stories from passionate chefs and owners. Led by an accredited guide, this experience offers a personalized glimpse into the vibrant West Midlands food scene.

tours.name: The Best Independent Gastro Pub Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique Gastro Pub Tour through the West Midlands, where you'll savor exquisite tasting treats at independent pubs renowned for their restaurant-quality food. Enjoy a delightful journey in luxury transport, eliminating the usual dining hassles, while exploring charming country and suburban settings. Experience the best of local cuisine in style!

tours.name: Around the World in 80 Tastes Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique culinary adventure through Birmingham and the West Midlands, exploring 80 worldly tastes in just 4 hours. This tour features 8 exciting stages across urban, suburban, and scenic countryside locations. Complete the challenge and receive an electronic passport to commemorate your flavorful journey around the globe.

tours.name: The Best Cellars Wine Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique wine tasting journey with an expert sommelier from Birmingham Wine School. Explore exceptional venues, from trendy wine bars to Michelin-starred restaurants, while enjoying personal stories and insights. This immersive experience promises to deepen your appreciation for wine in some of the region's most captivating locations.

tours.name: A Taste of West Midlands History Tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4-hour journey through the West Midlands, exploring its rich industrial history and vibrant food scene. Discover the stories behind iconic brands and local delicacies while visiting historic factories and homes. Enjoy delicious tastings and engaging anecdotes that bring the region's heritage to life in a unique way.

tours.name: Corporate Food Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique corporate food tour in the West Midlands, where you'll explore top restaurants while bonding with colleagues. Enjoy meet-and-greets with chefs, engaging insights from a WFTA-accredited guide, and the option to add fun psychometric challenges. Experience team building like never before, all while savoring delicious cuisine.

tours.name: The Michelin * Tour
tours.description: Experience the ultimate luxury with the Michelin star tour in the West Midlands, featuring exclusive access to the UK's finest restaurants. Enjoy personalized service from your private guide and chauffeur, along with customizable extras like a photographer, sommelier, or even a violinist, making every celebration unforgettable.

tours.name: Crossbows / Pistol Crossbows - Brokerswood
tours.description: Test your aim with a 90-minute archery session, trying pistols and crossbows, then compete in fun shooting games. Perfect for ages 9 and up, with expert guidance in a scenic outdoor setting.

tours.name: Gorge walking
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating adventure at Tweedsmuir hall, where you'll don wetsuits and embark on a thrilling journey through the gorge. Spend three hours sliding down shoots, jumping into refreshing pools, and climbing waterfalls. This unique outdoor activity promises unforgettable fun and excitement in nature's playground.

tours.name: D of E - Gold DofE Expedition
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable expedition experience at Thoulstone Park! Kick off with a skills refresh and map workshop, then head to Dartmoor for your adventure. With expert guidance and pre-arranged campsites, you'll build confidence in navigation while enjoying the thrill of the great outdoors. A perfect blend of learning and exploration awaits!

tours.name: River Thames Trip - Wallingford to Pangbourne
tours.description: Paddle along the stunning Goring Gap, passing willow-draped islands, lush nature reserves, and scenic villages. Enjoy peaceful breaks, breathtaking views, and a memorable river adventure through one of the Thames' finest stretches.

tours.name: Family MTB Half Day
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable family day in the forest with a thrilling mountain biking adventure! Explore scenic trails, learn fascinating facts, and enjoy quality time together. With a maximum of two adults and three kids, this inclusive activity promises fun and excitement for everyone. Don’t forget to pack your own snacks!

tours.name: Private Mountain Biking Sessions
tours.description: Experience the thrill of private guided mountain biking on Exmoor! Tailored to your skill level, this 1.5-hour session with a qualified instructor helps you develop techniques while enjoying the stunning scenery. All equipment is provided, ensuring a safe and memorable adventure for individuals or groups.

tours.name: Horner Farm Duathlon
tours.description: Experience the thrill of friendly racing at our Duathlon event, designed for ages 6 to 14! With a clearly marked course suitable for all abilities, participants can enjoy biking and running distances tailored to their age group. Compete for prizes and celebrate on the podium after each race!

tours.name: Bike Maintenance - Learn to Fix
tours.description: Join us for an engaging 3-hour bike maintenance workshop in partnership with Cycling UK! Learn essential skills to ensure your bike is safe, including fixing punctures and chains. Plus, take advantage of our free bike repair session to get your bike checked and repaired. Bring your own bike and ride confidently!

tours.name: Archery and Bushcraft Kids Club
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery and the adventure of bushcraft in our exciting Kids Club Session! Perfect for ages 5 and up, participants will learn archery basics, build a den, and light a fire, all while enjoying the great outdoors. Join us for a memorable 2.5-hour adventure!

tours.name: Beginner Mountain Biking Session - North Hill Tank Tracks Age 5-9yrs
tours.description: Kids aged 5-12 can boost confidence on off-road trails with fun skills, games, and guided rides. Perfect for beginners to advanced riders—bring your bike, helmet, and get ready for an exciting adventure.

tours.name: Children Learn to Ride
tours.description: Struggling to ride? Join a fun 1-hour coaching session to master balance and bike handling. Personalized guidance helps kids build confidence and pedal away, with bikes and helmets provided.

tours.name: Children Bike Confidence and Skills Session
tours.description: Boost your bike skills in a safe, traffic-free zone with expert coaching. Perfect for kids 4+ to build confidence and handle their bike with ease in just one fun hour. All gear provided or bring your own.

tours.name: 3 Day Voyage - Lowestoft to Chatham
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-night voyage aboard the Excelsior, where you'll experience traditional sailing like never before. Enjoy comfortable accommodations and delicious meals as you learn the art of sail training. Set sail from The Heritage Quay, Lowestoft, and create unforgettable memories on the open sea.

tours.name: St Michael's After School Club
tours.description: Join after school for six fun-filled weeks of skating, climbing, circus skills, and team challenges at Minehead EYE. Transport options available—kids will love the active, varied activities and friendly competition.

tours.name: Private Charter - Chatham
tours.description: Experience a unique team-building adventure aboard a beautifully restored 1921 Lowestoft Fishing Smack. Enjoy a delightful dinner on board, followed by an exhilarating sailing experience the next day. Immerse yourself in maritime history while learning to sail in a memorable 36-hour journey perfect for ages 14 and up.

tours.name: Melksham River Festival 2nd - 3rd September
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddle boarding on the River Avon with our 60-minute taster sessions in Melksham. Perfect for ages 8 and up, this fun introduction includes expert coaching and all necessary equipment. Dive into an unforgettable adventure and enjoy the beauty of the water while learning a new skill!

tours.name: DJ Workshop
tours.description: Join DJ Che for an exciting 75-minute workshop where you'll learn essential DJ skills like beat mixing and tune selection. With over 25 years of experience, Che brings a wealth of knowledge to inspire young aspiring DJs aged 9 to 16. Unleash your creativity and discover the art of mixing!

tours.name: Bioblitz!
tours.description: Join us for an exciting evening bioblitz at Shoreham port as we survey the vibrant summer ecosystem! Help us document diverse plant, insect, mammal, and bird species, contributing to vital conservation efforts. Your participation will aid in tracking seasonal changes and enhancing biodiversity in this unique natural habitat.

tours.name: Annual Wine Tasting
tours.description: Sample over 100 festive wines in historic cellars, meet importers, and enjoy exclusive discounts. All proceeds support charity—sip, save, and celebrate the holiday season. Book now for this limited, lively tasting event.

tours.name: Pompeii Entranct Ticket GT
tours.description: Discover the captivating ruins of Pompeii, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, where history stands still beneath volcanic ash. Experience the haunting beauty of ancient streets, temples, and baths, all while learning about the dramatic eruption of Mount Vesuvius. This unforgettable journey offers a unique glimpse into a lost civilization.

tours.name: Colosseum Entrance Ticket GT
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Rome's ancient history as you explore the iconic Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and Roman Forum. Experience the grandeur of the Colosseum, where gladiators once battled, and delve into the rich tapestry of the Roman Empire's rise and fall, uncovering its lasting legacy.

tours.name: A Taste Of Sushi @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Master sushi making in 2 hours: create perfect rice, roll spicy crab and salmon avocado maki, and learn pickling and flavor balancing. Enjoy your handmade sushi at the chef’s table with drinks included.

tours.name: Showstopping Ravioli @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create perfect ravioli with seasonal fillings and simple sauces in a fun 2-hour class. Learn pasta shaping, filling, and cooking skills, then enjoy your handmade dishes at the chef’s table with a glass of bubbly.

tours.name: Italian favourites @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create a delicious Italian feast in 2 hours: layer eggplant parmigiana, whip up a citrus-inspired salad, and finish with quick tiramisù. Perfect for food lovers eager to master authentic flavors and cooking skills.

tours.name: Christmas with all the trimmings @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Master Christmas cooking in 3 hours with expert tips on turkey, perfect sides, and festive sauces. Hands-on class ends with you enjoying a delicious holiday feast at the chef’s table.

tours.name: Bread baking: Knead to Know @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Bake fresh, crusty bread in just 3 hours. Learn to knead, shape, and prove dough, then enjoy your homemade loaves with a delicious BLT. All ingredients and expert guidance included—bring your baking skills to life.

tours.name: An introduction to classic Italian cookery @ Islington HQ
