tours.description: Join an exhilarating 6-hour airsoft event featuring intense pistol and shotgun battles, complemented by a unique flea market for trading gear. With a welcoming atmosphere for all styles, from snipers to speedsofters, this experience promises thrilling gameplay and the chance to connect with fellow enthusiasts. Don't miss out!

tours.name: Guided Tour RWY to Bovisand
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking South West Coast Path from a unique water perspective with SWSUP. Paddle through secret coves, mystical woodlands, and stunning architecture, guided by an expert instructor. Enjoy a refreshing stop at Bovisand Cafe before returning to Plymouth, all while soaking in spectacular scenery and wildlife.

tours.name: Screen Free Family session (adults and child 5 and older)
tours.description: Join us for a day of adventure in the woods this school holiday! Enjoy games, explore nature, and toast marshmallows in a refreshing escape designed for families. Perfect for children aged 5 and up, this experience promises fun and connection in the great outdoors, fostering mental well-being for all.

tours.name: Airsoft
tours.description: Join an unforgettable 7.5-hour airsoft adventure in the forest, guided by an expert team. Experience the thrill of battle without the need for personal equipment, as everything is provided for you. Just remember to bring snacks to keep your energy up during this action-packed day!

tours.name: Kittywake Summer Boat Party
tours.description: Set sail on an unforgettable summer boat party along the Wigan Pier canal! Enjoy refreshing drinks, dance to DJ Tommy G & Pow's live set, and soak in stunning views. Embrace the *SUMMER VIBES* theme with your best Hawaiian attire as you create lasting memories with friends on this vibrant cruise.

tours.name: Moor Outdoor Kids Club
tours.description: Join our free weekly outdoor kids club for ages 8+ with activities like archery, mountain biking, bushcraft, team games, and more. Fun, skills, and fresh air await every week at Carhampton Recreation Centre.

tours.name: Hilden Brewery Tour Experience
tours.description: Experience a captivating 45-minute tour of Hilden Brewery, nestled in the historic grounds of Hilden House. Led by the head brewer, delve into the rich history and beer-making process, followed by a delightful lunch featuring authentic Irish stew and a selection of house-brewed beers in a charming café setting.

tours.name: Shake Up
tours.description: Swap wheels for fun in a lively arena of games like slacklining, archery, curling, and obstacle courses. Led by instructors, this 1.5-hour session transforms the skatepark into a playground of surprises for ages 6 and up.

tours.name: Fen & Marsh Orchids of Kenfig
tours.description: Join us for a captivating 6-hour exploration of Kenfig NNR, where you'll search for unique orchids, vibrant butterflies, and migratory birds. Experience the beauty of Fen Orchids and other rare species, enjoy guided walks through diverse habitats, and capture stunning photographs, all while soaking in the rich natural history of the area.

tours.name: Half day of activities
tours.description: Paddle along a peaceful canal then choose two exciting outdoor activities like climbing, archery, or zip wire at Kinver Scout Camp, all in a fun 3.5-hour adventure perfect for groups and schools.

tours.name: Experience Ride: Beadnell
tours.description: Join our e-Bike Experience Rides in Beadnell, Northumberland, for a unique opportunity to explore various electric bike models. Led by experts, this immersive hour-long ride allows you to test different bikes, learn about their features, and gain the confidence to choose the perfect e-Bike for your adventures in beautiful coastal scenery.

tours.name: e-Bike Hire: Beadnell
tours.description: Experience the charm of Beadnell with our e-Bike hire service. Explore stunning coastal paths, sandy beaches, and rolling countryside effortlessly on our state-of-the-art electric bicycles. Perfect for leisurely rides or adventurous explorations, this eco-friendly journey promises unforgettable memories amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Northumberland. Embrace the freedom of two wheels!

tours.name: Private River Exe Tour
tours.description: Experience a serene private cruise on The River Exe, where stunning scenery and wildlife await. Glide past Dawlish Warren and enjoy Exmouth's sandy seafront, all aboard a luxury Italian Rib. Relax with drinks, swim if you wish, and create unforgettable memories in this tranquil setting. Dogs are welcome too!

tours.name: Thai Street Food
tours.description: Create authentic Thai street food in just 3 hours! Learn to make Pad Thai, Curry, Spring Rolls, and Satay from scratch. Enjoy eating your creations and take home leftovers—perfect for food lovers and adventurous eaters.

tours.name: Vietnamese Street Food
tours.description: Create authentic Vietnamese street food from scratch in a lively 3-hour hands-on class. Learn to make dishes like spring rolls and pork meatballs, then enjoy your tasty creations in a fun, social setting.

tours.name: Tapas and Prosecco
tours.description: Join a lively 3-hour tapas class, learn to make crispy croquettes, gambas, and patatas bravas, then enjoy your creations with a glass of prosecco. Perfect for food lovers to socialize, cook, and indulge in authentic flavors.

tours.name: Pasta and Prosecco
tours.description: Create authentic pasta from scratch in a fun, hands-on 3-hour class. Make dough, ravioli, tortellini, and pesto, then enjoy your meal with a glass of prosecco. All ingredients and equipment provided—just bring your appetite!

tours.name: Sweet Treats
tours.description: Master the art of sweet treats like chocolate-dipped toffee, peanut brittle, and marshmallows in a fun 3-hour class. Make, taste, and take home your creations—perfect for sharing or gifting!

tours.name: Mexican Street Food
tours.description: Create authentic Mexican dishes like tortillas, Adobo beef, and more in a fun, hands-on 3-hour class. Eat your creations, learn new skills, and enjoy a lively evening without washing up. Perfect for food lovers of all levels.

tours.name: Middle Eastern Street Food
tours.description: Create authentic Middle Eastern street food like falafel, hummus, and pita in a fun, hands-on 3-hour class. Eat what you make, learn new flavors, and take home recipes—perfect for adventurous food lovers.

tours.name: Tex Mex
tours.description: Create vibrant Tex-Mex dishes like tacos, quesadillas, and tostadas from scratch. Learn to grill, flavor, and assemble colorful street food perfect for summer gatherings—enjoy, eat, and take home your creations.

tours.name: East Asian Fusion
tours.description: Master vibrant Asian flavors in 3 hours with dishes like Korean fried chicken, satay, and spring rolls. Cook fresh, tasty recipes from scratch, enjoy sampling, and take home leftovers—perfect for spice lovers and food adventurers.

tours.name: Couples Night Thai Street Food
tours.description: Cook up authentic Thai street food with your partner in a fun 3-hour class. Make Pad Thai, Curry, Satay, and Spring Rolls, then enjoy your creations together in a lively, hands-on experience.

tours.name: Couples Mexican Street food
tours.description: Cook authentic Mexican street food with your partner in a fun 3-hour class. Make dishes like adobo beef, tortillas, guacamole, and ceviche, then enjoy your creations together in a lively, hands-on experience.

tours.name: Beef Wellington Masterclass
tours.description: Learn to make stunning Beef Wellington in just 3 hours, mastering searing, mushroom duxelles, and perfect assembly. Leave with a homemade Wellington and recipe pack—ready to impress at your next celebration.

tours.name: Doughnut Workshop
tours.description: Create irresistible, handmade doughnuts in a fun 3-hour class. Learn to make fillings, shape, and cook treats, then take home a box of delicious, fresh doughnuts—perfect for adventurous food lovers.

tours.name: The Fish Course
tours.description: Join a hands-on, 5-hour fish cooking course designed to boost your culinary confidence! Learn essential skills like filleting and scaling, while preparing delicious dishes with fresh, locally sourced seafood. Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, expert demonstrations, and the chance to savor your creations—all while expanding your kitchen repertoire.

tours.name: Mexican Street Food To Go
tours.description: Join a vibrant 2.5-hour class to master authentic Mexican street food! Create delicious dishes like tacos al pastor and fresh guacamole while learning about unique flavors and ingredients. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere with no cleanup, and take your culinary creations home for dinner. Perfect for adventurous food lovers!

tours.name: Essential Knife Skills
tours.description: Join our Essential Knife Skills course for an immersive 4-hour experience that transforms your cooking confidence! Learn from an expert chef as you master techniques from butchery to filleting, enjoy hands-on practice, and savor the delicious dishes you create. Perfect for adventurous eaters, this course promises a memorable culinary journey!

tours.name: The Bread Course
tours.description: Join the Bread Course for an immersive 6-hour experience where you'll master the art of bread making, from Sourdough to Cinnamon buns. Perfect for beginners and seasoned bakers alike, this hands-on class offers expert guidance, delicious recipes, and a box of your freshly baked creations to take home.

tours.name: The World Bread Course
tours.description: Embark on a global baking adventure in this 6-hour course, perfect for aspiring bakers eager to enhance their skills. Learn to create a variety of breads, from classic baguettes to Japanese milk bread, while enjoying a light lunch. No cleanup required—just bring your passion for baking and leave with delicious treats!

tours.name: The Kent Cookery Course
tours.description: Join a lively 5-hour cookery class celebrating Kent’s seasonal produce. Hands-on fun, expert tips, and delicious local dishes—enjoy eating your creations and take home recipes, all in a relaxed, friendly setting.

tours.name: Taste of India with Hari Ghotra
tours.description: Dive into a flavorful journey with this immersive 6-hour curry cooking course. Guided by expert Hari, you'll master authentic Indian dishes like Chicken Tikka Masala and traditional desserts, all while learning essential spice techniques. Enjoy your creations for lunch and take home leftovers, making this a unique culinary adventure.

tours.name: Indian BBQ with Hari Ghotra
tours.description: Join a vibrant 5-hour cooking class with Hari Ghotra, where you'll master delicious Indian BBQ dishes perfect for summer gatherings. Using traditional techniques, you'll create mouthwatering Tandoori and crispy Rotis, all while enjoying a social and interactive atmosphere. Leave inspired to impress friends and family with your culinary skills!

tours.name: Thai Street Food To Go
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Thai cuisine with this engaging 2.5-hour cooking class. Learn to create beloved street food dishes like Pad Thai and Chicken Satay, while discovering authentic ingredients and flavors. Enjoy a social cooking experience, take home your delicious creations, and expand your culinary repertoire!

tours.name: Curry Club to Go
tours.description: Join us for a vibrant 2.5-hour cooking class where you'll master the art of creating a delicious curry from scratch. Learn authentic recipes, blend spices with confidence, and enjoy a fun, interactive experience with fellow food lovers. Take home your culinary creations for a delightful dinner!

tours.name: Taste of Tokyo To Go
tours.description: Join a 2.5-hour culinary adventure where you'll learn to create three iconic Japanese dishes: Chicken Katsu Curry, Okonomiyaki, and Gyoza. Under the guidance of friendly tutor Jethro, you'll master authentic recipes and take home your delicious creations in takeaway boxes, perfect for impressing friends and family at dinner.

tours.name: Adult & Child Thai Cooking
tours.description: Cook up three delicious, authentic dishes in a fun, hands-on 3-hour class. Learn flavor balancing, make perfect Pad Thai, and take home your creations—no washing up, just tasty memories and new skills.

tours.name: Adult & Child Pizza Making
tours.description: Create authentic Neapolitan pizza from scratch in a fun 3-hour class. Learn to shape dough, make perfect crusts, and enjoy your homemade lunch. All ingredients, tools, and takeaway boxes included—just bring your enthusiasm!

tours.name: Adult & Child Pasta Making
tours.description: Create fresh pasta from scratch, learn to roll and shape dough, and make basil pesto in a fun, hands-on 3-hour class. Take home your delicious creations—no washing up, just tasty memories and family sharing.

tours.name: Adult & Child Sushi Making
tours.description: Create sushi masterpieces like California rolls and sashimi in a fun 3-hour class with expert guidance. Make, eat, and take home a delicious platter—no washing up, just hands-on fun for budding chefs aged 8-15.

tours.name: Private Party 3 Hour Session
tours.description: Create unforgettable moments with a 3-hour themed cooking class—from Mexican tacos to tapas, macarons, or Indian curries. Enjoy delicious food, a welcome drink, and a fun, hands-on experience perfect for celebrations.

tours.name: Half-Day Team Building
tours.description: Experience a unique team-building adventure with a hands-on cooking session that fosters collaboration and creativity. Guided by a friendly tutor, you'll master authentic recipes while enjoying tea, coffee, and a welcome glass of Prosecco. Celebrate your culinary creations together, with the option for a competitive twist and prize giving!

tours.name: Plant-Based Cooking
tours.description: Create vibrant vegan dishes from fresh Kent ingredients in just 3 hours. Cook flavorful recipes like chickpea curry and falafel, enjoy eating your creations, and take home a recipe pack—no experience needed.

tours.name: Calling of Arunachal
tours.description: Join an exhilarating cinematic journey with "Calling of Arunachal," where seven fearless kayakers tackle the breathtaking rapids of Arunachal Pradesh. Filmmaker Eirik Hansen captures their epic adventure on the Brahmaputra river, showcasing their courage against nature's might. Experience the thrill of this unforgettable kayaking odyssey!

tours.name: Amsterdam Voyage
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey aboard EXCELSIOR, one of Lowestoft's last operational Smacks. Experience the thrill of sailing to Amsterdam, where you can enjoy vibrant nightlife and explore the city's charm. With expert crew coaching, this unique adventure promises lasting memories for all sailing enthusiasts, regardless of experience.

tours.name: Adult & Child Mexican Cooking
tours.description: Cook a vibrant Mexican feast in 3 hours! Make fresh tortillas, guacamole, tacos, and more with expert guidance. No washing up—just fun, flavorful dishes to share and take home. Perfect for young foodies.

tours.name: Middle Eastern To Go
tours.description: Experience the vibrant flavors of the Middle East in this hands-on cooking course! Over 2.5 hours, you'll create delicious street food classics like Tabbouleh, Hummus, and Falafel, all while learning authentic recipes from a friendly tutor. Enjoy a relaxing afternoon and take your culinary creations home for dinner!

tours.name: Weekend Sailing Trip
tours.description: Escape the hustle of the week with a Friday evening getaway at Ipswich Haven Marina. Join Excelsior for a relaxing dinner aboard, meet the crew, and unwind before an exhilarating day of sailing on Saturday. Experience the thrill of the open water and return rejuvenated on Sunday.

tours.name: Trinity May Ball Fireworks - Shared Boat - Monday 22 June
tours.description: Watch Trinity’s fireworks light up the sky from a cozy shared punt, with stunning choreography and music creating a truly romantic, unforgettable night on the water.

tours.name: Trinity May Ball Fireworks - Private Boat - Monday 22 June
tours.description: Watch Trinity’s fireworks light up the sky from a private punt, blending stunning choreography and music for a truly romantic, unforgettable 2-hour experience on the water.

tours.name: Row Boat Hire - The Barnaby John
tours.description: Set sail on Loe Beach in the Barnaby John rowboat, perfect for exploring creeks or visiting The Pandora Inn. Enjoy a flexible hire with safety gear, tips, and a scenic adventure tailored to your day.

tours.name: Sunrise Tour
tours.description: Watch the sunrise over Wells Harbour, with vibrant orange skies and warm morning light. Glide past beach huts and coastline, then return in time for breakfast—an unforgettable start to your day.

tours.name: The Cloak And Dagger Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 3-hour private tour that delves into London's dark history, blending captivating storytelling with theatrical performances. Starting at The George Inn, you'll encounter chilling tales and historical figures, culminating in a dramatic reenactment of a true murder story by the fire, making for an unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Historic Holywood Walking Tour
tours.description: Discover the rich history of Holywood on a captivating 1.5-hour walking tour. From ancient monks to Viking settlers, explore the town's intriguing past while enjoying scenic views. With a special discount at Alexanders for food, this experience promises to be both educational and delightful. Dress comfortably for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Giants Causeway tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 5-hour journey from Belfast to the stunning Giants Causeway. Enjoy breathtaking views at Carrick-a-Rede rope bridge and Ballintoy Harbour, then explore the iconic hexagonal stones of the Causeway. This private tour offers a unique blend of natural beauty and adventure, perfect for those seeking an unforgettable experience.

tours.name: Indian Street Food @ Islington HQ
tours.description: Create authentic Indian street food with expert guidance—learn to make spicy tandoori chicken, fluffy naan, zingy salsa, and panipuri. Enjoy a flavorful feast at the chef’s table and take home your recipes.

tours.name: Education Sessions
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure that combines breathtaking scenery with thrilling challenges. Experience the rush of adrenaline as you navigate through stunning landscapes, creating memories that will last a lifetime. This unique journey promises excitement and exploration, making it a must-do for any adventure seeker.

tours.name: Experience Ride: County Durham
tours.description: Join our free e-Bike Experience Rides in Consett for an hour of exploration and education! Test ride various electric bike models, guided by our expert team, and discover the perfect fit for your cycling needs. Empower yourself with knowledge and confidence to enhance your biking adventures in a beautiful rural setting.

tours.name: REC 16hr Outdoor First Aid
tours.description: Join the REC outdoor first aid course for an engaging blend of theory and practical scenarios that prepare you for real-life emergencies. Learn essential skills like CPR, injury management, and environmental awareness in a supportive environment. This certified course is a stepping stone into the REC scheme, ensuring you’re ready for any situation.

tours.name: Rescue 3 WRT-Pro
tours.description: Enhance your white water skills with a 3-day professional rescue course. Tackle advanced techniques, learn to save lives, and boost confidence in challenging rapids at the National White Water Centre.

tours.name: Bloom Family Special - Minehead First School
tours.description: Join us for the Bloom Family Special, a vibrant outdoor session designed for children with SEND needs. Enjoy an obstacle course, bouncy castle, and water games at Minehead First School. Bring a blanket and picnic, and create unforgettable memories with your family while having fun in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Bloom - School Years 3+
tours.description: A calming 4-hour session for children with SEND, offering a quiet space with toys, Lego, and activities, plus a hot lunch. Kids can relax or join holiday fun—no parents needed, just a safe, inclusive environment.

tours.name: First Flips: FREE Adult Beginner Skateboard Taster
tours.description: Experience the thrill of skateboarding in a relaxed, adult-only taster session! Join a small group of beginners for an hour of expert instruction from Minehead Eye's skate tutor, Albert. Enjoy complimentary equipment hire and unwind at the onsite café with drinks and pizza after your skateboarding adventure.

tours.name: Filled Pasta Workshop
tours.description: Join a delightful 2.5-hour pasta-making course where you'll create fresh pasta from scratch! Learn to make dough, roll, stuff ravioli and tortellini, and whip up delicious dressings like pesto. Enjoy a hands-on experience, take home your culinary creations, and savor the joy of cooking in a social setting.

tours.name: Adult & Child Doughnuts
tours.description: Create delicious handmade doughnuts in a fun 3-hour class, learning to make fillings, shape, and cook. Leave with a box of treats, recipes, and new skills—perfect for young foodies eager to get hands-on.

tours.name: Santa Train
tours.description: Experience the magic of the season with a delightful train ride where children can meet Santa and share their last-minute gift wishes. Enjoy festive treats on board, and after two scenic laps, visit Santa's Grotto for a special present. This enchanting adventure promises unforgettable holiday memories!

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (Birmingham)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 90-minute adventure through Birmingham as you help Dennis and friends find the mischievous Gnasher! Solve fun puzzles, follow clues, and enjoy a leisurely walk with no time limit. This unique outdoor game combines digital assistance with beloved comic characters for an unforgettable family experience.

tours.description: Embark on an exciting 90-minute adventure through Manchester as you help Dennis and friends find the mischievous Gnasher! Solve fun puzzles and follow clues at your own pace, enjoying breaks for snacks along the way. This unique outdoor game combines exploration with beloved comic characters for a memorable family experience.

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (Norwich)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in Norwich as you help Dennis find his mischievous dog, Gnasher! This interactive outdoor game combines walking with fun puzzles and challenges, all guided by a mobile app featuring beloved Beano characters. Enjoy a leisurely pace with no time limit, making it perfect for families.

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (Leeds)
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in Leeds as you help Dennis find his mischievous dog, Gnasher! This interactive walking game combines fun puzzles and challenges with the charm of Beano characters. Enjoy a leisurely pace with no time limit, making it perfect for families seeking a memorable day out.

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (Bath)
tours.description: Embark on an exciting 90-minute adventure through Bath as you help Dennis and friends find the mischievous Gnasher! Solve fun puzzles and follow clues at your own pace, enjoying breaks along the way. This unique outdoor game combines exploration with beloved Beano characters, making it a memorable experience for all ages.

tours.name: Beano: The Outdoor Game (Newcastle)
tours.description: Embark on an exciting adventure through Newcastle as you help Dennis find his mischievous dog, Gnasher! This interactive outdoor game combines walking, puzzles, and comic characters, allowing you to explore at your own pace. Perfect for families, it promises fun and teamwork without a time limit.

tours.name: Moroccan Flavours
tours.description: Learn to cook authentic Moroccan dishes like tagine and couscous from scratch in a lively 3-hour class. Enjoy your creations, take leftovers home, and impress friends with your new culinary skills.

tours.name: Moroccan Flavours To Go
tours.description: Experience the vibrant flavors of Morocco in this exciting 2.5-hour cooking class! Learn to create traditional dishes like Khobz bread and tagine from scratch, using fresh, local ingredients. Enjoy a hands-on, social atmosphere while taking home your delicious creations. Perfect for adventurous eaters looking to impress at their next dinner party!

tours.name: Festive Couples Cooking
tours.description: Experience a memorable 3-hour cooking class this festive season, where you’ll create a delicious main course and dessert from scratch. Enjoy a fun, interactive atmosphere with no cleanup required, allowing you to savor both the food and each other's company. Perfect for couples, friends, or family!

tours.name: Festive Italian Treats
tours.description: Join a delightful 2.5-hour hands-on cooking class where you'll master the art of creating classic Italian sweet treats like Tiramisu, Cannoli, and Biscotti. Perfect for adventurous foodies, this adults-only experience allows you to take home your delicious creations while enjoying a fun, interactive atmosphere. All ingredients and equipment are provided!

tours.name: All The Trimmings
tours.description: Join this engaging cooking course to master the art of a stress-free, show-stopping Christmas dinner! Learn essential tips for perfect roasts, festive sides, and classic sauces while gaining confidence in your culinary skills. Enjoy a social atmosphere, all ingredients provided, and take home delicious leftovers. Perfect for adventurous foodies!

tours.name: Vietnamese Street Food To Go
tours.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Vietnamese street food in this hands-on cooking class. Guided by a professional chef, you'll create authentic dishes like Moo Ping and Prawn Spring Rolls from scratch. Enjoy a social atmosphere, take home your culinary creations, and expand your cooking repertoire with fresh, delicious flavors.

tours.name: Frosty Festivities in Santa’s Workshop
tours.description: Meet over 40 exotic animals in lush surroundings, then pose with fairy tale princesses and receive a Christmas gift from Santa’s Workshop. A magical holiday adventure perfect for the whole family.

tours.name: Prestwick Airport 2 Hour Walking Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique 2-hour walking tour of Prestwick Airfield, exploring its vibrant history from 1913 to today. Discover the evolution of aviation, from early pioneers to modern transatlantic travel, while enjoying complimentary teas and a souvenir brochure. Experience the fascinating coexistence of civilian and military aviation over eight decades.

tours.name: Londra sulle sponde del Tamigi - Tour di Gruppo
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4-hour walking tour along the historic banks of the River Thames. Discover London's iconic landmarks like Big Ben and Tower Bridge while delving into the city's rich history. Experience the transformation of areas like Canary Wharf, blending ancient charm with modern architecture, guided in Italian for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Londra sulle sponde del Tamigi - Tour Privato
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4-hour private walking tour along the Thames, tailored to your interests. Discover London's rich history as you explore iconic landmarks like Big Ben and Tower Bridge, while learning about the river's transformation. Experience the blend of historic charm and modern architecture at Canary Wharf, making unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Londra tra antico e moderno - Tour di Gruppo
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 4-hour walking tour of London, where ancient history meets modern marvels. Explore the Roman roots of Londinium, admire iconic sites like the Tower of London and Tower Bridge, and discover contemporary gems like the Shard. Enjoy a culinary stop at Borough Market for a truly memorable experience.

tours.name: Tour Privato personalizzato
tours.description: Experience London like never before with a personalized private tour in Italian, tailored to your interests. With a maximum of 10 participants, enjoy exclusive access to a knowledgeable guide who will reveal the city's history and creativity. Discover iconic landmarks and create unforgettable memories in this vibrant metropolis.

tours.name: The Fundamentals of Wellbeing Through Nutrition
tours.description: Join this transformative 6-week course to discover the essentials of good nutrition and break free from dieting. Led by Jen, you'll learn to nourish your body effectively and gain the tools to maintain a healthy lifestyle beyond the sessions. Embrace a new approach to wellness and empowerment!

tours.name: Nutrition Support for MSK Conditions
tours.description: Join a transformative 6-week course designed to alleviate pain from musculoskeletal conditions through nutrition. Each 45-minute session will explore simple dietary changes that promote healing and reduce inflammation, empowering you to enhance your well-being and manage symptoms effectively. Discover the healing power of food tailored to your needs.

tours.name: Supporting Emotional Wellbeing Through Nutrition
tours.description: Join this transformative 6-week course to explore the vital connection between physical health and emotional wellbeing. Discover how physical imbalances can affect your mood and anxiety, and learn practical strategies to enhance your mental state. Elevate your emotional health through simple yet effective lifestyle changes.

tours.name: Liverpool: The Dark Side Tour
tours.description: Join the spine-chilling Halloween walking tour in Liverpool, where you'll uncover the city's dark history filled with murderers, witches, and restless spirits. Led by an engaging local guide, explore haunting sites like St. George’s Hall and Covent Garden, and hear chilling tales that will leave you captivated and spooked.

tours.name: Tour dei pub storici di Londra con cena
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour journey through London's historic pubs, where you'll uncover hidden alleys and the rich culture behind these iconic establishments. Enjoy a unique experience led by an Italian guide, visiting four ancient pubs cherished by literary greats like Charles Dickens, all while soaking in the city's vibrant atmosphere.

tours.name: e-Bike Hire - Durham
tours.description: Experience the stunning North Pennines like never before with our e-Bike hire. Explore offroad paths, conquer moorland trails, and immerse yourself in the rolling countryside. Perfect for all riders, our eco-friendly e-Bikes promise an exhilarating adventure, allowing you to create unforgettable memories in this breathtaking region.

tours.name: Juniors Mariners Mile
tours.description: Join us for a thrilling swim event on September 23, 2023, supporting ESSEX and HERTS Air Ambulance! Competitors aged 10 to 13 can tackle a 300m or 150m loop, receiving a Mariners Mile Swim Hat and Mug. Dive in for an unforgettable experience while making a difference!

tours.name: Paddle, Chat & Coffee (Tonbridge)
tours.description: Escape the daily grind with a serene 1.5-hour paddle along the picturesque river Medway. Perfect for unwinding, this experience allows you to connect with friends while soaking in the beautiful scenery. After your paddle, enjoy a hot drink and relax, making it a memorable day of leisure and conversation.

tours.name: Réalta
tours.description: Join Réalta and Myles McCormack for a lively mix of traditional and modern Irish tunes, featuring energetic reels, soulful airs, and stirring songs that celebrate Ireland’s rich musical heritage.

tours.name: Halloween Ghost Walk
tours.description: Step into Stratford’s haunted past on a 1.5-hour ghost walk with lively guides sharing spooky tales of witches, ghosts, and murder. Dress up, bring an umbrella, and enjoy a fun, eerie adventure through history’s dark side.

tours.name: Tour Navideño
tours.description: Explore London's most stunning Christmas lights and secret decorated corners on a 2-hour tour. Walk from Bond Street to Carnaby Street, uncover festive traditions, and enjoy the magic of the holiday season.

tours.name: e-Bike Consultation: Durham
tours.description: Discover the perfect e-Bike for your lifestyle with a personalized consultation. This relaxed conversation allows you to explore your needs and gain confidence before hitting the road. Receive expert insights and essential information to make an informed choice, ensuring your investment aligns perfectly with your biking aspirations.

tours.name: Meet the unicorn experience
tours.description: Embark on a magical 40-minute journey to meet a real unicorn at Somerset Reindeer Ranch! Your child will be enchanted as they travel through an enchanted wardrobe to a glade, where a story is shared, and a luxury unicorn soft toy awaits. Create unforgettable memories in this exclusive experience!

tours.name: Introduction to White Water Canoeing
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling one-day whitewater canoeing adventure! Perfect for beginners, this course teaches essential paddling skills and rapid navigation under the guidance of experienced instructors. Enjoy a day filled with fun, learning, and safety while exploring the excitement of paddling on the river with all equipment provided.

tours.name: ONE OFF - Autumn Wreaths!
tours.description: Join us for a cozy autumn wreath workshop where you'll craft stunning wreaths using fresh foliage from the farm. Enjoy hot chocolates and coffees as you create your masterpiece with provided materials and expert guidance. Embrace the season's beauty and leave with a unique, Instagram-worthy decoration for your door.

tours.name: Youth Worship event with WOLT and YFC
tours.description: Join the Wiltshire Outdoor Learning Team and Youth For Christ for an unforgettable day of adventure and connection! Engage in thrilling activities like axe throwing, archery, and climbing, followed by a delicious BBQ dinner. Conclude the day with uplifting worship and a meaningful message, all while forging new friendships.

tours.name: Carnfunnock's Halloween Trail 2024
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure along the Carnfunnock Cauldron of Chaos Trail, where you'll encounter spooky live Halloween characters while searching for the Wicked Witch's missing potion ingredients. Use your decipher to crack codes and uncover hidden surprises. Dress up and prepare for a memorable quest filled with eerie excitement!

tours.name: WRT-PRO
tours.description: Join the Rescue3 WRT Pro course for an immersive three-day experience, from 09:30 to 16:30, tailored for aspiring raft guides and kayak instructors. Gain essential skills and knowledge to confidently handle water rescue scenarios, making this a vital training opportunity for those passionate about water safety and adventure.

tours.name: Adult & Child Curry Club
tours.description: Join your little chef for a hands-on culinary adventure, creating authentic Indian dishes like Korma and Chicken Tikka Masala under the guidance of expert chef Hari Ghotra. Enjoy a fun, interactive experience with no cleanup required, while discovering the art of blending spices and flavors in a vibrant kitchen setting.

tours.name: Lunch Dome Hire
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable dining adventure in our exclusive riverside Private Dining Domes, accommodating up to six guests. Enjoy stunning views of the River Thames and Folly Bridge while savoring your meal in a cozy, warm setting. Make lasting memories in this unique and intimate atmosphere for two hours.

tours.name: Afternoon Tea Dome Hire
tours.description: Experience an exclusive riverside dining adventure in our Private Dining Domes, perfect for groups of up to 6. Enjoy stunning views of the River Thames and Folly Bridge while savoring your meal in a cozy, warm setting. Book your dome for two hours of unforgettable dining in the heart of Oxford.

tours.name: Magheramorne Estate Festive Fair
tours.description: Join us for the enchanting Festive Fair, featuring local artisans and delicious homemade treats in a cozy setting. Enjoy live Christmas entertainment, explore unique gifts, and savor delights from Jane's Kitchen. With a woodland walk and exciting hamper giveaways, this two-day event promises to create unforgettable holiday memories.

tours.name: Morning Coffee Sail - Blackwater Estuary | Maldon
tours.description: Glide on a vintage barge through tranquil estuary waters, passing islands, colorful huts, and historic sites. Relax, enjoy scenic views, and savor a sweet treat or drink on this peaceful 2-hour sail.

tours.name: Golf & Hiking Experience | Hainault Forest
tours.description: Experience two hours of relaxation at Hainault Golf Club, where you can stroll through stunning parkland and tackle the challenges of hilly courses with breathtaking views of London. Conclude your day at the driving range, enjoying a leisurely tee-off, with options for refreshments afterward. Perfect for a weekend escape!

tours.name: Family Fun Adventures | Hainault Forest
tours.description: Experience a thrilling day in the great outdoors at Hainault and Epping Forest! With over 300 acres to explore, enjoy activities like rowing on the lake, navigating adventure trails, and discovering wildlife. Perfect for families, this adventure promises fun, learning, and unforgettable memories in nature's embrace.

tours.name: Cocktail Class & Bombay Sapphire Gin Factory
tours.description: Experience the enchanting Bombay Sapphire Distillery, nestled in Whitchurch's scenic countryside. Discover the rich history of this 10th-century mill, learn the art of gin distillation, and enjoy a cocktail masterclass with expert guidance. Stroll along the picturesque River Test, blending nature, history, and the allure of Bombay Sapphire Gin.

tours.name: 11 Day Winter Escape Tour to Ghana
tours.description: Experience the vibrant culture and stunning landscapes of Ghana on an unforgettable 11-day adventure. From the bustling capital of Accra to the historic Cape Coast and the cultural heart of Kumasi, enjoy beach escapes, music festivals, and traditional cuisine, all while connecting with the warm-hearted locals and exploring breathtaking natural wonders.

tours.name: Bristol City Weekend
tours.description: Experience a weekend in Bristol filled with culture and indulgence. Enjoy a warm welcome at the Marriott hotel, savor fine dining, and immerse yourself in the city's rich history with a guided tour. Highlights include the iconic Clifton suspension bridge and the option for afternoon tea or a crafted beer experience.

tours.name: Waddesdon Manor Exclusive Wine Cellar Cheese Tasting and Garden Tour
tours.description: Experience a unique one-day guided tour at Waddesdon Manor, featuring an exclusive wine cellar tour and tasting of eight exquisite Rothschild wines paired with gourmet deli-boards and cheeses. Enjoy a leisurely exploration of the stunning gardens and indulge in delightful refreshments, all within the enchanting setting of a French Renaissance chateau.

tours.name: Mini Golf
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating indoor mini golf adventure featuring 18 uniquely challenging holes filled with whimsical obstacles and mind-bending mazes. Enjoy interactive scorecards and compete for prizes, making every round memorable. Gather your friends and family for a delightful experience where fun and friendly competition await!

tours.name: Axe Throwing
tours.description: Test your aim and unleash your inner lumberjack in a safe, fun indoor axe-throwing session. Whether a beginner or pro, hit bullseyes, share laughs, and create unforgettable moments in just 30 or 45 minutes.

tours.name: Archery
tours.description: Step into the thrill of indoor archery, where you’ll aim, release, and hit the bullseye in just 30 or 45 minutes. Feel the excitement as arrows fly and targets are conquered—perfect for fun, focus, and friendly competition.

tours.name: Birthday Parties
tours.description: Celebrate your birthday at Level Up Warrington with a fun-filled party. Call us to customize your experience and make unforgettable memories at 3A Buttermarket Street.

tours.name: Sea Master Fishing Boat - Hire By The Hour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of self-driving a boat for six hours, perfect for up to four people. With buoyancy aids, oars, and mud weights included, you’ll feel secure while exploring. Enjoy a pet-friendly adventure, complete with easy-to-follow tuition, making it an unforgettable day on the water.

tours.name: Sea Master Fishing Boat - Hire By The Day
tours.description: Experience the thrill of self-driving a boat for up to 14 days, perfect for small groups or families. With buoyancy aids, oars, and mud weights included, you’ll be ready for adventure. Enjoy pet-friendly outings and easy operation with a quick tuition session before setting sail into unforgettable waters.

tours.name: Oxford Walking Ghost Tour 👻
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 90-minute ghost tour through Oxford's eerie streets, where chilling tales of executions, murder, and the devil await. This interactive experience, inspired by Derren Brown, promises immersive storytelling and unexpected jump scares. Join us for a night of spine-tingling adventure—if you dare!

tours.name: All day sailing: Lowestoft-Harwich
tours.description: Experience a memorable day at sea aboard Excelsior, heading to the renowned Harwich International Shanty Festival. Enjoy a night on the ship, complete with delicious meals, and wake up to a hearty breakfast before continuing your journey or relaxing in cozy B&B accommodations. Don't miss this unique sailing adventure!

tours.name: Last chance sail! Harwich to Lowestoft
tours.description: Experience a memorable evening aboard Excelsior on October 13th, featuring a delightful dinner and the vibrant Harwich International Festival finales. Set sail early the next morning, returning to Lowestoft by late evening. Enjoy all meals included as you create lasting memories on this unique maritime adventure.

tours.name: Wittgenstein and Friends Walking Tour
tours.description: Walk through Cambridge’s streets and explore Ludwig Wittgenstein’s world, from logic to language. Engage in lively debates, see key sites, and challenge your thinking in just 2 hours of eye-opening discovery.

tours.name: In The Footsteps Of A Murderer Walking Tour
tours.description: Step back to Victorian Cambridge with a 2-hour walking tour. Meet colorful characters, explore social history, and follow Emma Rolfe’s footsteps through gas-lit streets and hidden stories of 19th-century life.

tours.name: Intro to Flat Water SUP
tours.description: Paddle along the scenic Llangollen canal, balancing on a board surrounded by lush Welsh waterways. Perfect for all ages, with expert guidance, safety gear, and a fun, memorable adventure in North Wales’ stunning countryside.

tours.name: Coached Flat Water SUP
tours.description: Enhance your paddle boarding skills in a personalized 3-hour lesson led by certified instructors. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine specific techniques, this tailored experience includes all necessary equipment and expert guidance. Join us at Llangollen Sports Club for an unforgettable day on the water!

tours.name: Evening Social SUP Paddle
tours.description: Experience the thrill of stand-up paddleboarding in Llangollen every Wednesday evening this summer! Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere while catching up with friends on the water. With safety briefings and all necessary equipment provided, this unique social event promises fun, fitness, and stunning surroundings. Join us for an unforgettable evening!

tours.name: SUP Yoga
tours.description: Experience a unique blend of relaxation and adventure on the Llangollen canal with a two-hour paddle board yoga tour. Perfect for all skill levels, this session combines gentle yoga games with paddling to enhance performance and reduce stress, all guided by certified instructors in a serene natural setting.

tours.name: Intro to White Water SUP
tours.description: Experience the thrill of white water stand up paddleboarding in the UK! This unique 3-hour session, led by certified instructors, takes you from calm waters to exhilarating rapids. Perfect for groups, it offers tailored coaching and all necessary equipment, ensuring an unforgettable adventure on the river. Conquer the waves together!

tours.name: Coached White Water SUP - Half Day
tours.description: Elevate your paddle boarding skills with a thrilling 3-hour white water coaching session led by top UK instructors. Perfect for those with prior SUP experience, you'll master rapids, refine your technique, and learn essential safety skills. Enjoy personalized coaching and leave equipped with valuable tips to enhance your paddling journey.

tours.name: Archery
tours.description: Experience the thrill of archery in a stunning countryside setting by the River Dee! Perfect for families and friends, this 2.5-hour session offers expert guidance for all skill levels. Learn proper techniques, enjoy fun games, and create lasting memories while shooting arrows in a picturesque location.

tours.name: British Canoeing SUP White Water Discipline Specific Training (DST)
tours.description: Embark on a transformative two-day journey with the SUP White Water Coach Award, designed for those eager to enhance their coaching skills in river running. This hands-on course blends theory with practical application, empowering you to create engaging, safe coaching sessions while guiding paddlers through the exhilarating challenges of white water.

tours.name: British Canoeing SUP White Water Personal Performance Award
tours.description: Experience the thrill of SUP white water paddling over two exhilarating days! Master essential skills like direction control and body alignment while navigating dynamic river conditions. With personalized coaching and no formal assessments, each session is unique, ensuring continuous learning and growth. Join us in Llangollen for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: Coached White Water SUP - Full Day
tours.description: Elevate your paddleboarding skills with a full day of expert coaching on white water. Learn to navigate rapids safely while enhancing your footwork, posture, and paddle techniques. With tailored instruction from certified coaches, you'll gain essential skills and confidence for your paddling journey, all while enjoying a thrilling outdoor experience.

tours.name: Magical Elevator to Santa
tours.description: Experience the magic of Christmas by taking a ride in Ellie, the enchanting elevator, to visit Santa in his festive grotto. Enjoy a whimsical journey above the clouds and capture memorable moments with Santa. Plus, explore a variety of entertainment, shopping, and dining options at Castlepoint for a perfect holiday outing.

tours.name: *SOLD OUT* Santas Grotto For 3-4 Children
tours.description: Embark on a magical journey through a mystery trail to meet Santa in his enchanting Grotto. Enjoy a personal visit with family, capture memories with your own photos, and receive special gifts, including a present and a personalized letter. Experience the joy of Christmas in a unique and memorable way!

tours.name: Level Up Comic Con
tours.description: Join the first annual Comic Con cosplay meetup with 11 hours of fun! Play mini golf in a friendly, safe environment while celebrating your favorite characters and making new friends.

tours.name: Overnight Taster Sail Lowestoft - Grimsby
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable overnight adventure aboard the Excelsior this May Bank Holiday! Experience a thrilling two-day sail from Lowestoft to Grimsby, perfect for those seeking a challenging introduction to sailing. Enjoy training, team spirit, and the excitement of wild seas, all while making memories on the open water.

tours.name: Stratford-Upon-Avon: The Dark Side Tour
tours.description: Uncover Stratford’s dark history on a 1.5-hour Halloween tour filled with ghost stories, witchcraft, murders, and plague horrors. Walk haunted streets and graveyards as chilling tales of terror come to life. Book early—limited spots!

tours.name: City and Essex Countryside Tour With Lunch | London
tours.description: Experience the vibrant pulse of London, where iconic landmarks like St Paul’s Cathedral and the Shard meet rich culture and history. Explore bustling squares, indulge in world-class dining, and immerse yourself in a dynamic nightlife. With endless activities and events, London promises unforgettable adventures throughout the year.

tours.name: Amazing Hike of Historic London Trail | London & Wapping
tours.description: Embark on a captivating walking tour through London's historic Chancery Lane, exploring iconic sites like Lincoln's Inn Fields and the Old Bailey. Discover the city's rich literary and legal heritage, enjoy stunning views at St. Paul’s Churchyard, and savor a delightful lunch at the charming Prospect of Whitby pub.

tours.name: Beezley Falls Canyon Ingleton
tours.description: Experience the thrill of canyoning in Ingleton's stunning Yorkshire Dales! This flagship adventure features exhilarating big jumps, exciting slides, and challenging abseils. Spend a full day immersed in nature while equipped with state-of-the-art gear, making unforgettable memories with family and friends. Perfect for adventurers of all ages!

tours.name: Twiss Canyon
tours.description: Experience the thrill of our Most Extreme Canyon adventure, featuring the biggest jumps, abseils, and slides. This 8-hour challenge is designed for those who have conquered previous canyons. Bring your courage and up to two children for an unforgettable day of excitement and breathtaking views.

tours.name: Park Foot Summer Camp
tours.description: Kids enjoy three fun-filled days of archery, paddleboarding, raft building, and bushcraft. Perfect for summer holidays, this camp offers adventure, skills, and outdoor fun in a safe, lively environment. Limited spots!

tours.name: History of Prestwick Airport Virtual Tour
tours.description: Experience the rich history of Prestwick Airport from home with our guided virtual tour. Enjoy captivating under-wing footage as we explore the airport's past and present, sharing fascinating stories and current happenings. This unique journey lasts 1 to 1.5 hours, making it an exciting adventure for aviation enthusiasts.

tours.name: Santa Canoe Aqueduct Tour
tours.description: Join us for a unique 2-hour canoeing adventure on the Llangollen Canal! Experience the thrill of paddling over the world’s highest aqueduct while enjoying stunning views of the Dee Valley. With a festive twist, you'll don a silly Santa hat and savor a delicious mince pie at the end!

tours.name: Drag & A Drink
tours.description: Laugh, sing, and cheer with Dixi Tucker’s dazzling drag show—featuring live vocals, witty comedy, and lively audience fun. Enjoy a meal, drinks, games, and karaoke for an unforgettable night out.

tours.name: Grab-A-Dabba Bottomless Bingo
tours.description: Dive into Warrington’s wildest night with endless drinks, thrilling bingo, unlimited food, and mini golf—an outrageous party you won’t forget.

tours.name: Oíche Dhamhsa - Dance night with Caitlín Nic Gabhann, Annette Collins, Jim and Mary Mc Guigan, Jonathan and Seáinín Mc Cloy
tours.description: Join a lively night of Irish music and dance at An Droichead, featuring top dancers and acclaimed musicians. Feel the rhythm, see the movement, and immerse yourself in authentic Irish culture on Cooke Street.

tours.name: Spring Toddlers 2024 - all about lambing time!
tours.description: Join our engaging six-week outdoor sessions for children aged 12 months and up, led by Jasmine and Fenwick at their family farm near Jedburgh. Experience the joy of messy play, seasonal crafts, and hands-on activities with farm animals, all in a safe and nurturing environment. A memorable adventure awaits!

tours.name: VIP Ghost Walk
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling VIP Private Ghost Walk in the haunted village of Pluckley, Kent. Uncover chilling tales of murder and restless spirits as you explore this historic site. With exclusive stories and intriguing facts, this eerie experience promises to be both memorable and spine-tingling. Prepare for a night of ghostly adventure!

tours.name: Exclusive Snooker Room
tours.description: Enjoy exclusive snooker fun in a private room with TV sports, table service, and all equipment included. Perfect for relaxing with friends—just bring your game face!

tours.name: BC White Water Leader Kayak Training
tours.description: Boost your paddling skills over two days at the White Water Centre, mastering leadership and confidence on grade 2(3) rapids. Enjoy scenic walks, great facilities, and a supportive environment to elevate your adventure.

tours.name: BC White Water Canoe Leader Training
tours.description: Build your paddling confidence over two days, mastering leadership skills on thrilling grade 2(3) rapids. Enjoy scenic riverside views, top facilities, and a supportive environment to prepare for the White Water Leader Award.

tours.name: Progressive Skateboard School (Level 3)
tours.description: Boost your skate skills with expert coaching, learn park etiquette, and express yourself in a fun, inclusive environment. Bring your gear or use ours—helmets and boards provided—while enjoying the onsite café.

tours.name: Raft building
tours.description: Take on the thrilling Raft Building challenge, where teamwork and creativity collide! Design and construct your own floating platform using limited materials, then race it down the river. With expert guidance and fun games, this unique experience promises laughter, learning, and unforgettable memories for all skill levels.

tours.name: Charity Abseiling
tours.description: Experience the thrill of charity abseiling in the stunning UNESCO World Heritage site of Bath! Join us for an unforgettable 2-hour adventure that combines excitement with purpose, as you conquer heights and raise vital funds for a cause you care about. Perfect for everyone, from thrill-seekers to first-timers!

tours.name: Team Building
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating 2-hour outdoor team-building adventure that fosters collaboration and personal growth. Engage in unique physical and mental challenges designed to stretch comfort zones and enhance skills like problem-solving and leadership. With expert instructors and complimentary photos, this memorable event boosts positivity and motivation in a stimulating environment.

tours.name: Code Break Bath Plus
tours.description: Embark on the thrilling Code Break Plus challenge in Bath! Navigate the city, tackle mental and physical tasks, and race against the clock or rival teams to unlock your briefcase. Customizable for any group size, this immersive experience promises teamwork, iconic sights, and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Energy, sleep and motivation - a nutrition and lifestyle course
tours.description: Transform your life in just four weeks with this energizing course! Each 45-minute session blends nutrition and lifestyle changes to boost your energy, enhance sleep quality, and ignite your motivation. Experience a revitalized sense of vitality and embrace each day with renewed enthusiasm and well-being.

tours.name: Childhood nutrition - a course for parents and carers
tours.description: Join this transformative 6-week course designed for parents and carers to navigate the challenges of mealtime stress. Discover effective techniques to ensure your children receive essential nutrients while fostering a positive dining experience. Empower yourself with strategies that promote harmony and health at the table, making mealtimes enjoyable for everyone.

tours.name: My healthy way to balanced body weight
tours.description: Join this innovative 8-week course that blends nutrition, neurogenesis, and movement to help you achieve your natural healthy weight without dieting. Designed by expert Jen, this unique approach empowers you to understand and encourage your body’s balance, making the journey to wellness both enlightening and transformative.

tours.name: Balancing blood sugar and supporting pre-diabetes through nutrition
tours.description: Join a transformative 6-week course focused on stabilizing blood sugar levels through tailored food groups, eating patterns, and lifestyle changes. Ideal for anyone seeking guidance or those diagnosed with blood sugar imbalances, this program offers the opportunity to re-test your levels and witness your health improvements firsthand.

tours.name: Basingstoke Canal Trip
tours.description: Embark on a serene 10km paddle along the picturesque Basingstoke Canal, where lush countryside and vibrant wildlife await. Experience the thrill of gliding over the scenic Ash Embankment and the aqueduct, before taking a refreshing break at Ash Lock. This gentle adventure promises tranquility and natural beauty just beyond the urban sprawl.

tours.name: Weber BBQ Classics
tours.description: Join an exciting four-hour introductory barbecue course where you'll master the Weber cooking technique. Learn essential skills like temperature control and food doneness while preparing a delicious black bun burger and succulent barbecued chicken. An expert chef will also demonstrate the mouthwatering "beer chicken," expanding your barbecue repertoire.

tours.name: Weber Basic Essentials
tours.description: Join Weber’s Essential Introductory Grill Academy Course for a hands-on, four-hour grilling adventure tailored for beginners. Learn from a Weber Grill Master as you explore versatile cooking techniques and create delicious dishes like spicy nduja pizza and pesto stuffed pork tenderloin. Perfect your skills and impress at your next barbecue!

tours.name: Introduction to Kayaking for Adults
tours.description: Dive into the world of kayaking with this engaging 3-hour course! Learn about essential equipment and safety, then hit the water to master key skills, including a thrilling capsize drill. Conclude with a debrief and insights for future development, paving the way for exciting adult paddle sessions ahead.

tours.name: Coniston Challenge
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure challenge in the stunning Lake District! Tackle the iconic Coniston Old Man, navigate the thrilling Copper Mines Canyon, and paddle across Coniston on a giant paddleboard. Perfect for groups, this unforgettable experience combines hiking, teamwork, and breathtaking scenery in just one action-packed day.

tours.name: Weber American Classics
tours.description: Dive into the world of smokehouse cuisine with this hands-on barbecue course! Learn to master low 'n' slow cooking techniques on the Smokey Mountain Cooker while preparing mouthwatering dishes like spicy chicken wings and tender ribs. Experience the art of authentic American barbecue and impress your friends with your culinary skills!

tours.name: Weber BBQ Master Gas
tours.description: Join our gas barbecue course and unlock the secrets of grilling with Weber's Genesis Smart Grill. Learn from expert grill masters how to create mouthwatering dishes, from paella to pineapple cake, all at the push of a button. Transform into a barbecue hero and make unforgettable memories with friends!

tours.name: Belfast Highlights walking tour
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour walking tour with your private guide, exploring the city's rich history from the 17th century. Wander through charming cobbled streets, discover its transformation from a small town to a thriving hub, and marvel at the stunning City Hall, all while enjoying a local pub experience.

tours.name: 45 Minute Blast
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating boat ride from Gunwharf Quays, exploring the historic Solent Forts and the legendary site of the Mary Rose wreck. This thrilling journey promises stunning views and a unique glimpse into maritime history, making it an unforgettable adventure for all ages. Dress warmly for this exciting outing!

tours.name: The Hut Return Charter
tours.description: Experience a unique dining adventure with a private boat charter to The Hut, one of the UK’s most iconic restaurants. Enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and delicious food, all while cruising in style. This unforgettable journey ensures a fun and safe return to Gunswharf Quay, making your outing truly memorable.

tours.name: Private Charter
tours.description: Experience a private charter tailored for your special occasion! Enjoy the thrill of being on the water while surrounded by stunning views. Remember to dress warmly, as it can be cooler on the boat. Book your unforgettable adventure today and create lasting memories with friends or family.

tours.name: Taispeántas Scannán ‘The Dance’ le Pat Collins agus Comhrá/ In Conversation le Michael Keegan-Dolan. @ The MAC
#ShePaddles White Water Weekend Ticket
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable weekend at the National White Water Centre from June 6th to 8th, 2025. Enjoy thrilling coached sessions, guided paddling, two nights of camping, and engaging evening talks, all while savoring delicious dinners. This unique experience promises adventure and camaraderie in a stunning natural setting.

tours.name: Home Schooling Meet Up
tours.description: Join fellow home-schooled kids every first Wednesday, enjoying fun activities for just £5. Add archery for only £10 and make new friends in a lively, inclusive setting from 12 to 3.

tours.name: Stag and Hen Celebration
tours.description: Transform your Stag or Hen celebration into an unforgettable outdoor adventure! Choose from half-day, full-day, or multi-day excursions tailored to your group's preferences. Whether exploring local landscapes or venturing abroad, create lasting memories while celebrating in style. Book your dream adventure today and say ‘I do’ to excitement!

tours.name: Adult's Birthday
tours.description: Transform your birthday into an unforgettable adventure with a variety of exciting activities for all ages! Choose from thrilling games or serene nature outings to create cherished memories. With options for high-energy fun or relaxed experiences, celebrate in style and make your special day truly memorable. Book your adventure now!

tours.name: Father's Day Express
tours.description: Experience a nostalgic steam train journey with Gwili Railway this Father's Day. Enjoy delicious food served on-board as you travel for 90 minutes through the stunning Carmarthenshire countryside, featuring beautiful river views. Board at Abergwili Junction and create unforgettable memories in charming vintage carriages.

tours.name: The George Hotel Ghost Investigation
tours.description: Experience a thrilling night at The George, a historic coaching house dating back to 1649, known for its ghostly encounters. Join us for an evening of paranormal investigation, exploring haunted rooms and engaging in spine-chilling experiments. Discover the hotel's rich history while enjoying snacks and drinks in a uniquely eerie atmosphere.

tours.name: SEN Roundwood Family Activity Half Day
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable 2.5-hour multi-activity session with WOLT, tailored for children with special educational needs. Engage in exciting activities like crate stacking, archery, and laser games in a beautiful 40-acre woodland. Led by skilled instructors, this session promises fun, learning, and memorable challenges for ages 6 and up.

tours.name: The Timeless Songs of Barbra Streisand
tours.description: Join top vocalist Sue Caroline for an unforgettable evening celebrating the timeless songs of Barbra Streisand. Accompanied by a fantastic live band, this captivating showcase features beloved hits from Streisand's remarkable seven-decade career, including classics like "The Way We Were" and "Don't Rain on My Parade." Enjoy tea and cake too!

tours.name: Rewind to the 70's Diva Show
tours.description: Experience the vibrant energy of ‘Rewind to 70s Divas’ with the incredible Sue Caroline and the Andy Wall Band. This uplifting show celebrates iconic hits from legendary 70s artists, ensuring a night of nostalgia and joy. Get ready to dance, sing along, and immerse yourself in the golden age of music!

tours.name: Sonning to Henley
tours.description: Embark on a delightful 3-hour paddling adventure from Sonning to Henley, perfect for families and light paddlers. Enjoy scenic stops, picnic spots, and the serene Hennerton Backwater, teeming with wildlife. Experience the thrill of nature and explore Henley’s Regatta Course for an unforgettable day on the water.

tours.name: Caversham (Reading) to Henley
tours.description: Embark on a scenic 6-7 hour journey from Caversham to Henley, perfect for older children and adults. Enjoy the tranquility of unspoiled countryside, take a coffee break in charming Sonning, and explore the serene St Patrick's Stream and Hennerton Backwater before reaching the picturesque Henley, just below Marsh Lock.

tours.name: Cholsey to Henley
tours.description: Embark on a scenic two-day journey from Cholsey to Henley, covering picturesque landscapes and charming campsites. Enjoy a 10-mile trek to Mapledurham, with options for hotel stays, before continuing 12.5 miles to Henley. Experience the beauty of the River Thames and the vibrant atmosphere near the Rowing Museum.

tours.name: Cholsey to Windsor
tours.description: Embark on a memorable four-day adventure from Cholsey to Windsor, covering approximately 47 miles and navigating 17 locks. Experience the beauty of the Thames as you paddle through charming towns, stay in unique accommodations like Bell Tents, and enjoy the scenic landscapes along this historic waterway.

tours.name: Whole Thames Challenge
tours.description: Embark on the exhilarating 'Whole Thames Challenge,' a unique 6 or 8-day self-guided expedition from source to sea. Navigate the iconic river, tackle locks, and enjoy stunning scenery. With expert guidance and customizable itineraries, this adventure promises an unforgettable experience for those seeking a true test of endurance.

tours.name: Haunted London Pub Tour
tours.description: Gather your friends for a thrilling 1.5-hour tour of London's haunted pubs. Uncover chilling tales of Sweeney Todd, visit the original Bank of England, and meet the Professor of Profanity. Experience the city's ghostly history while enjoying its most historic public houses on this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Royal Maritime Greenwich Ghost Tour
tours.description: Embark on a chilling 1.5-hour journey through Greenwich's haunted history. Uncover tales of cursed sailors, ghostly lovers, and royal occult secrets while exploring hidden alleys, London's oldest park, and a notorious haunted pub. This leisurely walk promises a unique blend of history and the supernatural in a captivating setting.

tours.name: RDS Half Marathon 2026

tours.name: Holyhead Mountain & South Stack guided history and local interest walk
