tours.description: Join us for a thrilling family-friendly Trick or Treating adventure at the museum! Explore spine-chilling exhibits and discover the spooky surprises that await around every corner. It's a unique opportunity to experience the eerie atmosphere and create unforgettable memories together. Don't miss out on this hauntingly fun event!

tours.name: Pig Race (Fundraiser run by Minster On Sea Rotary Club)
tours.description: Join the Minster on Sea Rotary Club for an exhilarating Pig Race, a unique and entertaining event aimed at raising funds for the Criterion. Experience the thrill of watching these spirited competitors race while supporting a great cause, making it a memorable day for all involved.

tours.name: Scott Elvis
tours.description: Experience the electrifying performance of Scott Elvis, the top Elvis tribute act, brought to you by Annie Riley Productions. Immerse yourself in the unforgettable music and charisma that captures the essence of the King of Rock and Roll, making for a night filled with nostalgia and excitement.

tours.name: Craft & Hobby Fair
tours.description: Join us for an inspiring Craft & Hobby Fair, where creativity comes alive! Discover unique handmade treasures, engage in exciting workshops, and connect with fellow enthusiasts. This vibrant event promises a memorable experience filled with artistic expression and the joy of crafting. Don't miss out on this celebration of creativity!

tours.name: Betty Baker and the Swingtones
tours.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Swing, Jive, and Jazz from the 1940s and 50s, blended with a nostalgic twist on contemporary pop hits. This unique musical journey promises to transport you to a lively era, making it an unforgettable celebration of rhythm and style.

tours.name: Mad Hatters Tea Party & Easter Egg Hunt
tours.description: Experience a delightful day of family fun infused with a touch of madness, where laughter and excitement abound. Don't miss the chance to meet the Easter Bunny, adding a magical twist to your adventure. Create unforgettable memories together in this unique celebration of joy and togetherness.

tours.name: Games Afternoon
tours.description: Experience your favorite television games like never before on the big screen, accompanied by delightful tea and cake. This unique event combines the thrill of competition with a cozy atmosphere, making it a memorable outing for friends and family. Enjoy the excitement and indulge in tasty treats!

tours.name: Themed Food & Film Afternoon
tours.description: Immerse yourself in a vibrant evening of culture with a delightful curry dinner followed by an enchanting Bollywood film. This unique experience combines flavorful cuisine with the magic of Indian cinema, promising a memorable night filled with delicious tastes and captivating storytelling. Join us for an unforgettable celebration!

tours.name: Themed Food & Film Afternoon
tours.description: Join us for a unique 4th of July celebration featuring delicious Americana cuisine paired with a classic film. Experience the festive spirit in a Criterion style that promises to make this holiday memorable and enjoyable for all. Don't miss this perfect blend of food and cinema!

tours.name: Paddle and Pick
tours.description: Join a guided paddle to clear hidden marine plastic, protect wildlife, and boost your wellbeing. All gear provided—paddle, safety, and cleanup tools—so you can focus on making a difference in pristine waterways.

tours.name: Chauffeur Services
tours.description: Experience a personalized tour of Ulster, tailored to your interests and schedule. Your passionate local guide will immerse you in the region's rich history, vibrant culture, and delicious cuisine, providing an authentic glimpse into the lives of its people. Discover the unique stories that make Ulster unforgettable.

tours.name: Ragnarok 7
tours.description: Experience two thrilling days of magfed paintball at the historic RAF Driffield base. Engage in intense battles amidst the remnants of military history, where strategy and teamwork are key. This unique setting promises an unforgettable adventure for paintball enthusiasts seeking excitement and camaraderie in a captivating environment.

tours.name: Race Camp
tours.description: Join an exhilarating all-day camp where kids can enhance their racing skills! Over 4.5 hours each day, participants will engage in exciting activities designed to boost their confidence and technique, making it a memorable experience for young racing enthusiasts eager to learn and practice in a fun environment.

tours.name: Factory Tour and Truffle-making Workshop
tours.description: Create your own flavored truffles in a 1.5-hour factory tour. Learn the Bean-to-Bar process, taste award-winning chocolates, craft six truffles with expert guidance, and relax with a hot drink at Leah’s Yard.

tours.name: eBikes4work - test
tours.description: Experience the freedom of e-Bike hire for four weeks, perfect for commuting, traveling between work locations, or enjoying leisurely rides on your days off. This unique opportunity combines convenience and adventure, allowing you to explore your surroundings while embracing a sustainable mode of transportation.

tours.name: Bouldering Wall - St Davids
tours.description: Experience the thrill of bouldering in a safe, private setting with our indoor climbing wall and auto belays. Perfect for children and beginners, this unique session accommodates up to eight participants, ensuring a fun and memorable introduction to the exciting world of climbing.

tours.name: Spy Camp
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating spy adventure at the museum! Equipped with a spy kit, you'll uncover hidden clues, enjoy captivating comic history film clips, and collaborate with fellow spies in a dynamic drama workshop. Plus, savor a delicious lunch bag to fuel your mission. Don't miss this unique experience!

tours.name: Gobbins Cliff Path
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking Gobbins Cliff Path with our convenient transport service. Enjoy a seamless journey to this stunning coastal adventure, where pre-booking ensures your spot on this unforgettable tour. Discover the unique beauty of the cliffs and create lasting memories in this remarkable natural setting.

tours.name: Servicing/Repairs: Durham
tours.description: Experience personalized service with an in-store bike assessment. Discuss your e-Bike issues and desired upgrades directly with our experts. This unique opportunity allows for immediate solutions, as we can order parts and schedule necessary services right on the spot, ensuring your bike is in top shape for your next ride.

tours.name: Servicing/Repairs: Edinburgh
tours.description: Experience personalized service with a quick in-store assessment for your e-Bike. Discuss any issues or desired upgrades directly with our experts, ensuring tailored solutions. After evaluating your bike, we’ll help you order the necessary parts and schedule the service, making the process seamless and efficient.

tours.name: Annie Riley & Friends present a Winter Warmer Variety Show
tours.description: Experience an elegant Showtime Tea at 1pm, perfect for gathering with friends or colleagues. Enjoy delightful refreshments in a charming atmosphere, with special discounts for groups of over 30, making it an ideal outing for celebrations or team bonding. Don't miss this unique opportunity for a memorable afternoon!

tours.name: Fit For A King
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful Afternoon Tea experience, perfect for social gatherings. Enjoy a selection of exquisite teas and treats while savoring a unique atmosphere. Plus, take advantage of special discounts for groups of over 30, making it an ideal choice for celebrations and memorable moments with friends or colleagues.

tours.name: Polka Dots & Moon beams
tours.description: Indulge in a delightful Afternoon Tea experience, perfect for gatherings and celebrations. Enjoy a variety of exquisite teas and treats, making it a unique and memorable occasion. Plus, take advantage of special discounts for groups of over 30, ensuring a fantastic time for everyone involved.

tours.name: Shamrock n Roll Show
tours.description: Join us for a lively St. Patrick's Day celebration featuring the hilarious TV comedy impressionist Christopher Gee and the talented multi-instrumentalist Keith Slater. Enjoy a delightful lunch at 1pm while being entertained by their captivating performances, making this a memorable day filled with laughter and music.

tours.name: On Holiday?               5 Day Discount Hire Offer
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the water with kayak and paddle board hire during your stay! Enjoy the convenience of delivery to your holiday accommodation or keep your gear at our watersports center. Dive into adventure and explore the beautiful surroundings at your own pace!

tours.name: Supporting Menopause Through Nutrition
tours.description: 45mins a session • +18years old • 6 weeks in Length

tours.name: Christmas Fun Day
tours.description: Experience an hour of festive joy as you meet our friendly alpacas, dive into creative Christmas arts and crafts, and indulge in a delightful selection of chocolates for kids and mince pies for adults. This unique holiday gathering promises memorable moments and a warm, cheerful atmosphere for all ages.

tours.name: Home Education - Ceredigion
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable educational adventure in the wild! Our sessions will explore diverse wildlife while integrating the National Curriculum, ensuring a unique learning experience that connects nature with education. Discover the excitement of learning outside the classroom and immerse yourself in the wonders of the natural world.

tours.name: Nocturnal Wildlife Walk
tours.description: Embark on a captivating night adventure as we set off at dusk to witness bats in their natural habitat. Equipped with specialized tools, you'll hear the unique sounds of various bat species, making this an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and night explorers alike.

tours.name: New Year Ball
tours.description: Join the Criterions for a spectacular New Year celebration at the January Ball! Enjoy live music by The Bonnevilles while indulging in a delicious buffet. This unforgettable evening promises lively entertainment and a festive atmosphere, making it the perfect way to kick off the year in style.

tours.name: Panto
tours.description: Join the Criterions community for a delightful Panto performance, showcasing the lively talents of the Criterion Strummers Ukulele group. Experience a unique blend of humor and music that promises to entertain and engage audiences of all ages in a memorable celebration of community spirit and creativity.

tours.name: RYA Competent Crew 5 Day Course
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 5-day adventure with the RYA Competent Crew Course at Mallorca Sailing School. Perfect for beginners, this hands-on experience teaches you essential sailing skills while you actively participate as a crew member. Enjoy breathtaking views, learn teamwork, and gain confidence on the high seas, setting the stage for future sailing endeavors.

tours.name: RYA Day Skipper Practical 5 Day Course
tours.description: Embark on a transformative 5-day RYA Day Skipper course, where you'll gain hands-on experience in yacht handling, navigation, and crew management. Under expert guidance, you'll learn to command your own yacht, preparing you for independent sailing adventures. This unique opportunity blends practical skills with the thrill of the open sea.

tours.name: RYA Coastal Skipper Course
tours.description: Elevate your sailing skills with the RYA Coastal Skipper Course, a five-day adventure designed for experienced sailors. Master advanced navigation, boat handling, and emergency procedures while tackling challenging coastal passages by night. This course not only enhances your seamanship but also prepares you for the prestigious Yachtmaster™ Coastal Certificate.

tours.name: Cliff Richards Blue Sapphire Tour 2023
tours.description: Experience the magic of Cliff Richard's Blue Sapphire Tour 2023 on November 25th! Relive the excitement with timeless hits like “Move It,” “Wired for Sound,” and “The Young Ones.” This unforgettable event promises to be a dazzling celebration of music and nostalgia. Don’t miss out on the chance to see it live!

tours.name: London's Mysteries: Masonic Lodge Experience | London
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 5.5-hour mystery tour through the City of London, where you'll discover hidden gems and iconic landmarks. Unravel the stories behind famous attractions and events, revealing a side of the city that remains unexplored. Experience the rich history and charm of London like never before.

tours.name: A Million Dreams
tours.description: Experience double the entertainment with our special offer: enjoy two thrilling shows for the price of one. This unique opportunity allows you to immerse yourself in captivating performances, making for an unforgettable night out. Don’t miss your chance to double the fun and excitement!

tours.name: MTB Workshop Pumping and Jumping
tours.description: Experience a thrilling 3-hour session focused on mastering dynamic body movement for trail riding. Discover how to flow effortlessly, gain free speed, and elevate your skills by learning to catch air. Enhance your technique for height and distance while ensuring smooth, controlled landings—perfect for adventure seekers looking to elevate their ride!

tours.name: White Water Canoe Coach Training
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-day adventure that promises unforgettable experiences. Engage in exciting activities, explore new landscapes, and create lasting memories. This unique journey offers a perfect blend of excitement and discovery, making it an ideal getaway for those seeking both relaxation and adventure in a captivating setting.

tours.name: Rescue 3 WRT Advanced
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 4-day adventure that promises excitement and discovery. Experience unique activities and create lasting memories as you explore new horizons. This immersive journey offers a perfect blend of thrill and relaxation, making it an ideal escape for those seeking both adventure and tranquility.

tours.name: Tryweryn Freestyle
tours.description: Join Matt from GB Freestyle for an exhilarating day of flipping and spinning! Experience the thrill of mastering upside-down moves while enjoying a fun-filled atmosphere. This unique opportunity promises to leave you smiling as you learn new skills and embrace the excitement of freestyle activities.

tours.name: Circus Workshop with Shooting Stars Circus Skills
tours.description: Join a thrilling 2-hour workshop where you’ll learn circus skills from seasoned professionals. Experience the excitement of mastering juggling, acrobatics, and more in a fun, supportive environment. Unleash your inner performer and create unforgettable memories while honing your talents under the guidance of expert instructors.

tours.name: The Ace Tones
tours.description: Experience the electrifying Rock n Roll Legends Tribute with The Ace Tones, celebrating the iconic sounds of Buddy Holly, Elvis, Little Richard, and more. This unforgettable event promises to transport you back in time, honoring the music that shaped a generation and igniting your passion for classic rock and roll.

tours.name: Evening Mackerel Fishing Trip
tours.description: Join an intimate group fishing adventure in Whitby, where you’ll spend two hours casting lines and reeling in catches. With all tackle provided, this experience promises camaraderie and the thrill of fishing in a stunning coastal setting. Perfect for both beginners and seasoned anglers looking for a memorable outing.

tours.name: Oxford Private Tour
tours.description: Experience the thrill of a personalized adventure with our exclusive private tours. Tailored to your interests, these unique excursions promise unforgettable moments and insights. Connect with knowledgeable guides and explore at your own pace, ensuring a memorable journey that caters to your desires. Call us to check availability and start your adventure!

tours.name: Bellevue & Lagg Barley to Bottle Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique two-centre tour starting at Bellevue, where you'll discover the art of barley production on a traditional Arran farm. Capture memories with Highland cows before heading to Lagg Distillery for an exclusive look at distilling and savoring the rich flavors of local Arran Whiskies.

tours.name: Evening of Music & Mirth
tours.description: Experience an enchanting evening of Gilbert & Sullivan, hosted by the distinguished Vice Admiral Sir Henry and Lady Frances Nicholson. Delight in the company of special guest Mr. George Grossmith, as you immerse yourself in a night filled with captivating performances and elegant camaraderie.

tours.name: Tidal Wildlife Special
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2.5-hour adventure on the North Sea, where the stunning scenery meets the exhilarating sea breeze. Prepare for an unforgettable experience, but remember to dress warmly, as the waters can be surprisingly chilly, even in summer. Embrace the elements and create lasting memories on this unique journey.

tours.name: Free Community Ride
tours.description: Experience the beauty of Thanet and East Kent through our unique rides that promote well-being and community. Each journey is a mini-adventure, revealing stunning sights, fostering new friendships, and creating unforgettable stories. Join us for an exciting exploration that enriches both the mind and spirit.

tours.name: Mini Mal 8'0
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surfing with our advanced boards, designed for improved performance and maneuverability. Whether you choose to ride for an hour, a day, or a week, elevate your skills and take your surfing to new heights with this unique opportunity to enhance your wave-riding experience.

tours.name: Mid Length 7'2
tours.description: Experience the thrill of advanced surfing with our high-performance boards, designed to enhance your skills and elevate your maneuvers. Available for hourly, daily, or weekly hire, this unique opportunity allows you to push your limits and enjoy an unforgettable ride on the waves.

tours.name: Sunday Slam Jam
tours.description: Join the coaches for an exhilarating Sunday evening ride, where you can enhance your skills and engage in fun games like WAKE, Follow the Leader, and STICK IT! This unique experience promises to challenge your riding abilities while fostering camaraderie and excitement in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Intro White Water
tours.description: Experience the thrill of white water rafting over two exhilarating days, honing essential skills like breaking in, breaking out, and ferry gliding. Dive into the excitement of moving water and discover why this adventure is truly addictive! Join us for an unforgettable journey on the rapids.

tours.name: Adult Pottery Painting Evening
tours.description: Experience a delightful evening of pottery painting, perfect for friends, family, or solo creativity. Choose from a wide array of ceramic items to personalize while enjoying a relaxed atmosphere. Sip on drinks as you unleash your artistic side and create memorable pieces to take home.

tours.name: National Heritage Open Day
tours.description: Experience an exclusive behind-the-scenes tour of the Criterion, where you'll gain unique insights into its history and operations. The adventure continues with an engaging talk and a captivating short film, making this a memorable opportunity to explore the magic of this iconic venue like never before.

tours.name: Picnic Boxes
tours.description: Savor a freshly made picnic, beautifully packed and ready to enjoy. Handcrafted locally, this 60-minute treat complements your farm tour with delicious flavors and charming presentation.

tours.description: Discover the art of braiding in this engaging workshop for beginners! Learn to create stunning and practical items like shoelaces, jewelry, ties, and straps. Unleash your creativity and master the basics of braiding while crafting beautiful pieces that you can proudly showcase or gift. Join us for this unique experience!

tours.name: Science Workshop - Parc Cwm Darran
tours.description: Family Friendly - Discover Wildlife - Unique Experience

tours.name: Make your visit extra special
tours.description: Visiting for a special occasion? Add a gift or hamper to your booking to receive on arrival.

tours.name: Group Booking Bodiam
tours.description: Join an instructor-led session with kayaks, paddleboards, or megasup for water fun, or test your skills with archery and axe throwing on dry land. Choose your adventure and unleash your inner explorer.

tours.name: School/College Bookings Tonbridge
tours.description: Engage students in thrilling land or water activities designed specifically for schools. These sessions offer a unique opportunity to foster teamwork, build confidence, and create unforgettable memories through dynamic experiences that blend fun and learning in an exciting environment. Perfect for enhancing school spirit and camaraderie among students!

tours.name: Paint and Pudding Night: The Plough, Prestbury
tours.description: Experience a delightful evening of creativity at the Painting 'Book Club' on June 26th. Enjoy a beginner-friendly acrylic painting workshop led by a skilled artist, while indulging in three exquisite puddings crafted by Wellfed Kitchen's head chef. Unwind, create, and savor a unique blend of art and dessert!

tours.name: Beginners Braiding Workshop
tours.description: Discover the art of braiding in this engaging workshop for beginners! Learn to create beautiful and practical items like shoelaces, jewelry, and ties. This hands-on experience will equip you with essential skills while unleashing your creativity, making it a unique opportunity to craft something special.

tours.name: Moth Morning - North-East
tours.description: Experience a delightful morning as you savor breakfast and embark on an exciting adventure to discover the fascinating world of moths. Explore the mysteries hidden in moth traps and enjoy a unique opportunity to connect with nature in a memorable way.

tours.name: Changing of Guard Walking Tour of London
Brushstrokes & Barn-Dance: Roots & Seeds, Cirencester
tours.description: Create your own cowboy hat, enjoy delicious pizza, and dance the night away at a lively barndance. A fun-filled evening of art, food, and country dancing in Cirencester’s cozy Roots & Seeds Café.

tours.name: FESTIVE Paint and Sip: Churchdown Club
tours.description: Join Paint Pot Parties for a cozy Paint and Sip Night at Churchdown Club on December 4th. Unleash your creativity as you paint the festive design ‘Snow One Like You’ while enjoying drinks. Perfect for all skill levels, this memorable evening promises fun, relaxation, and the chance to create your own masterpiece.

tours.name: Brew and Brushes: Handpainted Book Vase/Book End
tours.description: Create your own painted vases or bookends in a cozy Cheltenham café, guided by an artist. Enjoy hot chocolate, cake, and a fun evening of art—leave with a unique masterpiece to cherish.

tours.name: The Story of Levi Strauss & Co.: The Origin & Evolution of an Icon
tours.description: Discover the fascinating journey of Levi Strauss & Co. with historian Tracey Panek in an engaging in-person talk. Explore the origins and evolution of this iconic brand, uncovering the rich history that shaped its legacy. Don't miss this unique opportunity to gain insights into a cultural phenomenon.

tours.name: Llandudno
tours.description: All ages • 🌞 Don't miss out on this exciting day trip!🌞

tours.name: River Wey & Ruins trip
tours.description: Glide along the peaceful River Wey for 15km, spotting kingfishers and herons, then explore the historic Newark Priory ruins. Enjoy a relaxed trip with chances to warm up in a riverside pub and soak up nature and history.

tours.name: Intermediate Sessions Tonbridge
tours.description: Boost your paddle skills with a two-hour session on efficient forward paddling, sharp turns, or confident movement on the board. Improve balance, control, and technique in a fun, supportive environment.

tours.name: Battle of the Beers
tours.description: Sample six bold, new craft beers in a lively, guided tasting at Sir Loin of Beef. Enjoy tasting cards, nibbles, and a prize draw in a friendly Portsmouth community event—perfect for beer lovers seeking fun and flavor.

tours.name: Overnight Camping & 2nd Session Admission
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable summer beer fest featuring over 30 real ales and ciders, alongside captivating close-up magic. Enjoy delicious food and unique merchandise while supporting local charities. With overnight camping available, it’s the perfect way to relax and indulge in a vibrant community atmosphere.

tours.name: Hidden Gems of Notting Hill
tours.description: Uncover hidden gems and colorful streets of Notting Hill on a personalized 3-hour walk. Capture charming scenes, explore film spots, and enjoy stories of its quirky characters and local secrets.

tours.name: Victoria and Albert Museum: Highlights and Gems
tours.description: Embark on a private 3-hour tour of the Victoria and Albert Museum, where you'll uncover both celebrated masterpieces and hidden treasures. Delight in fascinating stories behind unique objects, enjoy a refreshing tea in the stunning café, and explore the museum's remarkable architecture, making for an unforgettable cultural experience.

tours.name: Teen Sup Club
tours.description: Join the Teen SUP Club for an exciting 1.5-hour adventure on the river Medway! Under the guidance of a qualified instructor, you'll learn essential paddleboarding skills, safety tips, and team camaraderie. Perfect for beginners, this fun Friday evening activity promises unforgettable moments on the water with friends.

tours.name: Braunton Academy Climbing Club
tours.description: Experience the thrill of climbing at our fun-filled sessions designed for beginners! With an 8-meter wall featuring 25 routes, you'll receive expert guidance while enjoying the excitement of scaling new heights. Join us on Tuesday or Wednesday nights for an unforgettable adventure in a supportive environment.

tours.name: Kayak School
tours.description: Join our exciting Kayak School, offering two unique programs: Intro to Flat Water and Intro to White Water. Over four weeks, you'll learn essential kayaking techniques and safety measures with experienced coaches. Perfect for beginners, this adventure promises to build your confidence and skills on the water, making every session memorable.

tours.name: Full Day Guided Ride - Dumfries and Galloway
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable guided ride through stunning local forests and hills, tailored to your skill level. Choose from scenic coastal routes, thrilling singletracks, or challenging moorland climbs, all while discovering hidden trails. Enjoy expert guidance and breathtaking views, making every moment of your adventure truly memorable.

tours.name: Sea kayak coaching
tours.description: Experience personalized one-on-one coaching in surfing and sea kayaking, tailored to your unique skill level and needs. Enjoy guided trips and flexible scheduling, with sessions available for half or full days. Each adventure is customized based on weather and sea conditions, ensuring a memorable and engaging experience.

tours.name: Nav Day 2023
tours.description: Join hundreds of women on May 13, 2023, for an empowering navigation course designed for all skill levels. Experience hands-on learning in a supportive environment, mastering map reading, compass use, and route planning. Build confidence outdoors while connecting with fellow adventurers, all for an accessible price. Embrace the journey together!

tours.name: Brighton Wildlife Sailing Experience
tours.description: Sail along Sussex’s stunning coast on a small yacht, help steer the boat, enjoy bubbly, and listen to marine life stories from our wildlife guide. A magical, intimate adventure with dolphin sightings possible but not guaranteed.

tours.name: BCAB Sheltered Water Kayak and Canoe Coach Assessment
tours.description: Prove your kayaking and canoeing skills in a practical, one-day assessment. Show off your rescue, safety, and leadership abilities to earn your Sheltered Water Coach certification.

tours.name: 1:1 Canoe Coaching
tours.description: Experience the thrill of solo canoeing with personalized one-on-one coaching tailored to your skill level. Whether you're a beginner or looking to enhance your technique, our expert guidance will equip you with essential paddling strokes, maneuvering skills, and safety techniques, ensuring you paddle with confidence and enjoy every adventure on the water.

tours.name: 1:1 Paddleboard Coaching
tours.description: Enhance your paddleboarding skills in a full-day experience tailored for all levels. Whether you're gearing up for an expedition, training for a race, or simply seeking confidence on the water, this unique opportunity offers expert guidance to elevate your abilities and enjoyment on the board.

tours.name: Paddleboard Skills
tours.description: Experience the beauty of the River Weaver with our paddleboarding coaching and journey in Winsford! Perfect for all skill levels, this immersive day includes expert guidance, essential techniques, and a scenic adventure. Enjoy the tranquility of the water, observe wildlife, and gain confidence while exploring this stunning waterway.

tours.name: Paint and Pattie Night: Airs & Grace's, Cheltenham
tours.description: Kick off your week with a creative evening at The Airs & Graces in Cheltenham! Each month features a unique craft, from hand-painted tote bags to decorative candles and personalized gin glasses. Enjoy expert guidance and all materials provided, while savoring a delicious burger and fries. Unleash your artistic flair!

tours.name: Bespoke foraging day
tours.description: Create personalized adventures designed just for your group, whether exploring a scenic location or your own neighborhood. With expert guidance, enjoy a tailored day that fits your interests. Perfect for small groups of up to five, offering flexibility and a unique experience crafted around your preferences.

tours.name: Cannolis & Candle Painting: Topolys Gloucester
tours.description: Experience a delightful evening of creativity as you design and paint your own trio of dinner candles. Guided by an expert artist, you'll explore beautiful techniques while enjoying delicious desserts and your first drink. This workshop promises relaxation, inspiration, and the chance to craft something uniquely personal—no experience required!

tours.name: Blooming Brushstrokes
tours.description: Create stunning floral arrangements then turn them into watercolor art in a joyful morning of blooms, coffee, and creativity. No experience needed—just bring your love of flowers and curiosity. All materials included.

tours.name: Tour Southbank  🇪🇸
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey along the southern bank of the Thames, exploring iconic landmarks like St. Paul's Cathedral and the Millennium Bridge. Uncover hidden gems that are often overlooked by tourists, making this experience both unique and memorable as you delve into the rich history and charm of the area.

tours.name: Club Rafting
tours.description: Experience an exhilarating weekend of white water rafting in the stunning Lake District! Guided by seasoned experts, navigate the thrilling rapids of rivers like Kent, Leven, and Tees. This bespoke adventure promises unforgettable moments and the chance to conquer some of the best rafting in the UK.

tours.name: North Sea Navigational Training Expedition
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable sailing adventure from Skive, navigating the stunning Limfjord to Lowestoft. Enhance your seamanship skills through hands-on training, including passage planning, leadership roles, and traditional rig maneuvers. Experience the thrill of night passages and a North Sea crossing, perfect for personal growth or RYA certification.

tours.name: Paint and Pizza Night: Airs & Graces, Cheltenham
tours.description: Experience a delightful evening at The Airs & Graces in Cheltenham, where you'll create your own handpainted Vintage Heart Cake Vase while enjoying delicious pizza. Perfect for a date night, girls' night, or solo adventure, this unique art workshop promises fun and creativity with expert guidance from a skilled art coach.

tours.name: Children's Plant Pot Painting: Elkstone
tours.description: Join us for a delightful morning where your little ones can unleash their creativity by designing and painting their own terracotta plant pots. Afterward, they’ll select a plant to take home, making this a memorable and hands-on experience. Don’t miss this chance to nurture their artistic side!

tours.name: May Half-term North Sea Adventure - ideal DofE!
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 5-day sailing adventure where you'll actively participate in navigating the ship and managing night watches. With no fixed destination, your group will collaboratively chart the course based on weather conditions, creating a unique journey filled with camaraderie and unforgettable experiences.

tours.name: Play The River
tours.description: Dive into the thrill of The River – Back with a Splash! This revamped paddling course offers exciting challenges and playful maneuvers like rock slides and spins. Perfect for those comfortable on Grade 2/3 rapids, you'll enhance your skills while having a fantastic time on the water. Join the adventure!

tours.name: Long Distance Paddleboard Journey
tours.description: Boost your paddling skills with expert coaching on a 20km route. Improve technique, endurance, and trip planning in a full day of practical guidance and personalized feedback for confident, safe adventures.

tours.name: Spring Plants
tours.description: Discover Northumberland’s vibrant springtime bounty by foraging for wild plants and fungi. Learn to identify and prepare these natural ingredients, then savor a delicious meal crafted from your foraged finds. Immerse yourself in nature’s flavors and enjoy a memorable, hands-on culinary adventure in the countryside.

tours.name: Coastal Plants
tours.description: Venture along Northumberland’s coast to gather vibrant sea plants like coriander grass and crisp succulents. Feel the salty breeze as you forage for fresh, flavorful treasures hidden along the shoreline. This hands-on adventure immerses you in nature’s edible bounty, offering a unique taste of the wild seaside.
