tours.description: Create your own funky face planter while enjoying a delicious pasta dish and drink. No experience needed—just relax, have fun, and take home a unique masterpiece in this lively, creative night out.

tours.name: Wooden Duck Painting Workshop: Miro Lounge, Bristol
tours.description: Transform a wooden duck into your personal art piece with vibrant paints and creative techniques. Perfect for all skill levels, this workshop sparks fun, relaxation, and a unique keepsake to cherish.

tours.name: Pick, Paint & Picnic: Grandmas Garden, Cheltenham
tours.description: Create your own painted vase, enjoy a picnic, and pick fresh flowers in Grandma’s Garden. A fun, relaxing afternoon of art, food, and blooming beauty—perfect for friends and family alike.

tours.name: Paint and Sip Night: The Globe, Stonehouse (copy)
tours.description: Create vibrant 'Jenny the Jellyfish' paintings in a relaxing, beginner-friendly workshop. All materials provided, guided by a calming art coach—your fun, stress-free midweek escape into creativity.

tours.name: Paint, Pizza & Puddleducks: Wooden Duck Workshop, Cattivo
tours.description: Create your own wooden duck ornament in a relaxed evening of painting, guidance, and fun. Enjoy a delicious stonebaked pizza while unleashing your creativity—perfect for friends, family, or a solo treat.

tours.name: Paint and Sip Night: Churchdown Club
tours.description: Unleash your creativity at Gloucester’s cozy Paint and Sip Night. Sip drinks, relax, and craft your own masterpiece—no experience needed. All materials provided, just bring your imagination!

tours.name: Paint & Sip Night: The Crown Inn, Stroud
tours.description: Unwind with a fun, beginner-friendly paint night at The Crown Inn. Create your own artwork, enjoy a relaxed social vibe, and leave with a masterpiece—no experience needed, just bring your creativity.

tours.name: Londra Natalizia
tours.description: Step into London's festive wonderland with sparkling lights, bustling markets, and luxurious shop windows. Glide on Somerset House ice, marvel at Covent Garden’s towering tree, and explore vibrant Carnaby Street. This full-day tour immerses you in holiday cheer, art, and shopping, creating unforgettable Christmas memories in the heart of the city.

tours.name: Teen Girl SUP Club
tours.description: Join our Teen Girls SUP Summer School for an unforgettable adventure on the water! Learn paddleboarding skills, enjoy exciting games and challenges, and gain safety knowledge, all guided by a qualified instructor. Perfect for active teens and busy parents, this experience promises fun and laughter throughout the summer holidays!

tours.name: Sea Kayak Training | Hastings
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-hour Sea Kayaking Adventure, perfect for all skill levels! Paddle along the stunning coastline, navigate rocky shores, and ride the waves, with the chance to spot playful seals. All equipment is provided, ensuring a safe and memorable experience with friends or fellow adventurers.

tours.name: Brewbarn Sessions
tours.description: Enjoy an afternoon of unlimited local beers, fresh pizza, a brewery tour, and live music at Spitting Feathers Brewery. Bring your dog, sip on craft brews, and soak up farmyard fun in a lively, relaxed setting.

tours.name: The Braveheart Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s history by visiting the Wallace Monument, Stirling Castle, and Bannockburn Centre. Walk through legendary battle sites, see iconic weapons, and relive epic victories in a full-day adventure of heroism and heritage.

tours.name: The Celtic Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s ancient past in Kilmartin Glen with stone circles, rock carvings over 5,000 years old, and historic hill forts. Enjoy scenic villages, stunning views, and a traditional Scottish meal in a full-day adventure.

tours.name: One day Outlander tour from Glasgow
tours.description: Step into the world of Outlander with a full-day tour visiting iconic filming locations like Lallybroch, Castle Leoch, and Cranesmuir. Walk historic streets, explore castles, and relive your favorite scenes from the show.

tours.name: The Highlander Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s stunning Highlands in a full-day private tour. Visit Loch Lomond, Glencoe, Castle Stalker, and Kilchurn Castle, hear legendary tales, and enjoy breathtaking scenery and historic sites in one unforgettable journey.

tours.name: The 4 Day Outlander Experience
tours.description: Join a thrilling Outlander tour through Scotland’s historic sites and scenic villages, walking in Jamie and Claire’s footsteps. Explore castles, battlefields, and mystical locations in a four-day adventure.

tours.name: The 4 Day Isle of Skye Experience
tours.description: Explore the stunning Isle of Skye over four days, visiting dramatic cliffs, historic castles, fairy pools, and scenic mountain passes. Immerse yourself in Scottish legends, breathtaking landscapes, and local charm on this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Bespoke Experiences
tours.description: Create your dream trip with personalized guides, tailored to your schedule—whether one day or two weeks. An unforgettable adventure designed just for you awaits.

tours.name: Tyrants and Radicals: A political history of England at Westminster
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 2.5-hour journey through Westminster, uncovering the inspiring tales of heroes who challenged tyranny and shaped democracy over 800 years. Experience history like never before as you stroll through iconic sites and learn about the struggles that led to the rights we cherish today.

tours.name: Private Tour - Wonders of Civilisation:  A crash course in archaeology at the British Museum
tours.description: Starting from £330 per Group up to 8 | 5 hours (approx)

tours.name: Private Tour - Farther than any has been: The Age of Discovery at Maritime Greenwich
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 5-hour journey through Greenwich, where you'll explore the rich maritime history of explorers and pirates. Discover navigation techniques using celestial bodies, stroll through stunning heritage sites, and enjoy inspiring tales of adventure. Experience the vibrant Greenwich market for lunch, making this day unforgettable for all!

tours.name: Private tour - Tyrants and radicals: A political history of England at Westminster
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3.5-hour journey through British history, exploring the dark reigns of tyrannical monarchs and the brave heroes who championed democracy. Stroll through Westminster's historic center, uncover chilling tales often overlooked in school, and gain a fresh perspective on the fight for rights that shape our world today.

tours.name: Private Tour - The great black pit: Crime, poverty and punishment in the East End.
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling journey through London's East End, where crime and culture intertwine. Explore the vibrant street art, uncover chilling cold cases, and meet the eccentric characters that inspired Dickens. This immersive experience invites you to step off the tourist path and delve into the heart of a storied past.

tours.name: The Glencoe Photography Experience
tours.description: Capture Scotland’s stunning landscapes: roaring Falls of Falloch, tranquil Rannoch Moor, dramatic Glencoe Valley, and iconic castles. Perfect for photography and adventure in a full-day scenic tour.

tours.name: The Skye Photography Experience
tours.description: Explore the stunning Isle of Skye on a 4-day photography adventure, capturing iconic landscapes like the Old Man of Storr, Fairy Pools, Neist Point, and dramatic coastlines, guided by an expert through Scotland’s most breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: The Robert Burns Shore Experience
tours.description: Join a full-day private tour to explore Robert Burns' birthplace, including Dunure village, Burns Cottage, gardens, monument, and historic sites like Alloway Kirk and Tam o'Shanter Bridge, with scenic views and rich Scottish history.

tours.name: The Loch Lomond and Stirling Castle Shore Experience
tours.description: Journey through Scotland’s stunning landscapes, visit Loch Lomond’s villages, see Rob Roy’s waterfall, meet Highland coos, and explore Stirling Castle’s rich history—all in a full-day adventure.

tours.name: The Inveraray Shore Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s stunning landscapes, historic castles, and rugged glens on a full-day tour. Visit Inveraray Castle, Loch Lomond, and the 19th-century jail, with breathtaking views and rich stories at every stop.

tours.name: The Loch Ness Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland in a full-day tour: see Loch Lomond, Glencoe’s dramatic scenery, Loch Ness, and Urquhart Castle’s ancient ruins. Hear legendary stories, spot the monster, and enjoy breathtaking views all in one unforgettable trip.

tours.name: Scottish Whisky, Castles, Lochs and Waterfalls experience.
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s highlights in one day: visit historic castles, enjoy stunning views at Queens View, tour a family-owned distillery with tastings, and stroll through waterfalls and ancient forests—an unforgettable Scottish adventure.

tours.name: Two day Loch Ness and Scottish Highlands Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s stunning landscapes, legendary stories, and historic castles in a 2-day tour. Visit Loch Ness, Glencoe, Urquhart Castle, and enjoy whisky tasting, castle tours, and scenic hikes—all packed into an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: The Kelpies, Stirling Castle and Loch Lomond Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s highlights in one day: marvel at the towering Kelpies, walk through Stirling Castle’s historic halls, enjoy scenic views in Trossach National Park, and relax by Loch Lomond’s charming shores.

tours.name: The Ayrshire Coast, Culzean Castle and Robert Burns Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s heart with a 9.5-hour tour of Ayrshire’s stunning sights, from Burns’ birthplace and cottage to Culzean Castle and the historic Brig o’ Doon. Walk in Burns’ footsteps and enjoy breathtaking coastal views.

tours.name: The 2-day Outlander Experience
tours.description: Join a thrilling Outlander tour through Scotland’s historic castles, villages, and filming locations. Walk in Jamie and Claire’s footsteps, explore iconic sites, and relive the series’ most memorable moments in stunning settings.

tours.name: The 3-day Outlander Experience
tours.description: Join this thrilling Outlander tour to explore iconic Scottish locations like Culross, Blackness Castle, Lallybroch, and Doune Castle, where unforgettable scenes of Jamie and Claire's adventures come to life.

tours.name: Corporate - Bodiam
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable team-building adventure with Epic Life! Enjoy a day of laughter and skill-building as you paddle through scenic waters. This unique escape from the office fosters camaraderie and creates lasting memories, ensuring everyone leaves with stories of bravery and fun. Get ready for an epic corporate adventure!

tours.name: Stag & Hen Parties (Tonbridge)
tours.description: Experience unforgettable fun with our water activities, perfect for stag and hen parties! Choose from paddleboarding, river adventures, or competing on MegaSups at Hastings or the River Medway. Enjoy 1-2 hours of excitement while creating lasting memories with friends. Get ready for an adventure like no other!

tours.name: Stag & Hen Parties (Hastings)
tours.description: Organize an unforgettable Stag or Hen Party with exciting water activities in Hastings! Choose from paddleboarding, kayaking, or competing on MegaSups for 1-3 hours of fun. All equipment is provided, ensuring a memorable experience filled with laughter and adventure. Create lasting memories with friends in a stunning seaside setting!

tours.name: Mega-SUP (Bodiam)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Mega SUP sessions, where 4-8 friends can paddle together on giant boards! Enjoy the stunning river views while coordinating your movements for a fun-filled adventure. Perfect for all skill levels, this unique activity combines laughter and teamwork, making it an unforgettable outing for everyone.

tours.name: Learn to Lead Trad (Dartmoor)
tours.description: Join an immersive one or two-day climbing course at the stunning Irish Man's Wall in Dartmoor. Gain essential skills for leading traditional routes, including equipment selection and anchor building. With expert guidance and hands-on practice, this adventure promises to elevate your climbing experience and boost your confidence in the great outdoors.

tours.name: Rope Rigging Course
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating climbing adventure with this hands-on course in Dartmoor! Over 6-8 hours, you'll master essential skills like route selection, rope management, and safety techniques, guided by an expert instructor. Bring your adventurous spirit and prepare for an unforgettable experience in the great outdoors!

tours.name: Bespoke Adventures
tours.description: Embark on a personalized adventure with Laurence, who will help you create unforgettable experiences tailored to your vision. Whether it's a half or full day, enjoy expert guidance, stunning locations, and the thrill of exploration. Prepare for an exciting journey filled with nature, camaraderie, and a touch of adventure!

tours.name: Roman London - Discover Londinium!
tours.description: Step back in time with a 3.5-hour tour exploring Roman London’s ruins, including the amphitheatre and temple, and uncover stories that bring the ancient city to life before your eyes.

tours.name: Hampton Court by train
tours.description: Explore Hampton Court Palace and its stunning gardens on a 6.5-hour private tour, including train tickets, entrance, and expert guidance—step into royal history and lush landscapes in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: East End Street Art Tour
tours.description: Explore London's East End, an open-air art gallery filled with vibrant murals. Walk through lively streets, see stunning street art, and uncover the stories behind the urban masterpieces in this 3.5-hour tour.

tours.name: Distance Paddle - Tonbridge
tours.description: Join us for an exhilarating hour on the River Medway, where paddlers of all levels can test their skills in a timed distance challenge. Track your progress and improve your paddling technique while enjoying the beautiful scenery. It's a unique opportunity to compete and connect with fellow water enthusiasts!

tours.name: Progression Session | Tonbridge
tours.description: Join us for an exhilarating 1.5-hour paddling session on the River Medway, where expert instructors will enhance your speed and technique. Experience personalized coaching that will elevate your performance and transform your paddling skills, making this a unique opportunity to improve and enjoy the water like never before.

tours.name: Londra in un giorno - Low Cost
tours.description: Explore London's top sights in a single day with an Italian guide, visiting Westminster, the Tower, and the National Gallery. Ride a historic bus and enjoy an indoor-friendly tour perfect for rainy days.

tours.name: Progression Session | Hastings Beach
tours.description: Join us for a 1.5-hour paddling session at Hastings Beach, where expert instructors will help you enhance your speed and refine your techniques. This unique experience focuses on boosting your performance, ensuring you leave with improved skills and confidence on the water. Don't miss this opportunity to elevate your paddling!

tours.name: Learn to Lead Sport (1 day)
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-day climbing course designed to elevate your skills from the gym to the great outdoors. Focused on leading, you'll learn essential techniques like equipment selection and route retreat while exploring stunning locations. Join fellow adventurers for a memorable day filled with excitement and personal growth.

tours.name: Street Art Tour Nell’ East End
tours.description: Explore London's East End through vibrant street art, historic sites, and authentic cuisine. Capture fleeting murals, visit vintage shops, and uncover stories from Jack the Ripper, all while experiencing the neighborhood’s lively, multicultural vibe.

tours.name: Tour Musicale di Londra (IT)
tours.description: Explore Soho’s vibrant music scene, from legendary studios and iconic venues to rare vinyl shops. Walk where Beatles and Bowie once performed, see rock memorabilia, and relive London’s swinging 60s cultural revolution.

tours.name: Tate to Tate
tours.description: Explore art that challenges social ideals and history, from Moore's sculptures to Turner's vibrant paintings. Discover diverse, innovative works that question culture, promote equality, and reflect society’s evolving story.

tours.name: Oxford by train
tours.description: Travel from London to Oxford by train, exploring historic colleges, legendary halls, and ancient pubs. See Einstein’s equations, Marconi’s radios, and Hogwarts-inspired architecture, then enjoy local crafts at a vibrant market.

tours.name: Soho Music Tour
tours.description: Explore Soho’s vibrant music history, from legendary venues and iconic album covers to rare vinyls and rock memorabilia. Walk where stars debuted, uncover stories of the 60s cultural revolution, and see where music legends once performed.

tours.name: In the footsteps of the Boy Wizard
tours.description: Step into London’s wizarding world: visit Diagon Alley’s filming spots, cross the Millennium Bridge, explore magical bookstores, see the Harry Potter statue, and board the Hogwarts Express at King's Cross. An enchanting adventure awaits.

tours.name: Brighton by train
tours.description: Travel from London to Brighton by train, passing scenic landscapes. Explore vibrant streets, historic architecture, colorful graffiti, the Royal Pavilion, lively pier, and spot famous artists in this creative seaside city.

tours.name: Cambridge by train
tours.description: Travel from King's Cross to Cambridge, marvel at Gothic architecture, punt along the River Cam past iconic bridges, explore historic colleges, visit world-class museums, and uncover stories of legendary scholars.

tours.name: U24s Heritage Sailing Experience
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing aboard the historic wooden ship Excelsior! Engage in hands-on activities like raising sails and manning the tiller while uncovering the fascinating history of this remarkable vessel. Perfect for groups, this unique 8-hour adventure promises unforgettable memories on the open water.

tours.name: Boat tour and visit to Greenwich
tours.description: Enjoy a 4-hour boat tour showcasing London's iconic sights, then explore Greenwich's rich naval history, stunning architecture, and the Prime Meridian, with visits to the Cutty Sark, Maritime Museum, and Royal Observatory.

tours.name: London in one day
tours.description: Explore London's iconic sights in 6.5 hours: from Big Ben and Westminster Abbey to Trafalgar Square, Tate Modern, and the stunning Tower Bridge, with a scenic stop at St. Katharine’s Dock.

tours.name: Windsor Castle by Train
tours.description: Explore Windsor Castle’s royal history, stunning art, and Gothic architecture. Walk through monarchs’ tombs, see Queen Mary’s intricate dollhouse, and enjoy panoramic views—then choose to explore Windsor or sail the Thames.

tours.name: Highclare Castle and Cotswolds by Taxi
tours.description: Step into "Downton Abbey" with a tour of grand rooms, lush gardens, and scenic parkland at Highclere Castle, surrounded by 1,000 acres of breathtaking landscape crafted by Capability Brown.

tours.name: Blenheim Palace and Christ Church College in Oxford
Kayak & SUP Hire Hastings
tours.description: Embark on your own aquatic adventure with our paddleboards and kayaks, perfect for exploring the stunning coastline at your own pace. Enjoy the thrill of paddling with family or friends, and keep an eye out for seals! Experience the freedom of the sea while creating unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Architectural Tour
tours.description: Explore London's evolving skyline on a 2.5-hour tour, from historic Paternoster Square to futuristic skyscrapers and green rooftops, blending old charm with modern innovation and sustainable design.

tours.name: Tour di Architettura
tours.description: Explore London's modern skyline and historic charm in 2.5 hours. Walk from St. Paul’s to the City’s vibrant mix of innovative buildings, green spaces, and iconic landmarks blending past and future.

tours.name: Tour degli stadi: Stamford Bridge e Craven Cottage
tours.description: Join a passionate guide to explore Chelsea and Fulham football history, iconic stadiums, legendary trophies, and local pubs. Walk through storied grounds, see rare memorabilia, and feel the true spirit of London’s classic football culture.

tours.name: Stadium tour: Stamford Bridge and Craven Cottage
tours.description: Explore London’s football history with stadium tours of Chelsea and Fulham, visit iconic museums, see legendary trophies, walk through historic neighborhoods, and enjoy authentic pubs—all in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: British Museum and Camden Town
tours.description: Explore the British Museum’s ancient treasures, from Egyptian mummies to Greek friezes, then hop on a double-decker to vibrant Camden Market’s quirky shops filled with colors, scents, and one-of-a-kind finds.

tours.name: City of London: Templars and Museum of London
tours.description: Explore London's historic alleys, see the Royal Court of Justice, visit Twinings' 300-year-old shop, ride a double-decker to St. Paul’s, and uncover the city’s rich history at the Museum of London.

tours.name: Evening Tour And Boat On The River Thames
tours.description: Explore historic pubs near London Bridge, soar above the city from iconic skyscrapers, wander through world-famous museums at night, walk Victorian East End with Jack the Ripper, and enjoy lively neighborhoods like Soho and Chinatown after dark.

tours.name: Natural History Museum and Kensington Garden
tours.description: Explore London's highlights in 3.5 hours: marvel at dinosaur fossils, admire art masterpieces, stroll through Hyde Park, see Kensington Palace, and visit iconic landmarks—all perfect for families and curious travelers.

tours.name: Westminster and the National Gallery
tours.description: Join a 3.5-hour adventure filled with thrilling sights and unforgettable moments. Dive into the experience and create memories that will last a lifetime.

tours.name: Learn to Lead 2 day Sport
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating two-day course in Portland that equips you with essential skills for leading sport climbing routes. Learn about equipment selection, belaying, and building anchors while enjoying hands-on practice in diverse scenarios. Perfect for adventure seekers ready to elevate their climbing experience and confidence!

tours.name: SUP Distance Training | Tonbridge
tours.description: Join our SUP Distance Training sessions to boost your paddling speed and endurance! Tailored for all levels, you'll engage in timed trials, longer paddles, and interval training on the scenic River Medway. Perfect for those preparing for the Medway Canoe Challenge, this experience promises to elevate your skills and stamina.

tours.name: Epic Wales White water Trip
tours.description: Experience the thrill of white-water paddling in the stunning landscapes of North Wales! Join a three-day adventure with expert instruction, progressing from calm waters to exhilarating rapids. Stay in a cozy log cabin by the River Dee, complete with a hot tub for relaxation after an action-packed day.

tours.name: The ClanLands Experience
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s rich heritage with visits to Falkland Palace, St Andrews, a gin distillery tour, and the charming fishing village of Pittenweem. A full-day adventure filled with history, scenery, and local flavors.

tours.name: Travel Planning
tours.description: Experience London like a local with a personalized itinerary tailored to your interests and schedule. After a brief video call, you'll receive expert insights that reveal hidden gems and must-see attractions, ensuring a memorable trip. Let a local guide you through the city’s wonders at your own pace.

tours.name: Rockstars Grom (under 18)
tours.description: Join RTBA's Freestyle community for under-18s and dive into the thrilling world of freestyle kayaking! With expert coaching, monthly venue visits, and a supportive network of fellow paddlers, you'll enhance your skills while enjoying unique experiences. Don't miss the annual Rockstars Euro Invasion trip for unforgettable adventures on the water!

tours.name: Rockstars Seniors (18+)
tours.description: Join RTBA's Freestyle Community for an exhilarating 3-hour experience that combines expert coaching with the thrill of freestyle kayaking. Each month, explore new venues, enhance your skills, and connect with fellow paddlers. Benefit from personalized development plans and participate in the annual Rockstars Invasion trip for unforgettable adventures!

tours.name: Discover Kayaking (Learn to Kayak)
tours.description: Join our Learn to Kayak course for an exciting introduction to the world of kayaking! Over four weeks, you'll receive personalized coaching, learn essential techniques, and gain confidence on the water. Experience the thrill of maneuvering your kayak while enjoying the beauty of nature in a safe and supportive environment.

tours.name: Intro River Skills - White Water Kayak
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating two-day whitewater kayaking course designed to elevate your paddling skills from flat water to grade 2/3 rapids. With expert coaches guiding you through essential techniques, you'll gain confidence and poise on the river. Experience the thrill of navigating real rivers across various stunning UK and European locations.

tours.name: Discover Navigation
tours.description: Join us for an immersive 6.5-hour experience where you'll master the art of navigation! Whether you're a novice or a seasoned walker, learn to read maps and use a compass with expert guidance. Expand your skills and confidence while exploring the great outdoors in a fun and engaging way!

tours.name: Rock the Boat Rambles
tours.description: Experience the stunning beauty of the Surrey Hills on a two-hour countryside ramble. With breathtaking scenery at every turn, this guided adventure promises an unforgettable exploration of the English landscape. Join Rock the Boat for a memorable journey through nature's finest offerings.

tours.name: Intro River Skills - WW Canoe
tours.description: Embark on a two-day adventure to enhance your canoeing skills in a stunning river setting. Tailored coaching focuses on personal paddling, safety, and canoe setup, ensuring a unique experience that aligns with your goals. With expert guidance and an individualized action plan, you'll leave ready to tackle new challenges.

tours.name: Progressive River Skills - WW Canoe
tours.description: Join our progressive canoe river skills course to elevate your paddling expertise! Over two days, experienced coaches will tailor an action plan to enhance your skills in personal paddling, decision-making, and safety. Experience the thrill of natural rivers across the UK while achieving your personal canoeing goals.

tours.name: Private Coached Session
tours.description: Rock The Boat Activities offers personalized coaching sessions for paddlers of all levels, focusing on Freestyle Kayaking, Canoeing, Kayaking, and Stand Up Paddle Boarding. Tailored to your needs, these sessions provide expert feedback and a fun, structured approach to enhance skills, build confidence, and achieve personal goals in paddlesport.

tours.name: Mountaineering - Public tour
tours.description: Climb Wales' stunning peaks with expert guides, choosing routes from popular summits to hidden trails. Enjoy wild swimming, map skills, and wild camping for an unforgettable mountain adventure.

tours.name: Mountaineering - Private tour
tours.description: Climb Welsh peaks with expert guides, exploring popular trails or hidden gems. Enjoy wild swimming, learn navigation, and sleep under stars—creating unforgettable mountain adventures tailored to your skill level.

tours.name: Seimineáir na Nollag - Seimineár 1 - Bunleibhéal/Beginners
tours.description: Uncover the basics of Irish sounds in this beginner-friendly online seminar. Learn how letters sound and get started with Irish phonics in a clear, engaging way designed for new learners.

tours.name: Seimineáir na Nollag - Seimineár 2 - Meánleibhéal/Intermediate
tours.description: Uncover the secrets of the verbal noun in Irish with this engaging bilingual seminar. Perfect for intermediate learners, it clarifies tricky questions and deepens your understanding—all from the comfort of your home.

tours.name: Seimineáir na Nollag - Seimineár 3 - Ardleibhéal/Advanced
tours.description: Join our advanced Irish seminar on An Tuiseal Ginideach, delivered entirely in Irish. Perfect for fluent speakers eager to deepen their understanding of this key grammatical case.

tours.name: The Ayrshire and Arran Experience - 3 Day tour
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s miniature wonderland on Arran: ancient castles, Neolithic stones, stunning beaches, whisky tours, and the birthplace of Robert Burns—all in one unforgettable day.

tours.name: Pedal & Paddle from Canterbury to Margate
tours.description: Embark on a captivating city-to-coast adventure through the picturesque Kent countryside and coast. Paddle the River Stour, discovering diverse wildlife and charming villages, while enjoying a delightful tea shop and a cozy country pub lunch. Conclude your journey in Margate, exploring its vibrant dining scene and breathtaking sunset.

tours.name: Paddle & Pick
tours.description: Join EpicLife for a unique 1.5-hour Paddle & Pick experience, where you can enjoy a social outing with friends while helping to clean our waterways. Discover the surprising amount of litter, including unusual finds, and participate in your own litter pick with provided equipment. Make a difference while having fun!

tours.name: Wild Wales / Cymru Wyllt
tours.description: Experience a rejuvenating weekend on the stunning Gower Peninsula, Wales, with wild swimming, invigorating hikes, and beach yoga. Enjoy wholesome vegetarian meals in shared accommodations while connecting with fellow adventurers through inspiring talks and open-mic sessions. Embrace nature and camaraderie in this unique coastal retreat, limited to just 35 participants.

tours.name: PADI Scuba Diver
tours.description: Learn to dive in just 1.5 hours with the PADI Scuba Diver course. Dive up to 12 meters under expert supervision, rent gear, and start your underwater adventure—perfect for those short on time but eager to explore.

tours.name: PADI Advanced Open Water Diver
tours.description: Boost your diving skills with five exciting adventure dives in a weekend. Gain confidence, control, and safety while exploring new underwater experiences with expert guidance.

tours.name: Skin Diver - Snorkeling
tours.description: Learn to breathe, check buoyancy, and perform effortless surface dives in 1.5 hours. Perfect for exploring underwater life up close, whether in lakes or oceans, with expert guidance and safety precautions.

tours.name: Discover Snorkelling
tours.description: Dive into the underwater world with a fun, 2-hour snorkelling session led by expert divers. Explore vibrant marine life, learn quick skills, but remember—water activities carry risks. Safety first!

tours.name: Turas Gaeltachta (Remainder - £130.00)
tours.description: Join us in Donegal’s Gaeltacht to hear Irish from native speakers. Stay two nights at Teach Jack with breakfast, one evening meal, and a fun program—no transport included. Book early to secure your spot.

tours.name: Turas Gaeltachta (Full Price - £200.00)
tours.description: Immerse yourself in Donegal’s Gaeltacht, hearing Irish from native speakers. Enjoy two nights’ B&B at Teach Jack, Gweedore, with an evening meal and engaging events—book early, transport not included.

tours.name: Custom Coaching Session - Full Day
tours.description: Experience a personalized coaching session designed to elevate your mountain biking skills, regardless of your level. Over five hours, focus on your specific goals with expert guidance and video analysis. Whether mastering jumps or preparing for races, this tailored approach ensures a memorable and impactful learning experience.

tours.name: Custom Coaching Session - Half Day
tours.description: Experience a personalized 2.5-hour coaching session designed to enhance your mountain biking skills, regardless of your level. Focus on your specific goals with expert guidance and video analysis. Whether mastering the basics or tackling technical challenges, this tailored approach ensures a memorable and impactful learning experience.

tours.name: Family MTB Day
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable family day biking through the forest! This inclusive adventure allows you to explore nature, learn new things, and enjoy quality time together. With a maximum group size of five, you can create lasting memories while riding and having fun. Don't forget to pack your own snacks and drinks!

tours.name: Coaching for Kids - Custom groups
tours.description: Gather your friends for an unforgettable 2.5-hour coaching session designed for young shredders! Experience the thrill of biking while enhancing skills in a fun, supportive environment. Perfect for birthdays, this adventure promises excitement and camaraderie, ensuring lasting memories on the trails. Don't forget your helmet and hydration!

tours.name: Locals favourites- Dumfries and Galloway
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2.5-hour guided mountain biking adventure through the stunning local forests. With expert guidance, explore hidden trails tailored to your skill level, from mellow paths at Dalbeattie to challenging singletrack at Forest of Ae. Discover the best of the region's diverse terrain and unforgettable scenery!

tours.name: Surf kayak coaching 1 to 1
tours.description: Experience personalized surfing coaching with dedicated one-on-one sessions tailored to your skill level and goals. Choose between a half-day or full-day format, ensuring focused attention from expert coaches. Enjoy the thrill of advancing your surfing abilities in a location chosen for optimal conditions, making each session unique and memorable.

tours.name: Surf kayak group coaching
tours.description: Experience the thrill of surf kayaking in a small group setting, where you can learn and share the excitement with fellow enthusiasts. Tailored coaching sessions foster camaraderie and skill development, making each outing memorable. Join us for half or full-day adventures, with locations confirmed based on weather conditions.

tours.name: Surf Kayak Leader Training
tours.description: Join the BCAB Surf Kayak Leader Training Course on October 7th-8th at Gwithian, following an exciting symposium weekend. This course is the perfect opportunity for aspiring leaders to gain essential skills for guiding surf paddlers in moderate surf, setting the stage for unforgettable adventures on the water.

tours.name: Rock Climbing Experience Dartmoor
tours.description: Experience the thrill of outdoor climbing on Dartmoor's stunning rock formations, perfect for beginners and seasoned adventurers alike. Enjoy breathtaking views while tackling a variety of routes, from easy climbs to challenging overhangs. With expert guidance and all safety gear provided, this is an unforgettable day of adventure with friends and family.

tours.name: Guía Londres Esencial
tours.description: Explore London like never before with this essential guide, featuring famous landmarks and hidden gems. Navigate through historic sites, vibrant markets, and stunning views along the Thames. Each stop offers insights, photo spots, and local recommendations, allowing you to discover the city's treasures at your own pace. Download now!

tours.name: Interschool Climbing Competition Braunton Academy
tours.description: Join the excitement of the inter schools climbing competition and help reclaim the 2022 title! Experience a fun-filled day of top rope, speed, and bouldering challenges while meeting new friends. This event emphasizes enjoyment over seriousness, making it a memorable opportunity for climbers of all levels.

tours.name: Pembrokeshire Surfari trip (the bitches)
tours.description: Join four days of surf coaching or guided trips, riding waves during ideal tides. Perfect for learning and adventure, with camping options nearby—an unforgettable coastal experience awaits.

tours.name: National Outdoor Expo Social
tours.description: Join the Love Her Wild team at TGI Fridays after the expo for a lively social with drinks, food, and friends. Open to all supporters—connect, relax, and celebrate outdoor adventures together.

tours.name: Will's Test 2
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 35-minute walking tour of Montmartre, led by local historian James and journalist Alice. Discover the neighborhood's rich cultural heritage, learn about its famous residents, and enjoy breathtaking views, all while exploring the hidden gems that most tourists miss. Experience the authentic essence of Paris!

tours.name: British Canoeing  Awarding Body Sup Safer Course • Bodiam
tours.description: Join the British Canoeing Sup Safety course for an engaging four-hour adventure on sheltered waters. Perfect for beginners and novice paddleboarders, this small-group experience covers essential equipment, safety, and environmental awareness, ensuring you gain valuable skills while enjoying a fun and friendly atmosphere. Don't miss this unique opportunity to enhance your paddleboarding knowledge!

tours.name: British Canoeing Sup Safety Course • Tonbridge
tours.description: Join the British Canoeing Sup Safety course for an engaging four-hour adventure on sheltered waters. Perfect for beginners and novice paddleboarders, this small-group experience covers essential safety, equipment, and environmental awareness in a fun atmosphere. Enhance your paddling skills while enjoying a supportive learning environment with fellow enthusiasts.

tours.name: Kids Adventure Club
tours.description: Kids aged 8-14 can unleash their energy in a 3-hour adventure, mastering archery, bushcraft, and splashing around with kayaking, paddleboarding, and MegaSup—an action-packed morning they won’t forget.

tours.name: Young Explorers
tours.description: Join us for an enchanting 3.5-hour Forest School session designed for children aged 6-12, where they will explore nature, engage their senses, and enjoy activities like games, fire lighting, and whittling. Led by our qualified instructor, Teresa, this unique experience takes place in the stunning woodlands of Bodiam, East Sussex.

tours.name: Family Forest School Sessions
tours.description: Enjoy a 2-hour family adventure in East Sussex woods with games, storytelling, fire-making, den building, and more—perfect for kids aged 4-12. Create memories together in nature’s playground.

tours.name: Kids Forest School Party
tours.description: Celebrate your birthday in the enchanting woods of Bodiam with a unique woodland party! Led by a qualified Forest School Leader, enjoy two hours of adventure filled with den building, cooking, and stream jumping. Gather around the campfire for toasted marshmallows, hot chocolate, and unforgettable memories in nature.

tours.name: The Outlander Photography Tour
tours.description: Capture Scotland’s iconic Outlander sites—walk through castles, gardens, and historic towns, all perfect for photography. Follow in Jamie and Claire’s footsteps on a tailored adventure from Glasgow or Edinburgh.

tours.name: The Edinburgh Photography Tour
tours.description: Capture Edinburgh’s stunning architecture and historic charm on a fun, beginner-friendly photography tour. Snap iconic sights like Edinburgh Castle, Calton Hill, and Royal Mile’s hidden gems. Perfect for all skill levels.

tours.name: Ceol na bPíob : R.L. O’Mealy Piping Concert
tours.description: Celebrate R.L. O’Mealy’s legacy with top pipers in Belfast, blending tradition and innovation. Feel the rich cross-community spirit of Irish music at this unforgettable concert.

tours.name: Transfer
tours.description: Experience the ultimate in travel comfort with our luxury minivan service. Enjoy a private and stylish ride tailored for any transfer, ensuring a memorable journey. Indulge in the convenience and elegance that sets our service apart, making every trip a delightful experience.

tours.name: Holywood Food & Drink Tour
tours.description: Embark on a 3.5-hour culinary adventure in Holywood, exploring vibrant new venues and local suppliers while savoring delicious food and drinks. This unique tour blends history with gastronomy, offering a memorable experience for food enthusiasts. Please note, the tour is for ages 18 and over, with dietary concerns accommodated.

tours.name: Historic London: Secrets of Westminster
tours.description: Uncover Westminster’s hidden secrets in a 4-hour private tour. Walk historic streets, see iconic landmarks like Big Ben and Buckingham Palace, enjoy secret cafes, and hear tales of royal intrigue and ancient London.

tours.name: Private  Prestwick Airport Walking or Car Tour
tours.description: Embark on a unique walking tour of Prestwick Airfield, exploring its rich history from 1913 to today. Discover the evolution of aviation, from early pioneers to modern transatlantic travel. Enjoy complimentary refreshments, a souvenir brochure, and the chance to learn about the fascinating interplay of civilian and military aviation.

tours.name: Besom Broom Making Workshop - Ceardlann Déanta na Scuab Caillí
tours.description: Create your own traditional Besom Broom from local, natural materials, while sharing Samhain stories by the fire. A full-day workshop with lunch, blending craft, folklore, and celebration. Limited spots available.

tours.name: Bealtaine -  Peak of the light
tours.description: Uncover the rich stories and traditions of Imbolg, immersing yourself in ancient customs and festive rituals that bring this vibrant celebration to life.

tours.name: Tall Ships Races | Klaipeda-Helsinki
tours.description: Join Excelsior for an unforgettable 7-day adventure in the 2024 Tall Ships Races! Sail the stunning Baltic Sea alongside magnificent tall ships, explore vibrant Lithuanian and Finnish cultures, and enjoy lively crew parties. This unique experience is perfect for young adventurers seeking camaraderie and a chance to earn their Gold Duke of Edinburgh Award.

tours.name: Harbouring Potential 2023
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable sailing adventure that immerses young people in the offshore world. Gain practical sailing skills while exploring marine traffic, wildlife, and the UK's largest wind farms. Guided by experienced crew, this unique experience offers valuable insights for those considering careers in offshore engineering or renewable energy.

tours.name: Rockstar Rippers
tours.description: Experience the thrill of freestyle kayaking with Rock The Boat's 'Rockstars' program. Led by expert coaches, this monthly clinic offers personalized guidance, community building, and insights into new venues and techniques. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your skills, join fellow paddlers and elevate your freestyle journey.

tours.name: Dartmoor Advanced Development Day - (Grade 3/4)
tours.description: Join an exhilarating Dartmoor Advanced Development Day, where expert coaches tailor your paddling experience to meet your goals. Whether you're tackling the upper Dart for the first time or seeking to master the East Lyn, this unique opportunity offers personalized guidance in small groups, ensuring an unforgettable adventure on the water.

tours.name: Dartmoor Development Day - (Grade 2/3)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of paddling on Dartmoor's stunning waters this winter! Join our expert coaching team for a personalized development day, tailored to enhance your skills, whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your technique. With small group sizes, you'll receive focused attention to help you achieve your paddling goals.

tours.name: Slí na Sí
tours.description: Journey through Ireland’s fairy world with magical stops featuring gods, goddesses, and mythical messages. End in 'the otherworld' with music, crafts, face painting, and traditional games for a fun-filled family adventure.

tours.name: Tour Privado Westminster
tours.description: Enjoy a private, leisurely tour with an exclusive guide visiting Trafalgar Square, Buckingham Palace, St. James Park, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, and historic royal shops—without crowds or interruptions.

tours.name: One day Outlander tour from Edinburgh
tours.description: Visit iconic Outlander filming locations in Scotland, including castles, villages, and historic sites. Walk in Jamie and Claire’s footsteps, explore ancient castles, and relive your favorite scenes from the hit TV series.

tours.name: Scottish Whisky, Castles, Lochs and Waterfalls from Edinburgh
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s highlights in one day: tour a renowned whisky distillery, walk through historic Blair Castle, enjoy stunning views at Queens View, and relax amid waterfalls and ancient forests at The Hermitage.

tours.name: The Braveheart Experience from Edinburgh
tours.description: Walk through Scotland’s history with visits to Stirling Castle, the Wallace Monument, and Bannockburn. Touch legendary battles, see historic sights, and step into medieval warfare in an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: The Scottish Highlands From Edinburgh
tours.description: Explore Scotland’s stunning Highlands in a day: towering forests, roaring waterfalls, whisky tasting at Scotland’s highest distillery, historic Glencoe, scenic lochs, and playful Highland coos—an unforgettable adventure in nature and history.

tours.name: Tate Modern Gallery: Highlights and Gems
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 3-hour private tour of the Tate Modern Museum, where you'll delve into the world of modern art. Admire iconic works by masters like Matisse and Pollock, uncover hidden gems, and enjoy exclusive city views—all while engaging with fascinating stories that bring the art to life.

tours.name: Mile Builder
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day sailing adventure through the stunning Balearic Islands, where you'll build skills and camaraderie aboard a luxurious Bavaria 56. Engage in all aspects of sailing while enjoying comfortable accommodations and breathtaking views. Experience the freedom of the sea, with safety and inclusivity at the heart of your journey.

tours.name: Start Yachting
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling two-day RYA Start Yachting course in the stunning Balearic Islands. Perfect for beginners, this hands-on adventure offers practical sailing skills, safety essentials, and the chance to steer a luxury yacht. Experience the camaraderie of fellow sailors while discovering the exhilarating sailing lifestyle in picturesque Mallorca.

tours.name: Scottish Expedition | Edinburgh - Stromness
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking 7-day sailing adventure from Scotland's capital to the enchanting Orkney islands. Experience the thrill of offshore sailing, explore charming fishing ports, and witness dramatic coastlines and stunning landscapes. This unique journey offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation, ideal for those seeking unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Tall Ships Races | Mariehamn - Szczecin
tours.description: Join Excelsior for an unforgettable 9-day adventure in the Tall Ships Races, sailing the breathtaking Baltic Sea. Experience vibrant crew parties, cultural exchanges in Poland and Finland, and the thrill of racing alongside magnificent tall ships. This unique opportunity also counts towards your Gold Duke of Edinburgh Award residential.

tours.name: Baltic Homecoming | Szczecin - Lowestoft
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 14-day sailing adventure with Excelsior's Homecoming voyage from Szczecin, Poland, to Lowestoft, UK. Experience the stunning western Baltic Sea, navigate the iconic Kiel Canal, and enjoy onboard meals and accommodation. Perfect for those seeking a unique challenge and a qualifying activity for the Gold Duke of Edinburgh Award.

tours.name: Tall Ships Races | Turku-Mariehamn
tours.description: Join Excelsior for an unforgettable 6-day adventure during the 2024 Tall Ships Races in the stunning Baltic Sea. Experience the thrill of sailing alongside magnificent tall ships, explore vibrant Estonian and Finnish cultures, and forge lifelong friendships. This unique journey promises breathtaking views, exciting crew events, and a chance to earn your Gold Duke of Edinburgh Award.

tours.name: Shetland - Lithuania
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 14-day sailing adventure with Excelsior, exploring the stunning Baltic Sea. Experience the excitement of navigating through Norway, Denmark, Sweden, and Poland, with the route tailored by the Skipper. Enjoy meals and overnight stays on board, creating unforgettable memories on this unique maritime journey.

tours.name: Nordic North Sea Adventure | Shetland - Sweden
tours.description: Embark on a unique 7-day North Sea adventure aboard Excelsior, sailing from Shetland to Norway's Svinør, her former home. Experience the thrill of offshore sailing and a warm Scandinavian welcome, before concluding your journey in Gothenburg, Sweden. Perfect for those seeking an unforgettable maritime experience!

tours.name: Baltic Aventure Sweden | Lithuania
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day sailing adventure from the west coast of Sweden into the enchanting Baltic Sea. Experience the beauty of summer cruising, with potential stops at vibrant ports like Copenhagen and Gdynia, culminating in the spectacular Tall Ships Races in Klaipeda. Perfect for adventure seekers aged 14 and up!

tours.name: Black Water Estuary Mother’s Day Boat Cruise with Prosecco Lunch and Tour of Maldon
tours.description: Celebrate Mother's Day with a scenic 2-hour Maldon sail, passing Osea Island, enjoying prosecco and light snacks. Finish with a delicious roast lunch in a cozy cabin—an unforgettable day out.

tours.name: Ryan Molloy and Bríd Harper
tours.description: Enjoy a captivating Irish music experience with renowned fiddler Bríd Harper and composer Ryan Molloy, blending traditional tunes and contemporary sounds in an unforgettable live performance.

tours.name: Belsonic Farmers Bash - 12th June 2026
tours.description: Travel comfortably to Belsonic’s Farmers Bash on June 12, avoiding parking stress. Pick-ups from Larne, Whitehead, and Carrickfergus, with a relaxed return after the concert—all without alcohol or hassle.

tours.name: Dewerstone Social Rambles
tours.description: Discover the enchanting landscapes of Dartmoor National Park with Dewestone Adventures' Social Rambles. Led by knowledgeable guides, this leisurely two to three-hour journey through ancient woodlands and moorlands invites all skill levels to connect with nature. Enjoy a unique outdoor experience filled with scenic beauty and camaraderie.

tours.name: Guided Hike (Half Day)
tours.description: Embark on a half-day hike through the stunning landscapes of Dartmoor National Park with expert guides from Dewerstone Adventures. This enriching experience invites you to connect with nature while enjoying breathtaking views. Bring your sense of adventure and essential gear for an unforgettable exploration of this beautiful region.

tours.name: Golden Glow SUP Social Paddle
tours.description: Join us for an unforgettable evening on the scenic waters of Totnes with our Sunset SUP Adventures. Experience the tranquility of paddling at sunset, surrounded by stunning views. Bring your swimwear and snacks, and reserve your spot for this unique opportunity to connect with nature and enjoy a memorable adventure.

tours.name: 2 Day Coastal Kayaking Expedition
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 2-day Coastline Explorer Sea Kayak Adventure, where you'll paddle through hidden coves, camp on sandy beaches under the stars, and enjoy a cozy campfire evening. With expert guides and optional fishing, this unforgettable experience combines exploration, relaxation, and camaraderie along the stunning coastline.

tours.name: BCAB Paddlesport Safety and Rescue
tours.description: Join the Paddlesport Safety and Rescue course to master essential rescue skills in a sheltered water environment. Over six engaging hours, you'll learn practical strategies for safety while paddling canoes, kayaks, or stand-up paddleboards. With no assessments and expert guidance, gain confidence and knowledge to navigate water challenges effectively.

tours.name: BCAB Introduction to White Water Safety
tours.description: Embark on an exciting journey with the Introduction to White Water Safety course, perfect for novice paddlers eager to enhance their skills on grade 2 waters. Over six hours, explore essential techniques, safety strategies, and group dynamics while mastering rescues from kayaks, canoes, or paddleboards. Join us for an unforgettable adventure!

tours.name: BCAB White Water Safety - 2 Days
tours.description: Join this immersive 2-day White Water Safety course designed for paddlers eager to enhance their skills on grade 2(3) rivers. Experience hands-on training in emergency planning, rescue techniques, and safety protocols through realistic scenarios. Gain confidence and independence while mastering essential skills for safe paddling adventures.

tours.name: BCAB Advanced White Water Safety
tours.description: Enhance your skills with the Advanced White Water Safety and Rescue Training course, tailored for experienced paddlers. Over two thrilling days, you'll navigate grade 3-4 rapids, applying advanced techniques in real scenarios. This immersive experience not only builds confidence but also prepares you for challenging water environments.

tours.name: BCAB Core Coach Training - 2 Days
tours.description: Embark on the exciting journey of becoming a coach with the Coach Awards! Over two immersive days, you'll explore essential coaching principles, develop your skills, and learn to effectively guide paddlers of all levels. With 18 disciplines to choose from, this training is a unique opportunity for personal and professional growth.

tours.name: BCAB Paddlesport Touring Leader Assessment
tours.description: Experience a unique, stress-free assessment to become a paddlesport touring leader. Over one or two days, showcase your paddling, leadership, and rescue skills in a supportive environment. With personalized guidance and a focus on enjoyment, this assessment ensures you feel confident and prepared for your paddling journey ahead.

tours.name: BCAB Paddlesport Touring Leader Training
tours.description: Embark on a transformative 2-day journey with the Paddle Sport Touring Leader program, designed for those eager to lead mixed craft trips on moderate inland waters. Enhance your leadership, rescue, and group skills through tailored training, ensuring you're well-prepared for successful assessments and unforgettable adventures on the water.

tours.name: BCAB White Water Kayak Coach Assessment
tours.description: Embark on a transformative journey to become a White Water Kayak Coach with a comprehensive one-day practical assessment. Showcase your paddling, rescue, and leadership skills while engaging in professional discussions. This unique opportunity not only tests your abilities but also prepares you for a rewarding coaching career in thrilling white water environments.

tours.name: BCAB White Water Kayak Coach Training
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating two-day training designed for aspiring coaches of white water kayaking. This hands-on course emphasizes technical and tactical skills, enabling you to create safe and engaging coaching sessions. Gain practical experience tailored to your learners and enhance your coaching philosophy in the dynamic white water environment.

tours.name: BCAB White Water Kayak Leader Training
tours.description: Enhance your kayaking leadership with this immersive two-day training focused on personal skills and safety in moderate white water. Gain hands-on experience in paddling techniques, rescue skills, and group dynamics, ensuring you’re well-prepared to lead others confidently on the water. Perfect for aspiring leaders ready to elevate their skills!

tours.name: BCAB White Water Kayak Leader Assessment
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-day assessment to become a White Water Kayak Leader. Test your paddling, rescue, and leadership skills on moderate white water, ensuring you’re equipped for thrilling river journeys. This practical experience is essential for those ready to take charge in dynamic aquatic environments.

tours.name: BCAB Advanced White Water Kayak Leader Training
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating two-day training designed for aspiring white water kayak leaders. This course hones advanced paddling, rescue, and leadership skills while navigating grade 3-4 rapids. Gain confidence in your abilities and deepen your understanding of safety and group dynamics in thrilling river environments.

tours.name: BCAB Freestyle Coach Assessment
tours.description: Embark on a transformative journey to become a Freestyle Coach with a hands-on, one-day assessment. Showcase your practical coaching, safety, and rescue skills while engaging in professional discussions. This unique opportunity not only tests your abilities but also prepares you for a rewarding coaching career in freestyle sports.

tours.name: BCAB Freestyle Coach Training
tours.description: Join a dynamic two-day Freestyle Coach Training that immerses you in the art of coaching technical and tactical skills for paddlers. Experience hands-on learning both in the classroom and on the water, culminating in real coaching practice with students. Elevate your coaching abilities while fostering a motivating environment for athletes.

tours.name: BCAB Paddle Sport Instructor Award
tours.description: Embark on an exciting two-day journey to become a certified paddlesport instructor! This hands-on course equips you with essential skills to engage and inspire new paddlers through fun games and activities. Perfect for anyone aged 14 and over, it’s your chance to ignite a passion for adventure on the water!

tours.name: BCAB Paddle Sport Leader Assessment
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey to become a Paddlesport Leader in this hands-on, 8-hour assessment. Showcase your leadership, paddling, and rescue skills while deepening your knowledge and experience. This unique opportunity not only enhances your abilities but also prepares you for exciting adventures on the water.

tours.name: BCAB Paddle Sport Leader Training
tours.description: Embark on a transformative 2-day Paddlesport Leader training course designed to enhance your leadership, safety, and rescue skills. This hands-on experience allows you to create a personalized action plan, ensuring you’re well-prepared for assessment. No prerequisites are needed—just your enthusiasm to learn and grow in paddlesport leadership!

tours.name: First Aid At Work - FAA Level 3 - 16 Hour
tours.description: Join a comprehensive three-day First Aid course designed to equip you with essential skills for handling emergencies confidently and effectively. Covering a wide range of topics, from CPR to managing injuries, this training culminates in a recognized Level 3 qualification, ensuring you’re prepared to create a safe workplace environment.

tours.name: Emergency First Aid at Work - FAA Level 3 - 6 Hour
tours.description: Gain essential skills in emergency first aid with this comprehensive one-day course, designed to meet workplace safety regulations. Covering vital topics like resuscitation, choking, and bleeding control, participants will engage in practical and theoretical training. Successfully complete the course to earn a three-year qualification and ensure a safer workplace for all.

tours.name: First Aid At Work Requalification
tours.description: Join our engaging 2-day First Aid at Work requalification course, perfect for renewing your certification. Cover essential topics like CPR, choking, and injury management while gaining hands-on experience. With a maximum of 12 participants, you'll receive personalized instruction and earn a Level 3 Award, ensuring you're prepared for workplace emergencies.

tours.name: Outdoor First Aid - FAA Level 3 - 16 Hour
tours.description: Join this immersive two-day Outdoor First Aid course, designed for adventurers and Duke of Edinburgh award participants. Gain essential skills to manage emergencies in remote settings, with hands-on assessments leading to a Level 3 Award. Limited to 12 students, this experience ensures personalized attention and flexible scheduling for your convenience.

tours.name: School Holiday Club
tours.description: Join us for an exciting two-hour rock pooling adventure on Falmouth's shores! Children will explore and learn about the fascinating wildlife in the rock pools, discovering curious creatures along the way. Parents are welcome to join in the fun, making it a memorable experience for all ages!

tours.name: Ceolchoirm- Belfast Song Gathering Concert
tours.description: Join Belfast Song Gathering to immerse yourself in lively traditional music sessions, sing along with passionate musicians, and experience the vibrant Irish song culture in the heart of Belfast.

tours.name: First Aid at Work
tours.description: Gain essential life-saving skills with this comprehensive three-day First Aid course, designed to meet the highest standards of workplace safety. Limited to 12 participants, you'll receive hands-on training and assessments, culminating in a Level 3 Award valid for three years. Flexible scheduling ensures you can fit this vital qualification into your life.

tours.name: Cycling, Wild Swimming, Forest Bathing
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable outdoor adventure that blends cycling, wild swimming, and forest bathing. Led by expert physiotherapist Diarmuid Denneny, you'll benefit from his extensive knowledge in cold water therapy and woodland mindfulness, making this a unique opportunity to rejuvenate your body and mind in nature's embrace.

tours.name: SUP Adventure Weekend
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable adventure weekend in North Devon, where you'll enhance your stand-up paddleboarding skills while exploring stunning coastlines. Navigate through picturesque bays and caves, and ride the waves onto sandy beaches. This trip promises both excitement and skill development in one of the UK's most breathtaking coastal settings.

tours.name: Scotland Classics River Skills
tours.description: Join Rock The Boat Activities for an exhilarating five-day White Water Kayak Development Week in the breathtaking rivers of Scotland. Perfect for intermediate to advanced paddlers, this adventure offers expert coaching, a focus on safety, and the chance to forge friendships while creating unforgettable memories amidst Scotland's wild beauty.

tours.name: Turas Reilige. 02.03.25
tours.description: Join Sean Fennell for a guided cemetery tour at Reilig Chathair Bhéal Feirste. Walk through historic graves and uncover stories from the past, starting at the main gates—an unforgettable journey into local history.

tours.name: My Name is Rachel Corrie - Play
tours.description: A powerful play recounts Rachel Corrie’s brave stand in Gaza, based on her journals. Performed by Rosie McNally, it honors her courage and love amid ongoing Palestinian struggles. An evening of reflection and solidarity.

tours.name: South West Rafting Club
tours.description: Join the South Devon White Water Racing Club for an exhilarating adventure in raft racing! Founded by a former GB Team member, this club offers thrilling training and competition for all skill levels. Experience teamwork and excitement as you navigate rapids in various disciplines, from sprints to endurance races.

tours.name: BCAB White Water Leader Refresher and Assessment week
tours.description: Join a 5-day white water leader course to sharpen your skills, refresh safety techniques, and lead real groups. Perfect for aspiring leaders ready for assessment in grade 2/3 rivers.

tours.name: Paint and Pudding Night: Elkstone Tipi
tours.description: Unleash your creativity at Elkstone Studios with a fun, beginner-friendly 'Safari Sunset' painting. Guided step-by-step by an artist, enjoy seasonal puddings as you craft your masterpiece in a magical evening.

tours.name: Crafternoon Tea: Breast Cancer Now Fundraiser
tours.description: Experience an afternoon of creativity and compassion as you paint ceramic jugs while enjoying tea and cake. This unique workshop, hosted by Paint Pot Parties, supports Breast Cancer Now, with all profits going to the cause. Unleash your artistic side and make a difference in a fun, memorable way!

tours.name: BCAB Sheltered Water Canoe / Kayak Coach Discipline Specific Training
tours.description: Boost your whitewater skills in 2 days: master risk assessment, group management, and rescue techniques. Lead kayakers confidently through Grade 2/3 rapids with expert guidance and practical experience.

tours.name: HALLOWEEN Dunkertons Park: Decoupage Skulls
tours.description: Join Paint Pot Parties for a unique Halloween Paint & Sip Night at Dunkertons Park! Unleash your creativity by decorating Decoupage Skulls with vibrant patterns. No experience is needed—just bring your enthusiasm! Enjoy a festive atmosphere, delicious food, and drinks while crafting a memorable Halloween masterpiece. Spaces are limited, so reserve your spot!

tours.name: Paint and Pattie Night: Airs & Grace's, Cheltenham
tours.description: Join us for a creative Monday evening at The Airs & Graces in Cheltenham! Enjoy crafting your own masterpiece with expert guidance while savoring a delicious burger and fries. Each month features a unique project, with October showcasing Halloween Planters—perfect for getting into the festive spirit!

tours.name: Children's Pumpkin Painting: Dunkertons Park
tours.description: Join us for a magical morning at Dunkertons Park's Children's Pumpkin Painting Workshop! Kids will unleash their creativity by painting their own pumpkins with a variety of colors and accessories. Guided by experienced artists, this hands-on event promises Halloween fun, artistic expression, and delightful goodies to take home. Reserve your spot now!

tours.name: Children's Halloween Plant Pots: The Plough, Prestbury
tours.description: Join the Halloween Plant Pot Painting Workshop at The Plough Inn, Prestbury, for a creative and spooky experience! Perfect for all ages, you'll design your own Halloween-themed plant pot with provided materials and friendly guidance. Embrace the festive spirit and unleash your creativity in a fun, relaxed atmosphere!

tours.name: Paint and Pattie Night: Airs & Grace's, Cheltenham
tours.description: Join us for a unique Monday evening at The Airs & Graces in Cheltenham, where you can unleash your creativity by painting festive Wooden Ducks. Enjoy a delightful Burger & Fries while our artist guides you in crafting your own masterpiece. It's the perfect way to start your week with fun and creativity!

tours.name: Paint and Panettone: Topolys, Gloucester
tours.description: Create festive ceramic Christmas trees while savoring Italian desserts and drinks at Topoly’s in Gloucester. No experience needed—just bring your holiday spirit for a cozy, creative evening of fun and cheer.

tours.name: Sip, Paint & Be Merry! : Broadway Wine Company Collaboration
tours.description: Create a festive wooden duck ornament with cozy Christmas jumper designs, guided by friendly artists. Sip mulled wine, enjoy a mince pie, and get into the holiday spirit in a fun, relaxed evening of painting and cheer.

tours.name: Tall Ships Races 2026 Leg 1, Race 1: Aarhus to Harlingen
